x: The Seventh Battle of Ruusan was the final major engagement of the conflict known as the New Sith Wars.

Aquatic assault stormtroopers, also known as seatroopers or aquatic troopers, were a specialized branch of the Imperial stormtroopers. They were used by the Galactic Empire to maintain a presence on the many aquatic worlds under its rule.

The Zero-G assault stormtroopers, commonly known as spacetroopers, were members of a specialized branch of the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps equipped and trained to capture enemy vessels intact. They also operated within the Imperial Navy.
Dark Troopers were experimental soldiers created as part of the dark trooper program for the Galactic Republic and later Galactic Empire. Dark trooper models were body suits worn by a human pilot.

Cold assault stormtroopers, also known as Snowtroopers, were Imperial stormtroopers trained to operate in arctic climates. Some snowtroopers were deployed under Death Squadron's Blizzard Force, as well as other arctic forces.
Telos IV, often called simply Telos, was the fourth world within the Telos system, located in the Outer Rim's Kwymar sector.
Malachor V, or simply Malachor, was an Outer Rim planet located in the Malachor system. Prior to the final battle of the Mandalorian Wars, the planet was fertile and hospitable.
Abregado-rae, also known simply as Abregado and sometimes spelled Abregado-Rae, was a trade world located in the galaxy's Core Worlds. It was situated at the beginning of the Rimma Trade Route.

objective: Discover and colonize worlds in the Unknown Regions
x: Outbound Flight Project was a colonizing and expeditionary initiative by the Galactic Republic into the Unknown Regions, led mainly by Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth.
The Roche asteroid field, sometimes known simply as Roche, was a series of asteroids colonized by the Verpine, including Nickel One (the capital), Slayn, Korpil, Roche G42, and Shantipole.

The Corellian Security Force, commonly abbreviated CorSec, was the primary law enforcement agency of the Corellian system. CorSec was famous for its impressive success rate that relied on the great efficiency of its personnel.
N'zoth was the fifth planet in the N'zoth system, located in the Farlax sector in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the Yevetha.

The Battle of Dantooine took place during the Clone Wars in 22 BBY. One phase was fought on the grassy plains of Dantooine, pitting a small unit of the Grand Army of the Republic against a massive number of battle droids, while a later phase was fought at the same time as the …

The Tiss'shar were a species of predatory sentient therapod reptiles from the planet Tiss'sharl. They were comparatively strong, dexterous, and intelligent, possessing slender frames with long necks and short tails.
The Brentaal was a starship used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. It shared its name with the Core world Brentaal IV.

CoCo Town, also known as the Collective Commerce District or more simply as the Coco District, was a dilapidated industrial area of the planet Coruscant. It was also the site of Dex's Diner, a local eatery owned by Dexter Jettster during the Republic Era.
Mimbanites were one of the native races of the planet Mimban.

The Scimitar, also known as the Sith Infiltrator, was a heavily modified Star Courier and the personal starship of Darth Maul. After his defeat during the Battle of Naboo, the experimental starfighter was appropriated by Maul's master, Darth Sidious.

x: The treaty, having been suggested by Darth Vader to Marek, was actually a ploy by Emperor Palpatine to lure all of his enemies into a single place to capture them. Just as Bail Organa declared the treaty finalized, Imperial forces suddenly swarmed the building.

Despayre, originally known as Horuz, was a planet in the Horuz system in the Outer Rim Territories, that served as a massive penal and slave world for the Galactic Empire and as a location where the first Death Star was constructed and completed, after being relocated many tim…

The Battle of Mygeeto was one of the longest battles of the Clone Wars, lasting for two years and beginning in 21 BBY. In 19 BBY, it became part of the Galactic Republic's Outer Rim Sieges to secure the planets of the Outer Rim Territories.
TIE pilots served in the Starfighter Corps of the Imperial Navy by piloting the various TIE Series starfighters.
Imperial Navy Troopers, also known as Naval Troopers, Imperial fleet troopers, were the naval soldiers of the Imperial Navy, the space branch of the Galactic Empire's military.
Clan Fett was an ancient Mandalorian clan that could trace its lineage back as far as the Mandalorian Wars.

Wetland assault stormtroopers, nicknamed swamptroopers, were specialized stormtroopers trained and equipped to operate in forested wetlands and other semi-aquatic environments, such as lakes, rivers, and settlements built on or near waterways.
The Graveyard was the leftover remnants of the planet of Alderaan after its destruction by the first Death Star.
The Battle of Coruscant was one of several simultaneous engagements that constituted the Sith Empire's invasion of the Galactic Republic.

Vehicle Command Crewers, also known as Imperial Army pilots, were the Galactic Empire's support personnel responsible for the operation and maintenance of a variety of vehicles, such as the AT-AT and AT-ST, within the Imperial Army.

Republic City was a megalopolis and the capital of Hosnian Prime. It was the seat of power of the New Republic, as the planet served as the duly-elected capital of the New Republic Senate during the conflict between the First Order and the Resistance.

owners: Minister of State Leia Organa Solo
x: The Rebel Dream was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer of the New Republic Navy. It began its career in the Imperial Navy as the Tyrant.
The Beast Riders were those banished from Iziz into the wilderness of Onderon by its rulers who had been corrupted by their former king, the Sith Lord Freedon Nadd.
Vandos was a planet located in the Vandos system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was controlled by the Separatists during the Clone Wars.
The choreamnos was a type of lazy, arboreal animal. They hardly moved except to get leaves on other branches.
The Shell Hutts were the smallest of the Hutt clans and had a tortoise insignia.

The Human League was a neo-Imperial Corellia-based group active during the decades after the Battle of Endor. Its members were from the Human population, primarily that of the Corellian sector, of whom most were young and male. Female members were not unheard of, however.

Biker Advanced Recon Commandos, also referred to as BARC troopers, were special forces clone troopers of the Grand Army of the Republic that were trained to ride BARC speeders across difficult terrain or dangerous battlegrounds.

AT-RT drivers, also known as AT-RT clone pilots, were elite clone trooper pilots of the Grand Army of the Republic that specialized in ground reconnaissance and operating the bipedal All Terrain Recon Transport, which they were named after.

The Senate Chamber, also referred to as the Great Rotunda, Senate Rotunda, or Convocation Chamber and later known as the Grand Convocation Chamber under the New Republic, was the central chamber of the Senate Building in the Senate District on planet Coruscant.

The New Republic Intelligence Service, or simply New Republic Intelligence (NRI), was the primary New Republic intelligence-gathering agency, responsible for obtaining and analysing information about foreign governments, corporations, organizations and individuals, and reporti…

leader: Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader
x: The Inquisitorius, also known as the Inquisitorius Program, the Order of Inquisitors, the Inquisitor corps, the Imperial Inquisition, or simply Inquisition, was an organization of Force-sensitive operatives under the Galactic Empire.
The Red Guard, nicknamed Redrobes, was an elite organization of bodyguards trained to protect the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic.

The M'onnok was a dangerous, semi-sentient desert predator from the world of Socorro. Intelligent enough to create spears, clubs, and some simplistic tools, the m'onnok were respected by Socorran nomads for their hunting ability.

Arda II, also spelled Arda-2, and also known simply as Arda, was an industrial world located in the Arda system, a part of the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Clone sharpshooters, also known as Clone Trooper Marksmen, clone snipers, or Clone Specialists, were a specialized variant of clone troopers who served in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Operation Cobolt, also known as the Cobolt Offensive, was the military codename for a hit-and-run assault against an Imperial facility by the Rebel Alliance.

The Singing Mountain Clan was a Dathomiri Witch clan based at the Singing Mountain on Dathomir. The clan appeared as a cohesive, hierarchical matriarchy defined by its warrior culture and magical tradition.

Genarius was a gas giant in the Cularin system. Much like Bespin, it had floating cities, including a manufacturing city built by SoroSuub Corporation in 32 BBY. The floating cities of Genarius were viewed as relatively lawless by the standards of the rest of the Cularin system.

Pii III was a planet famous for the luxury greel wood that grew there. It was located in the Pii system inside the Arkanis sector of the galaxy. It was one of "Teeda's Eyes." It averaged 105 centimeters of precipitation annually.
Talofan was the capital planet in the Bajic sector. It was the headquarters of Grand Moff Kintaro.
Sakiya, also known as Saki, was a planet located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was the tropical and heavily industrialized homeworld of the Sakiyan species.
Sanyassa IV was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector. A forested world, Sanyassa was home to the barbaric Sanyassan species, who were governed by a kleptocracy.

Zorbia II was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector. Its terrain consisted of deserts, forests, and plains. The world was home to a group of Humans known as the Zorbian space pirates, whose roots seemed to be Corellian.
Tallaan was a planet in Tapani sector's Freeworlds Territory at the confluence of the Giju Run, the Procopian Shipping Lane, and the Shapani Bypass. It was best known for its starship production.
Canoliss IV was a planet located within the Canoliss system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Cannolite species.
Panna Prime, also known as the Mud Moon of Panna, and as the red-water moon, was a moon located in the Panna system that orbited the planet Panna along with two other moons.
Sevarcos II was the only inhabitable planet in the Sevarcos system. Sevarcos was the only source for the spice variants carsunum and andris, which were its only export.

Aldraig IV was a Core Worlds planet located on the Hydian Way super-hyperroute. Its surface featured forests and a picturesque countryside. During the Alsakan Conflicts, the planet was affiliated with the Galactic Republic's capital world, Coruscant.
Shulstine V was a planet located in the Colonies region.
Circarpous IV, often called simply Circarpous, was a planet in the Expansion Region, one of the financial capitals of the region.

Garos IV was a planet in the Mid Rim, the fourth world in the Garos system. Located near the Nyarikan Nebula, it was somewhat isolated from outside contact and its inhabitants were a tough, self-reliant people.
Tejrivozs was a planet in the trinary star system of Riflorii. It was a colony of the Advozsec and was controlled by a powerful crime family. It was left alone by the Yuuzhan Vong.
Akuria II was an ice planet in the Akuria system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Lokondo was an icy world in the Braxant sector of the Outer Rim.
Argavat was a planet within the Argavat system, in the Colonies region of the galaxy.
Talas was a dry, rocky, volcanic Outer Rim world located in the Kamdon system in the Calamari sector. It was the headquarters of Tallet and Lekket.

The Eriadu Trade Summit, also known as the Eriadu Conference, or simply Eriadu Summit, was an event proposed by Senator Palpatine in 33 BBY, ostensibly to gather all parties affected by Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum's proposal to allow the Trade Federation an increase in st…

The Borkeen Belt, also known as the Borkeen asteroid belt, was a dangerous asteroid belt situated in the Outer Rim Territories' Belsmuth sector. It was home to an eighty-meter-long exogorth that was discovered by 22 BBY by scientists from the University of Sanbra.
Nerit was one of the two moons of Ossus. It was temperate, with a varied ecosystem and gravity 125 percent of the standard. A clan of expatriate Neti lived there.

The Outer Rim Territories celestial body Karavis was a major industrial site for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Rebel Alliance General Crix Madine identified it as a possible target in the event that the Alliance campaign Operation Ringbreaker was successful.

Tomark II, also known as Tomark, was a Mid Rim world located in the Ividal sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of the Rebel Alliance starfighter base known as Chiron Base, from which attacks on Galactic Empire convoys were carried out.
Tshindral III was a Mid Rim planetoid near the Outer Rim with a scant, toxic atmosphere which could corrode a freighter's hulls in less than a local day. It was orbited by Starlyte Station.
Lyran IV was an Outer Rim Territories farming planet located in the Quiberon sector. It was home to the parasites known as Lyran bloodslugs.
Golm, also known as Bothawui Prime, was a planet in the Both system. A purple gas giant, it was the fourth planet in the star system and was orbited by 23 moons, as well as an asteroid belt.
Carosi VIII was a planet in the Carosus system. It was a hot, jungle planet deemed suitable for future Carosite colonization efforts. It had two moons.

The Declaration of a New Order was a proclamation made by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine in 19 BBY, first as an address to an Extraordinary Session of the Galactic Senate and then to the general galactic populous.
Talita was the twelfth planet in the Kamino system. It was orbited by six moons.
Titanicus was the fifth planet from the sun in the Sacorrian system. It was a gas giant orbited by 14 moons.

The Bosphs were a mammalian species from the planet of Bosph in the Outer Rim Territories' Bosph sector. They had six limbs, no neck and a pair of multiple-lensed eyes that also functioned as auditory sense organs.

The Kamarians were an insect-like species native to Kamar. During the Imperial era, the most technologically advanced Kamarians had just developed nuclear weapons, and were well on their way to developing clean fusion and spaceflight.
Tozeer was a planet located within the Tozeer system of the Outer Rim Territories. Tozeer was a desert world with Jawas and Tusken Raiders living on it.
Etorasp was a planet located in the Hakartha sector of the Expansion Region.
Jarsatt was a planet located in the Hakartha sector of the Expansion Region.

Goroth Prime, also known as Goroth, was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Goroth system in the Trans-Nebular sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square R-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Orvax IV was a slave trade planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Slaves were stored in dungeons here before being sold off to slave owners. The slave traders lived in the upper levels of the cities. Members of the T'surr species worked as security staff.
Rampa 1, also known as Rampa I, was a planet located in the Rampa Minor system, within the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

x: The Knowledge Bank, also known as Pakoukou, was a sentient native to Mon Calamari that was aware of all events that happened on the ocean world.

Muunilinst was a planet located in the Muunilinst system, in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories, that was the homeworld of the Muun species. Muunilinst was considered one of the financial centers of the galaxy.

The Delegation of 2000 was the group of senators, many of whom were part of the Loyalist Committee, who created and presented the Petition of 2000 to Supreme Chancellor Palpatine near the end of the Clone Wars.
The Battle of Derra IV was an engagement between the Galactic Empire and a Rebel Alliance convoy near the planet Derra IV.

This courier droid was tortured under the supervision of Jabba the Hutt's droid supervisor EV-9D9.

The demonsquid was an eight-armed mollusk native to the planet Aquaris, with large jaws beneath its clump of arms. It was a particularly vicious aquatic predator that attacked anything that came near its den.

The Thrugii Asteroid Belt was a widespread belt of orbiting material in the Socorro system. It was present in three different orbitals, and astrogation reports suggested that they were the remains of three planets, destroyed when the system's primary, Sokor, blossomed into a r…

The occupation of Bespin was a battle in the Galactic Civil War between the Bespin Wing Guard under Lando Calrissian (who turned to the side of the Rebel Alliance) and the stormtrooper garrison under Darth Vader, which led to the Galactic Empire gaining control of the gas plan…

Clone engineers, also known as combat engineer clone troopers, were clone troopers of the Grand Army of the Republic that specialized in military engineering, repairs, and demolitions work, filling a supportive role in the Galactic Republic's military during the Clone Wars aga…

The Mandalorian Crusaders were the first documented type of Mandalorians, established by Mandalore the First, sometime after 7000 BBY and under the command of Mandalore the Conqueror, later Mandalore the Indomitable, they eventually became involved in the Great Sith War and fo…

result: Capture of Ord Biniir by the Alliance
x: During the Galactic Civil War, the First Battle of Ord Biniir—also known simply as the Battle of Ord Biniir—took place when a group of Rebel Alliance Y-wing starfighters attacked the Imperial-controlled planet Ord Biniir.

The New Republic Ruling Council was the senior decision making body of the New Republic and was composed of the Chief of State and and the senators that chaired each of the six sub-committees of the New Republic Senate.

The Republic Army, known as the Republic Armies, was the collective ground forces of the Galactic Republic from its founding in 25,053 BBY until its dissolution during the Ruusan Reformation in 1000 BBY.

The Coruscant Health Office was a health agency active on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Republic. It controlled outbreaks of disease effectively in the world's spaceports, where they were frequent due to the risk of contagion.
Corri was a gas giant in the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector.
Coruscul was a world situated in the Core Worlds. It was the site of a hidden stronghold at one point used by the Order of the Silver Jedi sect of the Jedi Order.

Corutarn was a celestial body located in the Corutarn system, which was a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. The Human Major Perrn of the Galactic Empire, who was born around 32 BBY, hailed from Corutarn.
Kerig'En was a celestial body in the Kerig'En system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Brema sector.
Gellefon was a planet in the Korness system of the Outer Rim. It was the location of Kig Dannen Spaceport. It was a planet of cool, rocky crags, mountains, and crevasses.

Greyman's Planet was an industrialized Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Wazta sector. It was controlled by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, and at one point the Rebel Alliance executed a mission to transport supplies from it to the Alliance's outpo…

Karinda was an arid, dusty Outer Rim Territories planet that lay in the Wazta sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire maintained a small garrison there, while the Rebel Alliance also constructed a hidden listening outpost on the planet.
Miko was a planet located in the Sorella system.

Bormter was a Wild Space planet that was home to the four-armed reptiloid Bormterran species. Following the Battle of Endor, Moff Delurin broke with the Galactic Empire and declared himself a warlord, conquering Bormter with his warship, the Galaxy Dragon.
Entooine was a tidal locked moon of a gas giant in the Entoo system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the only inhabited celestial body in the system and had an extreme electromagnetic field.

The Epsom Asteroid Belt was located in the Epsom system, a part of the Quiberon sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Saurian crime lord Sithless Leethe owned a summer residence in the asteroid belt.

Muugrah was a planet that was closer to the fringe of the galaxy than it was to the Galactic Core. Its capital was Slaibo, which was close to Squarn's Junkyard. It was a planet of open grasslands inhabited by prospectors and ranchers.

Tegrat was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Koradin sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire launched an invasion of Tegrat's star system, causing numerous inhabitants of the planet to rush toward the local spaceport and many starships fleeing T…

Ksift was an Imperial rainforest world in the Outer Rim Territories. Its capital was Rakati. It was also the location of ATC-5/GS and a Rebel security outpost. Nik betrayed the local Rebels, but was brought to justice by Bret Hanson.
Kyrouac was a backwater Inner Rim farming planet held by the Galactic Empire. The planet's fauna included brush bats and a shelled creature residing in the Spiral Sea.

Radra IV was an average-sized planet with various climatic zones in the Radra system, some distance from major routes and close to the Imperial frontier. The planet had two moons. Its atmospheric density and gravity were slightly more than the Human norm.

Branth was an industrial planet of the Galactic Republic that manufactured droids. However, after the rise of the New Order, the Galactic Empire's heavy demand for droids polluted the planet until it had to be abandoned. It was the only planet in the system containing it.

Ahlenn was a planet in the Ahlenn system. During the Galactic Civil War, a prolonged conflict between Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire, the Imperial Admiral Kohrin's second fleet bombarded the planet thinking that it was home to an active Rebel base, in retaliation for Luke …
Phaylenn was an Imperial planet near Bespin and Ahlenn.

Energy spiders or spice spiders were arachnids that inhabited the Spice Mines of Kessel. They lived in complete darkness inside the mine's caves spinning webs made of glitterstim, a rare kind of spice.

The Sons and Daughters of Freedom, also known as Freedom's Sons, was an independent army that vowed to protect the Galactic Republic and considered the Confederacy of Independent Systems as a serious threat to the peace and freedom of the galaxy.

Garbage Compactor 3263827 was a garbage compactor on the first Death Star where Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Princess Leia Organa were temporarily stranded after freeing Organa from Detention Block AA-23 in 0 BBY. "3263827" was a hatch number.
The siege of Cato Neimoidia was an attempt by the Galactic Republic to capture Nute Gunray, Viceroy of the Trade Federation and a prominent member of the Separatist Council, during the Clone Wars.

conflict: Clone Wars (Felucia theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The Battle of Boz Pity was a major battle in the final year of the Clone Wars. Major Separatist activity on Boz Pity was discovered by Obi-Wan Kenobi during his search for Asajj Ventress.
The Ruusan Reformations were an event in the history of the Galactic Republic that limited the power of the Supreme Chancellor.

result: Bariss Offee becomes a Jedi Knight
x: The Battle of Drongar, also known as the Jasserak Engagement, was fought during the Clone Wars. Drongar was not a strategic military point; instead, both the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems wished to control the planet's main export, bota.

The Battle of Nadiem occurred during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Separatists. In 22 BBY, five months after the Battle of Geonosis, the Separatist Droid Army, commanded by General Grievous, invaded the Republic-controlled planet of Nadiem and was able to to grab…
The Twi'lek Ruling Council was the ruling council of Ryloth's capital city of Lessu.

The saber cat, or sabercat, was a huge, feline, carnivorous species native to the planet Monastery. They were predators with a thick horn which protruded from the top of the skull. The saber cat had four huge paws, each with five razor-sharp claws.

result: Initial Uprising Victory, Uprising violently struck down
x: An uprising took place on the city planet of Coruscant and occurred shortly after the Battle of Endor.
The Woostoids were sapient humanoids indigenous to Woostri.

The Bormterrans were four-armed, fearsome, loyal, dragon-like, reptiloid sapients indigenous to Bormter. They were fierce melee combatants, which made them perfect for recruitment into Warlord Delurin's dragon troopers.

The blue banthas were sapient, Force-sensitive banthas found on the planet Entooine. The average height of a young blue bantha was two meters, whereas adults generally grew to an average height of three meters.

The crystal spiders known as the Lucents (a name Daran Tal gave them, as their own language was unpronounceable to humanoids) were sentient arachnids from an unknown world that was thought to be in the Voidfire Nebula.

Thikkiiana City was a Wookiee city located on their homeworld of Kashyyyk. Acting as the technological hub of the planet, it was of equal standing to Kachirho, the center of all hyperspace mapping. By the time of the Galactic Empire, it featured a spaceport.
Palpatine's office was an office in the Galactic Senate Building on Coruscant used by Naboo Senator Sheev Palpatine.

A species was indigenous to Orooturoo. With small tentacles, four of which ended in a two-prong feature, extended from a large, purple-colored slug-like body, the species had a mating ritual which involved the female devouring the male, similar to some insects.
The Court of Justice, also known as the High Court or Supreme Court, was the highest judiciary of the New Republic and Galactic Alliance.
The Ackyuna was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy.
The Liberator, known as the Adjudicator during its Imperial service, was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer originally used by the Imperial Navy and later by the New Republic.
The Askhew were a race of short, furry humanoids native to the planet Entooine. They were known to have tamed the native quohrs, and used them to pull their sleds.

DV-9, also known as Deevee, was a research droid built by the anthropologist Mammon Hoole as an assistant. After the destruction of Alderaan, he spent most of his time as a personal tutor for Hoole's niece and nephew, Tash and Zak Arranda much to his dismay.

The Polydroxol were a species of sentient, denantium-based shapeshifters that were native to the world of Sevetta. They resembled two hundred kilogram masses of mercury while in their liquid state. Their native environment was the toxic volcanic pools of their homeworld.
Drexls, also known as warbeasts, were reptavian winged creatures indigenous to Dxun.

An FX-9 surgical assistant, also known as the FX-9 , was a FX-series medical droid manufactured by Medtech Industries. During Darth Vader's reconstruction after his duel with Obi-Wan Kenobi, a FX-9 supplied the wounded Sith Lord with a blood transfusion.

Danton VI was a transitional planet under the control of the Galactic Empire, and a leading weapons manufacturer for the Imperial cause. Weapons were shipped off-planet daily from its numerous manufacturing plants.
The Mudgubs were a species of sentient bipeds who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. They had large eyes and long, blunt snouts, as well as hairy, ear-like projections on the sides of the head.
Galdar was the home planet of the Galderians. It was a small, rocky planet which held very little natural resources, or food.

Renor was an Inner Rim planet, and location of a Republic supply depot, where Mon Mothma attempted to meet with a contact, to gain transport to the Outer Rim, prior to being abducted by Senator Pel Talon.
The tusk cat was a fawn-colored feline predator found on the world of Naboo and its moon Rori.
A gas giant in the Elrood sector was orbited by Vicerv 3.
Darstell 4 was a relatively peaceful planet in the Elrood sector, which was situated on a minor shipping lane. The primary continental mass consisted mainly of softly rolling hills.

Vicerv 3, also known as Vicerv, was a small planetoid hidden deep within a nearly-destroyed system in the Elrood sector. It received its atmosphere thanks to the nearby gas giant. This provided it with a barren, but survivable atmosphere.

The Mikoans were a sentient species native to Miko. They were humanoid, and appeared Human, bar their green skin pigmentation. The Mikoans resisted the Galactic Empire until their homeworld was bombarded by Moff Delurin from aboard the prototype Dragon-class heavy cruiser.
The brush bat was a chiropteroid species from the planet Kyrouac. When startled, it would produce a horrible screech.
BLX-5, more commonly known by the alias "Bollux," was a BLX labor droid that served for a time as a member of famed Corellian smuggler Han Solo's crew aboard the Millennium Falcon.

Rocket-jumpers were infantry units equipped with Jump Packs and Smart Rockets of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire and then decades later as part of the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order.
Mount Yoda, originally called Mount Dagger, was an enormous shield volcano on Dagobah that dated from the early years of that planet's formation, billions of years in the past.

The Battle of Kashyyyk, also known as the subjugation of Kashyyyk, was the first Imperial invasion of the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk in the year 19 BBY as part of the Empire's Enslavement of Kashyyyk campaign.

x: The Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion, also known as the Royal Guard, was a Separatist military unit utilized by the Separatist Council of the Confederacy of Independent Systems to provide important officials with sentient guards when it was too risky to use droids that were vulner…

The Proliferans were a species of sentient non-humanoids who resembled large red ants. They were excellent at digging, often using their skills to dig under enemy forces and waylay them when they got close.

The Homanans were a mysterious race of shape-changing sentients from the Homana system. They could change their size from anything the size of a Wookiee to that of an Ewok and were also slightly telepathic, as well as altering the pigment of cells within their flesh.

The Noolan were a sentient species native to the Outer Rim Territories' Noola system. During the Galactic Civil War, the Noolan Otolia Ratiuv, a technician, found her body occupied by the essence of Nana, a Rebel-affiliated member of the Homanan species, following an explosion…

The Shaliz'Na were a sentient species native to the planet Shar'Ack. The species had large wings, some with wingspans of 12 foot, and their bodies were covered in a fine down. Shaliz'na placed a premium on art of all forms, from music to sculptures to paintings.
Kaump III was a Mid Rim planet located in the Bruanii sector. Its high gravity led to its native species being short-statured and with a dense body structure.

X was a battle droid active during the Galactic Civil War. He was found in his manufacturer Kyrotech Corporate Combine's warehouse by a spaceport worker. Via the black market, the latter sold the droid to the pirate leader Zhen Mirat.

Gellbeasts, or Wardogs as they were also known were semi-intelligent creatures native to Gellefon which could grow to roughly 2.4 meters tall. They could be extremely vicious when hunting or when pushed into it.

The Gellefon Freedom Fighters were a group of Human settlers from the planet Gellefon who had joined Aran Starfire's bid to drive off the Imperial presence from their planet. They were extremely dedicated and had trained well.

The octucor was a forest-dwelling land squid from the Outer Rim Territories moon Endor. Sporting an eight-meter-long body with striped skin and eight three-meter-long tentacles, it was a fierce nocturnal predator that reached into the branches of Endor's trees in search of pre…

3B3-888, also known as 7276, was a Trade Federation B1-series battle droid who served in the Droid Army of Viceroy Nute Gunray. When Gunray's forces invaded and occupied the planet Naboo in 32 BBY, the native Gungans responded by massing their own army to combat the invaders.

The YT-1300 light freighter Century Hawk was the personal ship of Danielle Kieran. She bought the ship by taking a loan from Talon Karrde, wanting to fly the same ship as her supposed father Han Solo.

The Splendour was a Kom'rk-class fighter/transport owned by the Besalisk criminal Galus Vez. Vez used the starship to race opponents on his private racing track, the Fool's Run, where he could activate asteroid thrusters remotely from his ship to drive asteroids into opponents.
Maalraas or Nighthunters were a non-sentient species of predatory quadrupeds. Nighthunters hunted in packs, using long claws and powerful fanged jaws to disable their victims.

3B3-1204, also known as 7169, was a Trade Federation B1-series battle droid in the service of Viceroy Nute Gunray's Droid Army. In 32 BBY, 3B3-1204 was a part of the force that invaded and later occupied the world of Naboo, at Gunray's behest.
We Fix Anything was a starship repair bay on the Crystal Web Station run by New Republic officer Taver Soren.

The Kadal Asteroid Field was located in the Bestal system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector. The asteroid field lay close to the planet Bestal Three and contained asteroids with significant deposits of aluminite and corax ores.
Varada Five was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Varada system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector.
Bestal Three was a jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector. Its flora included the vortal tree, the seeds of which had medicinal properties.
Webweavers were a large species of spiders indigenous to the planet Kashyyyk. They were capable of devouring humans. Wookiees hunted and ate the spiders.

A stathas was a sleek, venomous reptile native to the Mandalore system, located in the region of the galaxy known as the Outer Rim. The stathas was known to use its seemingly harmless appearance to hide its deadly capabilities.

ES-PSA, also known as Espasa, was a RIC-920 rickshaw droid manufactured by Serv-O-Droid, Inc.. He operated as a rickshaw driver in the spaceport of Mos Espa on Tatooine, during the time of the Separatist Crisis and the Clone Wars.

The Imperials were a rival grav-crosier team to Jothan Tiaan Jerjerrod's Ripper-Raptors.Whilst being transported to Starkiller Base aboard a First Order Upsilon-class command shuttle, Jerjerrod noted the co-pilot reminded him of the Imperials sweeper.

type: Six Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers around a central core
x: Outbound Flight was the main ship of the Outbound Flight Project. It consisted of a central fuselage surrounded by six Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers designated D-One through D-Six; together, the massive ship was known as Outbound Flight.

The Mission to Vjun was Yoda's attempt to bring back Count Dooku into the fold of the Jedi and the Galactic Republic. However, it was actually a trap set by Dooku to ensnare Yoda and to deliver a deadly blow to the Republic's forces.
The Order of the Silver Jedi was a sect of the Jedi Order devoted solely to combat the dark side of the Force wherever it manifested, as well as to "Serve and Protect" the Galactic Republic.
Force Wraiths were non-sentient shadowy creatures created from the dark side by the Force power Create Force Wraith. They would obey their creators every command.
The Sybrial brain slug was a type of slug that shared its name with the Sybrial system of the Vodilux sector.

This droid, on a quick inspection, looked very similar to an R2-series astromech droid but was in fact of an earlier model which was slightly larger, being 1.1 meters, rather than 1.0. It also did not seem to have the retractable legs of the R2's.

conflict: Clone Wars (Felucia theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: A battle on Murkhana took place during the final days of the Clone Wars. The Grand Army of the Republic staged an assault of Murkhana, headquarters of the Corporate Alliance and residence of Magistrate Passel Argente.
The New Republic Security Force (NRSF) or New Republic Security, was the primary law enforcement and counter-intelligence agency for the New Republic government.
Dubravans were a species of green-skinned humanoids native to the world of Dubrava. They possessed yellow blood, black eyes, and webbed hands and feet with four digits apiece.

Desolation Alley was a Galactic Republic maximum security prison on the moon Oovo IV. Notable prisoners included Aurra Sing, Fud Sang, and Bendix Fust. During the last years of the Galactic Republic, Fenn Booda served as the prison warden.
Titan was a Victory-class Star Destroyer which once orbited the planet Harridan.

Harridan was a planet located on the fringe of Imperial space, and was originally used as a prison colony in the past. Even after it was fully colonized, it still continued to draw in the rogue elements as well as the Rebels of the galaxy.
Crullov City was a city on Corulag. A mostly abandoned industrial city, it was ruled by criminal syndicates, and was the sole source of underworld culture on Corulag.

The zucca boar or zucca pig was a large pig species native to the planet Tatooine. A muscular beast, it was slightly larger than the average womp rat, but not nearly as dexterous. Although the creature was herbivorous, it had thick skin and dangerous tusks.

The Nuns of G'aav'aar'oon were originally a group of Force-sensitive female Gamorreans who set up a convent in the ruins of an old Jedi fortress on the asteroid of G'aav'aar'oon shortly after the Clone Wars.

side1: Order of the Sith Lords/Galactic Empire
x: The Skirmish in the Senate was a confrontation that took place in 19 BBY between the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious and the Jedi Grand Master Yoda. The two veterans of the Force engaged in a ferocious lightsaber duel, with each making liberal use of their powers.
a: Duel in the Senate (Great Jedi Purge)

Order 66 is issued and the Great Jedi Purge begins
x: The showdown on Coruscant was a confrontation that took place in the Supreme Chancellor's Suite of the Galactic Senate on the afternoon of 16:5:22 GrS in 19 BBY.

The Jedi Council Chamber, also known as Jedi High Council Chamber or the Council Chambers, was the meeting place of the Jedi High Council. It was located in the High Council Tower—one of the four Council Towers—of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
The Sullustan Resistance was a guerrilla movement by the native population of Sullust against the Galactic Empire between approximately 2 BBY and 4 ABY.
The Crusaders were a group of droids within the Second Revelation, a group of sentient droids, that were sent out to find more droids like them.

The Nine Ruling Families, formerly the First Ruling Family when the Stybla family ruled the Chiss Ascendancy, the Three Ruling Families, the Ten Ruling Families, and at one point having as much as twelve Ruling Families, were an elite group of Chiss families that led the Chiss…
The Syndicat was a criminal organization that controlled the planet Phindar during the days of the Galactic Republic.
The Council of Elders was a religious institution of the Elders of the Path faith. Members of the council, such as Tromak, held the title of Elder.
The Republican Army was a ground force of the Galactic Republic that took part in the Battle of Mandalore that occurred before the Grand Army of the Republic came into existence.

Knights of the Force Squad were a squad of five minor Jedi who were present at the Battle of Mandalore and fought on the side of the Republican Army. It is unknown if this squad survived for the final victory or not.

result: Capture of Governor Vrox by the Republican Army
x: The Battle of Mandalore took place some time between 52 BBY and 32 BBY. Governor Vrox of the planet Mandalore had sent his Mandalorian Armed Forces to raid star systems neighboring Mandalore, and was suspected of constructing illegal war droids which caused the Galactic Republ…
Darkknell was an astronomical object located in the Darkknell system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Hydian Way at grid coordinates M-17.

The Myrkos was a Galactic Republic dreadnaught cruiser in service during the Clone Wars. It was stationed in orbit around Tembora, a mobile rogue moon that housed the Republic's Tembora Research Station.

The Felinians were a species of sentient felinoids originating from the Felin system. During the Galactic Civil War, the Felinians had developed technology considered primitive in the galaxy at large, but a group of them residing in jungles of the planet Zoma V desired advance…

The Great Spirit Tree, also called the Great Tree or Spirit Tree, was an ancient tree on the forest moon of Endor that was sacred to the local Ewoks. The species believed that they were all descended from the Great Tree, and that all life eventually returned to it.

The Bane Back spider was a subtype of gaping spider, an arachnid creature native to the planet Dathomir. A mutated variant, this creature was larger, stronger and more resistant to average gaping spider.
Thirteen was one of the medical droids who served in Fyzen Gor's Original Dozen. Two years after being repaired by Gor, the droid required replacement limbs.
The Syndicate was a criminal organization that was ran on Cularin by Alina Impeveri, during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. It was based in the Ishkik caverns.
The Chancellor's Podium was a podium located in the center of the Galactic Senate Building's Galactic Senate Chamber that extended from the Chancellor's working office directly below.
Thrass was a city located on the moon of Lupal. After the collapse of the civilization on Lupal and the abandonment of the moon by the few survivors, Thrass fell into ruin.

leader: New Republic Defense Force Army Command
x: The New Republic Army was a segment of the New Republic Defense Force that served as the ground military of the New Republic. It was formed from the ground forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic after the New Republic was established.

result: Base is actually a trap, Alliance victory
objective: Scout out Rebel base
x: The Ambush at Thila was an event during the Galactic Civil War. During the Infiltration of Kalist VI, Rebel agents provided false information regarding a Rebel base on Thila to the Empire.

The Starkiller was a freighter used by the bounty hunter Leshy Drobo prior to 20,000 BBY. Drobo and his partner, the assassin droid XT-8, captured the Jedi Knight Roni von Wasaki, on whom a bounty had been placed.
The Wildebeest was a creature presumably native to the planet Yelsain. They were known to reach heights of 1.5 meters and were generally as wide as they were tall.

The Martyr was a shuttle used by the Kaleesh warlord Grievous. The gray shuttle had multiple laser cannons and also functioned as a troop carrier, able to accommodate Grievous and all eight members of his elite Izvoshra.
An operation was carried out by the Alliance Fleet to prevent the discovery of their base on Hoth.

t: Attack on a Tatooine Imperial base
x: With the Imperial outpost in the Vergesso Asteroids fallen, the attack on a Tatooine Imperial base started when the Alliance fleet moved from the Vergesso asteroids to Tatooine.
Ananuru City was a city located on the planet Ananuru. It consisted of a spaceport as well as support facilities for the Ananuru Express and was protected from the dangerous planet by a force-dome.

result: Decisive Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
T-65 X-wing starfighters become the Alliance's primary starfighter.
x: The Battle of Fresia was a decisive engagement early in the Galactic Civil War in 1 BBY on the planet Fresia.
The Xamaural was the Imperial-class Star Destroyer that picked up Darth Vader following the Battle of Yavin.
The battle of Denubba was a battle fought at Denubba during the time of the Galactic Republic. General Maxine Baytor led the Republic forces and thought it was a spectacle later in her life.
The Tulrus Nesting Grounds, also known as the Tulrus Isle, was a landmass on the volcanic planet of Mustafar.
The Grand Audience Chamber, also known as the Ceremonial Hall or the Temple throne room, was part of the Great Temple on the jungle moon of Yavin 4.

result: Escape of R2-D2 with the Death Star plans
x: The Battle of Tatooine in the Galactic Civil War was a series of battles and skirmishes in the Tatoo system, primarily on the planet Tatooine, within a few days before the climactic Battle of Yavin. It resulted in the capture of Princess Leia Organa by Darth Vader.
The Jedi Temple Apprentice Tournament was a competition held annually at the Coruscant Jedi Temple during the reign of the Galactic Republic.

result: Escape of Independence, Liberty and Defiance
x: The Subjugation of Mon Calamari was one of the first battles fought by the new Galactic Empire. It resulted in the enslavement of the Mon Calamari and Quarren for nearly two decades, until both races united to throw the Empire offworld.
The sand bat was an animal native to the desert planet of Tatooine. The Tusken Raiders used its venom as a weapon to kill Krayt dragons during rites of passage.

Howlers were predators which lived on the moon Yavin 4. They got their name from their method of attack, which was a howl loud enough to stun their prey. Howlers were somewhat reptilian in appearance.
Treadwell was a WED 15 "Septoid 2" Treadwell droid who served the Millennium Falcon. Treadwell was acquired by Han Solo three years before the Battle of Hoth.
Pulga were a type of creature native to the forest moon Endor. The sentient Ewoks also native to the moon would sometimes ride pulga.
Gaupa were a type of creature native to the forest moon Endor. The sentient Ewoks also native to the moon would sometimes ride gaupa.
Palme du Tigre was a planet with a wide variety of terrain, which included jungles, deserts, plains, mountains, and seas.

The Palmiens du Tigre, or simply Palmiens, were humanoids indigenous to the planet Palme du Tigre. The Palmiens had a pre-spatial technology level. They were apparently wiped out as the last test of a stormtrooper training program.

Karlatt was the homeworld of the Morses, a species with a spatial level of technology. It was the first planet in the Karlatt system. It had a temperate climate and moderate precipitation. Its local days lasted 19 hours, and 520 local days made a local year.
Yasla was one of two planets in the Karlatt system terraformed by the Machinist Theocracy that served as home to ultra-wealthy Morses. It was in the Karlatt system of the Galactic Core.
Ymura was one of two planets in the Karlatt system terraformed by the Machinist Theocracy that served as home to ultra-wealthy Morses. It was in the Karlatt system of the Galactic Core.
The Siege of Otoh Gunga was a raid attempted by the Trade Federation on the underwater Gungan cities of Naboo in the Invasion of Naboo.

Skandits were a species of small, sentient bipeds with furred bodies, gangly limbs, and squat, compact torsos. Although the black fur around their eyes looked like a mask, the rest of the body was a bluish gray.
Korriban zombies, also known as Korriban Sith zombies, were semi-sentient, undead humanoid predators native to the Sith tombworld Korriban.
In the aftermath of the Battle of Endor, the planet Tatooine was embroiled in a revolt against the Imperial forces stationed there.

Hepsalum Tash, known collectively as "the Tash" were a sentient species native to the Dagobah system. Worm-like in appearance, they were a simple folk, valuing peace, stories, and musical entertainment.

Argo-6 was a terrestrial astronomical object, the climate of which featured several seasons. All members of a family residing on the celestial body maintained miniature farms in their mouths, which helped provide them with sustenance.
Andowyne was a Force-imbued planet located in the Kathol Rift. It was the home planet of the Brownie, Daikini, Nelwyn and possibly midi-chlorian life forms.
Bravo One was a UT-60D transport/gunship that served the Extraction Team Bravo of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

The Evacuation of Yavin was a battle between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire that took place six months after the Battle of Yavin in 0 ABY. It was to be the final clash of the long siege of the moon before the Alliance base was evacuated.

Lennax was an Imperial planet in the Carpurnal system, coreward of Celanon. It was a hot, arid planet covered in grass plains and near desert. The Human Lennaxians lived in a simple, nomadic society. There were numerous trade settlements on the planet, primarily Port Lennax.

Duors were highly sentient, Force-sensitive delphinoids indigenous to the planet Arrakan. They believed the Leviathan Kithnarrock to be their creator. They created the Battrach by using bio-engineering techniques.

The Leviathans were a tentacled sentient species residing on the waterworld Arrakan. The thousand-year-old Force-sensitive Leviathan Kithnarrock was worshipped as a god by the planet's Battrach species, and during the Galactic Civil War, he helped a group of Jedi and their com…
Tir Asleen was considered the greatest of all kingdoms on the planet of Andowyne.
The Brownies were a diminutive, long-lived species from Andowyne that defied most scientifc classifications.

The Naboo whale was an aquatic creature native to the southernmost oceans of Naboo. They were hunted by the Gungan company Binks & Son Whaling Company for hundreds of years before Jar Jar Binks was born. On a whaling trip when Jar Jar was hunting with his father, George R.

DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station
x: Death Star Troopers were elite Imperial Navy Troopers stationed aboard both the first and second Death Star. They piloted the battle stations to their destinations, guarded prisoners, and also fired the superlaser aboard each, along with Imperial weapons technicians.
The Uscru Entertainment District, also simply known as the Entertainment District, was the entertainment area located in the lower levels of the Uscru District on the planet Coruscant.

result: Jedi Master Yoda is named Defender of the Home Tree
x: The Wookiees of the planet Kashyyyk defended their homeworld from Confederacy of Independent Systems-aligned raiders in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars between the CIS and Galactic Republic.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: New Republic Fleet Intelligence, also known as New Republic Naval Intelligence or New Republic Military Intelligence, was the intelligence department of the New Republic Defense Fleet.

Peekoine was a planet. There were four Landslashers located on the planet. Landslashers 1, 2, and 3 maintained the canals of the planet. Landslasher-4 carved new canals. It was orbited by the space diner Mother's. Peekoine was home to to The Gutterwipes, a swoop gang.

The Malkite Poisoners, also known as the Poisoners of Malkii, were adept assassins who trained in and perfected their poisoning arts on the planet Malkii, where they got the ingredients for many of their deadly poisons.

The Bothan Spynet was a well-organized intelligence network that was active during the time of the Galactic Civil War. A Kupohan named Sakhet occasionally did contract work for the Bothan spynet, running a small noodle hut as a front of her intelligence services.
Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Obsidian 1 was the lead TIE/ln starfighter of the Galactic Empire's Obsidian Squadron.
The Cantham House Meetings, also known as the Cantham talks, were a series of meetings between Senators Bail Organa, Mon Mothma, and occasionally Garm Bel Iblis at Cantham House on Coruscant.
The Assassin's Guild, also known as the Assassins Guild, the Assassin Guild, or as the league, was an organization active during the Imperial Era, the members of which were freelance assassins.

The Defense Hierarchy, also known as the Chiss military command or Chiss command, was a military command of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force that consisted of its senior officers, including Admiral Ar'alani.
Imperial Navy Intelligence, also called Fleet Intelligence or Naval Intelligence, was the military intelligence branch of the Imperial Starfleet. Spurch Goa once worked as an investigator for it.
Slitherettes were a species of snake that hailed from a distant Outer Rim planet. The limbless reptiles could be thirty centimeters long and bright orange in color. They possessed small fangs.

The Diathim, also known as the Angels as a result of spacers mistaking them for such beings, were a mysterious species of winged sentients who inhabited the moons of the planet Iego, specifically living on the largest moon, Millius Prime.
The Sun Guard was a Thyrsian mercenary company and one of the most feared in the galaxy, centered on the planet Thyrsus in the Thyrsus system.
The Slag Pit was a cantina located on the Outer Rim Territories moon Nar Shaddaa. By the reign of the Galactic Empire, it had gained a reputation as one of the roughest bars in the galaxy.
The Exiles, or Jen'jidai in the Sith language, were the twelve Dark Jedi leaders banished by the Jedi Order into the Unknown Regions after the Hundred-Year Darkness.

The Outland Regions Security Force, or Republic Outland Security Force, abbreviated ORSF, was a paramilitary force established by the planet Eriadu and the Greater Seswenna for the protection of the Seswenna sector.
Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Onyx 2 was an Imperial Navy TIE/D Defender which was part of a limited production run of its class.

language: Primitive dialect of Galactic Basic Standard
x: Squidge was the insulting name given by the Vindar to the race of beings they oppressed. They were diminutive blue creatures with elongated skulls and wavy black patterns on their skin. They spoke a primitive form of Basic and were organized under "den mothers".

The Vindar were a species of white insectoids with four arms and a tough [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carapace carapace]. They possessed large black beady eyes, and they were able to fire powerful purple energy blasts from their hand.

The Navigators' Guild was a guild located in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy that sent navigators to those who hired them. Void Guides, Pathfinders, and Vector One were groups employed by the Guild.

F4-MF was an IG-series assassin droid who led the Rebel Four, operatives for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War, the team travelled to the planet Vatleria, where they uncovered a new Imperial base.

Ylesian white worms were a species of worm that lived in mud and were native to the planet Ylesia. They were white in color and relatively lengthy in size. Members of the Hutt species enjoyed eating them.

Spukami were a common breed of Corellian housecats that hunted vermin. The Fed-Dub Protective Services Spukami pocket blaster, manufactured on the nearby Corellia system worlds of Talus and Tralus, was named after the species.

x: The Mission to Kashyyyk was a rescue operation carried out by the commandos of the Republic's elite Delta Squad which led directly to the Battle of Kashyyyk.

Kormoran was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was a site of an Imperial attack. During the blitz, TIE Fighters were sent in to clear the roads of over 90,000 refugees.
The kheilwar was the name given by the Defel species to a small poisonous insect native to their homeworld of Af'El. It was also known to other races as a homunculus-wasp.
I-7 was a protocol droid belonging to the human Sevox, who had spliced into the droid in order to see after he lost his eyes.

Bracca was an inhospitable junkyard planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim. Located close to various hyperspace routes, Bracca's strategic importance made it the site of a campaign during the Clone Wars.

Clone stormtroopers were stormtroopers cloned from various templates, including the Mandalorian Jango Fett, whose genetic material was used in the creation of clone troopers during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

The Chattza clan was a Rodian clan on the planet Rodia. The clan was based on the continent opposite to that of Betu; the Chattza clan had little influence or presence in Betu. They were known to outfit interstellar starships.
The Zeuols were a species of sentient, pale-faced beings recognizable for their large, solid-black eyes and coarse, off-white hair.

place: Jedi Temple, and surrounding areas, Coruscant
result: Beginning of the Republic's transition into the Galactic Empire
x: Operation: Knightfall, also known as the siege of the Jedi Temple and the attack on the Jedi Temple, was one of the first military engagements in the Great Jedi Purge that took place in the year 19 BBY, around the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, the home of the Jedi Order.
The Analysis Bureau was a bureau of Imperial Intelligence responsible for handling large amounts of data from tens of millions of sources.
LEGO City was a gated city in the Known Universe. Despite not being located in the galaxy, the conflict of the Skywalker family was felt there through a Disturbance in the Force.

Beach Troopers were a specialized branch of stormtroopers who wore a stripped down variant of the usual stormtrooper armor, which included the regular helmet and a swimsuit. Beach troopers were often found lounging in baths and spas, seemingly off-duty.

Research Station Shantipole was an asteroid in the Roche system. It was primarily staffed by Verpine. After the Battle of Yavin, the asteroid was the site of the Shantipole Project, in which Slayn & Korpil worked with Commander Gial Ackbar to develop the A/SF-01 B-wing starfig…

result: All lab personnel killed, all assassin droids escape.
x: The Holowan Massacre or Holowan Disaster took place sometime before 15 BBY on the planet of Halowan. It involved the death of dozens of scientists and guards at the Holowan Laboratories at the hands of the assassin droid IG-88.

LU-L-N was an 8D smelter droid who served as a reporter for The Emperor's Court. After a trial for the murder of Greedo, LU-L-N interviewed the defendant, Han Solo, who lost the case and was sentenced to life frozen in carbonite.

The Convocation of the Force, also known more simply as the Convocation or the Force Convocation, was an advisory body and council designed to promote understanding between the various Force religions based on the desert moon Jedha during the High Republic Era.
Bennie was a medical droid that worked at the medcenter of the Moonbender Colony, assisting Doctor Korvik, who felt that the droid needed some reprogramming.

The Alderaanian Resistance was an early resistance movement against the Galactic Empire, led by Bail Organa on Alderaan during the early years of the New Order. It later became one of the founding members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A resistance on Chandrila was an anti-Imperial resistance movement led by Mon Mothma on Chandrila during the early years of the New Order. It later became one of the founding members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Risso was a planet located in the Risso system, situated in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim region, in grid square N-14 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Mos Eisley Police Authority was the local law enforcement agency in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. Their force was armed with blasters and had a station in the spaceport to enable the questioning of suspects. The officers patrolled the city and also operated in space above Tatooine.

R2-C4, frequently referred to as "C4," served the New Republic during 34 ABY as an R-series astromech droid. R2-C4 flew with Kazuda Xiono's squadron on their mission to deliver intelligence about the First Order to the Resistance.
Binks's Woe was an island in the southernmost seas of Naboo. George R. Binks, his wife and their son Jar Jar spent at least a month shipwrecked there.
Dura Mater Settlement was a settlement on Tatooine that was filled with gullible buyers of droids. Stan and Fred Jawa often hit it.
The Khonin Mountain Range was on Tatooine, east of the Cage. Obi-Wan Kenobi may have lived in a cave there.

Located on the top floors of the Senate Apartment Complex on Coruscant, the Naboo Embassy allotted this space as an apartment for the current Senator of the Chommell sector and Naboo. It was later converted into a restaurant known as the Naboo Queen.

Rebel Commandos, also known as SpecForce soldiers, were an elite variant of rebel troopers of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. They composed the multiple units of the Rebel Alliance Special Forces including the Marine Corps, the Special Forces Trackers Unit, and more.

MREM-02, or Moreemohtwo was a kitchen droid owned by Corpo the Hutt. When Corpo enslaved famous chef Slabba Drewl, Jedi Masters Micah Giiett and Plo Koon came to his rescue. Corpo then bet Drewl in a cooking contest with MREM-02.
The Hoth asteroid field, also known as the Hoth asteroid belt or Anoat Asteroid Belt, was an asteroid field overlapping the boundaries of the Hoth and Anoat systems near the planet Hoth.
Nos monsters were large aquatic creatures that dwelled in the freshwater lakes, underground rivers, and sinkholes of the planet Utapau.
Sandflies were a species of fly found on Tatooine. Moisture farm WED 15 Septoid 2 Treadwell repair droids would often chase sandflies, mistaking their whine for malfunctioning moisture vaporators.

result: Imperial containment of the Rebels for six months
Rebels forced to flee during the Evacuation of Yavin
x: The Yavin blockade, also known as the blockade of Yavin or the Blockade of Yavin 4, was a military action conducted by the Galactic Empire after the destruction of the Death Star in 0 ABY.

A song sparrow was a type of colorful sparrow endemic to the planet Coruscant. Ky Narec, a Jedi Knight, enjoyed feeding and watching song sparrows and crown finches fly around the Great Tree, located in the Jedi Temple training ground in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
Platform 429 was a landing platform on Cloud City. Tag Greenley and Bink Otauna landed the Tydirium there after the Battle of Yavin.
HR 51 was the room in Cloud City where Bink Otauna, dressed as a stormtrooper, blasted C-3PO.
Platform 215 was a landing platform on Cloud City.

Clam Clan was a Jedi youngling clan in the Jedi Temple in the time prior to the Invasion of Naboo. It was named for the clam. Producing many students over the centuries, the clan was dissolved along with the rest of the Order in 19 BBY during the Great Jedi Purge.
Beek-monkeys were a type of semi-sentient primate. They were noted for flailing when confined. Han Solo sometimes swore an oath, indicating a possible religious connotation.
Granicus was the name of an Imperial throneworld, in the Granicus system, a gas giant with gray cirrus methane clouds. The galactic capital was a floating city.
The Disaster at Deepspace Besh occurred nine months after the Battle of Yavin .

A species of non-sentient birds was present on the forest moon of Endor. Logray kept one in his hut around 3 ABY, as he showed the Towani children the whereabouts of their parents using a crystal image spinner.

The Tantive V was a CR90 corvette in the service of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Just prior to the Battle of Yavin, the Tantive V acted as a decoy for the identical Rebel corvette Tantive IV, the consular vessel of Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan, which w…

objective: Release Han Solo from carbonite and free him from Jabba the Hutt's imp
x: The siege of Jabba's Palace was conducted in 4 ABY by key members of the Rebel Alliance, including Leia Organa disguised as Boushh, Luke Skywalker, Chewbacca, Lando Calrissian, and Han Solo.
The Imperial Ministry of Propaganda was an organization responsible for the creation and dissemination of various Imperial propaganda intended to glorify the Empire or cover up its atrocities.

A cairoka was a type of creature capable of flight and found on the planet Alderaan. They had wings as white as snow. By 1 BBY, the Alderaanian youngling Rel watched cairoka fly over some trees on Alderaan.
Jexxels were tundra-dwelling, white-furred, red-eyed felines. They had serrated front claws and a mouthful of razor-sharp fangs. Their eyes glowed in the dark and gave them excellent night-vision.

The Nelwyn were a species of Near-Humans from Andowyne. They were shorter than the Daikini and had different proportions. Given their similarities to the Human and Brownie races of Andowyne, it is likely that the three groups shared a common ancestry.

The Mon Calamari Fish Market was a market on the planet Coruscant during the times of the Galactic Republic. A young Darth Maul visited the market briefly upon escaping from the Happy Nerf Herder home for young boys.

Palpatine's apartment was a suite of rooms maintained by Sheev Palpatine during his time as the senator of Naboo. It was was located in the upper levels of 500 Republica in the Senate District of Galactic City on the planet Coruscant.
The Imperial Space Force was the space warfare extensive branch of the Galactic Empire, as well as its primary military arm.
The Battle of Condawn was a conflict in the Clone Wars where Luke Starkiller's father Annikin died by the hands of the treacherous Sith Lords of the galactic capital of Alderaan.

In the later stages of the Clone Wars, the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, publicly known as Supreme Chancellor Palpatine of the Galactic Republic, maintained a meditation chamber inside the Grand Republic Medical Facility on Coruscant.
The Force Web, a network of filaments that connected galaxies, was the largest known structure in the universe by 32 BBY.

Emdee was an MD-series medical droid who served the First Order. While loading crates aboard the shuttle Two-Seven-Oh-Five on a First Order space station, Emdee was approached by Finn and Poe Dameron, members of the Resistance who were attempting to escape the station disguise…
A yaggie was a small, green, winged creature hunted for both its hide and meat on Greater Marianas. They were considered to have little intelligence.

Q'Maere was a planet located within the Kathol Rift. The planet had a deadly, poisonous atmosphere, full of chlorine, and the sky was a sickly green. The majority of the surface was a caustic ammonia ocean interspersed with volcanic salt-caked islands.
Vryssa was a planet located within the Vryssa system of the Outer Rim Territories that hosted an Imperial garrison base. Buldobeasts were commonly found on this planet.

The Zuborte Ma asteroid field was located between the planets of Mygeeto and Itzeho, in the Mygeeto system of the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was considered an easy asteroid field to navigate since the InterGalactic Banking Clan took control of the system.

The Lumini pirates were a pirate organization. By 35 ABY, the organization had become defunct, having been attacked by the First Order. Kuimi Enissa, a young lieutenant in the organization, was the sole survivor of the attack.

Capital City, also known as Lothal City, was the main population center and capital of Lothal, a planet in economic disrepair that had invited the Galactic Empire in return for prosperity and security.

headquarters: Cincey's working hut, Path compound, Dalna
x: The Children of the Open Hand, also known as the Children of the Path, or as simply as the Children, were a group within the Path of the Open Hand cult founded by the Mother and led by Yana Ro. The other members of the group were Cincey, Treze, and Kor Plouth.
The Imperial Surgical Corps was a medical branch of the Imperial Military during the Galactic Civil War.
GX-8 was a sewing assistant droid that was employed by Arta Kleidun, owner of Black Spire Outfitters, to help keep up with demand at her store.
Cather was one of three moons that orbited the planet of Saleucami, in the Suolriep sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It owed its greenish hue to the crystalline dust in its atmosphere.

The white-furred bantha was a large animal native to the planet Nelvaan. These creatures were used as riding mounts for the native Nelvaanian population and carried Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi to a Nelvaanian village.

This R5 unit was owned by a Jawa clan who had presumably salvaged it. The droid was defective, and despite hours of long work clan's mechanic failed to completely repair it. The frustrated Jawa angrily kicked the droid causing it to topple over.

Haven was the codename of the Rebel Alliance's predetermined rendezvous point in the Outer Rim Territories far above the galactic plane, where the Alliance Fleet regrouped after the Rebellion's defeat at the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.
Cornwall was a planet embroiled in a civil war between two rival clans. Qell Tepine, a member of the Star's Nova mercenary force, was implicated in the war.
The Battle of Shumari was a large-scale battle between Jedi survivors of Order 66 and the Galactic Empire, which took place on Shumari.

Viper was a CR90 corvette in the service of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was presumably attempting to destroy the Imperial Navy starships under the command of Vice Admiral Thrawn to stop a salvage attempt during the Battle on the Frontier.
The Executive Board was an organization consisting of the highest-ranked officials in the Tagge Corporation, a wealthy and powerful company owned by the Tagge family.
Rampa II, also known as Rampa, was an astronomical object in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories, connected to Panna in the Cronese Mandate by the smugglers' hyperlane Bubble Wink.

result: Enslavement of the Geroon species and theft of a Vagaari gravity well
x: The Vagaari attempted to enslave and plunder the Geroons by attacking their homeworld of Geroon. Force Commander Thrawn used possibly one of his favorite tactics, the Thrawn Pincer here.
The Soaring Hawkbat Clan, also simply known as the Hawkbats, was one of the many clans in which prospective young Initiates were placed when they first began to learn the ways of the Jedi Order.

manufacturer: Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps
x: Bravo 6, or Bravo Six, was an N-1 starfighter manufactured by Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps that flew as part of the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps' Bravo Squadron. The R2-series astromech droid R2-C4 was often assigned to the starfighter's astromech socket.

result: Sith revealed after a millennium of alleged extinction
x: The Duel on Tatooine was fought between the Sith Lord Darth Maul and Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn during the Invasion of Naboo.
The greelor was a quadrupedal carnivore. It had seven-toed feet, pale scales, a long tail, and a long, toothsome snout.

Unit 416 was a B1-series battle droid member of MT-7's unit while it was deployed to Akiva, a jungle planet in the Outer Rim, during the Clone Wars. During the war, at the onset of the monsoon season the unit was split and deployed to the field.
Snowmice were small, rarely-seen, land-scavenging rodents native to the icy wilderness of the planet of Hoth.

Dokma were small, timid gastropods native to Atollon. Often preyed upon by the spider-like krykna, they had protective shells and two eyestalks. Garazeb Orrelios nicknamed them "bogans." According to Volt Vescuso, the amount of milk a dokma drank was not to be underestimated.

Lankor VI was the sixth planet in its system, and was orbited by three moons. It had a temperate climate and was home to the Lankorians, an intelligent species of skinny bipeds, with long arms and a sugar-loaf shaped head.

Black 11, also known as Black-11, was the designation of a TIE/ln starfighter in the Imperial Black Squadron which was assigned to the Imperial Star Destroyer Steel Talon above the prison planet Despayre prior to the Battle of Yavin.
The Vessel was a transport starship piloted by Leox Gyasi of the Byne Guild. It was crewed by the co-pilot Affie Hollow and the navigator Geode.

Naval Command, also known as Supreme Naval Command, High Command, and the Imperial Star Fleet Command, was the command structure of the Imperial Navy. It was reformed from the Naval Command of the Republic Navy and may have been related to the Admiralty.
Yukka was a planet under the control of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The Atomic Punk night club was located on the planet.
Dac's moon was the single moon of Dac, also known as Mon Calamari.
The Triplehorn mountains was a mountain range located on the planet of Alderaan. Its snow-capped peaks bordered the Royal Palace of Aldera, the planet's capital city.

Thall was a planet that was inhabited by a civilization who followed a religion of the Force. By the High Republic Era, its original civilization was long extinct, though new settlements had been established on the planet.
The Tantrellius Theatre Groupe was a team of players who performed Jediboh Opera at the Jediboh Theatre on Peekoine. It was headed by Damien Tantrellius.
The Gutterwipes were a swoop gang on Peekoine during the Imperial Period. They were lead by Gamusha.
Landslasher-4 was one of the floating city Landslashers on Peekoine during the Imperial Period. It carved new canals into the planet's surface while the other three maintained the canals.
Jediboh Theatre was a theatre in Landslasher-4. It was home to the Tantrellius Theatre Groupe.

Camba-Fruit was a type of fruit used in the cosmetic product Distilled Water of Moltokian Camba-Fruit, a wrinkle prevention substance that partially shared its name with Moltok, a rainforest-covered Outer Rim planet.
The D'olop Mountain Range was a mountain range on M'haeli which housed a secret dragite crystal mine in 0 ABY.

Davnar II, also known as Davnar, was a planet located in the Davnar system, within the Kanchen sector in the Core Worlds and the Interior regions, in grid square K-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid. The planet occupied the second orbital position in its star system.

Exogorths, also known as space slugs, were members of a silicon-based sentient species that resided in the hollows of asteroids, who prided themselves on maintaining a pleasant ecosystem within their bodies. At least one such being, named Sy-O, lived in the Hoth asteroid belt.

Mongo Beefhead were a species of individuals on the edge of extinction. The group was native to the Outer Rim planet of Tatooine and were members of the Rebel Alliance. The Arkanian mutant Zeta Magnus consumed Mongo Beefhead meat, though it was nutritionally poor.
Berusa was the first planet in the Garos system. It was located in the Msst sector of the Mid Rim.
IP-8 was an astromech droid at an Imperial base on Argavat. Rebel spy, Ensign Waldron was undercover in the base as a stormtrooper, where he stole Imperial Battle Codes.
Cod was a type of fish with white meat. It was used as an ingredient in Crait Crusted Cod, a dish created by the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs to showcase the salt from the planet Crait.
Z-Mu Squadron was a Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing squadron used by the splinter government fleet of Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin. It fought at the Battle of Parmel during Zaarin's insurrection.

t: Unidentified MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser
x: This MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser served in the Alliance Fleet during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.
Level 139 was a level on Cloud City that held Detention Cell 5305 which kept Han Solo, Chewbacca and Princess Leia Organa prisoner.
The Spirit of the Republic was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in the service of the navy of the Galactic Republic during the pan-galactic conflict known as the Clone Wars.

A sentient species hailed from the high-gravity Mid Rim planet Kaump III. Its members had a short stature and limbs as well as a dense body structure and a flat face. The mercenary and pirate Chanchaz Iryt was a member of the species who grew up on Kaump III.

The Felin were a sentient species originating from the planet Heleth 4. Greel Ptavvishh was known as the only great Felin philosopher and was credited with saving the Felins from extinction by reorganizing the government to prevent brutal wars between clans.
