This unidentified icy planet was the location of the duel between Taki and Starkiller.
The Battle of the Cowl Crucible was a surreal skirmish between the Galactic Empire and a group of miners in the vicinity of the Cowl Crucible.

A Dreadnought-class heavy cruiser was used by the Galactic Republic and it beared Republic markings. At some point during the Galactic Civil War, the Dreadnought-class heavy cruiser emerged from hyperspace near an abandoned Republic supply depot, damaged and broadcasting a dis…
The Imperial Propaganda Bureau was a branch of the Galactic Empire.
The Battle of Kiros was fought between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
The Rishi moon, also known simply as Rishi, was a natural satellite of the planet Rishi.

affiliation: Grand Army of the Republic broadcast
x: One particular droid of the LeisureMech Enterprises BD-3000 luxury droid line, the Bettie-Bot VJ, was responsible for a music program on the Grand Army of the Republic broadcast system of the HoloNet during the Clone Wars.
A popular pet on the Chadra-Fan homeworld of Chad, the pleeky, also named the chak-chak, was a species of rodent which was miniscule in stature.
Muckworms were a type of worm. Muckworm could also be used as an insult, as exampled when Dek-Nil referred to Doctor Aphra and Lopset Yas as muckworms.

Tip-yips, also known as Endorian chickens, were a species that lived on the forest moon of Endor. They were similar to hens, and were raised for their eggs by the sentient Ewoks who also lived on Endor.

Rockrenders were large creatures who lived within the caves of the volcanic planet Sullust. They were attracted to the taste of dense minerals—including those found in stormtrooper armor. They had two extremely long claws on each front leg and a long tail.
Resputi-seals, also referred to as simply resputi, were a type of large and fierce creature that lived in the deep sinkhole caves of the Outer Rim planet Utapau.
The Fall of Falleen took place in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars when a Confederate fleet under the command of General Grievous attacked the planet Falleen.

The Tunnel Rats were a group of cutpurses and con artists who lived in the sewers in the floating city of Tolea Biqua on Genarius. They were lead by a Sullustan called Cheese and in 19 BBY, they captured Rydna, a member of the Believers in the tunnel.
The Skirmish on Altikar IV occurred when Imperials tracked the elderly Jedi Jhor-Kai to Altikar IV. There, a number of stormtroopers attacked Jhor-Kai, who engaged them with his lightsaber.

x: The Mission to Tazan was carried out by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
LEP-96M3 was the personal LEP servant droid of General Whorm Loathsom during the Clone Wars. It had a high voice and spoke in an odd language, consisting of changing high and lower pitch.

The Gen'Dai were a species of large, sentient beings. Their bodies were made up of a mass of regenerative tentacles, which allowed them to regenerate wounds quickly and, notoriously, be almost impossible to kill.

The Rodian Salvager's Cartel was a criminal group of Rodian scavengers on Raxus Prime led by Drexl Roosh during the Imperial Era, who had set up an impressive salvage operation on the junk-covered planet by using his minions to produce scrap and other goods that could be sold …

The Felucian ripper, or Flying ripper was a dangerous creature native to the jungle world of Felucia. The ripper was a large predator that hunted in the jungle canopy, although it dwelt in shallow rivers and creeks.

The Halls of Healing were an expansive wing of the Coruscant Jedi Temple. Located within the southwest quarter of the complex, the Halls were the center of healing and renewal of life for wounded members of the Jedi Order.

The Sky Battle of Quell took place in the first year of the Clone Wars in the skies over the contested world of Quell when Jedi General Aayla Secura and her Republic fleet were ambushed by a Confederate Navy flotilla.

Unit 2953 was a B1-series battle droid who served in the Separatist Droid Army. A droid with an exceptionally complaining personality, he was disliked by his fellow battle droids, and was sent to execute military duties while the other droids used their time by playing cards.
Smelting Core D was the smelting area where Anakin Skywalker's lightsaber was deposited after being lost by Luke Skywalker on Cloud City, at the gas giant Bespin.
The Pantoran Guard was a group of Pantoran soldiers that were assigned to protect the Pantoran Assembly.
This defective R2 unit was an astromech droid in service with the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
This unidentified volcanic planet was where Astaroth located Soul Edge.
La'drach was the Drach'nam homeworld, where the species lived in dark cave-cities.
C1-EZ8, also known as Eazy, was an espionage droid and assassin of the Empire.

The Internal Security Branch, known as IntSec, was a branch within Imperial Intelligence's Internal Organization Bureau. IntSec was charged with the physical security of Imperial Intelligence's facilities and personnel.
The Battle of Argul was a battle fought during the early years of the Clone Wars.

An Imperial-class Star Destroyer served with Sith Lord Darth Vader's Imperial Death Squadron—a task force assembled specifically for finding the headquarters of the Rebel Alliance—during the aftermath of the Hoth campaign of 3 ABY. The Star Destroyer was commanded by a captain.

This T-series tactical droid, along with three B1-Series battle droids, scouted the Naboo Grassy plains before being destroyed by the Royal Naboo Security Forces. It was later reactivated to garner more information about the Separatists' activities on Naboo.
The Procurer was a Lucrehulk-class battleship that served as Captain Mar Tuuk's flagship during the Confederacy of Independent Systems' blockade and invasion of Ryloth.

headquarters: Senate Bureau of Intelligence Central, Coruscant
x: The Cryptanalysis Department was a branch of the Galactic Republic's Senate Bureau of Intelligence that was created by Director Armand Isard.
The Taris asteroid belt was located in the Taris system. It contained a number of asteroids orbiting the sun, including the Rogue Moon which orbited in the opposite direction to the rest.
A battle took place on Rodia between the CIS and the Galactic Republic during the hunt for Nightsister Yansu Grjak.

The Wilderness Fighters were a military specialty of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Special Forces. Trained to fight and survival in a variety of wilderness environments, individual Wilderness Fighters were specialists in a single terrain type.
Kaythree was a R4 astromech droid that served as Jessika Pava's astromech in the Resistance, after her previous droid, O-R10N, was destroyed during the mission to Megalox Beta.
The Battle of Thaldo was a battle that occurred on Thaldo during the Galactic Civil War.

objective: Recover Sith amulet
x: The mission to Bakkah was an excursion to Bakkah in search of a Sith amulet.
The Imperial Military Police was a branch of the Galactic Empire's armed forces which were charged with ensuring that members of the military acted within the laws established by the Empire.
An asteroid belt surrounded the Mid Rim planet of Golm, also known as Bothawui Prime.

objective: Rescue Leia Organa, recover Imperial battle plans
x: The mission to Nibiru was a search-and-rescue mission undertaken by Luke Skywalker during the Galactic Civil War.

The Coruscant Zoo was an zoological institution located on the planet Coruscant. Following an attempt by bounty hunter Zam Wesell to assassinate Senator Padmé Amidala in 7955 C.R.C., the bisected remains of the two arthropods that had been used by Wesell in the attempt were se…
Mandalore City was a settlement on the Mandalorian homeworld of Mandalore. It was in existence during the time of the Galactic Republic before the year 1000 BBY.

A species of creatures lived on the planet of Vaal. They were large, brown land-living quadrupeds with several horns, a partial exoskeleton, large fangs and spiked tails. It is unknown if they were carnivorous or herbivorous. They were hunted by the predatory hyenax.
The storage floor of the Jedi Temple was located below the Temple proper and considered below "ground level" on Coruscant as it was lower than the rooftops of nearby buildings.

Stormtrooper snipers, also known as sniper troops, were specialized stormtroopers equipped with sniper rifles. Some of the troopers were specialists pulled from the ranks of scout troopers and known as Imperial sharpshooters.

The Galaxy Droid was a mysterious droid that had incredible knowledge of the galaxy. It was found by Revan after escaping the Leviathan, the droid was able to find the planet Lehon and even the Star Forge itself.
Jilrua was a desert planet that orbited a blue giant star within the Jilrua system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region, in the immediate vicinity of the Oktos Nebula.
Gannaria was a terrestrial planet located in the Gannaria system of the Trilon sector, a part of the Outer Rim Territories.

Rorak 4 was an industrial planet that was located within the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlanes called the Gamor Run and the Shag Pabol. Rorak 4 was orbited by the Rorak 5 space station and was the site of the largest slave market in the Hutt Space.

Listehol was an astronomical object located in the Listehol system in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Located on the Hydian Way, it was the head of the Listehol Run hyperspace route which linked it to Mirial.

result: Liberation of Ryloth from the Confederacy of Independent Systems
x: The Battle of Lessu, remembered as "The Hammer of Ryloth" and also known as the liberation of Lessu, was the final engagement of the Battle of Ryloth fought in 21 BBY during the Clone Wars.
Hosk was a moon orbiting the planet Kalarba. The moon saw a period of industrialization when Hosk Station was built across its surface. It was destroyed in 26 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Paqwepor Major, also known as Paqwepor, or Paqwepori, was a planet in the Mid Rim off the Corellian Run. It was within the region of Paqwepori. Paqwepor Major was the Paqwe homeworld and it was ruled by the Paqwe family.

The Blade of Dorin was a blue Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor flown by Jedi Master Plo Koon during the Clone Wars in service of the Galactic Republic, alongside his astromech droid R7-D4.

Reekeene's Roughnecks was a Rebel unit that performed guerrilla attacks against the Galactic Empire in Fakir sector and Thuris sector. Led and named by General Lens Reekeene, the Roughnecks became one of the best resistance teams of the Rebel Alliance.

The Galactic Republic–aligned planetary forces of the Expansion Region world of Kerkoidia were in operation during the Clone Wars. The famed Confederate General Whorm Loathsom, a native of Kerkoidia, served in his homeworld's forces.

The Battle of Dorin took place at the start of 21 BBY during the Clone Wars, when General Grievous of the Confederacy of Independent Systems struck at the Kel Dor homeworld of Dorin in retribution for the planet's loyalty to the Galactic Republic.

Ruusan 2, also known as the Ruusan moon, was one of the three moons that orbited the planet Ruusan located in the Teraab sector's Ruusan system of the galaxy's Mid Rim, in grid square P-11 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

The First Order flametrooper was a variant of the stormtrooper utilized by the First Order. Utilizing D-93 Incinerators to root out entrenched enemy positions and engulf any resistance, flametroopers were equipped with flame-proof armor and were feared for their ability to tur…
Xantar was a planet located within the Xantar system of the Outer Rim Territories' Corva sector.
These inhabitants were a gray-skinned sentient species native to the planet Xantar. Luke Skywalker visited Xantar as a guest of a "Bug-Eyes," a pilot from this species.

The unidentified Xantar starship was a saucer-like starship operated by a "Bug-Eyes" who brought Luke Skywalker to his home planet of Xantar. Some time earlier, the pilot brought the starship to the homeworld of Indiana Jones, then brought Jones back to Xantar.
The Cynestra Space Craft Show was a space craft show held on an artificial satellite orbiting the blue planet of Cynestra during the Galactic Civil War.
Clone gunners were clone troopers that manned vehicle-mounted weapons or artillery, wearing specialized clone trooper armor throughout their service.

The Diplomatic Escort Group, also known as Senate Security, or simply as the diplomatic service, was a clone trooper branch of the Coruscant Guard specialized in escorting diplomats to planets all around the galaxy during the Clone Wars.
The Lawquane farmstead was a farm located on the Outer Rim world of Saleucami, within the planet's wetland region.

R2-MK was the R2-series astromech droid companion of the Jedi Master Mickey Mouse during the era that saw the fall of the Galactic Republic and the rise of the Galactic Empire. Together, R2-MK and Jedi Mickey partook in many galactic adventures.

The Buried Treasure was a bulk freighter owned by the New Republic. Most of its available space was dedicated to cargo storage, and some of the space was not oxygenated or temperature controlled and therefore unfit for human habitation.

During the Imperial Period, the Galactic Empire enslaved the population of the forested world of Shar'Ack. The natives of Shar'Ack, the Shaliz'Na, were a sentient species of artisans addicted to alcohol.

affiliation: Primarily various planetary and sector governments
x: The Planetary Security Forces (PSF), also known as the Planetary Defense Forces (PDF), were the loosely affiliated military forces of the various planetary and sector governments of the galaxy.

The Duel on the Executor was a lightsaber duel on Darth Vader's flagship, Executor. The conflict took place after Vader brought the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 aboard the ship. The Dark Lord attempted to turn R2 to the dark side, but the droid refused, drawing a lightsaber.
Sarlacc Enforcer was the title taken by Sarlacc agents throughout the galaxy during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War.

This T-series tactical droid served in the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he was the commander for the CIS army on Malastare, in which he led his droid forces on the verge of conquering the planet.
The Shadow Wing, also known as the Dark Wing, was a pirate group that operated during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Neo-Bespinians were a gaseous species native to the planet Bespin. They were an advanced civilization which lived in the low atmosphere of the planet.

The Naboo Resistance were a group of loosely organized resistance cells created primarily by members of the Royal Naboo Security Forces. Acting largely independent from each other, the groups opposed the Trade Federation during their occupation of Naboo.

R4-D5 was an R-series astromech droid. R4 served in both the Clone Wars aboard an Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter, then later in the Galactic Civil War aboard a BTL Y-wing starfighter. R4 was present for the Battle of Yavin.

Colonial Station Chaf was a terrestrial planet within the territory of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Unknown Regions. It shared its name with the Chaf family, one of the Nine Ruling Families of the Chiss Ascendancy.
Penguins were a sentient species flightless bird.

Prior to the onset of the Great Sith War, a lightsaber duel occurred on the planet Vigil, between the Sith apprentices Xash and Sindra, and the Dark Jedi Lian Dray. Dray won the duel, after he slew the Sith siblings while defending his charge, a young girl named Nova.
The Swoop Droid was a strange droid found by Revan upon escaping the Leviathan, it was found in the Ebon Hawk cockpit with a swoop bike.

T7 was a copper-plated protocol droid who worked for the Weequay Jarl by 22 BBY. When the Mirialan Servit revealed to Jarl that he had a valuable EX droid that year, T7 helped Jarl hunt him down to try and acquire it, ending up at Dex's Diner.
The Mining Corps was a branch of the Galactic Empire that was formed in response to the need for raw materials and natural resources for the Empire's vast manufacturing ventures.

result: Eeth Koth taken captive to Saleucami
x: In 21 BBY, during the Clone Wars, Jedi Master Eeth Koth was captured by the Separatist Alliance General Grievous during a battle within the Outer Rim Territories Saleucami system.

A skirmish took place on Nar Shaddaa between Boba Fett and Djas Puhr and his mercenaries who were hired to provide security for the information broker Sheraxx Quorsha. Fett blew open the door to Quorsha's building and was confronted by Puhr and his mercenaries.
Figg Avenue was a street located in Cloud City just off the Administrative Levels. It was named after Ecclessis Figg. The street had K'cri's Cafe located there.
Talesia was a planet known for manufacturing some of the galaxy's deadliest thermal detonators.

Count Dooku escapes with the Death Star plans
Separatist Crisis ends; Clone Wars begins
x: The First Battle of Geonosis, also referred to as the Battle of Geonosis or the Battle on Geonosis, was the first major battle fought in 22 BBY between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic on Geonosis, marking the beginning of the three-year Clone W…
The Nightsister fortress on Dathomir was the settlement of the Nightsisters, led by Mother Talzin, during the Clone Wars. It was the home to Dathomirian assassin Asajj Ventress.

The Surgeon was a droid that resided in the former Galactic Empire outpost of DN-949A on the planet Netalych. The droid occupied a workshop within a secure bunker, where it kept itself mostly hidden behind a curtain of wires.

The Initiate Trials, also known as the Jedi Initiate Trial, the Jedi Tournament, or the Padawan Trials, were a series of tests that Jedi younglings of the Jedi Order were given as prerequisite in order to progress to the level of Padawan.
The medical corps was an organization of the First Order active during its war with the Resistance.

objective: To stop the Galactic Empire's movements on Vatleria
x: During the Galactic Civil War, an Alliance to Restore the Republic team known as the Rebel Four went on a mission to attack an Imperial base on the planet Vatleria.

The breathers were a rare Gand subspecies. Scientists were unsure if this race was of an older evolutionary stock, destined to either die out or further evolve; or if they were another coexisting race.
A settlement was located on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Greater Marianas.
The Palace Guard were a detachment of bodyguards that were attached to the New Republic Senate and were tasked with the protection as well as security of the Chief of State at Coruscant.
Docking Control Room 327 was the control room overlooking Docking Bay 327 on the first Death Star. It was helmed by Imperial gantry officer Pol Treidum and a gantry officer.

Dahgee was a planet where unique lightsaber crystals were mined. A small group of Jedi with unique robes also lived there. The lightsaber crystals on Dahgee gave their lightsabers a strange, zigzagging blade with a black core, almost like a tree branch.

result: General Grievous's collection of Sith lightsabers destroyed
x: A duel took place on the acidic planet Dica between the Confederate General Grievous and Dark Jedi twins Kaa and Lii. When one of the twins stole Grievous's Sith lightsaber collection, the General followed her and confronted her and the other sister on Dica.

The Umbaran militia was the local defense force of Umbara, a shadowy world in the Ghost Nebula. The militia was comprised of the planet's native Umbaran people, who utilized their advanced technology that had been developed on their world to defend their holdings and attack en…
A T-series tactical droid was a droid created to serve the Navy of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It was destroyed during the Battle of Umbara.

Under the aegis of the Galactic Empire, several members of a sentient species were executed by stormtroopers. The species was humanoid, had red eyes, two short antennae, and was distinguished by a nasal structure composed of three pairs of breathing holes.
Chaila was the second planet in the Garos system. It was located in the Msst sector of the Mid Rim.

A small and ingrate planet, Alzaris had a very low population, concentrated around a very small open field which served as a spaceport and some massive greenhouses. The planet is constantly bathed in the reddish light of its dying star.
The Silver Fulgur was a tavern located on the planet of Alzaris, in the Rama system. The bartender was Roxard, a former member of the Imperial Army.

The STC003 Starcrasher was an Imperial Heavy Fighter, developed by Incom Corporation, then manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems and Yoyodine Propulsion Systems after the defection of Incom Corporation's engineers.
Schizodes were an insectoid sentient species. Though they were considered to be good combatants and crafters, they were not very individualized.
Tastini was a planet in the Chamberlam system.
The Sawal were a humanoid sentient species originating from the planet Tastini.
The Slugh were a gastropod sentient species.
The Arakhyn were a sentient species of ruthless hunters.
Sylphes were a botanical, humanoid sentient species, native to Sylvia IV.
Sainte-Evanëflore was a planet and the Sylphe Homeworld. It was governed by the Lord of the Foliage.
Dwitzel's Rats were a mercenary unit based on Tatooine.

The Nepherides were students and members of a dark side school based on Byss. They were trained, Force-sensitive assassins of the Galactic Empire. They would often wear a plait, and their teeth were carved to look like fangs.
Sylvia IV was a planet and the Sylphe Homeworld, located in the Sylenia V system. It was discovered some decades before the Ruusan Reformation by the Galactic Republic.
The Morlings were the native sentient species of the planet Morda.
Morda was a planet and the homeworld of the Morling species.
The Doogs were creatures from the planet of Morda and shared the planet with the Morlings. The Morlings used their leather to produce clothes.

The Restoration was an MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser in the service of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was tentatively ready for service in the lead up to the Battle of Endor.

The Death Star command center, also known as the Death Star control room and the command station, was located on the second Death Star battle station. It was able to remotely operate the station's functions, including the deflector shield and superlaser.
Therpsis was a small mining planet and the homeworld of Pete Vandhaar.
A town was located on the planet of Carlac and was home to the Ming Po. Several of its buildings were burnt by the flamethrowers of the Death Watch led by Pre Vizsla.

climate: Arid, high temperature and low humidity
x: Paloma was the sole planet in the Paloma system, near the Kathol sector. It didn't have any important resources nor strategic value.
K'aargs were large, bipedal reptilian humanoids from the planet Shira. They were described as being not very accommodating, and were feared for their mouth full of sharp teeth.
Shira was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.
"The Specter" was a bipedal, humanoid assassin droid who operated out of Providence during the Galactic Civil War.

Pylat birds were a species of non-sentient avians native to the planet Neimoidia that were prized as status symbols. Some wealthy Neimoidians kept such birds in special cages. During 3 ABY the casino cruiser Morenia was offering a Pylat bird as a prize.

The Rim Faction was one of two split political factions that was active within the Galactic Republic's Senate prior to the inception of the Separatist Crisis, which was organized by the Separatist Alliance.
Kinzor was a planet where Professor Schardak studied in the local archaeological museum.
Dagmar II was a planet in the Dagmar system and the seat of the Imperial Governor of Dagmar where his palace was located.

This Archeological museum was located on the planet Kinzor. During his studies, the archeologist Schardak unwittingly freed an ancient abomination, found in a tumulus on Tatooine. The mummy killed several beings before fleeing the planet.

terrain: Rocky desert , putrid swamps , polluted lakes and ponds
x: Mandalah III was a planet in the Mandalah system.
Shrobs were saurian humanoids from the planet Mandalah III. They were tall and lean, with scaly brownish skin.
The Predator's Beak was a YT-2400 light freighter that was used by the Galactic Empire as a scout ship.
The Imperial Throne Room of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant served as the seat of the Galactic Emperor Palpatine, ruler of the Galactic Empire.
Mistar-5 was a terrestrial astronomical object. The attorney known as The Wavering Oeklass once appropriated a boat on Mistar-5.
The Crucible was an arena on Dathomir that housed the Selection of the Nightsisters.
The Deep Charting Expedition was an expedition made by the Republic scout ship Spotrunner, leading into the depths of the Unknown Regions. At some point a Mnggal-Mnggal outbreak occurred on the ship.
Jennie Pickalho was a Human replica droid, designed to be an almost perfect replica of a Human female. She worked at the Chandrilan Embassy on Coruscant at the time of the destruction of Alderaan.
The Second Bureau was a branch of the Chandrilan Embassy on Coruscant, dedicated to collect secrets and informations. In 0 BBY, it was directed by Major Jonas Davan.
The Glacier Breaker Wampa Den was a wampa cavern on the planet Hoth during the Cold War.
Darth Maul's Party Town was a spot set up in 32 BBY in the outskirts of Mos Espa, a city on Tatooine. The Sith Lord Darth Maul established his Party Town next to Queen Amidala's Royal Starship.

The Imperial Maritime Division, also referred to as the Imperial Navy (not to be confused with the Imperial Starfleet), was part of the Galactic Empire's Military that carried out operations on bodies of water of different planets.

t: Victory Rationing Orders and Regulation Plan
x: The Victory Rationing Orders and Regulation Plan was an initiative that was instigated by the Galactic Republic General Ministry following the outbreak of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY, to preserve supplies of materiel for the Galactic Republic's war effort and to hold back inflati…
The Taï were the native sentient species of the planet Taypho.
The Sliiskiis was a sentient, insectoid species found in the galaxy. They had retractable pincers.
The Assorhians were the native sentient species of Assorhan.
Drez was an astronomical object in the Drez system of the Corva sector, which was part of both the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories.
The Kanduh were an ancient sentient species from the planet Kaldahan.

This species had chalk white skin, sunken black eye sockets, and fingers with one more joint than a Human finger. Their long fingers were used for drawing blood. The lifespan of this species was much longer than that of a human. Aurra Sing's father was a member of this species.

A non-sentient tusked creature lived on Endor, a forested moon orbiting the planet of the same name. This animal had a strong odor and was sometimes used as a bait by the native Ewoks, a species of bear-like furry bipeds.
The Yalor were the native sentient species of the planet Yaloris.
The Globlours were a sentient species native to a planet in the Outer Rim.
The Swonks were a reptilian sentient species.
The Glothians were a sentient species in the galaxy.
The Dargas were a Near-Human sentient species native to the red desert planet Zender.

The Glimmer of Hope was a starship that served in the navy of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, Grand-engineer Lony Coleema was kidnapped by the IG-88 assassin droid IG-88 after providing information about the Galactic Empire to the Rebel Alliance.
The Xyrass were a small, skeleton-like humanoid species from Tabor V.

Ristal was a planet in the Kubilaï system. The colonel Ershack commanded a Rebel base on the planet sometime after the Battle of Yavin. After the disappearance of an Ytterbium cargo which was destined to the Rebel garrison on Hoth, he sent Rebel operatives to investigate.
The Snake's Guild was a pirate confederation which governed the planet Tabor V. Officially, the Guild reproved murders and crimes, but the local law enforcement was very soft in its action.
Aldorus IV was a mining planet in the Aldorus system.
Kaldahan (formerly known as Kanduh) was the home planet of the ancient Kanduh civilization.

An Orthar was a lizard-like creature, sporting a very thick fur and extreme resilience. It was used by the local populations as a mount in the frozen mountains of the planet of Shingra. One Orthar would cost 200 credits.
A Krodyur was a flat creature, sporting a white fur and a dreadful jaw. Extremely dangerous and hard to see in the mountain of Shingra—especially during the night—it would often attack the voyagers.
A Snow Siren was a creature living in the mountain of the planet Shingra. Similar to crabs, they hid under the snow and produced plaintive moans to attract voyagers in crevices.
Aldorus VI was a green gas giant in the Aldorus system.
Sélima Kim was a pirate organization, named after Sélima Kim, also a pirate.

IG-88B, also commonly known simply as IG-88, pronounced Eyegee-Eightyeight, or as a Phlutdroid, was a rogue, deadly masculine IG-series assassin droid manufactured by Holowan Laboratories who, because of his desire to kill organic beings, worked as a bounty hunter.

The Mandalorian secret service was a security organization of the New Mandalorian government. It was an elite unit of the Mandalorian Guard but had several corrupt guards who were in league with Prime Minister Almec in establishing an illegal black market on Mandalore.

Tauntaun Troopers were Rebel troopers who rode on Tauntauns during the events of the Galactic Civil War. They were largely utilized for scouting purposes, although they also saw some combat as well. They were outfitted at Rebel Troop Centers and carried flamethrowers.
The Botori, also known as the Botor, were a sentient species that inhabited around two dozen star systems in the Botor Enclave of the Core Worlds.
The Culroon were the natives of the planet Culroon III in Wild Space.

A Tusken Raider village was located in the deserts of the Outer Rim planet Tatooine prior to the Clone Wars. It was destroyed by Anakin Skywalker out of revenge for the death of his mother, Shmi Skywalker Lars.

The Department of Modification was a department of the Coalition for Improvements' Sector Development. Its public face was as an association of technologists and specialists who strove to help star systems modify their technology to fall in line with the Galactic Empire standard.

After replacing Luuke Skywalker as the replacement for Luke Skywalker following the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence in 43 ABY, Luuuke Skywalker set out to gather all the clones created by Grand Admiral Thrawn into one force. Luuuke aimed to use this Clone Army to conquer the galaxy.
Patagonia was a planet where the former pirate Roberts palace was located following the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence.

Thrawn's secret fortress was a secret fortress that Thrawn owned. When he started replacing people before they died with clones, he kidnapped the original person forcing them to live in this fortress.
The Alliance Diplomatic Corps was the branch of the Alliance to Restore the Republic tasked with dealing with friendly states and potential allies. It was under the control of the Ministry of State.
Wanda was a WA-7 waitress droid that worked in Dex's Diner on Coruscant shortly before the Battle of Yavin. She was friends with Harmony.

objective: Intervene in the operations of the Nightsisters
x: Sometime between 102 BBY and 81 BBY, the Jedi Order sent a group of Jedi Knights to the Outer Rim Territories planet Dathomir to intervene in the operations of the Nightsisters, a coven of witches native to the planet who were affiliated with the wider Witches of Dathomir soci…

LD-112 was a police droid that was active during the Clone Wars and served at the large space station. It was destroyed by the Sith Lord Darth Maul after he destroyed SD-357. LD-112 was destroyed soon after.
The Mos Eisley Parade was an event held in Mos Eisley, Tatooine by the Hutts to crown the Miss Mos Eisley. It featured the Max Rebo Band and Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes and saw Imperial presence.

During the Galactic Civil War, a prolongued conflict between Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire, the Imperial Admiral Kohrin's second fleet bombarded the planet thinking that it was home to a Rebel base, in retaliation for Luke Skywalker's attack on the Executor-class Star Dre…
Daronak was a terrestrial planet located in the Daronak system, a part of the Phelleem sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of Channoga Boulevard.
A skirmish occurred on Christophsis around 22 BBY. Yoda fought B1-series battle droids by leaping from one STAP to another.
Socco was a planet in the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector.
Kraten was a planet in the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector.

The Republic Strategic Command was a strategic command of the Galactic Republic. Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun consulted with the command regarding whether or not to enlist the Alliance Commander in the third Galactic War.
The Void Strider was a type of creature that lived on the planet Abafar, where they would run around the desert, looking for water.
The Departure Lounge was a highly dense area in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. It contained Docking Bay 94.

ALC-9 was an YV-865 Aurore-class freighter owned by the Snivvian Morlimur Snugg, the Superintendent of the Cybloc Transfer Station, during the Clone Wars. It was stolen by the Nightbrothers Darth Maul and Savage Opress.
The attack on the Memorial Shrine was a bombing of the New Mandalorian Memorial Shrine in the heart of Mandalore's capital city, Sundari, by the Death Watch during the Clone Wars.
The Mos Espa marketplace was a vast shopping area located in the city of Mos Espa, a spaceport on the sun-scorched planet Tatooine.
Zender was a red desert planet. It was the homeworld of the Darga species, who were mutated via exposure to radioactive Dorium in the planet's crust.

Tabor V was a planet located in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Xyrass. The planet was controlled by a pirate organization known as the Snake's Guild. The Galactic Empire knew its coordinates, but the Imperial authority thought it was unoccupied.

place: Space between Abafar and the Carida system
objective: Sabotage the Republic strategy conference
x: The Carida Incident was the result of a mission undertaken by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The Separatists sabotaged the Venator-class Star Destroyer Renown by loading it with rhydonium canisters with the intention of ramming it into the Valor space station, the sit…

The Aldo Spachian Comet was a comet captured between the two stars of the Aldo Spachian system. The beauty of the comet was legendary and so spectacular that many pilots risked death by piloting between the stars in order to approach and observe the comet.
The ebon hawk was a type of hawk. They were known to prey on the skittermouse, a creature found on the Inner Rim desert planet Jakku, which the birds would catch in their talons.

The Freedom Day celebrations were organized on the planet of Naboo following the victory against the Trade Federation's invasion forces in 32 BBY. Back by popular demand, a triumph parade was scheduled to be the high point of those celebrations two days after the decisive battle.
Cynestra was a planet. The Cynestra Space Craft Show was held on an artificial satellite orbiting the blue planet during the Galactic Civil War.
Possums were bipedal, reptilian creatures hailing from the fourth moon of Yavin Prime. They possessed devices resembling goggles over their eyes.
Gureishia were a species of whale of ambiguous sentience that dwelled in a sea of Hoth. They could communicate with protocol droids such as C-3PO and would be friendly to Humans and droids.
The Drogon was the Kroford family's personal starship. It was used during the Rebellion era by a group of Rebels to escape a group of cyborgs disguised as Maxeil Kroford's servants.

Abelard was a planet in the Abelard system on which the Galactic Empire had established a base during the Rebellion era. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance to Restore the Republic attacked the base and managed to steal a stabilized ytterbium cargo.

The Battle of Abelard was a battle between the Rebel forces and the Galactic Empire on the planet of Abelard some time after the Battle of Yavin. During the conflict, the Rebels managed to steal a stabilized ytterbium cargo.

The Solemnis was a Rebel Alliance starship. After the Battle of Abelard, the Solemnis was tasked with conveying the stabilized Ytterbium cargo that the Rebels had stolen from the Imperial forces to the Rebel base on Hoth but it disappeared before reaching Ristal.

Shingra was the only inhabitable planet in the Ordali system. It is covered in snowy mountains, with an average temperature of -15°C. Rarely, gems renowned for their size and purity can be found by mining the rock here.
Taypho was a planet located in the Mid Rim, away from the major hyperlanes.
Brazadann was a planet located in the Outer Rim, and the twin of the planet Oriadann.
Oriadann was a planet located in the Outer Rim, and the twin of the planet Brazadann.
The early death dog, also known as urcaninus lic morte or simply urcaninus, was a foul-tempered, strong, and voluminous predator.

Heep-heeps were creatures from Zrak. They possessed four legs, a backside, a reptilian head and black-colored eyes, and the species was known to dwell near tight holes on occasion. Heep-heeps could have at least one gender, male.
Desultori was a location in the Yde system. It contained the University of Desultori and was home to famed author Aanxi Raanxi Laanxi.
Ecorbs were a sentient species that inhabited the Detral Pits. They had coiled attachments called hampas on their gelatinous heads and possessed red, pulsating blup sacks.

t: Offspring of Parents Who Haven't Been Born Yet
x: Offspring of Parents Who Haven't Been Born Yet was a charity organization that adopted thousands of microscopic adrenaline addicts and found them good test tubes to incubate in.

The Gueal was a sentient species with red eyes, slit pupils, long snouts, and two pointy ears. Members of the species possessed four legs and beige skin. At some point, a Gueal wrote a lament about their journey with love.

t: Manifold Mollusk Matrix and Matrimony Association
x: The Manifold Mollusk Matrix and Matrimony Association was an organization for which the alien Skreen served as a technical director.

t: Society for the Refusal of Astrophysics
x: The Society for the Refusal of Astrophysics was an anti-astrophysics association that produced monthly publications. Regalia Sub-space station-12 director mOKDAR 15 was a member of the society and edited their publications.

Abar-12 was the location of Vemu, which in turn was the site of Cylinder 14. When the attorneys Lilac Nani, Medypsh, and Zot Effervescence sent a letter to their partner, The Wavering Oeklass, it was addressed to the latter at Cylinder 14, Abar-12.

Raspar-6 was a terrestrial moon. At some point, an atomic blast erupted on Raspar-6. A subsequent weather forecast—which referred to Raspar-6 as a "delinquent moon"—for the West Fissure region of an agricultural planet prognosticated that the explosion would affect the planet'…

The atomic blast on Raspar-6 was a large-scale nuclear explosion on the moon Raspar-6, located in the Tragan Cluster, within the Outer Rim Territories. The blast impacted the atmosphere of a nearby planet during the month of Stolivea in that world's calendar.
Fluorescent plankton was a type of bioluminescent plankton that dwelled in caves. They were cited in a song called "If Only I Could Let Go and Cry."
Port Town District was an area located on the upper concourse of Cloud City. The area was not to be confused with the notorious mid-level, Port Town.

The Cloud City dining room, also known as the Cloud City Dining Hall, was located on Cloud City. Accompanying his compatriots for what they believed to be some light but satisfying refreshments, as well as a brief mention of a plan to get Imperial influence out of Cloud City, …

A mind eel was a species of eel native to the West Fissure, an agricultural region on a planet situated near the moon Raspar-6, in the Raspar star system, located in the Tragan Cluster within the Outer Rim Territories.

A planet orbited a sun whose solar flares regularly affected most of the world's surface. The planet's climate was varied and included such weather phenomena as dry rain, glacial cysts, irrational echoes, spotted snow, resistance shadows, and talking fogs.

Galtor VI was a planet mined by the Galactic Empire. Some time during the Galactic Civil War, a prisoner managed to escape from the mines and joined a Rebel outpost in the Silenia system. The mines sometimes produced Socalium crystals.

result: New Mandalorian government overthrown by the Shadow Collective
Pre Vizsla killed and succeeded by Maul as Death Watch leader
Beginning of the Mandalorian Civil War
Almec is reinstated as Prime Minister
x: The takeover of Mandalore, also known as the conquest of Mandalore, or the assault on Mandalore, was an event during the Clone Wars when the Mandalorian splinter faction Death Watch and renegade Sith Lords Maul and his brother Savage Opress launched a sham takeover of the Mand…
This sentient species was a polygamous species that possessed eyestalks and were native to the Nebula Forso. Kaat Thrick-Thrick was a member of this species.
This sentient species were native to Lusaanda. Skreen was a member of this species.

The Souma were a species of sentient felines hailing from the planet Soum. Their whole bodies were covered with a thick coat of fur, and they had gentle, frank-looking eyes. The Souma species had a 1-to-5 male-to-female ratio.
Soum was a planet located in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the feline sentients known as the Souma.

The Fandélane Rebel base was a facility used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic at some point following the Battle of Yavin. That base was under the command of the Twi'lek Alliance Colonel Ki Essorel.
The Elespads were a pachydermoid, sentient species. They had brown or orange skin color, two large and floppy ears, a trunk and a pair of tusks.
The Coruscant Underworld Police were police officers of the Coruscant Security Force assigned specifically to patrol the underworld of the planet Coruscant.

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the First Son, leader of the Children of the Emperor, ordered the Empire to attack the planet Sarkhai in a bid to distract the Barsen'thor.

Eridani was a major Galactic Republic establishment on the planet Sylvia IV. In 1125 BBY, the Disaster of Arrakad led to the massacre of the Human population of Eridani, forcing the Republic to launch a massive evacuation of Jedar and Lorik before quarantining the planet.

Jedar was a major Galactic Republic establishment on the planet Sylvia IV. In 1125 BBY, the Disaster of Arrakad led to the massacre of the Human population of Eridani, forcing the Republic to launch a massive evacuation of Jedar and Lorik before quarantining the planet.

Lorik was a major Galactic Republic establishment on the planet Sylvia IV. In 1125 BBY, the Disaster of Arrakad led to the massacre of the Human population of Eridani, forcing the Republic to launch a massive evacuation of Jedar and Lorik before quarantining the planet.
Juranno was a city of Alderaan, situated in the Juran Mountains valley. The city had been deliberately built in this spot, so it looked like it had been carved from the mountains surrounding it.

Naboo Senatorial Delegation was the political body that represented the planet Naboo and the 35 other worlds of the backwater Chommell sector during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. It consisted of a senator and their entourage.
In 4 ABY, the Naboo people orchestrated a rescue of Queen Padmé Amidala after she was somehow captured by a group of Tusken Raiders stationed at Jundland Station.

Jedi Mickey's Starfighter was the personal customized Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor of the Jedi Master Mickey Mouse and his astromech droid partner, R2-MK. Mickey and R2-MK used Jedi Mickey's Starfighter to battle droid starfighters and Imperial TIE Fighter squadrons.

The mice (singular form, mouse) were a species of diminutive, rodent-like sentient beings with large ears who hailed from the world of Hyperion. The renowned Jedi Master named Mickey Mouse, who fought during the Clone Wars and survived the Great Jedi Purge, was one of them.

The Del Andue were a strange-looking sentient species. In 3 ABY, the Jedi Luke Skywalker spent some time living in a hovel on the planet Tatooine with two Del Andues while he made preparations to rescue his friend Han Solo from the clutches of the crime lord Jabba the Hutt.

The Vaathkree was an Imperial star cruiser commandeered by Grand Admiral Thrawn as of 6 ABY. That year, Thrawn traveled to Sluis Van aboard the Vaathkree in order to acquire a Star Destroyer under construction in the Sluissi construction yards, and to gather intelligence in an…

Raxus Secundus, also known simply as Raxus, was a lush world in the Outer Rim Territories' Tion Hegemony that served as the capital planet of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
A Capuchin was present at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on Tatooine around the time Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi were there. The Capuchin wore a red vest and was fond of dates.
OB-CPO was the aircraft of Jock Lindsey. At some point it was kept in Mos Eisley on Tatooine.

Kessel was the nickname of an unidentified species of bird found in the Aeneid system. Lando Calrissian, Marshak, Fonker Dahk, and others once tricked Han Solo into buying 17,000 credits worth of the worthless and pestilent birds.
Quarren City was a major population center for the Quarren people of the water planet Dac.
Prefsbelt IV, also known simply as Prefsbelt, was a planet in the Prefsbelt system and Prefsbelt sector of the Outer Rim Territories that housed a naval academy.
Nilrebmah I was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. No life had ever evolved on the world; its terrain was largely desert plains. There were no moons in Nilrebmah I's orbit.

Nilrebmah II was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. The atmosphere of the world was fluorine-based. It's desert-covered surface was cratered, due to the fact that its atmosphere was filled with asteroids which made frequent impact on the surface.
Nilrebmah III was an uninhabited low-gravity planet of rocky plains in the Nilrebmah system.
Nilrebmah IV was a frozen planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's atmosphere was methane-based, and no life had ever evolved on its frigid surface.

Nilrebmah V was a terrestrial world planet in the Nilrebmah system. Covered in seas filled with fish and crustaceans, the planet's atmosphere was oxygen-rich and breathable by the majority of species; though the planet never evolved sentient life.

Nilrebmah VI was once a planet in the Nilrebmah system. After some cataclysm in the galaxy's ancient past, the planet was reduced to rubble, forming a debris cloud where the planet once was. An exogorth was recorded as making its abode deep within the asteroid cloud.
Nilrebmah VII was a desert planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's atmosphere was a mix of oxygen-nitrogen, and no life had ever evolved on its dry surface.
Nilrebmah VIII was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's surface was tectonically unstable, with great storms of ash and fire worsening the erosion and blackening of the surface.

Nilrebmah IX was once a planet in the Nilrebmah system. After some cataclysm in the galaxy's ancient past, the planet was reduced to rubble, falling into its old orbit as an asteroid belt. Flocks of mynocks flitted about the belt.

Nilrebmah X was a rocky planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's atmosphere of sulfur dioxide. Lacking any surface water, the planet was home to a silica-based life form that were capable of touching the Force.
Nilrebmah XI was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. A world with a chlorine-based atmosphere, Nilrebmah XI never developed any lifeforms.

Nilrebmah XII was a volcanic planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet was in an unnatural state of tectonic activity, brought about by the machinations and experiments of Ku'ar Danar in the time of the Hundred-Year Darkness.

terrain: Shell formed 5,000 meters above the actual surface
x: Nilrebmah XIII was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. Following the experiments of Ku'ar Danar, Nilrebmah XIII had been moved into a lunar orbit over its neighbor, Nilrebmah XII.
The Ghost was a modified VCX-100 light freighter owned by the Twi'lek Hera Syndulla that was used by the Spectres rebel cell during the Age of the Empire.

The Senate chamber was an enormous chamber in the New Republic senatorial complex where the New Republic's Senate met. It was in this chamber where the fact that Darth Vader was senator Leia Organa's father was revealed.
The Internal Counterintelligence Branch, known as IntCon, was a branch within Imperial Intelligence's Internal Organization Bureau.
Al'Moab III was the third world in the Al'Moab system. A relatively imposing planet, Al'Moab III was mostly covered in deserts. However, that had not prevented the colonization of the land.

Tau Squadron was a starfighter squadron of TIE pilots serving the Galactic Empire's navy during the Galactic Civil War. They fought rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's coup forces during an insurrection.
Yaloris was a planet. The Yalor were the native sentient species of the planet.
The planet Alderaan was the capital of the New Galactic Empire.
Aquilae was a Planet in the Aquilaean system that was a target of conquest by the New Galactic Empire.

The Valarian Syndicate was a criminal organization created by Lady Valarian. During the Galactic Civil War, it strongly rivaled Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire for the control of the planet Tatooine. Members of the organization were known simply as Valarians.
Stobar Spaceport was a spaceport located on Stobar, where the diner Plop Dribble's was located.
The Ministry of Finance was the ministry of the Galactic Empire that dealt with monetary issues. It was led by the Finance Minister. In 19 BBY the position was held by Minister Gahg.
A planet was located on the edges of the Torch Nebula, a nebula in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy.

Lothal was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the early years of the Galactic Empire, Lothal was in a state of economic disrepair and invited the Empire to take over the planet's industries, with the promise of prosperity and security.

The Gampassa was a species of turtle native to the planet Glee Anselm's oceans. Their skin was wrinkled and gray, while their bodies were round and elongated. A ponderous head and tiny tail grew from the creature's front and backside, respectively.
Anchorhead was a spaceport town on the planet Aquilae.
The Battle of the Space Fortress was a battle that was fought between the Aquilaean Starforce and the Galactic Empire.
The Aquilaean Council was the official ruling council in the Palace of Lite, Aquilae lead by King Kayos, and eventually his daughter Queen Leia.

Sicemon (also spelled Siceman) was a planet located in the Sice system that was covered in vast grasslands and mounds. Inhabited by giant flying whales, it was home to a city that was used as a base by the Rebel Alliance.

Traal was a remote planet. At some point by approximately 180 BBY, the Twi'lek Jedi Master Skia Ro famously survived on Traal for two years while equipped with nothing but a towel, a fact that was known to her apprentice Christina Starspeeder.
J-45 was a gray 2-1B surgical droid employed by Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine. The droid offered Luke Skywalker medical treatment during his attempts to free a carbonite-frozen Han Solo from Jabba.

Gold Squadron was a unit of three B-wing starfighters in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, an Imperial Navy group attacked the cruiser Lulsla, an MC80 cruiser that the unit was stationed at.
The Starhawk was the prototype of the Starhawk-class battleship line and the product of the New Republic's Project Starhawk during the Galactic Civil War.

C1-10P, commonly known as "Chopper," or simply "Chop," was a masculine C1-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that was active during the Clone Wars and the early years of the Galactic Empire.
The Marines, also known as SpaceOps, were a division of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Special Forces operating during the Galactic Civil War.

x: The Phantom was a modified VCX-series auxiliary starfighter manufactured by the Corellian Engineering Corporation that was used by the Spectres during the Imperial Era and the early conflicts of the Galactic Civil War. The Phantom could dock with its mothership, the Ghost.
The Equatorial trench was the wide trench than ran around the equator of the Galactic Empire's first and second Death Stars, separating their northern and southern hemispheres.

headquarters: ISB Central Office, Imperial City, Coruscant
x: The Commission of Operations was the governing body of the Imperial Security Bureau. Based out of the ISB Central Office in Imperial City, the Commission would transmit assignments to the Sector Officer in charge of the relevant operational branch.
The Jedi twins Tiplee and Tiplar were members of a humanoid sentient species. Their skin color was red and green, respectively, and both had blue eyes.
A green starfighter piloted by the Jedi Master Yoda that strongly resembles a a downsized Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor at some point during the Clone Wars.

The capital city of Scipio was constructed on one of the planet's icy mountain peaks. The city's skyline of swooping arches and polished buildings was dominated by the massive and towering Main Vault of the InterGalactic Banking Clan.
Crazy Harry was a Clone Wars veteran droid with a strong personality. He was a pilot for the Star Tours spaceline.

Specters of "Sith Warriors" existed on the Sith homeworld of Moraband. These wraith-like apparitions were conjured by Force Priestesses as well as by the power of the dark side of the Force, in order to test if Jedi Master Yoda was ready to begin training to preserve his ident…

The Imperial Diplomatic Corps, or Diplomatic Service, was an organization in the Galactic Empire's military bureaucracy that used diplomats throughout the galaxy for negotiations and talks between governments and large corporations.

The Nimbanels were a sentient reptilian species native to Nimban. They could be found throughout the galaxy demonstrating their talents, particularly in the areas of business, politics, and general problem-solving. Jay Igno was a Nimbanel air taxi driver on Coruscant.
Bardotta was a remote planet located in the Bardotta system of the Shasos sector of the galaxy's Colonies region.

Alderaan, located in the Core Worlds, was a terrestrial planet covered with mountains. During the waning decades of the Galactic Republic, it was ruled by Queen Breha Organa and represented in the Galactic Senate by her husband, Senator Bail Prestor Organa.

Dogs, also known as hounds, were a classification of non-sentient, omnivorous quadrupedal or sometimes hexapedal species of canines in the galaxy. One type was the akk dog, which was found on Anoat. The Begamor two-headed dog was found on the planet Begamor.

headquarters: Senate Building, Federal District, Galactic City, Coruscant
x: The Galactic Senate, also referred to as the Galactic Congress, the Congress of the Republic, or the Republic Senate, was the legislative assembly of the Galactic Republic.

Humans were a species of sentient, bipedal mammals with bilateral symmetry. Throughout the galaxy, they constituted the culturally dominant species and were commonly encountered on most settled planets, from the bountiful planet of Naboo to the desert world of Tatooine.

The Coruscant Security Force (CSF), also referred to as Coruscant Security or Coruscant Police and later as the Imperial police, was the law enforcement service in charge of maintaining order on the galactic capital planet of Coruscant.

Naboo was a bountiful planet in the Chommell sector of the Mid Rim, in the Trailing Sectors and close to the border of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the indigenous Gungan species and to a population of humans known as the Naboo.

Dee'ja Peak was a farming community located in the Gallo Mountains on Naboo. It was founded by a nomadic tribe of humans from Grizmallt who came to colonize the planet many centuries before the Clone Wars.

terrain: Frozen ice plains, glaciers, oceans mountains
x: Hoth was a remote, icy planet that was the sixth planet in the star system of the same name, located in the Anoat sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld to the primitive wampa species.
Wampas, or wampa ice creatures, were a carnivorous, semi-sentient white-furred primitive species of mammal which dwelled on the snow-clad planet Hoth.

x: Kessel was a planet within the Akkadese Maelstrom that hosted spice mines. The planet also exported coaxium and Kesselstone. While Kessel's northern hemisphere was devoted to mining, the planet's southern hemisphere was home to lush sanctuaries.
The Executor was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought and personal flagship of the Sith Lord Darth Vader and was the most powerful vessel ever created by the Galactic Empire.

x: A battle was fought on Zanbar between the Death Watch forces of the Shadow Collective and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Dantooine was a planet in the Dantooine system, in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim Territories' northern New Territories region. Dantooine was affiliated with both the Galactic Republic and later, the Galactic Empire.
The Jedi High Council, more commonly known as the Jedi Council, was a body of twelve Jedi Masters that governed the Jedi Order.

Ewoks were a diminutive primitive species of furry bipeds native to the forest moon of Endor. They were most notable for helping the Rebel Alliance defeat the forces of the Galactic Empire at the Battle of Endor, allowing the shield generator there to be destroyed, and in turn…
Dathomir, nicknamed the "rancor planet," was a remote, neutral, and obscure planet in the Dathomir system of the Quelii sector in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy.
Womp rats were creatures native to Tatooine, and were considered pests by local moisture farmers who hunted them for sport.
Zabraks were a near-human carnivorous species native to the planets Iridonia and Dathomir. Most members of the species had distinctive horns atop their heads, as well as two hearts.
Coruscant , also known as Jewel of the Core Worlds, or Imperial Center during the rule of the Galactic Empire, was an ecumenopolis—a city-covered planet, in the Coruscant system of the Core Worlds.

Onderon was a jungle world located within the Inner Rim. During the Clone Wars, the planetary government seceded to the Confederacy of Independent Systems; in the Separatist Senate, Onderon was represented by Senator Mina Bonteri and later by her son, Lux Bonteri.

government: Clans under the authority of the Mand'alor
x: Mandalore, also known as Mand'alor, was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Mandalorians, a fearsome warrior clan-based people, and the indigenous Alamite species.
The Nightbrothers were a small colony of Dathomirian Zabrak male warriors who lived in a village on the far side of the planet Dathomir under the rule of the Nightsister clan of witches.

Tatooine was a sparsely inhabited circumbinary desert planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Part of a binary star system, the planet orbited two scorching suns, resulting in the world lacking the necessary surface water to sustain large populations.

The Republic Ministry of Intelligence was a ministry dedicated to the Galactic Republic's intelligence activities. During the Clone Wars, one of the Ministry's workers was a human, Davu Golec from the planet Mandalore.

Lotho Minor, also known as the Junk World, was a ruined planet in the Lotho Minor system in the Outer Rim Territories' Wazta sector that was the homeworld of the mysterious society known as the Junkers. It was discovered early in the history of the Galactic Republic.

The High Board Room was a hydrostatic bubble-chamber in Otoh Gungan, from which the Gungan High Council ruled the city. During the Invasion of Naboo, the two Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi were escorted to the High Board Room to explain their presence in Otoh Gunga.
Chagrians were an amphibious sentient species of tall and horned humanoids with blue skin that were native to the planet Champala.

The Naboo Royal Advisory Council, also known as the Royal Consultative Council, was a body of ministers who served as advisors to the elected monarch of the pastoral planet Naboo. The planet's governor was also the chairperson of that council.
Theed was the capital city of the Naboo, a society of humans who lived on the planet of the same name. It was home to the Royal House of Naboo's palace, which was situated on the Palace Plaza.

Midi-chlorians were microscopic, intelligent life forms that originated from the foundation of life in the center of the galaxy and ultimately resided within the cells of all living organisms, thereby forming a symbiotic relationship with their hosts.

R2-D2, pronounced Artoo-Deetoo and often referred to as R2 (Artoo), was an R2-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton with masculine programming.
Raydonia was a temperate, forested planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
C-3PO (See-Threepio) was a 3PO-series protocol droid designed to interact with organics, programmed primarily for etiquette and protocol.

Dagobah was a remote, unexplored planet in the Dagobah system, and one of the purest places in the galaxy within the Force. A remote world of swamps and forests, it served as a refuge for Jedi Grand Master Yoda during his exile after the destruction of the Jedi Order.
Bothans were a group known for operating a spy network. Bothans were known to communicate with each other in a series of growls.
Nal Hutta, also known simply as Hutta, was a hot, swampy planet located deep within Hutt Space of the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Hutt species and headquarters of the Grand Hutt Council.
Assorhan was the homeworld of the Assorhian species.

Ossapohans were one of the two variants of the Assorhians, the others being the Assopohans. The race of each Assorhian determined their position in society: the black-skinned Osoppohans were the ruling caste, while the white-skinned Assopohans were the slave caste.

Assopohans were one of the two variants of the Assorhians, the others being the Ossapohans. The race of each Assorhian determined their position in society: the black-skinned Ossapohans were the ruling caste, while the white-skinned Asoppohans were the slave caste.

The Millennium Falcon, originally designated YT 492727ZED and formerly known as the Stellar Envoy, and registered or known under various aliases and pseudonyms including Broken Bell, Corell's Pride, Close Shave, Fickle Flyer, Foul Matter, Graphite Skipper, Jin-Den Smoke, Longs…
Corellia was a planet located in the galaxy's Core Worlds known for its ace pilots and large starships.
The Selkath were a species of aquatic beings native to the planet Manaan. The species was most comfortable underwater and preferred to be immersed in liquid.

Sarlaccs were dangerous, carnivorous creatures located on Tatooine and several other planets throughout the galaxy. It shared common ancestry with other species, including the rathtar, blixus, and vixus.

The Naboo (singular "Naboo"), also known as Naboolians or Nabooians, were a cultural group of humans from the planet Naboo. Contrary to the native Gungans, with whom they shared their world, the Naboo originated offworld as human colonists from Grizmallt.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Level 5127 was a level on the metropolitan world of Coruscant, so named because it was located five thousand, one hundred, and twenty-seven levels from the planet's ground. Galactic City comprised the entirety of Level 5127.
Mustafar was a young, small planet located in the Mustafar system, within the Atravis sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

The Devastator was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy, famous for its tenure as the flagship of the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Vader. Under Vader's command, the Devastator participated in the Battle of Scarif and the capture of the Tantive IV.

headquarters: Senate Building, Senate District, Imperial City, Coruscant
x: The Imperial Senate, also referred to as the Galactic Senate or the Imperial Congress, was the legislative assembly of the Galactic Empire that constituted one of the last remnants of the Old Republic.

The Tantive IV was a CR90 corvette in the service of the House of Organa. The ship was a central player in the events at the beginning of the Galactic Civil War, serving as Princess Leia Organa's personal starship in the leadup to the Battle of Yavin.
Sullust was a planet located in the Sullust system of the Outer Rim Territories that was home to the Sullustan species.

Yavin Prime, also known simply as Yavin, was an orange gas giant, nearly 200,000 kilometers in diameter, located in the Outer Rim Territories. Its clouds provided cover in battle, but death awaited any pilot who dove too far.
Yavin 4, also known as Yavin, was the jungle-covered fourth moon in orbit around the red gas giant Yavin Prime.

Central City was a small country town on the planet of Lothal. When the Galactic Empire occupied Lothal, elite stormtroopers were charged with patrolling the streets of Central City, despite its minor importance.
The Saak'ak was a modified Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter that was part of the private fleet of the Trade Federation and served as the Federation's flagship during the Invasion of Naboo.

The Radiant VII was a Consular-class space cruiser of the Galactic Republic. It transported Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi to the planet Naboo, where they were to negotiate with Viceroy Nute Gunray of the Trade Federation.

Level 1 was the lowest megastructure level constructed on the planet Coruscant and was deemed uninhabitable. Level 1 was one of the very first levels of Coruscant constructed in 100,000 BBY that eventually rose from the soil into a world-spanning city.
Wookiees, known in their own language of Shyriiwook as "the People of the Trees," were a species of tall, hairy humanoids that were native to the planet Kashyyyk.
The Coruscant Underworld, also called the Lower Coruscant, lower levels or undercity, were the levels underneath the surface structures of the planet Coruscant.

The Valley of the Dark Lords was an area of Moraband that contained numerous monuments serving as crypts for deceased Dark Lords of the Sith. The largest monument in the valley housed the tomb of Darth Bane, the founder of the Rule of Two.

leader: Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader
x: Clone troopers, also known as Clone soldiers, Republic troopers, Republic troops, Republic soldiers, Regs, and nicknamed the "Boys in White," were highly trained soldiers in the Grand Army of the Republic.
The Cereans were a species of sentient mammals hailing from the planet Cerea. They were distinguished by their enlarged conical cranium that contained a binary brain.

x: The Battle of Bothawui was an engagement that took place near the planet Bothawui in 22 BBY. Remembered as a key battle of the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic's victory in the battle put a stop to a Separatist advance.

x: The Second Battle of Geonosis, also known as the invasion of Geonosis or second invasion of Geonosis, took place in 21 BBY during the Clone Wars on the planet Geonosis, which had also served as the site of the conflict's opening battle.

The Battle of Malastare Narrows took place at Malastare Narrows in 34 BBY. The Corporate Alliance Admiral Trench blockaded the planet Malastare, and a Galactic Republic fleet, in which the human Wullf Yularen served as one of the leading officers, attacked Trench's forces.

Stewjon was a planet in the Deep Core that was the homeworld of Obi-Wan Kenobi, a male human Jedi Master. Between 32 and 29 BBY, Kenobi told his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, that he did not remember leaving his homeworld.
A shark was a carnivorous type of fish prevalent on many worlds throughout the galaxy.
Kindalo were a species of tall, bioluminescent, tree-like sentients who could be found in the subterranean caverns of the planet Aleen.
Bespin was a gas giant in the star system of the same name in the Anoat sector, its riches manifested in the form of rare tibanna gas.
The Shadow Collective was a large criminal alliance and rival Sith Order founded during the Clone Wars by the rogue Sith Lord Maul.

The Death Watch, known as Kyr'tsad in Mando'a, was a Mandalorian terrorist splinter group of warriors that opposed the pacifist government of Mandalore (led by Duchess Satine Kryze) during the Clone Wars.

Polis Massa was a planetoid in a dense asteroid field located in the Subterrel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, far from any major hyperspace lanes. At some point, Polis Massa was a planet located within the system of the same name.
Dathomirians, also known as Dathomirian Zabraks and culturally as Dathomiri or Dathmiri, were a subspecies of Zabrak native to the planet Peridea in a distant galaxy.

Tauntauns were a species of semi-sentient reptomammals native to the snowy plains of Hoth. They were used by members of the Rebel Alliance after they domesticated some of them when they built their new headquarters on Hoth, as the extreme conditions made airspeeders unreliable.

Black Sun was a criminal syndicate that came into prominence during the Clone Wars as the Jedi Order focused more on military affairs and less on law enforcement. Black Sun was allied with the Shadow Collective and its leader, the renegade Sith Lord Maul.

Kamino was an aquatic planet located in a remote star system in Wild Space of the galaxy. It was sometimes considered extragalactic due to being in close proximity to the Rishi Maze dwarf satellite galaxy.

Zanbar was a temperate swamp moon in the Outer Rim Territories covered with massive rocky plateaus. During the Clone Wars, the Mandalorian splinter group Death Watch established a temporary camp on its surface, which continued to be used after Death Watch allied with Maul to f…

x: Ugnaughts were a species of porcine, sentient humanoids, native to the planet Gentes. They were considered by many to be among the (if not the) hardest-working species in the galaxy.

Tipoca City was the capital city of the watery planet Kamino, and home to several million Kaminoans and housed the Ruling Council. The city was a network of domed structures built atop stilts over 150 kilometers tall at Kamino's equator.
The Force Priestesses were five beings that resided on the Wellspring of Life, the home of the midi-chlorians.
Cloud City, originally known as Floating Home Mining Colony, was a tibanna gas mining colony floating in the clouds of the planet Bespin, located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Loyalist Committee was a political committee created by Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine as an advisory body to himself to handle the Separatist Crisis and promote loyalty to the Galactic Republic.
Lola Sayu was a volcanic and sulfurous planet located within the Lola Sayu system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belderone sector.

The ARC program, also known simply as ARC training, and alternatively known as the Clone Commander training program, was a training program that certain clone troopers of the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic underwent in order to turn them into leaders by developing their i…

Hutts were a large slug-like sentient species who were native to the planet Varl, but considered their homeworld to be Nal Hutta after abandoning Varl due to the Kayfoundo Kapa. They were well known as galactic gangsters who controlled the Hutt Clan crime syndicate.

x: The Battle on Ord Mantell, also known as the Battle of Ord Mantell, was fought between the Shadow Collective of Maul and the Confederacy of Independent Systems on and in orbit of Ord Mantell during the Clone Wars.
Ord Mantell was a planet of the galaxy's Mid Rim that served as the capital of the Bright Jewel system. It was the homeworld of the Mantellian Savrip species.

Stormtroopers (STs)—also known as Imperial stormtroopers and often derogatorally referred to as "bucketheads"—were the elite shock troops of the Galactic Empire, and were part of the Stormtrooper Corps, an independent military branch operating under the Imperial Army.

Kashyyyk, also known as Planet Wookiee C to some humans in the Core Worlds, was a wroshyr tree-covered forest planet located in the southwestern quadrant of the galaxy and the homeworld of the Wookiee species.
The Kaleesh, also known as the Kaleeshi, were a reptilian sentient species from the Wild Space world of Kalee.

Heavy Weapons Specialists were a branch of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Special Forces. A combat heavy role, Heavy Weapons Specialists were trained to operate and maintain a wide variety of heavy weapons, including repeating blasters, missile weapons, and artillery.
Utapau was a remote, subterranean planet located deep in the Utapau system of the Tarabba sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

x: The Battle of Dathomir, also known as the Massacre of the Nightsisters and Massacre of Dathomir, was a genocidal battle that took place in 20 BBY, during the Clone Wars, on the planet of Dathomir.
The Pykes were a species of sentient humanoids native to the planet Oba Diah. The species had two distinct physiological groups.
Falleen were a repto-mammalian sentient species native to the planet of the same name. They were capable of projecting powerful pheromones.

Gungans were an amphibious sentient species and the indigenous inhabitants of the planet Naboo. The various different Gungan races could live on both water and land, but often made their home in underwater cities such as Otoh Gunga.

terrain: Floating mountains, lush forests, molten caverns
x: Mortis was an ethereal realm within the Force that resembled a planet. Its existence was whispered over in legends and stories passed down through the millennia by Jedi, Sith, and the average spacer alike.
Scrud was an Espionage droid that worked for GalactiCore.
Endor, designated IX3244-A, also known as the Forest Moon of Endor or the Sanctuary Moon, was a small forested moon that was the ninth moon that orbited the Outer Rim planet of the same name.
Terentateks were a species of hulking bipeds found on the arboreal planet of Kashyyyk that craved the blood of Force-sensitives.

headquarters: Gardulla the Hutt's Palace, Nal Hutta
x: The Grand Hutt Council, also known as the Hutt Grand Council and the Hutt Council, was the ruling body of the Hutt homeworld of Nal Hutta, which included a number of high profile and influential clan-families, who led the powerful crime family known as the Hutt Clan from the h…

Florrum was a sulfurous desert planet located in the Florrum system, within the Sertar sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, it was the location of a pirate gang led by Hondo Ohnaka.

x: The Duel on Mustafar, also known as the Battle on Mustafar, was a lightsaber duel where Anakin Skywalker, now the recently apprenticed Sith Lord, Darth Vader, fought his former Jedi Master and best friend, Obi-Wan Kenobi, on the planet Mustafar in the Outer Rim.
The Zillo Beast, sometimes referred to simply as "the Zillo," was a non-sentient, reptilian species endemic to the planet Malastare.

A zombie, also referred to as an undead, was a corpse revived through supernatural means such as Dathomirian witchcraft. Completely will-less and speechless, zombies were controlled by those who had summoned them in the first place.

Koiogra was a world which had been visited by the New Republic pilot Chass na Chadic. While on Koiogra, she discovered a recording of Jyn Erso's speech prior to the Battle of Scarif, realizing she had previously met the rebel on Uchinao a year earlier.

Clawdites were a sentient reptilian species whose members could change shape to impersonate any humanoid close to their shape. Chromatophores allowed Clawdites to replicate the appearance of another person, but could not change their body size or mass.

result: Death of Jedi High Council member Adi Gallia
x: During the Clone Wars, a skirmish took place on the Outer Rim world of Florrum between the pirate forces of Hondo Ohnaka, aided by the Jedi Order, and renegade pirate forces under the command of the renegade Sith Maul and Savage Opress.
There was a city present on the desert moon Zardossa Stix during the Clone Wars.

Sundari was the domed capital city of the planet Mandalore. The city was situated in the deserts of Mandalore and was enclosed by a bio-dome that allowed the city to exist on the harsh planet, which had been rendered a desert after years of Mandalorian wars.

In the aftermath of the battle to end the Trade Federation's invasion of the planet Naboo, the funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn was held in Theed for Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn, who was impaled by the Sith Lord Darth Maul during the battle.

In the aftermath of the Galactic Empire's defeat against the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Battle of Endor, the Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker held a funeral for his father, Anakin Skywalker, on the Forest Moon of Endor.

Twi'leks, sometimes referred to xenophobically as tail-heads or Twi, occasionally referred to as Rylothians, were a tall near-human species whose most striking feature was a pair of long appendages protruding from their skulls, called lekku.
The Kaminoans were a tall, thin amphibian sentient species that hailed from the aquatic planet of Kamino in Wild Space.

Tusken Raiders, less formally referred to as Sand People or simply as Tuskens, were a nomadic sentient species indigenous to the desert planet Tatooine, where they were often hostile to local settlers. Tusken children were called Uli-ah.
Jawas were a nomadic sentient species of meter-tall furry humanoids native to the Outer Rim desert world of Tatooine. Jawas who migrated from Tatooine were referred to as Offworld Jawas.
Gorse was a tidally-locked planet located on the Inner Rim. It had one moon called Cynda, which was rich in thorilide crystals.
