Pau'ans were gaunt, long-limbed humanoids from Utapau. They dwelled in their planet's sinkholes, and tamed the local varactyl for riding. Due to their long life-span, they were also known as the Ancients.
Rancors were very large, semi-sentient reptilian carnivores native to the planet Dathomir, although they were also introduced to and present on Felucia, Tatooine, Ottethan and Koboh.

The Cave of Evil, also known as the dark-side cave, was a large and living dark side vergence located under a gnarltree on the swamp planet of Dagobah. Entering the cave subjected entrants to the vergence's control, projecting their worst fears as apparitions and illusions.
Lake Paonga was a lake located on the planet of Naboo. The underwater capital of the Gungans, Otoh Gunga, was located in the lake.

Toydarians were a sentient, winged species from the planet Toydaria in Hutt Space. In addition to their ability to fly, Toydarians were physically defined by their long snouts and webbed feet, and could resist mental manipulation from the Force.
The Great Pit of Carkoon, also known as the Sarlacc Pit, was a large sand basin located within the Dune Sea, on the desert planet of Tatooine.

Slave I, also spelled Slave One and also known as Boba Fett's starship and Jango Fett's starship, was a modified Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft used by the infamous Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett before the Clone Wars and later his unaltered cloned son, Boba …
Lasats were a humanoid sentient species native to the Wild Space planet Lira San, though the species had settled the Outer Rim world of Lasan.
The Destruction of Alderaan, known to the Alderaanians as the Disaster, saw the planet Alderaan in the Coruscant Core destroyed at the hands of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Geonosis, referred to as Geonosia by some natives, was the desert home planet of the Geonosians. It hosted the Confederacy of Independent Systems major battle droid foundries and was the site of the First Battle of Geonosis, the opening conflict of the Clone Wars, as well as t…

The Herglics were a species of sentient, hulking aliens with black skin, a wide mouth, oily eyes, and a blowhole. Due to mistreatment by the Galactic Empire, many took refuge on Level 1782, on Coruscant, where one rescued Anandra Milon from a stormtrooper.

Rats were creatures that could be found in the lower levels of the city-planet of Coruscant. Those that roamed the junkyard of Level 1782 were particularly large. Tatoo-rats dwelled in the palace of Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine.

Mos Espa was a spaceport settlement located on the desert world of Tatooine. The settlement included a number of commercial and workspace settings, as well as entertainment establishments such as the Mos Espa Grand Arena.
Bright Tree Village was home to an eponymous tribe of Ewoks on Endor during the Galactic Civil War.

Coronation Day was an event celebrated on the planet Alderaan. It was also celebrated by the Alderaanian residents of Level 3204 on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire, despite the fact many of them rarely visited their homeworld.

x: The Twilight was a Corellian G9 Rigger-class light freighter owned and operated by the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars. Skywalker and his Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, used the ship to escape from a battle on Teth.

Level 2142 was a level of the city-planet of Coruscant. Following the destruction of the planet Alderaan by the Galactic Empire, two Alderaanian survivors; Anandra Milon and her younger brother Santigo, spent a night in an alley on the level while trying to escape capture by I…

Hangra's Meat Shack was a food vendor stall set up on Level 2142 of the city-planet Coruscant. Shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan by the Galactic Empire, the stall's grill was operated by an old man who was approached by Anandra Milon, an Alderaanian survivor.

The Zygerrians were a humanoid feline species from Zygerria. Having evolved from a horned sentient canine species, they built a powerful empire by capturing and selling slaves until the Jedi of the Galactic Republic went to war with them and outlawed it.

Ord Mantell City was the capital city of the planet Ord Mantell. The Black Sun criminal syndicate operated a base in Ord Mantell City, which was the location of a battle between the Shadow Collective and Confederacy of Independent Systems, resulting in significant damage to th…

Zygerria was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Zygerrian species.

Lasan was a planet located in the Lasan system of Wild Space that was long ago colonized by a group of Lasat that left their original homeworld of Lira San. The planet was protected by the Lasan High Honor Guard.

x: The Battle of Ringo Vinda, also known as the Ringo Vinda campaign or the Battle for Ringo Vinda, was fought at Ringo Vinda during the Clone Wars. Separatist Admiral Trench captured the planet's orbital graving docks, prompting a Republic effort to retake the world.
Cynda Dreaming was a freighter that operated between the planet Gorse and its moon Cynda during the Age of the Empire. It was destroyed by the Imperial Star Destroyer Ultimatum in 11 BBY.
The Desert Jewel was a luxury yacht owned by Fayet Kelen, the owner of Kelen Biolabs. It was mainly used by his daughter, Nakari Kelen, for scouting planets for her father.

Ringo Vinda was a planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim, along the Perlemian Trade Route. It was encircled by a massive civilian graving dock. The Ringo Vindans, a human cultural group, spoke Galactic Basic Standard with a distinctive accent.

The Boonta Eve Classic, also known as the Boonta Eve Podrace, the Boonta Eve Classic Podrace or simply Boonta Eve, was the largest annual podrace in the galaxy and cultural event on the planet Tatooine.
The Void was the title of the featureless seemingly endless desert covering the entire surface of the planet Abafar. It was broken up by small bodies of water and several outposts such as Pons Ora.
Mos Eisley, also known as Mos Eisley Spaceport, was a large spaceport settlement located southeast of the Jundland Wastes on the backwater Outer Rim Territories planet Tatooine.

Anoobas were a species of vicious and carnivorous canine-like desert mammals. The species had a varying tones of gray fur covering its body. Additionally, anoobas also had a distinct lower jaw that was complemented with chin tusks.

x: The Commission for the Preservation of the New Order (COMPNOR) was a government agency responsible for the promotion of the Galactic Empire's New Order ideology.

Clone commandos, also known as Republic commandos while serving under the Galactic Republic and Imperial Commandos under the Galactic Empire, were elite clone troopers that served in the Grand Army of the Republic's Special Operations Brigade during the Clone Wars.
Devaron was a terrestrial jungle planet located in the Devaron system of the galaxy's Colonies that was the homeworld of the Devaronian species.

Ryloth was a planet in the Ryloth system of the Outer Rim Territories, and the homeworld of the Twi'lek species. Its terrain varied, filled with jungles, mesas, valleys, and volcanoes, and had an atmosphere breathable for Twi'leks and humans alike.

Level 3204 was a level of the city-planet Coruscant. It was mostly occupied by residents originally from the planet Alderaan, but after the planet's destruction by the Galactic Empire, most of the occupants rioted before being arrested by Imperial stormtroopers.

Level 1996 was a level of the city-planet Coruscant. The level was a maze of pipes, sluices and catwalks located underneath the compactors of the shady Level 1997 and above the open abyss of Level 1995.

The Old Market Sector was an area of the planet Coruscant. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, a series of riots took place there, which led to the members of the Mon Calamari species being "relocated." A droid mechanic who lived next door to the human child Anandra Milon…

Level 1997 was a shady level of the city-planet Coruscant. Anandra Milon and her brother Santigo Milon met a pair of criminals there to discuss employment, but ended up having to flee the encounter when Imperials arrived at the cantina where the meeting was taking place.

Level 1782 was a level of the planet Coruscant which consisted of one gigantic junk yard. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, a camp was set up among the scrap by fugitives hiding from the Empire.

Level 1995 was a level of the city-planet Coruscant located below Level 1996. One area of the Level produced humming noises and strange lights, both of which could be perceived from a catwalk on the level above.

Level 3108 was a level on the city-planet Coruscant. Shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan, the fugitives Anandra Milon and Santigo Milon fled from the Galactic Empire to Level 3108 from their home on Level 3204.

Mandalorian super commandos, also known as the Mandalorian Supercommandos, the Mandalorian traditionalists or Maul loyalists, were Mandalorian warriors who served the rogue Sith Lord Maul and his criminal syndicate, the Shadow Collective, during the Clone Wars.
The Mon Calamari (also known as Mon Calamarians) were a humanoid, aquatic species native to the planet of Mon Cala. They shared their home planet with the Quarren.
The Dugs were a sentient species from the planet Malastare. They were easily identified by their long snouts and the fact that they walked using their arms.
A series of riots took place in the Old Market Sector on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Zilkins were a diminutive humanoid sentient species whose members had spotted green skin and stood at an average of roughly 0.33 meters in height.
Centax-3, or Centax 3, and nicknamed "The Aunt," was the third of four moons orbiting the planet Coruscant. The Aloo family had a residence there.
The Works was an industrial zone located in the Industrial District of Imperial City on the planet Coruscant. It was a vast, burned out district that was mostly abandoned.

R5-D4, also referred to as R5 (Arfive) and called "Red" by Luke Skywalker, was a red and white-striped R5 astromech droid owned by a group of Jawas on Tatooine in the early days of the Galactic Civil War.

Saponza's homestead was a large house on the desert world of Tatooine. After the owner, Saponza, and his companion killed six of Jabba's scouts, Bib Fortuna contacted them, warning them that Jabba would have his revenge.
The Wellspring of Life, also known simply as the Force planet, was the homeworld of the midi-chlorians, microscopic organisms that made life possible by residing in all living things.

Delrian was a world in the Inner Rim Territories which hosted an Imperial penal work camp. Prisoners incarcerated there during the Imperial Era were tasked with installing electronics on the durasteel restraints used on the Oovo 4 prison.

The Togruta were a tall near-human species, characterized by their colorful skin tones, large montrals, head tails, and white facial pigments. They hailed from the planet Shili, in the Expansion Region.
The Inquisitor's TIE Advanced was the personal TIE/ad v1 prototype TIE fighter entrusted to the Grand Inquisitor in his mission to hunt down Jedi for the Galactic Empire.
The Broken Horn was a modified C-ROC Gozanti-class light cruiser and the personal transport of Devaronian criminal Cikatro Vizago, leader of the Broken Horn Syndicate.
The Broken Horn Syndicate was a criminal organization that ruled the planet Lothal's underworld. The Devaronian Cikatro Vizago was the syndicate's leader.

Detention Block AA-23 was a detention area located within Detention Block AA on the Detention Level of the Death Star. It was reserved for political prisoners. The detention cells for this sector were located 400 meters below Docking Bay 327.

The Lawbringer was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer commanded by Captain Hiram Zataire. In 5 BBY, it was requisitioned by Agent Kallus of the Imperial Security Bureau, who would use it in his mission to snuff out the rebel uprising on the planet Lothal.

The Aleena were a species of short, sentient reptiles from the planet of Aleen. The Aleena lived on the surface of their homeworld, while the Kindalo lived in the underground, as was outlined in the Aleena–Kindalo treaty that ended their war.

Slum district G17 was a district on the planet Coruscant located in the underworld. It contained, among other things, the Spider Arms Hostel, several cabarets, at least two Noodle Bar diners, Chezdeze, Galaxy Noodles, a massage parlor, a gangster hangout, a gun market, and a b…
Besalisks were a humanoid sentient species with four arms and an inflatable wattle that were native to the planet Ojom.
Riot clone troopers, also known as clone riot troopers or riot control clone trooper, were specialized clone shock troopers of the Coruscant Guard who were trained in riot control.

Loth-cats were a non-sentient member of the feline tooka species native to Lothal, often found in the grassy plains of that Outer Rim planet. They were small, temperamental creatures, and while at times friendly, were still able hunters with sharp teeth and claws.

Loth-rats were creatures that lived among the grasslands of the Outer Rim Territories planet Lothal. They served as prey for Loth-cats. On the planet, the term was also often used as an insult. The species made its home in the grass of Lothal's grasslands.

Xexto were a sentient species of slight, spindly, six-limbed aliens who were native to the planet Troiken. Xexto were highly dexterous, enabling them to participate in the highly dangerous sport of podracing.
The Er'Kit were a species of humanoids with large, elongated craniums and long, skinny legs. One Er'Kit was Ody Mandrell, a famous podracer who took part in the Boonta Eve Classic.

The Jedi Archives, also known as the Jedi Temple Library, was the Jedi Order's repository of knowledge on Coruscant, rumored to hold the sum total of all galactic knowledge. They were overseen by the Council of First Knowledge.
The Well of the Dark Side was a deep, magma-filled chasm located in the realm of Mortis where the dark side of the Force was channeled.
The Stormblade Bloodfest was a gladiatorial competition. By the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign, the Houk gladiator Borbig Drob had claimed victory at the Bloodfest on nine occasions.
Arena Day was a festival of illegal gladiatorial matches on the Outer Rim planet Lothal.
Houks were a sentient species of hulking humanoids that had massive forearms and were capable of building heavy musculature.
A methane lake was a body of liquid methane which could be found on the high-gravity planet of Malastare. The Malastare 100 Podracing circuit was built around a methane lake.

Rodia was a remote and swampy jungle planet. It was the homeworld of the Rodian species. Cities on Rodia were encased with domed environmental shields that allowed entry and exit for vehicles and vessels.
Betu was a continent on the planet Rodia. Shortly after the destruction of the first Death Star, Luke Skywalker took a luxury yacht, named the Desert Jewel, to Betu for a secret mission.
Geonosians were a winged, semi-insectoid species native to the planet Geonosis that created nests in large, spire-like colonies on their homeworld.

Mirialans were a long-lived, near-human species native to the planet Mirial. They had skin tones ranging from green to yellow or pink to purple. Most had traditional geometric tattoos on their faces which symbolized personal achievements.
Banthas were a species of large, hairy mammals with sharp, spiraling horns. They inhabited the desert planet Tatooine, though they were bred on many worlds throughout the galaxy.

Sullustans were a species of humanoids that hailed from the planet of Sullust, and were experts at manufacturing, scientific and technological development, and economics, having founded the prosperous SoroSuub Corporation.

Dandoran was a lush and watery planet located in the Doran system, within Hutt Space. Throughout history, it was often used to hide cartel smuggling operations. It was covered in crystal clear lakes and pristine forests.
The Jedi Temple Guard was a security force maintained by the Jedi Order and tasked with the protection of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, the capital planet of the Galactic Republic.
A camp was built within the junkyards of Level 1782 of the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Alderaanians were a cultural group of humans native to the planet Alderaan. Known for their pacifistic values and devotion to the arts, prominent individuals included Viceroy Bail Prestor Organa and his wife, Queen Breha Organa, who were the adoptive parents of Princess Leia O…
Beggar's Canyon was a dry river bed that cut through Ben's Mesa, on the desert world of Tatooine. Its landmarks included the so-called Dead Man's Turn, the Diablo Cut, and the Stone Needle.

Clone Intelligence was the military intelligence branch of the Grand Army of the Republic. During the Clone Wars, clone espionage units were tasked with tracking General Grievous, a Separatist commander and high-value target of the Galactic Republic.

Garel was a planet located in the Garel system of the Outer Rim Territories' Lothal sector that was controlled by the Galactic Empire. It was the homeworld of Imperial Supply Master Yogar Lyste. Garel was several minutes away from the planet Lothal via hyperspace travel.

Cynda was the thorilide-rich moon of the planet Gorse, located in the Inner Rim of the galaxy. The moon was vital to the production of turbolasers in the Galactic Republic and, later, the Galactic Empire.
Moonglow-72, tagged Imperial Provisional 72 and Renegade One by the Galactic Empire, and the Expedient by the human Kanan Jarrus, was a mining transport ship owned by Moonglow Polychemical.

The term "krayt dragon" referred to a number of large, carnivorous reptilian species that hailed from Tatooine, a desert planet in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Krayt dragons, despite their fierceness, were hunted for the precious pearls found in their bodies.

Neimoidians were a humanoid species native to the planet of Neimoidia, while also settling wealthy colonies they named Purse Worlds, such as Cato Neimoidia. They had smooth noseless faces, mottled green-gray skin, and large red-gold eyes.

Troigs were a sentient species that was native to the planet Pollillus. They had two heads, each head having its own personality and temperament. Both heads shared the same awareness, therefore they were very alert and observant.

x: The Battle of Utapau, also known as the Assault on Utapau and liberation of Utapau, was the decisive final battle that took place on the Separatist occupied world of Utapau in 19 BBY.

The Phase II Dark Trooper was a type of experimental stormtrooper created by the Galactic Empire as part of the Dark Trooper project. The Phase II was a heavily-armored black and silver body suit worn by a human pilot and stood taller than 1.83 meters.
Cato Neimoidia was a planet in the Cato Neimoidia system, within the Quellor sector of the galaxy's Colonies. It was a purse world of the Neimoidians and capital of its own planetary government.
Fireflies were insects, capable of emitting a powerful glow.

E-3PO was a silver 3PO-series protocol droid with yellow photoreceptors who was present in Cloud City, a tibanna gas mining colony that floated in the Life Zone of the planet Bespin, shortly after the Battle of Hoth.
Oba Diah was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Pyke species.
Felucia, known as Galush prior to the formation of the Galactic Republic, was a colorful, humid jungle planet located in the Felucia system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
Frenks were a slender reptilian humanoid sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

Malastare was a forested planet located in the Malastare system of the Mid Rim, situated along the Hydian Way. Its core was home to large reserves of Malastarian fuel, a toxic fuel found only on Malastare.

Umbara, known as the "Shadow World" due to the lack of sunlight on its surface, was a planet located within the Expansion Region. The planet was also an exporter of doonium, a metal utilized in the construction of starships.

2-1B was a 2-1B surgical droid that was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Along with FX-7, 2-1B was stationed at Echo Base on Hoth and treated Luke Skywalker with bacta after he had been attacked by a wampa.

Iziz was the capital city of the Inner Rim planet Onderon. During the Clone Wars, the city was host to several battles that made up the Onderonian Civil War, in which the Onderon rebels, backed by the Galactic Republic, overthrew the forcibly-installed Separatist administration.
Pixelito was a city on the planet of Malastare. The Dug podracing champion Sebulba was from Pixelito.

Manaan was an ocean planet located in the galaxy's Inner Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Selkath, an aquatic sentient species that at one time was dedicated to the care of the world's oceans.

The Crucible was a Paladin-class corvette operated by the Jedi Order. The ship, which had been in service from the time of its construction during the Old Republic through to the Clone Wars, was used to ferry Jedi younglings from Coruscant to Ilum.
The Padawan Observer was the school newspaper at the Jedi academy on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's time of attendance there.

The Outer Rim Carve-up was a gladiatorial event which took place prior to or during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. The Feeorin gladiator Warjak participated in the fight and emerged undefeated, earning him the title of champion.

Tookas, also called tooka-cats or Adoris Felines, were a subspecies of feline cats. They were popular as pets as the carnivores ate many unwanted pests, but were also considered by many to be feral nuisances themselves.

The Amanin were a sentient yet primitive species from the planet of Maridun. They were tall, flat-bodied aliens with long, gangly arms, and wrinkly hides covered in slime. At the time of the Clone Wars, there were Amani living on Utapau.
The Sugis were a species that earned a reputation as being among the best arms dealers in the galaxy.
Pau City, also known as the sinkhole city, was one of the large sinkhole cities that pitted the arid surface of Utapau. It was the planet's capital and primary spaceport.

The Utai were a species of short, stubby humanoids with distended eyes that hailed from Utapau. They shared their homeworld with the Pau'ans as well as with immigrated species, including groups of Amani and Sugi.

Lothal re-settlement camp 43 was a refugee settlement on the Outer Rim planet Lothal, constructed during the Imperial Era to house farmers displaced by the Galactic Empire’s mining operations.
The Holocron Vault was an archive chamber within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, home of the Jedi Order's holocrons, storage devices which held a powerful library of knowledge.

R4-G0 was an astromech droid who maintained Jek-14's stealth starfighter during the Clone Wars during the time when Jek-14 was on the run from the Separatists and Galactic Republic. The starfighter had earlier been maintained by a different yellow plated R-series astromech droid.

The Forager was a custom-built thorilide collector designed by Count Denetrius Vidian. In 11 BBY, the Forager was deployed to Cynda, the moon of Gorse, to collect the thorilide contained within the moon. It was destroyed at the conclusion of the Gorse Conflict.

Dactillion, also known as dactyls or dactilloids, were large, winged, carnivorous reptavians native to the planet Utapau.

Eriadu was a terrestrial planet in the Eriadu system of the Seswenna sector in the Outer Rim, located on the Galactic Frontier. The planet featured terrain such as mountains and jungles, and had a black pall.

In refusal of answering to an identification code, Kalani was the chosen name of an ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid, who served as a general in the Separatist Droid Army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

AZI-345211896246498721347 was a medical droid who served the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He was known as AZI-3 by the ARC trooper CT-5555 "Fives," who felt that numbers were demeaning, and simply as AZ by the genetically-modified clone Omega.

Rodians were reptilian humanoids native to the planet Rodia. During the Clone Wars, Rodia was represented by Senator Onaconda Farr in the Galactic Republic's senate. He briefly sided with the Trade Federation during the war, under the promise of food and protection from pirates.

The Scipio was Rush Clovis's personal H-2 executive shuttle. He used it while on the planet Scipio, which was its namesake. Beneath the foremost viewports flanking the vessel were letterings in aurebesh which spelt its name.

The Siege of Lasan, also known as the Fall of Lasan, the cleansing of Lasan, or the Lasan genocide, was an Imperial invasion orchestrated by Alexsandr Kallus that saw the near-extinction of the Lasat species.
Transport 651, also known as Freighter 651, was an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser. In 5 BBY, it was used by ISB Agent Kallus as part of a trap for a group of rebels.

The Invisible Hand was a modified Providence-class Dreadnought that served in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems as the flagship of the navy and the command ship of Kaleesh Separatist General Grievous during the Clone Wars.

Aqualish were a species of sentient humanoids from the planet Ando, who were identifiable by round black eyes and fur. Some members of this race possessed four eyes, while others only one pair.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: The Coalition for Progress (CFP), also known as the Coalition of Progress or simply Progress, was a sub-bureau of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order. It was responsible for the cultural progress of the Galactic Empire and shaping its public image.

The Carrion Spike was a corvette and the personal starship of Moff Wilhuff Tarkin while he was stationed at Sentinel Base in the Outer Rim Territories. It was later captured in 14 BBY by the disaffected former Republic Intelligence agent Berch Teller and his rebel cell.

Cell 2187 was Princess Leia Organa's cell on the original Death Star. Found in Detention Block AA-23, sub-level five, an area reserved for political prisoners, Organa was held here after she was captured by Darth Vader and tortured by an IT-O Interrogation Unit.
Advanced Recon Commandos, also known as ARC troopers, were an elite variant of the clone troopers that served the Galactic Republic.

headquarters: Separatist Senate Building, Raxulon, Raxus Secundus
x: The Separatist Senate, also known as the Separatist Parliament, the Legislative Senate, the Confederate parliament or the Separatist Congress, was the civilian legislative body of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, representing thousands of its member worlds during the Cl…
AppSci SaberCats was a grav-ball team fielded by the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences. Center striker Zare Leonis, fullback Beck Ollet, and kicker Merei Spanjaf all played for the team.

Ithorians, commonly referred to as hammerheads or as leathernecks as an insult, were a sentient species from the planet Ithor. Ithorians had two mouths on the opposite sides of their necks, giving them a deep, rumbling voice. Most Ithorians were peaceful and revered nature.

Phindians were a humanoid reptilian sentient species native to the planet Phindar that featured green skin, yellow eyes, elongated skulls, and long arms that extended past their knees. They were cautious by nature and generally preferred to avoid trouble.
Gotals were a species of humanoid sentients native to the moon Antar 4. They were common throughout the galaxy and could be seen on many planets.

Trandoshans, also called T'doshok, were large, bipedal reptilian sentient humanoids from the planet Trandosha, and were renowned as great hunters. Trandoshans relished the thrill of a hunt, and were known to embark on a hunting related rite of passage.
The Battle of Felucia was the third major engagement for control over the planet Felucia during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

result: The Galactic Empire begins its occupation to Kashyyyk
x: The Battle of Kashyyyk, also known as the invasion of Kashyyyk, defense of Kashyyyk, or the Kashyyyk campaign, was a legendary battle that acted as one of the final engagements of the Clone Wars.

Weequays were a sentient species from the planet Sriluur common throughout the galaxy. Weequay possessed tough, leathery skin resistant to desert environments and blaster fire. Many Weequay were mercenaries, pirates, and bodyguards for the Hutt Clan.

Devaronians were a sentient species from the planet Devaron. They exhibited great sexual dimorphism, with the males typically being bald and sporting horns, and the mostly hornless females displaying a full head of hair.

The Carrion Plateau, known simply as the Carrion, was an area of wilderness on the planet Eriadu. It was owned by the Tarkin family and was used as a site for male Tarkins to prove themselves against the wilderness.
A battle took place on the planet Murkhana in 21 BBY during the Clone Wars, nine months after the First Battle of Geonosis.

Harches were an imposing humanoid, spider-like sentient species native to the planet Secundus Ando, in the Mid Rim. They had six arms and six red eyes, and a pair of chelicerae near their mouths. The Harch were also a long-lived species.

Scout troopers, also known as biker scouts, were a specialized stormtrooper variant used by the Galactic Empire and later the Imperial Remnant on a range of missions, which mostly involved reconnaissance. In particular, scout troopers often used the 74-Z speeder bike.

Dewback troopers, also known as Dewback Riders, were sandtroopers who utilized dewbacks as mounts. They used jolts of electricity to control the beast, forcing them to batter down the property of those opposed to the Galactic Empire.
Tibidees were a type of giant silicon-based creature native to Stygeon Prime, though they could also be found on other mountainous Outer Rim planets, such as Oosalon.

x: After their mission to Stygeon Prime, the rebel crew of the Ghost undertook a mission to locate and destroy a powerful kyber crystal held by the Galactic Empire.

The Battle of Cato Neimoidia, also known as the capture of Cato Neimoidia, was one of the final battles of the Clone Wars, in which Jedi General Plo Koon led the Grand Army of the Republic's 442nd Siege Battalion against the Confederacy of Independent Systems for control of th…
The Siege of Saleucami was one of the longest campaigns of the Outer Rim Sieges during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems on the planet Saleucami.
Serenno was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' D'Astan sector, covered in lush forests, mountains and plains. Serenno was named after its ruling family, House Serenno.
Ruurians were a species of multi-limbed sentients with feathered antennae from the planet Ruuria. Slyyth, a Ruurian criminal, lived on Lothal around 3272 LY.

The Quarren, also known by the derogatory nickname "Squid Heads," were a humanoid, squid-like sentient species native to the planet Mon Cala, where they coexisted with the Mon Calamari in a peaceful, albeit tense, relationship.

An invasion of undead stormtroopers occurred on Dandoran at some point following the Battle of Yavin. It occurred following an outbreak at a secret Imperial research facility, where a bioweapon nicknamed the Sickness had been created.

Undead Troopers were stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire who had been infected by the viral agent known as the Sickness and between the Battle of Yavin and the Battle of Hoth an outbreak of the virus occurred.

An AAT Drivrer Battle Droid served the Sith apprentice Asajj Ventress during the Clone Wars. The battle droid was under the command of 224 in the battle on Rugosa. They were destroyed alongside the rest of the droid forces deployed to the area by Jedi Grand Master Yoda.

EV-9D9 (Eve-Ninedenine), also known simply as 9D9, Eve, or by the nicknames Queen of Durasteel and Mistress of Mayhem, was a feminine MerenData EV-series supervisor droid who, originally a peaceful, hardworking moisture vaporator mechanic, had a programming defect that made he…

Kothal was a settlement located on the planet Lothal. The settlement had a number of sellers and vendors, including Morad Sumar. Garazeb Orrelios and Ezra Bridger stole a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter from the Galactic Empire in Kothal.

x: The raid on Kessel, also known as the Kessel Slave Revolt or the Kessel heist, was an operation undertaken in 10 BBY by the criminal Tobias Beckett and his outlaw crew when they traveled to the spice mines of Kessel in an attempt to retrieve raw coaxium for the crime lord Dryd…
Corulag was a Core Worlds planet that was influential in the Galactic Republic helping the world Eriadu out of its debts and putting it onto the galactic-map.
Ganthel was a planet located in the Ganthel system in the Bormea sector of the Core Worlds, along the Rimma Trade Route. A species of beetles known as night-beetles inhabited Ganthel's outback.

conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
result: The rebels successfully free Morad Sumar, his wife, and an Aqualish pr
x: In the fifth year before the Battle of Yavin, two rebels who operated on the Outer Rim planet of Lothal, Ezra Bridger and Garazeb Orrelios, attacked three Imperial Troop Transports. Prior to the attack, the two were sent on a supply run by fellow rebel Hera Syndulla.

The Imperial Ruling Council, also referred to as the Imperial Advisory Council or the Imperial Council, was a collective body of bureaucrats composed of Emperor Sheev Palpatine's closest advisors including, Grand Vizier Mas Amedda, Sate Pestage, Janus Greejatus, Ars Dangor, Kr…

Veermoks were a wild species of clawed and sharp-toothed primates native to the planet Naboo. A distinct subspecies lived on planet Eriadu, in the Outer Rim Territories. They could also be found on the planet Xirl.

Nunas, also known as swamp turkeys, were small bipeds native to the swamps of the planet Naboo that spread to many other planets across the galaxy and could also be found on planets such as Tatooine, Coruscant and Saleucami. Their meat was used to make several dishes.
The Umbarans, also known as the Shadow People, were a near-human species native to the planet of Umbara. They were characterized by their pale, bluish skin and colorless eyes.

Wor Tandell was a location in the galaxy that traded with the Galactic Empire. During the Gorse Conflict, while attempting to persuade Hera Syndulla to leave Gorse with him, Kanan Jarrus offered to take her there, saying it was nice.
Galpos II was a planet home to a nest of Thalassian slavers that was located in the Galpos system in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square S-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Mendavi was a terrestrial astronomical object where the 291st Legion established a vanguard for urban combat, utilizing AT-DPs. It was located in the Mendavi system in the Ferra sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Acklays were amphibious reptilian crustaceans with six deadly claws and razor-sharp teeth native to the planet Vendaxa.

Rebel troopers, also known as Rebel soldiers or Alliance troopers, were the front-line soldiers of both the early rebel movement and, later, the Rebel Alliance against the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Chrona was a planet in the Chrona system of the Inner Rim Territories which was subjected to the suppression of harvesting enhanced crops by the Trade Federation. The crops were genetically engineered by the Leonis family, designed to improve the health of the native population.

Bardottans were a sentient species of scaled reptiles native to the planet Bardotta, and were a proud and independent people who were reputed for their mysticism and attention to spiritual matters as well as for art and music throughout the galaxy.

t: Commission for the Protection of the Republic
x: The Commission for the Protection of the Republic (COMPOR) was a populist movement and lobbyist group that existed during the late era of the Galactic Republic.
The Ubiqtorate was one of several organizations established by the Galactic Empire following the transition from the Galactic Republic.

result: Execution of Pong Krell for treason against the Republic
x: The Battle of Umbara, also known as the Umbaran Campaign, was a battle that took place during the Clone Wars on the planet Umbara.

The Duros were a humanoid species common in the galaxy native to the planet Duro. Notable Duros included bounty hunter Cad Bane who operated during the Clone Wars and Shriv Suurgav, a Duros who was a member of the New Republic Inferno Squad, and later the Resistance Inferno Sq…

Nerfs were a species of furry, non-sentient animals raised for their milk, meat, and hide. They could be found on a variety of planets across the galaxy, from Alderaan to Lothal. Despite their usefulness, nerfs were often regarded as disgusting because of their strong body odor.
Brezaks, also known as Zygerrian gliding lizards, were giant reptavian lizards that were able to glide via their skin flaps.

Kowakian monkey-lizards, also known as Kowakians, were a race of semi-sentient reptilian creatures often used by members of the underworld as pets. Owners of Kowakians included Jabba Desilijic Tiure, Hondo Ohnaka, and Emil Graf.

The Barchetta River was on the planet Lothal, located about 45-minutes west of Capital City. Westhills was located just beyond the river. The Galactic Empire built larger bridges across the river to accommodate their increases in harvesting and production.

Clone ordnance specialists, also known as Bomb Squad Clone Troopers, were specialized clone troopers who specialized in disarming ordnance, especially the defusing of bombs, which was one of the most dangerous jobs in the Republic military.

The Karkarodon, a shark-like, amphibious-aquatic humanoid species that was native to the ocean world of Karkaris, were known to be fast swimmers and fierce hunters, capable of ripping-apart their enemies or their prey with their teeth.

Kage Warriors were members of the Kage species that battled against the Belugans in the seemingly-never ending war on Quarzite. They once fought against Boba Fett, Asajj Ventress, and a crew of bounty hunters to save Pluma Sodi.
Moorja was a planet located in the Inner Rim Territories. Moorja was once home to Zare Leonis and his family.

Pa'lowicks were a sentient species of long-limbed reptilian humanoids that had spotted skin, eyes that protruded from the tops of their heads, and trunk-like mouths. Sy Snootles, the lead singer of the Max Rebo Band, was a Pa'lowick.

In 14 BBY, Berch Teller's rebel cell launched an attack against the Galactic Empire's Sentinel Base. Using communications equipment supplied by Vice Admiral Dodd Rancit, the rebels sent a fake holotransmission claiming that Rampart Station was under attack.

Sentinel Base was a facility located on a moon in a remote system of the Outer Rim's Arkanis sector. Along with the other Sentinel bases, its purpose was to protect the construction of the Death Star battle station.

Dianoga were large omnivorous cephalopods that hailed from the planet Vodran in the Si'Klaata Cluster, located in Hutt Space region of the galaxy. Although primitive, they were actually sentient, and some dianoga were sensitive to the Force.

Dewbacks were thick-skinned reptiles native to the desert planet of Tatooine, where they were used as beasts of burden, as well as mounts for specialized sandtroopers known as Dewback troopers. The two main dewback breeds were pearled and witla.
Patrolians were a highly intelligent piscine amphibious sentient species that were native to the aquatic planet Patrolia.

The Droid Gotra was a droid group that supported droid rights. It was originally formed by a band of lethal repurposed battle droids with grievances against the Galactic Empire for having been abandoned after their service during the Clone Wars.

Fyrnocks were silicon-based creatures originally indigenous to the jungles of the planet Anaxes. Surviving the destruction of their homeworld, many fyrnocks inhabited the resulting Anaxes asteroid belt, including the asteroid PM-1203, which contained Fort Anaxes, a military ba…
Rion was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy, orbited by multiple moons. During the High Republic Era, the Skembo Ceeril served as the ambassador of Rion.

result: Lando Calrissian makes a big impression on Rebel leadership
x: The Battle of Taanab was a famous battle that took place in 4 ABY, between Lando Calrissian and a pirate fleet in orbit of the planet Taanab. It was won by a daring and successful maneuver pulled by Calrissian.

The Sovereign was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer belonging to the starfleet of the Galactic Empire, and served as Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin's flagship for a period of time before the Battle of Yavin.
Hydroid Medusas were massive jellyfish cyborgs combined with armor and other cybernetic enhancements developed by the Karkarodons on their homeworld Karkaris.
Gundarks were vicious carnivorous desert mammals from the planet Vanqor. Renowned for their power and ferocity, the large creatures had sixteen claws and keen hearing.

Ando was a water-covered planet in the Ando system of the Lambda sector in the galaxy's Mid Rim, located in grid square Q-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid, that was the homeworld of the amphibious Aqualish species.

Ansion was a planet located in the Ansion system, a star system located in the Churnis sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was the junction of the Namadii Corridor hyperspace route and another route that ran from Keitum to the Rago system.

Anteevy was an terrestrial astronomical object located in the Anteevy system in the Esuain sector, on the edge of the galaxy's Mid Rim. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Empire maintained a facility known as Ice Station Beta on Anteevy.
Atzerri was a Gotal colony world in the Atzerri system of the galaxy's Inner Rim, located in grid square M-13 on the Standard Galactic Grid along the Shipwrights' Trace.

Bestine IV was a water-covered planet located in the Inner Rim Territories' Bestine system. One of the key members of the Galactic Republic by the time of the High Republic Era, it served primarily as an agricultural world, hosting starship manufacturing facilities as well.

Cartao was an Expansion Region astronomical object where the Galactic Empire kept a facility that became under threat from a potential dissident attack in 14 BBY. It was also the site of fighting during the Galactic Civil War, involving the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry.
Centares was an astronomical object located in the Centares system in the Maldrood sector of the Mid Rim at the junction of the Perlemian Trade Route and the Triellus Trade Route.

Conduit worms were non-sentient, parasitic worms native to the planet Coruscant that fed on electricity. They absorbed components as they grew along the ecumenopolis' electrical conduits, turning them into organs.
Brentaal IV, or Brentaal Four, also referred to simply as Brentaal, was a terrestrial planet located in the the galaxy's Core Worlds, on both the Hydian Way and the Perlemian Trade Route.

Corsin was a terrestrial world located in the Corsin system in the Greater Plooriod sector of the Expansion Region. It was located along the Hydian Way, and was the western endpoint of the Vaathkree Trade Corridor.

Auntie Nags was a nanny droid with a feminine programming that belonged to the Leonis family. By 3272 LY, she had been in the family for so many generations that no one remembered when they had acquired her.

Aquaris was a oceanic planet located in the Aquaris system in the Sumitra sector of the Expansion Region. It and Thustra were the closest principal planets to the location of the stolen Imperial corvette Carrion Spike while it was at the location designated as LCC-4-4-7.
The Koorivar were a sentient species of near-humans distinguished by their reptilian skin and large cranial horn that spiraled upwards from the center of their skull.
Rebel pilots, also known as Alliance pilots, Rebel fighter pilots or Alliance Starfighter Pilots, were pilots who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic under its starfighter corps.
Falleen was a planet located in the Falleen system in the Doldur sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the repto-mammalian Falleen species.
Jomark was an astronomical object located in the Jomark system in the Jospro sector of the Outer Rim Territories which housed an Imperial outpost and which was located close to the Galidraan system.

Yag'Dhul was a planet located in the Yag'Dhul system in the Inner Rim that was the homeworld of the sentient Givin species. Its environment was so harsh that their organs were sealed away from the atmosphere and they could survive for a short while in vacuum.

Trogan was an astronomical object located in the Trogan system in the Jospro sector of the Outer Rim Territories, situated in grid square R-7 in the Slice along the Salin Corridor. It housed an Imperial outpost and was located close to the Galidraan system.

Taanab was a planet located in the Taanab system within the galaxy's Inner Rim on the Perlemian Trade Route. The world was home to several agricultural projects which created food used to feed billions of inhabitants of Mid Rim and Outer Rim worlds.

The Jedi Trials were a process that Padawans of the Jedi Order took in order to achieve the rank of Jedi Knight. Jedi typically completed their trials in their young adult years, with some Jedi passing their trials as early as their teenage years.
"Miss Theelin" was a live beauty pageant held during the winter season that was available for entry by female Theelin.

Tydirium was an Imperial Lambda-class T-4a shuttle. Stolen by Sullustan Nien Nunb from the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Shieldmaiden during a diversionary mission called Operation Yellow Moon leading up to the events of the Battle of Endor, it was used by the Alliance to Rest…

Edgehawks were an avian species native to the grasslands of Lothal. They were known to harass Loth-cat young. Ezra Bridger once rescued a group of young Loth-cats from a number of Edgehawks, an event he recorded in his journal.
Several weeks after the Battle of Yavin, Luke Skywalker attacked Imperial forces above the planet Llanic who were attacking an unidentified Kupohan starship.
Jhothal was the informal name of a small outpost and village located far from Capital City, on the planet of Lothal. It was named after local Ithorian cantina owner Old Jho.

The Yavin Convention was a conference held approximately a millennium prior to 19 BBY at which the Yavin Code was established, which stated that prisoners were required to be blindfolded prior to being executed. The Yavin Convention shared its name with the gas giant Yavin.

11-4D was a protocol droid in the service of Darth Plagueis in the years before the rise of the Galactic Empire. Some time before the Clone Wars, Plagueis was killed by his Sith apprentice Darth Sidious, who took 11-4D as his inheritance.
The Kozinarg Trade Guilds was the wealthiest trade guild in the Mid Rim during the Clone Wars. It was run by the family of Esano and his sister.
Iridonia was an arid Mid Rim planet in the Glythe sector's Iridonia system, home to the Zabrak species.
Anchorhead was a small town on Tatooine. It offered connections to other cities on the planet, such as Mos Eisley.

The Relentless was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer commanded by Admiral Kassius Konstantine. On the day of the Galactic Empire's fifteenth anniversary, it was requisitioned by the Grand Inquisitor, the Emperor's Jedi hunter, to give chase to a group of rebellious individual…

Ilum, also later referred to as Starkiller Base due to the First Order military installation of the same name located on the planet, was a snow-covered planet located in the 7G sector of the Unknown Regions, originally located within the Ilum system.
The Judicial Forces were the military-trained peacekeeping force of the Galactic Republic in the years before its fall.

The Antar Atrocity was the name given by the media to an operation undertaken by the Galactic Empire in which Imperial forces, led by Wilhuff Tarkin, carried out arrests, executions, and massacres on Antar 4, as punishment for Antar 4's allegiance to the Confederacy of Indepen…

The Sullust Sector Spacefarers Academy was a piloting academy located on the planet Sullust. Most graduates of the academy took positions as commercial pilots, joined navies in local star systems, or joined the Galactic Republic Judicial Department.
The Judicial Academy was the system of training academies for those joining the Judicial Forces, part of the Judicial Department of the Galactic Republic.

objective: Bring Jango Fett into Jedi custody
x: Near the end of the Separatist Crisis, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi travelled to the Wild Space planet Kamino on a mission to investigate who was involved and responsible for the plot to assassinate Senator Padmé Amidala of Naboo.

Eriadu Mining and Shipping, also known as Eriadu Mining, was a corporation based on Eriadu that specialized in mining and shipping operations. For some time, the company was forced to deal with pirates in their area of influence.
BB-8, sometimes spelled and pronounced Beebee-Ate and nicknamed BB, was a BB-series astromech droid who operated approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

result: Rey, Finn, and BB-8 escape from Jakku aboard the Millennium Falcon
x: The Escape from Jakku occurred during the Cold War when a scavenger named Rey and a defecting stormtrooper named Finn escaped from the forces of the First Order on the planet of Jakku.

4-LOM "FOR-ELLOEM" was an ambitious LOM-series protocol droid that specialized in millions of languages. He was manufactured for the employment of insectoid species. A logic glitch allowed him to overwrite his programming and become a galactic thief and later a bounty hunter.

Taris was a polluted urban planet located in the Outer Rim. Although Taris was a heavily populated ecumenopolis, much of the surface itself was polluted with wrecked starships and dense, overgrown swamps.
Neimoidia, also known as Pure Neimoidia, was a planet centrally located in the galaxy's Colonies region, and was situated along the Trellen Trade Route.
Colla IV was an Inner Rim Territories planet that was home to the sentient insectoid Colicoids, a violent warrior species.

Ishi Tib were a sentient species of amphibious humanoids from the planet Tibrin. They had skin that ranged from green to blue, large eyes that extended from angular stalks on either side of their skull, and a beak-like mouth.

The Sakiyans were a humanoid sentient species with bulbous, hairless heads and sharply tapered ears. Sakiyans hailed from the Hutt Space planet Saki, and as such were often enslaved by the Hutts. Thanks to their keen senses and quick reflexes, Sakiyans were skilled hunters.

Feeorins were a sentient species with thick tendrils hanging from the back of their heads. During the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign, a Feeorin named Warjak performed as a gladiator, holding the title of champion of the Outer Rim Carve-up.
Ranats were a species of sentients rodent-like humanoids. Ranats had long tails, sharp teeth including large incisors, elongated whiskers, and a keen sense of smell.
Gelagrubs, also known as Felucian ground beetles, were a species of insect that were found in the forests of the planet Felucia in the Outer Rim Territories.
Cerea was a planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim. It was a paradise largely unspoiled by the ravages of technology.
Gran were a sentient humanoid species native to the planet Kinyen, but had colonies on many worlds such as Malastare, Hok, and Varkana.

Jumptroopers, also known as Imperial Jump Troopers, Imperial jet troopers, rocket troopers or jetpack troopers were specialized stormtroopers utilized by the Galactic Empire prior to and during the Galactic Civil War.
Anacondans were a snakelike sentient species.
Docking Bay 94 was a Mos Eisley docking bay that was used by Han Solo during at least one of his visits to Tatooine.
Mygeeto was a frigid, crystalline planet located in the Albarrio sector's Mygeeto system of the Outer Rim Territories, and was the homeworld of the Lurmen species.
Ossus was a terrestrial planet located in the Adega system of the Outer Rim Territories' Auril sector that was affiliated with the Jedi Order. The planet was orbited by at least one forest moon.
The Talz were a sentient species native to the planets Alzoc III and Orto Plutonia, on which they remained undiscovered until the Clone Wars.

Huyang was a Mark IV architect droid professor based aboard the Jedi vessel Crucible, who, for a thousand generations, taught Jedi younglings, including Grand Master Yoda and Jedi Master Mace Windu, how to construct their lightsabers following the Gathering.

Lutrillians were a sentient species of humanoids that were native to the planet Lutrillia. They were distinguished by their broad faces, fuzzy jowls, and wide-set eyes. Lutrillians lived a nomadic lifestyle and traveled around their homeworld.

The Malevolence was a Subjugator-class heavy cruiser that served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, and was used as the flagship of Kaleesh Separatist General Grievous during the Clone Wars.
The New Mandalorians was a Mandalorian pacifist movement that controlled the Mandalore system in the Outer Rim from 40 BBY to 19 BBY.

In the years before the Battle of Yavin, Ahsoka Tano, also known as "Fulcrum," had a corvette that was used in discreet meetings. This CR90 corvette was primarily white, but had some blue markings on it.
Rebel Vanguards were elite soldiers of the Rebel Alliance who carried E-60R missile launchers and wore uniforms derived from those of Alderaanian consular security.
Cymoon 1 was a moon located in the Corellian Industrial Cluster. It housed Weapons Factory Alpha, the largest Imperial weapons factory in the galaxy.

Otoh Gunga, also known as simply Gungan City or Gunga City, was a Gungan city located beneath the surface of Lake Paonga on the planet of Naboo. It was originally built by the Gungans in order to avoid contact with their surface-dwelling Naboo neighbors.

t: Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar
x: The bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar occurred late in the Clone Wars. Jedi Knight Barriss Offee—having become disgruntled with the fact that the Jedi Order, traditionally guardians of peace, were leading the Galactic Republic's war against the Confederacy of Independent Syste…
The Theelin were a rare sentient species recognizable by their brightly colored hair and spotted skin.
Vendaxa was a fertile planet located in the Expansion Region of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the acklay, a non-sentient species of crustaceans that inhabited the planet's lush plains.

The Bith were a peaceful and intelligent sentient species that were native to the planet Bith. They had hairless, domed heads and black, glassy eyes that lacked eyelids and could not shed tears. Bith often found work as musicians, scientists, and engineers.

Iego was a mysterious planet located in the Outer Rim Territories on the fringes of the known galaxy that was surrounded by a thousand moons collectively known as the moons of Iego, at least one of which was populated by a race of beings known as Angels.

Antar 4, also known simply as Antar and the Gotal moon, was a moon that orbited Antar, a planet located in the galaxy's Inner Rim, that was the homeworld of the sentient Gotal species. It was taken over by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Loth-wolves were sentient canine predators native to the planet Lothal. Loth-wolves had a special connection to the Force and Lothal, where they acted as the guardians of the light side on the world.
Chalactans were humans native to the planet Chalacta. Two prominent Chalactans were Jedi Master Depa Billaba and her sister Sar Labooda.
The Nikto or Niktos were a humanoid sentient species native to the planet Kintan in the Outer Rim Territories.

Klatooinians were a species native to the planet Klatooine, who often worked as henchmen and bounty hunters. Klatooinians possessed a strong physique that led many of them to work in the criminal underworld.

TX-20 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars as a commander. He was assigned to the command of Wat Tambor, foreman of the Techno Union and Emir of Ryloth.
TA-175 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Battle of Ryloth.
K0-5D. nicknamed Maximo, was an ASP-series labor droid that was heavily modified to participate in droid gladiator fights.

TV-94 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid who served within the Confederacy of Independent Systems' naval branch, under the command of Kaleesh General Grievous, during the Clone Wars.
TX-21 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid that served Poggle the Lesser during the Clone Wars. He was destroyed by Ahsoka Tano during the Second Battle of Geonosis.

C-21 Highsinger was a heavily modified droid bounty hunter of unknown manufacturer believed to be unique that operated autonomously during the Clone Wars. He was part of Krayt's Claw, a syndicate of bounty hunters that included Boba Fett, Latts Razzi, Dengar, Bossk, and Oked.
Coruscant police sector 417 was a sector of the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
Rontos were four-legged saurian herbivores native to the desert world of Tatooine. Skittish yet gentle and strong, they were the favored pack animals and mounts of the indigenous Jawas.

Opee sea killers were creatures found in the oceans of the planets Naboo and Strokill Prime. They contained evolutionary traits from multiple other animals, and had strong armor, jaws with double rows of teeth and long prehensile tongues which they used to quickly devour small…
Blixus were rare, half-shelled semi-aquatic creatures native to Sljee.
ST-45 was a Star Commuter 2000 transport shuttle that ferried passengers between the neighboring Outer Rim planets of Lothal and Garel. The shuttle was piloted by RX-24, a RX-Series pilot droid.

The Army of the Dead was a force of Nightsister Zombies on Dathomir who answered the call of the Nightsisters to fight against the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Separatist invasion of the planet, the Nightsisters' homeworld.

Clone trooper pilots, also known as clone pilots, were clone troopers that, due to having exceptional reflexes and vision, as well as good spatial awareness, were spotted early and brought into specialized training, with those who made the grade "earning their wings" as pilots.
Bantha Riders were rebel troopers who rode trained Banthas to strike down enemy defenses, similar to the Imperial Dewback troopers.
OOM-9 was an OOM command battle droid who served as the commanding officer of the Trade Federation's droid army during their invasion of the planet Naboo in 32 BBY.
Concord Dawn was a planet located in the Concord Dawn system, within the Mandalore sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Muuns were a thin, tall humanoid species with elongated heads who ran the InterGalactic Banking Clan throughout the waning days of the Galactic Republic and into the New Republic Era. Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Plagueis was a Muun.
Gorse City was a city located on the planet Gorse. It was known for its export of thorilide.

x: Kalee was a planet within the Kalee system, a star system in Wild Space that was the homeworld of the Kaleesh species. Grievous, a male Kaleesh warlord, was from this world.

Thisspiasians were a serpentine species, distinguished by their long snake bodies and thick beards, that were native to the planet Thisspias. Thisspiasians had four arms, but a pair of them were often hidden beneath their clothing.

Tholothians were a species of sentient near-humans native to the planet Tholoth. They could be distinguished from typical humans by their partial colorful skin pigmentation, their scaled craniums and fleshy white, blue, or red tendrils that sprouted from their skullcaps.
Iktotchi were a horned sentient species from the moon Iktotch. Jedi Master Saesee Tiin, a member of the Jedi High Council prior to and during the Clone Wars, was an Iktotchi.

The Siniteen were a humanoid sentient species that were native to Mileva. They were distinguished by their brain-shaped heads and hyperintelligence. They were capable of calculating hyperspace coordinates without the aid of a computer navigator.
Arcona were a sentient species of desert-dwelling humanoids that was native to the planet Cona that possessed a triangular shaped head.

x: The Naboo Royal Starship, a modified J-type 327 Nubian starship, was the royal starship of Queen Padmé Amidala during the Invasion of Naboo.

x: Lannik was a planet with a long history of war that was located in the galaxy's Mid Rim and was the homeworld of the Lannik species.

Kamino Space Control was the space control grid for the planet Kamino, which monitored space for incoming spacecraft. A high-performance communication tower was located at the top of Tipoca City, Kamino's capital city which warned Kamino Space Control for incoming starships.

Snivvians, nicknamed Snaggletooths, were a species of sentient mammalian humanoids native to the planet Cadomai Prime. They had large mouths and short fangs. The winters on their home planet were long, harsh, and difficult to survive.
Sy Myrthians were a sentient species from Sy Myrth who moved on one large "foot" (similar to the Hutts). They were covered in short fur and had elongated heads.

The Imperial Information Office (IIO) was an Imperial government office that was part of Imperial Intelligence. The Rodian Tseebo was an employee of the Information Office before escaping with the help of the Spectres rebel cell.

Tangletown was a small, once-thriving farming community on the Outer Rim planet Lothal. It proudly referred to itself as the "Food Basket of Lothal" due to its production of fruits, spices, vegetables, and other flavors.
Kyuzo were a sentient humanoid species native to the gravity-heavy Outer Rim world of Phatrong, where they evolved dense muscle fibers and fast reflexes.

The Kage were a near-human sentient species native to the planet Quarzite. Although they resembled humans, their striking eyes and pale skin set them apart. Their eyes were evolved to see in gloomy caverns lit by luminescent crystals.

Storm commandos, also known as shadow scout troopers, were a variant of shadow trooper that were part of the Galactic Empire's special forces. Some storm commandos were members of the elite 501st Legion, the Sith Lord Darth Vader's personal stormtrooper legion.
The Avenger was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy's Death Squadron, under the command of Captain Lorth Needa.

Varactyls were a species of majestic, giant reptavian herbivores native to the world of Utapau.

Home One, also known as Headquarters Frigate, was a modified MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser of the Alliance Fleet, famous for its role as Admiral Gial Ackbar's flagship during the decisive battle fought at Endor.

Ruuria was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories along the Hydian Way that was the homeworld of the Ruurian species. It was noted for having pink rivers, along the banks of which chroma-wings would eat, fly, and mate.

Ithor was a planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species, who spoke Ithorese. The expansive jungles of Ithor were considered to be sacred, and hunting there was highly illegal.

x: An IG-RM bodyguard and enforcer droid with masculine programming worked for the criminal Broken Horn Syndicate on the planet Lothal during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign.

EV-A4-D, also known simply as A4-D, was an EV-series medical droid and mechanic owned by General Grievous. He repaired the Kaleesh cyborg following battles with the Republic, and resided in his master's lair on the third moon of Vassek.
Scipio was an ice-covered planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was positioned in the Scipio system, and served as the headquarters of the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

Champala was a world in the Champala system in the Inner Rim. Located on the Hydian Way, it was home to the Chagrian species, including Mas Amedda, Vice Chancellor of the Galactic Republic and later Grand Vizier of the Galactic Empire.
The Crumb Bomber was a Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry gunship used by the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Imperial pavilion was an area of Capital City on the planet Lothal named for the Galactic Empire during the early years of their reign.
Saleucami, a name that translated into "oasis," was a planet located in the Saleucami system, within the Suolriep sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
The Canyon Dune Turn was a large turn that was a part of the Boonta Eve Classic podrace course located on the planet Tatooine.

The Toong were a sentient species of bipeds with a unique appearance that were native to the planet Tund. They possessed long legs and arms, several skin colors, and a large head located where the torso would normally be in humanoids.
The United Party was a pro-Imperial political party on the planet Sluis Van during the time of the New Republic. It was led by Slui-Koronar in 6 ABY.

Eopies were quadruped mammalian herbivores native to the planet Tatooine. These tough creatures were adapted to their homeworld's endless deserts, and as a result were domesticated by the planet's inhabitants.
Reeks were large, muscular quadrupeds native to the planet Ylesia that could also be found on Saleucami and the Codian Moon.

Padmé Amidala's funeral was held on her homeworld of Naboo after her death on the asteroid Polis Massa. Padmé Amidala, who died after giving birth to twins Luke and Leia, was mourned by thousands of Naboo citizens during her funeral in the capital city of Theed.

Dalgos were a creature native to the dense jungles of the planet Onderon. Unlike their smaller herbivore cousins, they were carnivorous predators. Despite this, they could still be domesticated, filling many of the same roles.

The Soulless One was a customized Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies Belbullab-22 starfighter which served as the personal ship of General Grievous, the leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Droid Army.

Quarzite was a small planet located in the Quarzite system of the Inner Rim whose high atmospheric pressure rendered its surface uninhabitable. However, the planet's crystalline caverns were capable of supporting life and were home to the warring Belugans and Kage.

The Sentinel moon was an inhospitable moon in an unnamed system in the Outer Rim Territories that served as a staging point for the construction of the Galactic Empire's Death Star superweapon with Sentinel Base situated there.

place: Republic Center for Military Operations, Coruscant
x: Former Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano was put on trial shortly before the end of the Clone Wars, after Tano was charged with sedition against the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic for her alleged role in the bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar.
Puffer pigs were a non-sentient, herbivorous, mammalian pig species native to the planet Kyryll's World. Puffer pigs were known to inflate their bodies to a large degree when they felt threatened.

The Roonan were a sentient species that were native to Roona. The Roonan had blue or gray skin and they had a ridged forehead and cranium with large, almond-shaped blue eyes. Short in stature, they had big ideas and were notoriously easy to offend.

Mynocks (IPA: /ˈmaɪ.nɒk/, Merriam–Webster: \mīnäk\) were a bat-like parasitic species that hailed from the world of Ord Mynock. A group of mynocks is called a battery. Even so, they also thrived in asteroids and could survive in realspace, with some even living within exogorths.

Boz Pity was a planet located in the Boz Pity system of the galaxy's Mid Rim. During the High Republic Era, it was considered a key member of the Galactic Republic, and received a sky-island with a representation of its environment at the Valo Republic Fair.

Wasskah, also known as the forest moon of Trandosha, was a moon that orbited the planet Trandosha within the Kashyyyk system of the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim. Located in grid coordinates P-9, the moon had islands covered in dense forest.
R2-KT was a compassionate, pink-plated R2-series astromech droid with feminine programming who witnessed the rise and fall of numerous galactic powers.

The Corellian Industrial Cluster was an area in the the galaxy's Expansion Region that contained the moon Cymoon 1. The Cluster was controlled by the Galactic Empire.

A species of sentient beings with pink flesh and yellow eyes inhabited the junkyards of the moon Cymoon 1 in the Corellian Industrial Cluster. Members of the species had tentacles protruding from all parts of their body, some of which they used as limbs.
224 was an OOM command battle droid who served in the Separatist Droid Army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Grizmallt was a war-torn planet in the Grizmallt system of the Core Worlds, and the origin of the humans who crash-landed on and colonized Naboo. Around 3900 BBY, a civil war on Grizmallt caused a group Grizmallti to flee their home in colony ships and settle on Naboo.
Rugosa, also known as the Coral Moon of Rugosa, was a temperate moon located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories close to the planet Toydaria.

Russo-ISC was an SP-4 ISC crime scene analysis droid who served the Jedi Order, working at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Level 1315 was an underworld level on the planet Coruscant. It was so named because it was located one thousand, three hundred, and fifteen levels from the core of the ecumenopolis, which was accessed by the underworld portal.

Island Four was the name of an island hunting ground located on the moon Wasskah that was used by members of a hunting guild headed by the Trandoshan Garnac.
Toydaria was the homeworld of the Toydarian species, located in Hutt Space.
The Tenloss Syndicate was a criminal group that co-owned a shipyard in the Bajic sector with several lower-level members of the criminal group known as the Crymorah Syndicate.
The Fremond was a spacetug used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. The starship shared its name with the Fremond system, located in the Inner Rim Territories.
The Salliche was a frigate in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. The vessel shared its name with the agriworld Salliche, which was located in the Core Worlds.
The Core Envoy was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. The Star Destroyer was equipped with engines and measured 1,600 meters long.

The Compliant was a Star Destroyer used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. In 14 BBY, the ship was stationed at the planet Pii's Imperial marshaling station, along with another Star Destroyer, the Enforcer.
The Gatherers were a group of non-Jedi Force worshipers whose aim was to spread the teachings of the light side of the Force and the Jedi Order during the reign of the First Order.

An outpost belonging to the Galactic Empire was located on the planet Trogan. Five years after the Empire's creation, the personal starship of Imperial Governor Wilhuff Tarkin was stolen by a rebel cell and used to attack Galidraan Station.

A rumor concerning the pirate Q'anah stated she once became stranded on an isolated moon in the final decades of the Galactic Republic's reign. While on this moon, prior to her rescue, Q'anah was forced to chew her hand off because it had become infected.

An RA-7 protocol droid served the Galactic Empire during the early years of the organization's reign. The droid was stationed on the facility known as Sentinel Base, where on one occasion it acted as the tailor of Governor Wilhuff Tarkin.

The Nautolans were a humanoid species from the planet Glee Anselm. They were amphibious, and adapted to survive in harsh environments. Nautolan society was largely peaceful, but they were at odds with the Anselmi, a related species also native to their home planet.
Christophsis was a planet located in the Christoph system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories where the Battle of Christophsis was fought during the Clone Wars.

Berch Teller's rebel cell was formed and led by the former Republic Intelligence agent Berch Teller after the Antar Atrocity. Members of this cell came from several species including humans, Koorivar, and Gotals.

The Dune Sea, known as the Great Dune, was a vast stretch of desert on the Outer Rim planet of Tatooine. The Great Pit of Carkoon, which contained a creature known as the sarlacc, was located in the Dune Sea. The Western Dune Sea was where the Mos Espa Grand Arena was located.

Merchant One was a C-ROC Gozanti-class light cruiser owned by the crime lord Azmorigan. The ship carried a number of armaments, including laser turrets and laser cannons used in criminal operations. The vessel also held a number of escape pods.
ST 321 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle which served as the personal transport of Darth Vader, a Dark Lord of the Sith, during the latter stages of the Galactic Civil War.

Gamorreans, derogatorily known as "pigs," were a sentient species of green-skinned pig-like humanoids that hailed from the Outer Rim planet of Gamorr. They grouped themselves in clans, each of which was led by a warlord and a Clan Matron.
The dragonsnake (also spelled dragon snake) was a large, predatory reptile that dwelled in the muddy waters of certain planets, including Dagobah and Nal Hutta.

Kaadu were creatures native and indigenous to the planet Naboo. During a fight on the Great Grass Plains, kaadu were deployed with fambaas to support the Gungan Grand Army to fight off the Trade Federation battle droids.
Fambaas were quadruped amphibians with tough hides that could be found on the planets Naboo and Onderon.

Great Grass Plains was a large area of plains located 40 kilometers from Theed on the planet Naboo. During the Battle of Naboo, the Gungan Grand Army fought against the Trade Federation battle droids on the Great Grass Plains.
The Alderaan Guard, also known as the Alderaanian royal guards, were a security force responsible for the protection of members of the House of Organa, the royal family of the planet Alderaan.

Monument Plaza, also known as Monument Park, was a large plaza on the populous ecumenopolis world of Coruscant. It was also the location of the planet's only uncovered mountain peak, Umate, the highest point of the Manarai range.
G8-R3, also known as R5-A7, was an astromech droid which served onboard the Naboo Royal Starship used by the royalty of the planet Naboo.
Er'Kit was a desert planet located in the Noonian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Er'Kit species.

Teth was a jungle planet located in Wild Space of the galaxy. At some point, the world was inhabited by the B'omarr Order. However, by the time of the Clone Wars, their castles were abandoned, though some would be converted by the Hutts into formidable strongholds.

Peace Park was a stylized rooftop garden terrace located in Sundari, the capital city of the planet Mandalore.

Sando aqua monsters were enormous, muscular predators that could be found in the oceans and lakes of Naboo. They could grow up to 200 meters, but because there were few of them left on Naboo by 32 BBY, they obtained an almost legendary status.

Rattatak was a mountainous planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. After killing the warlords responsible for the death of Jedi Knight Ky Narec, former Jedi Padawan Asajj Ventress ruled Rattatak until she was found and recruited by former Jedi Master Count Dooku,…
The Pantorans were blue-skinned near-humans native to the moon Pantora. They were part of the Galactic Republic, during the waning years of that government.

Mimban, also known as Circarpous V, was a swamp planet located in the Circarpous sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region. Situated along the Nanth'ri Trade Route, it was the homeworld of several intelligent species, including the Mimbanese.
During the Galactic Civil War, a group of outlaws working for Jabba the Hutt attacked a homestead on the planet Tatooine, belonging to the mercenary Saponza.

Orto Plutonia, also known as Orto, was a frigid planet located in the Pantora system of the Outer Rim Territories' Sujimis sector. It was orbited by the moon Pantora, which was long believed to be the only inhabited world in the system.

The Strix was a starship owned by the mercenary Saponza. The vessel was used in various battles by Saponza's gang during the Galactic Civil War. It was armed with a laser cannon, but the weapon could only provide one strafe's worth of fire before needing to recharge.

A group of mercenaries attempted to carry out a sneak attack on the homestead occupied by the mercenary Saponza and his partner's gang. The gang were informed by their allies of the attack before it commenced, and so were able to defeat the attackers.

Narglatches were a species of carnivorous mammalian cats native to the frigid world of Orto Plutonia and Naboo. These felines were considered sacred by Orto Plutonia's indigenous Talz, who used them as mounts and a source of food.
Trandosha, also known simply as Dosh, was an arboreal planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim and the homeworld of the Trandoshan species.

Arkanis was a rainy planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, and the throneworld of Leeya, the Empress of the Regency Worlds. The Galactic Empire's officers academy was located there.

The Supreme Court was the highest court of law in the Judicial Department of the Galactic Republic. The Supreme Court tried Nute Gunray, the Viceroy of the Trade Federation, on four separate occasions for his actions in launching the Invasion of Naboo, but Gunray avoided impri…
