x: In the fourth year before the Battle of Yavin the activities of a rebel cell operating on the Outer Rim planet Lothal drew the attention of Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, a high-ranking officer in the Galactic Empire by launching a raid on the communications tower.
Orrays were big creatures native to the planet Geonosis. They were used by the Geonosian picadors as mounts and beasts of burden.
Septoids were segmented, venomous, carnivorous creatures native to the Carrion Plateau on Eriadu.
Murkhana was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Known for its natural beauty, it was a major tourist attraction in the last years of the Republic Era.

Mustafarians were an insectoid sentient species native to the volcanic Outer Rim mining world of Mustafar of which there existed two distinct subspecies: the tall, thin Northern Mustafarians, and the short, stocky Southern Mustafarians.

264 was a readapted R4 astromech droid working for the Imperial Press Corps of the Galactic Empire as a communications courier. The droid was taken prisoner by the crew of the Ghost so their own droid, Chopper, could pose as a courier.

This unidentified planet that rained acid as well as glass was the fourth planet of a remote system near an unidentified planet which hosted the spaceport of Lasgo Port. This glass rain planet was home to a species of giant beetles which ate glass.
The Jundland Wastes were a region of Tatooine, a desert planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. The Great Chott salt flat existed in the southeastern extreme of the Jundland Wastes.

Tibrin was an aquatic planet covered in phosphorescent seas with towering coral reefs as tall as the sky. It was located in the Tibrin system, a trinary star system on the edge of the Hadar sector in the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Ishi Tib species.
Kel Dors were a sentient species native to the planet Dorin. In order to survive oxygen-rich environments, they wore specialized breath masks that covered their eyes and nostrils.
Nam Chorios was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that housed both an Imperial mining colony and prison facility by the fifth year of Darth Sidious' reign as Emperor.

Obroa-skai was a planet located in the Obroa-skai system of the galaxy's Inner Rim. The Vaathkree Trade Corridor connected it to Contruum and Ubduria. It was known mostly for its libraries and medcenters.
Dorin was a planet located in the Dorin system in the Deadalis sector of the Expansion Region that was the homeworld of the Kel Dor species.
The Admiralty was the leading department of the Galactic Empire that administered the Imperial Navy, giving counsel and governing policy of the Imperial Navy.

The Four Sages of Dwartii – Sistros Nevet, Braata Danlos, Faya Rodemos, and Yanjon Zelmar – were a group of contentious philosophers and lawgivers from the early days of the modern Galactic Republic, who had great influence on its early constitution.

The Kiffar were a near-human species from the planets Kiffu and Kiffex. Although they seemed human in appearance, Kiffar were distinguished by their scarlet blood and facial tattoos, which indicated their clan affiliation on their species' homeworlds.

Gossams were a diminutive blue-skinned species native to the planet Castell located in the Colonies region of the galaxy. Several Gossams, such as Shu Mai and Amita Fonti, allied themselves with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

The audience chamber of the Imperial Palace was located on the penultimate level of the Palace spire. A vast, circular room without partitions, it featured a ten-meter-tall podium upon which Emperor Palpatine sat in a simple chair.
The residence of Galactic Emperor Palpatine was located at the Pinnacle Room of the Imperial Palace's central spire. It was divided into two separate spaces by a curved partition.

Eskrats were a species of rat that ran around a lot. The demolitions expert Skelly compared the pilot Kanan Jarrus and the miners of the Moonglow Polychemical company to eskrats after Jarrus showed no interest in hearing about a potential mining hazard.

Sand monkeys were a species of animal which were good at climbing. When the Twi'lek pilot Hera Syndulla scrambled up a set of scaffolding on the planet Gorse, it was in a fashion similar to a sand monkey.

The Mandalorian Guard, also known as the Mandalorian police was the security force of the New Mandalorian led Mandalorian Government Council on the planet Mandalore. They served as peacekeepers.

x: The Battle of Lola Sayu, also called the mission to the Citadel, was a battle fought during the Clone Wars between the Grand Army of the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems in and around the Citadel, a Separatist prison on Lola Sayu.
Abafar was a remote desert planet located within the Outer Rim Territories, and was host to massive amounts of rhydonium, a scarce and volatile fuel source.

Pasher was a desert planet located in the Pasher system in the Inner Rim region of the galaxy, in square M-14. Although similar to the planet Tatooine in terms of terrain, Pasher lacked the intersecting hyperspace routes that made the other world a popular smugglers' den.
Sandstone scorpions were a species native to the desert planet Pasher. The scorpions possessed poison glands and had armor which was highly effective at deflecting heat.
Spine spiders were a species of spider native to the desert planet Pasher. The spiders possessed poison glands which had medical applications.
The Promise was a frigate in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Fleet. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the frigate was in hiding in the Sujimis sector near the planet Orto Plutonia.

Project Harvester was the codename for an Inquisitorius operation by the Galactic Empire to capture young Force-sensitives and turn them into Imperial agents skilled in the ways of the dark side of the Force, all while trying to prevent the Jedi Order from recovering.

The rebels TIE fighter, nicknamed "Sabine's masterpiece," and also known as Sabine Wren's TIE Fighter was an Imperial TIE/ln space superiority starfighter, piloted by Baron of the Empire Valen Rudor, that was stolen by Ezra Bridger and Garazeb Orrelios, two members of a rebel …

Ghests were a predatory serpentine species native to the jungle swamps of the planet Rodia. With long, green bodies; claws; and sharp teeth, they preferred to ambush prey on swamp shorelines by pouncing on them from the water, rarely if ever hunting on land.

Daxan Beta was a planet situated near a main trade route used by the Galactic Empire. General Jan Dodonna of the Alliance to Restore the Republic briefly studied it as a potential location for a new Rebel base after the evacuation of the Great Temple on Yavin 4, but quickly re…

Insk was a silicon-based planet located in the galaxy's Wild Space. General Jan Dodonna of the Alliance to Restore the Republic briefly studied it as a potential location for a new Rebel base after the evacuation of the Great Temple on Yavin 4, but quickly rejected it due to b…

place: Grand Temple's throne room, Great Temple, Yavin 4
x: The Royal Award Ceremony was a medal ceremony held in the Great Temple on Yavin 4 the morning after the Battle of Yavin.

WAC-47 was a modified DUM-series pit droid who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. He was a part of D-Squad along with several other droids on an important mission, serving under Colonel Meebur Gascon and piloting his ship.

The Invincible was a Providence-class Dreadnought and capital ship that served in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars as the flagship of Harch Separatist Admiral Trench.

Momongs, or Trandoshan monkeys, were a species of primates that lived in the trees of forests on Wasskah, the moon of the planet Trandosha. They had six limbs, a long tail, big ears and green eyes. Their fur was mostly orange, with occasional black and white patches.

A Judicial was a member of the Judicial Department. They served as the primary non-Jedi peace officers in the Galactic Republic. Most Judicials attended the Judicial Academy before being assigned to the Judicial Forces.
The Judicial Department, also known as the Judiciary branch, was the executive and judiciary department that oversaw law enforcement and judiciary affairs for the Galactic Republic.

Eufornis Minor, sometimes referred to as simply Eufornis, was a planet located in the Shadola sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A remote colony, it was sometimes confused with Eufornis Major, a prestigious city-planet located within the Core Worlds.
Todo 360 was a techno-service droid owned by bounty hunter Cad Bane. During the Clone Wars, Todo served Bane on various missions despite being often overlooked and undervalued by him.
The Lucid Voice was a Providence-class Dreadnought that served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
The Nite Owls were an elite Mandalorian unit made up of warriors led by Bo-Katan Kryze as part of the larger Death Watch movement.

Lagos was a Sentinel-class landing craft used by the Galactic Empire. After the destruction of the Imperial Communications Center on Lothal, Lagos was used to ferry R4 courier droids to and from the Tellstar in order to maintain Imperial communications.

Parwans were a sentient species native to Parwa. During the High Republic Era, Parwan Jedi Master Obratuk Glii was a respected diplomat within the Jedi Order. During the Clone Wars, the Parwan Derrown was considered one of the best bounty hunters in the galaxy by Count Dooku.

The Chekkoo clan was a Rodian clan on the planet Rodia. The clan was based in the Chekkoo Enclave on the continent of Betu. Members of the Chekkoo clan were known to be skilled in manufacturing weapons, armor, and other related munitions. Laneet Chekkoo was a member of this clan.

x: The Battle of Teth, also known as the battle on Teth, the assault at the B'omarr Monastery, the battle at the Teth Monastery, or the rescue of Rotta, took place on the Hutt-controlled planet of Teth between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Belugans were an aquatic sentient species native to the planet Quarzite. Largely humanoid, the Belugans sported fleshy sideburns on the sides of their faces and had sectioned jaws that hid their baleen-like teeth.

t: Darth Vader's black Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor
x: Several black Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptors served as the personal starfighter of the Sith Lord Darth Vader in the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign.

Clan Vizsla was a Mandalorian clan that was active during the time of the Galactic Republic, and the Galactic Empire. The Mandalorian Jedi Tarre Vizsla served as the Mand'alor of the Mandalorians sometime prior to the fall of the Old Republic.

Parwa was a planet which was the homeworld of the Parwan species. It had seasons which were several centuries long, and some Parwans hibernated along with the changing seasons even if they were not on Parwa. The Parwan bounty hunter Derrown was born on Parwa.

Corellian sand panthers, also known as just sand-panthers, were a feline species native to the planet Corellia. The engineers of Coronet Arms based the design of the Mark V "Sand Panther" hunting rifle on an ancient rifle used to hunt sand-panthers.
Pammant was a planet colonized by members of the Quarren species. By the Republic Era, several Quarren engineers resided there.

Gamorr was a lush planet located in the Galov sector of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Triellus Trade Route. It was the homeworld of a porcine sentient species, the Gamorreans, who chopped down forests to clear land for farming.
Level 1331 was a level on the planet Coruscant. During the Age of the Empire, Phoca Soot was the prefect of the level.

Carida was a mountainous planet located in the Carida system within the Colonies region of the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, the Valor space station orbited the planet, while the era of the Galactic Empire saw Carida as home to an Imperial academy and a naval docking facility.

The Deep Core Security Zone was an area of the galaxy's Deep Core which was controlled by the Galactic Empire. It was considered a sensitive region and access to the zone was restricted by the 15th Deep Core Reserve Fleet, operating out of nearby Empress Teta.

Calcoraan was a planet located in the Calcoraan system in the Inner Rim. It was entirely covered by an ocean made out of chromyl chloride, which gave the planet its blood red color, mixed with several other acids, making it uninhabitable.
Nyriaan was a planet where the human Jenkes managed a gladiator arena during the early days of the Galactic Empire's rule.
The Anx were a tall reptilian sentient species native to Gravlex Med. They were notable for their blade-shaped head which had a crest that changed color according to the individual's mood.

Balosars were a near-human sentient species which possessed two antennapalps on the tops of their heads, but were otherwise similar in appearance to humans. They were native to the ruined world Balosar.
Grassworms were a species of worm which were similar in appearance to noodles when anemic.

Givins were a sentient species from Yag'Dhul. They had the appearance of an animated skeleton, and were renowned for their mathematical genius. During the Galactic Civil War, the Givin cryptographer Drusil Bephorin was recruited into the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Ahakista was a location in the Ahakista system where the Daystar Casino was built. The Dug gambler Gronson Takkaro, who at one point worked as operations manager of the casino, fell deeply into debt on Ahakista and fled to the planet Lothal.

Section IG-44 was an area of the planet Coruscant. Coruscant Guard riot troopers believed Duchess Satine Kryze fled toward that section after the police identified her as a suspect in the murder of Davu Golec.

Malastare Narrows was a location on the planet Malastare in the Mid Rim Territories. In 34 BBY, prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, a Corporate Alliance fleet commanded by the Harch Admiral Trench had fo…
Imperial Heavy Troopers were a branch of the Imperial Army's Stormtrooper Corps. Heavy Troopers were equipped with special combat armor and electrostaffs in order to deal with highly resilient foes.

Carrandar Secundus was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Carrandar Secundus system of the Outer Rim Territories' Portmoak sector. The Galactic Empire destroyed a nest in the system around five years before the Battle of Yavin.

A nest was located on Carrandar Secundus, where it was destroyed by the Galactic Empire around five years before the Battle of Yavin. The human girl Merei Spanjaf read about the nest's destruction on a newsfeed on her datapad.

Uquine was a placid planet located in the Uquine system in the Colonies region. The agricultural scientist Tepha Leonis gave birth to her second child, Zare Leonis on the planet, although the Leonis family left the world, living in a number of locations including the space sta…

Eufornis Major, sometimes referred to as simply Eufornis, was a prestigious ecumenopolis planet located in the galaxy's Core Worlds. Due to their similar names, Eufornis Major was occasionally confused with Eufornis Minor, a remote Outer Rim colony world.

PM-1203, colloquially known as the Fort Anaxes asteroid, was a massive planetoid located in the Azure system's Anaxes asteroid belt, within the Azure sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Keren was the largest city on the planet Naboo. It was the location of Club Deeja, as well as a pocket of Alderaanian citizens. After the destruction of Alderaan, Princess Leia Organa ventured to Keren to save the Alderaanians there from the Galactic Empire.
The Patience was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in the service of the Rebel Alliance's fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

QT-KT, also known as Qutee-Kaytee and often referred to as Qutee, was an astromech droid and a member of D-Squad, under the command of Colonel Meebur Gascon, during the Clone Wars. She belonged to Jedi Knight Aayla Secura.

M5-BZ, also referred to as simply BZ or Beezee, was an astromech droid who had served the Jedi Master Tera Sinube and subsequently became a member of D-Squad. M5-BZ was lost in hyperspace after opening an airlock while aboard a Venator-class Star Destroyer, the Renown.

Kalist VI, also known simply as Kalist, was a barren rocky planet located in the Kalist system of the Deep Core. It was the homeworld of rebel pilot Dak Ralter, who joined Rogue Squadron of the Rebel Alliance.
Toola was a frigid planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of both the sentient Whiphid species and massive beasts of burden known as mastmots.
Tiisheraan was the homeworld of the Alliance to Restore the Republic Major Bren Derlin. It was located in the Tiisheraan system in the Core Worlds.

Ralltiir was a terrestrial planet located in the Core Worlds' Darpa sector, in the Ralltiir system. During the Clone Wars, Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic of the Galactic Republic financed a few weeks of vacation on the planet for the smuggler Has Obitt's former crew member…

Axxila was a sparsely-populated terrestrial planet located in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories. An exporter of ores, the once prosperous world eventually fell into obscurity after outside forces like the Galactic Empire engaged in strip mining operations.

The Kupohan were a sentient species from the planet of Kupoh in the system of the same name. Due to the strong winds of their ecosystem, they had evolved their frequency filter organs to screen out all the noise and detect voices, which also helped them hunt.

The Rand Ecliptic was a starship in the service of the Galactic Empire shortly before the Battle of Yavin. After attending an Imperial Academy, the pilots Biggs Darklighter and Derek Klivian both received their commissions aboard the vessel.

R3-S6, also known as "Goldie" or "Stubby," and as "Agent R3" to the Separatists, was an R3-series astromech droid assigned to Anakin Skywalker, during the Clone Wars to replace his lost astromech droid R2-D2.

Llanic was a planet located in the Llanic system in the Karthakk sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated at the intersection of the Llanic Spice Route and the Triellus Trade Route.

Pantora was the primary moon in orbit around the planet Orto Plutonia, in the Pantora system, located in the Sujimis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square P-19 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

place: Above the moon Pantora, in the Pantora system
x: The blockade of Pantora, also known as the Pantoran blockade, was established during the Clone Wars by the Trade Federation above the moon Pantora, in the Pantora system.

During the Clone Wars, the daughters of Pantora Supreme Chairman Notluwiski Papanoida, Che Amanwe Papanoida and Chi Eekway Papanoida were kidnapped by the bounty hunters Greedo and his Gotal accomplice.

Omereth was a water-based planet located in the Omereth system within the Outer Rim Territories, past Hutt Space. Practically uninhabited, it possessed a few archipelagos and had little to offer to most species in the galaxy besides fish.
Located on Level 5000, the planet Coruscant's central power distribution grid was comprised of massive generator towers that powered the entire ecumenopolis.
Volpai were a four-armed sentient species found in the galaxy. Notable Volpai included Robbs Ely, Tiggs Leo, and Moregi.

Kouhuns, also known as Indoumodo kouhuns were small, multi-legged arthropods from the jungle planet of Indoumodo that were able to deliver a deadly venom to their victims. As their venom was typically lethal, they were sometimes employed by assassins to kill their targets.

A mandatory blackout was put into place on the planet Coruscant in the aftermath of the bombing of the central power distribution grid. Senator Onaconda Farr was assaulted by bounty hunters Robonino and Chata Hyoki during one of the blackouts.
Padmé's office, located in the Senate Office Building on Coruscant, was used by Senator Padmé Amidala during her time in the Republic Senate.
A funeral for Senator Onaconda Farr was held on the planet Coruscant a few days after his death.

Asmeru was a planet located in the Asmeru system in the Outer Rim Territories' Senex sector, part of the Senex-Juvex region. On the 234th day of the world's sixteenth month, the natives at one point celebrated a festival known as Q'anah in their language.
The Hound's Tooth was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YV-666 light freighter used as the personal starship of Bossk, a Trandoshan bounty hunter.
Balnab was a temperate planet located in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim, near Patitite Pattuna. During the Clone Wars, it served as a home to a group of alien castaways.

Aleen was a rocky planet located within the Bright Jewel sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. It was home to the diminutive, terrestrial Aleena species, and the Kindalo, a bioluminescent, tree-like species.
Nexu were predatory felines native to the planet Cholganna. They were also found on Zhanox, Vodran, and Saleucami.

The Core Five, also known as the Council of Five, was the ruling body of the InterGalactic Banking Clan on the planet Scipio. The Council was arrested after being charged with corruption, allowing Senator Rush Clovis to assume total control of the Banking Clan.
"Doctor Ball" was an IT-O Interrogation Unit in service to the Galactic Empire before the start of the Galactic Civil War.

Thalassians were a sentient species, some of whom worked as slavers. During the reign of the Galactic Republic, the Er'Kit Senator Danry Ledwellow accepted bribes from Thalassian slavers and allowed them to operate on his species' homeworld.
Yuzzums were a sentient species native to the Forest Moon of Endor. A Yuzzum named Joh Yowza occasionally sang with the Max Rebo Band, while another known as Wam Lufba worked as an exterminator.
Garel City was a city on the Outer Rim planet Garel. It was the location of the Garel City Spaceport.

Pons Ora was one of the few settlements on the surface of Abafar, a remote desert world located in the Outer Rim Territories, and served as the planet's de facto seat of government. During the Clone Wars, it was host to a Separatist rhydonium mining installation.
MF-80 was a protocol droid with feminine programming who was in the service of the Grand Hutt Council and owned by Gardulla.
The Naboo Royal Handmaidens, or simply handmaidens, were a group of young female handmaidens chosen as aides to the Queen of the planet Naboo.
0-0-0, also known simply as Triple-Zero, or just Trip, was a protocol droid that specialized in etiquette, customs, translation and torture.
BT-1, also referred to as "Bee Tee," was a homicidal BT-1 assassin droid created by the Galactic Empire's Tarkin Initiative.

U9-C4, also referred to as Ceefor and nicknamed "Flat Top" by Colonel Meebur Gascon, was a somewhat timid R5 series astromech droid owned by Thongla Jur, a member of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

A species of bioluminescent microplankton were native to the planet Mon Cala. The microplankton could be used as a hair dye if it was washed into an individuals hair, as it would bond with each hair strand and then emit pulsating glow.

Tey-Zuka was an ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.

x: In 4 BBY the rebel crew of the Ghost accompanied smuggler Lando Calrissian on a mission to his farm on Lothal, after aiding him in acquiring a puffer pig from the crime lord Azmorigan.

The Electrum was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. Originally stationed at the planet Ryloth's deepdock, the Star Destroyer was loaned out to serve in the flotilla of the Imperial installation known as Sentinel Base.

KRONOS-327 was an IG-86 sentinel droid who worked in Ziro the Hutt's criminal organization during the Clone Wars. He was Ziro's favored assassin until he failed an assignment and was ordered for destruction.

TC-70 was a TC-series protocol droid who served as a translator for Jabba the Hutt during the Clone Wars and into the Imperial Era. However, by 2 ABY, Jabba had a different protocol unit serving as his translator droid.
Yoda's fighter was a modified Jedi starfighter at one point during the Clone Wars, stationed in the Jedi Temple hangar.

R9-D9 was an astromech droid who served King Sanjay Rash of Onderon during the Clone Wars. Late in the war, R9 showed Rash and General Kalani holographic images of Steela Gerrera and Lux Bonteri as Akenathen Tandin informed them the rebel leaders also included Steela's brother…

Stormtrooper grenadiers were specialized stormtroopers equipped with grenade launchers that fired Class-A thermal detonators. They wore a red pauldron and a black bandolier across their chest. Their armor's right shoulder plate featured a red symbol.

The Gathering was a rite of passage of the Jedi Order meant as a lesson to teach Jedi Initiates how to overcome their personal fears or failings and to find a kyber crystal attuned to their Force presence in the Crystal Caves of Ilum.

Desert stormtroopers, or sandtroopers, were specialized stormtroopers who were trained and equipped for desert operations. Organized into a specialized division of the overall Stormtrooper Corps, they served the interests of the Galactic Empire in deserts throughout its reign.

The Liberator was a Venator-class Star Destroyer belonging to the starfleet of the Galactic Empire. Five years after the inception of the Empire, it was parked at R/M Facility Four deepdock at Belderone.
The Goliath was an Imperial escort carrier belonging to the starfleet of the Galactic Empire. Its main function was to carry starfighters.

Zeltrons were a humanoid sentient species whose skin varied in shades of red. Whenever a Zeltron became angry, their skin turned a deeper red. Ric Farazi was a Zeltron journalist during the High Republic Era.

The Battle of Slag's Pit took place at Slag's Pit during the Clone Wars, around 19 BBY. The general in charge of the Galactic Republic troops hoped to use demolitions to bury a Separatist fortification.
Kallerans were a tall sentient species native to the planet of Kaller.
Concordia was a moon of the planet Mandalore. It was governed by Pre Vizsla. The Death Watch, which was in fact led by Vizsla, used the abandoned mines on Concordia as secret hideouts.

The Bivall were a semi-aquatic sentient species of tall bipeds with lanky bodies, large stalked eyes, crested heads and long fingers that were native to Protobranch in the Core Worlds. Sionver Boll and Okalin were members of this species.

The Junkers were a sentient group made up of natives to the planet Lotho Minor. Apparently hybrids of various organic species and mechanical debris, they scavenged the caustic surface of their ruined homeworld for discarded cybernetics to augment their bodies with.

x: The Battle of Mon Cala, also known as the Battle of Mon Calamari, the Second Battle of Mon Calamari, the civil war on Mon Cala, or the Attack on Mon Cala, was fought during the Clone Wars on the aquatic world of Mon Cala.
The Massassi were a species who lived on Yavin 4, the fourth moon of Yavin Prime. Thousands of years before the Imperial Era, they built enormous stone temples on the moon for unknown purposes.
Battle droid 513 was one of many monster battle droids assembled by the Mandalorians of Death Watch for target practice during their stay on the planet Carlac in the midst of the Clone Wars.
BNI-393 was an LEP-series service droid who served within the naval forces of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Kaller was a terrestrial planet with a complex climate located in the Kaller system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Kallerans.

Patitites were a species of diminutive sentients native to the planet Patitite Pattuna. During the Clone Wars, they had to start a democracy after the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 caused the death of their dictator, "Big" Hay-Zu.

Executrix was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer belonging to the starfleet of the Galactic Empire. It served as Wilhuff Tarkin's personal flagship during his service as Moff and later Grand Moff, from 18 BBY, up until Tarkin took command of the Death Star in 1 BBY, where the …
Fex was a moon located in the Deep Core orbiting the planet Sha Qarot. It was once considered but later rejected as a location for a Rebel Alliance base.

A species of large, gray, non-sentient quadrupeds was native to the plains of the planet Utapau. These grass-eating creatures were plated in armor on their dorsal side as a protection against predator attacks from above.

TC-14 was a silver-plated TC-series protocol droid with feminine programming who was manufactured by Cybot Galactica. She served aboard the Trade Federation flagship, Saak'ak, where she frequently received memory wipes that left her permanently confused and with no personality.
The Marina District was an area of the city of Keren on the planet Naboo. Club Deeja was located in the Marina District.

The Chiss were a near-human sentient species that possessed blue skin, red eyes, and dark blue hair. They hailed from the planet Csilla. The Chiss were notable for the nature and structure of their families, and how Chiss families dominated many aspects of Chiss society.

t: Mission to rescue the survivors of Alderaan
objective: Rescue surviving Alderaanians from execution by the Galactic Empire
x: During the Galactic Civil War, Princess Leia Organa undertook a mission to save the few Alderaanians left living in the galaxy after her homeworld of Alderaan was destroyed by the Death Star.

The Imperial Advisor's Office was an office in the government of the Galactic Empire. While on a mission to rescue the few Alderaanians who survived in the galaxy after the destruction of Alderaan, Princess Leia Organa posed under the name "First Minister Solo" and advised the…
CZ-246 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that belonged to the Galactic Empire. It was destroyed shortly after the Battle of Yavin, when it was attacked by pirates.

Zardossa Stix was a moon with a desert climate, in the Colonies located near Bardotta. The clay warriors of Zardossa Stix were associated with the moon, and according to Zardossan legend would return an enemy army to life if they were ever destroyed.
Kupoh was a planet located in the Kupoh system in the Dohlbani sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Kupohan species.

Rupings were a notable reptavian species native to the planet Onderon. They had vocal chords that produced a rasping roar, finger-like wingtips, and a thumb claw that allowed them to grasp and climb with their wings.

This black astromech droid, was in service to the Galactic Empire shortly after the Battle of Yavin. It was stationed aboard Grand General Cassio Tagge's Executor-class Star Dreadnought, the Annihilator.
A skirmish occurred between a group of villagers and the Galactic Empire on the planet Vyndal five years before the Battle of Yavin.
Lurmen were a diminutive, pacifistic species from the Outer Rim planet Mygeeto. At least one settlement of Lurmen was present on the planet Maridun at the time of the Clone Wars.
1138 was a B1-series battle droid serving under the Trade Federation Droid Army during the Naboo Crisis. 1138 took part on the Battle of Naboo under the command of OOM-9.
Haruun Kal was a planet within the Haruun Kal system, a star system in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim Territories, and the homeworld of Jedi Master Mace Windu.
Darth Vader's TIE Advanced was a modified TIE Advanced x1 prototype starfighter personally employed by the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Vanqor was a rocky crystalline planet located in the Vanqor system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the gundark species. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems established a listening post on this world.

x: In 4 BBY, ISB agent Kallus laid a trap in the Lothal City Capitol Building in an attempt to capture the rebels active on Lothal. Using the fake rebel Senator Gall Trayvis, the Empire intended to lure the rebels into the Senate Building.
Lucazec was an astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories along the Salin Corridor that was controlled by the Galactic Empire.

Jubba birds were a non-sentient species of bird native to the swamps of the planet Dagobah, where they made their nests using mud. The birds were capable of manipulating the Force, which they used to calm others through songs and quiet their young when danger was near.

Cholganna was a dark, cool forest planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the nexus, a species of predatory felines that spread off-world as a result of their value as attack beasts.
Ylesia was a terrestrial planet in the Ylesia system of Hutt Space that, along with the Codian Moon, was the homeworld of the reek species. It was situated along the Shag Pabol hyperspace route.

The Ohnaka Gang, also known as Hondo's Gang or the Hondo Ohnaka pirate gang, and sometimes referred to as the Weequay pirates, was a group of pirates led by Hondo Ohnaka that was based on the Outer Rim planet Florrum during the Clone Wars.

The colo claw fish, also spelled colo clawfish, was a large and nightmarish creature found in the depths of Naboo's seas, as well as the Cordaxian Sea. The colo had a flat eel-like body, a bio-luminescent tail, a crocodile-like head, a row of sharp teeth, and a set of mandibles.
Carlac was a peaceful planet Carlac system in the Prefsbelt sector within the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories.

A vixus was a stationary, non-sentient creature that originated from Umbara. The vixus had tentacles that looked like harmless vines that it would use to ensnare victims and draw them into its toothy mouth, which had a long grasping tongue shaped like a three-pronged claw.

conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
result: Execution of Commandant Cumberlayne Aresko and Taskmaster Myles Grint
x: In 4 BBY, the crew of the Ghost raided an Galactic Empire installation and stole some supplies near the town of Jalath. Commandant Cumberlayne Aresko and Taskmaster Myles Grint personally commanded the pursuit, but the rebels managed to escape.

Denon was an ancient, conservative planet located in the Denon system in the Iseno sector of the Inner Rim, at the confluence of the Corellian Run and the Hydian Way. An ecumenopolis world, it had city growth covering the entire surface, similar to Coruscant.

Kadavo was an ugly, barren planet located in the Kadavo system of Wild Space. During the Clone Wars, it was under the control of the Zygerrian Slave Empire, which used it to process slaves. Kadavo had multiple volcanoes, but for the most part, they were dormant.

Kiros was an idyllic world filled with vast green valleys and flowing waterfalls located in the Kiros system in the the galaxy's Expansion Region. Located in the Ehosiq sector like Shili, the homeworld of the Togruta species, Kiros was home host to 50,000 Togruta colonists.

The Phoenix was a GX1 short hauler used by the Galactic Republic during an attempt to negotiate with the Separatists during the Clone Wars. It was a diplomatic vessel that was designed for long and extended missions.

objective: Rescue of Halcyon planetary leadership members
x: Around a decade before the Clone Wars, a group of Judicials and Jedi were sent by the Galactic Republic on a mission to rescue a group of hostages being held by usurpers on the planet Halcyon.

Murkhana City was a capital city on the Separatist Alliance bastion planet Murkhana. Argente Tower was at one time its tallest building, but it was decimated in the Clone Wars. Following the Clone Wars, Murkhana City was occupied by the Galactic Empire.
Kuat was a vital shipbuilding and industrial planet located in the Kuat system of the galaxy's Core Worlds region and homeworld of the Kuati people.

climate: Arid; hot days with cold nights
x: Jakku was a remote desert planet located in the Jakku system in the galaxy's Inner Rim and was the homeworld of the Teedo and Uthuthma species.
The Resistance was a military resistance movement that opposed the secretive First Order, a fascist military junta and the successor of the Galactic Empire.
The Justifier was a starship owned by the bounty hunter Cad Bane. It had a central thruster that was capable of reorienting itself laterally, so that it would align itself horizontally with the ship.

Skako Minor, sometimes referred to as simply Skako, was a planet that was the homeworld of the Poletec species. It was controlled by the Techno Union, whose headquarters was the city of Purkoll.

Skakoans were a sentient species native to the planet Skako. In order to survive off of their homeworld, they were required to wear pressure suits to simulate its unique atmosphere and pressure, which were vastly different from the galactic standard.
Brain worms were a species of parasitic worm from the planet Geonosis which were capable of entering the body of a host and taking control of it and had the potential to control entire societies.

Rhen Var was a planet with frigid environments in the Rhen Var system of the Thanium sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was located near the Galidraan system in the grid R-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Commander Mekedrix abandons the Clone Wars

The Resolute was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that served in the Fifth Fleet of the Galactic Republic naval forces' Open Circle Fleet, and also served as the flagship of Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his fleet during the Clone Wars.

objective: Bring Toydaria into the Galactic Republic
x: The Battle of Rugosa, also known as the Ambush on Rugosa, was a mission that took place during the Clone Wars on the moon Rugosa. The Galactic Republic aimed to create a base to combat the Confederacy of Independent Systems in the Outer Rim Territories.
Vyndal was a planet located in the galaxy that was covered with colorful forests, and rocky plains. Vyndal was also the homeworld to a unknown race.

The defense of Cato Neimoidia, also known as the invasion of Cato Neimoidia or the Battle of Cato Neimoidia, was a battle fought during the later stages of the Clone Wars when the planet Cato Neimoidia, which housed the headquarters of the Trade Federation, was invaded by the …
Anaxes was a rocky planet located in the Azure sector in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. A majority of its surface was covered with tall, red plant-like life.

D4L1 was a data processing droid owned by Xira, a member of the Free Ryloth Movement. During the movement's attempt to assassinate Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine and the Sith Lord Darth Vader, he aided Xira in coordinating an attack on the Imperial Star Destroyer Perilous.

place: Sullust system, over the planet Sullust
x: The Battle of Sullust was a conflict which took place during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems for control over the planet Sullust.
The Inflictor was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that participated in the Battle of Jakku, between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic one year after the Battle of Endor.

Zakkegs were a species of creature known for being crafty and stubborn. The mercenary Saponza compared the Tusken Raider known as the Jundland General to a zakkeg after discovering that he had several heavily fortified bases.

Varykino Villa was located in Naboo's Lake Country on an island of the same name. The isolated estate was owned by the royal government and was used as a private refuge from the planet's capital Theed by several renowned members of the Naboo people, including Omar Berenko, a p…
The Khetanna was an LO-KD57 luxury sail barge manufactured by Ubrikkian Industries that was modified to suit the needs of the Hutt crime lord Jabba.

x: The Battle of Malastare, one of the fiercest battles of the Clone Wars, took place on the planet Malastare. During the battle, the Confederacy of Independent Systems attempted to deplete the Galactic Republic's fuel supply by sending a massive army to conquer the world.
Coyerti was a planet in the Mid Rim, and was the home of the Coyerti species. Due to its rich plant and animal life, it served as a military research outpost for biological weapons.
Haidoral Prime, or simply Haidoral, was a backwater planet located in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice regions.

Jablogians were a sentient species native to the planet of Nar Kanji. They were noted for their overweight torsos, blemished red skin, pointed ears and beady eyes. Azmorigan, Drahric and Nazgorigan were members of that species.

x: In 0 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire, the Alliance bombed the shipyards at the Core world Kuat.

x: The Battle of Sarrish, also known as the invasion of Sarrish, was a grueling battle that took place on the planet Sarrish in the Outer Rim Territories during the second year of the Clone Wars.
Corellians were a cultural group of humans native to the planet Corellia. Han Solo, captain of the Millennium Falcon, was a Corellian who fought for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Perilous was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer serving as the flagship of Darth Vader, up until the skirmish with the Free Ryloth Movement in which it was destroyed.

The Redemption was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's fleet. It was refitted with advanced medical facilities and served the fleet as the primary medical frigate, but could also hold its own in combat.
The Alderaan vigil rioting took place in Coruscant after the destruction of the planet Alderaan by the Death Star in 1 BBY.

Chandrila was a planet in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. The female human Mon Mothma hailed from Chandrila, and represented her homeworld in the Senate of the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire. It was also the homeworld and birthplace of Ben Solo.

The Alderaan Enclave was a compound that lay deep beneath the surface of the volcanic planet Sullust. The Enclave was built by a group of Alderaanians after they emigrated from their homeworld of Alderaan and bought the land from the native Sullustans.
The Nightbrother village was a village where the Dathomirian Zabrak warrior group, the Nightbrothers lived and trained on their homeworld of Dathomir.

result: The Rebel Alliance bombs the supply base
x: In 0 ABY, after the Rebel Alliance destroyed the Galactic Empire's Death Star superweapon, the Alliance carried out a bombing of an Imperial supply base on the world Imdaar.
The Numm were a technologically-primitive sentient species Han Solo and Chewbacca encountered after the Millennium Falcon hyperdrive malfunctioned, forcing them to land on the Numm's world.
The Blade Master was a Krath war droid with arms containing retractable metal swords who led a group of other Krath war droids.

The Naboo Palace Guard, also referred to as the Royal Palace Guard, was one of three distinct divisions of the Royal Naboo Security Forces. Its members protected the Monarch of Naboo and other dignitaries. They were mostly seen around and in the Royal Palace's grounds.

The Security Guard, also referred to as the Security Troopers, was one of three divisions of the Royal Naboo Security Forces led by Captain Panaka. Composed of mostly volunteers, they served as police officers of the planet Naboo.
The Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps, also known as the Royal Naboo Starfighter Corps or Royal Space Fighter Corps (RSFC), was one of three divisions of the Royal Naboo Security Forces.

The Obedience, formerly known as the Defiance, was a cruiser in the service of the Galactic Empire. The cruiser had served as a training vessel for many years under the command of Commandant Pell Baylo until he attempted to destroy the vessel and assassinate Galactic Emperor S…
The Industrial sector was a location within Crescent City on the planet Corellia. The swooper Dengar took part in a swoop race in the Industrial sector at some point by 13 BBY but was beat by Han.

result: Prevention of Anaxes capture by the Confederacy of Independent Systems
x: The Battle of Anaxes—also known as the battle for Anaxes, the battle on Anaxes, and the defense of Anaxes—was a prolonged engagement that was fought on the planet Anaxes for several months during the Outer Rim Sieges in 19 BBY, the final year of the Clone Wars.

result: Jedi General Plo Koon and company rescued
x: The Battle of Abregado was a naval engagement that took place in 22 BBY, early in the Clone Wars after Jedi General Plo Koon's fleet of Venator-class Star Destroyers discovered Confederate General Grievous' new warship, the Malevolence.

objective: Kill Count Dooku
x: During the Clone Wars, the Nightsisters undertook a mission to assassinate the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Tyranus, publicly Count Dooku after he betrayed his apprentice Asajj Ventress.

The Marauder was a modified Omicron-class attack shuttle that served as the personal starship of Clone Force 99, also known as the "Bad Batch." The craft was unique compared to other Grand Army of the Republic starships, so it was used for the Bad Batch's covert and undercover…

Lessu City, commonly shortened to just Lessu, was the capital city of Ryloth. It was taken over by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, but eventually won back by the efforts of the Galactic Republic and the Twi'lek Resistance.

The massiff was a reptilian species of dangerous hunters found on desert planets including Tatooine and Geonosis. Massiffs were domesticated for sentry and guard tasks, and were used by the Tusken Raiders of Tatooine.
The Festival of Light was a Naboo tradition, which celebrated the anniversary of the planet Naboo joining the Galactic Republic.

Maridun was a planet located in the Rolion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a temperate and verdant world, with a comfortable climate despite its challenging ecosystem and dangerous predators.
The Battle of the Ryndellia system was a battle that took place in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars in the Ryndellia system.
Mahranee was a planet in the Mahranee system in the Taldot sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Mahran species.
Gutkurrs were a species of vicious predatory insect carnivores native to the planet Ryloth, where they maintained hunting grounds. "Gutkurr" can also be used by Ryloth natives as a pejorative term.
The Defiance Flight Training Institute was an organization that was created by Pell Baylo.

Yalbec Prime was a location in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, the Republic's Clone Force 99, an elite group of clone troopers, were sent to put down an insurrection on Yalbec Prime, but complications arose when a member of the group, known as Wrecker, cut of…

Yalbec were an insectoid species found on Yalbec Prime. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, several Yalbec were involved in an Insurrection on Yalbec Prime, during which they came into conflict with the Republic's eli…
In 19 BBY, the final year of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Separatist Alliance, the Republic's elite clone commando squad Clone Force 99 ended an insurrection on Yalbec Prime.
The Poletecs were a species of purple, red, or beige-skinned, lanky humanoids native to the planet Skako Minor.

Quermians were a gaunt, long-necked humanoid sentient species native to the planet Quermia. They had two brains, one located inside their head and the other within their chest cavity, and two pairs of arms.
Mine 3601 was a Mine located deep beneath the Volcanic Planet Sullust's surface. The mine was inhabited by a herd of Rockrenders who survived off of mineral deposits located there.
The Mayjein Eruption was a location on the volcanic planet of Sullust. An enclave of Alderaanians was located south of the Mayjein Eruption.
The Lord Junn was a pleasure craft that originally belonged to Junn, a male human who lived as a Lord on the planet Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.

conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
x: During their rebellion against the Galactic Empire, the rebel crew of the starship Ghost carried out an attack against an Imperial convoy on Lothal.

The Eyewell was a part of the Alderaan Enclave on the volcanic planet Sullust. It contained many computer surveillance stations that were used to monitor the enclave, Sullust's surface, and even Sullust's moon.

Imdaar was a terrestrial world located in the Imdaar system within the Dantus sector of the Outer Rim. It was situated on grid square J-6 on the Standard Galactic Grid. During the Imperial Era, Imdaar housed a supply base of the Galactic Empire.

This landing field was owned by the Corporate Alliance, and was part of a spaceport located on the planet Murkhana. It consisted of a hexagonal spaceport, and a quartet of ten-kilometer bridges that linked it up to the Murkhana City.
Shili was a planet located in the Shili system within the Expansion Region, that was the homeworld of the sentient Togruta species.

The Bright Hope was a GR-75 medium transport that served the Rebel Alliance. There were twenty-nine other transports of the same model used by the rebels to escape Hoth. During the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, the transport was a part of the evacuation plan.
Purkoll was a city located on the planet Skako Minor that served as the headquarters of the Techno Union. The facility had D1-series aerial battle droids and octuptarra magna tri-droids guarding it.

Seswenna was a planet located in the Seswenna system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, the planet was a stronghold of the Galactic Republic.

Quarantine World III was a large asteroid located in Kallidahin Space. It, among many artifacts, stored the Triple-Zero protocol personality matrix, the personality matrix for a homicidal protocol droid.
Kallidahin Space was an area of the galaxy. Quarantine World III was located in Kallidahin Space.
Cylo's base was made up of many large, armored Whale-ships and was the headquarters of Doctor Cylo, an agent working for Darth Sidious, the ruler of the Galactic Empire.

result: All but one of the Geonosians exterminated
x: Around 9 BBY, the Outer Rim world of Geonosis was sterilized by the Galactic Empire, killing virtually all of the planet's population, by orders from Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, to ensure the secrecy of the Death Star project.

The Battle of Khorm was fought during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems at some point between 22 BBY and 21 BBY over the natural resources of Khorm.

result: Barriss Offee is arrested by Anakin Skywalker
x: During the Clone Wars, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker fought fallen Jedi Knight Barriss Offee in a lightsaber duel in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
The Crystal Cave was located in the Jedi Temple on the planet Ilum. It was a sacred place where Jedi younglings would go find their lightsaber crystals in the ritual known as the Gathering.

A species of sentient humanoids with black eyes and pointed ears hailed from the planet of Vyndal. At some point during his life, a human named Yeleb landed on Vyndal and made contact with the natives.

The Kasmiri was the personal starship of the Kalleran scoundrel Janus Kasmir during the Clone Wars. It was stolen by the Jedi Padawan Caleb Dume while he fled clone troopers who were trying to kill him during the execution of Clone Protocol 66.
Dragonsnake Bog was a murky lagoon located on the swamp planet of Dagobah. It was named after its most dangerous occupant, a giant snake-like beast called the dragonsnake.
In 22 BBY, a funeral was held for Shmi Skywalker Lars at the Lars moisture farm on Tatooine. The funeral followed her death one month after being kidnapped and held hostage by Tusken Raiders.
Kiffu was a planet located in the Kiffex system in the Kiffu sector of the Inner Rim region of the galaxy. It was one of two home planets of the sentient Kiffar species, along with Kiffex.
Plateau City was a cosmopolitan city and the primary spaceport for the planet Kaller.
Galidraan IV was a planet in the Galidraan system within the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by at least two moons.

x: During the Galactic Civil War, a duel was fought between Jedi trainee Luke Skywalker and the bounty hunter Boba Fett in the former home of Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi on Tatooine.

Ruggers were a type of arboreal, herbivorous rodent native to the Forest Moon of Endor. Expert climbers, the agile creatures were hunted by many of the moon's predators, including the temptor, which used the furry heads of their long tongues to effectively bait the characteris…
Lantern birds were a species of bird native to the moon of Endor. They were hunted by the aggressive, sentient Dulok species, who were also native to the moon.
Duloks were an aggressive sentient species native to the forest moon of Endor, where they lived in swamps.

Gorax were a semi-sentient species of seldom-seen giant humanoids that inhabited the mountains of Endor. They sometimes attacked the villages of the Ewoks, who were among the sentient inhabitants of the moon.

Woolamanders were a species of creature native to the moon Yavin 4. They lived in the canopy level of the gigantic Massassi trees native to the world where they cradled their young, and late at night produced echoing mating calls.
Sintaril were a species of rodent native to the moon Yavin 4. They hunted in packs in the giant Massassi trees found on their homeworld and there overwhelmed roosting whisper birds.

Duracrete slugs, also known simply as duraslugs, were a species of non-sentient slug found in the underworld of the planet Coruscant. They fed on the artificial stone duracrete, then after digesting it, secreted it from their bodies to form a hard outer shell.
Phidnas were a type of glowing parasitic insect native to the Outer Rim planet Geonosis. They were smaller and less deadly then the world's three-meter long sand snakes.

Tractor Beam 12 was a tractor beam control unit located in Section N6 on board the Death Star. When a YT-1300 light freighter named the Millennium Falcon was captured by the station's tractor beam, Obi-Wan Kenobi, who was the passenger of the ship, turned off the device in ord…

Condor dragons, also known as mantigrues, were a species of creature native to the moon of Endor. The Ewoks of Bright Tree Village on Endor posted watchers in the forest canopy above their homes to watch out for condor dragons.
Munyips were tiny creatures that lived on the forest moon Endor. Arboreal in nature, they glided between trees using flaps of skin between their limbs and sang as they climbed or glided.
Rock warts, also spelled rock-wart, were a species of venomous parasites that could be found on Tatooine. They had eight legs and four eyes.
Alsakan was a Core Worlds planet situated along the Perlemian Trade Route. It was the homeworld of both Doctor Cornelius Evazan and the career military officer Enric Pryde.

Indoumodo was a jungle planet located in the Indoumodo system in Wild Space, in grid square S-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Venomous insects known as kouhuns were native to the world's swamps, where they hunted prey as large as dogs.

Merdeths were a type of huge insectoid that dominated the barren exterior of their homeworld, the Outer Rim planet Geonosis. Omnivores, they would eat any organic matter they came across, using eight powerful tentacles to pull prey into their mouths.

Rawwks were a type of creature found on the gas giant Bespin. They flitted among the algal trees that grew in the breathable upper atmosphere of the planet and nested on vast floating beldons, preying upon schools of air shrimp.
The Invictus was an Imperial Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was stolen by the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was used by Leia Organa and Han Solo to search for a new Rebel base.
Quermia was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the namesake of the Quermian species, whose ancestors were settled on Quermia by Arkanian scientists.
Runyips were a herbivorous species that foraged on the floors of Yavin 4's forests, where they were harassed by piranha beetles.
Piranha beetles were a species of beetle native to the moon Yavin 4. The beetles harassed runyips while the other species foraged on the floor of the moon's forests.

New Plympto was a Core Worlds astronomical object that was the homeworld of the Nosaurian species and a safe world for Senator Mon Mothma's organized rebellion against the Galactic Empire, which was later officialized as the Rebel Alliance.

Troiken was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories region of the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Xexto species. It was also home to raw spice mining operations, controlled by the Pyke Syndicate.

Glee Anselm was an ocean planet located in the Jalor system of the galaxy's Mid Rim that was the homeworld of the Anselmi and Nautolan species. Star Tours, a tour company, offered vacation tours of Glee Anselm during the Clone Wars.

Thisspias was a rocky, temperate planet located in the Thisspias system in the Farstey sector of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Thisspiasian species, including the Jedi Master Oppo Rancisis.
Ojom was a frozen planet located in the Ojom system in the the galaxy's Deep Core that was the homeworld of the Besalisk species.

Moonus Mandel was an astronomical object located in the Moonus Mandel system in Bothan Space, a sector of the Mid Rim. It was homeworld of the Veknoid podracer Teemto Pagalies and the human Jedi Knight Wellig Yuns.

Mirial was a cold and dry desert planet located in the Mirial system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the near-human Mirialan species, including Jedi Master Luminara Unduli and her Padawan Barriss Offee.
Sembla, formerly known as Utavurk, was a planet located in Mahrusha sector within the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Vurk, including Jedi Master Coleman Trebor.
Adana was a planet in the Deep Core's Adana system, situated in Standard Galactic Grid square L-10. Adana was the homeworld of the Faust scientist Nuvo Vindi.

Castell, also known as Gossam, was a planet located in the Castell system of the Colonies, situated along the Perlemian Trade Route. The Commerce Guild had interests on Castell and their Presidente Shu Mai hailed from the planet.

Cosia was a planet located in the Cosian Space part of the Deep Core, a region of the galaxy, within the system of the same name. Cosia was the only inhabited planet in that system, and served as the homeworld of the Cosian species, which included Jedi Master Tera Sinube.
Iktotch was the moon of the planet Iktotchon located in the galaxy's Expansion Region.
Lowick was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories that was the swampy homeworld of the Pa'lowick singer Sy Snootles.

Socorro was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Socorro system in the Kibilini sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of Lando Calrissian, former Baron Administrator of Cloud City.
Kubindi was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the insectivorous Kubaz species.
The Kubaz were an insectoid sentient species that were native to the planet Kubindi. They lived on a diet of insects, using their long snout to snatch their prey from inside hives.

Secundus Ando was a cavernous planet in the Secundus Ando system in the Lambda sector of the Mid Rim that was the homeworld of the Harch species, which included Admiral Trench, who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Tepasi was a planet located in the Tepasi system in Tagge Space, a region of the Core Worlds. Tepasi was the homeworld of Grand General Cassio Tagge, a member of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War who was born into the noble House of Tagge.

R4-G9 was a feminine astromech droid with white plating, bronze outlines, and a green sensor. She was assigned to Jedi Aayla Secura and later Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi right at the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY.

Zolan was a planet located in the Zolan system in the Lambda sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the sentient reptilian Clawdite species, recognized throughout the galaxy for their innate shape-changing abilities.

Nar Shaddaa, nicknamed the "Smuggler's Moon," was the notorious moon of the planet Nal Hutta, homeworld of the Hutt species. It was home to a large criminal underworld dominated by bounty hunters and Hutt crime lords.

Patrolia was an aquatic planet in the Patrolia system of the Inner Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Patrolian species. The Patrolian bounty hunter Robonino, who was active during the Clone Wars, hailed from Patrolia.
Protobranch was an agriworld and the homeworld of the Bivall species, including the scientist Sionver Boll, who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Phatrong was a terrestrial planet located in Outer Rim Territories' Thrasybule sector. It was covered in oceans divided by thin and mountainous continents, and was home to the Kyuzo species, which evolved several adaptations to the world's heavy gravity.

Virujansi was a planet in the Virujansi system of the Inner Rim Territories. It was ruled by the Virujansi council, and defended by the Virujansi Rarified Air Cavalry, until the Galactic Empire arrived and replaced the council's rule with an Imperial governor.

Tholoth was an arboreal planet located in the Tholoth system in the galaxy's Colonies region that was the homeworld of the Tholothian species. Tholoth was also the homeworld of the Jedi Master Stass Allie, who fought and died during the Clone Wars.
Belderone was a planet located in the Outer Rim's Belderone system, situated along the Salin Corridor.
Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder, also known simply as the Travelling World of Wonder, was a traveling intergalactic circus attraction run by the Dug showman Preigo.

The Ministry of Agriculture (Ag Ministry), also known as the Imperial Agriculture Ministry, was a government department of the Galactic Empire that was tasked with managing agricultural and horticultural production throughout the galaxy.

Lyleks were a species of large insectoid predators native to the equatorial forest of the planet Ryloth. With their spiked pincers and powerful mandibles with a pair of tentacles near them, the lyleks were the only Rylothian lifeform more dangerous than the predatory gutkurrs.

The meridian trench, sometimes called the Polar Trench, was a trench situated near the north pole of the Galactic Empire's Death Star battle station. It contained its only weakness, the thermal exhaust port.

The Kallidahin were a sentient species of humanoids that lacked facial features. Although they originated on Kallidah, they also established their presence in the asteroid field of Polis Massa. Because they stayed so long on the planetoid, they came to be known as Polis Massans.

Worrts were a non-sentient species that hailed from the desert of the planet Tatooine. These squat, large-mouthed creatures caught prey by sitting stationary in the sand and using their purple prehensile tongues to wrap around passing rodents, insects or birds.

The Vurk were a reptilian sentient species that was native to the planet Sembla. They had green, dark green, gray, or pink skin. It was thought that the Vurk were a primitive species, but they were highly empathetic and skilled mediators.

During the galaxy-wide conflict known as the Clone Wars, the Onderon rebels built and maintained the nest, a wooden fort built on a mountain that they used in their fight against the illegitimate King of Onderon Sanjay Rash, who had dethroned the planet's rightful king, Ramsis…

The Trade Spine League was an organization that consisted of both smugglers and freelance mercenaries who valued having independence and personal freedom. It operated out of the Anoat sector as both a union and a privateer network.
Burnin Konn was a planet in the Anoat sector that served as a mining colony for chromium and other ores.
Espirion was a planet in the Espirion system of the Inner Rim Territories that was home to a sentient species.
The Espirions were a sentient species of humanoids that hailed from the planet of the same name. Although very similar to humans, they had red skin, dark hair, and yellow eyes with green sclerae.
Jalath was a city located on the planet of Lothal, in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. Following its occupation of Lothal, the Galactic Empire established a small installation near Jalath.
The Alder-Espirions were a hybrid species, a mix between the red-skinned Espirions and members of the human race called Alderaanians which were native to the planet Alderaan.
The Bastinade was one of eleven Lambda-class T-4a shuttles carried by the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Ultimatum during its mission to the planet Gorse.

W1-LE, commonly known as "Willie," was an RQ protocol droid owned by Lando Calrissian since the Clone Wars. Willie originally had a different body type, however sometime before the Siege of Lothal Calrissian transferred Willie's logic unit into an RQ protocol droid.

The Bounty Hunters' Guild (BHG), also known as the Bondsman Guild or simply the Bounty Guild, was an institution that regulated the complicated profession that was the bounty hunting trade throughout the galaxy.

Blue was a blue-plated protocol droid that belonged to the Koorivar black-market merchant Sheb Valaad. It was equipped with two specialized programs, "Adul-8" and "B-Little," which made him particularly obsequious and pleasant.

The Mahran were a sentient species native to the planet Mahranee. They had four-fingered hands, sharp tufted ears, a blue muzzle with a keen sense of smell and a coat of fur. Every Mahran also had a stinger that could release venom.
Kiffex, alongside Kiffu, was one of the home planets of the Kiffar species. It was located in the Kiffex system in the Kiffu sector of the Inner Rim. Kiffex was the homeworld of Jedi Vildar Mac.
Oon was an arid planet located in the Lothal sector of Outer Rim Territories.

An enslavement empire was led by the Zygerrian MaDall on the planet of Oon, in the Outer Rim Territories in 4 BBY. It included slaves of many different species, including Aqualish, Bith, Duros, humans, Ithorians, Talz, Togruta, Twi'leks, and Wookiees.

Kintan was a planet located in the Kintan system within Hutt Space in grid square S-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid, that was the homeworld of the Nikto species, which was divided into at least three subspecies: the green-skinned Nikto known as Kadas'sa'Nikto, the lavender-ski…

Skaradosh was a desert planet located in the Skaradosh system in the Inner Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Skaradosh served as neutral-ground for a prisoner transfer during Princess Leia Orga…
An Imperial-class Star Destroyer belonged to Commander Dreed of the Imperial Navy.

R4-P17, nicknamed R4, was a brave but cautious feminine R4-P astromech droid that was assigned to Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, prior to and throughout the Clone Wars. She was destroyed by a buzz droid during the Battle of Coruscant.

Dinar was a settlement close to the equator of the planet Lothal. A few years before the Battle of Yavin, a rogue Imperial named Jovan stopped in Dinar to find a discreet way off Lothal and escape his pursuer, Agent Kallus of the Imperial Security Bureau.

Bogden was an astronomical object located in the Bogden system of the Inner Rim on the Hydian Way that was orbited by multiple moons, one of which was the location where the Sith Lord Darth Tyranus secretly hired the bounty hunter Jango Fett to become the cloning template for …

Felucians were a sentient species native to the plains and grasslands of the planet Felucia. At the time of the Clone Wars, many Felucians, including Casiss Midagatis, were peaceful farmers, growing nysillin and other crops.

The Triumphant was a Venator-class Star Destroyer and the flagship of Jedi Master Plo Koon during the Clone Wars. The starship was destroyed in the Battle of Abregado, during which Koon and his fleet encountered the Subjugator-class heavy cruiser Malevolence.
The Negotiator was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in the navy of the Galactic Republic, operating as a part of the Open Circle Fleet.

The Im'g'twe Hills were an elevated region on the planet Geonosis located near the Badlands of N'g'zi. The area was home to the Petranaki Arena, several droid factories and the Separatist command center.

The Badlands of N'g'zi were a region of the planet Geonosis located near the Im'g'twe Hills. During the First Battle of Geonosis, Republic forces routed the Separatist army to the Badlands, leading to the Separatists' retreat.
In 4 BBY, the Mandalorian freedom fighter Sabine Wren went on a mission to free the many enslaved individuals of MaDall, a Zygerrian enslaver.

Roggwarts were large, predatory reptiles with curved horns, long tails, and thick skin from the planet Mustafar, Vendaxa, and Guiteica. During the Clone Wars, General Grievous kept a roggwart named "Gor" as a pet.
Vassek was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim's Wazta sector, within the Vassek system. It had three moons—one of which was Vassek 3.

The Tranquility was a Venator-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Republic naval forces' Open Circle Fleet, where it served as the flagship of Jedi General Luminara Unduli and her fleet group during the Clone Wars.

Duro was a temperate planet in the Duro system of the Core Worlds's Duro sector. The planet was located in grid square M-11 of the Standard Galactic Grid, and was situated along the Corellian Trade Spine.

Clone cadet was a rank in the Grand Army of the Republic. It was assigned to clone troopers who were still training to become soldiers of the Galactic Republic.
Beldons were a large species native to the gas giant Bespin. They lived in the planet's lower atmosphere and could be found in large herds.
Thrantas were a large, flying species native to the planet Alderaan. As a species, they survived the destruction of their homeworld due to the relocation of some thrantas to Bespin.

Air shrimps were a type of creature found on the gas giant Bespin, where they lived in the planet's breathable layer of upper atmosphere amongst the algal trees that grew there. The shrimps had pink skin and black eyes, with a segmented body ending in a barbed tail.

Velkers were a predatory species native to the gas giant Bespin. They traveled in flocks and preyed upon the giant floating beldons that inhabited the planets lower atmosphere, feasting on the creatures buoyant flesh which attracted carrion-eating crab gliders.
Crab gliders were ten-limbed creatures found on the gas giant Bespin that fed on the corpses of giant beldons in upper atmosphere of the world.
Whisper birds were a species of golden-colored bird native to the moon Yavin 4.

Velser's Ring was an asteroid field located in the Bespin system of the Anoat sector in the Outer Rim Territories. The belt separated the gas giant Bespin from its two sister worlds in the star system.

The Mellcrawler was the personal starship of the Sullustan smuggler Nien Nunb that he used throughout the Galactic Civil War.

The Codian Moon orbited the planet Codia I in the Mid Rim Territories. It featured forests, and wood-moss grew there. At some point, herds of the creatures known as reeks were transplanted to the Codian Moon from their homeworld, Ylesia.
Starkiller Base, also known as the Starkiller, was a series of First Order military installations and bases built into and on the ice planet of Ilum in the Unknown Regions.

Organic, living whale-ships made up Doctor Cylo's research base, and therefore his fleet. The whale-ships had four long fins and thick tails that allowed them to maneuver through space. They also had massive teeth.

Aargonar was a planet located in the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, the husband of Confederacy of Independent Systems Senator Mina Bonteri went there to set up a base for the Separatists, but was killed when Republic clone troopers attacked.

Sha Qarot was a planet located in the Sha Qarot system in the Deep Core that orbited a red sun. It had a moon named Fex. Due to its poisonous atmosphere and heavy volcanic activity, Nakari Kelen thought nobody would ever want to set foot on the planet.

A hawk-bat (also spelled hawkbat) was a type of bat which had a beak with sharp contours. The nose of Wilhuff Tarkin, a bony human male, looked like a hawk-bat's beak. The Jedi youngling clan which Dooku belonged to was named after the creature.

Loth-bats were a species of giant bat native to the planet Lothal in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. They were known to travel in packs and had the ability to glide over long distances, as well as roost under the eaves of buildings.

The Stellar Vista was a Mon Calamari star cruiser during the Imperial Era. In the standard year 14 BBY, during the star cruiser's service as a luxury liner, it was pulled out of hyperspace by the orders of Imperial Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, who was seeking to recapture the Carrion …
The Mon Cala eel also known as the Mon Calamari eel, or the electric eel, was a species of predatory eel found in the oceans of Mon Cala. They were reputed for being slippery.

Ord Cestus, also referred to as simply Cestus, was a planet in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Located in the vicinity of the Perlemian Trade Route, it was situated a considerable distance away from common routes between Geonosis and Coruscant.

A jail was located in Gorse City, capital of the planet Gorse. After the industrialist Denetrius Vidian murdered the Besalisk Lal Grallik, her husband Gord Grallik and his cousins attempted to arrest Vidian and the Imperial Captain Rae Sloane and take them to the jail.

The Gray Syndicate was a small criminal organization located on the planet Lothal. The group was headquartered in the outskirts of Capital City, in a disused tavern down a dirty alley that had at one time been Ake's Tavern.

Level 1313 was a level on the metropolitan world of Coruscant, so named because it was located one thousand, three hundred, and thirteen levels from the core of Coruscant, which was accessed by the underworld portal.

The Banshee was a Lancer-class pursuit craft which served as the personal starship of bounty hunter Asajj Ventress during the Clone Wars. The Banshee featured two cabins, a small galley, and a cargo hold, used for holding bounties prisoner.
The veeka was a type of red-plumed bird that was native to the planet Dathomir. The meat of the species was edible by Dathomirians and Kiffar.
Burra fish were a species of fish native to the planet of Dathomir, who's flesh was edible by the Kiffar, Dathomirians, and Latero.
The Academy Screening Office was a department of the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal that was tasked with ascertaining the qualifications of applicants.
Lightning was an astromech droid with a masculine personality that worked in the Zero Angle, a bar in the Galactic Empire's Flight Base for the Bright Jewel Oversector.
Lahn was a planet located in the galaxy. It was covered in beaches, forests, and oceans.
The falumpaset was a herbivorous species of mammal found on the planets Naboo and Onderon. In the wild, the species lived in swamps, forests, and plains in family groups.
Ortolans were a sentient elephantine species of squat, blue-skinned bipeds with large, floppy ears, beady black eyes, and a trunk-like nose that were native to the cold planet Orto.

Separatist holdouts was a term for the various fractured military and political elements of the Confederacy of Independent Systems which continued to remain active after the end of the Clone Wars after the reintegration of former Separatist worlds into the Empire after splitti…

Orto was a cold planet located in the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Ortolan species. Orto was so cold, the natives had to consume large amounts of food in order to develop a warm layer of blubber.

The Rover was a HH-87 Starhopper belonging to the Devaronian Gev Hessan. After his death, the pilot Wedge Antilles used the ship to explore the Outer Rim Territories. Over Akiva, he was confronted by an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire.

Rayboo were antlered mammals native to the barren ice tundra of the planet Hoth. They gave loud, wailing cries and were hunted by wampas, alpha predators that occupied the top of Hoth's food chain but primarily hunted tauntauns.

The Iotrans were a humanoid species from the Iotra system. When Merei Spanjaf and Jix Hekyl tried to smuggle a pulse-mag into a data center on Lothal, they encountered a hulking, bald example of this species with a blaster who warned them that they'd be "two smoking spots" if …

Mataou was a hot desert planet located in the Mataou system, in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories, on the edge of the Ivax Nebula. Long before the Galactic Civil War, Mataou was ruled by Hutts, including the Gnuda Kajidic.
The Chadra-Fan was a sentient species of meter-tall, rodent-like humanoids from the Outer Rim world of Chad. They had large ears, and flat noses with four nostrils.

Yarkora, also known as Yarkorans and Yak Faces, were a sentient species found in the galaxy. Saelt-Marae and Jedi Master Adampo were Yarkorans. Due to most Yarkora eating constantly throughout the day, they had two stomachs, four kidneys, and three livers.

The Kadas'sa'Nikto, or Green Nikto, were one of the subspecies of the Nikto species from the planet Kintan; another was the Kajain'sa'Nikto. They had scaly green, gray, or red skin, black eyes, and symmetrical horns.
The Great Drought was a period of intense drought conditions on Tatooine, a desert world in the Outer Rim Territories, in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin.
TJ-55 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid who led an infantry detachment from the Separatist Droid Army during the Battle of Christophsis of the Clone Wars.

Count Dooku's solar sailer, also known as Count Dooku's Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop, was a Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop owned by Count Dooku after receiving it as a gift from the Geonosians. He used it as a private transport throughout the Clone Wars.
