Thrad was a dry desert planet which was represented by Nadea Tural in the Imperial Senate. In 4 BBY, Tural was rescued by the crew of the Ghost after her shuttle crashed.

EG-86 was an EG-series power droid that served the rebellion as a courier of vital information. Rebel Hera Syndulla dispatched fellow rebels Sabine Wren, Ezra Bridger, and the droid C1-10P to find EG-86 and take it to the Havoc Outpost, but their mission was nearly compromised…
An RX-series pilot droid flew a GX1 short hauler several years before the Battle of Yavin. During a routine trip to the planet Garel, his ship was hijacked by members of the Spectres rebel cell.
The Northern Dune Sea was a region of the Dune Sea, a large expanse of desert on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine.
During the Clone Wars, the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure employed a feminine vendor droid as a translator in his palace on the planet Tatooine.
The school bus was a type of vehicle, similar to a shuttle or a starfighter, used by the Jedi Temple School District to transport Jedi Initiates and Padawans from the Jedi Temple to other locations.

A B1-Series battle droid was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems as Asajj Ventress' bodyguard in her journey to Coruscant. At some point during 22 BBY, Asajj Ventress was sent to Coruscant while the political group Bureaucratosis was giving a speech.

Fortune and Glory was the personal Luxury 3000 space yacht of the pirate Captain Hondo Ohnaka, leader of the Ohnaka Gang. He used the yacht to deliver supplies to a group of rebels on the planet Onderon during the Onderonian Civil War in the Clone Wars.
The Zann Consortium was a crime syndicate that was active during the Galactic Civil War. The consortium was at odds with Black Sun.

Culroon III, also known as Culroon, was a terrestrial astronomical object located the Culroon system of Wild Space, situated in grid square P-20 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was inhabited by Culroonians.

Zaloriis was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Askarian sector's Zaloriis system, which was situated in the Expansion Region and the Slice. It was situated in grid square P-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Zaloriis was inhabited by Zalorians.
Scaparus Port was a spaceport on the planet Arkanis. It was about two klicks from the Arkanis Academy, nestled in a gap between two cliffs.
Internal Affairs was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau which was responsible for rooting out traitors amongst the Empire's ranks.

The Nothoiins were a species of gold-skinned humanoids that hailed from the planet of the same name. Long before the Galactic Civil War, the Nothoiin aristocrats founded the Noble Court that ruled the entire Anoat sector.
Armored eels were a species of carnivorous eel native to the swamps of the moon Yavin 4. They preyed upon brightly colored lizard crabs.

D'Qar was a verdant planet located in the Ileenium system of the Outer Rim Territories. By the thirtieth year after the formation of the New Republic, the planet was the location of the headquarters of the Resistance, a private paramilitary force formed by Senator Leia Organa …

Vashkan apidactyls, also called dacs for short, were a species of giant, winged insects that hailed from the warm planet of Vashka. They were the size of a small humanoid, had an armor-like chitinous exoskeleton, two sets of wings, and venomous stingers.
The moons of Gozgo were a group of at least two moons located in the galaxy. The moons were referenced in a curse used by Cikatro Vizago, Kemlin and Orka.

Hosnian Prime was a planet in the Hosnian system of the Core Worlds, located along the Corellian Trade Spine. By 28 ABY, it served as the capital of the New Republic and the headquarters of the New Republic Senate.

Giju was a planet located in Herglic Space within the Colonies. Due to its placement on the Rimma Trade Route and the Herglic Alley hyperspace routes, it received many visitors and had tapcafes and cantinas to serve them.
Whiforla II was a planet located along the galaxy's Shipwrights' Trace trade route. Whiforla-song was a language spoken by the avian inhabitants of the planet.
Tikaroo was a town located on the planet Devaron. The town was composed of a few small stilt houses, most of which were one or two stories tall. Tikaroo was surrounded by jungle.

Sirpar was a planet found within the Galactic Empire. It was known for its extremely high gravity compared to that of other human-inhabited planets in the Empire, as well as a dazzlingly intense sun that was so bright that non-natives needed to wear polarized goggles in order …
A salt hawk was a type of bird that occurred around the home of Ciena Ree in the valleys of Jelucan, and whose cries were familiar to her. They could be heard from indoors before dark.

Anglers were a bulbous, carnivorous species of organism native to the swamps of the moon Yavin 4. They would sit on the buttress roots of trees and pull lizard crabs from the swamps, which they would then absorb and eat.

Lizard crabs were a species of brightly colored creatures native to the swamps of the moon Yavin 4. They were eaten by armored eels and anglers, the later of which grabbed lizard crabs while perched on buttress roots and then absorbed them.

Leviathan grubs were a subterranean, omnivorous species native to the moon Yavin 4. The grubs would feed on the roots of Massassi trees below ground for three hundred years before emerging as one of the largest predators in the moon's forests.
Lizards were a type of reptile. Some varieties of lizard could be found in the swamps of the planet Dagobah, including sleens, while others dwelt on the planets Dathomir and Hissrich.

Spiny bograts were a species of rat that were native to the swamps of the planet Dagobah. While living in exile on Dagobah, Jedi Grand Master Yoda often found spiny bograts and various other swamp life coming through the door of his hut.
Sapphire ice worms were a species of worm native to the ice planet Hoth. They dug winding burrows, which the wind whistled through at night to create haunting melodies.

Butcherbugs were a species of insect that were native to the swamps of the planet Dagobah. While living in exile on Dagobah, Jedi Grand Master Yoda often found butcherbugs and various other swamp life coming through the door of his hut.

Gwerps were a non-sentient species of lean, frog-like creatures with protruding horns and tusks. Bobbajo, a Nu-Cosian nicknamed the "Crittermonger," used to carry small animals around in cages, including some gwerps.

Lonlans were a non-sentient species of mammal whose body resembled a large, semi-inflated, mud-colored balloon. The Nu-Cosian named Bobbajo, also known as the "Crittermonger," used to carry around one such creature in one of his cages.

Zhhee were a non-sentient species of winged lizards. They sported bright colors and had a noisy, mischievous, and obstreperous behavior. Bobbajo, a Nu-Cosian nickamed the "Crittermonger," owned a mated pair of zhhee.

Reestkii was a town located near the equator of the desert planet Jakku. It was also situated over four hundred kilometers away from the only settlement on the planet worth noting, called Niima Outpost.
Gabdorins were a sentient species of large, round-headed amphibians from Gabdor.
Vinsoth was an astronomical object located in the Vinsoth system, a star system in the Quelii sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Nu-Cosian were a genetically-engineered offshoot of the Cosian species. They were created to colonize the planet Cos Secundu. They were long-necked bipeds with muscular tails they used for balance and self-defense. Bobbajo belonged to the species.

The Shadow Caster was a Lancer-class pursuit craft used by the bounty hunter Ketsu Onyo. About four years before the Battle of Yavin, Ketsu used this starship to travel to the planet Garel during an assignment from the Black Sun crime syndicate to obtain the GNK-series power d…
Thwips were a species of non-sentient mouse-like mammals. They were tiny creatures with four eyes and six legs. They had sensitive hearing.
Snees were a species of sentient avians. Those long-beaked creatures were no bigger than a human's fist, including the span of their blue wings.
Ponemah Terminal, also known simply as Ponemah, was a remote desert planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, near the planets Ogem and Jakku in the Mid Rim.

Frigosians were a sentient species that were native to the planet Tansyl 5. Small for the average humanoid, they had sensitive eyes that meant they had to wear goggles to protect them from the light in certain environments.
Sidon Ithano's pirate crew was a crew of pirates led by Captain Sidon Ithano, a pirate who went by the moniker "Crimson Corsair".
The Lost Clusters was a region of the galaxy in Wild Space. Sidon Ithano, known as the Crimson Corsair, was considered the most dangerous pirate to ever sail the Lost Clusters.
The skirmish of Adratharpe 7 was a conflict that took place on Adratharpe 7. Sidon Ithano, known as the Crimson Corsair, was considered the most feared fighter in the battle.

Docking Bay 327, also known as Hangar Bay 327 or simply as Bay 327 was a docking bay aboard the Death Star. The docking bay was overseen by a control room, along with a tractor beam projector. It served as a cargo loading assembly area.
B1-CC14 was a B1-series battle droid with masculine programming who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
C5-D9 was a purple and green protocol droid with masculine programming that served as cabin boy in the Weequay pirate Scorza's gang around fifty years after the end of the Clone Wars.
The Wheel Races was an event on the planet Jakku that took place north of Ergel's Bar sometime after the Battle of Endor.

Wasp-worms (also spelled as waspworms) were a type of worm that resided in hives on the planet Vrogas Vas, although they were not native to the planet. During a battle on the planet, Han Solo and Doctor Aphra became covered in wasp-worms after shooting a pair of hives.
O-66 was a pilot droid who served on the Scimitar, a Star Courier owned by Darth Sidious.

Hammertown was an area home to a large Ithorian population in Takobo City on the world Takobo. During the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire, two Imperial Inquisitors—the Seventh Sister and the Fifth Brother—captured a Force-sensitive Ithorian there.

Niima Outpost was a junkyard settlement on Jakku, a desert planet in the Western Reaches of the galaxy. The outpost was named for and founded by Niima the Hutt after the Battle of Jakku to capitalize on the new scavenging opportunities the battle created on the planet.

Amethia Prime was a planet located in the galaxy's Inner Rim. It had at least one large ocean which was spotted with volcanoes. During the Age of the Empire, crime lord Big String based his operations on an island fortress there.
Aryx were large bipedal birds native to the Mid Rim planet Cerea. The Cerean rebel Kidi Aleri rode the birds at some point in her life prior to Operation Yellow Moon in 4 ABY.

The Dowutin were a species of large humanoids that were native to the frigid planet Dowut, which was located in the Core Worlds. Dowutins were known for their great size and strength, facial horns, and long lifespans.
The Quantum Storm was a GR-75 medium transport in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Scum-squids were a type of carnivorous squid that could eat humans and were found on the Hutt Space and Outer Rim moon Nar Shaddaa.

Lava eels were a type of eel that lived in the dolovite mines on the volcanic world of Mustafar. For years, lava eels were kept out of the mines by Kongo the Disemboweler before he was taken to fight in Grakkus' arena on Nar Shaddaa.

Xandanks were predatory creatures that lived in the dolovite mines on the volcanic world of Mustafar. For years, Xandanks were kept out of the mines by Kongo the Disemboweler before he was taken to fight in Grakkus Arena on Nar Shaddaa.
Celanon was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Hydian Way which connected it to Junction and Botajef. It was home to the Astarte line.
Anthan 12 was a moon that orbited the planet Anthan Prime in the Anthan system.
Anthan 1 was a moon that orbited the planet Anthan Prime in the Anthan system of the Outer Rim Territories' Albarrio sector.

The Hassks were a sentient species native to Hasskyn. They were almost completely covered in fur, except for their gray-skinned faces. They had sensitive hearing and keen night vision, all the better for hunting.

G21 was a B2-series super battle droid manufactured by Baktoid Combat Automata and used in the Separatist Droid Army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.

The Meson Martinet was a heavily modified CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle captained by Sidon Ithano. At some point after the Battle of Endor, its crew consisted of first mate Quiggold, the Ishi Tib Pendewqell, the Arcona Reeg Brosna, the Twi'lek Reveth and the Gamorrean Squeaky, …
TZ-33 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
A Separatist outpost was a CIS mobile command center on the planet Felucia. It was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.

The Uugteen were pale near-humans who resided on the planet Akiva. They were usually kept to jungles, canyons, and caves, although some lived in an abandoned droid factory in the catacombs beneath the city of Myrra. They lived in groups.

The Mud Jumpers were a group of clone troopers attached to the 224th Clone Division of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, a pan-galactic conflict fought between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Sparrowhawk was an aging Kom'rk-class fighter/transport owned by the retired pirate Delphi Kloda. He let his former student Bazine Netal borrow it for her mission to Vashka if she helped train the slicer Orri Tenro.
Balosar was a ruined planet in the Balosar system of the galaxy's Core Worlds that was the homeworld of the Balosar species.

Skako was a planet in the Skako system in the Core Worlds region of the galaxy which was the homeworld of the sentient Skakoan species. It had a high-pressure methane atmosphere that was unpleasant or deadly to offworlders.

Leyakians were a sentient species found in the galaxy. One notable Leyakian, By Bluss, served as a senator in the Separatist Senate.
Raithal was a planet in the Raithal system in the Colonies along the Perlemian Trade Route that hosted an Imperial Academy several years before the Battle of Yavin.
Karkaris was an aquatic planet in the Nilgaard sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its expansive oceans were home to much of the world's biodiversity, including the native Karkarodon species.
Happabores were a species of massive, gray omnivorous mammal.

Crucival was an Old Tionese colonial backwater planet in the Outer Rim and the homeworld of Hazram Namir. Imperial defector Governor Everi Chalis considered settling there to avoid being found by the Galactic Empire.
Crolutes were a hulking aquatic humanoid sentient species from the planet Crul. Crolutes were exclusively male, while their mates, the Gilliands, were exclusively female.
Adarlon was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Adarlon system, a star system in the Minos Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.
Balamak was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Balamak system in the Taldot sector of the Mid Rim Territories along the Great Kashyyyk Branch hyperspace route.

The Goazon Badlands, also known simply as the Goazon, were a canyon zone on the planet Jakku, characterized by the presence of debris and wreckage of Imperial walkers and other vehicles.

The Starship Graveyard, also known as the Graveyard of Giants or Graveyard of Ships, was a wide desert area on the planet Jakku that took its name because of the wreckage of "giant" ships accumulated on its dunes as a result of the Battle of Jakku.

The Hosnian Cataclysm, also known as the destruction of Hosnian Prime, the destruction of the Hosnian system, the attack on Hosnian Prime, the Hosnian Calamity, the Starkiller Incident, or the Starkiller Base incident, was the destruction of the Hosnian system by the First Ord…

x: Shozers were a sentient species with pale-colored skin and black eyes. The Resistance technician Goss Toowers was a member of the species.

Teedos were a sentient reptilian species native to the planet Jakku, in the Western Reaches. They were diminutive in height and had gray-green skin, most of which was covered in wrappings to protect them from the intense heat of their homeworld.

The Trillia Massacre was an event on Trillia involving dangerous creatures known as dwarf rathtars, a subspecies of the rathtar. During this incident, a number of beings were killed and eaten by the rathtars.
Melitto were a species of insectile humanoids native to the planet Li-Toran. They had no eyes or mouth, but were capable of sensing their environment using super-sensitive cilia.

place: Jedi Temple of Luke Skywalker, Ossus
x: The destruction of the Jedi Temple by Ben Solo occurred on Ossus in 28 ABY during the era of the New Republic.
The Sko'rraq Mountains were a mountain range on Jakku, a desert planet in the Western Reaches of the galaxy.
Black One was a T-70 X-wing starfighter that was used by Resistance pilot Commander Poe Dameron. Dameron was usually accompanied by his trusty co-pilot, the spherical astromech droid BB-8.

HURID-327 was a loadlifter droid who worked as groundskeeper and luggage porter for Pirate Queen Maz Kanata's castle on the planet Takodana. He was jovial and slightly lazy, but kept the area around the castle clear of undergrowth.
4B-EG-6 was a green-colored, emancipated GNK-series power droid with masculine programming that diligently served the Resistance during their conflict with the group known as the First Order.
GA-97 was an unassuming GA-series servant droid who served at the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata on the planet Takodana, but was secretly aligned with the Resistance.
GTAW-74, also known as "Geetaw," was a GTAW welding droid that lived in Niima Outpost on the desert planet Jakku around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

Ahch-To , known by many names in ancient legends, was a planet mostly covered in water, with numerous rocky islands blanketed with green trees located in the Unknown Regions. It was the birthplace of the Jedi Order and held the ancient Jedi texts.
Bloggins were avian creatures that lived on the planet Jakku. Rey noted in her journal that bloggins may be the dumbest creatures in the galaxy.
RP-G0 was an astromech droid in Industrial Automaton's R5 line that served in the Resistance during their conflict with the First Order. The droid was assigned to the Sullustan pilot Nien Nunb.

Botajef was an ecumenopolis planet located in the Belsmuth sector of the Outer Rim Territories, at the confluence of the Salin Corridor and Hydian Way hyperspace routes. It was the homeworld of the Jefi species and the headquarters of Botajef Shipyards.
Etti IV was a planet located in the Etti system that served as the headquarters of the droid manufacturing company Cybot Galactica during the early Imperial Era.

Nar Kanji was an Outer Rim world that was the homeworld of the Jablogian species. Long before the Cold War, it became a Hutt colony world and its human colonists were enslaved and consequently subjected to years of exploitation and suppression.

The Kelvin Ravine was a canyon located on the desert planet Jakku of the Western Reaches. It contained at least one settlement, Tuanul, which was sacked in 34 ABY by the First Order. The desert sands north of the Kelvin Ravine were loose and crashed starships could sink quickly.

Myrra was the capital city on the Outer Rim planet Akiva, with about a million inhabitants. The city was a sprawling, choked mess of strange-angled buildings that emerged from the jungles around them.
Dermos was a planet in the Belsmuth sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A group of insurgents planning a raid on Dermos were apprehended by the Imperial Security Bureau in 3 ABY.
The Abafar Junior Dejarik Club was an organization found in the city of Pons Ora on the planet Abafar. Marketed towards youth, the club focused on the holographic game of Dejarik.

Shu-Torun was a volcanic, resource-rich planet located in the Mid Rim region of the galaxy, in grid square J-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Its infrastructure was powered by the Spike, a massive structure built by the first settlers.

The Great Scourge of Malachor, also known as the Battle of Malachor, was a battle between the Jedi Order and the Sith Empire on the planet Malachor. During the battle, the Jedi attacked the Sith temple, a battle station and superweapon capable of destroying life.

Orondia was a desolate world in the Orondia system in Hutt Space. During the Clone Wars, Obi-Wan Kenobi, disguised as Rako Hardeen, Cad Bane, and Moralo Eval were scammed into stopping there when a Bith gave him only enough fuel to reach Orondia, where his brother ran a fuelin…

objective: Insurance of Imperial ore quotas being met
x: The Sith Lord Darth Vader traveled on a mission to the mining planet Shu-Torun in the Mid Rim in order to ensure that ore quotas for Imperial building projects would be fulfilled.
Artiodacs were a sentient, bipedal species native to the cold, swampy world of Artiod Minor, recognized for their stocky, muscular build. They exhibited slightly hunched postures.
The Blarina were a short sentient species that were native to the planet Rina Major who were notably fond of words and were famously accomplished liars.

The Liberation of Gorma was an event that occurred during the Galactic Civil War. Shara Bey, a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, earned the Bronze Nova for Conspicuous Gallantry for her actions during the Liberation of Gorma.

Operation: Mynock Bite was a military operation carried out by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Lieutenant Shara Bey carried out a raid on an Imperial fuel depot at Beroq 4 as part of the operation, during which she earned her triple ace.
Hosra was an agrarian planet and the fourth planet of the Burnin Konn system in the Anoat sector. It had no mineral wealth or any major fuel sources.
The Eravana was a Baleen-class heavy freighter used for smuggling operations, piloted by Han Solo and Chewbacca.
The Sacred Order of Ramulus, also known as the Sacred Ramulus, was a religious sect of worship amongst the Ithorian species of the planet Ithor.

Fantabu were a species which produced fur and wool. The devotees of the Church of the Force living in Tuanul on the planet Jakku used the hair of fantabu in their clothing, with Lor San Tekka wearing a home-spun fantabu wool coat and Dasha Promenti wearing a vest fringed with …

The Senate Intelligence Committee was a legislative committee within the New Republic Senate. In the decades after the Galactic Civil War, it investigated reports regarding the First Order and concluded that it was an ill-equipped, poorly organized, and barely-funded remnant m…

Culisetto were a sentient species of small, tube-mouthed insectoids that fed off of blood and also wore traditional brown traveling smocks. The Dengue sisters were members of this species as well as the bounty hunter Vorhdeilo.

result: The Corporate Sector Authority dealings are exposed
objective: Steal the Hevurion Grace and capture Senator Erudo Ro-Kiintor
x: Operation: Sabre Strike, also known as Resistance Mission 456-VH, was an operation undertaken during the Cold War by Commander Poe Dameron and a crew from the Resistance that took sometime after the Battle of Endor.
Candovant was a planet in the Candovant system of the Colonies region of the galaxy, situated along the Hydian Way and home to the Candovantan species.

Uyter was a planet known mostly for its agriculture and farming of crops and foodstuffs. It was located in the Uyter system in the Lantillian sector of the Mid Rim Territories, at the intersection of the Randon Run and another hyperlane.

Ubardia was a world in the Ubardia system in the Colonies, located along the Hydian Way. Thirty years after the Battle of Endor, Ubardia was a member world in the New Republic, where it was represented by Gadde Neshurrion in the Galactic Senate.
Fexian skullborers were the apex predators of the purple moon of Fex in the Sha Qarot system of the Deep Core, inhabiting the trees of the mostly unexplored moon.
Oculus was a Carrack-class light cruiser used by the New Republic during the Rebellion on Akiva. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, the Oculus sought refuge in remnants of the comet Kinro.

The Dhen-Moh genocides were ordered by the Galactic Empire on the astronomical object Dhen-Moh. The Sith Lord Darth Vader killed many there with his lightsaber, an act that was marked on his reputation afterward.
Sabodor's was a purveyor of exotic pets. It was located on Etti IV.

The Echo of Hope was a refitted Mon Calamari MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser in service to the Resistance during their conflict with the First Order. After leaving the New Republic to join the Resistance, Rapier Squadron was redeployed aboard the Echo of Hope.
Asyrphus was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Perkell sector's Asyrphus system in the Mid Rim Territories, situated at the coordinates Q-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Blacktar Cyst was a Mid Rim Territories terrestrial astronomical object where both the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, also known as Twilight Company, and the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing were deployed sometime by 3 ABY.

The Sinking Fields were an area of the Goazon Badlands on Jakku. They were located north of Niima Outpost and Rey's AT-AT home. They were the site of a crash landing by Poe Dameron and FN-2187 in a Special Forces TIE fighter after escaping the First Order's flagship Finalizer.

The Council of Neutral Systems was a political organization in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic that consisted of over 1,500 star systems that wished to remain neutral during the Clone Wars, the conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independ…
The Imperial Agricultural Collective was an Imperial government department that operated on the planet Lothal.

Phorsa Gedd was a Mid Rim Territories planet that had factory-deserts. The Imperial soldier Vryant served in the planet's trenches for two years, and the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry also fought on Phorsa Gedd as a part of the Alliance's campaign into the Mid Rim, whi…

Nightwatcher worms, also known as Arconan night terrors and sandborers, were a little-documented species of nocturnal sand-boring worms native to the planet Jakku. Mature specimens topped twenty meters in length, although some were reputed to be much larger.
Delphidians were a group of related humanoid sentient species from the Delphidian Cluster, a stellar nursery on the fringes of Wild Space in the Mid Rim.
The ash angels were a species of scavenging birds that lived on the planet of Sullust. They were featherless, covered in thin strips of tissue.

x: During the Cold War, an unauthorized skirmish was initiated in OR-Kappa-2722 when New Republic pilot Poe Dameron was on an unsanctioned mission to find the captured freighter Yissira Zyde.

A moof was a creature of the galaxy that had hoofed feet and a thick hide. They secreted milk, and moof milk could be used to make yogurt. There were individuals who milked moofs, which inspired the term "moof-milker," an insult to a person's intelligence.

Pinyumb was a capital city on the volcanic planet of Sullust in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was located in a massive cavern under the south side of the volcanic mountain Inyusu Tor. During the Galactic Civil War, Pinyumb was under the control of the Galactic Empire.

The Thunderstrike was a CR90 corvette utilised by the 61st Mobile Infantry of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The vessel was commanded by Captain Micha Evon, more commonly known as Howl, until his death at the Battle of Hoth.
Gilvaanen was a backwater planet located in the Gilvaanen system in the Inner Rim Territories. Prior to the Galactic Civil War, Gilvaanen housed production facilities for Imperial stormtrooper armor.

Ripper-raptors, also known as ripper raptors, were a little-documented species of flying reptiles native to the planet Jakku. With their leathery wings and keen eyesight, they rode the thermals in the Kelvin Ravine or on Carbon Ridge, looking for carrion.

The Carbon Ridge was a ridge located on the desert planet Jakku. It held a secret research facility owned by the Galactic Empire. During the Battle of Jakku, the New Republic took notice of this facility and attempted to attack it.
Feressee's Point was a rock formation in the Starship Graveyard on the desert planet Jakku. Starship wrecks and corpses dating back to the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY could be found near the formation.
Namenthe's Crater was a crater in the Starship Graveyard area of Goazon Badlands on the desert planet Jakku.
The Pilgrim's Road was the name given by residents of Niima Outpost to an old happabore trail that ran through the Goazon Badlands region of the desert planet Jakku.
The Congress of Malastare, also called the Malastare Congress, was a planetary legislative body on the planet Malastare.
Ogem was a world located in the D'Aelgoth sector of the Mid Rim Territories within the Western Reaches.

habitat: Sand dunes and rock outcrops near wreckage
x: Steelpeckers were a non-sentient species of nocturnal carrion bird that could be found on the planets Jakku and Ferrix. The birds were ragged and mangy in appearance, with scraggly black feathers.

Sacred Villages were areas located on the desert planet Jakku. One of them, Tuanul, was populated by members of the Church of the Force, who eschewed modern technology and instead created their own in order to bring themselves more in touch with nature.

The Moraband execution chamber was a massive execution chamber in the largest Sith temple in the Valley of the Dark Lords, a corridor of ancient monuments that served as crypts for the Dark Lords of the Sith located on the planet Moraband.
Ankhural was a planet in the system of the same name in Hutt Space. It had one city which was protected by a ray shield to hold off giant clouds of dust from the silicon fields.
Splledarks were creatures that could be found on Endor, a forested moon orbiting the planet of the same name. The native Ewoks hunted splledarks for their meat and commonly ate them spit-roasted.

result: Depa Billaba goes into a coma
x: The Battle of Haruun Kal was a battle that took place on the planet Haruun Kal in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars. Jedi General Depa Billaba led her battalion of Republic clone troopers against enemy forces from the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A bombing at the Jedi Temple took place a few months prior to the end of the Clone Wars. The bombing was conducted by the Separatist Captain Rackham Sear. However, the Jedi foiled the bombing and Sear perished.
A skirmish between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems took place on the planet Kardoa during the Clone Wars.

x: The liberation of Kashyyyk was a battle of the Galactic Civil War between the Imperial territory G5-623, a breakaway faction of the Galactic Empire and the forces of the New Republic. The battle resulted in the liberation of the Wookiees and their homeworld of Kashyyyk.
Nantoon was a world in the Colonies region of the galaxy where the pirate Queen Maz Kanata hid a portion of the spoils of her reign in a buried vault protected by an antitamper sub-space alarm.
Jhas was one of two gas giants located in the Hoth system of the Outer Rim Territories. Jhas would shrink as a result of pressure on its surface, causing gravitational energy to convert to heat.

Jhas Krill was the eleventh moon of the gas giant of Jhas, located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. At the tail end of the Galactic Civil War, its sole inhabitants were the Nightsister Shelish and her Wookiee subordinate Owacchi.

Pressy's Tumble was an artificial asteroid field in the Pressylla system. It was once a moon rich with ore, but because the ore was too deep to easily mine, the moon was destroyed by an explosives engineer.

Blowback Town was a settlement on the desert planet Jakku. Around thirty years after the Battle of Endor, the Blarina merchant Ohn Gos operated in the town, and when the Blarina scavenger Naka Iit found the Resistance pilot Poe Dameron lost in the deserts he agreed to take the…

Pressy's Tumble refinery complex was a mining facility located on the artificial asteroid field of Pressy's Tumble in the Pressylla system. The miners answered to the First Order and staged a strike to protest the harsh working conditions there.
Zhanox was a mining planet located in the Anoat sector of the galaxy. Ugnaught miners were known to work there, although they feared the presence of spiny nexus.

The Gungan Minister Rish Loo maintained a secret lab in an ancient temple on Naboo. During the Clone Wars, Separatist leader and Sith Lord, Count Dooku used this as his command center during his brief alliance with Rish Loo.
Gnaw-jaws, also known as gnaw jaws, were a species of non-sentient, six-legged, carnivorous insects that lived on the desert planet Jakku.

Keshians were a sentient species nearly identical to humans from the planet Keshi. The only visible distinction between the two were the Keshians' eyes, which were large and oddly colored, allowing them to detect a broad spectrum ranging from ultraviolet to infrared.
The Crackle was a portion of the Starship Graveyard on the planet Jakku. Despite the X'us'R'iia, Jakku's storms, reshaping the terrain, the Crackle was one of the few constants on the planet.

The Yissira Zyde was an NK-Witell-class freighter that operated as a free trader during the New Republic Era. The starship was valuable to the First Order, so they entered the Mirrin sector of New Republic space and hijacked the vessel.

Absanz was a desert planet that hosted a factory belonging to Sienar Fleet Systems. The Spectres traveled to Absanz to retrieve intelligence on Sienar's newest TIE prototypes. They attempted to capture lead designer Dron Ryall, but were forced to let him go in order to escape.

x: Kallidah was a world that was located in the Kallidah system in the Subterrel sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Kallidahin species and home to the Archaeological Research Council.
The Archaeological Research Council was a committee of archaeologists based on Kallidah, the homeworld of the Kallidahin species.
The Serendipity, formerly known as the Miss Fortune, was a 1550-LEX yacht owned by Delia Leighton. The yacht featured a cantina inside its cargo hold and operated on planets such as Cyrkon and Jakku.

objective: Investigate the distress call originating from Carnelion IV

The Bear Clan, also known as the Mighty Bear Clan, was a class of Jedi younglings that began their training in the ways of the Force under the tutelage of Grand Master Yoda.

Takobo was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was home to a number of emigrated species, including Ithorians. The peaceful world boasted colorful architecture with a mix of modern and classical designs.

Chandel was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, specifically at Standard Galactic Grid square N-6. It lay within the Chandel system of the Ojoster sector, which was also a part of the New Territories. Chandel had water covering its surface and appeared blue from space.

A battle was fought between the Jedi Order and the ancient Sith on the planet Takodana thousands of years before the Galactic Civil War. The castle that was later owned by Maz Kanata was built over the land where the battle was fought.
Kelvin Ridge was a location on the planet Jakku.

Suraz 4 was a celestial object in Mirrin sector that was the site of the Suraz engagement between the First Order and the New Republic's Rapier Squadron led by Poe Dameron. It was part of a star system that also contained Suraz 5.

Suraz 5 was a celestial object in the Mirrin sector that was near the site of the Suraz engagement between the First Order and the New Republic Rapier Squadron led by Poe Dameron. It was part of a star system that also contained Suraz 4.
Carnelion IV, also known simply as Carnelion, was an icy planet located in the Carnelion system in Wild Space.

x: During the Galactic Civil War, in the fourth year before the Battle of Yavin, a skirmish was fought in Garel City Spaceport on the planet Garel between members of the rebellion and stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire.
Faust were an alien species of tall humanoids with pale blue skin, a double set of eyelids, and light-colored eyes. Their homeworld was the planet Adana.

Maxilan's explosive bloatworm was a type of parasitic worm native to Lanteeb in the Outer Rim. They could infest the domesticated happabore species, which was found on planets throughout the Western Reaches.
Lanteeb was an astronomical object located in the Lanteeb system of the Outer Rim Territories' Bri'ahl sector in grid square I-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

A gargoyle was a supernatural creature with a long wingspan, dark skin, and large fangs. On Mortis, the Force wielder known as the Son took on the form of a gargoyle that represented the embodiment of the dark side of the Force.

A griffin was a supernatural creature with a long wingspan, green eyes, and colored feathers. On Mortis, the Force wielder known as the Daughter took on the form of a griffin that represented the embodiment of the light side of the Force.
The Fallen Teeth was a mountain ridge located near the equator of the desert planet Jakku. Niima Outpost was constructed not far from the ridge, in a temperate zone of the planet.
Bladderworms were a type of parasitic worm that could infest the bladder of happabores, a domesticated species found on planets across the Western Reaches.
Crop microserps were a type of parasitic worm that could infest the domesticated happabore species, which was found on planets across the Western Reaches.
Multilegged throat croakers were a type of multi-limbed parasitic worm that could infest members of happabores species, domesticated creatures found on planets across the Western Reaches.

Brain crawlers were a type of parasitic worm whose homeworld was Cheelit in the Mid Rim. They could infest the brains of members of the domesticated happabore species, which could be found on planets throughout the Western Reaches.

The flesh-eating daggerworm was a type of parasitic, non-sentient worm that originated at the Outer Rim world Trenwyth and lived in the internal organs of happabores, quadrupedal creatures that could be found on many planets in the Western Reaches.
Cranial nodular worms were a type of parasitic worm that could infest the craniums of the domesticated creatures known as happabores, which could be found on planets across the Western Reaches.
Cheelit was an astronomical object in the Cheelit system of the Mid Rim Territories' Semagi sector in grid square I-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Trenwyth was a world located in the Trenwyth system of the Outer Rim Territories' Stensen sector in square I-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Spit-crawlers were a type of parasitic worm that dwelt within the snouts of happabores. They existed as both greater and lesser nasal nesting spit-crawlers.

The intestinal fangworm was a type of parasitic, non-sentient worm that formed colonies in the intestines of happabores, quadrupedal creatures that could be found on many planets in the Western Reaches.
Shaketown was a locality on the planet Gorse. Rae Sloane once had a conversation with Lal Grallik and Shaketown's mayor, during her and Denetrius Vidian's inspection visit to the world of Gorse.

Drakka's Diner was an eatery in a dangerous region of Shaketown on the planet Gorse. The Besalisk Drakka worked as a chef. The location was frequented by Kanan Jarrus as well as other local residents.

An EV-series medical droid with feminine programing operated as an interrogation droid in the Citadel, a prison located on the planet Lola Sayu that was controlled by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Nakadia was an agricultural planet in the Expansion Region located just off of the Rimma Trade Route. The homeworld of the Nakadian species, it was occupied for some time by the Separatist Alliance.

Naator was a planet in the Mid Rim Territories with icy mountains. The world contributed to the Galactic Empire's war effort during the Galactic Civil War. The Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry targeted Naator as part of its campaign, defeating the Empire's assets there.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: During the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry fought a battle against the Empire in the mountains of the Mid Rim planet Naator in 3 ABY.

Nyonpur was a colony world of the Rodian species in the Mid Rim Territories. Located in the Nyonpur system in the Daimar sector, the world was represented in the Imperial Senate, the legislative body of the Galactic Empire, until Emperor Palpatine disbanded it shortly before t…
Envoy was a protocol droid in operation during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Naalol was a strategically insignificant mountainous planet in the Naalol system in the Spirva sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It had a series of mountainous towns with small crooked mountainous houses.
The Strus clan was a group of thieves that operated on the desert planet Jakku at the time of the Cold War.
Tofallids were a humanoid species with elongated necks. The anatomy of the protocol droid PZ-4CO was designed by the droid manufacturer Serv-O-Droid, Inc. to resemble that of Tofallids.

The Abregado debris field orbited Anza, the star of the Abregado system. It was formed from the wreckage of a Republic fleet that was destroyed by the Separatist Subjugator-class heavy cruiser Malevolence in the Abregado system during the Battle of Abregado, an early battle of…

In 6 BBY, a group of insurgents planted detonators on several seismic surveyor droids in the planet Lothal's Westhills. Beck Ollet, a local youth, and his friends Zare Leonis and Merei Spanjaf were visiting his former homestead when they discovered the insurgents.
In 6 BBY, Imperial forces on Lothal under the command of Lieutenant Piers Roddance massacred a gathering of peaceful demonstrators in the Westhills near Capital City.

Rey's 690 light freighter was a freighter that crashed on Jakku sometime before the Battle of Starkiller Base. It was found by the scavenger Rey, who planned to repair it and sell it to Niima Outpost junk boss, Unkar Plutt.

x: In 6 BBY, the Lothalite youth Beck Ollet and two other insurgents were involved in a brief skirmish with an Imperial Troop Transport in Lothal's Westhills.

Imperial Mobile Surgical Units, or IMSUs, were the prefabricated medical centers utilized by the Imperial Army. They were the latest incarnation of Republic Mobile Surgical Units used during the Clone Wars.

x: In 3 BBY, the Spectres undertook a mission on Lothal to raid an Imperial depot on the planet Lothal in an attempt to hijack three Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvettes.
Galaan was a greenish gas giant in the Corva sector located in the Outer Rim Territories that wasn't able to become a star. It was surrounded by many moons, including one known as Yellow Moon.

The Vanquish was the personal Imperial-class Star Destroyer of Grand Moff Valco Pandion. He brought it to Akiva for the meeting of the Imperial Future Council, and when the New Republic found the fleet in space above the system, fought in the Rebellion on Akiva.
Onodones were a sentient elephantine species distinguished by the trunk-like mouths, some long enough to be draped over and behind their shoulders and down their torsos.

The Golden Harp was a yacht belonging to the enslaver Arsin Crassus, who was one of the main moneylenders to the Empire and was therefore wealthy. The yacht itself was very opulent and large, made with bronze, carmine and gold among other things.

The Conquest was a Secutor-class Star Destroyer in service of the Galactic Empire in 14 BBY. It was in use by Vice Admiral Dodd Rancit as a command ship while partaking in the blockade of the Carrion Spike above Carida. The Conquest was 2,200 meters in length.

Crickbeets were a type of nocturnal critter known for their constant chirping, which would suddenly stop if they sensed danger. One type of crickbeet was the Lothalian crickbeet. It could be found in Capital City on the Outer Rim planet Lothal.
C4-ST was a protocol droid who operated as a merchant in the Outer Rim's Anoat sector during its blockade by the Galactic Empire in the aftermath of the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

The Celadon Sea was a poisonous mist that covered the icy mountain ranges on the planet Carnelion IV. Grecker, a member of the Closed, blamed the Open for destroying their world and creating the Celadon Sea.

In 5 BBY, a data breach occurred at the Transportation Ministry's headquarters on the planet Lothal's Capital City. This data breach was perpetrated by Merei Spanjaf, a slicer who was the girlfriend of Zare Leonis, an Imperial cadet and secret rebel sympathizer.

A blurrg (plural: blurrg or blurrgs) was a non-sentient, two-legged reptilian beast of burden found throughout the galaxy. Blurrgs were notably used by the Twi'lek Resistance and Free Ryloth Movement during the Clone Wars and the Imperial Era.

Boomer was an R5 astromech droid belonging to Sevox, a human on the planet Andelm IV. During a mission underwent by the human girl Zarro and the Wookiee Chewbacca, the two placed a thermal detonator inside the droid and named it "Boomer," intending to detonate it aboard a Lamb…

The barghests were a species of non-sentient quadrupeds that could be kept as pets for protection. They had dark fur and skin, a large mouth filled with sharp teeth, and six red eyes. Although they looked monstrous, carnivorous barghests showed great loyalty toward their owners.

The Narquois were a short-sized species that hailed from the planet of Narq. Their skin, their eyes, and the filaments that grew from their heads were all blue, as a means of camouflage in the fungus forests of their homeworld.
Narq, also known as Narqui, was a Colonies world located on the Quellor Run hyperspace route. Its surface featured fungus forests, in which the sentient Narquois species originated.
A village existed on the planet of Vyndal during the Imperial Era.

Kardoa was a rocky planet located in the Atrivis sector with the Outer Rim Territories. Three weeks after the bombing at the Jedi Temple, Jedi Master Depa Billaba and Padawan Caleb Dume went to Kardoa to confirm or deny a Separatist presence.

x: The Ahia-Ko were an ancient species and civilization which lived on the planet Akiva. Constructing great temples in the planet's jungle wilderness, they believed that water from the planet's special canyons was so pure, it could take one's sins away and leave them a better per…

Kalevala was a planet located in the Mandalore system, within the Mandalore sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of House Kryze, the prominent Mandalorian political family who ruled as Dukes and Duchesses of Kalevala.
The Third Battle of Mygeeto, also known simply as the Battle of Mygeeto, erupted on the planet Mygeeto during the final months of the Clone Wars.

House Vizsla was one of the ruling houses, or political factions, that made up Mandalorian society. It was headed by Clan Vizsla. Two of the clans that allied with House Vizsla were Clan Wren and Clan Saxon.

House Kryze was a house, or political faction, active in Mandalorian society, prominent throughout the Clone Wars and the New Republic Era. At some point before the Clone Wars, the house served as the royal family of the Mandalorians. The house was based on Kalevala.

The third moon of Concord Dawn was an astronomical body in the Concord Dawn system, and a moon of the shattered world of Concord Dawn. The Mandalorian Protectors, a group of Mandalorian warriors sworn to protect the system, established a base on the third moon.
During the Galactic Civil War, the rebels of Phoenix Cell were engaged by the Protectors of Concord Dawn in a dogfight over Concord Dawn.

t: Mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn
place: Protectors Camp, third moon of Concord Dawn
result: Fenn Rau is captured, leading to a tepid alliance with Phoenix Cell
objective: Secure an alliance with the Mandalorian Protectors and/or destroy thei
x: During the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire, the rebels Kanan Jarrus and Sabine Wren went on a mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn.
The Mandalorians—known in Mando'a as the Mando'ade ("Children of Mandalore")—were a clan-based culture composed of members from multiple species and bound by a common creed, language, and code.

Hangar 718 was a hangar at Starkiller Base, the First Order's superweapon built into the planet Ilum. In 34 ABY, sensors at the hangar were triggered during the scavenger Rey's attempted escape from the base.

The Kwazel Maw was a large aquatic predator that was native to the swamps of the planet Rodia. During the Clone Wars, the Gungan Jar Jar Binks encountered one of these creatures while on a mission to Rodia, which he befriended and named "Bogey." Bogey helped Binks secure the T…

The Jixuan desert was located in the southern hemisphere of the planet Ryloth. In 21 BBY, during the Galactic Republic's efforts to liberate the planet from the Confederacy of Independent Systems' control in the Clone Wars, the Republic forces of Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi ha…

Tee-muss were a domesticated species native to the planet Onderon and exported across the galaxy to planets such as Florrum, where they were used as battle mounts, or Felucia, where they were used by nysillin farmers.

The Pikaati were a bipedal sentient species whose heads had two large, bulbous cranial lobes and breathed hydrogen cyanide, a gas that was poisonous to humans. They created Pikaati armor, a rare black armor that was able to withstand blaster fire, which was confiscated from them.

Klonoid was a planet located in the Phelleem sector within the Outer Rim Territories. At some point during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire, it housed a rebel cell whose members opposed the Galactic Empire.
The rebel cell of the planet Klonoid was a group of resistance fighters that opposed the Galactic Empire in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin.
STALKER-1 was a masculine-programmed mining droid that served as a sentry for a chromium mine on Burnin Konn.

Igniter was an ancient, masculine-programmed mining droid who served the Hutts on Mataou. He was modified with an experimental Imperial combat design, causing him to be an effective fighter with slight insanity.

The Vulture's Claw was a GS-100 salvage ship owned by the Trandoshan scavenger Gha Nachkt. Following the Battle of Bothawui, Nachkt scavenged Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker's astromech droid, R2-D2, from the debris and stored him aboard the Vulture's Claw.

Mushroom Mesa was a cluster of mesas located near the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine. At the time of the Invasion of Naboo, Mushroom Mesa was part of the Boonta Eve Classic podracing circuit, forcing racers such as Anakin Skywalker to maneuver around the obstacles.

Jag Crag Gorge was a gorge located near the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine. At the time of the Invasion of Naboo, Jag Crag Gorge was part of the Boonta Eve Classic podracing circuit, and pilots such as Anakin Skywalker raced through it.
RN-18 was an Imperial mining droid who was stolen by the pirate Fortombro and reprogrammed with numerous combat protocols.
Hosnian was a planet located in the Hosnian system, in the Core region of the galaxy. The system, including Hosnian, was destroyed by the First Order in 34 ABY.
The Quarren Isolation League was an organization with its own soldiers that believed the Quarren should not be ruled by the Mon Calamari monarchy.
The Bespin Wing Guard was the formal law enforcement agency of Cloud City, a mining colony floating in the atmosphere of the planet Bespin.

Kirdo III, also referred to simply as Kirdo, was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, that was the homeworld of the Kitonak species On the way back from Rodia, Luke Skywalker forged a new hyperspace lane between Kirdo and Orto Plutonia.

Ison was a planet in the Ison system and found on the Ison Trade Corridor. Ison was near pirate-controlled territory, and at the time of the Iron Blockade, it hosted a debris field which inflicted critical damage to a passenger transport attempting to navigate it.
The jungle rancor, also known as the hunter rancor, was a subspecies of the reptilian, semi-sentient rancor species native to the planet Felucia.
The Oba Diah moon was a desert moon that orbited the planet Oba Diah. Prior to the Invasion of Naboo, the Pyke Syndicate shot down Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas's shuttle over the moon.
The Coronet was a New Mandalorian luxury liner, transport ship, and diplomatic vessel used by Duchess Satine Kryze and her New Mandalorian government by the time of the Clone Wars.

Level 2685 was a level on Coruscant, in the planet's seedy undercity. Three years after his election to the post of Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic, Sheev Palpatine brought Anakin Skywalker, then a Padawan to Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Club Kasakar, an establis…

The Kouhun was a secret criminal cult that operated in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was named after the venomous creature of the same name. Within its ranks were assassins, blackmailers, kidnappers and political manipulators.
The Data Seekers were an underground group whose members sought to unravel the mysteries of the Anoat sector's ancient history.
The shore police was a branch of the New Republic Defense Fleet. They wore military uniforms and had holstered sidearms.

Coral City, also known as Mon Cala city, was the capital city of the planet Mon Cala, that was built over a coral reef and ruled by the Mon Calamari monarch. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of the Battle of Mon Cala.

result: Three Lasat survivors, with the help of the crew of the Ghost, redisco
objective: Find Lira San, the original homeworld of the Lasat
x: In 3 BBY during the Imperial Era, a group of Lasat who survived the destruction of Lasan rediscovered Lira San, the ancient Lasat homeworld.

The East City Brawlers were a grav-ball team from the planet Lothal. The team had an intimidating reputation, as it sported two burly fullbacks and the team's coach was known for his unpredictable strategies.

The Necropolis was an ancient Hutt burial site located on the planet Mataou. The Kouhun, a secretive order of assassins, used the abandoned Necropolis as a theater for their nocturnal initiation rites.

Unkar's thugs were a group of henchmen who worked for Unkar Plutt at Niima Outpost on Jakku. They wore hoods over their humanoid heads and ambushed scavengers that conducted an unauthorized barter or questioned Unkar's authority.

M2-D8 was an astromech droid originally built to operate in collapsed mining tunnels. However, the droid eventually fell into the hands of a clever but malicious mechanic who re-equipped it for combat.

The Halo was an SS-54 assault ship owned by the Zabrak bounty hunter Sugi during the Clone Wars. Over the course of the Galactic Civil War, this ship came into the possession of Sugi's niece, Jas Emari.

Akk dogs were a type of dog native to Anoat, a planet in the Anoat sector. They were quadrupedal, with red, scaly skin, four horns, a pair of blue eyes, and rows of pointed teeth. At the time of the Iron Blockade, akk dogs freely roamed the streets of Anoat.

The Steel Talon was a Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. It was commanded by Admiral Conan Antonio Motti, Chief of the Imperial Navy and a member of the Imperial Joint Chiefs, prior to his death during the Battle of Yavin.
The Starscorch Robbers were a group of criminals that operated in the Anoat sector, where they once had an association the Trade Spine League.

The Zanbar Death Watch camp was constructed by the Mandalorian splinter group Death Watch on the moon Zanbar after they made it their temporary base of operations following their abandonment of the planet Carlac.
The Carlac Death Watch camp was erected by the Mandalorian splinter group Death Watch on the planet Carlac.
Pollillus was a planet in the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Troig species. The Troig podrace announcer Fodesinbeed Annodue hailed from Pollillus.
The Chamber of Judgment was a room housed in the Reassignment Council Tower of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant where the Jedi High Council passed judgment on Jedi accused of wrongdoing.

The transformation chamber was a room in the Jedi Temple where a Jedi could be disguised as another individual through the use of a facial transformation program. Obi-Wan Kenobi used this room to pose as his supposed assassin, Rako Hardeen.

Aargau was a planet in the galaxy's Core Worlds, in grid square L-10 on the Standard Galactic Grid, that was headquarters of the Bank of Aargau. Colossal seventh-stage bank-courier repulsor-trucks were used on Aargau. It was considered one of the financial centers of the galaxy.
Ando Prime was an ice-covered planet located in the Ando system in the Lambda sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was the site of the Ando Prime Centrum podracing course.

Eladro City was the biggest settlement on Basteel. It was subterranean and constructed out of tunnels that had been carved over the centuries. The entrance to the city was located in a narrow canyon on the surface of Basteel.
The Elders were a reptilian humanoid species that inhabited ancient Naboo. Little was known about them other than their history of conflict with the Gungans and the monuments they left behind.
Ertegas was an agriworld located in the Anoat sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It had at least one moon, where the Galactic Empire exploited a crystal mine.

Purrgil were a semi-sentient species of massive whales that lived in deep space, traveling from star system to star system. Regular purrgil were only the size of a small starship, while another type of purrgil, known as Purrgil Ultra, was significantly larger.

Bilbousa, or Bilbousa City, was the capital city and foremost spaceport on the swamp world of Nal Hutta. The city was a sprawling mess consisting of squat and uninspiring buildings covered in arching roots that spread out from looming bulbous pods.

Bilbousa Bazaar was the primary marketplace in the city of Bilbousa on the Hutt world of Nal Hutta. During the Clone Wars, both Cad Bane and an undercover Obi-Wan Kenobi acquired goods from a pawnshop inside of the Bazaar.

Almak was the homeworld of the sentient Leffingite species and Almakian apples. It was located in the Almak system within the Almak sector of the Mid Rim Territories and the Western Reaches. It was situated in grid square J-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Leffingites were a horned sentient species native to the Mid Rim astronomical object Almak. By 22 BBY, the Leffingite speeder thief Magaloof worked on the planet Coruscant and nearly collided with the Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi while joyriding.

Nabat was a city inhabited by Twi'leks on their home planet Ryloth. Around 21 BBY, during the Battle of Ryloth, the Confederacy of Independent Systems' droid army seized control of the city and took its inhabitants hostage.

Platform 327 was a landing platform in Cloud City on Bespin. The Millennium Falcon parked there after the Battle of Hoth when its crew, the friends of Luke Skywalker, were fleeing Darth Vader's pursuit and sought refuge with Lando Calrissian.
Polmanar was a planet located in the Anoat sector of the galaxy. At the time of the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade of the sector, Polmanar was a base of the Trade Spine League.

121-247 was a security droid who resided on Anoat at the time of the Iron Blockade. During this time, Tam Bastion of the Alliance to Restore the Republic sent a young smuggler to disable the droid, and the smuggler succeeded in doing so.
Coronet City, also known as Corellia City, or as the Golden City, or the Unbroken Clan Territory, was the capital city located on the prestigious Core World planet Corellia.

Level 1325 was one of the lower levels of the Coruscant underworld, located in Sector I-9. During the Clone Wars, the clone trooper CT-5555 met with Jedi General Anakin Skywalker on Level 1325 after discovering that Supreme Chancellor Palpatine was involved in a plot to destro…

The Thief's Eye was a yacht owned by King Katuunko of Toydaria. It was commandeered by the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker during Savage Opress's kidnapping–and accidental killing–of the king.
TJ-912 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid with feminine programming who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

FLO, also known as WA-7, or Wanda, was the nickname of a WA-7 waitress droid working at Dex's Diner on Coruscant. She once served Obi-Wan Kenobi when he came to the diner asking for help from Dexter Jettster.

The Raider was a GS-100 salvage ship captained by the Twi'lek scavenger Ratch. In the aftermath of the Battle of Sullust during the Clone Wars, it recovered Asajj Ventress's Ginivex-class fanblade starfighter and her unconscious inside it.
The canyon krayt dragon was the smaller and more common species of krayt dragon, a predatory reptile from Tatooine. As its name suggested, it dwelled in rock caves and canyons.
The greater krayt dragon was a large species of krayt dragon, predatory reptiles from Tatooine. Using its ten strong legs, it literally swam through the shifting sands.

The Lake Country was the most isolated area of the planet Naboo. Its population consisted of farmers, shaak herders, and glass craftworkers. A popular vacation spot, visitors traveled to see its waterfalls and open grasslands filled with wildflowers.

The Colicoids were a species of sentient, insectoid native to the planet Colla IV. Known for their completely emotionless and murderous ways, they created the design of the three-legged droidekas in their own image.

The Xi Charrians, also known simply as the Charrians, were the sentient insectoid. They were behind the Haor Chall Engineering Corporation company, which notably designed the Sheathipede-class transport shuttle, the Sheathipede-class Type B shuttle, and the Vulture-class starf…

Tansyl 5, also known simply as Tansyl, was a planet that was the homeworld of the Frigosian species. Due to its atmosphere being different from that of Takodana, the Frigosians Thromba and Laparo wore breathing apparatuses around where a humanoid nose would be during their tim…

The Apprentice Legislature, also known as the Junior Senate or junior legislative program, was an organization for politically-minded youth that was founded under the Galactic Republic and continued under the Galactic Empire.

The Raydonian settlement was a human colony on the Outer Rim world of Raydonia. The inhabitants of the settlement, including one woman, were slaughtered by Maul and Savage Opress to gather the attention of Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, who had left Maul for dead during the Battl…
The corner of twelfth and G was an alley in Level 1312 of Coruscant. Asajj Ventress moved to an apartment there when she was working as a bounty hunter.
Otua Blank's stronghold was the residence of Quarzite's Belugan ruler Otua Blank. Built into a crystal cavern, the stronghold had outer walls but also a large opening for a subtram to dock.

Level 1312 was a level in Coruscant's underworld. Lohim Nara was from Level 1312. Asajj Ventress stayed at the corner of twelfth and G when she lived on the planet. Ahsoka Tano briefly went into hiding from the Galactic Republic on this level.
Mijos was a planet located in the Anoat sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was covered in swamps inhabited by savage beasts.

Advanced Recon Force troopers, also referred to as ARF troopers or as AT-RT Drivers, were clone troopers who wore lighter armor for stealth and speed and often rode All Terrain Reconnaissance Transports into battle, wielding RPC-2 Rocket Launchers and DC-15A blaster rifles.

The Krish were a sentient species. While searching for information concerning Imperial attempts to sure up the Empire's relations with criminals following the Battle of Endor, the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca were ambushed by a trio of Krish marauder-ships in the Mid Rim.

Gualama were a species of herbivorous animal found on the grasslands of the planet Naboo. To describe someone as "Gualama-loving" was considered an insult, and during a family meal at their home on Saleucami the Imperial-loyal Webb Taffral used the term to against his brother …

The West Cap City Carvers were a grav-ball team based on the planet Lothal. Approximately six years before the Battle of Yavin, this team played the AppSci SaberCats in their first match of the season.

The Green Dragons were a grav-ball team based on the planet Lothal. Approximately six years before the Battle of Yavin, this team played the AppSci SaberCats, who had already won their first three matches of the season.
A planetoid was the site of a Mining Guild asteroid gas refinery during the age of the Galactic Empire.

Foerost was a Core Worlds astronomical object where the Battle of Foerost, an engagement that the Republic officer and later Imperial Tabor Seitaron participated in, took place in the vicinity. A travel service ran between the celestial body and the planet Coruscant in 5 BBY.

RZ-4 was a snake-like Hutt Guard Droid with a male programming. Built by Shizu the Hutt long before the Galactic Civil War, RZ-4 eventually outlived his master.

x: TB-73 was a Pelta-class Medical Frigate of the Galactic Republic that was deployed following the Second Battle of Geonosis during the Clone Wars. It was sent to a medical station at Ord Cestus to pick up supplies intended for Jedi General Mace Windu's forces on Dantooine.
Kinpany Gap was an area near the equator of Lothal. Once the Galactic Empire arrived on the planet, they began heavy mining in this area and established a settlement for the workers.

The Thrashers were a grav-ball team based on Lothal. The team sported two long-armed wing-strikers, but had a center striker who threw erratically and fullbacks who tended to turn the wrong way and miss tackles.
Patitite Pattuna was a planet in the Patitite Pattuna system in the Bright Jewel sector of Mid Rim, not far from Balnab, that was the homeworld of the tiny Patitite species.
Andui was a city on the Mid Rim planet of Takodana. Using a speeder bike, it took a solid day to get there from the castle of Maz Kanata.
The Righteous was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in the navy of the Galactic Republic. In 22 BBY, during the Clone Wars, The Righteous was destroyed by Separatist Alliance Admiral Trench.

The Swift Return was a Consular-class cruiser that served in the Republic Navy's Open Circle Fleet. It was destroyed by Admiral Trench prior to the Battle of Christophsis. At one point prior to its destruction, the Swift Return fired its weapons while in an asteroid field.
This forest was located in the equatorial regions of the Outer Rim world of Ryloth. It was inhabited by lyleks and gutkurrs, two of Ryloth's most dangerous predators.

This shuttle was owned by the Sith Lord Darth Vader in 14 BBY. When the Imperial Star Destroyer Perilous fell under attack and was crippled by the Free Ryloth Movement, Darth Vader, with his master, Darth Sidious, used this shuttle to escape.
TB-2 was a 2-1B surgical droid in service of the Galactic Republic, stationed as a medic aboard the freighter Twilight during the Clone Wars.

Jan-gwa city was a Gungan city on Naboo located by a waterfall. Cad Bane went there to kidnap the Force-sensitive infant Roo-Roo Page for Darth Sidious, but was apprehended by Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano, who had foreseen his arrival and alerted the family.
The South Capital City Volunteers were a grav-ball team based on Capital City on the planet Lothal. The team was known for trying to befuddle its opponents with trick plays.

J0-N0 was an 8D-series smelter droid who worked for Cad Bane during the Clone Wars. He attempted to acquire the plans for the Republic Senate Building from C-3PO, Senator Padmé Amidala's protocol droid.
R8-B7 was a R-series astromech droid, used as a co-pilot by Jedi Master Mace Windu. He shared his coloration with Windu's lightsaber.
Jedi shuttle 634 was an Eta-class shuttle used by Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano during their mission to Wild Space that led to the discovery of Mortis.

Neskroff was a city on the planet Gutretee. During the Iron Blockade, the Rebel Alliance believed some vaults within Neskroff should remain sealed, fearing that the native population might attack. As a result, the Rebels sent the Smuggler to warn against opening the vaults.

Miriatin was a world on which an entire Imperial patrol mutinied during the Galactic Civil War. It was located in the Miriatin system in the Var Hagen sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square M-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Forked River Mavericks were a grav-ball team based on Lothal. In the grav-ball season held approximately six years before the Battle of Yavin, they were generally a poor-performing team.
Deyer was a planet in the Anoat system in the Anoat sector of the galaxy. For years, Deyer was ruled by the Galactic Empire, which established prisons and outposts on the world.

Mirrin Prime was a planet in the Mirrin sector. Following the Battle of Yavin, Mirrin Prime, along with D'Qar, was scouted by Caluan Ematt and the Rebel Alliance's Shrikes and was eventually built up.
The Hevurion Grace was a Pinnacle-class luxury ship that belonged to New Republic senior Senator Erudo Ro-Kiintor, a Centrist delegate for Hevurion.

Hevurion was an member world of the New Republic about thirty years after the Battle of Endor. Located in the Hevurion system in the Inner Rim Territories, it was situated along the Hydian Way southwest of Bogden.
Adratharpe 7 was an astronomical object in the Adratharpe system in the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square H-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Sea of Sand was a region of the desert planet Ponemah Terminal's southern hemisphere. Although the entire world was inhospitable, the area in the region of the Southern Pole was particularly hazardous.

The Umbaran capital city was the capital city of Umbara, the homeworld of the Umbarans. During the Clone Wars, capturing the city was the main objective for the Grand Army of the Republic at the Battle of Umbara.
An unidentified planet covered in electrical storms was located in the Monsua Nebula. The smuggler Han Solo occasionally used a hiding place located on the planet.

The Kothal Roughnecks were a grav-ball team based in the city of Kothal on Lothal. Approximately six years before the Battle of Yavin, the team put a strong performance in its league and was a candidate to be league champion.

Frogs were croaking amphibians that could be found on various planets including Sorgan, Ossus, Rodia, and Tinnel IV. Klatooine paddy frogs were a type of frogs. The gwerps were similar to frogs in some respects.
The Watchtower was a troop transport shuttle used by the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Gorse Space Traffic Control was a organization of the Inner Rim planet Gorse. It enforced traffic laws inside the space lanes of the planet.

Truncheon was a Lambda-class shuttle in the complement of the Imperial Star Destroyer Ultimatum, under the temporary command of Imperial captain Rae Sloane in 11 BBY. It was used by Count Denetrius Vidian during his inspection tour of the planet Gorse.
Northern Mustafarians were one of the two species of Mustafarian.

Southern Mustafarians were one of the two subspecies of Mustafarians which evolved separately in underground caves. They worked together to collect valuable minerals from the lava flow and had a trade agreement with the Techno Union.
A T-series tactical droid was active during the Clone Wars, it was present on the surface of the planet Anaxes during the Battle of Anaxes.

Bahryn was one of fifteen moons that orbited the Outer Rim planet Geonosis. In stark contrast to Geonosis' arid climate, Bahryn was a frigid world, reaching temperatures that only those who were adapted to the intense cold, such as the moon's native bonzami, were capable of su…
Bonzami were large, four-legged beasts that could be found on Bahryn, one of Geonosis' moons. They had large, axe-shaped jaws, and were resistant to blaster bolts.
CR-8R, also referred to as "Crater," was a prim, masculine-programmed droid who belonged to the Graf family.

Somewhere in the galaxy lived a species, known for their red skin. A number of them were painted on patina-darkened vases owned by Temmin Wexley in his junk shop on the planet Akiva. This race of people were often seen to have been dressed in dark robes.
