result: The rebels are driven off the construction module
objective: Determine what the Galactic Empire was building in orbit of Geonosis
x: In 3 BBY, the crew of the Ghost was ambushed by the Galactic Empire in an Imperial construction module that orbited Geonosis.
Valkyrie 2929 was the callsign of a Nu-class attack/transport shuttle used to bring Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano and Rex to meet the rebels on Onderon during the Clone Wars.

Kraken was an ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid of masculine programming who held the rank of commander in the military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
The Whisper Bird was a Mu-class shuttle that belonged to the Graf family during the early Imperial Era.
Level 5000 was a level on Coruscant that was home to the planet's central power distribution grid.

The Moyn were a sentient species of brown furred humanoids that inhabited the galaxy during the Clone Wars and the reign of the Galactic Empire. They had two protruding eyes with horizontally closing eyelids, and several small tentacle-like appendages that surrounded their mouth.

A council controlled the law enforcement on the planet Andelm IV. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, the gangster Jaum paid the council to turn a blind eye to his mining operations in the Andelm beetle caverns, w…
The Gorsian dragonfly was a flying insect native to Gorse, a planet located in the galaxy's Inner Rim. Its multicolored wings were similar to those of the Thunian wart-hornet.

The Eriadu veermok was a subspecies of veermok that could be found on Eriadu, a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. While the regular veermok was a solitary and arboreal creature, the Eriadu subspecies was social and adapted to the dry conditions of plateaus.

Thunian wart-hornets were a species of insect native to and quite commonly encountered on Thune, a planet situated in Wild Space. Wart-hornets had bloated, slimy bodies reminiscent of toads, and they had two pairs of multicolored wings akin to Gorsian dragonflies.

Clip beetles were a non-sentient species of purple-shelled beetle. They were edible by certain species, including Kowakian monkey-lizards and Sullustans. According to the Sullustan Dil Pexton, who found them delicious, dried clip beetles tasted like colo claw fish.
Sludge salamanders were a species native to an uncharted swamp planet in Wild Space which the Graf family temporarily named Graf-World.
Horned billipedes were a species native to an uncharted swamp planet in Wild Space which the Graf family temporarily named Graf-World.

Skim-snakes were a species of rainbow-colored snake native to an uncharted swamp planet in Wild Space nicknamed Graf-World by the Graf family of cartographers. They lived in the heavy tree canopy above the world's swamps.
Razor-boars were a species native to an uncharted swamp planet in Wild Space which was nicknamed Graf-World by the Graf family of cartographers.
A blobfish was a type of fish found in the galaxy. Unkar Plutt, a Crolute on Jakku, was blobfish-like, earning him the nickname "Blobfish."

The Yellow Moon was one of the many moons of Galaan. It was called that because its shiny, sandy surface reflected the yellow light of the gas giant. It was the inspiration for the naming of Operation Yellow Moon.

The Anaxes shipyards were shipyards vital to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars located on the planet Anaxes. The Confederacy of Independent Systems sought to claim these shipyards during the Battle of Anaxes.
A Poletec village was located near the city of Purkoll on the planet Skako Minor during the Clone Wars. Those living in the village were led by a Poletec chief.
The assembly complex was a Galactic Republic shipyard on Anaxes seized by the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars, becoming their most fortified position during the Battle of Anaxes.
The Invulnerable was a Providence-class Dreadnought, that served within the naval branch of the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars.

result: The Jedi escape from the Inquisitors
x: In 3 BBY, while scouting for a potential location in which the rebellion could build a base, the Jedi Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger fought a lightsaber duel with the Inquisitors known as the Seventh Sister and the Fifth Brother on the planet Oosalon.
Oosalon was a barren, mountainous planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

M9-G8 was an astromech droid belonging to Resistance X-wing pilot Yolo Ziff. He was stationed at the Resistance base on the planet D'Qar. He co-piloted with Ziff in his T-70 X-wing starfighter as part of Blue Squadron during the Battle of Starkiller Base.
A Knighting Ceremony was a Jedi ceremony in which a Padawan, who, by the right of the Jedi High Council and will of the Force, was granted the rank of Jedi Knight.

objective: Steal the Son-tuul Pride's fortune
x: The Son-tuul Pride robbery, also known as the Son-tuul Pride heist, was carried out shortly after the Battle of Yavin when Imperial forces, under the command of Grand General Cassio Tagge, began a crackdown on Outer Rim criminal interests who had gone unchecked in the past.

Terrelian Jango Jumpers were tall, slender humanoids who were known for their acrobatic abilities. The criminal Cassilyda "Cassie" Cryar was a Terrelian Jango Jumper, as were the Eighth Brother, a member of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius, and Lika, who was held captive by…
Wolves were quadrupedal, canine creatures with long bushy tails, short tapered ears, and a pointed muzzle containing sharp teeth.

The Jedi Temple dojo was a room where members of the Jedi Order trained and practiced in lightsaber combat. Located in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, Jedi younglings and Padawans alike honed their skills in the dojo.

A ringed planet was located in the Regani sector, and was orbited by Osisis Station, along with many asteroids. Fool's Run, a private race course owned by the Besalisk Galus Vez, was located in the rings of the planet.

The Lower-Sea Province was a region on the spice-producing planet of Kerev Doi. While flying his TIE fighter over the Lower-Sea Province, the TIE fighter pilot Thane Kyrell witnessed several emaciated Bodach'i slaves being led by stormtroopers.

R5-G4 was an astromech droid belonging to Norra Wexley, a pilot of the Rebel Alliance and later the New Republic. R5-G4 was with Norra at the Battle of Endor in her Y-wing during the Alliance's attack against the second Death Star, but was destroyed by enemy fire.

Farsigo Bay was a salty bay of calm waters located south of Myrra, the capital city of the Outer Rim planet Akiva. During the Imperial Era, Akiva's residents—including the Wexley family—visited the bay on vacations to go fishing, gather korlappii shells, and ride in boats.

Captivator was a bounty hunter assassin droid tasked with tracking down Han Solo and Chewbacca. Captivator was hired by Jabba the Hutt to hunt down Solo. He worked with a human, a Gran, and a Kubaz bounty hunter. Later he joined with Alecia Beck and the Imperials to find Solo.
Galidraan was a planet located in the Galidraan system within the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It shared its name with Galidraan III and Galidraan IV, all of which were located in the same system.

Anantapar was a planet located in the Anantapar system in the Yarith sector, which was located in grid square K-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid and in the Greater Javin region of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated along the Corellian Trade Spine super-hyperroute.
Orn Kios was a planet in the Yarith sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, near the Anoat sector.

The Ore-duke Baron Rubix controlled a delving citadel on the planet Shu-Torun. During the War on Shu-Torun, in which Rubix and the other ore-barons rebelled against the Imperial-backed Queen Trios, Rubix sent his vessel the Lava Leviathan to kill Trios in the ancestral retreat…
The Lava Leviathan was a vessel owned by the family of the Ore-duke Baron Rubix on the planet Shu-Torun.

Yoda's quarters, also known as Yoda's living space, were the private living quarters that Yoda, the last Grand Master of the Jedi Order, maintained at the main Jedi Temple on Coruscant. The Grand Master would retreat there to rest and meditate on the will of the Force.

Anakin Skywalker's quarters were the private quarters of the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker. They were located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. While most Jedi quarters were usually simple and sparsely furnished, Skywalker's room was abundantly decorated with old Podracing posters.

Bamayar was a Mid Rim planet home to the Ducal Palace and Chenodra port. Between around 3 BBY and 1 BBY, the Imperial cargo pilot Bodhi Rook met and fell in love with a woman on Bamayar, who rejected him.

The Battle of Maraken took place in the vicinity of the Maraken system during the early stages of the Galactic Empire's reign. The Imperial officer Visler Aqorian Korda III lost his lower jaw to a combat droid during the battle, but was able to destroy the droid in turn.

Xirl was a jungle planet located in the Xirl system in Wild Space, near the Kalidorn system. The Stinker was a creature that was native to Xirl. The female human Gozetta built a hunting lodge on Xirl.
Clone SCUBA troopers, also known as clone dive troopers, were clone troopers from the Grand Army of the Republic who were outfitted for combat in aquatic environments.
Kinor bats were a species of bat found on "Graf-World," a planet in Wild Space discovered by the cartographers Auric and Rhyssa Graf. Kinor bats had purple skin and lived in flocks inside caves.

The Sullustan ash-rabbit was a species of ash-rabbit found on the planet Sullust. While on "Graf-World," a Wild Space planet, Milo Graf encountered an ash-rabbit, which he likened to a Sullustan ash-rabbit.

Ash-rabbits were a species of rabbit found throughout the galaxy. One type of ash-rabbit was the Sullustan ash-rabbit, which was native to Sullust. They were small and herbivorous, eating food such as marsh-fruit.
Rabbits were a type of species in the galaxy. One type was the ash-rabbit, which could be found on Graf-World and Sullust.

"Graf-World" was the nickname of an uncharted swamp planet located in the galaxy's Wild Space region. It was discovered by Auric and Rhyssa Graf, who were arrested by Captain Visler Aqorian Korda III of the Imperial Navy, who claimed it for the Galactic Empire.
Fleas were a type of insect found throughout the galaxy. They were known to bite, and their name could be used as an insult. A type of flea was a lava flea.

Morellia was an astronomical object located in the Morellian Commonwealth within Wild Space. Prior to the Galactic Civil War, Auric Graf gave an emerald pendant to his wife, Rhyssa, while on Morellia.
Kalaan was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Kalaan system in the Churnis sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

Imperial Harbor Control, also referred to as Harbor Control, was an organization in the Galactic Empire responsible for directing planetary traffic over the planet Thune, as well as verifying ID transponders of starships and establishing blockades if necessary.

The starbird, also known as a phoenix, was a legendary avian creature that was thought to be immortal. Allegedly, when it seemed to be dead, the starbird was actually renewing itself in the heart of a nova.

Ukio was a bountiful agrarian planet located in the Abrion sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, connected by hyperlane to Rishi and Molavar. Ukio also enjoyed a trade route with another argiworld, Noomis Riga. Its native inhabitants were the Ukians.

This tribunal was held at the Arkanis Academy against Zare Leonis for crimes against the Galactic Empire while training as one of its cadets. At the tribunal, Leonis was charged with numerous offenses against the Galactic Empire and plead guilty to them all.

"Copper" was the nickname of a protocol droid owned by the Galactic Empire. As an experiment, Imperial technicians equipped the droid with deflector shield generators to provide defense for ground troops.

affiliation: Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military
x: In the Galactic Empire, the naval chiefs were the highest ranking officers of the various branches of the Imperial Navy. At a higher level, some of them were part of the Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military, along with chiefs of the Imperial Army.

Hudalla was a large red and violet gas giant found in the Hudalla system. Its planetary rings were some of the largest in the entire galaxy. Sifo-Dyas referenced Hudalla's size when joking about the ego of fellow Jedi Initiate Dooku.

Thune was a planet located in the Thune system in the Wazta sector of the Outer Rim Territories, situated in grid square I-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid along the Koda Spur. From space, it looked like a brown and blue orb.
A toad was a creature whose body was similar to that of a Thunian wart-hornet minus the wings. Luke Skywalker used the terms "toad" and "frog" interchangeably.

This hiding place was a cave claimed by the smuggler Han Solo, which was located on an unnamed planet in the Monsua Nebula. After crash landing on the planet, Solo and his partner Chewbacca found the cave and used it to store various items such as Corellian wine.
Not long after the pivotal Battle of Yavin, members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic escaped naval forces of the Galactic Empire during a dogfight in the Monsua Nebula.
AP-5, nicknamed AP, was a masculine RA-7 protocol droid who served as an analyst droid on a Galactic Republic attack cruiser during the Clone Wars.

Atollon was a remote planet in the Lothal sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was known to the ancient peoples of the sector and was depicted in their artwork. The only known inhabitant was the Bendu, a mysterious Force wielder.

Bavva was a planet in the Bavva system in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories, along a hyperspace route. Over several months during the Iron Blockade of the sector by the Galactic Empire, a merchant on Bavva was robbed several times.

result: Atollon is discovered by Phoenix Squadron
x: An attack on the rebel cell Phoenix Cell fleet was launched by Admiral Kassius Konstantine. The fleet was waiting for fuel to be delivered by the crew of the Ghost before it could jump into hyperspace in route to the Yost system, where the rebels intended to set up a base.
The Centrists, also known as the centrist faction, were one of the two major political factions in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic.
The Populists, also known as the populist faction, were one of the two major political factions in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic.
Imperial Cargo Transport 241 was a cargo ship of the Galactic Empire helmed by a mustachioed captain. At some point during 3 BBY, the transport docked at the Horizon Base.

The Witch's Finger was a unique-looking cliff located on the jungle world of Akiva, located within the larger Canyon of Akar. It was named by the ancient Ahia-Ko people after the way it looked like a bent and accusing digit.
Obumubo was a cold moon in the Core Worlds and the Interior regions that was covered in a sea of liquid metal. It contributed to the Galactic Empire's war effort during the Galactic Civil War.
Xagobah was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Xamster Neva Kee. During the Galactic Civil War it produced war resources for the Galactic Empire.
Berzite was a planet in Wild Space's Yost system that, in 3 BBY, was blockaded by the Galactic Empire in anticipation of rebel activity.

A moon was the natural satellite of the planet Berzite in the Yost system of the galaxy. It was a habitable moon with a breathable atmosphere and was planned to be used to house the rebellion's base, before the moon was blockaded by the Galactic Empire.
Grancha was an ancient Hutt Guard Droid that roamed an abandoned Hutt settlement on the planet of Mataou.
Honorbound was a Throneship in the service of the Noble Court. While it flew under the captaincy of the Nothoiin officer Regmus, Honorbound was lost to the Galactic Empire.
Mardona III, also known simply as Mardona, was a planet in an intersecting portion of the Inner Rim Territories and the Interior regions.
Vir Aphshire was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Tharin sector which had honey fields, orchards, and clay hives.

Thurhanna Minor was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Thurhanna Minor system of the Tynquay sector within the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. It fell within grid square R-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Hunters were an elite group of Nightsisters that were hand-picked by Mother Talzin and who wielded energy bows with plasma-generated strings and arrows. During the Clone Wars, the Hunters tracked down and killed enemies of the Nightsisters on the orders of Mother Talzin.

Palace Plaza was a wide, exclusively pedestrian avenue located in Theed, the capital city of Naboo's human inhabitants. It was the city's main thoroughfare, and stretched from the Theed Royal Palace to the Palace Courtyard.
The Palace Courtyard was a large enclosure located in Theed, the capital city of Naboo's human inhabitants.

Lira San was a remote planet located in the Lira San system of the galaxy's Wild Space region. Hidden behind a treacherous nebula formed from an imploded star cluster, it was the original homeworld of the Lasat species.
Dasoor was a planet located in the Dasoor system in the Agarix sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was known as a world overrun by thieves, and gangs of enslavers.

Kara-bin was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Kara-bin system in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The human smuggler Han Solo and his Wookiee co-pilot Chewbacca visited this location, playing a role in the liberation of the Wookiees.
Hinari was planet located in the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories' Thesme sector, within the Hinari system. It was situated in grid square O-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Phoenix Nest, also known as Phoenix Home and originally known as the Liberator, was an Imperial light carrier used by the Galactic Empire as a mobile base of operations to periodically launch bombers on the planet Ryloth.

Tsevuka was a planet in the Outer Rim of the galaxy, and the homeworld of the Tsevukan species. At some point the planet came under the control of the Galactic Empire, causing an uproar among the planet's natives.
Tanis was an astronomical object in the Tanis system in the Atravis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square L-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Gorma was a world that at some point during the Galactic Civil War was liberated by the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was located in the Gorma system in the Majoor sector of the Expansion Region.
Klatooine was a desert planet located within the Klatooine system in Hutt Space that was the homeworld of the Klatooinian species.

Oulanne was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories with a single megacontinent. 18 months after the Battle of Yavin, a massive earthquake hit the planet, leaving the citizens in despair after the Galactic Empire refused to send aid to the economically unimportant planet.
Corpse-leeches were a species of non-sentient carnivores native to Carnelion IV. They were distinguished by their six eyes, red skin, and wings.

The Crypt was a black site prison maintained by the Galactic Empire on the outer reaches of the Anoat system. A high-security interrogation center, the Crypt comprised two dozen compounds spread over a lifeless moon of the planet Pujool.

The Eclipse, also known by the alias Tirion, was a YT-209 freighter used by a small band of smugglers in 13 BBY. The ship was used in a smuggling run to provide medicine for Twi'lek elders on the planet Ryloth.

result: Her Majesty and Loathe taken prisoners
x: Several months into the blockade of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire, the Uprising plotted to kidnap Commander Bragh, leader of the Purge Troopers and right-hand-man of the Imperial Governor Ubrik Adelhard.

A barren, lifeless moon was one of the six natural satellites that orbited the planet of Pujool. The Galactic Empire, an authoritarian government founded at the end of the Clone Wars, established a secret high-security prison known as the Crypt on the surface of that moon.

Krykna were predatory, non-sentient, spider-like creatures native to Atollon. They were resistant to blaster bolts and highly sensitive to negative emotions, making them extremely difficult to tame with the Force. They were repelled by the signal emitted by sensor beacons.
The Red Key Raiders were a criminal syndicate that emerged following the Battle of Endor. Its members included Adwin Charu, Lorgan Movellan, and Bivvam Gorge.

The Atollon Coral Mesa was a land formation situated on the planet of Atollon. A broad, flat-topped elevation, it was covered in huge coralline formations. Many creatures, including krykna and dokma, lived in the area.

Seeker droids, also known as seeker remotes, were generally small spy droids that carried out scouting or spying missions for its owner. Models of seekers included the ID9 "parrot" droid, the ID10 seeker droid, the Prowler 1000 seeker droid, and the DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid.
Bilzen was a planet in the Bilzen system of Wild Space that featured mountains and at least one frozen cavern, which contained giant icicles.

The Rings of Alios were a system of planetary rings where Eneb Ray, an agent of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, once performed a mission. They were located in the Alios system in the Rachuk sector of the Colonies.

The Eliminator was a Star Destroyer in service to the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 ABY, around one week after the Battle of Yavin, in which the Galactic Empire's Death Star battle station was destroyed, the Eliminator was one of around a dozen Star Destroy…

The Civilian Defense Force, also known as the Yavin system's Defense Force, was a civil defense force tasked with protecting the Yavin system. After the Battle of Endor, Lieutenant Shara Bey retired from the Alliance to Restore the Republic and settled with her family on Yavin 4.
Octuptarras were eight-eyed, gasbag-headed vine walkers native to the planet Skako that were the namesakes of the octuptarra tri-droid, a model of droid walker manufactured by the Techno Union.

Sarrish was a planet located in the Sarrish system in the Vensensor sector of the Expansion Region where the Battle of Sarrish took place during the Clone Wars. The Galactic Republic lost the battle and suffered tremendous casualties, and it was considered a devastating loss.

result: Sith holocron retrieved and Sith temple destroyed
Maul escapes and his plans are foiled
objective: Understand knowledge to defeat the Sith
x: The Mission to Malachor was the last decisive event undertaken during the Great Jedi Purge, occurring during a mission by Jedi Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger as well as Ahsoka Tano, and the astromech droid Chopper to the planet Malachor to seek knowledge that would help them de…
Cygnats were small biting pests native to the planet Thisspias in the Expansion Region. They could be deterred by dense hair, such as the beard of Thisspiasian Jedi Master Oppo Rancisis.

Whiphids, or simply a Whiph, were a sentient species of large, furry bipeds that had two large ivory tusks protruding from their lower jaws native to the frozen planet Toola. J'Quille and Valarian were both Whiphids.
IG-101 was one of the two IG-100 MagnaGuards, the other being IG-102, that served as General Grievous's droid bodyguards aboard the Invisible Hand during the Battle of Coruscant.

Tosste was an astronomical object located in the Tosste system in the Atravis sector. In describing early Imperial history in his Strategy and Tactics class at the officer's academy on the planet Arkanis, Colonel Julyan taught his students that it was on Tosste that Admiral Te…

Metalorn was a Mid Rim Territories planet that became a famed industrial world by the time of the High Republic Era. It was inhabited by immigrated Skakoans, such as Wat Tambor, the future foreman of the Techno Union merchant guild.

objective: Rescue Janard from Imperial custody
x: In 4 BBY, members of Phoenix Cell undertook a mission to rescue Janard, an old contact of the rebel Mandalorian Sabine Wren, who was being held prisoner by the Galactic Empire.

Quila was an aquatic planet located in the Rolion sector of the Outer Rim Territories that appeared blue from space. In 4 BBY, an Imperial freighter carrying Janard, a prisoner of the Empire and informant to the rebel Sabine Wren, crashed into Quila's oceans.
R6-H5, nicknamed Ar-Six, was the astromech droid of Jedi Master Kit Fisto. R6 accompanied his master on many missions during the Clone Wars aboard his Jedi starfighter.
Chaaktil was a desert planet located in the Chaaktil system in the Inner Rim, in grid square N-14 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It had many cities, such as Chaako City.
K2-B4 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the time of the Clone Wars.

The yellow-bellied sand lizard was a small non-sentient reptilian species originating from an unknown homeworld, though their name and behavior suggest they adapted to desert climates. An adult yellow-bellied sand lizard could be trained to perform several complex tasks.
Suntilla was a location in the Suntilla system within the Colonies. It was the homeworld of Vober Dand, a male Tarsunt.
The Chandrilans were a cultural group of humans who called the planet of Chandrila home. They were regarded as peaceful but slightly haughty, pedantic, and interested in politics.

The Ascent was an Imperial Star Destroyer which, along with the Vigilance and the Vanquish, was present at the planet Akiva for the battle there. It brought one of the Empire's greatest tacticians, General Jylia Shale, to the emergency summit on Akiva.

result: Black Squadron obtains a clue on Lor San Tekka's whereabouts
Black Squadron learns that there is a spy in their ranks
objective: Locate Lor San Tekka and ask him for help locating Luke Skywalker
x: During the Cold War, the mission to Ovanis was undertaken by Commander Poe Dameron and Black Squadron of the Resistance when they traveled to the planet Ovanis to find Lor San Tekka to ask for his help in locating Jedi Master Luke Skywalker.

A battle took place between Phoenix Cell and the Galactic Empire between 4 BBY and 3 BBY. The Phoenix Squadron was able to retreat relatively unscathed but lost Phoenix Three to a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter.
In the months following the Battle of Endor, New Republic and Galactic Empire forces fought a battle on the planet Naalol.
Moths were small species of insect no bigger than a human hand. They were notoriously good fliers, able to fly in all directions. They came in many colors, such as brown and white.

The Moth was a MK-4 freighter owned by Owerto Naiucho, used for smuggling illegal goods. After the Battle of Endor, he used it to travel to the planet Akiva. Following the death of Owerto, the New Republic starfighter pilot Norra Wexley took ownership of the Moth.

Zenn-La was a location in the Zenn-La system within the Venzeiia sector of the Expansion Region and the Slice. It was situated in grid sqaure O-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of Jlibbous, a chef who was renowned for greatness by 146 BBY.
Ovanis was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories on which the followers of a religion known as the Crèche dwelled.
In 4 BBY, several dissidents on the planet Garel staged an impromptu protest against the local Imperial authorities' destruction of a controversial statue by the artist Janyor of Bith.

The Fortress was a cave on the planet Jelucan, named such by Ciena Ree and Thane Kyrell. The two friends spent years furnishing it with fur rugs and blankets from Ciena's family, and luxurious castoffs from Thane's.

The Sapphire Rogue was a starship that responded to the hyper-transceiver beacon that Leia Organa and her team placed on Sesid during Operation Yellow Moon. It was the size of a a small freighter but accelerated like an attack ship.
The Daisy Mae was a unique customized Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor owned by Admiral Gial Ackbar.
Ubdurians were a species of sentient humanoids native to Nag Ubdur and Ubduria. Their bald heads featured dark eyes seated deep in their sockets, but no visible nose.

PZ-99, nicknamed "Peezee-Ninety-Nine," was a security droid that appeared to have originally have been a PZ protocol droid. He served at the Battle of Jakku and later the Resistance during its struggle against the First Order.
0-MR1, more often referred to as Omri, was an RA-7 protocol droid who served the First Order during the Cold War.

Crul was a planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim that was covered in warm, shallow, and salty seas and lagoons. It was the homeworld of two sentient species: the Crolutes, who were exclusively male, and the Gilliands, who were exclusively female.

The Gilliands were one of the two sentient species that lived on the oceanic planet of Crul. They were exclusively female, while the other species, the Crolutes, were exclusively male. Z'Vk'Thkrkza was a Gilliand who ran a tavern on the Colossus, located on the planet Castilon.
2MED2, spelled Toomedtoo, was a medical droid who served the Resistance during the Cold War.
CO-34, also called "See-Oh Three Four," was a CLL-M2 binary loadlifter who served the Resistance during its conflict against the First Order
VL-44, also called "Vee-El Forty-Four," was a security droid who appeared to have originally been a PK-series worker droid. He served the Resistance during the Cold War.

affiliation: Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research
headquarters: Imperial Center of Military Research, Scarif
x: The Tarkin Initiative, also knows as the Grand Moff Tarkin Initiative or the Tarkin Institute, was a secret think tank within the Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research, an agency that belonged to Imperial Intelligence and the Imperial Security Bureau.

This Tarkin Initiative base was where the BT-1 assassin droid was created. Sometime before the secret mission to Geonosis, the BT-1 prototype, revealed to be homicidal, killed everyone in the base and then set it to self-destruct, as the assassin droid jettisoned into space.

Shuttle S257 was a Sentinel-class landing craft of the Galactic Empire's naval forces. Sometime in 4 BBY, the shuttle was stolen by the rebels of Phoenix Cell, where it was used by Kanan Jarrus and Rex in their mission to an experimental Interdictor-class heavy cruiser in orde…

Oosalon Mesa was a mesa located on the planet Oosalon, a barren world in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. In 3 BBY, it was the site of a duel in which Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger fought against the Fifth Brother and Seventh Sister.

Askajians were a sentient humanoid species that were native to the planet Askaji. On their homeworld, they lived in tribes led by a chief. Jedi Master Klefan Opus and Yarna d'al' Gargan, who was forced to dance for Jabba the Hutt as one of his slaves, were both Askajians.

B33 was an astromech droid that was owned by the Kubaz banker Rikard Lovas. Fitted with a restraining bolt, B33 was a member of Lovas' droid posse and was used in the Kubaz's attempt to fake the robbery of his own starship.

The molsume was a large, multilegged predator native to the jungles of Ithor. It had twin poisonous fangs and a jewel-like, iridescent pelt warning potential predators that its flesh was also toxic. Once it scented food, the molsume could attack with high speed.
Riosa was a planet located in the Inner Rim region of the galaxy.

affiliation: Committee for transportation of construction materials
x: The Elder Houses, also known as the Great Houses, were the collected hereditary royal houses of the galaxy. They included the House of Organa and Lady Carise Sindian's family.

Draboon was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Mandalore sector. During the Mandalorian Civil War circa 42 BBY, Satine Kryze of the Mandalorian House Kryze came under the protection of Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi.

In 0 ABY, the rebel spy Eneb Ray carried out a prison siege at Sunspot in retaliation for the deaths of pro-rebel senators and Rebel Alliance operatives during the Arrth-Eno Mission. Eneb sought to kill all Imperial prisoners housed in the Alliance's top-secret Sunspot Prison.

Lonerans were a sentient species from the Expansion Region planet Lonera that had long, silky fur the color of gold and four thin, extended limbs that allowed them to walk on two feet or all fours with equal ease.
Ashaftans were a diminutive sentient species that had wooly fur. In 28 ABY, the Ashaftans were represented in the New Republic Galactic Senate.

Birren was a small, quiet Inner Rim planet that was originally settled by both Alderaanian and Arkanisian explorers. After the destruction of Alderaan, it was one of the few places where candlewick flowers still grew naturally.

A rebel cell led by Commander Ryden initially had its headquarters on the planet of Imvur. It was part of early rebel movement, headed in secret by Senator Bail Organa of Alderaan, that would become the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Verpine were an insectoid sentient species that controlled Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines, a droid manufacturer. Effor was a member of the Verpine species.

The Stone Needle was a spindle of rock located in Beggar's Canyon on the desert planet Tatooine. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, when Luke Skywalker successfully operated an X-wing flight simulator, he felt as he had the first time he threaded the Stone Needle in his T-16 …
The dead-enders were a group of elderly men who lived in Carbon Ridge mountain on the desert planet Jakku.
CZ-1G5, referred to as Seezee, was a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid that lived on the planet Jakku.
