objective: Investigate Rinnrivin Di's cartel's activities on Bastatha
x: In 28 ABY, the New Republic Senators Leia Organa and Ransolm Casterfo embarked on a mission to Bastatha to investigate the Nikto crime lord Rinnrivin Di's cartel.

result: Senator Leia Organa learns that the Amaxine warriors are funding Rinnr
Destruction of Sibensko city, Amaxine warriors, and Rinnrivin's cartel
objective: Investigate Rinnrivin Di's cartel and the Amaxine warriors
x: In 28 ABY, the Mission to Sibensko was undertaken by the New Republic Senator Leia Organa and her senatorial staff embarked to the Expansion Region planet of Sibensko. Posing as smugglers, Leia's team managed to infiltrate the underwater Sibensko city.

result: Deaths of Tai-Lin Garr and Arliz Hadrassian
objective: Assassinate New Republic senator Tai-Lin Garr
x: Tai-Lin Garr's assassination occurred in 28 ABY on the New Republic capital Hosnian Prime. The New Republic Senator Tai-Lin Garr was killed by Arliz Hadrassian, the leader of the Amaxine warriors, a paramilitary faction that had been destroyed during a skirmish on Sibensko.

In 28 ABY, a memorial service was held to honor the late Populist Senator Tai-Lin Garr. Earlier, Tai-Lin had been assassinated by the Amaxine warriors' leader Arliz Hadrassian under the orders of the Centrist Senator Lady Carise Sindian, who was a secret First Order agent.

Gromas was an astronomical object located at the Perkell sector's Gromas system within the Mid Rim in grid Q-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the location of an Imperial depot and supported a mining operation for phrik, a metallic compound that was nearly indestructible.

The Marauder was a starship operated by Weequay pirates during the Clone Wars. Over one year into the war, the Republic-owned droids R2-D2 and C-3PO were captured and taken to the ship to be watched in a gladiatorial arena for the pirates' amusement.

Muckrats were a type of rat that inhabited the galaxy. During the Iron Blockade, the Galactic Empire's attempt to prevent the Anoat sector's populace from learning of the crushing Imperial defeat at the hands of the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the Battle of Endor, the …

Project Stardust, also known internally as the Death Star project, the Ultimate Weapon project, or as the battle station project, was the project that saw the construction of the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station, known as the first Death Star.
Dowut was a frigid planet of windswept tundras located in the Dowut system, a trinary star system in the Core Worlds of the galaxy.

Raada was a remote farming moon in the Outer Rim Territories. The moon was originally controlled by farmers, but the Galactic Empire eventually took control of the moon for their own propagation of nutrient-rich plants to be used in rations.
Ubduria was an Inner Rim Territories celestial body. It was one of the two homeworlds—the other being the Outer Rim planet Nag Ubdur—of the sentient Ubdurian species.

Pikhrons were a species of naturally herbivore mammals that lived on the planet Devaron. They were valued for their skin and teeth which would fetch considerable prices in the black market since the Galactic Empire had forbidden the hunting of Pikhrons.

A species of insectivorous animals with long, muscular tongues and flexible snouts eventually evolved into the sentient Bravaisian species. They were pack hunters that used their sturdy snouts to dig through the dirt and sand in search of tubers and nests of insects.

Bravais was an Inner Rim astronomical object that featured hot deserts. The celestial body's flora and fauna had adapted to live underground during the day. Bravais was the homeworld of the sentient Bravaisian species.
The Blazemaker Mark II was a Z-wing that Zander Freemaker assembled at Freemaker Salvage and Repair on the Wheel. He later flew it while escaping Imperial TIE fighters on Coruscant.
Feeks were a type of animal that inhabited the frozen plains of the planet Dowut, where they lived in subterranean dens that they used for hibernation.
The sentient Dowutin species evolved from a species of non-sentient, omnivorous herd animals native to Dowut, a Core Worlds planet.

Shuimi were a type of feathered creatures that lived in the scrub forests of the planet Artiod Minor. Juvenile members of the sentient Artiodac species, which were also native to the world, would forage in the forests to collect shuimi feathers for use in making crowns that th…
The New Gilliland was a cruiser that the Delphidian pirate Sidon Ithano and the Weequay pirate Scorza served aboard until it was destroyed by the Hutt Clan.

During the Third Battle of Mygeeto, Republic clone trooper Stance was killed by Separatist colonel Coburn Sear. Following the battle, a funeral was held for Stance by Jedi Master Depa Billaba, Padawan Caleb Dume, and Stance's fellow clone soldiers.

Just over a year after the Battle of Hoth, in which the Galactic Empire routed the Alliance to Restore the Republic from their headquarters, another battle was fought on the icy planet of Hoth, this time between the Empire and the Anoat sector's faction of resistance known as …

At some point during the blockade of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire, a battle took place on the devastated planet of Anoat. Knowing that Anoat held secrets valuable to its enemies, the Empire sought to lock down the planet.

At some point during the lockdown of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire, a battle was fought on the former Hutt jewel world of Mataou between the Empire and the resistance faction called the Uprising.
Jerethian clamberwolf were a highly intelligent species of wolf native to Jereth VI.

A complex was located underwater on the planet Sibensko. By the time of the New Republic era, it was regarded as a crime haven and also hosted the headquarters of a paramilitary faction known as the Amaxine warriors.
The Imperial Outer Rim High Command was a subdivision of the Galactic Empire's High Command that was in charge of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Onderon highlands were a mountain range to the east of Onderon's capital city, Iziz.
Clever-birds were a type of squawking bird that lived in the Canyon of Akar on the Outer Rim planet Akiva.

Purra-birds were a type of bird that could be kept as pets. In 5 ABY, the bounty hunter Jas Emari asked her colleague, the former Imperial loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus, about his future plans and whether they included settling down with his boyfriend Conder Kyl and having…
The skor-fins were a species of fish native to the oceans of the planet Chandrila.
Rot-wings were a species of flying insects native to Nag Ubdur that fed on decaying organic matter. In the presence of corpses, rot-wings flocked en masse, forming blurry clouds above them.

New Republic pilots were pilots part of the New Republic Defense Fleet who served in the military forces of the New Republic. They fought in various conflicts from the Galactic Civil War to the Cold War with the First Order.

The Tellstar was an Arquitens-class command cruiser in service to the Galactic Empire's navy. After the destruction of Lothal's Imperial Communications Center, the Tellstar was used to capture and relay information from surface courier droids brought aboard.
The advisers were a Force-using organization based in the Anoat sector. Their existence was tied to that of the Noble Court, the assembled ruling families of the sector.

The Amalthea was an MC80 Star Cruiser of the New Republic Navy that was active during the Galactic Civil War. Its most notable participation was during the battle for the Kuat Drive Yards where it acted as the carrier for Blade Squadron.
A Separatist outpost was a CIS mobile command center on the planet Maridun was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars for weapons testing.
The Battle of Malastare was a battle that took place on the planet Malastare between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire sometime after the Battle of Endor.

During the New Republic reign, the Inner Rim world of Riosa had its own planetary security force. Prior to embarking on his career as a New Republic senator, Ransolm Casterfo served in Riosa's planetary security force for two years.
The light freighter later known as the Trumpet's Call was used by the Rebel Alliance in the Mid Rim. It changed its name frequently, formerly being known as the Eyesore and the Careful Buyer.
Thidaxx also known as Tar monsters, were a species of cave-dwelling predatory creatures native to Taul. They had squirming tentacles and shark-like heads covered in eyes.

The Keepsake was a VCX-150 freighter used by the Sullustan resistance during the Galactic Civil War. On the same day as the Battle of Hoth, a number of Stormtroopers stormed it and apprehended a Chadra-Fan who was part of the Sullustan resistance.

The Apailana's Promise, or simply the Promise, was a Braha'tok-class gunship that served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It bore two X-wings attached to its undercarriage and was crewed by a dozen navy veterans.

Prengalli were water-dwelling creatures that could be found on the swampy planet of Artiod Minor, in the Morellian Commonwealth. The sentient natives of Artiod Minor, the Artiodacs, raised schools of prengalli in their aqua-farms.

A species of non-sentient tree-dwellers evolved in the fungus forests of Narq, a planet located in the Colonies region of the galaxy. Their overall blue coloration helped them blend with their habitat.

In ancient times, the Mandalorians devastated the planet of Ubduria as part of their crusade into the Inner Rim solar systems. They acted out of contempt for the Ubdurians, who they regarded as dishonorable cowards.

The Vodrans were a sentient species native to Vodran, a planet located in the Hutt Space region of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. They possessed distinctive horns around their face and could have blue eyes and light brown skin.

During the Age of the Empire, the Sullustan crime lord Surat Nuat led a gang that was based in the Alcazar in Myrra, the capital city of the planet Akiva. The gang collaborated with the Galactic Empire, and had a strong connection to the Hutt Cartel.
During Operation Ringbreaker in 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry initiated an attack on Nakadia against the Galactic Empire.
Some shipyards were located at the astronomical object Xa Fel, serving as one of the Galactic Empire's major shipyards during the Galactic Civil War.
Drifter's Gorge was a natural formation on the planet Burnin Konn, a mining colony.
During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish broke out between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic sometime after the Battle of Yavin on the volcanic moon Ghost Moon.

result: Han Solo and Chewbacca manage to capture the three Rathtars for King P
objective: Capture three full-grown Rathtars for transport to King Prana
x: During the Cold War, Han Solo, along with Chewbacca and Varond Jelik were tasked by King Prana to go the planet Twon Ketee and capture three Rathtars for him.

The Apex Overlook was a luxurious open plaza located in the heights of Cloud City, a floating structure suspended high among the clouds of Bespin. At the time of the Iron Blockade, high-ranking members of the Anoat sector's Noble Court-in-exile sometimes met at the Apex Overlook.

Peacocks were creatures that sported long, ostentatious tails that trailed behind them. Vain or ostentatious people were sometimes compared to a peacock. The Imperial bureaucrat Arsin Crassus sometimes wore a glittering robe trailing behind him like a peacock's tail.
A species of amphibious creatures were native to the planet Crul in the Mid Rim, where they eventually evolved into the sentient Crolute species millions of years later.
The guarlara were a species of non-sentient quadrupeds indigenous to the planet Naboo.
Wol Cabasshites were a sentient species of sedentary, limbless beings that sported a long tongue from Wol Cabassh. Because of their appearance, they were frequently mistaken for pests.

R4 was a green and gold colored R4 astromech droid who served in the Resistance. During Black Squadron's mission to Megalox, R4 assisted them in Operation Upside, working with BB-8, O-R10N, and R2-HA in an attempt to free Grakkus the Hutt.

result: Savage Opress locates his brother Darth Maul on Lotho Minor
objective: Locate Darth Maul on Lotho Minor
x: During the Clone Wars, Savage Opress went on a mission to Lotho Minor to locate his brother and former Sith Lord Maul. He eventually found his brother and brought him back to Dathomir.

A tribe of Ewoks inhabited a village located near the site of what would eventually host the second Death Star's shield generator bunker. One night, the tribesman Romba returned from hunting only to find the Galactic Empire had burned down his village and killed his whole tribe.

The Wreckers were a large group of scavengers on the planet Hoth, residing in debris left from the Battle of Hoth. The Wreckers were led by the Aqualish Bohento Splinth, a former meteor miner, until he was killed during the Iron Blockade by a young smuggler.
OM-5 was a B1-series battle droid who served in the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
OM-7 was a B1-series battle droid who served within the Confederacy of Independent Systems' droid army during the Clone Wars.

O-R10N was a blue astromech droid who served as Jessika Pava's astromech in the Resistance. During Black Squadron's mission to Megalox, O-R10N assisted in Operation Upside alongside BB-8, R2-HA, and R4 in an attempt to free Grakkus the Hutt until it was destroyed by an unident…
R0-H2 was an R0 astromech droid that served in the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order. During the Battle of Takodana, R0-H2 served as Commander Poe Dameron's astromech.

objective: Await a delivery from Han Solo
x: A Padawan hoping to join a new generation of Jedi was sent by Luke Skywalker on a mission to the planet Tatooine where an Imperial remnant began an operation to attack the Padawan.

Manda was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Manda system in the Manda sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was situated along the Manda Merchant Run hyperspace route and was the endpoint of another route that traveled west to Mon Gazza.
Allst Prime was a backwater planet in the Mid Rim Territories where Governor Magé rule over an impoverished population during the Galactic Empire's reign.
Tangenine was a planet located in the Core Worlds' Tangenine sector. It was home to the norango bush farmers Remba and Kelven and their children Lauren Mel Coelho and Julien.
Camson was a desert planet in the Camson system in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories that had at least one city.
Andooweel was a world in the Andooweel system in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

A species of primitive creatures were native to the planet Abednedo, in the Colonies region of the galaxy, where they lived in series of interconnected underground tunnels. Their mouth tendrils were sensory organs that helped them navigate in the dark.

Drabatans, also known as Drabatas were a sentient amphibious species native to the planet Pipada. Their homeworld was harvested for materials by the Galactic Empire, displacing much of the native population, including the Drabatans.
RO-Z67 was a heavily modified RO-series childcare and nanny droid employed by Darth Sidious, Dark Lord of the Sith, during the Clone Wars.

During the late Clone Wars, the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker flew a yellow Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor. Anakin Skywalker piloted the interceptor during a mission to rescue Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine during the Battle of Coruscant.

Camp Four was a prison camp established by the Trade Federation during their invasion and occupation of the planet Naboo, located in Theed's largest market square and designated for government personnel such as Theed Royal Palace staff and members of the Royal Naboo Security F…

The Starlight Wanderer was a CR90 corvette that was in the service of the New Republic and participated in the Battle of Jakku during the Galactic Civil War. During the battle, the ship was carrying secret information that was being coveted by both the Imperials and New Republic.

Naboo Fighter Pilots were pilots who served in the Royal House of Naboo's Space Fighter Corps. Even though she wasn't a member of the Space Fighter Corps, Queen Sosha Soruna earned a fighter pilot certification a year before her election as Queen of Naboo.

Chagar IX, also known as Chagar, was a world located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of stormtrooper Sergeant Kreel, and fell under the control of the Galactic Empire in Kreel's youth.

The Ghost Moon was a volcanic moon located in the system of the same name in the Wornal sector of the Mid Rim Territories. The Ghost Moon was the site of skirmish between the Galactic Empire's elite Task Force 99 and a group of Rebel troopers during the Galactic Civil War.

O.M.5, also known as OM 5, was a B1 battle droid used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, serving under Poggle the Lesser. They and another B1 followed Poggle in a sandstorm but was swept away by it and left for dead.
Byss was a world located in the Interior and the Deep Core regions of the galaxy. It acted as the endpoint of the Byss Run and was part of the larger Nexus Route.
Prakith was an volcanic planet located within the galaxy's Deep Core. It was connected via the Byss Run hyperspace route to Byss and Empress Teta.
Empress Teta was an ecumenopolis planet located in the Empress Teta system, in the Koros sector of the Deep Core.
Tython was a terrestrial planet located in Deep Core's Tython system that played a pivotal role in the history of the Jedi Order.

Sanjin was a planet that had several moons within the Sanjin system, a star system of the Colonies. Before the mission to Vassek's third moon, Jedi Master Neebo traveled to one of these moons to aid refugees.

t: Mission to the moons of Sanjin
objective: Defend the refugees on the moons of Sanjin
x: Some time prior to the mission to Vassek's third moon, a mission was undertaken by Jedi Master Neebo to protect the refugees located on the moons of Sanjin. Neebo was presumed missing.

The turbolift transport area was a series of turbolifts that allowed beings to travel to the surface of Quarzite safely as the pressurized atmosphere meant that starships were unable to land without imploding.
Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire learned that the people of Tureen VII were secretly providing aid to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Pantoran City was the capital city of the moon Pantora. The government of Pantora, the Pantoran Assembly, governed the moon from Pantoran City. The city had many high buildings with parks on top of their roofs.

result: Hondo Ohnaka is rescued from the Galactic Empire
x: The rescue of Hondo Ohnaka occurred in 2 BBY, when Jedi Padawan Ezra Bridger, along with Sabine Wren, Garazeb Orrelios, and the droid C1-10P ("Chopper") launched a rescue mission to free the pirate Hondo Ohnaka and his partner Terba from the Imperial prison on Naraka for some …

QT-9 was a prototype therapy droid given to the former Rebel soldier Dade Hetkins after he was discharged from a New Republic vet hospital in Darropolis on the planet Hosnian Prime. QT-9 was approximately knee-high and had two ocular lenses.

Fedalle was a terrestrial planet within the Fedalle system in the Core Worlds. It was situated along the Hydian Way hyperspace route between Skako and Bellassa, and sat at the head of a second hyperlane that linked it to Kuat.
The arrawtha-dyr was a creature native to the planet Kashyyyk, notable for its many-pronged antlers.

The Junihar Cartel was a criminal organization which made use of prisons. The Siniteen prison architect Golas Aram designed and built prisons for the Junihar Cartel among other interests such as Splugorra the Hutt, Kanjiklub and the Galactic Empire.

Kotaska was a gang of enslavers and spicers which operated on the planet Ganthel during Rae Sloane's childhood. Kotaska thugs wore metal masks cut into the shape of skulls, and were known to abduct individuals from Ganthel's spaceport.
The Keldar were a species of the galaxy. They settled on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Nag Ubdur after being transplanted along with Artiodac refugees and the Ubdurian natives.

Makem Te was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Swokes Swokes species. It was located close to one end of the Perlemian Trade Route, which connected it to the planets Quermia and Desevro.

Formos was an Outer Rim Territories astronomical object lying on the hyperspace routes known as the Pabol Sleheyron and the Triellus Trade Route. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Formos served as a processing location for spice transported off of the planet Kessel.

Junkfort Station was an Outer Rim Territories astronomical object. At some point, the smuggler Platt Okeefe mentioned Junkfort Station in an entry she made in the book known as the Smuggler's Guide, and an individual on the celestial body at one point claimed to have completed…

TV-94B was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid that was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. He was assigned to General Grievous as a replacement for TV-94. He oversaw the space portion of the Battle of Kamino.

objective: Steal a squadron of Y-wing starfighters from Reklam Station
x: In 2 BBY, Phoenix Cell launched a mission to Reklam Station to steal a squadron of BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bombers from the Galactic Empire on Reklam Station. A team of rebels led by the newly appointed Lieutenant Commander Ezra Bridger raided the station.
Naraka was a rocky and hazy planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Imperial Era, it was controlled by the Galactic Empire, who maintained a prison there.

Yarma was a planet in the Yarma system within the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories where Reklam Station, an Imperial salvage yard, was located. In 2 BBY, a mission was undertaken by members of Phoenix Cell to steal a squadron of Y-wing starfighters for their fleet.

Batonn was a planet located in the Batonn sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Admiral Thrawn was victorious in the Batonn insurgency, which led to the Emperor promoting him to Grand Admiral.

The Bahk-tov Council, known as the Bardotta Council, was the ruling body of the Bardotta. Comprised of members of the Force-sensitive Dagoyan Order, led by a High Seneschal, the council was convened and dismissed by the strike of a gong on the calling of the Bardottan monarch.
Toltek's band was a band of Devaronian pirates led by Toltek.

t: Rescue of Lando Calrissian's puffer pig
result: Lando Calrissian retrieves his puffer pig
x: In 4 BBY, the human gambler Lando Calrissian rescued his puffer pig, which had been stolen from his Lothalian farm by the Varluk Organization.
Gigorans were a sentient species of tall, hairy humanoids that hailed from the planet Gigor. They were often exploited for their strength and typically used as bodyguards.
The Sith snake was a type of snake from the Sith planet Moraband. During the Clone Wars on a mission to the planet, Jedi Master Yoda encountered Sith snakes.

The Ongree were an amphibious sentient species native to the planet Skustell. The Jedi Pablo-Jill was a member of this species, as were Jedi Master Coleman Kcaj and the Anklebiter Brigade member Urk G'lar.
Hutt Flats was a region of desert located on the planet of Tatooine. It was once the bed of the prehistoric Lake Anre, which, via underground tributaries, ran to the Northern Dune Sea.

Ebe Crater Valley was a landmark on the desert planet of Tatooine. Pocketed with dips and craters, the valley was part of the Boonta Eve Classic podrace, and contained a quarry, in the last decades of the Galactic Republic.
Sump was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Koradin sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Nuknog species.

Vulpter was a planet located in the galaxy's Deep Core that was the homeworld of the Vulptereen podracer Dud Bolt. The KX-series security droid K-2SO was constructed on Vulpter, as were many of the Galactic Empire's probe droids.
Ord Radama was an astronomical object located in the Ord Radama system in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Devlikk species, including podracer Wan Sandage.

Phu was an astronomical object located in the Phu system of the Colonies region of the galaxy that was colonized by the Bardottan species of Bardotta. It was the homeworld of the Bardottan podracer Mars Guo.

Embertown was a mining location on the planet Burnin Konn. Originally known as Kind Caverns, the place was renamed after the mine caught fire. Having survived the Great Jedi Purge, the Jedi Khandra and Nuhj went into hiding there.

Vulptereens were a sentient species that had a shovel-like mouth with six tusks, a feeler on their snout, and two pointed ears. A Vulptereen podracer named Dud Bolt, who was native to Vulpter, participated in the Boonta Eve Classic on Tatooine in 32 BBY.
Zyzar was a mountainous planet within the reaches of the galaxy. During the Age of the Empire, it hosted the headquarters of the Varluk Organization. Sand rains would sometimes occur on Zyzar.
Stellar Sun was a YT-2000 Light Freighter owned by Rikarda.
The Xot were a sentient species characterized by their small size and head shaped like a pair of macrobinoculars. Known Xot included Bidvel and Davil, who operated a scrap pile.

Tureen VII, was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was orbited by twin moons. Following the destruction of the Death Star at Yavin, the people of Tureen VII started aiding the Alliance to Restore the Republic in secret.
The Freedom's Dawn was an MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser manufactured by Mon Calamari Shipyards that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

The Hall of Knighthood was the penultimate chamber just below the Pinnacle Room of the Jedi Temple's central spire. Within this hall, members of the Jedi Order were elevated to the rank of Knight or Master by the Jedi High Council.
The Chamber of Conclave was a room that was located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant where representatives of the Jedi Order gathered annually to hear reports from the Jedi High Council.

Commander Grey turns on his fellow clones and helps finish off their s
x: Managing to survive Order 66, which saw the destruction of the Jedi Order, Jedi Padawan Caleb Dume went into hiding and attempted to distance himself from his Jedi upbringing, joining up with the Kalleran smuggler Janus Kasmir.

t: Maul's capture of the Ghost crew
x: In 2 BBY, the former Sith Lord, Maul, captured the crew of the Ghost in order to obtain both the Jedi and Sith holocrons that the rebellion had in its possession.

R2-BHD, also known as Tooby, was an R2-series astromech droid who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. By the year 1 BBY, the droid worked with the Alliance Fleet's Gold Squadron, and most commonly flew with the squadron's leader Jon Vander.

A caltrop field was a field of large spikes that protruded from the ground on the planet Geonosis. In 21 BBY, during the Second Battle of Geonosis of the Clone Wars, Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi and the battalion of his Clone Commander, Jet, were stymied by a massive caltrop field…
The Nightbrother was a modified Kom'rk-class fighter/transport, named and used by the former Sith Lord Maul during the Clone Wars and the Imperial Era.

The Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations (IOCI) was a law enforcement agency of the Galactic Empire. They notably issued Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificates to members of the Bounty Hunters' Guild, which granted them access to the Imperial Enforcement DataCore.

The Dreadstar was a battleship that Rae Sloane served aboard. At one point, Sloane refueled the ship at a floating depot on the ninth moon of Tilth's Sea of Carawak. While at the depot, an oncoming storm made the sea look monstrous.

Phelbos was a celestial body surrounded by several rings of asteroids, located in the Bright Jewel system of the Mid Rim's Bright Jewel sector. Orbiting the star Bright Jewel, Phelbos was situated i grid square L-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Cave of the Crèche was an outpost located underground on the planet Ovanis, and was home to the Crèche during the time of the Cold War.

A species of massive, winged entities lived on the planet Ovanis. At the time of the Cold War, an egg of the species was praised and nurtured by the Crèche, a culture which believed the egg to carry a "savior unborn."
Cold-weather Soldiers were Rebel Alliance troopers specially trained and field-tested to operate in arctic conditions. Wilderness Fighters could serve as Cold-weather Soldiers.
The Tower of First Knowledge was one of the four towers surrounding the Temple Spire atop the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. It was here that the Council of First Knowledge would convene.
The Reassignment Council Tower was one of the four towers surrounding the Temple Spire atop the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. It notably housed the eponymous council and the Chamber of Judgment.
The Council of Reassignment was one of the four councils of the Jedi Order in operation during the rule of the Galactic Republic.

Antar was a gas giant located in the galaxy's Inner Rim, located in grid square N-12 on the Standard Galactic Grid, that was orbited by Antar 4, homeworld of the sentient Gotal species, and the Dead Moon of Antar.
The Wirutid were a sentient species of ambulatory fungus. They were hyper-intelligent, and evolved into an outwardly human form that enabled them to secure shelter and trap prey.

The Council Towers were the four towers—the Tower of First Knowledge, the Reassignment Council Tower, the High Council Tower, and the Tower of Reconciliation—that surrounded the Temple Spire atop the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

The Bimms were a species of diminutive sentients who resembled short humans. Rycar Ryjerd, a patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, Tatooine, was a Bimm. A different species of furred individuals with floppy ears was also called Bimm.
The Skirmish on Tatooine was a skirmish between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire that occurred during the Galactic Civil War in and around the Beggar's Canyon Raider Camp.

The Council of First Knowledge was one of the four councils of the Jedi Order in operation during the rule of the Galactic Republic. Its role was to procure advice on matters requiring ancient Jedi wisdom, including the curriculum of the Temple, and the Jedi Archives.

The Council of Reconciliation was one of the four councils of the Jedi Order in operation during the rule of the Galactic Republic. Its role was to try and settle interplanetary disputes. To this end, it worked with the Galactic Senate and the Republic Diplomatic Corps.

Bestine was a city and the capital of Tatooine. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker spent a night in Bestine while on their way to Mos Eisley. Imperial stormtroopers searching for C-3PO and R2-D2 intercepted a Jawa sandcrawler as it left Bestine.
Lake Sui was a lake located on the Forest moon of Endor. The lake was surrounded by forest and was home to multiple villages that were built on stilts and inhabited by the moon's native Ewok species.
Lake Marudi was a lake on the forest moon Endor. The body of water consisted of two large open portions connected by a strait on the northern edge of the lake.
MR-T3 was an R4 astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that was in service to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Shuttle 593 was a Star Commuter 2000. In 4 BBY, Senator Nadea Tural of the Imperial Senate boarded the shuttle on her way to the planet Arkanis. However, the hyperdrive malfunctioned, causing the Star Commuter to crash.

The High Council Tower was one of the four towers surrounding the Temple Spire atop the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. It most notably housed the meeting place of the Jedi High Council, which had overall decision-making powers over the Jedi Order.

Virdugo Plunge was the most prominent, and largest, waterfall in Theed, the capital city of Naboo's human denizens. Marking the end of a tributary of the Solleu River, it was located near the Royal Palace's hangar.

Peg Shar I was an industrial world in the Peg Shar system of the Halla sector in the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice. It fell within grid square R-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was represented by a senator in the Senate of the Galactic Republic by 32 BBY.

The massacre near Teralov was the destruction of a rebel GR-75 medium transport and flight of A-wings from Green Squadron by the Galactic Empire who were en route to provide supplies to the people of Teralov.

result: Wedge Antilles and Hobbie defect from the Galactic Empire and are deli
x: In 2 BBY, Imperial cadets Wedge Antilles and Derek Klivian were able to escape from Skystrike Academy with the help of Sabine Wren and the rebels of Phoenix Cell.

Teralov was a planet where the rebellion attempted to take supplies in 2 BBY. However en route, the rebel ships were attacked by Imperial forces led by Captain Vult Skerris, a brief battle occurred resulting in the destruction of all the rebel ships and failure to deliver the …

Roon was an astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories that was a junction between the Death Wind Corridor, the Mumble's Turnaround, and the Triellus Trade Route hyperlanes. The celestial body made up one of three corners of the Spice Triangle trade network.
The Gallo Mountains was a mountain chain that was located on the planet of Naboo. The settlement of Dee'ja Peak was situated upon the summit of a mountain within this chain.

The Theed Landing Plaza was a large plaza located in Theed on the planet Naboo where diplomatic ships could land. Before the Festival of Light, Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine and his escort arrived there in a T-6 shuttle.

OOM-87, also known as OOM87, was a B1-series battle droid who served in the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars. During a battle on the planet Florrum, the droid was destroyed by Jedi younglings Zatt and Petro while making a report to General Grievous.
The Room of Arches was a room located in the palace of Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine. At the time of the rescue of Han Solo, it was occupied by a colony of outcast Jawas.
Montross was a planet in the binary star Montross system in the Truum sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

261 was a black-and-gold R-series astromech droid in service of the Galactic Empire. At some point before the Battle of Yavin, 261 was among the many droids used to maintain operations aboard the Death Star battle station.
Thune City was a large city on Thune, a planet located in Wild Space.
The luggerwahl was a species of four-legged creatures that were used as beasts of burden by scavengers during the era of the Galactic War and the Eternal Empire.
Ord Cantrell was an astronomical object known for its weavers that was located in the Ord Cantrell system in the Fath sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Balmorra was a rocky wasteland factory world located in the Colonies' Balmorra system. It joined the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars and housed droid factories for the faction.
Byblos was an astronomical object located in the Byblos system of the galaxy's Colonies region that was situated along the Corellian Run.
Exodeen was a planet in the Colonies' Exodeen system, situated along the Hydian Way and Nanth'ri Trade Route.
Arkania was a cold planet located in the Arkania system of the galaxy's Colonies region, positioned at the coordinates M-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of Arkanian species.
Rina Major was a planet located in the Rina Major system in the Stensen sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Blarina species, whose name meant "children of Rin".

During the Galactic Civil War, the Wookiee Krrsantan owned an Auzituck anti-slaver gunship which he flew on his missions with the rogue archeologist Doctor Aphra. The two used it to pull off the Son-tuul Pride robbery.

Darropolis was a city on the planet Hosnian Prime. A New Republic veteran hospital was located in the city, and the hospital was where Dade Hetkins received treatment and a cybernetic leg to replace the one lost in the aftermath of the Battle of Endor.
The Bendeluum Public Safety Service was a law enforcement agency on Bendeluum.
Having heard of the informant's situation, the Smuggler dispatched several of their crewmembers to Mexeluine.

Lake Anre was a prehistoric lake on the planet Tatooine that ran all the way to the Northern Dune Sea desert via underground tributaries. By 32 BBY, the lake had dried up, with its bed left as a region of desert that became known as the Hutt Flats.
Binji-Tin was a large merchant city on the planet Nag Ubdur. During the Galactic Civil War the population of Binjai-Tin was massacred by the Galactic Empire.

Yabol Opa was a terrestrial planet located in the Yabol Opa system of the Colonies and the Slice. It was also situated in grid square M-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid, and the super-hyperroute known as the Perlemian Trade Route linked Yabol Opa to the Castell system as well a…
Gravlex Med was a mountainous high gravity planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Anx species.
Abhean was an astronomical object located in the Abhean system of the Maldrood sector, a part of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice.
Govneh Ridge was a popular place on Nag Ubdur.

Quellor was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Quellor system in the Quellor sector in an intersecting portion of the Colonies and the Slice. It was situated at the coordinates N-12 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Ubrikkia was a Mid Rim celestial body that shared its name with several companies. During the conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Nihil marauders, the Republic Defense Coalition wrestled Ubrikkia from Hutt Cartel control.
Thabeska was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories where the Fardi clan operated. It was windy and dusty, and newcomers to the planet could be identified by having clean, dust-free clothing.

Solarine was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories with notable sunsets and was the homeworld of Val. Ziro the Hutt and his love Sy Snootles planned on spending their lives on Solarine together, however Snootles killed Ziro, believing that he had abandoned her.

ZeHeth was an Mid Rim world located in the ZeHeth system of the Dustig sector in grid square N-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The super-hyperroute known as the Hydian Way connected it to the Malastare system as well as the Expansion Region's Pax system.
Riverbreaker was a location on the planet Uyter.

A few months after the Battle of Endor, a battle between Galactic Empire and New Republic took place in Central City on the planet Uyter. The Imperial stormtrooper academy on Uyter was destroyed during the battle.
Central City was the capital city of Uyter. A battle was fought in Central City sometime after the Battle of Endor between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire.
Uviuy Exen was a world located in the Uviuy Exen system of the Shwuy sector, a part of the Colonies and the Interior. It was situated in grid square L-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Vakkar was an astronomical object located in the Vakkar system in the Fakir sector of the Colonies region, along the Shwuy Exchange hyperspace route.

Wayland, also known as Weyland, was a forested, mountainous planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim. Wayland served as the base of operations of the Galactic Empire's cloning program early in its reign.
Borleias was an astronomical object located in the Borleias system of the Colonies region. Borleias sat at grid square K-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Ghorman was a Colonies planet located in the Sern sector’s Ghorman system along the Rimma Trade Route. The planet was known for its streamlined high-quality silk and twill industy, and it was considered a rite of passage for new fashion designers to visit the planet.
Kattada was an astronomical object located in the Kattada system of the galaxy's Colonies region. It shared its name with the wine Kattadan rosé.
Kelada was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Colonies region, situated along the Corellian Trade Spine. The Labyrinth, a cantina owned by Lorana, was located on Kelada.
Loronar was an astronomical object located in the Loronar system of the galaxy's Colonies region that was situated along the Corellian Run.

Andara was an astronomical object located in the Andara system in the Core Worlds, in grid square L-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Around 5 ABY, the New Republic captured Andara from the Galactic Empire.

Humbarine was an ancient world that constituted a part of the Core Worlds. Home to the Humbarine Academy of Advanced Studies, it was subjected to a devastating Separatist orbital bombardment during the Clone Wars and later had a planetary defense force in which the pilot Lega …
Palanhi was an astronomical object located in the Palanhi system in the Fakir sector of the Colonies. It was located along the Shwuy Exchange hyperspace route.
Csilla was a frigid, ice-locked planet in the Unknown Regions. It was the homeworld of the sentient, near-human Chiss species and the capital world of the Chiss Ascendancy.
Rendili was an ancient, conservative planet located in the galaxy's Core Worlds. Arch-Provost was a governing position on the planet.

Sarapin was a planet located in the Sarapin system in the Core Worlds. At some point prior to the attack on the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Hellion's Dare over Jiruus, a fleet battle occurred at Sarapin during which Riot Squadron members Wyl Lark and Sonogari were present, b…
Constancia was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Deep Core.
Adumar was an astronomical object located in the Adumar system of the galaxy's Wild Space.

Bellassa was a world located in the Bellassa system of the Core Worlds. It was situated within grid square M-11 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The Hydian Way super-hyperroute connected Bellassa to the planets Exodeen and Fedalle.
Belsavis was an astronomical object located in the Bozhnee sector's Belsavis system within an intersecting portion of the Outer Rim Territories and the Western Reaches.
Botor was a planet located in the galaxy's Core Worlds that was home to the pirate faction known as the Flesh Mongers during the Republic Era. The youngling Lo was from Botor.
The moon Raada orbited an uninhabitable planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.
Anzat was a planet located in the Anzat system in the Bryx sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Anzati species.
Lee romay were a species of clam. One lee romay held the crown that Lemcke presented to Lee-Char when he became King of Mon Cala.

Gyndine was a planet in the Expansion Region's Circarpous sector, situated along the Nanth'ri Trade Route. Controlled by the Galactic Empire, it was home to the offices of Imperial Moff Bin Essada as well as the Gyndine shipyards.
Elomin were humanoids from the planet Elom with tapered ears, a crown of horns around their head, and tusks on their cheekbones.

x: One year after the end of the Clone Wars, the Raada Uprising took place against the Galactic Empire on the agricultural moon Raada.

R2-H15 was an R2-series astromech droid that was optimized to function in cold weather. The droid's distinctive red-and-white "hat" was an auxiliary thermal guard that included a cylindrical atmospheric gauge on top. It also included a Burtt acoustic signaller.

The Tann Province, also known simply as Tann, was located on the planet Ryloth. The Twi'lek Hera Syndulla grew up in the province in her home, along with her father, General Cham Syndulla, and her mother, Eleni Syndulla.
The Tulara Ravine was located on the planet Ryloth.

The Enforcer was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. In 14 BBY, it was stationed at the planet Pii's Imperial marshaling station, along with the Compliant, another Star Destroyer.

The Dominion was a Star Destroyer at the time of the Liberation of Kashyyyk in 5 ABY. At this time, it was infiltrated by New Republic forces, and used to attack two other Star Destroyers over Kashyyyk, the Neutralizer and the Vitiator, the latter of which it destroyed.

The Neutralizer was a Star Destroyer at the time of the Liberation of Kashyyyk in 5 ABY. At this time, it surrendered to the New Republic over Kashyyyk, after the Dominion, under the command of New Republic insurgents, destroyed the Vitiator, another Star Destroyer.

The Vitiator was a Star Destroyer at the time of the Liberation of Kashyyyk in 5 ABY. It was destroyed by the Dominion above Kashyyyk, after the New Republic gained control of the ship, and began firing on the Vitiator.
Medical frigate 517 was the designation of a Consular-class cruiser during the Clone Wars. It was used to transport clone trooper Tup from Ringo Vinda to Kamino.

Zelry wyrms were a species of creature that could served live as food. During a competition to determine the next sous chef of the pirate Maz Kanata's castle on the planet Takodana, the chef Jom Jarusch prepared a spicy living zelrey wyrm while crawling around the castle's kit…

The Dutyfree was a GR-75 medium transport that was part of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's fleet, most notably taking part in the Battle of Hoth, where it was escorted off-planet by T-65B X-wing starfighters flown by Luke Skywalker and Wedge Antilles.

manufacturer: Baktoid Combat Automata / Baktoid Armor Workshop
x: B1-268 was an OOM command battle droid who was a part of the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars.

H'nemthe were a reptilian sentient species with sharp tongues. M'iiyoom Onith was a member of this species, and she was courted by the Gotal tax collector Feltipern Trevagg, who did not know the dangers of romancing a H'nemthe.

Eons before the Clone Wars, a species of sentient, spacefaring nonhumans settled the planet of Utapau, in the Tarabba sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim. Some created homes in the sinkholes of Utapau, while others chose to live on the planetary surface.

The Dowager Queen was an early colony ship that crashed on Tatooine long before the Galactic Civil War. The upended wreckage later became a landmark in the spaceport town of Mos Eisley, located at the intersection of Dune Street and Inner Curved Street.
Thon's Orchard was a GR-75 medium transport that was part of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's fleet.
Dune Street was a street in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. The wreckage of the Dowager Queen was located on this street.
Inner Curved Street was a street in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. The wreckage of the Dowager Queen was situated on the corner of this street and Dune Street.
The P1 was a Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's fleet.
An ST-series super tactical droid was in active service to the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

P3 was one of three Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvettes that was sent by Senator Bail Organa to reinforce Commander Jun Sato's unit of the rebellion. P3 could be identified by its distinctive faded yellow and orange markings.
P2 was one of three Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvettes that was sent by Senator Bail Organa to reinforce Phoenix Cell, a rebel unit led by Commander Jun Sato.

The Tower of Reconciliation was one of the four towers surrounding the Temple Spire atop the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. It was here that that the Council of Reconciliation would meet and work toward settling interplanetary dispute.

The Great Time of Peace for the planet Naboo took place around 832 BBY after general Jafan united warring city-states through both force of will and force of arms. The era was considered a golden age in Naboo history.
The deschene was a clawed creature native to the Zoess, a large forest on the planet of Radhii.

objective: Obtain munitions
x: In 2 BBY, Captain Rex and the Spectres undertook a mission to the planet Agamar to obtain proton bombs from a Separatist supply ship.

The Phantom II was a modified Sheathipede-class transport shuttle belonging to the Spectres. It replaced the team's original VCX-series auxiliary starfighter Phantom, which was lost during the mission to Reklam Station.
The derrick major was an area on Coruscant that had cargo docks underneath it.
V2A DAZ was a droid that served as a forensic science commander in the Coruscant Security Force during the Clone Wars.

One year after the Clone Wars, the moon Raada had a settlement where Selda's cantina was located. Former Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano briefly hid out there under the name "Ashla" while hiding from the Galactic Empire.
In 1 BBY, the prototype astromech droid P2 stood within the equipment-filled garage of Tosche Station on the planet Tatooine, dwarfing a nearby R5 droid who was repairing a generator.

place: Hyborean Moon black-site prison, Hyborean Moon
x: One month before the liberation of Kashyyyk, forces of the New Republic attacked the Imperial-held Hyborean Moon, destroying the ISB's blacksite prison as well as its civilian complexes.

A RA-7 protocol droid was active on the Smuggler's Moon, Nar Shaddaa, shortly before the skirmish in Grakkus the Hutt's arena. The droid was destroyed by Chewbacca after another droid attempted to cut off C-3PO's head.
An LOM-series protocol droid was one of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's bounty hunters who attempted to capture Luke Skywalker after the boy stole water from their speeder.
Bardotta Capital City was the capital city of Bardotta.
The Ro-ti-Mundi was a Venator-class Star Destroyer of the Open Circle Fleet, a major space fleet of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
Moraga was a jungle planet located in the Oricho sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Moragan species.

Lahn-rats were a type of rat native to the planet Lahn. In 4 BBY, when the rebel cell known as the Spectres undertook a mission on Lahn, the Jedi Padawan Ezra Bridger attempted to lure a pair of stormtroopers away from their post as a distraction for his master, Kanan Jarrus, …
Illmek Island was an island on the planet Lahn. An outpost of the Galactic Empire was located there.

The World That Was were the remains of an advanced civilization destroyed in a war between the Open and the Closed. It was located under the Celadon Sea, a poisonous mist that Grecker claimed the Open poisoned Carnelion IV with.
Fishers, also known as corpses, were a sentient species of carnivores native to Carnelion IV. They were mutated from humans who lived on the planet as a result of the poisonous Celadon Sea.

Carnelian dragons were a type of carnivorous reptilian dragon native to the planet Carnelion IV. They had four legs, eight blue eyes, red and green skin and an aggressive behavior towards other organisms.

New Alderaan was a safeworld that the Alderaanian survivor Janray Tessime spent time on during the Galactic Civil War tending civilian populations. It was located in the Ash Worlds in the Outer Rim Territories. The festival of Winter's Heart was celebrated on New Alderaan.

Signal Intelligence, also referred to as Signals Intelligence, was an intelligence organization within the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Its technicians gathered secret information from Imperial electronic signals such as encrypted communications chatter.

Rendezvous Point: Victim was a location in the Outer Rim Territories where Captain Lerr Duvat aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Torment rendezvoused with a messenger that was carrying an important message from Emperor Palpatine.
The Great Basin was a wide, water-filled valley on the jungle planet Akiva. It contained the cliff known as the Witch's Finger, and the middle of the basin was taken up by Lake Amari.
The Chenza Hill was a location on the planet Akiva.
The Orchard Hill was a location on the planet Akiva.
The homeworld of the Squamatan species was a planet located in the Squamat system in the Mayagil sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Squamatans were a sentient species of humanoids notable for their blue skin and acidic venom. They were enslaved under the Galactic Empire to assist in acquiring thorilide minerals from their homeworld.
Pheryon was a gas giant located in the galaxy's Inner Rim. Poe Dameron traveled to Pheryon during the Cold War to meet with the journalist Suralinda Javos.
The Galaxy Beacon was a HoloNet channel that the journalist Suralinda Javos worked for around the time of the Cold War.
A skirmish occurred on the Inner Rim planet of Pheryon during the Cold War.
The Cobalt Laborers' Reformation Front, or just Cobalt Front, was an anti-Imperial workers' association on the planet of Sullust, which fought for better safety and factory standards.

Valgauth was the homeworld of the Valgauthians, a group of human who had a reputation as berserkers when boarding starships. As such, a Valgauthian was regarded as a valuable addition to any pirate crew.

The Claatuvac Guild was an ancient organization of Wookiee cartographers and navigators reputed for their knowledge of secret hyperspace routes. The Guild's headquarters were located in the Tree Vikkilynn, in the settlement of Kachirho, Kashyyyk.
Wroshyr lice were insects found in the wroshyr trees of Kashyyyk. The native Wookiees processed them in distilleries to make wroshyr lice syrup.

t: Mission to hijack an Imperial weapons shipment
objective: Hijack an Imperial weapons shipment
x: In 14 BBY, several members of the Free Ryloth Movement led by Pok undertook a mission to hijack an Imperial weapons shipment at the Yaga Minor shipyards.
During the Dragon Void Run, pilots participating in the race stopped on a planet. Whilst on the planet, the pilots were arrested by Imperial forces. However, the racers were later released.

Arthon was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Arthon system within the Ottega sector of the Mid Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square L-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid, and was inhabited by members of the sentient Ottegan species.
GL-916 was a green-plated shopkeeper droid with red sensors that owned a kiosk in the lower market districts of the planet Coruscant's underworld in 21 BBY.
K-8PO was a protocol droid on Coruscant during the Clone Wars.

A needlebug was an insect. It was also used as a term to describe someone who was holding someone else back. Princess Leia Organa took pride in being the official needlebug in Emperor Sheev Palpatine's side in the Imperial Senate.

result: The Sith are driven off Coruscant
x: The Liberation of Coruscant was a battle during the Jedi-Sith War, in which the Jedi Order succeeded in driving the Sith off Coruscant. Later, an arcade of stained-glass windows and statues in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant honored the Jedi heroes of this battle.

Q2-B3KO, or Threekayo, was a feminine-programmed articulated holographic color separator. Originally a class five droid, she was mistakenly upgraded to class one status as a result of a requisition error.

A species of non-sentient arthropods evolved on the volcanic planet of Mustafar, where they lived in mountain caves that protected them from the lava. Eventually, they evolved into the sentient Mustafarian species.

The Umbaran airbase was an airbase located on the planet Umbara. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Umbaran Militia, an ally of the Separatists, used the airbase as a supply line to the planet's capital city.
The Sundari Warehouse District was a district in the New Mandalorian city of Sundari. During the Clone Wars, Prime Minister Almec used a warehouse to store black market supplies.

The shadow rancor was a subspecies of the reptilian, semi-sentient rancor species notorious for its penchant for destruction. Easily recognized by their black-tinted skin, they attacked anything within arms reach.

A relay was the source of all HoloNet communications on the planet Murkhana. During the Clone Wars, it was utilized by the Confederacy of Independent Systems to transmit Shadowfeeds, Separatist propaganda transmissions, to enemy worlds along the Perlemian Trade Route.

The Clabburn Range was a mountain range on the snow planet Hoth. The Alliance to Restore the Republic built their base into the mountains of the Clabburn Range and used a relatively flat ground to the base's immediate south as a staging area for evacuation.
Caamas was an astronomical body located in the Cirius system within the galaxy's Core Worlds. It shared its name with Caamasi light sculpture, and Caamasi cheese pie.
The Upper Ring was a part of the Wheel space station that was restricted to the rich, and the Galactic Empire. Some notable residents included Wick Cooper, Becky Smoochenbacher and Furlac.

The coronation of Queen Amidala as monarch of Naboo took place on the Day of Ascendancy, during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Padmé Amidala was elected to the throne of the Royal House of Naboo, becoming the queen of her people at the age of fourteen.
The Rokarian dirt-fish was a type of fish found in the Rokaria system of the Outer Rim Territories. Members of the galactic populace were known to "gut" dirt-fish.
The Nev Ice Flow was located on Hoth. The Rebel Alliance built Echo Base south of the ice flow, and the Battle of Hoth took place over it.

Sneeps, also known as pishnes, were a species of non-sentient bird that were long-necked, soft-mouthed, feathered creatures that resembled a combination of avian and mollusk. They could be found in the galaxy thirty years after the battle of Endor.
The Toydarian royal delegation was a commission of individuals from the planet Toydaria.

The Middle Ring was a section of the space station called The Wheel in the Abrion system. It was home to the Freemaker Salvage and Repair, a family starship and repair business owned and operated by the Freemakers. It was located between the Lower Ring and the Upper Ring.

Hera's A-wing was an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor used by the rebel pilot Hera Syndulla. Syndulla was the leader of Phoenix Squadron, a squadron of A-wing fighters that was a part of the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
The Epoch Swift was the personal starship of Maz Kanata. It was kept in a private hangar in her castle on the planet Takodana.

Cazne was an area of cratered flatlands located on the planet Ryloth. The site of a major battle during the Battle of Ryloth, it was marked by a number of simple Twi'lek graves, while the underground hideout of the Twi'lek Resistance was hidden beneath the wreckage of a C-9979…

Mos Elrey was a settlement within the small inhabited portion of the desert planet Tatooine's northern hemisphere. It was located on the eastern edge of the Western Dune Sea near the south western edge of the Jundland Wastes.

Codenka Mafurias was the moniker used by the creator of the podracing poster "The Sport's Greatest Rivalry," which depicted the rivalry between podracers Ben Quadinaros and Sebulba in the final decades of the Galactic Republic before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

Tayron was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Videnda sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Wretch of Tayron housed an Imperial Security Bureau black site during the Galactic Civil War.

Garel Shuttle 63725 was a GX1 short hauler on Garel. In 4 BBY, the Spectres Sabine Wren and Chopper hijacked the shuttle after picking up the GNK-series power droid EG-86. The shuttle was damaged in a skirmish with the bounty hunter Ketsu Onyo's ship Shadow Caster.

Orchis 2 was a terrestrial moon in the Orchis system where the Graf Archive, a depository of records and artifacts, was located. The moon was home to the Graf family and at one point was occupied by the Galactic Empire.

x: In 2 BBY, members of Phoenix Cell undertook a mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn. After the Phoenix Cell lost contact with the Mandalorian Protectors, Fenn Rau, Sabine Wren, Ezra Bridger, and Chopper traveled to the third moon to investigate.

The Avenue of the Core Founders was a large concourse which served as the pathway to the Senate Building's entrance on Coruscant. It was adorned with humanoid statues representing the original founders of the Galactic Republic, all of whom hailed from the Core Worlds.
Bastion was an industrialized planet located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. Also part of the New Territories, it was connected via hyperspace route to Anthan Prime.
Zequardia was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Zequardia system in the Dalchon sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It became the site of a battle during the Clone Wars.
New Coral City was a city on the Outer Rim ocean planet Mon Cala, homeworld of the Mon Calamari and Quarren species, that existed by 20 BBY.
The Hidden Cave was located in the Nightsister lair and was the home of Old Daka, who summoned the Army of the Dead to destroy the Separatist Droid Army which had attacked Dathomir.

Soun IV was an astronomical object with royalty in the Soun system of the Expansion Region in grid square J-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A humanoid princess from Soun IV visited the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant shortly before the Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY.
The Sub-Adult Group (SAGroup) was a youth-based organization consisting of enthusiastic youth members fervently loyal to Emperor Sheev Palpatine, the Galactic Empire, and the tenets of the New Order.

The planet Galidraan IV had at least two moons. One of these was considered its outermost moon.
The Battle of Foerost occurred by around 5 BBY, sharing its name with the terrestrial astronomical object Foerost.
Sector Monitors were civilian spy agencies that were part of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's Coalition for Progress.

t: Commission for a Safe and Secure Republic
x: The Commission for a Safe and Secure Republic was a nonprofit think tank based on Level 5121 of the planet Coruscant during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
a: Commision for a Safe and Secure Republic

x: The Shadow Stacks was the subterranean department of the Graf Archive on Orchis 2. The items that could not be immediately identified were stored there awaiting processing.
The Belnar Insurrections were a series of events that took place sometime by the year 3 ABY, taking place in the vicinity of the Colonies' Belnar system.
The battle on Phorsa Gedd took place during the Galactic Civil War between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire as part of the former's Mid Rim offensive of circa 1 ABY–2 ABY.

The Chargona campaign was a battle that involved the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry sometime by the year 3 ABY during the reign of the Galactic Empire. It took place in the vicinity of the Expansion Region's Chargona system.
In 0 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Nakari Kelen and fledging Jedi Luke Skywalker undertook a mission to Pasher.
A battle took place on the planet Phindar between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and Galactic Empire.

x: During the Galactic Civil War, in 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry undertook a raid on an Imperial heavy freighter.
During the Galactic Civil War, the CR90 corvette Thunderstrike was infiltrated at a rendezvous in the Elochar sector in 3 ABY.

During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems launched an attack on the planet Phindar. After the rise of the Galactic Empire, Moff Wilhuff Tarkin recalled the attack in a conversation with the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
The Concordian mines were a series of mines constructed on Concordia, the moon of the planet Mandalore.

The taqwa (which translated into "snow-strider" in Galactic Basic Standard) was a multi-headed, non-sentient quadruped hailing from the planet of Vallt. Despite their innate ferocity, the taqwa were used as draft animals by Vallt's native, blue faced sentients, the Valltii.

The Valltii were a sentient species native to the planet of Vallt. They were stout, with large round faces and mouths designed to chew meat, ice-blue skin, and lustrous growth of facial hair. According to Galen Erso, they were skilled stoneworkers.
Kaddak was a lawless planet located in the Kaddak system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, near Rothana. In the years of the New Republic, it was controlled by the Ranc Gang.

Vallt was a planet located in the Juris sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Valltii and Taqwa species, and also the birthplace of Jyn Erso. Vallt was a cold world, with half the planet covered in glacial ice.

objective: Retrieve C-3PO's operative from Kaddak and obtain the information abou
x: During the Cold War, the Resistance operatives Poe Dameron, C-3PO, BB-8, and the technician Oddy Muva undertook a mission to Kaddak to obtain secret information that would lead to the First Order's Supreme Leader Snoke.
Tambolor was a city located on the planet Vallt. During the Clone Wars, the scientist Galen Erso was held prisoner in the Tambolor prison.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic suffers heavy casualties
x: The massacre at Asyrphus took place on the terrestrial astronomical object Asyrphus, between the years 1 BBY and 3 ABY, when the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry faced a bombardment that saw the deaths of many of its troopers, including its comm tech and her droid.
Dreivus was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Oeiros sector's Dreivus system, within an intersecting portion of the Expansion Region and the Slice.

Druckenwell was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Druckenwell system in the Doldur sector of the Mid Rim. It was situated in grid square P-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid along the Corellian Run, at the head of another hyperlane that linked it to Bothawui.

Vurdon Ka was a planet located in the Vurdon Ka system in the Darlonn sector of the galaxy's Inner Rim that was the homeworld of the Vuvrian species. It was located close to one end of the Perlemian Trade Route, which connected it to the planets Castell and Chazwa.

A spaceport in the Outer Rim Territories was the site of a duel between two Jedi Finn Ertay and a Nikto Jedi and the brothers Darth Maul and Savage Opress around 19 BBY during the Clone Wars. The two Jedi were both killed during the battle.
R3-D3 was an R3-series astromech droid active during the Galactic Civil War.
Talrezan Four was the fourth orbit of the Talrezan system in the Tandon sector within an intersecting portion of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice.

Unroola Dawn was located in the Unroola Dawn system in the Mid Rim Territories' Doldur sector. Situated at the coordinates P-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid, it was affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Haidoral Administrative Center One was a city located on the Mid Rim planet Haidoral Prime. It was known as Glitter by the locals due to the crystal mountains that were located nearby.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Battle of the Tower was fought on the Outer Rim world Crucival between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry nineteen years after the Clone Wars. The Empire armed the civilians to help them defend the Crucival transmitter tower.
Vanzeist was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Suolriep sector's Vanzeist system, within an intersecting portion of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice regions.
The decimation on Magnus Horn took place sometime prior to 3 ABY, where the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry suffered heavy casualties on the terrestrial astronomical object Magnus Horn.
Magnus Horn was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Talcene sector's Magnus Horn system, within an intersecting portion of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice regions.

x: The Cylo Hijacking was an incident that occurred shortly after the Battle of Yavin when Tarkin Initiative Dr. Cylo and his fleet attempted to hijack the Executor, an Executor-class Star Dreadnought, while it was still in construction in the shipyards of Kuat Drive Yards.

A city was the capital of the planet Ankhural. Sometime before she joined the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, Brand came to the planet and the city had been enclosed by a ray shield that filtered out of the billowing dust of the surrounding silica plains.

A Geonosian empire was ruled by the Queen Karina on the desert planet Geonosis after it was sterilized by the Galactic Empire. Karina, however, was injured by the Empire, and lost the reproductive use of her womb.

The Ryn were a humanoid sentient species with white hair and prehensile tails. They were known to be itinerant and were rarely seen in the Core Worlds. Shortly before the end of the Clone Wars, two Ryn followed Lyra Erso only to offer a scintillating pendant.

A species of tentacled creatures lived on the planet Kelrodo-Ai during the early years of the Galactic Empire. The creatures, which were pink and red in color, lived in tunnels and laid gelatinous black eggs which they violently protected from intruders.

Grange was an agrarian planet located in the Kurost sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of Galen Erso, who drew the attention of Republic Futures Program scouts in Grange's sector.
A moon orbited the planet Vallt in the Outer Rim Territories.
During the Clone Wars, the planet Grange was besieged by the Confederacy of Independent Systems for a period of over two standard months.
The battle on Lokori was one of the last engagements of the Confederacy of Independent Systems in the Clone Wars against Galactic Republic fought on the planet of Lokori in 19 BBY.
Hypori was a remote planet located in the Hypori system in the Ferra sector of the Outer Rim Territories that had a hydrothermal landscape that was host to a Techno Union droid factory.
Mac-Vee was a nanny and housekeeping droid who served the Erso family. After leaving for Lah'mu, Jyn Erso admitted that she missed Mac-Vee, and wondered what the droid would do without them.
The Galactic Republic's Grand Army of the Republic—assisted by the Jedi Order—and the Confederacy of Independent Systems waged a battle on the planet Hypori in 22 BBY as part of the Clone Wars.
The Salient Campaign, also known as the Battle of Salient or as the campaign at Salient, was a multi-week battle that took place in the Salient system in 17 BBY.
Hangar Six was a hangar bay located onboard the First Order's Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Finalizer.
Bay Two was a launch bay located on the wall of Hangar Six onboard the First Order's Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Finalizer.
Alpinn was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories where Lyra Erso searched for kyber crystals. Alpinn reflected light in realspace due to the remnants of ancient mineral seas.
Assis was a TDK-160 research-assistant droid. Sometime before the rescue of Galen Erso, the droid worked with a group of scientists notably including Galen and Lyra Erso on the planet Vallt.
Espinar was a planet located in the Espinar system of the Core Worlds where Lyra Erso led a survey team, discovered and mapped a cave system that promised a bounty of rare crystalline deposits.

Hellenah was an astronomical object in the Hellenah system in the Xan sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square Q-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Sometime before 21 BBY, the Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt delivered munitions to Hellenah, garnering a hefty profit.

Lah'mu was a ringed agrarian planet in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its small population of settlers included the Erso family, who relocated to Lah'mu after the Clone Wars, and were ultimately tracked down by Director Orson Callan Krennic years later.

The Room of Morning Mists was a room in the Varykino lake retreat on the planet Naboo. The controversial poet Omar Berenko wrote one of his most famous works, the disturbing and visionary epic poem Defense of Naboo, in this room.

Atrisia, also known as Kitel Phard, was a Core Worlds celestial body featuring brush on its surface. Atrisian mythology included the demigod Wapoe, and at some point, the celestial body was ruled over by the Atrisian Emperors.

Bonadan was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories Corporate Sector that marked the start of the Hydian Way. By 10 BBY, the arms dealers Ephant Mon and Masse Goskey had attended an arms exchange on the planet.
R4 was an R-series astromech droid that flew with Scout Two. Along with Scout Two and Scout Three, R4 was destroyed when they discovered the First Death Star.

The Republic Corps of Engineers was an organization of the Galactic Republic. Its purpose was to construct and maintain facilities throughout the galaxy, both onworld and in deep space, for the use of the Republic.
Synistahg was an astronomical object in the Synistahg system in the Lothal sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In the year 2 BBY, the Galactic Empire blockaded Synistahg.

R3-A3 was an R3-series astromech droid and member of a local rebel cell on Mykapo called the Iron Squadron. He was responsible for maintaining the Sato's Hammer systems and customized it to its own specifications.

Mykapo was a planet located in the Mykapo system of the Outer Rim Territories.

SAGEducation (Sub-Adult Group Education) was an organization dedicated to the creation of curricula determined to shape young citizens into patriots. It was a branch of the Coalition for Progress's Sub-Adult Group.
Science was a sub-bureau that was a part of COMPNOR's Coalition for Progress. It was tasked with guiding research and development into new military applications.
The Sato's Hammer was a YT-2400 light freighter used by Iron Squadron.

Late in the Clone Wars, the Separatist cruiser Obrexta III was attacked in a sector of the galaxy by Galactic Republic forces en route to deliver clone trooper CT-6116 "Kix", who had been captured on Coruscant by Separatist forces, to Confederate leader Count Dooku's palace on…
Rudy was a green and white R2-series astromech droid known for its "gleeful" enjoyment of taking over systems and turning them against perceived enemies.

Suba was a planet located in the Atravis sector within the Outer Rim Territories. The Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt found the Malicious Moondog, a cantina on Suba, no more nastier than the cantina on Rajtiri, the Wanton Wellspring.

Jibuto was an ancient city located on the arid planet of Rajtiri. It was believed Jibuto prospered as a result of Rajtiri birthing and fostering more smugglers anywhere outside of Hutt Space.

Rajtiri was an arid planet in the Rajtiri system in the Dona Laza sector of the Expansion Region. It was safeguarded by thorny space-time anomalies, but still close enough to a couple of major hyperspace lanes that could permit effortless jumps to lightspeed.

The sneak attack on Roche was a surprise assault that took place during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict fought between the Galactic Republic and Separatist Alliance, at the Mid Rim's Roche Asteroid Field at some point between 21 BBY and 19 BBY.
The Chimaera was a modified Imperial I-class Star Destroyer captained by Imperial officer Thrawn during the Galactic Civil War.
Dressel was an remote astronomical object located in the Dressel system in the Noolian sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Dressellian species, including Has Obitt.

x: A research and development lab was located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant and run by Doctor Gubacher. The lab was utilized during the Clone Wars to outfit the astromech members of D-Squad with upgrades prior to their mission to steal a Separatist encryption module.
The Galactic Empire initiated a blockade over Synistahg in 2 BBY.

Eadu (pronounced /ˈiːduː/) was a storm-stricken planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It hosted the Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory prior to the outbreak of the Galactic Civil War, where Galen Erso and his team of scientists attempted to unlock the secrets of the kyber crysta…

t: Wedding of Lyra and Galen Erso
x: The wedding of Lyra and Galen Erso took place on the planet Coruscant in 25 BBY.

The Good Tidings was a light freighter owned by the Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt during the Clone Wars. It was agile, making it good at slipping through blockades. Obitt handled the freighter with skill, which had been learned through years of piloting.
The Cupola was a location on the planet Coruscant. At some point before the Campaign at Salient, the lawyer Arsha Lome and Governor Wilhuff Tarkin visited the Cupola.
The Koboks were a sentient species of skeletal insectoids.

The Tynnans were a species of furred and bucktoothed aquatic mammalian sentients from the planet Tynna. The species was adapted to freshwater environments and had sensitive snouts to make up for their poor eyesight.

The Trianii were a species of bipedal felinoid sentients from the Trian system. In an attempt to impress a Trianii debutante, Lando Calrissian once took a swing at the Esoomian brawler Bumblethunk, who beat him down and stole the Smuggler's Guide from him.
Jedha City, also known as the Holy City, NiJedha in the ancient texts, or simply Jedha, was an ancient walled city located on the desert moon of Jedha.

2-1B Delta was a 2-1B surgical droid who initially belonged to the Galactic Empire. While working throughout the military prison system, he developed an aversion to the damage done to organic flesh by Imperial weapons, which eventually prompted him to flee.

"Pinprick" was the nickname the Rebels of the Anoat sector gave to an IT-O interrogator droid they salvaged from an inexplicable wrecked starship. It could not speak, its memories were encoded, and strange things would happen wherever it went.
The Good Tidings V was a starship owned by the Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt that replaced his old light freighter the Good Tidings.

Merj spaceport control was an organization based in Merj spaceport on the planet Merj. The Dressellian smuggler had a good rapport with agents of Merj spaceport control which convinced Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic that Obitt could be as trusted as any smuggler.
Hiitians were a species of human-sized sentient avians. They had feathers growing from their backs.
