x: During the Clone Wars, a HoloNet news station reported that a Separatist cell was exposed and attacked on the planet Coruscant. Several members of the cell were killed whilst several others were captured.

During the Clone Wars, a Separatist cell operated on the planet Coruscant. At some point during the war, HoloNet news station reported that the cell had been exposed with several members killed and several others captured.
The Senate Square was located in Republic City on the planet Hosnian Prime.

The Central District was a sector of Galactic City on the planet Coruscant that contained the Central District spaceport, the Imperial Energy Division headquarters, the Institute of Applied Science, and the Llanter Plaza.

Reamma was a planet located in the Reamma system in the Corbett sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance to Restore the Republic set up a temporary base, LX-Robynsun V, on Reamma.
Aria Prime was a planet in the Aria Prime system of the Inner Rim Territories that was where Lyra Erso was born around 48 BBY. Lyra's mother lived and worked on Aria Prime as an artist.
A museum was a located next to the Peace and Security station in Coronet City on the planet Corellia. The museum shared a basement with the P&S building and used it to store a bunch of artifacts.
Salient I was a planet located in the Salient system of the Aparo sector in the Outer Rim Territories, along the Hydian Way.

Salient II was a planet located in the autonomous Salient system, on the edge the Corporate Sector. In 18 BBY, the planet, along with the rest of the system, resisted what they perceived as intrusion by the Galactic Empire in a hard-fought, prolonged campaign.
Skorii-Lei was an aquatic planet within the galaxy that Princess Leia Organa traveled to sometime after the Battle of Yavin.

objective: Recover cargo containers of weapons and ship parts
x: In 3 BBY, Sabine Wren and Garazeb Orrelios went on a mission to Thune City to recover cargo containers full of weapons and ship parts on behalf of the rebellion.

In 3 BBY, a remote planetoid was the site of a scrap pile operated by two Xot named Bidvel and Davil. As indicated by the presence of a dome shield over the scrap pile, the planetoid lacked an atmosphere.
Gruthic Winged Beasts were large non-sentient creatures having a pair of wings, two heads perched atop long flexible necks, a long tail, scaly gray-green skin and four limbs ending in sharp claws.

The Llanter Plaza was a plaza located in the Central District on Coruscant. During the Clone Wars, Lyra Erso ducked into a corridor that ended at the southeast of Llanter Plaza whilst working out to find some breathing space.
Wynkahthu was a gas giant in the Mid Rim Territories with turbulent atmospheric storms located near Ord Mantell.
The Lokori were a stalklike insectoid species with green blood native to the planet Lokori.
A sentient species of avians were native to the planet Malpaz. During the Clone Wars the species began integrating with colonists from all over the sector.
The Xidelphiads were a sentient species in the galaxy. Individuals within the species would change sex at several points in their life, and would do so by encasing themselves in a chrysalis.

Lokori was the home planet to the species of the same name. It was near Ryloth and had a pleasant atmosphere. The planet had a rainy season. The capital city was Fucallpa, which was home to Helical HyperCom, a producer of personal comm devices.
Malpaz was a planet that during the Clone Wars suffered invasions from both the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It was home to an avian species.

Fucallpa was the capital city of the planet Lokori. According to Lyra Erso, it looked like an "enormous flower bed" due to the riotous colors and shapes of the city's basketlike buildings and spiked domes.

x: In 2 BBY, the Spectres joined forces with the pirate Hondo Ohnaka and the crime lord Azmorigan in a mission to loot an Imperial cargo ship.

Nanth'ri was a planet located in the Nanth'ri system in the Kurost sector within the galaxy's Mid Rim. It sat along the Trax Tube hyperspace route and was the western endpoint of the Nanth'ri Trade Route.
Amboo Square was a location in the city Fucallpa on the planet Lokori. During the Clone Wars, a battle was fought on Lokori between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic.

The B'ankora were a sentient species of ruminants in the galaxy. Their homeworld suffered a cataclysmic collision with a meteor at some point before around 1300 BBY, which led the Galactic Republic to give them a small sanctuary, that eventually became the B'ankor Refuge, on t…
The Epiphany moon was the exemplary moon of the planet Epiphany. It was the location of the Zerpen Industries headquarters.

Kanzi was a planet located in the Colonies region. A few months after the end of the Clone Wars, the scientist Galen Erso, his wife Lyra and their daughter Jyn rendezvoused with Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic on Kanzi in the Orona Hotel, where Krennic used kyber crystals t…

Kartoosh was an astronomical object in the Western Reaches and Narrant sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was located along the Cerean Reach hyperspace route. The massive construction and overhaul facility was a shipyard stationed over Kartoosh that saw design work in 23 BBY.

Epiphany was the outermost of three planets that orbited a red dwarf star in the Salient system, in the Aparo sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its moon was the location of the headquarters of Zerpen Industries.
RB-551 was an older model B1-series battle droid who served within the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

The rocket stormtroopers, also known as rocket launcher stormtroopers or Demolition Troopers were specialized stormtroopers equipped with large, shoulder-fired missile launchers that allowed them to damage vehicles and buildings from a great distance.

Kothal market was a marketplace in Kothal on the planet Lothal. The human farmer Morad Sumar sold fruit in the Kothal market.

Sap drinkers were non-sentient insects that could be found on the planet of Devaron. They had a teardrop-shaped, iridescent blue body that featured two pairs of crystal-like wings and a barbed stinger, which they used as a defense against creatures that might attack their nests.

Skorii-Lei Fish Market was a market located in a city, on the planet Skorii-Lei. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, Pash Davane went to Skorii-Lei Fish Market to get medicine for Princess Leia Organa who she had saved from drowning.
Bruce was a RIC-series general labor droid that was owned by the human female Pash Davane.

The B'ankor Refuge, or B'ankora Refuge, was a small sanctuary on Coruscant given by Supreme Chancellor Chasen Piian of the Galactic Republic in perpetuity to surviving members of the B'ankora species during the waning years of the Republic.

Fulan Ro was a town located on the Cosmatanic Steppes, in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy.

Wobani was a temperate planet partially hidden by a swirling dust cloud, located in the Wobani system, in the Bryx sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. During the Imperial Era, the planet was used by the Galactic Empire as a site for labor and prison camps.

Corellian Academy of Sciences was a Corellian institution. Its members notably studied the rathtars for years, but they only managed to discover very little about them, because of the difficulty to investigate the species closely without being attacked or eaten.
At some point before around 1300 BBY, the homeworld of the B'ankora species suffered a cataclysmic collision with a meteor.
The homeworld of the B'ankora species was a planet in the galaxy. At some point before around 1300 BBY, the planet suffered a cataclysmic collision with a meteor.

Thrawn's Offices were the personal offices of Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn. His main office was located aboard his personal Star Destroyer Chimaera. He also had another office in the Imperial Armory Complex.
A planet located in Wild Space was home to the trading and supply base Havoc Outpost. A terrestrial world situated in Standard Galactic Grid square S-19, it appeared bluish from space.

Spamels were blue- or purple-skinned, long-legged riding creatures native to the desert moon of Jedha. The beasts featured a thick neck that carried their wedge-shaped head.
Sometime after the Battle of Endor, a battle was fought over the planet Kuat. During the battle, the New Republic captured an Imperial dreadnought whilst it underwent repairs.

During the Galactic Civil War, Imperial forces ambushed soldiers of the New Republic at Govneh Ridge on the planet Nag Ubdur. Despite losing a number of men and women, the New Republic was able to capture Govneh Ridge.

During the Galactic Civil War, the population of the merchant city Binjai-Tin were massacred by the Galactic Empire. During the Battle of Nag Ubdur, the massacre was discovered by members of the New Republic Thirty-First including Private Rorith Khadur.

Malgan Market was a market located in the city of Iziz on the Inner Rim jungle planet Onderon. As a central hub in the city, merchants and traders sold goods, including many types of fruit, in the market.

Sector S-11 was an area on the planet Onderon that was suspected by the occupying Confederacy of Independent Systems to contain a secret base maintained by the Onderon rebels. However, the Onderon Rebels' true base was located in Sector S-29 at the time.
Sector S-29 was an area on the planet Onderon that was home to the Onderon rebels' secret base around 20 BBY. It was also the site of a small battle in the Onderonian Civil War as well.
Pretor Flats was a location on the far side of the planet Lothal from Capital City's Academy for Young Imperials that was home to Pretor Flats Academy, a less prestigious Imperial Academy.

DLC-13 was a DLC-13 mining droid who worked at an ore mine in the Belgaroth asteroid field following the Battle of Hoth. DLC-13 was carrying out his duties in the processing plant when Rowan Freemaker, who was in trance-like state, was carried in the droid's pot.
Merchant's Bridge was one of the biggest thoroughfares in Thune City, the capital of the planet Thune. A large bridge spanning a canal, it was covered with market stalls and merchants.
Aphra's crew was the grouping of various bounty hunters, assassins, and other allies who worked with the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra at any given time.
Mikkia was a planet with a variety of climates located in the galaxy's Expansion Region, and home to the Mikkian species. Mikkia was a member of the Galactic Republic for thousands of years.
K-OHN (or KONE) was a manumitted L-1 tactical droid that provided people with his programmed skills in exchange for energy and credits.

In 13 BBY, renowned scientist Dr. Galen Erso was captured by Orson Krennic, Director of the Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research agency, and his personal squad of death troopers.
The Profundity was an MC75 Star Cruiser commanded by Admiral Raddus that served in the Alliance Fleet. It was notably present during the Battle of Scarif.
The Ark Angel II, formerly known as the Ark Angel, was a modified Bellicose-class heavy lifter owned by the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra.

Abersyn symbiotes were a species which fed on the brain stem of sentient species. They had to be fed into a plasma furnace in order to keep them in a quiescent state, though a regular exposure to a plasma vent was proven to have the same effect on them.
SW-0608 was a Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle stolen from the Galactic Empire by the Alliance to Restore the Republic and used by the squad Rogue One during the Battle of Scarif.

Kyber mines were located on the moon Jedha. Rogue Rebel leader Saw Gerrera led several attacks on Jedha's mines and cargo shipments. After that, the Imperial Star Destroyer Dauntless was moved over Jedha City to provide security and serve as a deterrent to further attacks.
Fest was a cold, mountainous planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Atrivis sector. It was the forged homeworld of the adopted boy Kassa, later renamed Cassian Jeron Andor.

Anomids were a sentient species that were native to Yablari. Because they lacked vocal cords, they communicated with one another through a sophisticated and subtle combination of hand and body language.
The Britarro were a mysterious sentient humanoid species that were native to Britaxis Minor. Nik Hepho was a Britarro who worked as a bounty hunter.

Queen of the Core Network was a HoloNet news network active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Two of its employees were the human journalist Tracene Kane and the Trandoshan cameraman Lug.

Talpini were a sentient species native to Tal Pi. Weeteef Cyu-Bee, a member of the Partisans, was a member of this species.

The Ring of Kafrene, also referred to simply as Kafrene, was a mining colony and deep-space trading post in the Kafrene asteroid belt of the Thand sector.

The Central Isopter was a death-worshipping cult whose members frequented areas of violence, meditating on matters of mortality.

The Military Police was the law enforcement branch of the Galactic Republic's military during the Clone Wars.
Wetyin was a continent located on Yavin 4, a jungle moon of the gas giant Yavin. It notably housed the Massassi Site, home of the Great Temple.
Starloft was a continent located on Yavin 4, a jungle moon of the gas giant Yavin.
The Massassi Site was a region of Yavin 4, a jungle moon of the gas giant Yavin, that housed a number of ancient monuments built by the vanished Massassi people, including the enormous Great Temple.

Nystullum was an underwater city located beneath the northern ice floes of the planet Mon Cala. Prior to the Galactic Civil War, the starship Profundity was the city's civic governance tower.

Lorrdians were a sentient bipedal species that gave off a distinctive natural scent and had a very expressive body language. Lorrdian members of the Brotherhood of the Beatific Countenance wore concealing robes that acted as a physical vow of silence.
The Vobati were a little-known sentient species that were native to Vobes. Valwid Ined was a member of this species.
Eadu Flight Station was a shuttle depot located at the Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory on the planet Eadu during the Age of the Empire.
The Kafrene asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in the Thand sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region that contained the Ring of Kafrene.
Sativran City was a city located on the planet Lexrul. Director Orson Krennic was born in Sativran City around 52 BBY.

The Commenor Underground was a rebel cell that fought against the Galactic Empire during its reign. Around 10 BBY, it briefly worked with Saw Gerrera's extremist Partisans. Arhul Nemo was a member of this group.

The Path of Judgments was a location in Jedha City, a large, walled city on the cold, desert moon of Jedha. The Path of Judgments and the rest of NiJedha were destroyed by a single-reactor superlaser blast from the newly-operational Death Star.

The Dome of Deliverance was a location in Jedha City, a large, walled city on the cold, desert moon of Jedha. Before the Galactic Empire had arrived on Jedha, some of the orphans were brought to live there, or at the Temple of the Kyber or Waiting of Night.
SW-1721 was a Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle used by the Galactic Empire to transport turbolaser barrel sleeves to the Imperial security complex on Scarif.
SW-4415 was a Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle used by the Galactic Empire to transport deflector shield matrix circuitry to the Imperial security complex on Scarif.

During the Clone Wars, an insurrectionist cell, backed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, operated in the wilds of the Outer Rim Territories fighting against the Galactic Republic.

Essie was Jyn Erso's name for an SE-2 worker droid who worked on the farm of Galen Erso, keeping an eye on the horizon for any intruders. Despite being a menial labor droid, Essie had a very pronounced loyalty subroutine.
R3-S1, nicknamed "Threece," was an R3-series astromech droid with feminine programming that served as part of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Adalog was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Adalog system within the Slice portion of the Mid Rim Territories. Situated in the Mytaranor sector, it lay at the coordinates Q-10 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Agricultural Corps, also known as the AgriCorps, was one of the four branches of the Service Corps of the Jedi Order.

Tonekh was a city located on the planet Kupoh. The city was populated by the Kupohan, a sentient species native to the planet. It was built inside of a mountain valley, which protected it from Kupoh's harsh winds.

x: The Republic Special Weapons Group was an agency responsible for the development of advanced weapons technologies for use by the Galactic Republic.

The Clan of the Toribota was a nomadic enclave native to the planet Isde Naha. After astronomical conjecture pointed the enclave to the desert moon of Jedha, they believed the star in the system to be the First Light, the first star glimpsed by their early ancestors.
Isde Naha was an Outer Rim Territories world situated in the Yarith sector and at the intersection of the Corellian Trade Spine and Lipsec Run hyperspace routes.

Jenoport was a location in the Jenoport system of the Colonies. Sometime before the mission to Eadu, K-2SO found Cassian Andor on Jenoport staring at his blaster with tears on his face after committing an act that even General Davits Draven was not aware of.

Chemvau was a location in the galaxy. After escaping a prison in the Catacombs of Cadera on Jedha, Cassian Andor considered leaving Jyn Erso behind like he had left men behind on Chemvau and Eiloroseint.
Eiloroseint was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Eiloroseint system in the Tokamac sector of the Expansion Region.
The Imperial Ball was a lavish, formal party that was held in the Imperial Palace on Coruscant every year on Empire Day.

Trohlu, also known as Alethea, was the only moon orbiting Aleen, a planet in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim. A yellow, rocky satellite, Trohlu lacked an atmosphere, though it did host an observation post and a listening station established by the Galactic Empire.

The Sabat were a sentient species in the galaxy. The Sabat had blue, pink, or tan colored skin, large foreheads and flattened heads. Leevan Tenza, a member of Saw Gerrera's Partisans, was a Sabat. Gelan Yees was a Sabat member of the Cloud-Riders.

A DH-Omni Support Vessel was in service of the Confederacy of Independent Systems' navy during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic. The supply ship crashed on the planet Agamar in the Outer Rim Territories during a battle between Republic and Separatist forces.
Tythoni Square was a municipal area in the Holy Quarter of Jedha's Holy City that shared its name with the Deep Core planet Tython.

Heavy Shoretroopers were coastal defender stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire who had undergone specialized training in the use of heavy ordnance. They were equipped with large reciprocating quad blaster cannons, DLT-19 heavy blaster rifles, and Z-6 rotary blaster cannons.
Montellian Serat was the capital city of the planet Devaron.

Plaeree was an ancient city on the planet Devaron. The Point of Parting that stood at the gates of the city's spaceport was claimed to be the original plaza that inspired other cities to establish a point of parting at every starport on the planet.

The Wanderer's Path was a road that ran through the thick vine jungles of the planet Devaron. Adolescents would accompany experienced Wanderers on expeditions out into the dense jungles as part of a formal rite of passage established during the planet's history.

Stellar Sphere was one of several Imperial projects developed in secret by the Tarkin Initiative. The technical schematics for Stellar Sphere were kept at the Citadel Tower on Scarif, along with those of Project War-Mantle and the Death Star.

Bamayar IX was a gas giant formed of emerald- and turquoise-colored gas clouds. Between 7 BBY and around 5 BBY, the trainee pilot Bodhi Rook skillfully flew a Nu-class transport through the clouds of Bamayar IX with a number of his classmates in the Galactic Empire's Terrabe S…

Ankhela was a city on the Iktotchi homeworld Iktotch, the third moon of Iktotchon.
Lonalaka was a city on the Iktotchi homeworld Iktotch, the third moon of Iktotchon.

The Apostate was a starship owned by the bounty hunter Nik Hepho. While Hepho was searching for adherents of the Church of the Force in Jedha City on the moon Jedha in the year 1 BBY, the ship hovered in orbit above, operated by a droid intelligence that waited for the hunter …

Yelsain was an astronomical object in the galaxy that was covered in dense forests and was home to humans who dwelled in the wilds. Wion Dillems was a member of the Tree Dweller tribes native to the world.

Generis was an Outer Rim astronomical object part of the Atrivis sector. It served as a regional headquarters and operations sector for Senator Mon Mothma's organized rebellion against the Galactic Empire.

Fresia was a terrestrial planet in the Core Worlds' Torranix sector that was home to the Coromon Headhunter. During the Clone Wars, the world's Galactic Republic senator, Seti Ashgad, simply vanished.

Broadberry Meadow was a secluded cliff and riverside garden located in the capital city Theed on the planet Naboo by the year 32 BBY. The garden contained a hexagonal building with beige walls and a domed green roof built amongst the grass and trees of the meadow.

The Ellié Arcadium was a circular building with tan-colored walls and a turquoise dome that matched the style of other buildings in Theed, the capital city of the human Naboo culture on the planet Naboo.
The Caves of Eleuabad were a network of water-filled underwaterways within the porous structure of the planet Naboo.

Asterios was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Asterios system in the Narrant sector of the Mid Rim Territories where the Alliance to Restore the Republic had a base prior to moving to a new one on the Outer Rim world Reamma.

Archaeo-Prime was a structure located on the Cosmatanic Steppes, a mantle of land suspended over a gas giant in the Outer Rim Territories. Archaeo-Prime was maintained by the Archaeological Association.
Black-Saber was a code name for a data tape in the Galactic Empire's data vault on Scarif. Rebel Alliance member Jyn Erso mentioned it while searching for the Death Star's plans.

Lamproids were a carnivorous sentient, serpentine species that were native to Florn. They were well adapted to the dangerous environment of their homeworld, protecting themselves against dangerous lifeforms with their teeth, serpentine coils, and venomous tails.

The Holy Quarter was a location in the Holy City on the moon Jedha. During the Battle on Jedha, Jyn Erso saved the young girl Pendra Siliu from the fighting occurring there between the Galactic Empire and Saw Gerrera's Partisans.

The Eedit Road was a road that ran straight through the thick vine jungles of the planet Devaron. Joining the town of Tikaroo and the Temple of Eedit, the road was built by the Jedi Order and made of red stone.

Berchest was an astronomical object located in the Berchest system in the Anthos sector of the Inner Rim Territories. In 4 ABY, General Hera Syndulla led a New Republic strike at Berchest in hopes of capturing Imperial Yachts and securing useful data.

Thyferra was a planet located in the Inner Rim Territories, lying on the Rimma Trade Route. It was the homeworld of the Vratix species, who invented the substance bacta and eventually became addicted to it.

Cona was a desert planet located in the Cona system in the galaxy's Inner Rim that was the homeworld of the Arcona species. Hem Dazon, a male Arcona frequently spent time in the Mos Eisley cantina after becoming stranded on Tatooine.
Marsh spiders were a type of spider that could be found stalking the swamps of the planet Dagobah.
The Promenade of Seven Guilds was a ceremonial avenue and the main thoroughfare in Pau City on the planet Utapau.

Mos Taike was a settlement built on the western edge of the Northern Dune Sea on the north side of the Mospic High Range in the small habitable region in the northern hemisphere of the desert planet Tatooine.

Kinyen was an agriworld located in the Kinyen system in the Bes Ber Bikade sector of the Expansion Region, on a junction with the Corellian Trade Spine and the Great Gran Run. It was the original homeworld of the Gran species.
Kinrah was a planet located in the star system of the same name in the Mid Rim Territories.
The Chandrila Mistress was a Taylander shuttle used by the former Imperial senator and rebel leader Mon Mothma. It was equipped with a signature modulator to mask its true identity.

Columus was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Core Worlds which was the homeworld of the Columi. The pirate queen Maz Kanata hid a portion of the spoils from her reign there in a buried vault equipped with an antitamper sub-space alarm.

Tammuz-an was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Shortly after the end of the Clone Wars, the kingdom of Tammuz-an purchased a batch of R-22 prototypes from Kuat Systems Engineering designers for their planetary defense fleet, after the Galactic Empire rej…
Quarrow was the capital city of the planet Nakadia. In 5 ABY, the New Republic Senate transferred its headquarters from Hanna City, Chandrila, to Quarrow.
RA-7-D4 was an RA-7 protocol droid who served aboard the First Order Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Finalizer as a spy for the Resistance.
Mucktown was the main settlement of the Mud dwellers of Vagadarr Prime.
The Quaggians were a sentient species from the Quaggia system. They were known for having a hand gesture called the Quaggian hand turtle, which meant "It's great" or "Something's great."

Beznaz was an astronomical object located in the Beznaz system in the Quiberon sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During a mission to the Kinrah system, Ezra Bridger, Mizel Pomdak, and Reann Tomvig posed as refugees from Beznaz en route for Camson.
The twilight of the Ordu Aspectu was a confrontation fought at the Citadel of Rur in 0 ABY between the crew of the archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra and Captain Magna Tolvan of the Galactic Empire.

objective: Extract Leia Organa from Skorii-Lei

x: During the Cold War, Admiral Gial Ackbar of the Resistance sent J-Squadron on a scavenging mission to the planet Vodran.
Smarab was an astronomical object located in the Mid Rim Territories.
R3-W5 was a hexagonal-domed astromech droid that flew with Temmin Wexley in his T-65C-A2 X-wing starfighter during the Battle of Jakku.

Kergans was a urban planet located in the Kergans system within the Inner Rim Territories that was protected by the New Republic. It was the homeworld of Lorica Demaris. A hotel owned by Lorica's mother and father was located on Kergans.

The Eleutherian Plaza was a large plaza in Hanna City that housed the Chandrila Senate house following the Battle of Endor. The Chandrila Senate house housed the New Republic's Galactic Senate between 4 ABY and 5 ABY. It was near the Old Gather-House and the Senate Plaza.
Ammon IV was a hot, barren planet located in the Ammon system in the Ciutric sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
A scutjumper was a nocturnal creature which scavenged on the planet Taris.

AG-90 (Aygee-Ninety), was a "monster droid" built by the scavenger mother of Dec Hansen. The boy had no siblings, so his mother built AG-90 out of various parts, including the head of a J9 and the torso of an agromech.

objective: Steal the Imperial clearance codes for Lothal
x: In the year 2 BBY, Phoenix Cell dispatched Phoenix Leader Hera Syndulla and her Spectres crew on a mission to recover Imperial codes from the Imperial Security Bureau station on Killun 71 for the Alliance to Restore the Republic's attack on Lothal.

The molator was an aggressive creature from Alderaan. They appeared in Alderaanian mythology, where they were considered to be a magical creature, with an specific mythological individual known as "Grimtaash the Molator".

Killun 71 was a moon located in the Killun Station system within the Pakuuni sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was occupied by the Galactic Empire in the years leading up to the Galactic Civil War.
PZ-7 was a feminine RA-7 protocol droid who served the Galactic Empire in 2 BBY as an inventory droid at Killun Station, an Imperial Security Bureau base located on the moon Killun 71.
R3-M2 was an R3-series astromech droid that served the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

R5-SK1 was an R5 series astromech droid that served as part of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Red Squadron. It was stationed on the moon of Yavin 4 as part of the Massassi Group of Rebels headquartered in the Great Temple.
Noe'ha'on was a jungle world located in the Noe'ha'on system, a part of the Piryn Shar sector of the Expansion Region.
Molavar was an astronomical object located in the Abrion sector's Molavar system within an intersecting portion of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice regions.

The northern market district was the northern district of Capital City, the aptly-named capital city of the planet Lothal. It contained Ake's Tavern and an express speeder bus ran between the district and Capital City spaceport, with only a single stop in between them.
RX-48 was an RX-series pilot droid with a masculine programming. He once piloted pleasure liners for the Galactic Tourist Bureau, until he accidentally crashed a tour bus into a space station.
Pelikki were a species of non-sentient, river-dwelling birds from the planet Naboo. They had an expandable throat pouch in which they held their aquatic prey when hunting.
Keejins were a species that inhabited the galaxy. They were likely to be encountered in caves.
Xala's moon was a moon located in the Xala system, in Wild Space that orbited the planet Xala. Approximately 89.94 percent of its surface was covered in frozen oceans.
Pion was a planet located in the Pion system within Wild Space.

The Star Herald was a top-of-the-line prototype scout ship that was developed by the Galactic Empire around 18 BBY. It had a long, arrow-like hull supporting a tractor beam projector, and it housed at least one probe that could go underwater.

A special and secure conference room was located on the officer's deck of the Overbridge of the Death Star battle station. Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin held regular meetings with his senior staff in that room.
Lutrillia was a planet in the Yarith sector, a subsector of the Javin sector of the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Agaris was a planet with a damp, clammy climate located on the very edge of Wild Space and was the adopted homeworld of the Agarian species.

Ya-ya flies, also known as yaya flies, were a type of fly native to the jungle world Akiva. They were purple with a pair of wings, four appendages and a long needle like protrusion sticking out from their head.

Lund Gourley was a farming city located on the planet Durkteel.

Ques was a swampy planet in the Ques system near the inner border of Hutt Space, and its population primarily consisted of scavengers, such as Dec Hansen. The axton-tarsier, the ferin, the slime crab, and the Snarlap were creatures native to Ques.
Fjor-bats were a species of flying creatures native to the star system that became the site of a battle between Resistance pilot Poe Dameron and the forces of Lord Terex.

AD-97R was a Viper probe droid who resided in the Anoat sector at the time of the Iron Blockade. He was reprogrammed by scavengers to seek pillage on Hoth, AD-97R had developed an extreme attachment to and fondness for its controllers.

The Strikefast was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in service to the Galactic Empire's naval forces. It was the site of a meeting between the Chiss Mitth'raw'nuruodo, Imperial Captain Voss Parck, Colonel Mosh Barris, and Cadet Eli Vanto.

Skups were a humanoid sentient species with long arms, stooped shoulders, four fingers per hand, a bulbous abdomen, a pair of close-set eyes, and a long nose. Antha Mont was a female Skup affiliated with the Resistance.

Dun thackstons were a non-sentient species of birds that could be found in the swamps of Vodran. Bearing a symbiotic relationship with sarlaccs, they built their nests out of sticks and mud over sarlacc pits so that wandering animals mistook the hole for solid ground and fell …
Tufted cackys were a species of non-sentient birds found on the swamp planet of Vodran. Although their plumage was mostly brown for camouflage, they had bright pink spots on their chests.

The Needles was an area in the Jundland Wastes region of the desert planet Tatooine. The nomadic Tusken Raiders native to Tatooine would concentrate into semi-permanent camps in the Needles during the planet's stormy season and the hottest times of year, waiting there until a …
Outer Curved Street was a street in Mos Eisley on Tatooine.
Spacers Row was a street in Mos Eisley on Tatooine. Spaceport Express and Quebe-Luxfause Systems headquarters were located on this road. One of his ramifications was the Paradise Road.

Cell Block 4227 was a cell block located in the Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817 on the planet Wobani.

LMTR-20 was a UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft that was owned by the Rebel Alliance during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire. It was used by Captain Cassian Andor, Jyn Erso, and K-2SO during Operation Fracture.
The Notch was a narrow opening of Beggar's Canyon on Tatooine.

B'Thazoshe Bridge was a rock formation in the Jundland Wastes on Tatooine. Formed by ancient drainage channels, B'Thazoshe Bridge was the largest natural bridge on the planet, and it was considered sacred by the native Tusken Raiders.

Thrawn's sparring gym was a room designed and equipped for exercise aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Chimaera, the flagship of Grand Admiral Thrawn. In that room, the Grand Admiral used to train in hand-to-hand combat by fighting DT-series sentry droids.

Ysalamiri were four-eyed, lizard-like creatures. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn had two sculptures of ysalamiri made out of green, brown, and yellow material in his office aboard the Chimaera, placed behind his desk.
The Redeemer was an assault frigate that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.

The Amity was a Starhawk-class Battleship Mark I that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY. The Amity took part in the Battle of Jakku where it was subsequently destroyed.
The Unity was a Starhawk-class Battleship Mark I that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY. The Unity took part in the Battle of Jakku.

The ginzy was a thick-bodied, monkey-like creature with a chunky clay-colored and blond plumage and black eyes. It stood on two skinny legs, and its tiny hands ended in hooked talons, which the creature used for defensive purposes.

Bassa hounds were a type of heavy-hoofed dog. During the Imperial Era, a bassa hound belonged to the personal zoo of Harra the Hutt on the planet Vodran. By the New Republic Era, bassa hounds were trained as hunting companions at Kergans Academy.

Blue One was a T-65 X-wing starfighter that was used by Rebel Alliance pilot General Antoc Merrick. Merrick notably used Blue One during the Battle of Scarif, where he was killed when his fighter was shot down.
Fathiers were a species of quadrupeds that resided in the galaxy. They were often used as mounts, and wealthy inhabitants of Kergans and Cantonica rode them in competition.
The Kergans Security Force was the law enforcement agency of the planet Kergans.

Aurek-14 was an excavation site on the planet Scarif. Located on the tropical world's southern hemisphere, this site was operated by the Galactic Empire during its occupancy of Scarif for the development of top-secret Imperial Military projects including construction of the De…

The orphan farm of Lund Gourley, Durkteel, was a farm in which orphans under the care of Marn grew and harvested hemmel crops. Marn provided her wards with water and food, and would often send them to the local Phirmist temple by drift shuttle.

The Cirque Glacier was a glacier located on the ice-covered planet Hoth. It was located north of the Clabburn Range of mountains and south of the North Ridge and Lanteel Glacier. The Hanging Valley sat to the west of the Cirque Glacier and the Nev Ice Flow lay to the east.
The E'Y-Akh Desert was located on the planet Geonosis.

During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, Galen Erso was in charge of a field team of scientists while examining crystals in a cave system on the planet Espinar. Lyra, a human female who would go on to marry Erso and bear his child, served as their guide.

R4-P44 was a R4-P Astromech that was assigned to Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi's clone trooper forces while stationed on Utapau. The droid, like R4-P17 and R4-G9, had the dome of a R2 unit.
Straight Street was a street in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. Kerner Plaza ran off this road, as well as the Mos Eisley prefecture militia base.

The Elom were a mysterious sentient species that were native to Elom who lived in frozen grottos. They were short and stocky, and covered in thick, oily fur. As a result of living in darkness, Eloms had exceptional eyesight, but found natural or bright lights intolerable.
KMD-RA-71 was a silver-plated RA-7 protocol droid that served the Galactic Empire. It was present in Jedha City on the moon Jedha in 1 BBY.
The Orion was a Braha'tok-class gunship that was in service of the Massassi Group, a Rebel cell led by General Jan Dodonna.
Clan Saxon, also known as the Saxon clan, was a Mandalorian clan of House Vizsla.
The Vanguard was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate commanded by General Jan Dodonna that was a part of the Rebel Alliance's fleet.
Ingo was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Ingo system in the Bortele sector of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice, falling within grid square R-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor was an Interdictor-class heavy cruiser commanded by Imperial Admiral Kassius Konstantine during the Battle of Atollon.

The Black Forest was a forest on Kashyyyk that had been dead millennia before 5 ABY. The native Wookiees believed that the area had been poisoned by a darkness, and some believed that the Black Forest was cursed and haunted by bad spirits.
Slime crabs were a species of crab that could be found in the swamps of Ques. They were also edible to humans.
Ton-biri was a city on the planet Devaron.
Assarda was a city on the planet Devaron.

The Room of a Thousand Fountains was a massive seven-story greenhouse located in the First Knowledge Quarter behind the arcade depicting Liberation of Coruscant within the ziggurat base of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

Accipipteros were a type of large, birdlike reptavians native to the planet of Dagobah. Flying predators, they were the uncontested rulers of the swamp world's jungle canopies, where they spent their entire lives in the branches of gnarltrees.

Corporations Road was a street in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. It contained the Customs House. It was on this street where a Jawa fell off a startled ronto during Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi's traverse through the city.

x: In 18 BBY, Milo and Lina Graf mounted a heist to retrieve the head of their droid CR-8R, which the Mon Calamari crime lord Rask Odai kept in his office at the Twin Horns Storage building.

Freedom of Naboo was a regular celebration held on the edge of the Lianorm Swamp on the planet Naboo in the years following the Gungan and Naboo victory against occupying Trade Federation forces during the Battle of Naboo in 32 BBY.
Kreuge's Revenge was a Razor-class frigate in service with the navy of the Galactic Empire around 0 ABY. At the time, it was commanded by Lieutenant Pyparr.

R5-D8 was an R5 series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Massassi Group during the Galactic Civil War. During the Battle of Yavin, it flew with Rebel pilot Jek Porkins as Red Six.
R3-A2 was an orange and white R3-series astromech droid. It was seen in the Rebel base during the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.

type: Neo-Imperialist polity comprised of several Imperial holdouts
x: The Imperial Remnant, alternatively capitalized as the Imperial remnant and also known as the Remnant Empire or neo-Imperial forces—was a large neo-Imperialist polity made up of several remnant factions of the Galactic Empire that refused to comply with the terms of the Galact…

The Devil's Doorknob was a part of the hazardous Boonta Eve Classic course, located at the end of The Corkscrew. It was considered a very tough part of the arena, and many individuals had died in the Devil's Doorknob.
The Shadowlands, designated as Sector 7 by the Galactic Empire, were dark forests on the planet Kashyyyk. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Kashyyyk resistance hid in the Shadowlands.

The big game hunter Gozetta owned a sleek blunt-nosed shuttle. It was black and gold, with platinum bearings, had eight ion engines, and a rear hatch. Its design greatly resembled the Botajef SS-54 assault ship.
AT-ACT drivers were Galactic Empire army or navy units who piloted All Terrain Armored Cargo Transports.

Regor-Mada was a terrestrial astronomical object that was the homeworld of J'mi, a young alien who ended up joining the Resistance. It was located in the Regor-Mada system in the Tantra sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square M-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Keredians were a species of humanoids whose members were thinly spread around the galaxy. Little information existed about them, including their homeworld.
The Moveable Feast was a freighter starship that belonged to the bounty hunter Shalla Mondatha, also known as "the Shade."

M-OC was an Imperial hunter droid which was created by Emperor Sheev Palpatine and was tasked with locating and capturing the Force-sensitive Rowan Freemaker. He had a personal starship called the Tracker I.
The Arrowhead was a starship built by Rowan Freemaker, who believed that it could turn the tide of the Galactic Civil War.

result: Freemakers help Princess Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker escape the Whe
x: Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, an Imperial manhunt for Princess Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker took place on The Wheel. With the help of the Freemakers, Princess Leia and Luke evaded Lieutenant Estoc's forces and returned to the Rebel Alliance.

x: In 3 ABY, the Freemakers and Naare undertook a mission to rescue Zander Freemaker from the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vendetta. Zander had been captured by the Galactic Empire after taking Wick Cooper's N-1 starfighter on a joyride.
The Well-Being level, also referred to as Level 10 and written as the Tenth Level, was a location in Pau City on the planet Utapau.
Crait was a small salty mineral planet located in a remote sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square N-17 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Veruna was one of three moons that orbited the planet of Naboo. It shared its name with King Ars Veruna, who reigned over the Naboo before Padmé Amidala.

Sic-Six were a six-eyed intelligent species who, due to their unusual appearance, were easily mistaken for pests. One Sic-Six resided in the palace of Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
The Alderaanian delegation was a group of diplomats that represented the planet of Alderaan in the Congress of the Galactic Republic, and later in the Senate of the Galactic Empire.
Rawnde was one of the many moons that orbited Iego. It had a pinkish surface, with a large blue fissure running down one side.

Winlion was one of the 1,000 moons of Iego, a group of moons that orbited the Outer Rim Territories planet Iego. Each of the moons was as mysterious as the planet itself, which was located at Standard Galactic Grid coordinates T-7.

The Tracker I was a starfighter piloted by the Imperial Hunter droid M-OC, the Emperor Palpatine's secret project. He used this ship to ferry him across the galaxy during the hunt for Rowan Freemaker, who had stolen the Kyber Saber from the Emperor.

Dead Man's Turn was a landmark within the Beggar's Canyon, located on the desert planet Tatooine. The turn held notoriety for the particular danger it posed to people who flew through the canyon, giving it the befitting name.
Mabo was an MA-B0 cargo lifter droid who joined the Church of the Force. He was a believer and a pilgrim who believed in the Force.
T-2LC also known as "Elsie" was a protocol droid that served as a nanny for Han Solo and Leia Organa around the time of the Battle of Jakku.

Kril'Dor was a planet located in the Kril'Dor system in the Outer Jalor sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was a source of tibanna gas. Located close to the Uba system, Kril'Dor was positioned at the coordinates I-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Togorians were a sentient species of large, feline beings with digitigrade feet. Their bodies were covered in short, thick fur that could be brown, white, orange or red with stripes, and their eyes could be yellow or green with a yellow hue.

The Cyphari were a sentient species native to the planet Cyphar. Cyphari were described as resembling large stick insects with snouts similar to that of a Rodian. They were covered in neat rows of short red fur. One group of Cyphari was known as the Afe clan.

Cyphar was a terrestrial planet located in the Spirva sector of the Mid Rim that was the homeworld of the Cyphari species. The planet was mainly covered in grasslands and deserts with canyons, and had ground rich in scarn, a pre-spice compound.

Lysatra was an isolated planet in the Lysatra system in grid square I-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, a portion of the Expansion Region that was considered Wild Space. By 15 BBY, it was still considered a part of Wild Space.
A throne room was used by Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the Galactic Civil War.

R2-H16 was an R2-series astromech droid that was optimized to function in cold weather. The droid's distinctive red-and-green "hat" was an external radiant heating array. He also included a Burtt acoustic signaler.

R2-B00 was an R2-series astromech droid that was a space pirate, and could be found on the planet Takodana. The droid was painted with a phosphorescent colorant, and included a Burtt acoustic signaller.
R5-X3 was a red-and-white plated R5-series astromech droid that worked for the Resistance during the Cold War with the First Order by 34 ABY.
The Sterdic Star was a Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette commanded by Captain Hoff that was part of the Resistance's naval forces.

objective: Investigate the reports that the Rebel Alliance were gathering near My
x: During the twenty-third celebration of Empire Day, Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine received a report that the Rebel Alliance was gathering near the planet Mygeeto, Palpatine had his apprentice Darth Vader investigate to see if the report were true.
Clepresdan was one of the 1,000 moons that orbited Iego. It had a singular large crater on its surface with large canyons diverging from that crater.
Cobarb was one of the 1,000 moons that orbited the planet Iego, which was located at Standard Galactic Grid coordinates T-7 in the Outer Rim Territories.

Flitrude was a green and brown colored moon that orbited the planet Iego, which was located in the Outer Rim Territories at Standard Galactic Grid coordinates T-7. Like the rest of rest of Iego's 1,000 moons, Flitrude was as mysterious as the planet itself.

Uncovalor was one of the 1,000 moons that orbited the planet Iego, which was located at Standard Galactic Grid coordinates T-7 in the Outer Rim Territories. Like all of Iego's moons, Uncovalor was as mysterious as the world itself, and had a pink and brown surface.
Dinzo was a planet located in the Dinzo system in the Msst sector of the Mid Rim Territories.
The Noghri were a sentient species native to Honoghr. They had gray skin, a row of horns on their head and ran on all fours. Noghri were known for their combat skills and keen sense of smell.

Vardos was a planet located in the Jinata system in the galaxy's Core Worlds, and was home to Iden and Garrick Versio. Vardos was notable for its diversity and loyalty, with even the planet's many alien inhabitants expressing faith in the Empire.
The Ho'Din were a species of yellow-green humanoids in the galaxy. Ho'Dins possessed two large dark eyes, long suction cup-tipped fingers and, on their heads, red-violet fleshy tendrils.

The Pau Sinkhole was a natural formation stretching beneath the surface of the planet Utapau. It housed the subterranean settlement of Pau City, home to a million inhabitants including Pau'ans and Utai.

Chalcedon was a terrestrial planet located in the Chalcedon system in the Tashtor sector of the Mid Rim, in grid square I-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Located on the Great Gran Run between Cerea and Takodana, it was the center of the galactic slave trade.
Bacrana was an astronomical object located in the Bacrana system in the Brak sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region along the Corellian Run.

Black Spire Outpost (BSO), commonly known as Black Spire, was an outpost settlement on the planet Batuu. Due to Batuu's location on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories, Black Spire Outpost was one of the last stops before Wild Space and the Unknown Regions.

Ord Biniir was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square K-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Prior to the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic launched a successful assault on Imperial targets there.

result: Terex is taken into First Order custody
Death of L'ulo L'ampar and N1-ZX
x: During the Cold War, a battle broke out in the Fjor system between the Resistance, the First Order, and the Ranc Gang.

The Blood Crow was an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser originally commanded by Captain Rik Virgilio, and later by Captain Filia Rossi. It was the first assignment of Lieutenant Thrawn and Ensign Eli Vanto.

The Corvus was a Raider II-class corvette used by Inferno Squad during the Galactic Civil War. Originally an Imperial vessel, the Corvus joined the New Republic following Commander Iden Versio and Agent Del Meeko's defection from the Empire.

The Thunder Wasp was an Imperial Arquitens-class light cruiser under the command of Commander Alfren Cheno. Captain Thrawn served as first officer aboard the vessel with his assistant, Ensign Eli Vanto.

result: Four starships and many small arms weapons captured
x: A battle occurred in the years leading up to the Battle of Yavin between the Sammun insurgents and the 96th Task Force of the Galactic Empire. Commander Karyn Faro, acting under Admiral Thrawn's direction, pacified the insurgents.

Kerner Plaza was a roadway within the city of Mos Eisley on the desert world of Tatooine. Flanked by an open-air bazaar, Kerner Plaza connected Straight Street to Inner Curved Street and was home to the Dim-U monastery.
Coruscant food stall was a marketplace located in the Uscru Entertainment District, on the planet of Coruscant, street-side food stalls serve affordable, fast fare to residents of all types.
Batuu was a remote terrestrial planet on the edge of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in the Batuu system of the Trilon sector.
A desert planet was located in the Fjor system in the Grohl sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 34 ABY, it was the site of a battle between the Resistance, the Ranc Gang, and the First Order.
Rebel sentries were Rebel Alliance personnel who monitored incoming and departing starships from the top of a watchtower near the Great Temple, the Rebellion's headquarters on Yavin 4.

LIN-V8K was a LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer—a model of black-plated fifth-degree mining droid—that was amongst the droids offered for sale to the Lars homestead on the planet Tatooine by a group of Jawas in the year 1 BBY.
R-3DO was a protocol droid working at the Resistance base on D'Qar. The red-colored droid monitored the Resistance's network of spy droids.
Pik-pok fish were a species of small red fish on Naboo. The Gungan Jar Jar Binks enjoyed eating pik-pok fish. Tooka cats also enjoyed eating such fish.
During the Cold War, the Resistance held a funeral for L'ulo L'ampar, a Resistance pilot after he perished in a battle over a desert planet.

During the Imperial Era, nighttime riots occurred on the planet Ryloth, spurred by the heat of the summer months. The riots resulted in Twi'leks resisting Imperial control, forming crowds in the streets and cantinas of Lessu City, with unrest ensuing.
Shimmerbirds were an avian species whose tongues were used by the Koorivar to craft robes.
The Lunnix were a sentient species with white fur and yellow eyes that lived in the galaxy. Zorahda was a member of this species.

The Ociocks were a sentient avian species that lived in the galaxy. A family of Ociocks including a female and her mother were imprisoned at Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817 on the planet Wobani during the time Jyn Erso was there.
The Rayeth were an amphibious sentient species that lived on Inusagi. They had long and slender bodies as well as membranes. Bardbee was a member of the Rayeth species.
The Caldanians were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They had dark brown slimy skin, tendrils, and a flexible cartilage instead of bones. A criminal was a member of this species.
The Cyrans were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. At least one Cyran was living on the planet Skuhl during the Imperial Era.
The Fryiaans were a sentient four-armed species from the Fryiaa system. In the Imperial Era, a female Fryiaan was a dancer and singer of a band.
Winrocs were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. At least a few Winrocs were living on the planet Skuhl during the Imperial Era.

The Jefi (plural form: Jefies) were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. The Jefies were considered to be a species of incredible loyalty, unflinchingly following anyone who presented them self as a competent leader.

The makorr were an aquatic predator species that lived in the galaxy. They fed on mollusk meat. During the Imperial Era, Captain Thrawn was able to track down a group of iridium smugglers by following several boats that had dumped a large quantity of mollusk meat, attracting a…
The Blade was a maze of narrow streets in the city of NiJedha, on the holy moon Jedha.
The Old Shadows was the long outer wall of the Temple of the Kyber in NiJedha, Jedha. Forever shielded from sunlight, it symbolized the necessity of balance between light and darkness.
The Labbo were a long-eared sentient species that lived in the galaxy. The Labbos' ears had flaps that could touch their shoulders when twitching.
The Ma'cella were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Dwindun was a member of this species.
The Huloons were a sentient species whose anatomy included hands. During the reign of the Galactic Empire a Huloon youngling lived as a beggar on the Five Points space station.
The Kaths were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. A shopkeeper was a member of this species and had scales and at least one scaly hand.

Meftians were a fur-covered sentient humanoid species that had long black and white fur. They were also slightly reminiscent of the Wookiees. Kullbee Sperado, a member of this species, was a gunslinger and a member of the Partisans.

D'janis IV was an astronomical object where the female Dejammy Shallon served as a teacher and priestess. It was located in the D'janis system in the Halla sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square J-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Errimin was a terrestrial astronomical object where the Galactic Empire attempted to assassinate Saw Gerrera by poisoning him with teccitin. The attempt failed but Gerrera was sick for months afterwards.
Ghita was an astronomical object where an attempt to assassinate Saw Gerrera occurred. The attempt failed when the sniper missed Gerrera by centimeters.
Yablari was a world in the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Anomid species. Silvanie Phest led a handful of Anomids from their homeworld to the moon Jedha.

Siriamp was an astronomical object in the Siriamp system of the Mid Rim Territories' Halm sector where the Galactic Empire transformed ore from in what Saw Gerrera believed was a major weapons development due to its increased focus on cargo.
Centori was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Centori system in the Iskin sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square O-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Corlus was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Corlus system in the Woostri sector of the Expansion Region where a growing group of Saw Gerrera's partisans were based.

The Weldsingers of Grace were a religious group dedicated to the veneration of the Force. They were one of many such faiths whose members could be found in Jedha City on the moon Jedha prior to the city's destruction in 1 BBY.
The Tulava Quartet were a group who worked in Jedha City on the moon Jedha and were known to purchase goods stolen from the Galactic Empire.
By 3 BBY, the male human Tonk led a crew of anti-Galactic Empire insurgents. The crew consisted of Tonk himself, Sybl, Osky, and Ten-21, a cyborg human, and a Weequay.
Bakura was a planet in Wild Space considered an attractive destination for a day trip from the planet Batuu by the author Eloc Throno. Its capital city, Salis D'aar, was built in a circular pattern.

conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
x: Ezra's broadcast was a message of rebellion delivered shortly after the raid on the communications tower in the year 4 BBY.

Khomm was a planet located in the Khomm system of the galaxy's Deep Core. It had many oceans and was the homeworld of the Khommites and the Khommite striders. Khomm participated in cloning that left behind logo proteins.
Aridus was a planet located in the Aridus system, a star system in the Narvath sector of the Expansion Region along the Gamor Run.

Cularin was an astronomical object situated in the Thaere sector's Cularin system within the regions known as the Expansion Region and the Slice. It was located in grid square P-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Cyrillia was an industrial planet located in the Cyrillia system in the Cyrillian Protectorate, a sector of the Expansion Region in grid square O-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Derra IV, also known simply as Derra, was an astronomical object located in the Derra system in the Mikaster sector of the Expansion Region, in grid square N-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Gizer was an astronomical object located in the Gizer system in the Lantillian sector of the Mid Rim Territories on the Perlemian Trade Route, which connected it to Taanab and Lantillies.

Horox III was an astronomical object located deep in the Outer Rim Territories where the Alliance to Restore the Republic established a temporary outpost. Luke Skywalker traveled to a bar on Horox III sometime after his mission to Vagadarr Prime.

A police probe was flying patrol in Coruscant's Sector GL5 when a shot rang out. The probe spotted Mandalorian Duchess Satine Kryze beside the body of Davu Golec of the Republic Ministry of Intelligence.

Bulbas were a species of tiny rodents from Skuhl that had pale brown fur, a tiny pink twitching nose, big black eyes, and a long, fur-covered tail ending in a tuft. Bulbas' bones were very weak, which set the stage for a symbiotic relationship with an indigenous vine species.
Hirara was a small, inhabitable planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. There were guesses that rebels had set up a base on the planet.
The Judicator was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer in service of the Imperial Navy during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

At some point before the Battle of Endor, the Rebel Alliance's Blue Squadron launched an assault on the Galactic Empire's Strike Station Aurek. Lieutenant Valeria devised a plan to destroy the battle station by dropping a proton bomb into the base's thermal exhaust port.
During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Woan Barso owned a Unar-Con tug which he used to move cargo up to the freighters waiting in orbit above Jedha.
Inusagi was a planet in the Vilonis sector of the Mid Rim region of the galaxy. It was famous for its sakoola blossom festival.

In 4 ABY, a dogfight took place between the Rebel Alliance's Blue Squadron and the Galactic Empire. During that dogfight, Zander Freemaker flew his modified starfighter Blazemaker Mark II, which had been fitted with several blasters.

t: Skirmish with an Imperial Star Destroyer
result: Destruction of an Imperial-class Star Destroyer
x: In 4 ABY, a space battle took place between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. An Imperial Star Destroyer attacked the Rebel Alliance's command ship Home One.

t: Mission to rescue Lando Calrissian and Chewbacca
result: Freemakers succeed in rescuing Lando Calrissian and Chewbacca
R0-GR loses one of his legs
x: In 4 ABY, the Freemakers undertook a mission to rescue the Rebel Alliance agents Lando Calrissian and Chewbacca. The Freemakers were initially intercepted by an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser commanded by Durpin and Plumestriker.

t: Mission to obtain a Type A vector coil
result: The Freemakers obtain a Type A vector coil
objective: Obtain a Type A vector coil
x: In 4 ABY, the Freemakers undertook a mission took place to collect a Type A vector coil for the Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot Colvett Valeria's U-wing starfighter.
A growing group of Saw Gerrera's Partisans were based on Corlus.
The Agarians were an extremely long-lived sentient species that evolved from fungi. They were, in a manner of speaking, sentient mushrooms who could alter their size and the number of their limbs.

Hyropodic aetherbeasts were a type of creature native to only three biomes on the world of Yolthani VI. They possessed a large muscled upper torso, with two arms and a head. Their faces included two white eyes and a mouth of sharp teeth surrounded by red tentacle-like appendages.

Yolthani VI was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Yolthani system of the Nijune sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories, being situated in grid square N-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Essfour, also spelled as Essfor, was an R5 series astromech droid that served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was assigned to Luke Skywalker, following R2-D2's mission to rescue a captured C-3PO.

The Ezaraa were a species of warmongering carnivorous sentients that were native to the the planet Ezaraa. They intended to overthrow the Galactic Empire, only to replace it with their own dominion and feed on the other species, which they deemed as lesser to them.

Jos was one of three moons that orbited the planet Saleucami, located in the Suolriep sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The moon had a greenish hue due to crystalline dust in its atmosphere.

Victori was one of three moons that orbited the planet Saleucami, located in the Suolriep sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Crystalline dust in the moon's atmosphere caused it to have a greenish hue.
The Romary was a Phelarion-class fuel tanker in service to a crew of Xexto led by Captain Perrili in 34 ABY.

Moltok was an astronomical object located in the Atrivis sector's Moltok system, within the intersection of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories regions. Situated at the coordinates L-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid, it was home to a Ho'Din settlement.
Keitum was a planet located in the Keitum system in the Ariarch sector of the Mid Rim, connected via hyperspace route to Ansion. Cartherston was a city located on the planet.
Cartherston was a city located on the planet Keitum.

Maryx Minor was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Many eruptions, explosions, and spurts of radiation were common on the planet. These conditions made it difficult to maintain shelter for very long, a reason the Galactic Empire passed over it.
The Botajef Defense Force was the planetary defense force of the Outer Rim world of Botajef. It was made up of seven squadrons of V-19 Torrent starfighters as well as two CR90 corvettes.
Vulpors were a non-sentient species with long, silky tails that inhabited the grasslands of Skuhl.

M'haeli was an agriworld located in the M'haeli system in the Majoor system of the Expansion Region. The world contained the D'olop mountain range, where dragite gems were mined for use in lightsabers.
Sernpidal was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

The Panaka was a starship of the Galactic Empire's loyalist forces during the Galactic Civil War, serving as a vessel within the Imperial blockade that defended the Imperial capital Coruscant in 5 ABY. It was named after the Imperial Moff Quarsh Panaka, who had perished in 3 BBY.

Huulia was a planet located in the Huulia system of the Colonies. In 32 BBY, the nacelle from a Huulian starfighter was among the junk stored in the scrapyard of the Toydarian Watto's junkshop in the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine.
4A-2R was a RA-7 protocol droid droid that was a member of Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang by the Clone Wars. 4A-2R was a valued part of Ohnaka's operation due to the surveillance equipment in his head.

Ktath'atn was a dark forest planet in the Ktath'atn system in the Chopani sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was ruled by the Queen of Ktath'atn, whose hive fed on the human inhabitants. It was the location of the Citadel of Ktath'atn, which stood over a village.
Tharl was a terrestrial astronomical object where the Graf lodge was located. It was located in the Tharl system in the Sugai sector, a subsector of the Zuma sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Makurth were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. On Moltok, a Ho'Din settlement came under attack from a local Makurth boss, leading the Ho'Din to request Imperial muscle to avoid it turning into a full-fledged war.
G2-PI (Geetoo-Peeeye) was a talkative G2 repair droid who managed droid maintenance at the Resistance base on D'Qar.
Four hundred vulture droids were launched from the outermost moon of the planet Umbara during the Battle over Umbara.
Chankin was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Chankin system in the Mid Rim's Jidlor Marches sector.

Kal'Shebbol was a planet located in the Kal'Shebbol system in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located close to one end of the Rimma Trade Route, which connected it to Septra. Cal Alder, an Alliance to Restore the Republic lieutenant, hailed from the planet.

The Coruscant Ministry of Ingress was the organization responsible for processing immigrants arriving on the planet Coruscant. The ministry had subdivision offices located throughout Galactic City. Tannon Praji served as the First Minister of the Coruscant Ministry of Ingress.
The B'omarr Flats were an expanse of land in the Northern Dune Sea of Tatooine near the Great Mesra Plateau. The Great Pit of Carkoon was located in this area.
Paradise Road was a street in Mos Eisley, branching off from Spacers Row. Masse Goskey's famous Arms Emporium and Jabba Desilijic Tiure's Desilijic Complex were several buildings on this road.

Shadda-Bi-Boran was a planet located within the Toblain sector in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. By 228 BBY, it was located within the Occlusion Zone created by the Nihil marauders. In 39 BBY, the planet's sun was dying.
During the rebellion on Akiva, the New Republic starfighter pilot Norra Wexley formed a team to inspire a popular uprising against Imperial rule on Akiva.

The moons of Ai'ken Prime were a group of at least two moons located within the Inner Rim Territories. Lord Hossferin of the Vandelae star system Hossferins traveled from the moons of Ai'ken Prime to visit the queen of Ktath'atn, but was killed by her lieutenant, Bombinax.

Canto Bight was a coastal city on the desert planet Cantonica. The city was a destination for wealthy individuals, as it was filled with casinos and racetracks. During the war between the Resistance and the First Order, Resistance members Finn and Rose Tico traveled there.
The Valley of the Eremite was a valley on the planet Jakku that was near the Plaintive Hand plateau. It was located beyond the Yiulong Canyons and Caverns of Bagirlak Garu.

The Ponta One was an SC3000 freighter cargo ship owned by Akshaya Ponta. Akshaya's daughter, Tanith Ponta worked aboard the freighter, causing her to become ill with bloodburn. After Tanith's death, Akhaya banned her son Hadder from piloting, fearing he may get the disease.
During the Separatist Crisis, in the final months before the start of the Clone Wars, the Roshu Sune pursued a terrorist bombing campaign.
The Miraluka were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They had tanned brown skin, gray or white hair, and did not possess eyes.

AD-W4, also referred to as Ay-Dee, was a mercenary droid that General Grievous hired to oversee the Separatists operations on the planet Hissrich during the Clone Wars. AD-W4 was ultimately destroyed after a duel with Jedi Master Mace Windu on Hissrich.

BB-9E was a black-plated BB-series astromech droid in the service of the First Order. A top-of-the-line astromech droid, during the New Republic Era, BB-9E served aboard Supreme Leader Snoke's flagship, the Supremacy, keeping machinery operational and upholding security proced…
The odupiendo were a species of large, flightless avians from Naboo. Although unable to fly, the odupiendo were fast runners.

t: Attack on a New Republic outpost
x: In 5 ABY as the Imperial Era ended, the Acolytes of the Beyond launched an attack on a New Republic outpost on the planet Devaron. During the attack, the Acolyte Remi tried to kill his estranged lover Kiza in order to recover his lightsaber.
The Frillian Confederacy were an organization that were owned by the Black Sun. The Frillians also owned the Gindar Gang.
The Gindar Gang were an organization who were owned by the Frillian Confederacy, who were in turn owned by the Black Sun.

Radhii was a planet located in the Radhii system of Wild Space that was part of the Galactic Empire by the time of the Battle of Endor. In Tavuu the capital of the planet, the Segenka prison was located there.
Xala was a planet located in the Xala system in Wild Space that was orbited by at least one moon.

Tamsye Prime was a planet located in the Tamsye Prime system in the Thanium sector in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, the planet produced shell munitions for the Galactic Republic. In 5 BBY, Saw Gerrera abandoned Jyn Erso on the planet whilst on a mission there.

headquarters: Peace and Security station, Coronet City
x: The Peace & Security, abbreviated as CCPS, was a law enforcement agency on the planet Corellia in the months following the Battle of Endor. Some notable Peace & Security personnel included the detectives Erno, Shreen, and Mursey and the security officer Spob Rydel.

The Octagon district, also called simply the Octagon, was a multi-level plaza in Lessu City on the planet Ryloth. The capitol building was located in the district. Imperial personnel relied on the Octagon for recreational purposes such as visiting cantinas.

The Acidity was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It served as the personal Star Destroyer and flagship of Grand Moff Randd, who commanded the Imperial fleet from the bridge of the Acidity during the Battle of Jakku.

The Guarlara was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that served in the Fifth Fleet of the Galactic Republic naval forces' Open Circle Fleet, and participated in the Battle of Coruscant during the Clone Wars in 19 BBY.

result: Rescue of Conder Kyl and Nim Tar's child
