I'vorcia Prime was a planet in the I'vorcia Prime system of the Outer Rim Territories' Mieru'kar sector that was home to various exotic creatures, including sarlaccs.

result: Destruction of a large portion of the planet's rich ecosystem
x: The Battle of I'vorcia Prime was a battle the Galactic Empire participated in during the Imperial Era on I'vorcia Prime.

The I'vorcia Prime Preserve was an area of the planet I'vorcia Prime kept preserved after the Battle of I'vorcia Prime damaged its ecosystem. The smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca took a baby sarlacc from the preserve for the collector Dok-Ondar.
The Kendoh Gang, also known as the Kendoh Crew, was a notorious gang led by the criminal Kendoh Voss, which included Remex Io and Wooro.

Calumdarian was a volcanic rocky world located in the Calumdarian system in the Immalia sector of the Expansion Region. Its atmosphere was breathable for a short time period, but was filled with smoke that made long-term exposure difficult.

objective: Capture Shenda Mol
x: The Mission to Numidian Prime was an operation undertaken by a Jedi Order strike team on the Mid Rim planet Numidian Prime to capture the bounty hunter Shenda Mol around 66 BBY.
Ohma-D'un was a small moon that orbited the planet Naboo. Bursas could be found there. It was colonized by the Gungans in the aftermath of the Battle of Naboo.

The Gillanium Syndicate was a criminal organization led by a crime lord known as "The Underlord." Around 2 BBY, the assassin droid bounty hunter IG-88B engineered a series of events that resulted in the destruction of the syndicate, allowing the droid to collect a large number…

Minashee was located in the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories, within the Tadrin sector, which was a subsector of the Cassander sector and thus was part of the Cassandran Worlds. It was situated in grid square K-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Jedi Temple refectory or simply the Jedi refectory was the dining room located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Its tables were equipped with hologram displays which showed rolling schedules and menus.
Carannia was the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno. It shared its name with Carannian fur which was worn by Serennian Senator Izzet Noor during the High Republic.

The Windrunner was an airship that belonged to Dooku, the Count of Serenno. During the invasion of Serenno, Count Ramil was in command of the Windrunner. Dooku allowed the droids to take him to face Ramil aboard the airship, where he killed the Count and disabled his army.
Vollick were a sentient species. Osika Kirske was a Vollick warlord on Rattatak. The Jedi Master-turned-Sith Darth Krall was a Vollick.

The Altiri were a sentient species. They were known to have purple skin and white hair. Some individuals had a gem in the middle of their forehead and above their eyes. Jedi Master Lene Kostana and her family belonged to the species.
The Tirra'Taka was an ancient dragon that lived on the planet Serenno. In ancient history, users of the dark side of the Force captured a Tirra'Taka and corrupted it to use in battle.

A solar storm occurred on Protobranch during the Republic Era. It was a natural disaster that sent the floating cities of the planet falling. Jedi Padawan Sifo-Dyas had a Force vision of the event before it occurred.

In 82 BBY, after her death, a funeral was held for Countess Anya of House Serenno on the funeral moon of Serenno. A protest broke out during Lady Jenza's speech honoring her mother, with rocks being thrown at Count Gora.

During their time at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, Jedi Initiates were placed into clans. Such Clans were the Bear Clan, the Clan Kowak, the Hawk-Bat Clan, the Heliost Clan, the Thranta Clan, and a clan that consisted of the Younglings Petro, Ganodi, Katooni, Byph, Zatt and Gu…
The Battle of Wasted Years occurred by 1032 BBY. The Sith Lord Darth Krall participated in the battle and emerged victorious.
Tuk'ata were a species of creatures classified as a Sith warbeast. Also known as Sith hounds, they could be found on Moraband.
Saffia was a city on the planet Serenno, over one hundred kilometers away from the capital city of Carannia.

Asusto was a small forested planet located within the Tamsis Nebula in the Outer Rim Territories, strong with the dark side of the Force and often visited by smugglers. The last of the Presagers of Hakotei hid on the planet.
The Second Moon of Thrinittik was a rocky moon. As a child, Chelli Aphra lived in a house in the University Quarter on the moon, along with her mother Lona Aphra and father Korin Aphra.
Red Mist was a Slinani Migration Shrine that was at one point located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. Around 2 ABY, the archaeologist Chelli Aphra visited the shrine with Vulaada Klam.
The University Quarter was a settlement on the Second Moon of Thrinittik. The family of Chelli Lona Aphra resided in a house in the University Quarter.

Carajam was a desert planet in the Carajam system in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The bounty hunter Boba Fett visited the planet to claim a bounty on a Rebel pilot, taking a job to target Zingo Gabnit.

The Heliost Clan was one of the many clans in which initiates were sorted at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Jedi Master Tera Sinube was their primary teacher for lightsaber combat and at one point consisted of Gretz Droom, Ky Narec, and Qui-Gon Jinn.
The Thranta Clan was one of the many clans in which initiates were sorted at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Jedi Master Dooku was the main lightsaber combat instructor of Thranta Clan.

Palek was an astronomical object inhabited by the Palekians and known for its hyperstorms. It was located in the Palek system, a star system in the Cyrillian Protectorate in the Expansion Region in grid square O-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Plin Minor, also known as Plin, was a terrestrial planet in the Plin Minor system of the Inner Rim Territories that was home to the Plinovian species. The Solodoe wished to terraform the planet, which would damage the Plinovians' natural habitat.
Salliche was an agriworld located in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. It provided crops to other worlds in the region like Coruscant.

Nithorni was an astronomical object in the Nithorni system in the Colonies that was represented by Tanan Vetall at the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally on Coruscant. It shared its name with the Nithorn avian sentient species.

Coachelle Prime, also known simply as Coachelle, was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Terr'skiar sector's Coachelle system within the Mid Rim Territories that was represented by the Lepi racer Thrar in the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally.
LEP-10019 was a droid in service to Count Dooku. LEP-10019 summoned Asajj Ventress while she stayed at his palace on Serenno.
Minfar was a backwater jungle planet in a distant region of space in the Inner Rim Territories in grid square I-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Sakreen was a rocky planet in the Sakreen system in the Ash Worlds of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the hiding place of the pirate Rane Mahal, whose starship had crashed on the planet.
Mitek-Por was a terrestrial astronomical object that contained the Ruins of Mitek-Por. An NP-unit was discovered in the ruins and taken to the droid museum on Nubia.

Valgauthians were the human inhabitants of the planet Valgauth. They had a reputation as berserkers when boarding starships. As such, Valgauthians were regarded as valuable additions to any pirate crew.

The Archive of Forbidden Artifacts was a Bogan Collection, a hidden vault of prohibited objects associated with the dark side of the Force, that lay within the archives of the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.
The Ruins of Mitek-Por were a set of ruins on Mitek-Por. An NP-unit servo-droid was discovered within the ruins, and taken to to the droid museum on Nubia.
The Kentas Gallery was a gallery in the droid museum on Nubia, holding some of the museum's most valuable droids.
Level Two was a location on an Imperial base. During the Galactic Civil War, a chief named Rusl-Kwin clogged the toilets on Level Two.
Carrion birds were a type of predatory bird. In 28 ABY, Leia Organa compared them with members of Rinnrivin Di's cartel who were in pursuit of her and Ransolm Casterfo.
Arbiflux was a forest planet located in the Outer Rim Territories along the Veragi Trade Route. The future archaeologist Chelli Aphra and her mother Lona moved to the world after leaving her father.
Unox was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories, and the location of an abandoned spice mine.
The Slinani were a religious warrior clan that constructed Migration Shrines that stored their battle trophies. One such shrine was Red Mist, located in the Outer Rim Territories.
Barab I, also known simply as Barab, was an irradiated planet in the Barab system in the Albanin sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Nar Haaska was a shadowport on the border of Hutt Space and the Outer Rim Territories. At some point by 10 BBY, Bandit Billie and her crew of shipjackers accosted the space yacht of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure, the Star Jewel, while it was on a layover on Nar Haaska.

Dellalt was an astronomical object located within the Tion Cluster of the regions known as the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. The astronomical object was positioned within grid square T-6 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Drongar was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy, positioned at the coordinates T-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid. A smuggler grew up on Drongar and, prior to the First Order-Resistance War, used to climb the trees there.

Sy Myrth was a planet located in the Sy Myrth system in the Jospro sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square S-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was linked via hyperspace routes to Belderone, Boonta, Centares, and Jabiim.

Jabiim was a terrestrial planet situated within the regions known as the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. Connected to Sy Myrth and Taskeed by hyperspace routes, it was positioned at the coordinates S-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Ore was one of the main exports of Jabiim.
Varl, also known as Varl Prime, was a planet located in the Varl system in Hutt Space that was orbited by 3 moons.
Reuss VIII was a planet in the Reuss system in the Portmoak sector of the Outer Rim Territories, located along the Llanic Spice Run hyperspace route.
Azure was an astronomical object located in the Azure system in the Truum sector of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice. It was positioned in grid square P-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Kinooine was an astronomical object located in the Kinooine system of Wild Space, in grid square J-21 of the Standard Galactic Grid south of the southern edge of the Outer Rim Territories.

River toads were a type of toads. In 40 BBY, Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi felt that the Pijali Minister Orth's facial expression during a conversation about the Opposition performance troupe with Pijal's lord regent Rael Averross expressed disgust, as if she would rather lick a…
Dooku's quarters were the private quarters of Jedi Master Dooku at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
Dannamore was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Saijo sector of the Outer Rim Territories where the orgo-harvest facility was located.
The Republic Correctional Authority (RCA) was an organization within the Galactic Republic that was charged with detaining criminals deemed too dangerous for local law enforcement agencies.
The Republic Treasury was an organization in the Galactic Republic that was tasked with overseeing the government's economic system, including the printing of Republic credits.
The Space Rescue Corps, abbreviated to SRC, was a Galactic Republic organization active around the time of the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Senate Intelligence Oversight Committee served within the Galactic Republic as the oversight committee for the Galactic Senate's Bureau of Intelligence.
The Finance Committee was a committee in the Galactic Senate that related to the Galactic Republic's budgetary and financial matters.
The Ethics Committee was a Galactic Senate Legislative committee of the Galactic Republic, and was considered a spiritual partner of the Judiciary Committee's Internal Activities Committee.

objective: Protest the link between the Pijali monarchy and Czerka
x: The Opposition on Pijal led a non-violent series of protests led by Halin Azucca to protest the link between the Pijali monarchy and Czerka Corp in 40 BBY.

result: Revolt on the Leverage is started
objective: Facilitate the treaty between the Pijali monarchy and Czerka
x: The Mission to Pijal was a mission undertaken by Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi to mediate the signing of the Governance Treaty between the Pijali monarchy and Czerka Arms on the Inner Rim planet Pijal in 40 BBY.

The Tributum was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that was under the command of Imperial officer Kanchar. During the Galactic Civil War it fought against Rebel Alliance forces during their mission to Shu-Torun.
Tarsunt was a planet located in the Tarsunt system of the Mid Rim, located in Bothan Space. It was the homeworld of New Republic Chancellor Lanever Villecham.

Danan Karr was a location on the Outer Rim Territories planet Carajam, containing a spaceport. While being pursued by the bounty hunter Boba Fett on Carajam, Zingo Gabnit contacted the Xan sisters, who refused to rescue him unless he met them at Danan Karr.

The Death Plains was an inhospitable stretch of desert on the planet Carajam. During the Imperial Era, Zingo Gabnit and Turfitch were forced to cross the Death Plains whilst escaping from the bounty hunter Boba Fett.

A rocky planet was the location of a mining colony ran by the Fantanines. The planet was strip-mined, destroying its environment. A sentient species native to the planet impeded the mining operation, leading the Fantanines to exploit them for resources.

The Fantanines were a sentient species with insectoid features. They had long lifespans and a small population, which led them to strongly avoid conflict within their species. The Ben Diffle Fantanines were a group of Fantanines who operated a mining colony.
Following the destruction of Accresker Jail, Doctor Chelli Aphra and 0-0-0 were involved in a chase on Milvayne, having been linked together with proximity bombs by Cornelius Evazan.
Spine-wolves were a type of wolf that lived in a forest on the planet Serenno. As an infant, the Serennian Dooku was abandoned in that forest by his father, Gora.

CZ-94 was a droid that served in the portmaster's office at the Serenno Spaceport. It was destroyed by Asajj Ventress, Sith apprentice to Dooku, who visited the spaceport in search of her master's sister Jenza.

Pendago were a sentient species with multiple tentacled limbs. One Pendago was a member of the Razorclaw Gang on Serenno, and had several of its limbs cut off by Asajj Ventress, who was attempting to learn the location of the Crolute criminal Glute.
Palekians were a group of sentients that inhabited Palek. They used crystals that appeared similar to kyber in order to meditate.

Kijimi was a frigid mountainous planet located in the Bryx sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim, in grid square R-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Once famed for its marked spirituality, the planet became known as a haven for criminals and lawlessness.
Pasaana was a desert planet located in the Expansion Region's Ombakond sector that was the homeworld of the Aki-Aki species.

The Aki-Aki were a sentient elephantine species native to the desert planet Pasaana. They were generally peaceful and hospitable, making them welcoming to offworlders when they arrived on their planet. According to Unkar Plutt, they were very literal.
Orbaks were a species of horse-like riding beasts. Found on several worlds, their exact galactic origins were unclear, although the ocean moon Kef Bir was the homeworld of a herd of orbaks.
The Thieves' Quarter, also known as the Thieves' District and formerly known as the Quarter of the Beatific, was an area of Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi.
The Moon of Avedot was a mountainous moon of the planet Avedot in the Colonies region's Avedot system that hosted the New Republic impound facility Base 354-23X.

The Turret Room was a serene chamber within the Theed Royal Palace, in the capital city of Theed on the planet Naboo. It was attached to a small temple used to revere ancient rulers of Naboo and was originally constructed by King Jafan.

Khormai were a sentient species from the Khorm system. One Khormai bothered Asajj Ventress in the Belsallian Cantina on Serenno, and the Sith apprentice knocked him unconscious with a tray from a serving droid.

The Tabor Plains was a grassland on Protobranch, where the majority of the planet's bacta was produced. The Tabor Hospital was suspended above the Tabor Plains on an antigrav platform, along with bacta production plants.
Aitch-Sixteen was an astromech droid that worked with starships of the Jedi Order in the hangars of the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.
Pijal capital city was a city located on the planet Pijal.

K43, referred to as Kakra by the indigeonous population's elders in their native tongue, was a tectonically unstable volcanic planet located in the Kakra system in Wild Space, within the Expansion Region.
Jamiri was an astronomical object where the Alliance to Restore the Republic had an outpost.

The supply moon was a moon located in deep space, controlled by the Galactic Empire. A minister was traveling to the moon when his Lambda-class T-4a shuttle came under attack from Rebel Alliance X-wings.
A crown finch was a type of bird. Jedi Knight Ky Narec fed crown finches and song sparrows, another type of bird, that lived in the training ground of the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.

Ordo was a Mandalorian world located in the Ordo system in the Mandalore sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was home to the Archaic Arsenal, which housed an ancient Mandalorian rally master lance.

The Windfall was a starship owned by a smuggler and their droid co-pilot ZO-E3. During a smuggling operation, the Windfall was pulled out of hyperspace above Mustafar by an Imperial Interdictor-class, and its captain was taken to be imprisoned in the fortress of Darth Vader.

t: Fact-finding mission to the Outer Rim
x: A fact-finding mission to the Outer Rim was undertaken by members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War waged against the Galactic Empire.
Plinovians were the native species of the planet Plin Minor. They were gaseous life-forms that were able to self-combust when riled up.

objective: Kidnapping the Givin codebreaker
x: The Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure sent a group of his men led by the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo on a mission to Mygeeto to kidnap a Givin codebreaker from the InterGalactic Banking Clan on the planet Mygeeto.

The Republic Office of Criminal Investigations (or ROCI) was the division of the Galactic Republic's Judicial Department that managed subordinate law enforcement agencies and maintained the Republic Enforcement DataCore.

The Republic Security Force, also known as the Republic Guard, was the primary civil law enforcement agency of the Galactic Republic and was a branch of the Republic Office of Criminal Investigations.

The Core Faction was a split political faction that was active within the legislative assembly of the Galactic Republic prior to the outbreak of the Separatist Crisis, which was organized by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Militarists were a political faction active within the Galactic Republic Senate prior to the onset of the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Separatist Crisis.
The Senate Rotunda Preservation Committee was a committee within the Senate of the Galactic Republic whose tasks were to exterminate granite slugs and keep the Senate Rotunda architecturally sound.

The Republic courts were judicial assemblies that were part of the Galactic Republic's Judicial Department. Their jurisdiction was primarily over disputes between planets, such as taxation and trade between star systems or crimes committed outside orbital space.
Shoril was a small Gungan town located under a lake of the same name. Consisting of a dozen hydrostatic bubbles, it was in shallow water, and thus could be seen from the surface.

Pandem Nai was a terrestrial planet in the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories with a tibanna gas industry. It, along with its tibanna-mining space station, Orbital One, was taken over by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing shortly after the Battle of Endor.
The Lodestar was an Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship that served as the flagship of New Republic General Hera Syndulla's Barma Battle Group during the Galactic Civil War.
Ollopoms were short, gentle non-sentient herbivores native to the swamps of the planet Naboo. A species of rodent, they were often mistaken for pom petals, a plant that was part of their diet.

Blutopians were a sentient species from the watery planet of Blutopia. Oolin Musters was a female Blutopian who was imprisoned by the Galactic Empire on Wobani. Oga Garra was another female Blutopian who owned Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.

Profoggs (also called Profroggs) were a species of large rodents characterized by a snout, horns, super-sharp incisors, and powerful claws that they used for defense and digging. They built complex underground burrowing systems called "towns." They could be found on Tatooine.
The Leviathan was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era.
C2-B9 was an R5 series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton. It at some point served in the palace of Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine.

EG-127 was a green-plated GNK-series power droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton. During the Galactic Civil War, it served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and was stationed in Echo Base, the Alliance's headquarters on the planet Hoth.

EG-57 was a green-plated GNK-series power droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that in 10 BBY witnessed a slave and droid uprising in one of the Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel.
L4-R6 was an R4 astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton who functioned as a repair droid. In 1 BBY, L4-R6 was in the possession of a tribe of Jawas on Tatooine.
MB-12 was a BB-series astromech droid that served the Resistance on board the MC85 Star Cruiser Raddus at some point prior to the starship's destruction in 34 ABY.

V0-RK was a Viper probe droid that served the Galactic Empire and took part in the effort to locate the secret base of the Alliance to Restore the Republic after the Battle of Yavin during the Galactic Civil War.

t: Heist on a First Order train
result: Two containers of Coaxium are successfully stolen and are given to the
objective: Steal a shipment of Coaxium from the First Order
x: During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, Hondo Ohnaka of Ohnaka Transport Solutions launched a heist on a First Order train to steal containers of coaxium to give to the Resistance.
Skettos or cave skettos, were a species of non-sentient, ferocious flying pests found on the desert planet of Tatooine.
Peko-peko were a type of flying creatures that could be found in the swamps of the planet Naboo.

Felucia birds were a type of bird that lived on the planet Felucia. In 19 BBY, several flew by forces of the 327th Star Corps during the Battle of Felucia, and one of these birds flew near Clone Commander CC-5052 and other clone troopers as they fired on Jedi General Aayla Sec…

Gualaar were a type of quadruped animal indigenous to the mountains and hills of Naboo. They were tall and broad-barrelled with white fur, black eyes, and a single large horn on their head and two on their snout.

Dwarf vinocks were a type of winged creature with cream skin and black eyes. In 10 BBY, the crime lord Dryden Vos kept a dwarf vinock on display in a case in his study on board his yacht, the First Light.

Goaty-chickens were a type of small bipedal creature with brown fur and black eyes. In 10 BBY, the crime lord Dryden Vos kept the remains of a goaty-chicken on display in a case in his study on board his yacht, the First Light.

The droch was a type of cerulean-colored creature from the planet Felucia. In 10 BBY, the crime lord Dryden Vos kept the remains of a cerulean droch on display in a case in his study on board his yacht, the First Light.

Wurrek were a type of tentacled creature with red skin. In 1 BBY, a human inhabitant of Jedha City on the moon Jedha was cooking a wurrek in a pan over a fire in the city's streets as the rebel operatives Jyn Erso and Cassian Andor walked past, shortly before the city's destru…

Sheffi were a type of small, gray-furred creature with black eyes. In 34 ABY, Gatha Elbaphay, a patron of the Canto Casino in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica carried the pet sheffi Awgree while at the casino tables.
Jekoon was a floating non-sentient species that existed in the galaxy. A Xi'Dec kept a Jekoon at the Canto Bight casino.

Versimillipedes were a type of quadrupedal, brown-skinned species on Jedha, Kenari, and Khofar. In 1 BBY, a versimillipede climbed a rock face near to the Catacombs of Cadera, shortly before the area was decimated by the Death Star superweapon.

Sand skitters were a type of small, brown-furred creature that could be found on the desert planet Tatooine. In 4 ABY, a worrt captured a sand skitter with its tongue outside the crime lord Jabba the Hutt's palace and devoured it.
Nudjs were a type of green-skinned lizard found in the swamps of the planet Dagobah. In 3 ABY, a nudj scurried out of the entrance to the Cave of Evil as the Jedi in training Luke Skywalker entered.

The Iltan clan was a clan on the Inner Rim planet Pijal. Decades before 40 BBY, the clan imported varactyls, a species of ridable creatures, from the planet Utapau to gain an advantage in Pijal's ceremonial Grand Hunt racing event.

The Opposition were a theatrical performance troupe on the moon of the Inner Rim planet Pijal, led by Halin Azucca. The Opposition was created to inform the Pijali citizens of the misrepresentation of the moon's population due to influence from the Czerka Corporation.

objective: Investigate rumors of Sith artifacts
x: During the Republic Era, Jedi Master Lene Kostana undertook a mission to the planet Asusto in order to track down rumors of Sith artifacts on the black market.

Gafsa was a canyon in the South Jundland Wastes region on Tatooine, a desert planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Gafsa contained at least one water well. Rare wells like that were consider sacred to the Tusken Raiders, and trespassing could lead to swift violence.
Imperial Refining Platform M36 was a Galactic Empire refinery located in an asteroid field in the Outer Rim Territories. It had no organic workers, but was protected by KX-series security droids.

49AX3 was a Dreadnought-class heavy cruiser that served the navy of the Galactic Empire. Some time between 3 and 4 ABY, the vessel was captured by the Alliance to Restore the Republic, who used it to raid Imperial Refining Platform M36, a refinery in the Outer Rim Territories.

t: Raid at Imperial Refining Platform M36
result: Rebel Alliance escape with the fuel
objective: Acquire fuel supplies
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a team of rebels undertook a raid at the Galactic Empire's Imperial Refining Platform M36. Assisted by Luke Skywalker, the rebels destroyed the KX-series security droids at the facility, securing its fuel supplies.
During the Clone Wars, a mission was undertaken to Alderaan by Ahsoka Tano, Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala.

Lokud 7 was a jungle world in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, Rebel Alliance spies landed on Lokud 7 with Imperial intelligence. Darth Vader followed the Rebel spies to the planet in search of them.

The Stinger Mantis, commonly known as the Mantis, was an S-161 "Stinger" XL luxury yacht owned and piloted by Greez Dritus. In 14 BBY, Dritus transported the former Jedi Cere Junda and Cal Kestis on the vessel as part of their secret mission to rebuild the Jedi Order.

2296 was the designation of an OOM-series security droid that served in the Trade Federation's Droid Army. In 32 BBY, it was stationed on board the modified Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter Saak'ak while the starship was part of the blockade of the planet Naboo.

2391 was the designation of an OOM-series security droid that served in the Trade Federation's Droid Army. In 32 BBY, it was stationed on board the modified Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter Saak'ak while the starship was part of the blockade of the planet Naboo.

Wyyyschokk were a species of gigantic spider that lived on the planet Kashyyyk. Both highly intelligent and extremely hostile, they could ensnare prey by casting webbing at them from a distance, and would often wait to ambush their prey by attacking them from above or below.

Flame beetles were a species of beetle that lived on the planet Kashyyyk. The creatures consumed local plants and synthesized their remains into a highly flammable derivative, giving them their signature bioluminescent abdomen.

The Senate gardens were located in the Senate Plaza on Coruscant. One section of the garden had a grove of chinar trees which was the favorite of Senator Bail Organa of Alderaan who liked to sit there after a general session and think of home.
Senthrodys was a terrestrial planet located in the Senthrodys system of the Inner Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square O-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Beauchen was a terrestrial astronomical object located in an eponymous star system within the Mid Rim Territories' Vensori sector.

The Entropian Hive was an asteroid in the Entropian Hive system in the Elbaran sector of the Mid Rim Territories, along the Cerean Reach. The asteroid was used as a black market trading post, controlled by the Entropian Hive Trading Council.

Jiruus was a planet in the Rolion sector that was home to the Jiruusi species, orbited by the Grinning Moon of Jiruus. Under the Galactic Empire's rule, its star system, the Jiruus system, was the prize jewel of the Rolion sector's Imperial moff.

The Grinning Moon of Jiruus was a moon that orbited the planet Jiruus, located in the Jiruus system within the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated in the Rolion sector at the coordinates P-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Alakatha was a terrestrial astronomical object known for its beaches that was located in the Alakatha system within the Var Hagen sector of the Mid Rim. It was situated in grid square M-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Mountain troopers were a specialized stormtrooper variant in the Stormtrooper Corps of the First Order. They were equipped with white armor reminiscent of the old Imperial coastal defender stormtroopers.

Skorrupon was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Skorrupon system in the Trans-Vulta sector of the Mid Rim Territories and New Territories, in grid square N-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid, where the New Republic pilots Wyl Lark and Kamala encountered a Twi'lek.

Polyneus, known as Home by its inhabitants, was an isolated, pastoral world in the Inner Rim. The world, largely detached from galactic affairs, was known for its native sur-avkas, semi-tame flying creatures that were ridden by its human population.

Sur-avka were a species of flying creatures native to Polyneus. New Republic pilot Wyl Lark grew up riding sur-avka on Polyneus, giving him the ability to fly starfighters. They had down feathers, leathery skin, and an unpleasant odor.

Trenchenovu was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches that was situated along the Corellian Trade Spine. The Galactic Empire operated the Trenchenovu shipyards there.

The Trenchenovu shipyards were a Galactic Empire shipyard near Trenchenovu. The Rebel Alliance squadron led by Nath Tensent attempted to attack the shipyards, but were all but destroyed by the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.
Thumbsnapper's Bridge was a location where Riot Squadron won a battle against pirates. It was located in the Phelleem sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Mek'tradi was a planet in the Mek'tradi system in the Baroli sector of the Expansion Region that housed a Rebel Alliance cell during the Imperial Era. The Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing bombarded the planet from orbit to draw out the rebel cell and destroy them.

The Hellion's Dare was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate captained by the Chadra-Fan Kreskian in the service of the New Republic. Following the Battle of Endor, it was assigned to scouting missions, embarking Riot Squadron and Hound Squadron.

Dhen-Moh was an Inner Rim Territories astronomical object where the Galactic Empire, including the Sith Lord Darth Vader carried out genocides. Multiple individuals reflected on the atrocity later on, particularly in respect to Vader's involvement.

Mrinzebon was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Mrinzebon system in the Sombure sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was the site of a colony. It was the site of a battle between Republic clone troopers and Separatist droids during the Clone Wars.
Ontotho was a forested planet in the Ontotho system in the Nembus sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Argai Minor was a terrestrial planet. The Galactic Empire had forces within the Treinhaus Citadel on Argai Minor, and when the New Republic attacked the citadel, the Barma Battle Group sent Meteor Squadron, Hail Squadron, and Vanguard Squadron to support their ground forces.
Hetnagaro was a world located in the Hetnagaro system within the Andirma sector of the Expansion Region and Trailing Sectors. It was situated in grid square L-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Indu San was an astronomical object in the Rolion sector of the Outer Rim Territories where the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing operated at in the weeks after the Battle of Endor 4 ABY, during which some of their members were killed.
Harkrova I was a terrestrial planet located in the Harkrova system in the Inner Rim Territories. The planet was situated at the coordinates N-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
An unnamed moon orbited the barren planet Harkrova I. The moon was covered in forests and mountains, and housed a temple which the Rebel Alliance used as a supply cache.

Vernid was a planet located in an Outer Rim Territories and New Territories' Vernid system with at least two moons. Home to mud plains and bruising rain, its inhabitants, considered barbaric by some, included worm farmers that worked dig-rigs.

Greater Xnapolis was a city located on the world Mrinzebon. The city was somewhat profitable during the reign of the Galactic Empire, however, shortly after the Battle of Endor, the Empire abandoned the city and Mrinzebon. Immediately, riots and looting began.

Induchron was a city located on the planet Pandem Nai. When the New Republic attacked Pandem Nai to take out the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, which had taken hold on the planet, Induchron was endangered by debris from the falling Orbital One station.
The Aerie was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier used by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. It pursued and destroyed the New Republic frigate Hellion's Dare.
The No Harm was a medical frigate in the navy of the New Republic. Yrica Quell was treated aboard the frigate after the battle on Pandem Nai.
D6-L, or Dee-six, was an R-series astromech droid that served the New Republic. Imperial defector Yrica Quell chose the droid for her T-65B X-wing starfighter in Alphabet Squadron.
T5, or Tee-five, was a C1-series astromech droid owned by Nath Tensent. T5 had served Tensent in his Rebel Alliance squadron, and later in the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron.
The Red Isles was a location on Thakwaa. Nath Tensent and his astromech droid T5 were once stranded on the Red Isles for several days.
The Warren was a bunker in Traitor's Remorse, a holding area for Imperial defectors. It was located next to a bunker.

The Huntsman was a starship that served in the navy of the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The vessel lost its entire crew during a number of attacks carried out by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing some time after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

The Kalpana was a starship that served in the New Republic's fleet during the Galactic Civil War. The entire crew of the vessel were lost during a number of attacks carried out by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing some time after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

IT-O, also known as Ito, was a reprogrammed Imperial IT-O interrogation droid with masculine programming who served New Republic Intelligence agent Caern Adan. In 4 ABY, Adan tasked IT-O to help him figure out if Imperial defector Yrica Quell was committed to the New Republic.
Jiruusi were the sentient inhabitants of the planet Jiruus. Most of them barely spoke Galactic Basic Standard, and they strongly opposed the Galactic Empire.

The Entropian Hive Trading Council were a group that controlled the asteroid trading post Entropian Hive. Former Rebel Alliance pilot Nath Tensent worked with the trading council, claiming to be on behalf of the New Republic.

During the Galactic Civil War, the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing of the Galactic Empire launched a series of attacks on the New Republic's EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate, the Hellion's Dare in the Oridol Cluster.
The Unyielding was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire which was awarded to Colonel Madrighast during the Empire's reign.
The Tangrada-Nii were an ancient culture hailing from the Tangrada-Nii system that believed that the Oridol Cluster was a living god.

The Tagra-Tel were a culture descended from the Tangrada-Nii near the Oridol Cluster. While their ancestors believed the star cluster was a god, the Tagra-Tel sent starships into the cluster over a number of centuries, and instead came to believe that it was a living creature …

Tinker-Town was a town located within the city of Greater Xnapolis on Mrinzebon. The town had been somewhat lively during the heyday of Greater Xnapolis, until the Galactic Empire cut resources to the colony. After the Empire left, it was plagued by gang activity.
Little Neimoidia was a town within the city Greater Xnapolis on Mrinzebon. It bordered Tinker-Town.

In the weeks following the Battle of Endor, Imperial TIE fighters attacked the Hellion's Dare while in orbit above the planet Jiruus. Both Riot and Hound Squadrons scrambled to defend the frigate before escaping to hyperspace.

result: Nath Tensent leaves the Rebel Alliance
x: Six months before the Battle of Endor, the battle at Trenchenovu was fought when a squadron of BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bombers, led by the rebel pilot Nath Tensent launched an attack on the Trenchenovu shipyards.

The battle at Sarapin was a fleet battle fought at some point before the attack on the Hellion's Dare. Riot Squadron pilots Sonogari and Wyl Lark were grounded during the battle, during which they kissed each other.
The raid on Beauchen took place in 4 ABY on the terrestrial astronomical object Beauchen. The Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing took part in the raid, bringing about many deaths.
During the Imperial Era, Riot Squadron fought at Thumbsnapper's Bridge against pirates who almost achieved a victory that even the Galactic Empire had not aspired to.

The Battle of Grumwall was a battle that occurred between 0 ABY and 1 ABY, in the vicinity of the Outer Rim Territories' Grumwall system. The Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing engaged Rebel Alliance forces as part of anti-rebel operations from the fighter wing.

Recon Stormtroopers were a specialized unit of the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. They were visually similar to Heavy Weapons Stormtroopers, although Recon Stormtroopers wielded a blaster rifle and thermal detonators.

The Hundred and Twenty were a group of volunteers that left Polyneus and joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic. One member of this group was the pilot Wyl Lark, who continued his service as the Rebellion became the New Republic.

The Gobreton minefield was a field of smart mines in the Gobreton system in the Barma sector of the Core Worlds. Yrica Quell used the minefield to train the pilots of the newly-formed Alphabet Squadron.

Neshorino was a city on the planet Abednedo. The city was carved into the side of a rust-brown mountain range. Neshorino had ornamental towers, jagged natural spires, and great cliff faces due to being built by a species native to caverns.

The Orinda Massacre, also known as the Red Insurgency, was a massacre carried out on Orinda by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. The 204th earned the name Shadow Wing as a result of this massacre.

The Bazaar of Esoteric Obscenities was a location which burned down a number of weeks after the Battle of Endor, in 4 ABY. Major Soran Keize, former Imperial pilot of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, had been present at the location when it had burned down.
The Sanction was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served in the Galactic Empire's navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Lancer was a corvette in the navy of the Galactic Empire. During a New Republic attack on Pandem Nai in the aftermath of the Battle of Endor, the Lancer was present above the planet.
A battle was fought on Mrinzebon during the Clone Wars between clone troopers of the Galactic Republic and Separatist battle droids.

Polynean were the human inhabitants of the planet Polyneus. When speaking with Caern Adan about Wyl Lark, New Republic General Hera Syndulla noted that she had seen two Polynean tributes in her career and had been impressed with their knack for piloting.

objective: Investigate reports of Imperial holdouts
x: Following the Galactic Empire's attack on Abednedo, the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron undertook a mission to the planet to investigate reports of Imperial holdouts that remained on Abednedo after Operation: Cinder.

The destruction of Nacronis, also referred to as the cleansing of Nacronis, was a massacre carried out by the Galactic Empire as part of Operation: Cinder, following the death of Emperor Palpatine in the Battle of Endor.
Ridge was a village on the planet Polyneus. It was where eventual New Republic pilot Wyl Lark had been raised.

Following the New Republic's victory at Argai Minor, a battle was fought in the Haldeen sector when Hail Squadron, along with support from Alphabet Squadron, engaged a Star Destroyer that had been limping through the sector for weeks.

result: Death of Shadow Wing's leader Shakara Nuress
x: The Battle of Pandem Nai or attack on Pandem Nai was an attack during the Galactic Civil War led by the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron against the Galactic Empire's base on Pandem Nai, home to the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

The bombardment of Mek'tradi was a massacre carried out by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing prior to the Battle of Endor in an attempt to draw out a rebel cell. After participating in the bombardment, Lieutenant Yrica Quell was horrified at her part in the event.
The bombing of Mennar-Daye was carried out by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing on Mennar-Daye prior to the Battle of Endor.

Dragonflies were a type of insect. Whilst thinking of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing's bombardment of Mek'tradi, Yrica Quell noted that they had chased rebel X-wing starfighters in loops and burned ascending shuttles like children tearing wings from dragonflies.
The Hidden Hand was a mysterious criminal syndicate affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic that was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
TZ-2, or Teezee-Too, also known as Teezee, was an RA-7 protocol droid that worked for General Airen Cracken of the Rebel Alliance's Intelligence division.
GNK-143 was a GNK-series power droid that inhabited the settlement Tuanul on the planet Jakku.

Salobea was a forested world in the Salobea system in the Noonian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. After their mission to Shu-Torun, Leia Organa and her team dropped Benthic and the Partisans off on Salobea in a foggy clearing outside of the forest.
Bakerstown was a town located on the planet Vernid.

The Expansionist Oligarchy was a cabal of corporate conglomerates that existed several centuries before the beginning of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY. The group pushed for the right of world development in the Outer Expansion Zone region from the Galactic Republic.

The Nebula Front was a radical political group opposed to vast corporate conglomerates. In 33 BBY, at a trade summit on Eriadu, the Nebula Front attempted to assassinate Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum of the Galactic Republic, and successfully assassinated the directorate of…
Lanz Carpo was a small planet located in the Lanz Carpo system of the Core Worlds, possessing one of the highest crime rates in the region.

Namzor was a terrestrial world located in the Mid Rim. During the era of the Galactic Empire, a group of insurgents were based on the world. Governor Ahr led an attack on the insurgents, but discovered that they were based above their stores of coaxium.
Huk was a desolate planet within the Huk system, a star system in Wild Space, the homeworld of the technologically-advanced insectoid Yam'rii species.

Valahari was a terrestrial planet located in grid square N-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid, in the Valahari system of the Valahari sector, a part of the D'Astan sector in the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories.

Granite slugs were a type of small slug found on the ecumenopolis Coruscant. The slugs were silica parasites capable of consuming mineral matter, excreting acidic saliva as they moved across the surface of buildings and then consuming the resulting slime using their two mouths.
Zaadja was a planet located within the Savareen sector of the region known as the Outer Rim Territories.

The Neimoidian soldier beetle was a type of beetle that Haor Chall Engineering Corporation constructed the Sheathipede-class transport shuttle roughly in the shape of. It shared its name with the sentient Neimoidian species.

The toothspike raptor was a creature native to the planet Colla IV. The bell-shaped hull of the Droch-class boarding ships used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems produced by the Colicoid Creation Nest were loosely based on toothspike raptors.
Pzandias was a planet located in the Pzandias system within the Bryx sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square S-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Raxus Address was a speech given by the former Jedi Count Dooku in 24 BBY that was credited with essentially setting the stage for the Separatist Movement.

The Judicial Plaza was a plaza located on the planet Coruscant, the capital of the Galactic Republic. Around the time of the Clone Wars between the Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Republic's Judicial Department was headquartered in the Judicial Arcology, a…
Mechis III, also known as Mechis, was a small planetoid vital to the Techno Union. It was defended by a mix of starships from member corporations and design firms such as SoroSuub Corporation.
New Holstice was a terrestrial astronomical object in the New Holstice system in the Maldrood sector of the Mid Rim Territories which had medical facilities associated with the Galactic Republic.
The Republic Central Medcenter was a medcenter located on the planet Coruscant, the capital of the Galactic Republic.
The Salissians were a social group originating from the Outer Rim's Salissia system that was active in the galaxy during the Republic Era.

Sikurdians were a sentient species from the Sikurd system. During the Clone Wars, Sikurdian privateers supported the Corporate Alliance, which had pledged its resources to the Confederacy of Independent Systems, in defending its headquarters on the planet Murkhana.
The Jedi Exploration Corps, officially designated as the Archaeological and Research Division and nicknamed the ExplorCorps, was an organization within the Jedi Order.

Zoph was a planet located in the Zoph system within the Wazta sector of the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches. It was situated in grid square J-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The Zophis crystal, a type of kyber crystal, could be found at Zoph.

Gibad was one of the hundreds of agriworlds in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. Located in the Gibad system, it fell within grid square S-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Tieos was an agriworld in the Tieos system, one of hundreds located within the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Abrion Major was a planet covered in islands and one of the hundreds of agriworlds located in the Outer Rim Territories' Abrion sector.
Escarte was a world in the Escarte system within the Keldrath sector of the Outer Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square T-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Kalarba pirates were active in the galaxy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Merson pirates were active in the galaxy during the Republic and Imperial Eras. They shared their name with the Merson system in the Inner Rim. During the Clone Wars, they were one of several pirate groups supported by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Nuro pirates were a group of pirates that were active throughout the time of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Nuala Marauders were a group of pirates originating from the Nuala system of the Mid Rim Territories. The group was active during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Minntooine was a strategic planet located in the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice, within the Calamari sector's Minntooine system. The planet was controlled by the Commerce Guild prior to and during the Clone Wars, holding major corporate interests of the guild.
The Penal Oversight Committee was a political committee within the Galactic Republic's senate active during the time of the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Delmaasi pirates originated from the Delmaas system of the Outer Rim Territories. The group was active during the latter years of the Republic Era.

The Iridium Pirates originated from the Iridium system of the Outer Rim Territories. The group was active during the time of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Red Fury Brotherhood were a group of pirates that signed terms with Count Dooku, leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, to exclusively target the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Martaus VI was the homeworld of Fossil, a female Martigrade who served in the Resistance. According to Paige Tico, the First Order turned Martaus VI into a labor camp. It was located in the Martaus system in the Inner Rim Territories.

During the New Republic Era, the First Order bombed the village of Sebris Gamma on Hays Minor when it refused to follow its orders. The First Order dropped ground-penetrating bombs loaded with incendiaries into the village and burned the Gammans alive.

The Pacifist faction, simply known as the Pacifists, was a political faction within the Galactic Republic Senate that consisted of an assortment of miserable Core Worlds star systems that were in opposition to increasing taxes and was against the centralized power granted by t…
The Pijali honor guard was a military group on the planet Pijal.
The Punishing One was a JumpMaster 5000 owned by the bounty hunter Dengar. The ship had no holding cell due to the fact that Dengar usually only took in dead bounties.

The Blackguard was a military group on the planet Pijal. Their actions were blamed on the Opposition, considered an easy scapegoat due to their previous protest actions as performance artists, but they were actually a division of the Pijal royal guard.
The Secessionist Faction, also known as the Secessionists, was an extremist faction within the Galactic Republic's Pacifist faction.
The IG-2000 was a modified Aggressor-class Assault Fighter owned by the assassin droid bounty hunter IG-88B.
The Judiciary Committee was a Galactic Senate legislative committee of the Galactic Republic that was active during the Clone Wars, which lasted from 22 BBY to 19 BBY.

The Internal Activities Committee was a legislative committee that was part of the Galactic Republic Senate's Judiciary Committee. It was considered to be a spiritual partner of the Senate's Ethics Committee.

The Republic Defense Procurement Office, abbreviated as RDPO, was a civilian agency within the Galactic Republic that was responsible for acquiring and providing logistical support for the Republic Military during the Clone Wars against the Separatist Alliance.

Project Supercharger was a joint Galactic Republic project spearheaded by both the Corellian Engineering Corporation and the Republic's defense procurement office which was active during the time of the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Department of Naval Procurement was a department within the Galactic Republic's defense procurement office that was active during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Galactic Senate's Naval Subcommittee was a political subcommittee within the Galactic Republic. It was active during the Clone Wars against the Separatist Alliance, fought from 22 BBY to 19 BBY, and had the Procurement Panel directly beneath it.

This 2-1B surgical droid worked on Naboo for its royal house during the Clone Wars. It was present in Theed in the year 21 BBY, when the Confederacy of Independent Systems had an unwelcome presence on the planet.
The Procurement Panel was a legislative organization within the Galactic Republic that was part of the Galactic Senate's Naval Subcommittee.
The Independence Faction was a political faction within the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Separatist Senate during the Clone Wars.
The Peace Faction was a political faction within the Separatist Senate of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars who wished to bring an end to the war.

The War Faction was a political faction within the Separatist Senate of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, which was based in the Separatist Senate Building on the planet Raxus Secundus during the Clone Wars.

Aduba was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Aduba system in the Bheriz sector, along the Triellus Trade Route on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories in grid square U-11 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of Cobalt Hammer pilot Finch Dallow.
The Republic Tax Collection Agency was a government agency of the Galactic Republic that was responsible for collecting taxes from members of the Republic.
The War Council Advisory Panel was an organization of the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, it advised the Supreme Chancellor on matters relating to the war effort.

objective: Obtain supplies for the Rebel Alliance
x: During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance sent Phoenix Leader Captain Hera Syndulla and a squadron of BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bombers on a supply mission.

The River of Origin was a river on the planet Kashyyyk. Some time after Order 66, former Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis hijacked an Imperial All Terrain Armored Transport that was walking through the river during a skirmish against the forces of Saw Gerrera's Partisans.

IDT-28 was the designation of a starship used to transport new recruits into the Galactic Empire. While it was located at Coronet Spaceport on Corellia, the Imperial Recruitment Officer Drawd Munbrin sent a recruit to IDT-28.
The Firedrake was a Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire that served as the flagship of Grand Admiral Balanhai Savit and the Imperial Navy's Third Fleet. Its commanding officer was Captain Boulag.
Grallocs were a species of creature related to the mynock. They lived in the vacuum of space, attacking power cables in a similar way to mynocks, but were larger and stronger.
The coronation of Queen Fanry as queen of Pijal occurred around 40 BBY. Upon Princess Fanry's fourteenth birthday, it was planned that she would be crowned as queen by the traditions of her people.

Ord Mynock was a planet located within the Ord Mynock system of the Prefsbelt sector within the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories. It fell within grid square K-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Ahn Krantarium was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Mid Rim's Ahn Krantarium system. Long before the Imperial Era, it was overrun by ferocious droids who continued to rebuild themselves to be deadlier.

Phelzepham was a rocky moon located in the Mid Rim. During the early Imperial Era, the Imperial Governor Ahr led a battle on the moon. As the Empire came closer to victory, Ahr pulled out all forces aside from the Sith Lord Darth Vader, who he hoped would die during the battle.

The Kankalo Belt Containment Zone was an asteroid belt located in the Kankalo system in the Esuain sector of the Mid Rim. It was inhabited by a large and dangerous creature, which the Galactic Empire chose not to disturb.
In 13 BBY, the Galactic Empire undertook a mission on Qhulosk where they fought a battle in the city of Howlan on the planet Qhulosk.
During Qui-Gon Jinn's Padawan training, he and his Master Dooku took place in a battle on Shurrupak.

t: Bureau of Sig, Spice and Slavery
x: The Bureau of Sig, Spice and Slavery, shortened to S3, was an intelligence and analysis law enforcement agency of the Galactic Republic which was formed centuries prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Arr-Nine-Nineteen was a droid who claimed to be a Jedi hunter, but was a Hutt Clan spy in reality. During the Imperial Era, he was one of several individuals hired by the Hidden Hand crime syndicate's leader, Gwi, as part of a team tasked with hunting down the Sith Lord Darth …
The Republic Ambassadorial Corps was an organization within the Galactic Republic that was active before the outbreak of the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Republic Mobile Surgical Units were mobile, prefabricated medical centers utilized by the Galactic Republic's Grand Army during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

In the Clone Wars, between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, the Quellor sector's purse worlds were blockaded by the Galactic Republic's 2nd Fleet. Suffering from the blockade, the Trade Federation's enormous home defense fleet was deployed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Deck Nine, also known as Deck 9, was a location on the First Order planet of Starkiller Base. During construction of the area, the cleaning crew ran into an infestation which killed two of its members.
Fikari was a terrestrial world in the Outer Rim Territories. Darth Vader searched for information regarding a plot to assassinate him on the Hidden Hand crime syndicate on the world.
TX-532 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid who served in the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars.
Clone artillery troopers were clone troopers of the Galactic Republic that specialized in using and other artillery pieces such as the Model 201 mortar system.
The Lower Bay Docks was a location on the Outer Rim world of Fikari. It was one of the locations where the Hidden Hand criminal syndicate operated.

Two months after causing chaos on Milvayne, Chelli Aphra and Vulaada Klam infiltrated the Slinani Migration Shrine Red Mist. During the infiltration, Aphra sliced one of the defending "janitor droids" to destroy its peers and collect a cape.

The Mospic High Range was a rocky region that acted as a frontier between the settlement of Mos Espa and the Dune Sea, located at the western end of the Northern Dune Sea in the small habitable region of the desert planet Tatooine's northern hemisphere.

Death Watch Warriors were warriors that served the Mandalorian terrorist group Death Watch. Led by Pre Vizsla, the warriors of Death Watch were exiled for their intent to restore the ways of Mandalore's warrior past, opposing the New Mandalorians and their pacifist ways.

090192 was a spy ship used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic. During the war, the T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid TX-532 utilized the starship for a secret operation on Naboo.
Jedi mystic was a term used to refer to members of the ancient Jedi Order who made prophecies based on visions granted to them via the Force.

Mumuu was a deadly predatory beast native to the Wild Space planet Kalee. The native Kaleesh species hunted the Mumuu for more than simply meat and generally killed the creatures to demonstrate their bravery.

Special Enforcement Officers, abbreviated SEOs, were elite police officers of the Galactic Republic Sector Rangers. While standard Sector Rangers were restricted to their assigned sectors of space, SEOs used their jurisdictional freedom to pursue criminals across borders.
The Ravenstar was a starship flown by the explorer Ariana Surabat and her crew, who founded the planet Batuu in the Outer Rim Territories.
Jereth VI was a forest planet that was home to the Jerethian clamberwolf. It was located in the Jereth system in the Bozhnee sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Pipa birds were a species of small bird with white feathers. Known for their long pink beaks and distinctive morning calls, they inhabited regions ranging from the jungles of Batuu’s southern hemisphere to the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost.

Dugar dugar were a species of deerlike creature native to the planet Batuu. They were described as slender, with long silky fur that was "the color of mushrooms." Their calls could be heard from within Black Spire Outpost.

Lahiroo were a species of feathered reptiles native to the planet Batuu. Their calls could be heard from within Black Spire Outpost. Some residents of Batuu raised lahiroo to become pets or for other reasons.

Nightsnakes were a species of snake native to the planet Batuu. Their calls could be heard from within Black Spire Outpost. Some residents of Batuu raised nightsnakes to be pets or for other reasons. Some people would carry nightsnake scales as charms for courage.
Batuuan Rats were a species of rat native to the planet Batuu. Their calls could be heard from within Black Spire Outpost. Some residents of Batuu raised rats to become pets or for other reasons.

Spiran Fireflies were a species of firefly native to the planet Batuu. Their calls could be heard from within Black Spire Outpost. Some residents of Batuu raised fireflies to become pets or for other reasons.

Terra tree toads were a species of toad native to the planet Batuu. They lived in the Batuu tree. Their calls could be heard from within Black Spire Outpost. Some residents of Batuu raised terra tree toads as pets or for other reasons.
R4-I9 was an R4 astromech droid with masculine programming, dark blue panelling and a black sensor who served the Galactic Empire.

Krill were small crustaceans that lived in water in great numbers. In the oceans of the planet Kamino, they were a major source of food for the semi-aquatic aiwha species, which had baleens in their mouths to filter krill out from seawater.

Fort Tusken was a settlement on Tatooine that was founded some eight decades prior to the proclamation of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY. Situated on the edge of the Badlands of the Jundland Wastes, it almost immediately faced attacks from the local Sand People.
The Imperial Records Office was a department of the Galactic Empire that was responsible for maintaining records.
Jat Kaa's Coolers was a company owned by the Lurmen male Jat Kaa, who hailed from the planet Mygeeto. He imported beverages to the Outer Rim planet Batuu and sold them throughout Black Spire Outpost.
Dee-dee-nine was a droid who helped Lyra Erso research kyber crystals on the Outer Rim world Alpinn.

B6-24 was a protocol droid with feminine programming who hosted Droid Station Frequency 3-7-6-4-3-7, a classified radio station where droids helped droids. The station played in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.
The Rawani Cup was a podracing tournament. The final race of the event was held in the city of Baroonda, where it was broadcast by the alien Bakk and Zico for the radio station BSO 401.72.

Baroonda was a city where podracing took place. When Syril Karn attempted to gain entry to the Imperial office complex on Ghorman after hours, the two guards were watching a podrace on a datapad screen, with Aurebesh text at the bottom indicating that the race took place in Ba…

Galma, also known as Galma Vicinity, Galma District, or Galma outskirts, was the name of a settlement on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. The settlement's vicinity was host to illegal podraces and droid fights.

Slitherfish were a non-sentient species found on the Mid Rim planet of Naboo. Despite their name, they did not live in the water, but under the shade of trees, where they formed clusters that made them look like vines at first glance.

The Cliffs of Theed were a line of towering cliffs located on the Mid Rim planet of Naboo. The city of Theed, the capital of Naboo's human inhabitants, stood on a plateau at the top of one of those cliffs, with the Royal Palace sitting directly on its edge.
During the Clone Wars, Doctor Galen Walton Erso and his wife Lyra were captured on the planet Vallt.
Neskar was a planet orbited by at least 3 moons that was located in the Neskar system in the Tashtor sector of the Mid Rim Territories. From space, Neskar was banded with streaks of red and purple.

The Fellio Asteroid Belt was an asteroid belt located in the Fellio system within the Cadavine sector of the Outer Rim Territories and Trailing Sectors. It was situated in grid square P-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Broken Wing was a starship piloted by the bounty hunter Beilert Valance during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Valance utilized the Broken Wing when he was hired by the Hidden Hand criminal syndicate to lead a team on a hunt for the Imperial enforcer Darth Vader.
The Garbage Moon of Maher was a moon located in the Unknown Regions. It was used as a dump site and, as a result, featured heaps of junk on its surface.
During the era of the New Republic, the First Order launched an attack on the iron planet Demir in the Unknown Regions.

Level 1671 was one of the city levels of the planet Coruscant, located 3,456 levels beneath the surface. In 7951 C.R.C., the Pau'an Zodu Onglo took part in a botched arms deal on Level 1671 and was arrested for aggravated assault by the Coruscant Security Force.

Gavas-Eclat was a neighborhood on Level 3215 of the ecumenopolis that covered the planet Coruscant. The neighborhood contained lower-class apartments and reduced-capacity industrial areas with urban blight seeping between them, bringing with it criminals who shook down the har…

The Aradonti Ravine was a gap between building blocks in Galactic City, the ecumenopolis city that covered the surface of the planet Coruscant. It was situated south west of the planet's Federal District and close to the Collective Commerce District.
The Glitch was a splinter faction of the Droid Gotra, a criminal syndicate formed from disaffected droids after the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY.

The Baroonda Circuit was a podracing course that shared its name with the city Baroonda, where the Rawani Cup podracing event was held. It also shared its name with the astronomical object Baroonda in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Mos Eisley prefect's office, also known as the spaceport prefect's office, was a law enforcement agency office built on Straight Street in the spaceport of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine.
The Ministry of Science was a government department of the Galactic Republic. During the final decades of the Republic, the scientist Sirro Argonne was a member of the ministry.
Rekkana was a shipyard planet home to the Rekk, who were known for their skills in creating automatic systems.
The Rekk were a sentient species and the native inhabitants of the planet Rekkana. They were known for their expertise in creating automatic computer-controlled systems.
Drazkel was the homeworld of Lady Xev Xrexus, leader of the Xrexus Cartel, a collection of semi-legitimate droid manufacturing firms from the Mid Rim.
The Eastport Docks were a docking area in Eastport, a spaceport in the Port District of Galactic City, the ecumenopolis covering the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

The Heavenly Sphere, briefly known as the Righteous during Queen Fanry's ownership, was the flagship of the royal fleet of Pijal. After Fanry's revolution during her coronation, she commanded the starship in an attempted assault on the Czerka Corporation vessel Leverage.

The conference rooms were a location on the space station Zeta. The Jedi Rael Averross met with Dooku and Qui-Gon Jinn after negotiations between the Plinovians and the Solodoe on the station were disrupted.
Level twenty was a level of the Station Zeta space station. The casino Chance Encounters was located on the level.
Chance Encounters was a casino on level twenty of Station Zeta. While serving as a diplomat aboard the space station, the Jedi Arath Tarrex became stuck with gambling debts to the casino.
Jirree Town was a town located on the planet Vandor.
Kakrans were a species of rock people who lived on the planet Kakra, a sentient world that was a giant Kakran itself.

Sergia was a desert planet in the Inner Rim of the galaxy. The Alliance to Restore the Republic operated a refueling station on the planet. When Imperial probes were reported to be close to the rebel refueling station, Luke Skywalker was sent to draw them away.

Sith troopers, also known as Sith stormtroopers, were elite soldiers in the forces of the Sith Eternal, a cult that resided on the dark planet of Exegol in the Unknown Regions. The army was comprised of the children of the Sith cultists that revered the dark side of the Force.
The Demirians were a species that inhabited the iron planet Demir in the Unknown Regions. When Captain Phasma of the First Order led an attack on Demir, the Demirians defended their world.
The Galard Stables hive was a notable Geonosian hive that wielded huge influence over the political systems of the Geonosian species on their homeworld, Geonosis. The system included ten prime hives.
The Steadfast was a Chiss heavy cruiser of the Chiss Ascendancy serving under the Expansionary Defense Fleet during the Imperial Era. It was under the command of Admiral Ar'alani.
Some time after the Batonn insurgency, the Chiss warship Steadfast was involved in a nasty skirmish with the Grysk and some of their allies near the Imperial edge of the Unknown Regions.

An attack was carried out on the Mid Rim world of Namzor by Imperial forces led by Moff Ahr and the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Vader, during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The aim was to secure coaxium supplies and to destroy the insurgents that were near the area.

2P-1 was a 2-1B surgical droid with yellow and white plating. During the First Order's occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, 2P-1 was kept on display in the Droid Depot, a store located in Black Spire Outpost.
K-7R1 was a KX-series security droid manufactured by Arakyd Industries. Standing 2.16 meters tall, it had white sensors and black plating marked with white patterning.
The Logistics division was an organization within the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
BK-86 was a IG-series assassin droid that worked as primary security droid for the Ithorian antiques dealer Dok-Ondar at his Den of Antiquities in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.

G4-S8 was an R4 astromech droid, manufactured by Industrial Automaton. During the First Order's occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, G4-S8 was displayed amongst a variety of droid parts upon one of the upper shelves of the Droid Depot in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.
JB-9 was a BB-series astromech droid, manufactured by Industrial Automaton, that belonged to the Droid Depot in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.
In 34 ABY, following the Battle of Crait, the First Order launched a blockade of the planet Kashyyyk, home to the Wookiees, during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

An attack was carried out on the Mid Rim world of Ahn Krantarium by Imperial forces led by Governor Ahr and Darth Vader, which happened during the early days of the Galactic Empire. The aim was to destroy deadly droids that had overrun the world long before the Imperial Era.

As part of the Galactic Empire's pacification operations in the Esuain sector of the Mid Rim Territories around 2 BBY, Imperial forces under the command of Moff Ahr carried out an attack against the insurgents based on a moon in the sector, Phelzepham.
Tookes were creatures that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Batuu in the forests near the ancient ruins.
The Broken Chain Clan were a group of pirates whose membership consisted of ex-prisoners and criminals that had banded together. They attacked starships to take their supplies and cargo.

Doomsday Cloud was a notorious group of well-established smugglers that was active during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. The group wrought havoc and destruction without mercy, swallowing all in their path.
B-R72 was a heavy loader droid manufactured by JLD Mechanicals Consortium with yellow and red plating. The droid belonged to the Droid Depot in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.

EG-01 was a GNK-series power droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton with green plating. During the occupation of the planet Batuu by the First Order in 34 ABY, the power droid was displayed alongside several other droids on a plinth behind railings located outside of the D…
R1-J1 was an R1-series astromech droid with green plating and a yellow trim. It stood 1.94 meters tall and, like all R-series astromech droids, was manufactured by Industrial Automaton.
AC-38, or "Ace," was an AC-series pilot droid who had its StarSpeeder hijacked by a rogue protocol droid and taken on a dangerous trip across the galaxy.

t: High Energy Concepts and Implementation Labs Division
x: The High Energy Concepts and Implementation Labs Division was one of the Maw Installation's organizations. The Division was headed by Director Paldis Doxin. The HECIL Division was responsible for creating the Sun Crusher and the Metal-Crystal Phase Shifter projects.
A type of creature inhabited the planet-turned superweapon Ilum in the Unknown Regions. The creature had bat-like wings and a carnivorous diet.
The Carpo Crime Syndicate, also known as the Carpo Organization, was a criminal syndicate led by Boss Carpo, which held control over the Core Worlds planet Lanz Carpo.

The Red Carpo Guards were law enforcement officers of the Carpo Crime Syndicate on Lanz Carpo. District Advocate Dar Champion often arrested members the Red Carpo Guard for crimes such as extortion and unlawful detainment, but Boss Carpo always bailed them out of any punishment.

Central Booking was a law enforcement office on the planet Lanz Carpo. Dar Champion brought several corrupt Red Carpo Guards to Central Booking to be arrested, but they were freed on orders of Regional Magistrate Eck.

D-4 was a protocol droid that belonged to Countess Anya and later her husband Gora and Ramil her son. At the time, when Abyssin pirates invaded Serenno, Jenza sent the droid to Coruscant find Dooku to save their people.

Akira was a village on Felucia that grew and harvested nysillin during the Clone Wars. Casiss Midagatis served as the village's elder. He hired four expensive bounty hunters; Sugi, Embo, Rumi Paramita and Seripas to defend the village from the pirates of the Ohnaka Gang.
The Ailon were a sentient humanoid species whose entire population was employed in a mercenary group called the Ailon Nova Guard. They originated from the Ailon system in the Inner Rim Territories.

The Ailon Nova Guard originated from the Ailon system of the Inner Rim Territories. It was an ancient mercenary culture, created eons before the Clone Wars fought between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems from 22 BBY to 19 BBY.
The Aurodium Sword was a company of mercenaries active during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, fought from 22 BBY to 19 BBY.
Alaris was a planet of the Mytaranor sector's Kashyyyk system in the galaxy's Mid Rim. One of its moons, Alaris Prime, was home to a colony of Wookiees from the neighboring planet Kashyyyk.

Alaris Prime was one of the several moons that orbited the planet Alaris of the Kashyyyk system, in the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim, and had hosted a colony of Wookiees (from the neighboring world of Kashyyyk) by the time of the Clone Wars.
The Inner Rim Mercenaries were a newly-established mercenary group active at the time of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Vipers were a newly-established group of mercenaries during the Clone Wars. Like several other newly-created groups, the Vipers quickly emerged as a group who immediately sided with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Audit Division was a department of the Galactic Empire that was responsible for auditing. While Lando Calrissian was the Baron Administrator of Cloud City, Bondeeni threatened to have his cousin, who worked for the agency, involved in the deal he and Lando were having.
Felucian fireflies were a species of firefly native to the planet Felucia. By 34 ABY, Dok-Ondar kept a terrarium with Felucian fireflies in his Den of Antiquities on the planet of Batuu.

Pau City Police was the law enforcement agency of the Utapaun Pau City during the Clone Wars. Late during the war, police Inspector Jen June and Governor Torul Blom conspired with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Aloxor was a planet located in the Esaga sector's Aloxor system within the Mid Rim Territories. During the time of the Galactic Empire, Aloxor was under the jurisdiction of Governor Haveland, possessing an Imperial presence.

Charra was a terrestrial astronomical object where Governor Tarkin of the Galactic Empire attended a trade conference. It was located in the Charra system in the Charra sector of the Expansion Region, in grid square P-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Kurost transfer point was a location in the Kurost sector where the Galactic Empire shipped materials for Project Stardust.
Tiquwe was a town located in the south hemisphere of the planet Aloxor. A large section of its population was made up of smugglers and pirates.
The Misthunter was a Star Destroyer in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire as a part of Third Fleet.
The Stormbird was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire as a part of Third Fleet. It was commanded by Captain Lochry.
