x: During the First Order-Resistance War, the First Order sent the Nikto engineer Nenavakasa Nalor on a mission to sabotage the Colossus platform. Posing as a stranded spacer, Nena managed to gain the trust of the Colossus crew particularly the fellow Nikto Neeku Vozo.

Luftgriff Peak was part of the Iridium Mountains range on the planet Vandor. It shared its name with luftgriff creatures. In 10 BBY, due to an explosion during Tobias Beckett's heist on a conveyex, Luftgriff Peak was blown clean in half.
The Jirree Glacier was a mass of ice on the planet of Vandor. At one point, an archaeologist came to Vandor in search of an ancient temple she thought was buried beneath the glacier.
A T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid was assigned to oversee a Separatist garrison on the planet Horain during the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
The Mon Calamari male Aftab Ackbar utilized an MC95 Star Cruiser during the war between the First Order and the Resistance in 34 ABY.
Doaba Guerfel was a mountain town on the planet Corellia, located a short distance away from the capital, Coronet City.
Bela Vistal was a town located on the planet Corellia. It was the hometown of Winshur Bratt, who despised his upbringing and attempted to sever ties with the town.

Tovash Tchii was an astronomical object in the Tovash Tchii system in the Alui sector of the Mid Rim Territories, along the Triellus Trade Route. When the Millennium Falcon became low on fuel after the Battle of Crait, Nien Nunb suggested stopping at Tovash Tchii to refuel.
The Ryloth Defense Authority, or RDA, was a paramilitary group founded to defend Ryloth from oppression and slavery.

The Collective was an underground organization composed of engineers, technicians, and scientists who were determined to stop the spread of authoritarianism via the use of technology. It used a white-horned serpent as its symbol.

The Turclom Riots had occurred by 34 ABY in the vicinity of the Mid Rim's Turclom system. The former New Republic pilot Norra Wexley believed that the grav-ball champion Cutar Har died during the riots.

Inya Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object. While searching for allies of the Resistance in 34 ABY, Resistance operatives Shriv Suurgav and Zay Versio visited Inya Prime, where Suurgav acquired a persistent rash.

Gheia Six was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Gheia system within the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim and New Territories. It was situated on grid square K-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Spira was a tropical planet known for its golden beaches that was located in the Galactic Core.

The Ibdis Maw was a superorganism that lived on the planet Bracca, located in the Mid Rim. While resembling a sarlacc from outside, the Ibdis Maw consisted of a number of mouths connected by a vast digestive system located hundreds of meters below the surface of the planet.

Wish, formerly known as Outpost 665, was a former Galactic Empire tibanna mining colony in the atmosphere of the gas planet Ephemera. After the tibanna supply ran out, the Empire abandoned the colony, which was later turned into a resort destination after the discovery of tuusah.

The Records Department was a department of the Corellian Engineering Corporation on Corellia. Winshur Bratt worked as a clerk in the Records Department, but was promoted to Executive Records Officer when the First Order took control of the company.
In 34 ABY during the war between the First Order and the Resistance, the Attack on Ryloth was launched by the First Order after they discovered the Resistance's base on the planet Ryloth.

The Employment Department was a department of the Corellian Engineering Corporation. When Executive Records Officer Winshur Bratt of the Records Department went to receive a group of First Order prisoners, he asked his assistant Monti Calay to look after his office, claiming h…

RDA One was a Rycrit-class starship piloted by Hahnee Brethen for the Ryloth Defense Authority. When the Millennium Falcon arrived above Ryloth, Brethen flew RDA One to the freighter, using her authority as a member of the Ryloth Defense Authority to force government Can-Cell …

The Ryloth Historical Society was a historical society based on Ryloth. When the Ryloth Defense Authority was founded, they were moved into a facility that had formerly been used by the Ryloth Historical Society.

Barterus was a location on the planet Rattatak that contained a gladiatorial ring. While searching on Rattatak for the ex-Imperial warlord Teza Nasz, Jessika Pava and Suralinda Javos were forced to fight in the gladiatorial ring in order to speak with her.

Dormitory F was a floor within the dormitory building of the Corellian Command Base, headquarters of the Corellian Engineering Corporation under the First Order. A group of prisoners sent to Corellia were placed in Dormitory F.

Cell 8 was one of the cells located within Dormitory F, a floor of the Corellian Command Base's dormitory building where the First Order held prisoners. Ransolm Casterfo, designated Prisoner 876549C, was imprisoned within cell 8.

Platform thirty-three was a platform of the scrapping facilities on the planet Bracca. A Resistance team led by Shriv Suurgav traveled to platform thirty-three via train while on a mission to steal starships from the planet.

Platform thirty-three G was a Scrapper Guild platform located on Bracca. While on a mission to steal starships for the Resistance, a team led by Shriv Suurgav managed to steal a number of ships that were ready to be scrapped on platform thirty-three G.
Platform thirty-two was a Scrapper Guild platform on Bracca. While on a train to platform thirty-three, a Resistance team led by Shriv Suurgav passed by platform thirty-two.

Platform twenty was one of many Scrapper Guild platforms on the planet Bracca. While on a Resistance mission to Bracca with Shriv Suurgav's Dross Squadron, Raidah Doon was picked up as a known criminal by First Order stormtroopers.
Mount Izukika was a snowy mountain on the planet Kijimi. The ancient Kijimi City and Kijimi City spaceport were located high atop Mount Izukika, between other surrounding mountains.
The Reform Office was a division of the First Order that worked with prisoners. Colonel Genial, a reform officer, accompanied a number of prisoners to Corellia.
Alliance Military Research and Development, also simply known as Alliance R&D, was a research and development division of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Asteroid-Helix was an asteroid field located near Karga. One of the asteroids, Asteroid Helix 13-v, was the location of an ancient Force cult temple, which received a number of pilgrims over the years.
Asteroid Helix 13-v, or the Comet Helix, was an asteroid located in the Asteroid-Helix. The Force cult known as the J'doon constructed a shrine known as the Helix temple on the asteroid.

Piu was an astronomical object in the Piu system in the Kallea sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The scholar Korin Aphra witnessed prayer-oolites form aurorae above Piu after the annual Giganism Sacrifice hit the troposphere.
The J'doon were a Force cult that existed long before the Galactic Civil War. They created a shrine on Asteroid Helix 13-v, an asteroid in the Asteroid-Helix.
Karnex dragons were a species of predators native to the planet Drahgor III, which normally lived deep underground.
Desert manglers were a creature that could be found in the deserts of the Inner Rim planet Sergia. The stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire used the creatures as mounts for their patrols.
Cell block nine was a cell block located on the Sunspot Prison space station. When Doctor Aphra was imprisoned in Sunspot Prison by the Rebel Alliance, she was held in cell block nine.

Q sector was a location within the Rebel Alliance's Sunspot Prison. When former rebel spy Eneb Ray broke into Sunspot Prison to kill Imperial prisoners, he and his team of droids breached the hull in Q sector.

The west sector was a sector of the Rebel Alliance space station Sunspot Prison. During Eneb Ray's assault on Sunspot Prison, he created a diversion in the west sector so that he could take control of the station's control room.

Cell-block seven was a cell block within Sunspot Prison. When Eneb Ray attacked the prison to kill Imperial prisoners, he attempted to kill the prisoners within cell-block seven with his IG-RM droids.

Sector nine was a sector of the Rebel Alliance's Sunspot Prison. During Eneb Ray's assault on Sunspot Prison, Leia Organa held escaped prisoners in the sector. Ray deactivated the sun shields in the sector, and the prisoners were burned to death by the star.

K block was a section of the Rebel Alliance prison space station known as Sunspot Prison. During Eneb Ray's assault on the prison, Sana Starros attempted to send a transmission from the block, but was attacked by one of Ray's IG-RM droids.

Cell seventeen was a cell of Sunspot Prison, containing a prisoner who claimed to have killed three Jedi. While assaulting the prison to kill all the Imperial prisoners held there, Eneb Ray entered the cell and killed the prisoner before moving onto cell eighteen.

Cell eighteen was a cell located in the Rebel Alliance's Sunspot Prison. During his quest to kill all the Imperial prisoners in the prison, Eneb Ray ordered for the cell to be opened after killing the prisoner in cell seventeen.

The Vengeance was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer used by the navy of the Galactic Empire. After capturing the bounty hunter Beilert Valance, who had attempted to hunt down Darth Vader, he was taken to be imprisoned on the Vengeance, where the Empire tortured him for informat…
The Imperial Energy Division was a department of the Galactic Empire that was part of Project Celestial Power.
Veteran Services was a department of the Galactic Empire that dealt with veterans, including those who had fought for the regime's predecessor government, the Galactic Republic.

leader: Director of research Dr. Galen Walton Erso
x: The B'ankora division was an organization of the Galactic Empire that was part of Project Celestial Power.

Pam'ba was a planet predominately covered in warm marshlands located in the galaxy's Mid Rim. It was once the site of phosphate mines, before it was largely abandoned over a century before the New Republic Era.

Arvala-7 was a remote desert planet with a barren, rocky surface and breathable atmosphere in the Arvala system in the Sevetta sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the New Republic Era, it was home to the Ugnaught Kuiil, who lived on a moisture farm with his blurrg.

The pulsar skate was a sea creature that could be found on the planet Corellia. A sea animal control worker for the Corellian Engineering Corporation headquarters was bitten in half and killed by a pulsar skate.

The white-horned serpent was a species of serpent. It was the symbol of the underground organization known as the Collective. Nifera Shu, a Corellian benefactor of the Collective, owned one such serpent as a pet.
The twenchok was an ocean creature that could be eaten as food. Battered and fried twenchok was served at the fiftieth birthday party of Nifera Shu.

The yobcrab was an aquatic creature with a hard outer shell. Yobcrab legs could be eaten as food, though the shell had to be removed beforehand. Finn attempted to eat a yobcrab leg at the fiftieth birthday of Nifera Shu.

Lessu command was the command organization of the Ryloth government, based in the Lessu, the capital city of Ryloth. When arriving in the Ryloth system, the Millennium Falcon was confronted by two Can-Cell class fighters of Lessu command.

The First Order Academy was a First Order institution located in the Unknown Regions. By 34 ABY, Dopheld Mitaka earned a prestigious placement aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Finalizer after graduating at the top of his academy class.

Nacon was a celestial body located in the Nacon system of the Deep Core and the Interior. It was situated in grid square L-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid and was connected to the Coruscant and Empress Teta systems by the hyperspace route known as the Koros Trunk Line.

The human pilot Norra Wexley stole a shuttle, a leisure shuttle, which she used to fly out of Myrra, the capital of Akiva.
Former Imperial officer Teza Nasz had an old Imperial model shuttle craft that had carried her from Ryloth to Rattatak. She used it on the mission to Corellia.
This feline species lived on Ephemera. Their excrement was discovered by a philosopher who saw that it had healing properties.

Incinerator stormtroopers, also referred to as incinerator troopers, incinerator soldiers, or Burners, were a stormtrooper variant within the Galactic Empire.
An emergency election was held in response to the Hosnian Cataclysm on Akiva, which saw a known First Order sympathizer emerge victorious.

This fuel refinery on the planet Drahgor III was run by a flock of Gozzo related to the Colossus resident Flix. It was the only fuelling station in the area, which mean the Colossus was forced to go there for fuel when it ran low during its flight from the First Order.
The Hand of Am-Shak was a Corona-class armed frigate owned by the pirate captain Gwarm and his gang. It was named after Am-Shak, a Weequay deity and the god of thunder.
The Mythrol were a sentient humanoid species with amphibious traits.

Teres Lutha Minor was a high-gravity astronomical object located in the Teres Lutha Minor system within the Farrfin sector of the Core Worlds and the Interior. It was situated in grid square K-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of the humanoid Caysin Bog.
Chanceuxi was a celestial body located in the Chanceuxi system within the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories.

Troglofa was an Outer Rim Territories astronomical object located in the Belderone sector's Troglofa system. It was situated in grid square R-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Troglofa was the homeworld of Thamm, a Troglof croupier at the Canto Casino on the planet Cantonica.

The Troglof were a rare sentient species with tentacle-like arms native to Troglofa. A diminutive species, the Troglof had a pleasant natural odor. Troglofs could also move their eyestalks independently.

Majoros was located in the Inner Rim Territories' Majoros system, situated in grid square O-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of the human Anj Zavor, who served as a colonel in the Rebel Alliance's Fleet Command.

Gabdor was a wet terrestrial world located in the Gabdor system of the Expansion Region. It was situated in grid square H-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Gabdor was the homeworld of Quiggold, the Gabdorin first mate of the pirate captain Sidon Ithano's crew.

habitat: Underwater inside the Living Waters lake
x: Mythosaurs were creatures of gigantic proportions found on the Outer Rim world of Mandalore. The Mines of Mandalore were a mythosaur lair.
Ravinaks were large reptiles that inhabited the frigid planet Pagodon, swimming underneath the ice.

The Nevarro Mandalorian covert was a Mandalorian covert hidden in the sewers of Nevarro by the time of the New Republic. The covert was operated by the Tribe. It was a place where Mandalorians could remain in secret, and preserve their creed and way of life.

The Tribe was a Mandalorian clan active during the years following the fall of the Galactic Empire. The bounty hunter Din Djarin, known often as "the Mandalorian" or simply "Mando," was a member of the organization, as was a female Mandalorian Armorer and Paz Vizsla.
Maldo Kreis was a terrestrial ice planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. The Mandalorian bounty hunter Djarin crash-landed on Maldo Kreis after being pursued by two New Republic pilots.

Chorin was a rocky mining planet located in the Inner Rim Territories' Chorin system. Its human population, including the Valance family, was enslaved as miners for generations before being liberated by an Imperial force led by Captain Tarl Sokoli, with the Empire also maintai…
Lowik was a jungle planet located in the galaxy. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance operated a secret outpost on Lowik.
The Processional Way was a large boulevard leading to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
The Tammuz-an were a species of humanoids from the planet of the same name that had taller frames and longer legs than average. They were ruled by a monarch.

The Nikto hideout was an encampment located on the desert world Arvala-7 that was controlled by a gang of Nikto mercenaries in 9 ABY, guarding an infant named Grogu. At that time, the bounty hunters IG-11 and Din Djarin raided the encampment during their search for Grogu.
A gang of Nikto mercenaries was active on Arvala-7 in 9 ABY, and had in their captivity a child that was the same species as former Jedi Grand Master Yoda.
The Sundari Police Authority was a law enforcement division of the Mandalorian Guard, which served the New Mandalorian government.

Kuiil's moisture farm, also known as Kuiil's ranch or Kuiil's vapor ranch, was a moisture farm on Arvala-7, operated by the Ugnaught Kuiil, who worked as a moisture farmer in an attempt to find peace in a reclusive world.

x: During the Great Jedi Purge, the Mantis crew undertook a mission to the water moon Nur to retrieve a Jedi holocron from Fortress Inquisitorius, the stronghold of the Inquisitorius of the Galactic Empire.
Nur was a water-rich ocean moon in the Mustafar system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was covered in sodium-rich water and had no natural land masses charted.

The Zeffonians, or Zeffo for short, were an ancient sentient species native to the planet Zeffo. Many Zeffonians could wield the Force, which they referred to as the "Life Wind," and those who did became known as sages.

Lateron was a small planet located in the Mid Rim that was home to the Latero species. The planet fell under the control of the Galactic Empire, who viewed it as expendable, making life difficult for its inhabitants.

Project Auger was a mining operation by the Galactic Empire carried out under the will of Emperor Palpatine. The project involved the occupation of the planet Zeffo, and Imperial operations to excavate the many ancient artifacts on the planet.
Mudhorns were large horned creatures that inhabited Arvala-7. The eggs of mudhorns were considered a delicacy by Jawas.
A Jawa tribe led by Chettkap was active on Arvala-7 in 9 ABY. The Jawa tribe dismantled and stole pieces from the Razor Crest, a gunship used by a bounty hunter known as the Mandalorian.
A gang of three Trandoshan bounty hunters in matching uniforms were in operation shortly after the fall of the Galactic Empire.
Boglings were small furry creatures native to the planet Bogano. They dug a number of tunnels and nests throughout the rocky plains and marshes of Bogano, working in large packs.
Bog rats were carnivorous creatures found on the planet Bogano. They were quadrapeds with hardened skin and one large eye, but poor eyesight, making them easy prey for the oggdo.

A splox was a type of large, non-sentient insect native to the Outer Rim planet Bogano. Usually found in groups, splox were known to launch coordinated attacks against their prey. The insects were omnivorous, and they inhabited Bogano's wetlands and mesas.

Oggdos were a carnivorous species native to the planet Bogano. Oggdos were alpha predators and used their adhesive tongues to attack their prey. They had thick, lightsaber-resistant hide, making them dangerous at close range. A subspecies of the creature was the Oggdo Bogdo.

Jotaz were a species of large and aggressive but slow predators found on the planet Zeffo. With a thick hide and strong forearms, the Jotaz used brute strength to overwhelm their enemies but had vulnerabilities such as the abdomen region where the skin was thinnest.

Lesser Nydaks, also known as Nydaks, were predatory creatures from the Outer Rim Territories planet Dathomir. Carnivorous and highly aggressive, Nydaks could traverse the terrain of Dathomir using their powerful arms.
Mykal were flying predators native to the planet Kashyyyk.
The shyyyo bird was a rare species of massive blue-blooded bird native to the planet Kashyyyk. By 14 BBY, shyyyo were extremely rare and became an endangered species.

The Haxion Brood was a crime syndicate that operated throughout the Outer Rim, led by the crime boss Sorc Tormo. The syndicate's headquarters was Ordo Eris, an asteroid stronghold that served as the center of the Haxion Brood's power structure.

The mudhorn cave was located on the desert planet Arvala-7. In 9 ABY, the bounty hunter Din Djarin stole a mudhorn egg from a mudhorn living in the cave, managing to defeat the creature with the help of the Force-sensitive child Grogu.
The Oggdo Bogdo was a rare subspecies of the Oggdo, a dangerous apex predator native to the Outer Rim planet Bogano.
Rabid Jotaz was a diseased jotaz that resided amongst the wreckage of a Venator-class Star Destroyer on Zeffo.
Daschorb was a Haxion Brood Bounty Droid affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate.

Bad Protocol was a Haxion Brood Bounty Droid that served the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. Once a loadlifter droid, the Haxion Brood reprogrammed the droid, who was enhanced with salvaged parts.
Mich Murda was a bounty hunter droid affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate.
Chonk was a bounty droid who worked as an enforcer for the Haxion Brood criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era. Chonk was destroyed in 14 BBY, after engaging Cal Kestis in battle.

Clunk was a Haxion Brood Bounty Droid that served the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. Once a loadlifter droid, the Haxion Brood reprogrammed the droid, who was enhanced with salvaged parts.

J-DH3 was a Haxion Brood Bounty Droid who served the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. Once a loadlifter droid, the Haxion Brood reprogrammed the droid and enhanced J-DH3 with salvaged parts.

Kompaktor was a Haxion Brood Bounty Droid who served the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. Once a loadlifter droid, the Haxion Brood reprogrammed the droid, who was enhanced with salvaged parts.

The Maestro was a Haxion Brood Bounty Droid that served the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. Once a loadlifter droid, the Haxion Brood reprogrammed the droid, who was enhanced with salvaged parts.
Murdie was a bounty droid who served the Haxion Brood criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era.
Reviktor was a bounty droid who worked for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate as an enforcer during the Imperial Era.
Slaejax was a bounty droid who served the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. Slaejax was killed when hunting the Jedi survivor Cal Kestis.

Ashas Ree was a forested planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. Its sole inhabited outpost was situated next to a Jedi temple that had been built to seal the power of a Sith temple beneath it.

Vargos 9, also known as Vargos Nine, was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Vargos system of the Mortex sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square R-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Ashas Ree outpost was the only populated location on the planet Ashas Ree. It was situated next to a Jedi temple of the Force.

The Stinger Mantis crew, also abbreviated as the Mantis crew, operated aboard the Stinger Mantis during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The crew was initially formed by the former Jedi Cere Junda, who wished to restore the Jedi Order some time after Order 66.

origin: Throughout planets in the Outer Rim Territories
x: Parvinoths were non-sentient insects found on planets throughout Outer Rim Territories, including the forested planet Ashas Ree.

Ba-Gonk was a droid that served the Haxion Brood crime syndicate as a bounty hunter during the reign of the Galactic Empire. It had white and dark blue plating and orange and cyan sensors. In combat, Ba-Gonk used a wrist blaster mounted on its right arm.
Ottethan was an astronomical object located in the Ottethan system within the Halthor sector of the Outer Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square M-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

CeSai was a planet located in the Illisurevimurasi sector's CeSai system. It specifically lay in the Standard Galactic Grid space Q-4 of the Outer Rim Territories, which was also a part of the New Territories.

Merokia was a desert planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories near the Unknown Regions, in grid square J-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was inhabited during the era of the New Republic. Merokia was the homeworld of the Force-sensitive human Karr Nuq Sin.
A kleex was a creature that possessed a shell. Kleex were known to retreat into their shells.
Ovissians were a sentient species with a bipedal figure and two pairs of horns. A population of Ovissians inhabited the planet Krystar by the time of the Clone Wars.
Taeltor Province was a location on the planet Merokia. A trade school was located in Taeltor Province.

The Unnamed was a starship used by the Rebel Alliance's intelligence branch during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, Captain Magna Tolvan commanded the Unnamed, and her unit Strike Team Misericorde served aboard the vessel.
Elphrona was a rocky planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to an ancient High Republic Era Jedi outpost used as a treasure trove for a number of artifacts.

The Luminous was a GR-75 medium transport that served in the Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. It participated in the Battle of Endor, where it was confronted by a group of TIE/IN interceptors.

Karnac was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Karnac system of the Cadma sector, a part of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice in grid square T-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Its surface featured ocean dunes.

Nevarro was a volcanic planet located in the Dalicron sector of the Outer Rim Territories connected to the Hydian Way. It was covered with vast regions of lava fields as well as volcanic rivers, and had a capital city which became a port and a trading hub in the Outer Rim.
The Twi'lek healing baths were baths associated with members of the Twi'lek species that customers visited for healing and relaxation.
The incident on Nevarro was a skirmish that began after the mission to Arvala-7 in 9 ABY. The bounty hunter Din Djarin completed his bounty by giving Grogu to "the Client" of an Imperial remnant.
Felucian snails were snails native to Felucia. They were kept as pets.

The Nevarro school, formerly the Nevarro Common House and briefly the Client's office, was located in Nevarro City on the planet Nevarro. Originally a cantina, it was built from Greef Karga's cut of Gorian Shard's treasure. The cantina was used by the Bounty Hunters' Guild.

A Geonosian Brood Alpha was the alpha of the Geonosian broods. They earned the position in the hierarchy of their hive after proving his powers as a champion the arena. They wielded a glaive and a big golden shield into battle.
Nightsister Spirits were the undead spirits of members of the Nightsisters.
Nightsister Zombies, also known as Undead Nightsisters, were the Dathomirian zombies of the Nightsisters. When the Chant of Resurrection was recited, they emerged from burial pods.

Heavy Infantry Mandalorians were Mandalorian warriors equipped with heavy beskar armor known as Heavy Infantry Mandalorian Armor and blaster cannons. Paz Vizsla was a Heavy Infantry Mandalorian who served with the Tribe in 9 ABY. He wielded a M-55 Medium Repeating Blaster.

Torch was the astromech droid companion of rebel pilot and later Resistance pilot Venisa Doza. He accompanied her on many missions, including to the worlds Bakura and Lehon.
Venisa Doza's X-wing was a modified X-wing starfighter owned by Resistance pilot Venisa Doza. She flew the starfighter during the First Order-Resistance War, accompanied by her astromech droid Torch.
Scrap rats, also spelled as scrap-rats, or known as junkyard rats, were a small species of scavenging rats native to the planet Bracca. They could also be found on Ord Mantell.

The Shattered Lake was a location on the planet Ilum. Covered in snow and rocky mesas, the Lake was located near the planet's Jedi Temple, where generations of Jedi younglings took part in the Gathering ritual, during which the younglings discovered their kyber crystals.

Para fish were a type of silver-scaled fish with black eyes. They were found inhabiting large water bodies on the planet Bogano. Primarily feeding on small fragments of algae and other plants, many of the fish would die off if algae supplies became scarce.

x: The mission to Pasaana, also known as the raid at the Festival of the Ancestors, was a mission undertaken by the Resistance during their war with the First Order.
Sandtrooper Scouts were sandtroopers who acted as scouts.

The Sunder was an Onager-class Star Destroyer that belonged to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At one point, it sustained damage to its hull when exchanging fire with an enemy MC80 Star Cruiser in an asteroid field.
The Nydak Alpha was a rare subtype of the Lesser Nydak, apex predators native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Dathomir.

Binogs were a species of amphi-mammalians native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Bogano. During the Republic Era, Jedi Master Eno Cordova traveled to the planet and observed artistic depictions of a binog created by the ancient Zeffonian species.

Zeffo Sages, also known as the Three Sages, the Life Wind Sages, and the Zeffonian Sages, were Force-sensitive Zeffonians who wielded the Force, which they referred to as the "Life Wind." By the Imperial Era, the Sages were extinct along with their species.

result: The Clone Wars return to Saleucami
x: Launched at some point between 21 BBY and 19 BBY during the Clone Wars, the massive invasion of Saleucami was undertaken by the Confederacy of Independent Systems on the Outer Rim planet Saleucami.
The Voxx Cluster was an asteroid field located in the Outer Rim Territories' Ash Worlds. It was located in a purple-colored nebulous region and was the site of Vranki's Hotel and Casino.
The Shipbreaking Yard was an area of rocky plains on the planet Bracca where the Scrapper Guild brought starship wreckage to be broken down.
Zaur were a species of lizard native to the planet Bogano. They had a low stance and an adhesive grip, allowing them to travel quickly across many types of surface, including cavern walls.

The Fractured Plain was an area of plains on the planet Bogano, broken up by chasms and cliffsides. When visiting Bogano as part of their quest to rebuild the Jedi Order, Cere Junda and Cal Kestis landed on the Fractured Plain in the Stinger Mantis.

The Great Divide was a chasm located within the plains of the planet Bogano, near the Bogano Vault. A hastily build Zeffonian burial site was located in a cave near the Divide with another Zeffonian skeleton laying in the grass outside the room.

The Binog Mesa was a grassy mesa on the Outer Rim Territories planet Bogano that shared its name with the amphi-mammalian binog species. The mesa was visited by Jedi Master Eno Cordova and by fugitive Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis years after.

The Bogdo Sinkholes was a region of the Outer Rim Territories planet Bogano, which consisted of a cluster of sinkholes. The Oggdo Bogdo, a rare subspecies of the oggdo creature with which the region shared its name, inhabited the Bogdo Sinkholes.
The Subterranean Refuge was an area of caves on the planet Bogano, located beneath the Binog Mesa. Bog rats could be found inside the Subterranean Refuge.

Todola was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Todola system in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Todola, along with its system was occupied by the Galactic Empire during its reign, and hosted a secret Imperial walker production outpost.

The Abandoned Village was a village located on the cold planet Zeffo. The settlement was near the Derelict Hangar, the Turbine Facility, and the Weathered Monument. It was founded by Galactic Republic archaeologists and pioneers.

The Gusty Bluffs were an area of cliffside on the Outer Rim Territories planet Zeffo, known to be inhabited by phillaks. The high winds in the area led to the Turbine Facility to be constructed nearby. The area was in between the Turbine Facility and the Weathered Monument.
The Auger Pulverizers was an area of mountainside on the planet Zeffo, used by the Galactic Empire as a site to mine the planet's rock using MK-270 Imperial Pulverizers as a part of Project Auger.
The Ice Caves was a cave system located beneath the surface of the planet Zeffo. The caves were inhabited by jotaz, phillaks, and scazz.
The Crash Site was an area on the planet Zeffo formed when a Venator-class Star Destroyer crashed onto Zeffo's surface after suffering heavy damage in a battle against a Separatist dreadnought.

Sorgan was a breathable, forested swamp planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. With a small native population, it was the only inhabitable object in its system. In 9 ABY, it was home to a Klatooinian tribe, which frequently raided a small krill farming village.

A grinjer was a creature that could be found on Sorgan. The grinjer's bones could be turned into bone broth, a type of soup. In 9 ABY, the Mandalorian human Din Djarin ordered the broth from a tavern on the planet for Grogu he protected.
A skirmish occurred on the planet of Sorgan in 9 ABY, after a village hired Din Djarin and Carasynthia Dune to protect them from Klatooinian raiders that had been attacking and raiding the village.

The Klatooinian raiders operated on the planet Sorgan in 9 ABY. Comprised of Klatooinian raiders and the AT-ST Raider, the tribe launched attacks on a remote village, killing villagers and robbing them.

A human tribe lived on the planet Sorgan by 9 ABY. A peaceful tribe of krill farmers, it consisted of men, women, and children living in a village of primitive structures, with limited amounts of droid technology and only a small amount of weapons for protection.

Ottega was a celestial body located in the Ottega system, which featured the Ithorian sun and was situated in the Ottega sector in the Mid Rim Territories and the New Territories as part of grid square M-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Dodonna's Pride was a CR90 corvette that served as part of the Rebel Alliance fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Jaina's Light was a CR90 corvette in service to the Rebel Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Albedo Brave was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in the navy of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
TC-G3 was a droid owned by the Hutt Vranki the Blue, who worked at his space station Vranki's Hotel and Casino as a greeter and race announcer.
Palmatian II was a world on which gambling could be done safely. It was located in the Palmatian system in the Baronos sector of the Colonies.

Venerable Stirta was a terrestrial astronomical object within the Venerable Stirta system in the Ghost Nebula sector of the Expansion Region. within the reaches of the galaxy. According to DK-RA-43, its desert landscapes were far more scenic than those of Tatooine.

Affa was a terrestrial planet that housed great droid factories. Located in the Affa system in the Inner Rim Territories, it was situated in grid square M-13 and was located along the Shipwrights' Trace hyperspace route.
Sardines were a type of fish that could be cooked and eaten in dishes such as dried Naboo sardines and Naboo sardine fritters.

The Dark Quarter was at Yuw, a location in the Mid Rim's Herdessa sector. In 1 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Vader learned of a plot to assassinate him, and subsequently traveled to the Dark Quarter, where he interrogated and killed several bounty hunters in order to gain informati…

The Arkanian Dawn was a freighter owned by the enslaver Krastic Tarta during the Imperial Era. By 10 BBY, Tarta had the vessel respond to a distress call from a privateer's starship that had crashed landed on an unnamed planet.

t: Madam Synata's Genius of A Thousand Faces Museum
x: Madam Synata's Genius of A Thousand Faces Museum was the private museum of Madam Risha Synata on board her ship.

The Meridional Ice Cap was a cold region of the planet Tython. The Martyrium of Frozen Tears was located within the Meridional Ice Cap. After learning the location of the Rebel Alliance base on Hoth, Doctor Chelli Aphra instead led Darth Vader to the Meridional Ice Cap on Tython.

The Albino Wyyyschokk was a rare subspecies of Wyyyschokk native to the planet Kashyyyk. Faster and more aggressive than normal Wyyyschokks, these massive spiders were found in dark, subterranean areas where they could live for centuries.

x: During the First Order-Resistance War, the Colossus refueling station fought a skirmish against forces of the Guavian Death Gang in an asteroid field at the edge of Guavian-controlled space.
This asteroid field was located in the galaxy on the edge of Guavian Death Space, a region controlled by the Guavian Death Gang.

Cargo vessel TR-141 was the designation of an Intersystem Transport Ship used by the Resistance during their war against the First Order. It participated in the mission to Batuu, where it was helmed by Nien Nunb and under the command of Lieutenant Bek.
J1-KC was a red and white R5 series astromech droid that belonged to the the Lurmen Jat Kaa, owner of Jat Kaa's Coolers in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.
J2-KC was a red and white R5 series astromech droid that belonged to the Lurmen Jat Kaa, owner of Jat Kaa's Coolers in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.

J4-KC was an R2-series astromech droid owned by Jat Kaa's Coolers on Batuu. The droid drove a ground vehicle that carried Sprite beverages that were sold in Black Spire Outpost. The droid's green-and-white color scheme matched that of the vehicle, themed to the Sprite logo.

J5-KC was an R2-series astromech droid owned by Jat Kaa's Coolers on Batuu. The droid drove a ground vehicle that carried Diet Coke beverages that were sold in Black Spire Outpost. The droid's red-and-white color scheme matched that of the vehicle, themed to the Diet Coke logo.

J3-KC was an R5 series astromech droid owned by Jat Kaa's Coolers on Batuu. The droid drove a ground vehicle that carried Coca-Cola beverages that were sold in Black Spire Outpost. The droid's red-and-white color scheme matched that of the vehicle, themed to the Coca-Cola logo.
Pacara was a terrestrial planet located in the Pacara system in the galaxy's Mid Rim, in grid square J-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Swellbottom market was a merchants' area on the planet Balmorra. During the Imperial Era, the pirate Hondo Ohnaka found a store there that sold animals in exchange for credits.

The Cyklo market was a slave market on the planet Chalcedon. During the Imperial Era, the criminal Black Sun slavemonger traded the Smuggler's Guide to the Varcinius Auction and Artifact Collective there.
The Cellar of Penitence was an area affiliated with the Church of Infinite Perception on the planet Florrum, where the pirate Hondo Ohnaka hired the forger Bar the Rotter.

The Analysis Rooms were the analysis spaces of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, falling under the overall jurisdiction of the Jedi Archives and their Chief Librarian. They were used to locate the provenance of exotic objects, among many other tasks.
This Courtyard Antenna was located in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu in the Service Yard between Droid Depot and Docking Bay 9. It served as a central communications relay station.
Ozri II was a swamp astronomical object. The Rebel Alliance spy Thassilio Smeuse infiltrated the Galactic Empire on Ozri II, and was extracted by Captain Magna Tolvan and Strike Team Misericorde.
Slitherwolves were a type of wolf. They were known to be preyed on by rancors, who let the slitherwolves feast on their own prey before catching them when they were gorged and asleep.
Docking Bay 13 was a docking bay located on Nar Shaddaa. Beilert Valance and Vharn were attacked by a Imperial TIE fighter in the docking bay.

Treasure Ship Row was a gaudy, wealthy open-air bazaar located in Coronet City, the planetary capital of Corellia. One of many Coronet neighborhoods rich in history, it originated in ancient times, when sea captains still settled disputes with swords and whips.
Port Town was a seedy district of Cloud City. It was located on Level 130.
Moenia was a city on Naboo whose level of activity was comparable to that of Theed, the planet's capital. Emperor Palpatine had a retreat located west of Moenia.
The Black Fleeks were a criminal gang active on Corellia. Like the White Worms and the SuperNovas, they had their headquarters in the sewers and tunnels beneath Coronet City.

The Ikadrian flitter-whipit was a creature known for its short attention span. According to the RA-7 protocol droid DK-RA-43 in the book the Galactic Explorer's Guide, his master, Hondo Ohnaka, had an attention span shorter than some Ikadrian flitter-whipits.

DK-RA-43 was an RA-7 protocol droid. Originally built for the Galactic Empire in the droid factories of Affa, he ended up with a new master, the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka, under unclear circumstances—the droid was either won in a sabacc game or exchanged for a purebreed Loth…
Q9-0, also known as Zero or Z, was a modified RA-9O protocol droid who worked as a mercenary during the time of the New Republic.

The arges frog, also known as Sorgan frogs were a species of one-eyed frogs named for the forest planet Sorgan, though they could be found on a number of other worlds.
This species of bird could be seen in large flocks circling in the skies of the planet Zeffo. The species had a brown body, grey wings, and a cream-colored head with a long bill.

The Corkscrew was a location inside the turbulent Outer Rim Territories region known as the Akkadese Maelstrom. It connected two parts of the Channel hyperspace route and contained carbonbergs as well as the area known as the Thunderhead.
The Committee for Historic Preservation was an organization that verified the authenticity of Hunters of the Outer Rim arena sets.

Security Operations was a centralized coordination unit of the First Order that was active during the war against the Resistance.

The First Order electroprod stormtrooper, also kown as the prisoner control stormtrooper, electroprod stormtrooper or electroprod trooper, was a variant of the First Order stormtrooper that was active during the war against the Resistance.
The Caphex were a humanoid sentient species with wispy hair that grew from the sides of their faces.

x: In 14 BBY, during the Galactic Empire's Great Jedi Purge, Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis took a mission to the planet Ilum in order to build a new lightsaber after breaking his lightsaber.
The Cytocaves of Nora were a location where sentient beings were engineered. They were located in the Mid Rim Territories' Nora system.
Geegee was a droid who served at the temple of the rebuilt Jedi Order, led by Jedi Master Luke Skywalker. Geegee operated aboard the Grimtaash, the vessel of Skywalker's nephew Ben Solo.
The Verity was a starship of an unidentified class used by the Jedi Order under Jedi Master Luke Skywalker.
The Grimtaash was a starship owned by Ben Solo, a Jedi trainee in Luke Skywalker's rebuilt Jedi Order. The starship shared its name with Grimtaash, a figure from Alderaanian myth.

Sector Security, also known as SecSec, was a law enforcement agency that operated during the time of the New Republic. The agency sought to capture the brothers Karrst and Filin, who were responsible for at least one hundred deaths.
Lava fields, also known as lava flats or lava plains, were large fields of lava that were located on Nevarro.
Sorgal 12 was an Outer Rim mining planet located in the Mieru'kar sector. The engineer Vharn and his family hailed from Sorgal 12, with the family becoming enslaved by the occupying Galactic Empire.
Killcrabs were a type of crab. An ingredient imitating their meat was used by the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs as a filling for fungus caps in the dish known as Constable's Caps.

Nevarro reptavians were a species of winged, predatory reptavians native to the planet Nevarro. Venomous creatures, they hunted at night; at one point, several of them ambushed a group of bounty hunters and mercenaries seated around a campfire, taking one of their hunters, two…

The Kuiil Clan was an clan that was active during the Imperial Era. After paying his debt, the Ugnaught Kuiil left the clan to live a life of solitude as a moisture farmer on the desert world of Arvala-7.

x: The Clash on Nevarro took place on the planet Nevarro in 9 ABY involving an Imperial remnant and the allies of Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin. Beforehand, Djarin stole the Force-sensitive infant Grogu from the remnant after being hired to deliver the child to them.
Exegol (also spelled Ixigul in ancient texts) was a dark desert planet located within the Unknown Regions that, according to legend, was the hidden redoubt world of the Sith.

The Night Buzzard was a modified Oubliette-class transport used by the Knights of Ren. The Knights made several alterations to the Night Buzzard to better suit their tastes, such as altering the vessel's appearance to match their dark side aesthetic.

The destruction of Kijimi took place in 35 ABY, after the escape of the Resistance operatives off of Kijimi when Darth Sidious ordered Allegiant General Enric Pryde and the Sith Eternal to destroy the planet.

Osseriton was a penal world located not far into the Unknown Regions in the Osseriton system within grid square G-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Jaguada was a desert planet and one of the noteworthy worlds of the ancient Sith. According to legend, the Sith Lord Darth Noctyss carried out research on the planet that eventually led her to the lost Sith world of Exegol in her quest to attain immortality.

Rhelg was a noteworthy world affiliated with the Sith. In the time of the Galactic Republic, Rhelg was quarantined along with other planets like Malachor, Ziost, and Jaguada, and its history and Sith affiliation was hidden.
The Resistance base, also known as the Resistance camp, was a base established by the Resistance on the jungle moon Ajan Kloss after their former base on D'Qar was eliminated by the First Order.

x: In 35 ABY, the Jedi apprentice Rey and her companions, Chewbacca, Poe Dameron and Finn, undertook a mission to the Kef Bir moon in the Endor system.
Korkar, designated IX3244-B, was one of the moons of the gas giant Endor. Korkar was an extremely reflective icy moon. Its surface concealed a liquid sea.
Hual Maka, designated IX3244-D, was an irregularly shaped rocky moon of the gas giant Endor. The moon may have been a comet that was captured by Endor's gravity.
Sharls, designated IX3244-E, was a dead moon of the gas giant Endor. Made up of rock and ice, it had an iron-rich core.
Vix, designated IX3244-F, was a bleak moon of the gas giant Endor. Its nitrogen-rich atmosphere caused methane rain to fall onto its surface.
Gouuls, designated IX3244-I, was a moon of the gas giant Endor. It had a broken, patchwork surface, thought to be due to breaking up during its formation.
Alprezar, designated IX3244-H, was a metallic moon of the gas giant Endor. The Galactic Empire extensively mined the moon for the construction of the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station.
Fentakka, designated IX3244-G, was a moon of the gas giant Endor. Its surface reflected less than 10 percent of light, making it the darkest of Endor's moons.
The Bestoon Legacy was a modified WTK-85A interstellar transport and the personal starship of Sith loyalist Ochi of Bestoon.
A Sith cultist, also referred to as a Sith acolyte, Sith loyalist, or Sith occultist, was an adherer of a Sith cult who practiced the beliefs of the Sith and venerated the dark side of the Force.
The Steadfast, a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer of the First Order Navy, was the flagship of Supreme Leader Kylo Ren and Allegiant General Enric Pryde.
The Steadfast was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. Imperial officer Enric Pryde was assigned to the ship in 6 BBY.

The Derriphan was a Xyston-class Star Destroyer of the Final Order that was the first of the new ships to launch from Exegol. It destroyed the planet Kijimi. The name came from the Sith word for "devourer."

The Symeong were a sentient ape-like species who had large, sensitive ears. The Symeong metalsmith Albrekh, who worked aboard the Knights of Ren's starship Night Buzzard, used his ears to determine the heat of metal from the tone it produced when struck.

Jaymir was a frontier world located on the edges of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square I-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of the human siblings Aarton and Nimi Chireen, who became members of the Resistance.
Aris was a rustic terrestrial planet located in the Aris system in the Outer Rim Territories' Albarrio sector, along the Braxant Run hyperspace route.
The First Order Supreme Council, also known as the First Order High Council, was a deliberative body of twelve high-ranking military officials in the First Order.

Didyma V, was a terrestrial world that was located in the Didyma system in the New Territories region and Wild Space, in grid square J-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of the Didynon Engi Golba.

The Incinerator was a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer that was a part of the navy of the First Order at some point by 35 ABY. It was manufactured by Kuat-Entralla Engineering and measured 2,915.84 meters (9,566.29 feet) in length.
The Lacertilo were an amphibious species with compound lungs. Resistance member Bo Rogiave was a Lacertilo, using his biology to his advantage when on missions where oxygen levels were thin.

Fabrin was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Expansion Region's Circarpous sector, within the Fabrin system. It was situated in grid square O-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid in the Slice.

Drophun III was an astronomical object located in the Colonies and the Interior's Drophun system. It was situated in grid square L-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The human Clemitt Polus was born at Drophun III, serving as a local defense pilot before joining the Resistance.

Lerct was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Lerct system in the Prackla sector of the Expansion Region that was home to the Arhul Hextrophon School of Embedded Journalism and the Lerct Historical Institute.
Ajara was a gas giant planet located in the Ajara system within the Cademimu sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, situated in a partially explored region of space off the Celanon Spur.

The Trodatome were a sentient species. While they had no arms, they possessed prehensile sensory antennae and flippers. The Trodatome Klaud worked as a mechanic in the Resistance. At least one Trodatome, Gido, was present on the planet Koboh in 9 BBY.

Gorvin snu were a species of small lizard-like creatures that inhabited the desert planet Arvala-7. Skittish quadrupeds, they could be found on the world in 9 ABY, when the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin encountered them.

Sovereign Protectors were the elite bodyguards of Darth Sidious, the Sith Lord and Galactic Emperor who returned from death. A cadre of crimson-armored sentinels, they were considered the best soldiers in a secret army of Sith troopers trained by the Sith Eternal cult.

Fleet technicians were a type of technician who operated and maintained the Xyston-class Star Destroyers of the Final Order, serving the same role as the First Order fleet gunners. They were fanatically loyal to the Sith Eternal and the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious.

The Sinta Glacier Colony was a settlement located on the Sinta Glacier, a massive chunk of ice orbiting the star Sinta. The Resistance operatives Finn and Poe Dameron underwent a mission to meet Boolio at the colony.

A green and blue skinned creature was native to the planet Irff. According to Jek Tono Porkins, they were known to be delicious.

The vexis was a serpent native to the desert world Pasaana. The species burrowed under the sand of Pasaana, and oils excreted from its skin hardened the sand it passed through to form an ever-expanding network of tunnels.
AL1-L3, nicknamed "Allie," was a protocol droid that served in the administrative center of the Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel.

Gavriza was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Gavriza system of the Prackla sector, a part of the Expansion Region and the New Territories. It was situated in grid square O-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Corvax Fen was a forested and swampy forest region on the planet of Mustafar, inhabited by the cult, Alazmec of Winsit, who attempted to replenish Mustafar's ecosystem, by planting Irontrees.
Kessurians were a sentient species that originated in the Kessur system. They had red skin and elongated ears and montrals, which increased their senses.
Brix was the homeworld of the human smuggler Corus Kapellim. It was located in the Brix system of the galaxy's Colonies and was situated at the coordinates N-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Shungbeek were a sentient species that pupated at some point in their lifetime. They breathed an argon-rich atmosphere, and had to wear an enclosed perspex dome to survive in other conditions.
The Nebular Kelpie was a modified Lancer-class pursuit craft owned by the Shungbeek Kid Malmash.

Cingulons were a sentient species with pebbly skin and flanged faces. A Cingulon senator served in the Imperial Senate during the time of the Galactic Empire. Dellso Prin was a Cingulon mechanic who joined the Resistance as a cargo pilot.

The Alazmec were a sentient species on the planet Mustafar. The Alazmec of Winsit were Sith cultists who honored Darth Vader by protecting the ruins of his castle and a nearby bog, Corvax Fen. Loriach was a Alazmec sniper who was a member in the Assassin's Guild.

x: The Kloss, as named by the Resistance settlers of Ajan Kloss, was the name given to the moon's ancient former inhabitants.

The Klosslands was an area of jungle on the moon Ajan Kloss. During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, a vast cave within the Klosslands was occupied by the Resistance's main operational base.
Zymods were a type of color-changing reptile native to the jungle moon Ajan Kloss. They had poisonous tongues and webbed feet that let them climb almost anything.
The Aing-Tii were a sentient species. Their neural activity resembled the motion and reactions of the plasma within wayfinders, navigational devices used by both ancient Jedi and Sith.
The Hâsk desert was a region of desert on Exegol, an ancient Sith planet in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy.
The Hon Zduul plateau was a plateau on the planet Exegol, an ancient Sith world of barren rock and desert flats located in the Unknown Regions.

The Sadow escarpment was a rocky, gray escarpment on the Unknown Regions planet Exegol, an ancient Sith redoubt covered in barren rock and desert flats. The escarpment was named in honor of the ancient Sith Lord Naga Sadow.
Odynnia Gavo was a terrestrial world located in the Odynnia Gavo system within the Bryx sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square R-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Torost was a terrestrial world located in the Torost system within the Bryx sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square R-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
An alleged third volume of the Aionomica, a collection of sacred Jedi texts, was the subject of a forgery scandal three hundred years prior to the fall of the Jedi Order in 19 BBY.
Qartuums were a goat-like species that inhabited the planet Nevarro.

The Deymasollians were a sentient species native to the Colonies' Deymasoll system. They had two arms with delicate fingers and two legs—both limb pairs being relatively short—and a large mouth and prominent lower jaw.

The Mohsenians were a sentient species with cream skin, graying fur, and large dark eyes. Mohsenians had extremely powerful noses that could smell sickness and injuries. They had dexterous clawed fingers that where originally designed for digging.

L4E-R5 was an orange-and-white R5 series astromech droid who operated with pilot Lega Fossang. L4E-R5 originally served in the Humbarine planetary defense force but moved alongside Fossang to join the Resistance amidst the war.
Sinta Glacier was a massive chunk of ice, billions of years old, which had once been the core of a mega-comet, and was eventually caught in the orbit of the star Sinta.

Sinta IV was an astronomical object that held the fourth orbital position around the star Sinta within the Sinta system. It was located in the Hune sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice, in grid square Q-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Megafauna Chasm was a location within the Typhonic Nebula. While skipping the Millennium Falcon away from First Order pursuers at the Sinta Glacier, Poe Dameron passed through the Megafauna Chasm and was confronted by an Arakurth.

Ivexia was a famous city in the Mid Rim Territories that contained the Mirror-Spires, a number of kilometer-high mirrored buildings. When hyperspace skipping the Millennium Falcon after escaping the Sinta Glacier, Poe Dameron traveled through the Mirror-Spires of Ivexia.

The Mirror-Spires of Ivexia were a series of shining white towers with numerous reflective surfaces. While trying to escape First Order forces in 35 ABY, Resistance pilot Poe Dameron jumped from the Crystal Chaos of Cardovyte to the spires, with several TIE/wi Interceptors in …
Cardovyte was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories that featured the legendary Crystal Chaos, an expanse of crystalline stalagmites.

The Crystal Chaos of Cardovyte was a massive cavern-like structure that contained many crystalline stalagmites. Light from a bright star reached the cavern and reflected from the crystals. It had long gained legendary status and was even included in several holo adventures.

Cyclorrians were an insectoid sentient species famed for their dedicated engineering skills. They were proud of producing advanced starships at the Cyclor Shipyards in the Mid Rim, which were second only to the Corellian shipyards during the High Republic Era.

Caphexdis was a celestial body located in the Caphexdis system of the Homon sector, a part of the Mid Rim Territories and the New Territories. It was situated in grid square M-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid and was the homeworld of the Caphex Resistance spy Seossra Thwisp.

Talpiddians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They had acute eyesight at close range, but had difficulty identifying individuals of other species, particularly humans. Their hair could stand on end as a threat gesture, or when they were nervous.

Reesarians were a sentient species from the Reesaria system. Possessing almost simian features, they had acute senses and sharp eyesight that allowed them to see in infrared and ultraviolet. When a pair of Reesarians bonded, they became highly attuned to each other's whereabouts.

The Shahkirin were a sentient species from the Inner Rim Territories' Shahkir system. One Shahkirin was a member of the Rebel Alliance in 2 BBY, being present at the Alliance base on the moon Yavin 4 that year.

OC-JK14, also known as Seejay, was an astromech droid who served the Resistance during its war against the First Order. It served at the Resistance base on the moon Ajan Kloss, where it could often be found underfoot while roaming the undergrowth looking to be productive.

AD-4M, nicknamed Aydee and the concierge, was a white, humanoid administrative droid that managed logistics for the Resistance at their outpost on the moon Ajan Kloss during their war against the First Order.

The Boosodians were a sentient species with gray skin and twenty eyes that lived in the galaxy. Amuncie Tidian was a Boosodian who worked as a forger. In 9 BBY, a Boosodian vendor on Daiyu sold clothes to Obi-Wan Kenobi and Leia Organa whilst they were escaping the planet.

The Didynons were a sentient species in the galaxy. They had eyes that could retract into the calloused dermal plates on its head. Engi Golba was a Didynon from Didyma V who escaped his world's annexation by the First Order to join the Resistance.
The Ozrelanso were a sentient species found in the galaxy. Male members of the species had lekku that grew on the sides of their skulls.
The oki-poki were a species of cliff-dwelling rodents native to the desert planet of Pasaana. They fed on thistlebuzzers, gorpions, and other insects.
The Ikledu Wastes was an area of the desert planet Pasaana.
The Jamtareen Mountains were a range of mountains located on the desert planet Pasaana. The mountains shared its name with the Jamtareen tribe.
Aki-Ktura was an Aki-Aki farming community on the desert planet Pasaana. It had a population of 3,000.
The Forbidden Valley was a rocky valley located on the desert planet Pasaana not far from the Lurch Canyon. The Aki-Aki Festival of the Ancestors took place in the valley.

Taloraan was a gas giant that contained a life zone. Located in the Taloraan system in the Expansion Region and the Interior in grid square I-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid, it was home to the Wind Raiders.
The Wind Raiders were a group that existed on Taloraan. They wore helmets, one of which was gifted by Komat to Lando Calrissian, who wore the helmet while living as a hermit on Pasaana.

Lurch Canyon was a canyon on the planet Pasaana not far from the Forbidden Valley. The canyon was home to the community of Aki-Aki and various species of native fauna, including the vexis and gouge-beetles.

The Shifting Mires was a dangerous region of Pasaana's Lurch Canyon. The area contained fields of unstable ground consisting of a black sand which would swallow nearly everything that got stuck in it.
The Battle of Ansett Island was a mission undertaken by Company 77 of the First Order lead by Captain Shikra on Ansett Island on the planet Epo sometime before the mission to Kef Bir.

Ansett Island was an island located on the planet Epo within the Outer Rim Territories. At some point between approximately 10 ABY and 33 ABY, the First Order was involved in the Battle of Ansett Island there.
The kybuck was a creature that had spiral horns and brown fur. Kybucks were native to the planet Kashyyyk, and also inhabited the planet Shili, where they resided in its forests.
The Ghal Kadarthu Gorge was a location on the frozen planet Kijimi.
The Galinkandoker river valley was a valley located on the planet Kijimi.
The Ghollidaru massif was an area of mountains located on the planet Kijimi.

The Lha-Mi glacier was a glacier located on the Mid Rim Territories planet of Kijimi. The Spice Runners of Kijimi had a secret cache in the glacier. Ice was chiseled from the glacier to make a frozen dessert bar, sold in Kijimi City.
Monk's Gate was a location within Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi. It was situated on the northernmost wall of the Thieves' Quarter.
The Amphitheater of the Sith Eternal was the throne room of the reborn Galactic Emperor and leader of the Sith Eternal cult, Darth Sidious, and located within the Sith Citadel of Exegol.
The Intracluster Gatherers were a guild that operated during the war between the First Order and the Resistance, formed from a splinter of the Wandering Star criminal syndicate.
The Ginmids were a sentient species. They were bipedal with two five-fingered hands, light green skin, and a flattened nose with prominent nostrils.
The Angkuadi islands were a group of grassland islands located on the moon Kef Bir.
The Kef Sur Ocean, also known as just the Kef Sur, was a vast and furious ocean located on Kef Bir, an ocean moon of the gas giant Endor.
The Shoduah continent was a continent located on the ocean moon Kef Bir.

The Cliffs of Dead Empire, as named by Company 77, was a cliffside on the coastline of Kef Bir's principal ocean. Debris from the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station's destruction at the Battle of Endor landed in the ocean, and was visible from the cliffs.
The Fortitude, nicknamed "lucky lander" by some troops, was a YC-123B transport hauler in the service of the Resistance during their war against the First Order.

BFB-7 was a droid nicknamed "Boost-Bot," who was active during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. The droid had a servomotor-equipped riser at its top, and a simplified logic center on its front.

TQ3-R1 was a droid with silver and yellow plating and a gray sensor. It had two legs, a cylindrical body, and a dome-shaped head. In 35 ABY, the droid was on the planet Kijimi in the Thieves' Quarter workshop of the droidsmith Babu Frik, a member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi.

Varkana was a rocky desert planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It included the port village Vargo Spaceport, where the human Losha Tarkon operated a cantina. The cantina was visited by the Nautolan bounty hunter Nakano Lash and her crew around 10 BBY.
The Dalkor Dagger was a starship owned by the bounty hunter Ax Tagrin.

2BR-NTB, known as 2B, was a BB-series astromech droid who served the Resistance and worked alongside the spy Norath Kev. The droid had a distinct green and red paint scheme and sensors attuned to impending danger.
The Vargo Spaceport was a spaceport town on the desert planet Varkana. It contained a cantina, which the crew of the Nautolan bounty hunter Nakano Lash visited during the Imperial Era.
A giant crab-like creature was known to inhabit the Kankalo Belt Containment Zone. It was able to survive in the vacuum of space.

This Venator-class Star Destroyer was the flagship of the Imperial Governor Ahr. He oversaw Imperial campaigns throughout his sector onboard this vessel until he was killed by a creature in the Kankalo Belt Containment Zone.

Babu Frik's workshop was a workshop utilized by the Anzellan Babu Frik on Kijimi. It was here that Frik removed C-3PO's programming block during the mission to Kijimi and allowed him to read the location of the Emperor's wayfinder as found on Ochi's dagger.
The Spice Runner's Den, or Kijimi Spice Den, was a den run by the Spice Runners of Kijimi that was located in the Thieves' Quarter on Kijimi.

The farmer Julen Rakab owned a Avent100-series light freighter, which he bought from the spice dealer Trix Sternus while in the Outer Rim planet Batuu's spaceport. It had a hexagonal shape, and was painted with red markings.

Bestoon was a planet located in the Bestoon system in the Colonies region of the galaxy in square J-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid, which also fell in the Interior. It was the homeworld of Ochi, a Bestoonian Sith assassin affiliated with the Sith Eternal cult.

The Alsakan Academy was an Imperial Academy located on the Core Worlds planet Alsakan. Enric Pryde, who would go on to become Allegiant General of the Galactic Empire's successor state, the First Order, attended the Academy at age sixteen in 11 BBY.
Lava meerkats, otherwise known as fire rats, inhabited the lava tubes of Nevarro and the sewers below Nevarro City.

The Namara were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Silvasu Fi, Wini Eres, and Xonr were all notable members of this species.

The Geonosian War Room, also known as the Geonosian Command Center or the Stalgasin war room, was a command center on Geonosis from which Count Dooku, Archduke Poggle the Lesser, and Viceroy Nute Gunray monitored the ongoing First Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY.

Efrem LX was a droid who was active during the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance. In 35 ABY, Efrem LX was present in Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi at the same time as several Resistance operatives undertook a mission on the planet.
An uprising against the First Order occurred on the planet Jakku in 35 ABY, simultaneously with multiple other uprisings across the galaxy.

Rendezvous Point Delta-Three was a Rebel Alliance rendezvous point during the Galactic Civil War. It was located near a star in the Mid Rim. Following the Battle of Hoth, the Alliance Fleet's Fourth Division grouped at the rendezvous point.
The Tyvarex was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that served in the navy of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

The Black Ivory Quintuplets were a group of criminals active during the Imperial Era. The group's members were killed by the bounty hunter IG-88, who chose not to immediately claim the bounty on them.
The audience chamber was a location within the headquarters of the Gillanium Syndicate, where the Underlord met with visitors.
Resolute command was a command unit stationed aboard the bridge of the Venator-class Star Destroyer Resolute.
The scientist Dr Cylo maintained his own army of marines aboard his whale fleet. Several marines were killed when Darth Vader, Dr Aphra, and her squad breached Cylo's flagship.
Ranzar Malk's crew was a gang of mercenaries led by ex-Imperial sharpshooter Migs Mayfeld in order to rescue the Twi'lek Qin from the Bothan-5, a New Republic Correctional Transport, in 9 ABY.
The etobi were a type of non-sentient quadrupedal creature native to the desert planet Pasaana, where they were used as mounts.

The Forest Trench was an area on the planet Kashyyyk between the Imperial Refinery and Cargo Pad 119-Grek. Cal Kestis traversed the trench during his quest to find the Wookiee freedom fighter Tarfful.

A GR-75 medium transport served as a mobile recruitment base for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Nevarro City was the capital city of the planet Nevarro. It contained a bazaar, a cantina, which was later converted to a school, an Imperial facility, and the Twi'lek healing baths. Underneath the city ran a sewer, where the Tribe's covert was located.

The Windwailer was an ancient rock formation on the planet Ahch-To. The violent storms and rainfalls of this world had shaped the rock and given it a very peculiar shape, vaguely reminiscent of the paw of a gigantic animal pointing up to the sky.
Gorpions were insects found on the desert planet Pasaana. They were often eaten by Pasaana's oki-poki.

The Jamtareen tribe was a tribe that existed on the planet Pasaana. It shared its name with the Jamtareen Mountains. Zabmon Roro, a visitor at the Aki-Aki Festival of the Ancestors, wore a cloak with the pattern of the Jamtareen tribe.
Titan-erke, also known as erke, were a species of creature found on the desert planet Pasaana. The creatures had both antlers and a large, singular horn.
Zitontown was a run-down mining town located on the planet Mustafar, precariously perched on a ledge overlooking a river of lava.

Bluebarb wasps were creatures with the ability to sting individuals and cause swelling and poisoning. The venom, possessing a sharp and rancid stench, adversely affected a human's breathing and caused them to cough profusely.
Karabbac was a predatory creature native to the Wild Space planet Kalee, as are members of the Kaleesh species.
Cliffspringers were a type of docile, fleet-footed, grazing mammal native to the ocean moon Kef Bir, where they dwelt on grassy islands.

Shallowbucks were a type of herbivorous grazing mammal native to the grassy islands of the ocean moon Kef Bir. The members of Company 77, a group of human First Order deserters, hunted shallowbucks for meat and hide, harvesting their kills efficiently.

Cloudrippers were a type of high-soaring avian found on the ocean moon Kef Bir. Alongside wanderwings, they were popular prey for Company 77, a group of human First Order deserters who used their custom energy bows without power augmentation to hunt the birds.

A type of high-soaring avian, the wanderwing was a native of the ocean moon Kef Bir. The members of Company 77, a group of human First Order deserters, hunted the birds using their custom made energy bows without power augmentation, with both wanderwings and cloudrippers being…

Striped canths were a type of marine fish found on the ocean moon of Kef Bir. The group of human First Order deserters known as Company 77 fished for striped canths and blubs as a food source using sea skiffs.

The meadow-prowler was a creature. Jannah, the leader of Company 77, a group of First Order stormtrooper defectors, wore a custom tunic made from meadow-prowler hide while living on the ocean moon Kef Bir.

During the First Order-Resistance War, a First Order Resurgent-class Star Destroyer attacked and destroyed an Aeosian village as part of their campaign to deny the Resistance access to former Rebel Alliance bases.

The Vinta Harvest Classic was a podracing event. The smuggler captain of the Windfall attempted to compete in the race, despite being a human. The smuggler was able to fly a podracer, but was not met with much success.
The Necropolis was an area within the sanctum of Lady Corvax on the planet Mustafar. Lady Corvax's army of sentinels, the Marching Horde, were kept dormant within the Necropolis.

Mantellian flutterplumes were carnivorous birds native to the Mid Rim planet Ord Mantell. They had four legs that ended in sharp, curved talons, and their bodies were mostly covered in multi-colored feathers.

The Fosh were a sentient bird-like species that were native to the Mid Rim planet Dallenor. They were among the guards at the Dallenor Excavation and the Krypder Riders, including leader of the riders, Hudso Shaku.

x: The Architects of Vaale were a secret society of artisans that existed long before the time of the Imperial Era, was long forgotten.

A battle between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance took place in the Outer Rim world Mordal's city of Maborn in 4 ABY. The Ballast family became trapped in the area of contention between the warring sides, which were stationed on opposite sides of Maborn.

The suppression of the Aeos system, also known as the bombardment of Aeos, was a bombardment conducted by the First Order on Aeos Prime in the Aeos system that took place following the Blockade of Dantooine, and was led by Commander Pyre and Agent Tierny.
5-L was a MSE-6 series repair droid who served the First Order during its war against the Resistance. When the TIE pilot DT-533 wished to leave the First Order, she reprogrammed 5-L to assist her.
Dendro IV was a planet that appeared green from space. In 34 ABY, the First Order attacked the planet, causing a region of its surface to become devastated and burned.

Retrieve the shield generator schematics from Vharn
x: At some point prior to the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, the smuggler Han Solo hired the bounty hunter Beilert Valance, and tasked him with escorting Vharn, an engineer carrying the schematics for a shield generator, to the Rebellion's rendezvous point aboard Home One.
The Harlok Gang were a criminal gang that operated on Tatooine during the Imperial Era. Consisting of a number of Weequays, the Harlok Gang possessed a small fleet.
The Jundt Massif was an area on the desert planet Tatooine located near the palace of the crime lord Jabba the Hutt.

Nelgenam was a planet in the Tashtor sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was home to the ancient Lost Library of Nelgenam. Centuries prior to the era of the First Order, Nelgenam was a paradise world, hosting many visitors from across the galaxy.

Wreck-weavers were a species of arachnid creature. Their diet consisted of metal, and they were averse to bright light. Wreck-weavers could be found on the planet Nelgenam, where they infested the Lost Library of Nelgenam.
Tierny's office was an office maintained by the First Order Security Bureau Agent Tierny on the First Order's Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Thunderer by the time of the First Order-Resistance War.
During the First Order-Resistance War, the First Order attacked an Aeosian village as part of its campaign to deny the Resistance access to former Rebellion bases in the Outer Rim Territories.

The royal guards of the Inner Rim planet Pijal served the Pijali monarchy.
Saleucami buzzards were creatures native to the planet Saleucami. A group of buzzards feasted on the corpses of 91st Recon Corps. clone troopers when Jedi Master Stass Allie was killed.
Ronion was a New Mandalorian bio-dome city on the planet Mandalore, located within one of the world's desolate desert regions.

The Edict was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire that operated during the Imperial Era. In the closing stages of the Galactic Civil War, it fell under the control of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.
ZED-6-7, also spelled Zed Six Seven or Zed-Six-Seven, was the designation of an SP-4 ISC forensics droid that served the Galactic Empire.

The Trade Federation armaments committee was a committee of the Trade Federation that dealt with the company's private army. The committee was formed at some point before the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY.
Tagata was a farming village on the planet Felucia, which was the site of an engagement between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Purge Trooper Commanders were Purge Trooper officers who commanded squads of other Purge Troopers.
The non-sentient quadrupedal creature had green skin, purple hair and black eyes. One served as a mount for Hudso Shaku on the planet Dallenor.
Vyndal Station was a station within the Chorlian sector in the Outer Rim Territories that shared its name with the world of Vyndal..

Gorm-worms were a type of worm. After Commission for the Preservation of the New Order agent Paramiah Shrove confiscated a spacer's strongbox in the Chorlian sector because it contained the book that would become known as the Smuggler's Guide, Chief Imperial Inspector Hedge De…
The Republic War Office was an organization of the Galactic Republic that was formed early during the Clone Wars.

Cell two-two-one, also called prison cell 2-2-1, was one of the prison cells inside a New Republic Correctional Transport, the Bothan-5. The Twi'lek criminal Qin was imprisoned in the cell after being arrested. In 9 ABY, Qin was rescued by a team of mercenaries.

leader: Royal line of the Unbroken Clan
x: The Unbroken Clan was a criminal syndicate that had a sanctuary on Corellia. They were ruled by the same family line for hundreds of generations, though it ended when General Vukorah took control of the syndicate.

headquarters: Fortress of the Mourner's Wail, Dotharian
x: The Mourner's Wail Syndicate was a criminal syndicate that operated on Corellia. The syndicate hired a number of bounty hunters to attack a sanctuary of the Unbroken Clan, breaking a truce that had been established sometime prior.
The South Quadrant was an area within a sanctuary of the Unbroken Clan, in Coronet City on Corellia.
The West Quadrant was an area within a sanctuary of the Unbroken Clan, in Coronet City on the planet Corellia.
At some point following the death of Galactic Emperor Palpatine at the Battle of Endor, Commodore Visler Aqorian Korda III led a faction of the fragmented Galactic Empire.

Defend the Imperial Metal Factory and eliminate the Partisans
