x: In 19 BBY, a skirmish took place on the planet Zeffo between the clone troopers of the Galactic Empire and the Jedi Chiata and Marseph as a part of Order 66. Following a naval battle with heavy damage sustained, the unit formerly led by Chiata hunted and killed both Jedi.

The Chancellery Secretariat was a suite of the Galactic Republic's Office of the Chancellor located beneath the Galactic Senate Chamber within the Senate Building of the Federal District, on the planet Coruscant.
The First Order field-tested its All Terrain Heavy Hauler on Dromondar Beta in a star system of the same name in the Unknown Regions by 34 ABY, in grid square H-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
CZ-4 was a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid that belonged to the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure along with CZ-3.
Esoomians were a sentient species from the Esooma system in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Razzi Syndicate was a criminal syndicate and crime family run by the crime lord and bounty hunter Latts Razzi during the Imperial Era.

The Exegol Broadcast was a transmission broadcasting of the voice of the late Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine, who was in truth the Sith Lord Darth Sidious, was delivered across the galaxy in 35 ABY.

objective: Resolve a tribal dispute on Felucia
x: The mission to Felucia was a task assigned to Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas by the Jedi High Council prior to the Invasion of Naboo, where he was tasked with resolving a tribal dispute on the planet Felucia.

The Imperial Dig Site was an excavation site of the Galactic Empire located on the planet Zeffo. The site was utilized following the reactivation of Project Auger, in which the Empire attempted to locate artifacts from the ancient Zeffonian ruins.
Sallowpink was a B2-series super battle droid manufactured by Baktoid Combat Automata that was enhanced with a variety of additional gray armor plating across its body and spikes along its arms.

Rheen, styled as Rheen the Powderizer, was an enhanced gladiator droid. It was humanoid in shape with a narrow head topped with an antenna, a large armor plate over its lower torso and a single armor plate over its right shoulder.

A bazaar was located on the Outer Rim planet Crucival during the time of the Galactic Empire. The individual Keffan was at one point robbed outside the bazaar, not being able to move his fingers for some time after as a result.

The Great Hyperspace Disaster, also known as the Great Disaster, Legacy Run disaster, or the evacuation of Hetzal Prime, was an event that occurred during the High Republic Era, in 232 BBY. Several moons in the Trymant system, including Korbatal, were destroyed in the disaster.

The Republic Naval Insitute was an institution tied to the Galactic Republic and its navy. Active at the time of the Clone Wars, it notably published the magazine Space Battles, which contained true accounts of historic space battles.
Keelkana were creatures used as mounts by the Mon Calamari Knights of the planet Mon Cala. Mon Calamari energy lances were designed to be used from atop the back of a Keelkana.
The Drall were a species with eyes that were especially vulnerable to light. They inhabited the Corellia system alongside humans and Selonians.
The Cthon were a troglodytic species that did not rely on visual senses. As such, the weapon known as the flashstick, which emitted a bright flash of blinding light when used, had no effect on them.

The Barabels were a saurian species native to the irradiated planet Barab I. They had blaster-proof scales and were incredibly strong, earning a fearsome reputation that put them in high demand as hired muscle in the criminal underworld.

Selonians were an otter-like sentient bipedal humanoid species from the world of Selonia. Selonians had a short muzzle tipped with a flat rhinarium nose, and bodies covered in fur that could be a range of colors from chestnut brown, to beige, to white, and was not uncommon to …

The Stokhli were a people native to the Inner Rim world of Manress. In ancient times, they designed the spraynet launching weapon known as the spray stick in order to hunt their homeworld's megafauna.
Level 109 was a level of Cloud City, a floating city in the atmosphere of the gas giant planet Bespin. The city's central control mainframe was located within Level 109.

The Oppressor was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought serving in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At a time when it was the newest Executor-class vessel, the Oppressor prepared to test its hyperdrive prior to final deployment.
The Department of Imperial Justice was a bureaucratic department of the Galactic Empire that was active during the formative years of the new Imperial government.

The Hoplite was a Gladiator-class Star Destroyer that served as the flagship of a small Imperial Navy battle group at Ilum. The Hoplite was helmed by Captain Malthegn and was escorted by small frigates and gunboats. As a Gladiator, the Hoplite was 600 meters in length.
The Tholothian government maintained a legislative senate during the Republic Era.
The Godoans were a sentient species of deeply religious people who had a great reverence for the Dancing Goddess idol. They originated from the Godo system.
The uncle of the stormtrooper Thara Nyende owned a cantina in Pinyumb, the capital city of the planet Sullust.

Dorm four was a dormitory located in Pinyumb, the capital city of the planet Sullust. At some point by 3 ABY, the workers who lived there suffered from burns when the steam pipes in some magma extractors burst.

A droid bounty hunter operated during the time of the Galactic Empire. The bounty hunter was a monster droid, made from the body of a B2-series super battle droid and the head of a BX-series droid commando.

Erkush was a creature native to the Wild Space planet Kalee, as are members of the Kaleesh species. Kaleesh warriors hunt the Erkush for more than simply meat and generally kill to demonstrate their bravery, making its pelt for clothing and its skulls and bones for fearsome ma…

Bedlam was a mysterious planet of which little was known other than stories. Dok-Ondar once acquired a relic that was supposedly from the planet. The Gen'Dai Rayvis led a marauder group known as the Bedlam Raiders during the Imperial Era.

result: The Sixth Division of the Alliance Fleet is completely destroyed
x: In 3 ABY, after escaping Imperial forces at the Battle of Hoth, the Sixth Division of the Rebel Alliance's fleet was destroyed. The cell was discovered by Commander Ellian Zahra, who was able to locate the rebels with the help of a signal analysis protocol she had developed.
Nine-Four-El was a droid who served the cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance during the Imperial Era. The droid assisted Valance in acquiring bounties and monitored his progress in completing them.
The Safe House was location outside of Phelar Port on Eriadu.

A special breed of mushroom grew in the excess condensation of moisture vaporators on the desert planet Tatooine. The breed was edible to Artiodacs and was used as an ingredient in the dish Tatooine Terrine, with its juices providing moisture in the recipe.
The Imperial Bureau of Operations was an organization within the Galactic Empire that was active during the Imperial Era.
The Imperial Central Bank was a bank of the Galactic Empire that was active during the Imperial Era.
The Kimoliga's Maw was a C-ROC Gozanti-class light cruiser that was active during the Imperial Era.
The mutiny on the Advent was an incident that occurred in 48 BBY aboard the Advent, a cargo freighter tasked with delivering food to a famine stricken star system.
The scyk was a species of swift, vicious lizard native to the desert planet Tatooine. The M3-A Scyk interceptor manufactured by MandalMotors was named for the reptile.

The Scarlet Dominon was a Nau'ur-class yacht custom made by Kalevala Spaceworks for Aurelia Tagge. It had chromium highlights that were often highlighted by lifestyle paparazzi during the Imperial Era.

The Memory was a Nau'ur-class yacht manufactured by Kalevala Spaceworks. Following the destruction of Alderaan in 1 BBY, the surviving elements of the planet's crown jewels were kept inaccessibly locked away on board the yacht.

A dispute arose between the Gungan and the Naboo several generations before Padmé Amidala was elected Queen of the Naboo. At the time, the situation required the monarch to employ a bodyguard, a practice that would not be reintroduced until Amidala's reign.
The Aruzans were a blue-skinned near-human sentient species. During the Imperial Era, the Aruzan Manaroo, who hailed from Aruza, dated the human bounty hunter Dengar.

Cardooine was an astronomical object in the galaxy where the criminal Zann Consortium were active. It was located in the Cardooine system in the Jospro sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square R-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Gall was an astronomical object with an Imperial spaceport that was located in the Gall system in the Cadavine sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Wanderers were a nomadic collective that traveled in a convoy of seven heavily modified Xiytiar-class heavy transports. During the Imperial Era, the group entered a star system unannounced, identified themselves and then moored to open their extensive bazaars for trade.

The Bakisian Drift was an electrical anomaly located in the Tragan Cluster in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Imperial Era, a convoy owned by Twin Suns Transport Services lost a GR-75 medium transport while traversing the drift.
The Battle of Elphrona was fought when Ben Solo engaged in a duel with three Jedi students Voe, Hennix, and Tai at the Elphrona Outpost following the destruction of Luke Skywalker's Jedi temple.
The Squib were a sentient species. SquibLabs was a corporation managed by Squibs that produced grabbers, a device used for cheating at sabacc.

R2-C4 was an R2-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that belonged to the Space Fighter Corps of the Royal House of the planet Naboo, often serving in the astromech socket of the N-1 starfighter Bravo 6. This droid had been assigned to pilot Gavyn Sykes.

R3-T2, or just R3, was an R3-series astromech droid with red, blue, and white paneling. They lived in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine and in 9 BBY stood in one of the streets when a transport carrying three Inquisitors landed nearby.

R3-Y2 was an R3-series astromech droid that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was stationed in the command center of Echo Base, the Alliance's headquarters on the planet Hoth.
LEP-171B was a dedicated LEP-series service droid that served in the LEP droid pool of the Coruscant Security Force during the Clone Wars.
Bearsloths were fierce arboreal predators found in the forests of the celestial body Arbooine. They had long furry bodies with six legs and four eyes.

Vynocks were non-sentient winged parasites with a large sucker like mouth, two black eyes, two legs and a tail. They were cousins of the legless, silicon-based mynock and were just as troublesome, posing a hazard to anyone traveling through space.

The Blackscale Clan was a Trandoshan mercenary clan based on the species's homeworld, Trandosha. It had a contract to deliver enslaved Wookiees to the Galactic Empire, and so the clan's members raided the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk mercilessly.

The Zssik Clan was a clan of Trandoshan mercenaries that was based on Trandosha, the Trandoshan homeworld. The clan mercilessly raided the planet Kashyyyk in order to provide the Galactic Empire with Wookiee slaves as part of a contract.

Truwel was a planet that was located in the Truwel system in the Outer Rim Territories. It was governed by the star system's government that was officially under the Galactic Empire but secretly supported the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The soldier Hazram Namir led a band of soldiers on the planet Crucival. This included Pira Ten, who Namir befriended while part of the Opaline Creed, and Tar and Mishru, men who Namir fought against before their masters were lost.
Logal Ri, often called the moon of Logal Ri, was a rocky moon in the Chaama sector of the Mid Rim Territories.
Syphacc's Bountiful Bounties was an organization based on Kirkeide Station that provided bounties to bounty hunters in exchange for credits, operated by the cyborg Syphacc.
The Minemoon was a mining moon that orbited Mimban. A number of Mimbanese miners worked on the Minemoon, and uncovered an ancient artifact known as the Mindsplinter.
The Vendaxan land squid was a creature native to the planet Vendaxa. Highly territorial, the squids spawned every ten years and became very aggressive during their mating season.
A clan of Devaronians was active in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu in 3 ABY.

objective: Kill Krynthia
x: A mission to Corellia, also known as the job on Corellia or simply the Corellian job, took place in Coronet City on Corellia during the Imperial Era.

A democratic parliament was part of the Blood Monarchy of Thisspias, which maintained daily and practical governance while the Blood Monarch provided cultural leadership. The Blood Court was eventually abolished by the Galactic Empire during its reign.
A droid was one of many droids that served the religious warrior clan known as the Slinani, protecting Red Mist, one of their Migration Shrines.
Keen's Grotto was a location on the planet Corellia.
Orik's Spine was a location on the planet Corellia.
The Gold Beaches were a location on the planet Corellia.
Dorismus Athenaeum was a location on the planet Corellia.
The Corona House was a location on the planet Corellia.

The Red Honeycomb Zone, also known as the Red Zone, Ship Eater and the Blood Net was a safe passage through the Galactic Barrier, a chaotic web of hyperspace anomalies that prevented travel into the galaxy's Unknown Regions.
The Rakith Plateau was a location which was dry in high summer that was known to the human Jedi apprentice Rey, who had grown up on the Inner Rim desert planet Jakku.

The Comeuppance, otherwise known as Zorii Bliss's Y-Wing, was a modified BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter owned by Zorii Bliss, leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. Bliss purchased the Y-wing for around 40,000 credits after the First Order began raiding the planet Kijimi by 33 ABY.

A battle droid was repaired by the droidsmith Babu Frik in the year 35 ABY, as a job from a wealthy client. Frik intended to provide the battle droid with self-awareness and upgrade its command functions while he repaired it in his workshop on the planet Kijimi.
Hiila Basin was a location on the desert planet Jakku, containing salt flats. Rey compared the salt flats of the planet Tatooine to those of Hiila Basin.

The Anodyne Two was a starship operational during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. It shared its name with the Nebulon-C escort frigate Anodyne, a Resistance starship destroyed by the First Order in an attack on its fleet.
Interrogation Six was an interrogation cell located aboard the First Order Star Destroyer Steadfast. After the Wookiee Chewbacca was captured, he was taken to Interrogation Six.

The moon of Kyzring was a rocky moon in the Vendaxa system that was rich in carnium, a mineral rich in energy. The Mining Guild undertook mining operations on the moon, carving out large areas of rock.
Arakurth were a type of gigantic worm with three claw-like teeth protruding from their mouth. They were native to the green gas cloud of the Typhonic Nebula.

Serelia was a planet orbiting a trinary star in the Serelia system in the Oriolan sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Its surface was mostly covered in oceans, which supported aquatic life and the planet's fishing industry, though it had occasional red landmasses.
Automaintenance Crew 28-G was a droid maintenance crew on Cloud City, consisting of a number of MSE-6 series repair droids, which operated during the time of the Galactic Empire.

Level 110 was a level of Cloud City, a floating city in the atmosphere of the gas giant Bespin. The droid maintenance unit Automaintenance Crew 28-G were making repairs to the level when they were given new orders by Lobot, to attack a number of stormtroopers attempting to bre…
Level 130 was a level of Cloud City, containing Port Town as well as the floating city's largest hangar.

Central Processing was the central command mainframe of Cloud City, located on Level 109. Lobot was connected to the mainframe in Central Processing after the Galactic Empire took control of the city, but was rescued by former Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian.

Galmerah was a graveyard planet located in the galaxy. During the time of the Galactic Empire, a number of bounty hunters visited Galmerah while hunting down Nakano Lash, a fellow bounty hunter who disappeared after an apparent betrayal years prior.
Sigma Station was a terrestrial astronomical object in an eponymous star system in the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories regions.
The wharf was a location on Level 1313 of Coruscant's sprawling underworld. It had an underground lake, speeder docks, and Ronto Grill, a restaurant with outdoor seating.

Vaale was a city on the planet Dianth, constructed out of living bone. The city was designed by the Architects of Vaale, who created numerous other artifacts including the Rings of Vaale, which supposedly provided their wearer with great power.
Valara was one of two moons orbiting the native planet of Batuu in the Outer Rim Territories. It shared an orbit with Destra, which was not visible from Black Spire Outpost.
Dotharian was a planet located deep within Hutt Space. It was the home of the Mourner's Wail criminal syndicate, led by Lord Khamdek, who operated from a secure fortress.
Qlint was a terrestrial astronomical object where the assassin Just Lucky attempted to kill the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra at one point by 3 ABY.

The Ark Angel III was a starship used by the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra in the time following the Battle of Hoth. Aphra utilized the vessel after the destruction of her previous starship, the Ark Angel II.
2J-3PO was a protocol droid that was active during the Clone Wars on Tatooine and acted as a courier for the Vosadii.

Sector 5-1-5 was a sector on the desert planet of Geonosis. During the First Battle of Geonosis, after Jedi Grand Master Yoda ordered all fire be focused on the nearest starship, a Clone Captain in the Forward Command Center ordered all quadrants to the sector, allowing for th…
Cell 2188 was a holding cell at a work camp ran by Commodore Visler Aqorian Korda III's Imperial faction on the planet Rekkana.
The Silver Angel was a repurposed Nebula-class freighter assembled and modified by the mechanic and aspiring pilot Trace Martez, who lived on Level 1313 of the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
Shortly after the Battle of Endor the Imperial remnant led by Commodore Visler Aqorian Korda III established a work camp on the planet Rekkana for the Rekk species.

Bride's Talon was a mountain on Cato Neimoidia outside the city of Tarko-se. It had a conveyex track that ran through it. Tobias Beckett ordered Tuska to climb the face of it and keep watch during his attempt to steal a railcar.

objective: To recover information from a J9 worker drone
x: In 33 ABY, the junk boss Unkar Plutt was kidnapped by the Zendiat Collective in order to recover a J9 worker drone that was sold to him. The scavenger Rey tricked them, and was able to recover the junk boss and take him back to Niima Outpost, where Krynodd had taken over.

Caragon-Viner was a distant planet in the Caragon-Viner system of the Colonies that held a Jedi outpost during the High Republic Era. Jedi Master Stellan Gios was once stationed there alongside Jedi Knight Indeera Stokes.

A city was located on the planet Oba Diah, situated near the fortress of the Pyke Syndicate. After escaping imprisonment from within the Pykes' fortress, Ahsoka Tano and Rafa and Trace Martez were pursued through the city.
An 8D-series smelter droid served the Pyke Syndicate on Oba Diah, operating as a torture droid within the prison of the High fortress of the Pyke Syndicate.
A Sugi arms dealing group operated on Utapau during the Clone Wars, a galaxy-wide conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

result: Ahsoka Tano and the Martez sisters successfully escape from the Pykes,
objective: Escape from the Pyke Syndicate
x: In 19 BBY, late in the Clone Wars, Ahsoka Tano and sisters Trace and Rafa Martez escaped from the planet Oba Diah after incurring the wrath of the Pyke Syndicate.

Docking Bay 5 was a docking bay at the spaceport in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. During the First Order occupation of the planet, Docking Bay 5 hosted Ohnaka Transport Solutions, where the pirate-turned-legitimate Hondo Ohnaka hired flight crews to pilot the Millen…
A Scrapper Guild L-1g general purpose droid worked as a foreman in the Shipbreaking Yard on the planet Bracca.
A pilot from the planet Hosnian Prime owned a backup racer they brought to the supertanker fuel depot Colossus as a backup ship for the All Aces Battle Royale race in 34 ABY.

Troithe was a planet in the Cerberon system of the galaxy's Deep Core. As a ecumenopolis, it once rivaled the galactic capital of Coruscant as the jewel of the Old Republic, centuries before the Galactic Civil War.

result: New Republic captures Troithe from the Galactic Empire
x: The Troithe operation, also referred to as the battle at the capital, attack on the capital, and battle for the capital district, was a battle initiated by the New Republic to attack enemy forces, led by Governor Hastemoor, shielded within the capital of the planet Troithe.
WED-15-77 was a WED-15-XT Treadwell repair droid that served the Lars family at their moisture farm on the planet Tatooine for more than twenty years.

t: Raid on a Pyke Syndicate shipment
x: In 19 BBY, during the Clone Wars, a shipment of spice belonging to the Pyke Syndicate was raided by the Galactic Republic on its arrival to Coruscant, with the drug being seized. None of the Pykes escorting the shipment made it back to the syndicate.
In 19 BBY, a ring of thieves worked with the owner of a cantina Janott, who fed them information on Separatist Alliance shipments going through the cantina.

The revolt on the Leverage occurred around 40 BBY. The Leverage, commanded by the Czerka Corporation's Sector Supervisor Meritt Col, attempted to prevent the enslaved workers on board from attaining freedom.
R2-B1 was an R2-series astromech droid that was stationed in the repair droid pool on the royal starship belonging to Queen Amidala during the invasion of Naboo by the Trade Federation.

Worker Rail Route 213 was a train line located on the planet Bracca, utilized by the Scrapper Guild. After the former Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis was discovered by the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius, he was pursued along a train on Worker Rail Route 213.
During the final days of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems launched an attack on the Galactic Republic FireStar II-class Orbital Defense Platform Sentinel Flare.

In 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's Twenty-First went on a mission to the planet Bestine IV as a part of a coordinated final effort to distract forces of the Galactic Empire and allow the Alliance Fleet to complete its withdrawal from the Mid Rim.

The Gauntlet was a Kom'rk-class fighter/transport that was used by Bo-Katan Kryze, leader of the Mandalorian Nite Owls, during her search for allies who would help liberate her people's homeworld, Mandalore.
A Venator-class Star Destroyer served in the navy of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, under the command of Jedi General Chiata.

The Haxion Fight Pit was a fighting arena located within Ordo Eris, the asteroid space station of the Haxion Brood criminal syndicate. Sorc Tormo, crime lord of the Haxion Brood, often enjoyed watching combat in the arena.

3464 was a B1-series battle droid that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems as part of a droid army on the planet Geonosis.

Bay 12 was a hangar bay located onboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Tribunal that stored shuttles for the Grand Army of the Republic. In 19 BBY, it held a Nu-class attack/transport shuttle. The bay was destroyed after the Star Destroyer crashed on a moon.
In 22 BBY, the Pastoral Collective maintained the communally owned water meadows and pastures of the Mid Rim planet Naboo's Lake Country.
The Baskron Pirates were a pirate group originating from the Mid Rim Territories' Baskron system. that was active in a region of space.

Fork-nosed ice worms were a rare species of worm that could be found on Hoth, a frozen Outer Rim planet. In 3 ABY, Doctor Chelli Aphra visited the world and recovered a fossilized fork-nosed ice worm.

The Gulches were a location on the Outer Rim planet Crucival. Hazram Namir, a soldier from a clan named the Malkhanis, was present in the Gulches for some time during the era of the Galactic Empire.
Geranites were a species that could only breathe a certain gas and wore special suits to survive. Doallyn was a member of the species.

The Hanging Valley was a valley on the ice-covered planet Hoth. It was located south of the North Ridge, west of the Cirque Glacier, and north-west of the Clabburn Range of mountains.

Mount Ison was a mountain located on the ice-covered planet Hoth. It was located north of the North Ridge. The mountain shared its name with the planet Ison, located in the Ison system, which, like Hoth, was located in the Anoat sector.

The North Ridge was a mountainous ridge on the planet Hoth. In 3 ABY, the Jedi Luke Skywalker was attacked by a wampa on the ridge, prompting his friend Han Solo to pass through the region while searching for him.

The Kerane Valley was a valley on the planet Hoth. In 3 ABY, the All Terrain Armored Transports of the Galactic Empire's Blizzard Force passed through the valley on their route to attack Echo Base, headquarters of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Lanteel Glacier was a glacier on the planet Hoth. In 3 ABY, the rebels Han Solo and Luke Skywalker placed sensors on the glacier before Skywalker was attacked by a wampa and dragged to the creature's nearby cave.
Trindello was an astronomical object located in the Trindello system of the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector.

The Genetic Records Hall was a room within the Tipoca City Military Complex, a military complex operated by the Galactic Republic on the planet Kamino's capital city Tipoca City. The hall contained data on the original DNA of every clone which was cloned by the Kaminoans.
An embryo room was located in the Tipoca City Military Complex, a Galactic Republic military complex located in Tipoca City, the capital city of the planet Kamino.

Pipe-birds were a type of bird with the ability to whistle. According to the maniacal ex-surgeon Cornelius Evazan, a dying princess in the Kingdom of Tion taught her pipe-bird to whistle her favorite song thousands of years before the Imperial Era.

Thule was an arid mountainous planet within the Thurra system in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet shared its name with a mercenary gang known as Thugs of Thule.
Zarra was the capital city of the planet Cato Neimoidia. During the Imperial Era, Bandit Billie stole the contents of Tobias Beckett's pack, including the Smuggler's Guide, from him in Zarra.

Loovria was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Loovria system in the Juvex sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It featured fighting arenas that, during the Galactic Civil War, were gaining popularity as a competitor to the Grakkus Arena on Nar Shaddaa.

The Imperial Special Training Corps was an organization of the Galactic Empire that assumed the duties of quality control and training of Imperial Military forces following the Empire' ascension from the Galactic Republic.

Hisseen was a planet in the Mid Rim Territories that was home to the Hisseenians. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems attempted to capture the planet in 22 BBY, and the Galactic Republic sent Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi, Plo Koon, and Anakin Skywalke…

The Hisseenians were a group of humans who inhabited the planet Hisseen. In 22 BBY, when the planet was attacked by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic intervened to protect the Hisseenians.
During the early Clone Wars in 22 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems laid siege to the planet Hisseen.

The Alchemists Guild was an organization that had been defunct for almost a thousand years by the Imperial Era. Doctor Cornelius Evazan was not aware of this fact and sent in an application, becoming disappointed when he received no response.

Little Petrovi was a location in the Yushan sector of the galaxy. Droid Gotra began to transmit orders to all members of Gotra and the Cyban Front stationed in the Rim Territories, ordering them to strike high-value data caches on Terminus, Little Petrovi, and Corbett Cluster.

The Bug Hunters were gangsters who kept butterflies in captivity in cages. The smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca tried to free them but were captured. However, Solo's son, Ben Solo, had hidden in the their starship, the Millennium Falcon.
Benglor was a planet in the Onatos sector in the galaxy's Mid Rim Territories. It had rocky terrain and a hot climate.

The Kyyyalstaad Basin was a lake on the planet Kashyyyk. It was fed by water from the nearby Kyyyalstaad Falls.
Gloomroot Hollow was a dark region of forest on the planet Kashyyyk. It could be accessed from the Kyyyalstaad Basin and the Origin Lake.
The Origin Lake was a lake located on the forest planet Kashyyyk, situated at the base of the Origin Tree. It shared its name with the nearby River of Origin.
Keldabe was the former capital city of the planet Mandalore in ancient times. The Great Forge was located beneath the city.

The Deserted Village was an abandoned Wookiee village located on the planet Kashyyyk, near the Shadowlands. As the former Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis traversed Kashyyyk in search of a Zeffonian Astrium, he was attacked by the TIE Reaper piloted by the Ninth Sister.
The Gnarled Heights was a location within the Origin Tree on the planet Kashyyyk. The former Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis climbed through the area while attempting to reach the top of the tree.

The Chieftain's Canopy was an area situated at the top of the Origin Tree on the planet Kashyyyk. Long before the Imperial Era, the Zeffonians visited Kashyyyk, and left an Astrium in the Chieftain's Canopy.

Level 42 was a level in the Corellian Sector on the moon Nar Shaddaa. Prior to or during 10 BBY, the con artist Loonoo complained about the smell in the Corellian Sector, attributing it to corpses that had not been disposed of, in an entry in the logbook known as the Smuggler'…

Level 220 was a location on the moon Nar Shaddaa. At some point by 10 BBY, the con artist Loonoo carried a customer card for the unidentified animal emporium on Level 220, which was taken from him when he was robbed by Skrrll.

Zenezians were a sentient species. The musician Infrablue Zedbeddy Coggins was a Zenezian, as was Sudswater Dillifay Glon. It was considered a major insult to refuse a musical instrument from a Zenezian.

AD-3, also called Aidee, was a protocol droid that served as the companion of the Jedi Master Kelleran Beq alongside the astromech droid LX-R5. AD-3 was a good friend of Beq, and possessed a sense of humor.

A B2 super battle droid served in the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. The B2-series super battle droid, among many others, were dispatched in an army commanded by the Sith apprentice Asajj Ventress.
The Athylia was a Pelta-class frigate in the service of the Jedi Order. Jedi Master Kelleran Beq often served aboard the vessel, alongside the protocol droid AD-3 and the astromech droid LX-R5.
The Credit recovery division was an organization within the Bounty Hunters' Guild. The skip tracer Shesslaria was a member of the credit recovery division.
Ziro the Hutt's criminal organization was a criminal syndicate led by the gangster Ziro Desilijic Tiure on Coruscant.
LX-R5, also known as Ellex, was an R5 series astromech droid that served the Jedi Order, working alongside the Jedi Master Kelleran Beq and the protocol droid AD-3.

The Battle of Corvair was one of several Galactic Republic advancements into in the Corvair sector early in the Clone Wars. During the battle, Jedi General Anakin Skywalker led his starfighters against Separatist forces.
An RA-7 protocol droid served the Galactic Empire's Inspectorate at the Imperial Inspectorate HQ on Coruscant, controlling access to the organization's databanks.

Sublevel nine was a location within the Galactic Senate Building on Coruscant. It housed the building's sewage recycling facility and was featured in the orientational tours of newly-elected senators.

Kreeling was a planet located in the Kreeling system in the Chommell sector of the Mid Rim. It was a mining world that hosted numerous refineries. The person in charge of the refineries was considered more or less in charge of the planet.

Behpour was a planet in the Naboo system within the Mid Rim's Chommell sector. It possessed a relatively small population. Behpour was represented by Olan Carrus at a summit held by Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo.
Chommell Minor was a planet located in Chommell Minor system in the Chommell sector of the Mid Rim. The planet was represented by Nitsa Tulin at a summit held by Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo.

Silpath were a creature found on the planet Jafan. They possessed antlers and hooves, resided in herds, and would migrate annually. At one point, Harli Jafan and her cousins were caught in a silpath migration, and had to climb a tree to escape.

The Delcontrian faction was a group that originated from the Delcontr system of the Mid Rim Territories' Oriolan sector. The group served as representatives in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Republic Era.
The Tellonites were a group originating from the Tellon system in the Sombure sector of the Mid Rim Territories. The group was represented in the Galactic Republic's Senate during the Republic Era.
The Jafani were the inhabitants of the colony planet Jafan. A number of Jafani, most of whom were artists, also resided on Naboo, a planet in the same sector.
The Naboo planetary legislative assembly was the legislature of the planet Naboo. Members of the assembly were elected at the same time as Naboo's monarchs, every two years.

An MSE-6 droid was located in a Mos Espa house on the desert planet Tatooine. In 28 BBY, the Naboo Royal Handmaiden Sabé lived in the house for six weeks while attempting to free slaves on the planet.
The Tantel mercs were a mercenary group affiliated with the Crymorah Syndicate during the Imperial Era. They had a numbered account at the Bank of Coruscant.
A light freighter belonged to a Rebel Alliance captain during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the captain conducted repairs for the ship while stationed in Echo Base on the planet Hoth.
Enujut was a rocky world in the galaxy. Evor Haris served as a peacekeeper on the world, welcoming visitors.

Zemerin were a species of telepaths that fed on negative energy. A group of Zemerin visited the world Enujut and caused negativity between its residents in order to feed, but their plans were foiled by local peacekeeper Evor Haris and a protocol droid that had discovered the t…

A blue-plated protocol droid resided on the rocky world Enujut. After a group of Zemerin arrived on Enujut, the protocol droid discovered that the species was telepathic and caused negativity in order to feed on it.
Dybrin was a planet located in the Dybrin system, in the Deep Core and the Interior region, in grid square L-12 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Blutopia was a planet in the Vensensor sector's Blutopia system, in the Expansion Region and the Trailing Sectors. The watery world was home to the Blutopian species.
Bernilla was a planet located in the Bernilla system of the Inner Rim and the Interior regions, in grid square L-14 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It shared its name with Bernillan silk.
Avedot was a planet located in the Avedot system in the Colonies in grid square L-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was orbited by the moon of Avedot.
Guagenia was a planet located in the Guagenia system, within the Guagenian sector of the Inner Rim and the Interior regions. It was situated in grid square J-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Xibariz was a planet located in the Xibariz system of the Inner Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square O-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Orchis was a planet located in the Orchis system of the Inner Rim and New Territories region, in grid square N-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Ketzali was a planet located in the Ketzali system within the Lannik Wilds sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim and the Slice regions. It was situated in grid square R-13 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Throffdon was a planet located in the Throffdon system of the Inner Rim and the Interior regions, in grid square J-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid. The planet orbited at least one sun, which went supernova during the Imperial Era.

Oshira was a planet located in the Oshira system, within the Vilonis sector of the Mid Rim and the Trailing Sectors regions, in grid square O-16 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It shared its name with Oshiran sapphires, which originated from the same star system.
Peak was a location on Polyneus. Sun-Lamas lived here.

The world-ocean was an enormous body of water beneath the surface of the planet Utapau. The tidal forces of Utapau's moons created powerful currents that eroded the underside of the planet's crust and created many sinkholes and chasms.

The Black Spire Outpost Market was located in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. Merchants located within the Market included Black Spire Outfitters, Creature Stall, Jewels of Bith, Toydarian Toymaker, and The Wooden Wookiee.
River was a location on the planet Polyneus.

This OOM command battle droid served as a guard at the Cyber Center on the planet Anaxes in the Azure system. Admiral Trench informed the droid that a group of clones were approaching to attack the center. Trench advised that the battle droids stay alert for the clones.

Savi's scrapyards located on the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost was the main location of Savi & Son Salvage, a company owned by Savi on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. The junkyard had stone walls and a formal entrance on the route known to locals as Savi's Path.
R4-F5 was a blue-green and gray R4-P astromech droid that was permanently integrated into the Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor of Jedi Master Plo Koon.
Galitan was a remote moon located in the Galitan system in the Ringali Nebula, a nebula in the Bormea sector of the Core Worlds.
The ground crew of the New Republic was a group that serviced starships.

Esseles was a planet located in the Esseles system in the Darpa sector of the Core Worlds that had been contested territory throughout the Galactic Civil War and had a secret Imperial listening post concealed in its icy rings.

Stabinator was a modified Mark VII gladiator droid who worked for the Grakkus Arena around 0 ABY and had 15 clean kills on the Wumpo circuit using a power lance. Stabinator was manumitted after a slave uprising instigated by Wrollanppf.
Mos Zabu was a city on Tatooine. It contained a podracer racetrack and a cantina.
Snooze was a blue and silver astromech droid in service to the beings Yates and Oota. It assisted them in maintaining Yates's Podracer for use on the Mos Zabu racetrack on Tatooine.

A desert planet existed in the galaxy, characterized by its extreme sandstorms. During the Imperial Era, a spy of the Rebel Alliance escaped into the planet's atmosphere when evading TIE fighters sent by Commander Tylux of the Galactic Empire.

result: Destruction of the Rebel Alliance forces
Exo and a rebel spy escape
x: After a spy of the Alliance to Restore the Republic acquired schematics to a key factory of the Galactic Empire, the Empire led an attack on the base of the rebel forces.

The City Bigspace was a large hydrostatic force field bubble located in the Gungan city of Otoh Gunga. It was one of many bubbles added to the city by Rugor Nass during his rule, and was visited by Gungans from around Naboo.
The Grand Walkway was a massive walkway located in Otoh Gunga. Large parts of the walkway were often occupied by lost tourists.

The Civic Level was the highest of Pau City's eleven levels. It contained the city's government, bureaucracy, civic and ceremonial buildings, and cultural and recreational facilities, such as the Pahum Cultural Center. The Pau'an elite also lived on the level.
The Battle of Crombach Nebula took place sometime between 22 BBY and 19 BBY in the Crombach Nebula during the Clone Wars between Galactic Republic and Separatist Alliance forces.

The Overseer was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that was built at the Kuat Drive Yards for service in the Imperial Navy and later served as the flagship of Titan Squadron. The Star Destroyer managed to win major victories at Jeyell and Pothor.
The Temperance was an MC75 Star Cruiser that was in service to the Alliance Fleet and the subsequent New Republic Defense Fleet, in which it served as the flagship of Vanguard Squadron.

The Accordance was an MC75 Star Cruiser in service to the Rebel Alliance alongside its sister ship, the Temperance. Manufactured by Mon Calamari Shipyards and active during the Galactic Civil War, it was part of the Alliance Navy and defended the borders of the Hosnian system.

Var-Shaa was a resource-rich planet located in the Mid Rim that hosted a dockyard of the Galactic Empire in its orbit. The dockyard was a key waypoint for the Imperial Navy, but was destroyed in a New Republic attack shortly after the Battle of Endor.
The Battle of Jeyell was an engagement that saw the Galactic Empire's Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Overseer overwhelm several EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates despite being vastly outnumbered.

Sissubo was the seventh planet of the Chandrila system in the Bormea sector. It was surrounded by a debris field that consisted of remnants of salvaged Galactic Empire starships as part of the New Republic's Project Starhawk.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: A battle occurred at the border of the Hosnian system during the Galactic Civil War at the same time as the Battle of Endor between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
Project Starhawk, also known as the Starhawk project, was a New Republic starship project to develop the Starhawk-class battleship. The Starhawk was a prototype of the class developed by the project.
The Mining Level was the lowest of Pau City's eleven levels. Its primary uses were waste disposal and the mining of bone and stone, both of which would be used in construction.

The Produce Level was one of the lower levels of Pau City. It contained a number of greenhouses that were used to grow food plants such as cave-molds and ocean-kelps. Varactyls and dactillions were also bred on the Produce Level. The level's primary inhabitants were Utai.

The Battle of Var-Shaa occurred after the Battle of Endor during the Galactic Civil War, and the formation of the New Republic, when a naval group of the New Republic Defense Fleet undertook a strike against the key Imperial dockyard located in orbit above Var-Shaa, resulting …

Laundry room #346 was a laundry room located aboard the Supremacy, a Mega-class Star Dreadnought built by Kuat-Entralla Engineering that served as the flagship of Snoke, the Supreme Leader of the First Order.
At the heart of First Order flagship Supremacy was a massive assembly hall that could seat 200,000 beings. Despite its size, less than a tenth of the ship's crew could sit within it at any one time.

Droid manufacturing plant P-3 was a droid manufacturing plant on the First Order dreadnought Supremacy. Prior to Supremacy's destruction, the plant won the top rank in a competition with seven other facilities.
Droid repair shop A16-523 was a droid repair shop located on the port side of the Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy.
The frondtrailer was a species of crinoid native to the planet of Ahch-To. The net-maker Corm-Kairuku wore a hat made from frondtrailers.

result: Treinhaus Citadel destroyed, Imperial intelligence recovered by the Ne
x: The Skirmish on Argai Minor was a conflict between the New Republic and remnants of the Galactic Empire sometime after the Battle of Endor.
The tytahuso fish was a species of fish native to the planet Ahch-To. The Caretakers constructed a ladder from the vertebrae of a tytahuso fish.

t: Plo Koon's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor
x: In 19 BBY during the Battle of Cato Neimoidia, Jedi Master Plo Koon flew a Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor with a paint job similar to that of the Delta-7B starfighter that he flew in the earlier stages of the Clone Wars, Blade of Dorin.

Orelon was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Orelon system in the Hapes Cluster of the Inner Rim Territories that was the site of a weapons trade involving the Wookiee smuggler Chewbacca and Big Quince.
R5-G19 was an R5 series astromech droid that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

objective: Find the Tusken totem and use it to discover the location of salt mine
x: A search for a Tusken totem was undertaken on the planet Tatooine.
A sentry droid worked in a small crew led by the bounty hunter Jeskian Veldar. He had plating colored entirely black, with a singular red sensor.
A protocol droid was owned by the crime lord Ne'eda Frip, leader of Ne'eda's Stalwarts on Neral's moon. The protocol droid translated for Frip, who usually resided within a tank in her tower.

Ne'eda's Stalwarts were a criminal organization that consisted of the henchmen of the crime lord Ne'eda Frip, who resided in Ne'eda's Tower on Neral's moon. They were charged with keeping order on the moon.

The Retreat from Parcelus Minor happened during the Imperial Era. The mercenary Saponza claimed to have participated in the retreat from Parcelus Minor, in addition to the Mytaranor Campaign and the Kwymar Suppressions.

A pilot droid was one of many similar droids that served the Scrapper Guild on the shipbreaking planet Bracca, piloting hover barges in the Shipbreaking Yard. In 14 BBY, the pilot droid was situated by a wrecked Venator-class Star Destroyer, collecting waste on his hover barge.
Line Ten-A was the designation of an area on the wing of a wrecked Venator-class Star Destroyer situated within the Scrapper Guild's Shipbreaking Yard on the planet Bracca.
The Hynestian Royal Guard were the security force of the royal family of the planet Hynestia. Captain Twyla was the head of the Hynestian Royal Guard.
The Uniformed Branch was the most visible division of the Canto Bight Police Department. Its members worked in the city's Old Town and casinos.

The Legacy Run was a Class A modular freight transport that was destroyed in an event known as the Great Hyperspace Disaster. Fragments of its debris were shot through hyperspace and traveled to points across the galaxy.
The Byne Guild was a guild based in in the outer reaches of the galaxy during the High Republic Era. Owning a fleet of starships, the guild was headed by Scover Byne.

Saberfish were a type of enormous fish that lived in the storm seas of the Mid Rim planet Tibrin. During the High Republic Era, a countess from the Core Worlds planet Abregado-rae ordered a saberfish for her private aquarium.
Catadra was a temple world located in the Deep Core's Cerberon system. It was home to a number of religious cults, the most notable of which was the Children of the Empty Sun.
The Yordain Core was an astronomical object in the Yordain Core system in the Inner Rim Territories where an event happened, involving a blessing by a priest-king.

The Allegiance was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier which served in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, it began serving the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing along with two other cruiser-carriers.

Verzan was an airless planet located in the Deep Core's Cerberon system. It served as a garrison world of the Galactic Empire, but was bombarded by the New Republic during its campaign to capture the system, obliterating much of Verzan's surface.
CB-9 was an astromech droid who served the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron as the droid of Yrica Quell. CB-9 replaced Quell's previous astromech D6-L after it was destroyed in a crash on Pandem Nai.
Jarbanov was a barren planet located in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region, in the Serathrace sector in grid square P-11 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Anx Minor was an astronomical object located in the Anx Minor system in the Outer Rim Territories' Raioballo sector. It lay along the Veragi Trade Route between the Dantooine and Ord Trasi systems. It was the site of a massacre during the Galactic Civil War.
A massacre took place at the location Anx Minor during the Galactic Civil War, prior to the New Republic's campaign in the Cerberon system.

Narthex was the moon of Catadra, a planet in the Deep Core's Cerberon system. Having once been inhabited, Narthex had been unpopulated for nearly a millennium, and the moon was overrun with dirkweed brambles.
The Cerberon debris field was an asteroid field located in the Cerberon system, within the Deep Core.
Asteroid CER952B was an asteroid located in the Cerberon debris field, within the Cerberon system of the Deep Core.

A planetoid was located in the Cerberon system, orbiting the Cerberon singularity black hole. Yrica Quell, Caern Adan, and his unique IT-O crashed onto the planetoid after escaping the destruction of the Lodestar. The planetoid contained a Sith tower located on top of a mesa.

Kol Huro was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Kol Huro system in the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The journalist Caern Adan was detained and imprisoned by the Galactic Empire after he published a story about droid production forecasts on Kol Huro.

Koru Neimoidia was a Purse World located in the Colonies region of the galaxy. After being imprisoned by the Galactic Empire, the former journalist Caern Adan hoped that a new warden would be appointed and release him back into the streets of Koru Neimoidia.

Yethra was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector's Yethra system within the Outer Rim Territories. Situated at the coordinates N-17 on the Standard Galactic Grid, it had one sun and a terrain that consisted of ice sheets.
The Warplands was a location on the planet Fedalle, containing the ruins of Navosh-Hul.
The Cataract of Moons was an astronomical object where TIE fighter pilot Soran Keize of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing once encountered an enemy Polynean pilot.
The Cybersynth District was a district of the planet Troithe that contained foundries. During the Troithe operation, Wyl Lark escorted Kairos's U-wing through Cybersynth District foundries.

Quarmendy was a rocky planet in the Mid Rim Territories. The Nexus, a floating city and trading outpost, was situated above Quarmendy. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the latter group controlled the Nexus.
The Nexus was a trading outpost located above the planet Quarmendy. Early on in the Clone Wars, the Nexus was occupied by the Confederacy of Independent Systems under the leadership of Wat Tambor.
New Vertica was a city located on Nar Shaddaa. The Benevolence Tower, home to the Inheritors of the Crystal cult, was located on the outskirts of New Vertica.

Deaons were a sentient species native to the astronomical object of Ord Gimmel. Members of the species possessed long fingers and manufactured a variety of makes and models of the short, squat variable holdout blasters, which were shaped to fit their hands.
Chorgad was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Chorgad system within the Fei Hu sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square Q-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Starskimmer was the starship of the bounty hunter Nakano Lash, who led a crew of other hunters. The ship included a large room with a holoprojector at its center, which Lash would use for briefing before missions.

Receiver Station 356-39 was a communication station located on the mining planet Chorin. The bounty hunter Beilert Valance attempted to contact his former lover Yuralla Vega through Receiver Station 356-39, but cut the transmission just before it went through.
By 3 ABY, a bombing on Chorgad was carried out by a crew of the Mourner's Wail Syndicate against their rival, the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate.

objective: Take control of the Nexus
x: During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic undertook a mission to the planet Quarmendy to take the floating city Nexus from Confederacy of Independent Systems control.
A town was located on the planet Merokia. It was the home of the Force-sensitive human Karr Nuq Sin and contained his school.
The Force-sensitive human Karr Nuq Sin lived in a house on the planet Merokia. The house was located in the same town as Nuq Sin's school.
Fire rats were a type of creature native to Mustafar. They were known to gnaw on the lava crystals that could be found on the volcanic world.
This BX-series droid commando served on Anaxes during the battle between the Grand Army of the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
The operation at Jarbanov, also referred to as the Jarbanov attack, was carried out in 5 ABY at the planet Jarbanov by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.
The east passage was a location on the planet Pasaana.
In 32 BBY, recently-elected Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo held the Chommell sector summit for the leaders of other planets in the Chommell sector.

The Broken Wing was a specific location formed on the planet Zeffo when an unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer crashed there after suffering large amounts of damage from a Separatist dreadnought during the Battle against a Separatist dreadnought.

Riar was a major city located on the planet Toydaria. It had a population of approximately 100,000, of which about 80 percent were Toydarian, and was divided into several districts. It was built on a series of hills.
Toydar was the largest city on the planet Toydaria. It had a population of approximately half a million.

Arnel was a major agri-industrial city on the planet Toydaria. The city was composed on ten rings of alternating water and land surrounded by swamps. The majority of its buildings were constructed atop large metal poles.
The Low Park was the region between the several hills that made up the Toydarian city of Riar.

The Merchant Mounds were a trio of hills located in the Toydarian city of Riar. Most of Riar's trade takes place in the mounds. One of the hills, called Merchant Mound One, was the first settlement that would become Riar, and so was also known as the Old Town.
The Factory Hill was a hill located in the Toydarian city of Riar. It was used for heavy industry and contained the city's power plants and other utilities

The Transit Hill, also known as the Riar Starport, was a hill located in the Toydarian city of Riar. It was adjacent to the Factory Hill, and all starship traffic entering the city was routed through the hill.
The Tower Hills were a pair of hills located in the Toydarian city of Riar. They contained a number of residential towers, which could be up to fifteen stories tall.
The Royal Highland was a hill located in the Toydarian city of Riar. It contained the royal residence and other government facilites. It was the largest and tallest hill in the city.

Merchant Mound One was one of the three hills that made up the Merchant Mounds, the district of Riar in which most trade took place. The original settlement that became Riar was located on Merchant Mound One, so the hill was also known as the Old Town.
The Bright Vigil was a medical transport that served the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
The southern province was a province of the Mid Rim planet Naboo. By 32 BBY, a girl lived in the province who was famed for her water sculptures.

The battle above Catadra, also referred to as the battle over Catadra, was a battle initiated by the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, led by Colonel Soran Keize, to attack General Hera Syndulla's New Republic forces within the Cerberon system.

The rock garden was a location in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Jedi Padawans were often assigned to rearrange the stones in the garden, and it was one of the tasks Obi-Wan Kenobi wished he were carrying out rather than reading taxation bills presented to the Galactic Senate w…

result: The Galactic Empire destroys the Parozha VII outpost
x: The attack on Parozha VII was carried out in around 5 ABY by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Salis D'aar was the capital city of the planet Bakura. It was laid out in a circular pattern which, according to historian Eloc Throno in his 34 ABY book Traveler's Guide to Batuu, made it easy for outsiders and visitors to navigate.
The Queen's library was a library in the Theed Royal Palace down the hallway from the royal apartments on the fifth floor, reserved for the use of the Queen of Naboo.

The Theed sewer system was the sewer system of the city of Theed, capital of Naboo. For health purposes, it was the only part of the city's infrastructure completely managed by droids, and as such was normally completely flooded with water.
The sewage treatment plant was a location on the outskirts of the Naboo city of Theed where the city's sewage was processed.
A catfish was a species of fish native to the planet Batuu in the Outer Rim Territories.

The eastern exurbs were a location on the planet Christophsis. In 22 BBY, during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, the exurbs served as the site for the refugee camp of Republic Senator Bail Prestor Organa, as well as the comp…

The Minister of Sustenance's compound was a compound owned by the Minister of Sustenance in the eastern exurbs of the world of Christophsis. Senator Bail Organa and his rebels stayed in the cellar beneath the compound when they were targeted by Separatist General Whorm Loathsom.
The western district was located within the city of Chaleydonia, the capital of the planet Christophsis.

The War Production Board was an organization within the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic noticed scientists who were associates of the War Production Board during a meeting of the Strategic Advisory Cell.

The western district in Chaleydonia, the capital city of the planet Christophsis, had a town square. During the Battle of Christophsis, the Galactic Republic encountered little resistance when capturing the town square and rest of the district.

H-dash-five-one-eight-zero-two was the designation of a Coyote cargo ship owned by Hondo Ohnaka of Ohnaka Transport Solutions on the planet Batuu. The Resistance spy Vi Moradi used the freighter when rescuing Siv and Torbi from the planet Parnassos.

The Shrikarai, also known as the Nameless, as the Shrii Ka Rai or Shrii-ka-rai (Eaters of the Force or Force Eaters), were creatures that preyed on the Living Force, thus making them into natural predators for Force-sensitive individuals when they were forced off of their home…

A moon in the galaxy was once colonized by the Geonosian species. Long after the moon had been abandoned, during the Imperial Era, antiques dealer Antron Bach went into hiding on the moon with a cache of Jedi artifacts he had been entrusted with by Jedi Master Uvell.

Lizard-crows were a type of creature found on the lava fields of the world Mustafar. They were known to be scared off by what the Mustafarian priestess Sssl referred to as "molten men." During her attack on the fortress of the Sith Lord Darth Vader with an army of plagued Must…

An RQ protocol droid served the Czerka Corporation aboard the cruiser Leverage. The RQ protocol droid processed the former Czerka slave Rahara Wick after she had been captured on the moon of the planet Pijal.

A Geonosian colony was located on a moon in the galaxy. Long after the Geonosians had abandoned the colony, during the Imperial Era, antiques dealer Antron Bach went into hiding there with a cache of Jedi artifacts he had been entrusted with by Jedi Master Uvell.

The Trustworthy was a starship flown by the pilot Reen and her droid partner Kreven. The two were hired by the Guild of Technicians to transport cargo aboard the vessel, but Kreven sabotaged the thrusters, intending to allow pirates to steal the Trustworthy cargo.

Kreven was a six-armed droid that worked with the pilot Reen. The two were hired by the Guild of Technicians to transport cargo aboard the starship Trustworthy, but Kreven betrayed Reen, intending to sabotage the vessel so that pirates could take the cargo.
The Guild of Technicians was a guild that hired the pilot Reen and her droid partner Kreven to transport cargo aboard the starship Trustworthy.

An enforcer droid served the Chance Encounters casino on the space station known as Station Zeta. After the Jedi Arath Tarrex, who was sent to Station Zeta as a diplomat, gained debts to the casino by cheating, the droid was sent to collect the money from him.

A tactical droid served Count Dooku of the planet Serenno aboard his airship, the Windrunner. When Dooku, a Sith Lord, sent his apprentice Asajj Ventress to find his sister Jenza at Carannia Spaceport, he insisted Ventress take the airship, where she was accompanied by the tac…

A waitress droid served at the Belsallian Cantina on the planet Serenno. When the Sith apprentice Asajj Ventress entered the cantina to search for the Crolute criminal Glute, she used the waitress droid's tray to knock a Khormai patron that had been harassing her unconscious.
A command security droid served Count Gora of the planet Serenno, leading a unit of other security droids. During the funeral of Gora's wife, Countess Anya, Gora had the droids stationed nearby.

During the Galactic Civil War, New Republic General Hera Syndulla's Barma Battle Group bombarded the Galactic Empire's airless garrison world of Verzan. The world had been a fortress that cracked open under the fire from the Lodestar and proton bombs from Alphabet Squadron.

A security droid served as a commander in the droid army of Count Ramil of the planet Serenno. After Ramil orchestrated the takeover of Serenno by Abyssin mercenaries, numerous Serennians fought back, assisted by the Jedi Master Dooku, brother of Ramil.
The incident on Serenno was an invasion of the planet Serenno orchestrated by its Count, Ramil of House Serenno, in 42 BBY. Ramil intended to turn the people of Serenno against the Galactic Republic.

x: At some point the Knights of Ren were hired to raid the penal world of Osseriton. During the raid, the Knights freed prisoners and liberated the dungeon ship known as the Night Buzzard, which they modified to become their own transport.
Woshrikes were a species of dangerous creatures found on the agrarian planet of Ertegas in the Anoat sector. While growing up on Ertegas, Arro Basteren protected his family's crops from woshrikes.

During the time of the Galactic Republic, a summit was held on Station Zeta between the Plinovian and Solodoe species. The Solodoe wished to terraform the planet Plin Minor, which would lead to the destruction of much of the Plinovians' natural habitat.
