x: The Battle of Troithe, also referred to as the attack on Troithe or the battle at Core Nine, was a surprise attack initiated by the New Republic against the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during the Galactic Civil War.

J-6 was a protocol droid who existed during the High Republic Era, belonging to aspiring inventor Avon Sunvale. A repurposed bodyguard droid, she was given to Avon by her mother Ghirra Starros around three years before the girl was sent to Port Haileap.
Gaaten was a planet located in the Garis sector. It was home to an orphanage that became the home of a Force-sensitive girl named Elish in the aftermath of the Clone Wars.
Malloran was an astronomical object in the Malloran system in the Garis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The young girl Elish as well as her mother hailed from Malloran.
A terrestrial planet home to an undeveloped society was the homeworld of the human Everi Chalis, who lived in the ruins of a bombed paper mill prior to the time of the Galactic Empire.
Templemarch was a city on the planet Crucival where the Opaline Creed faction was present in 4 BBY, operating from a cloister outside the city until its fall.

A civilian settlement was located on the planet Vir Aphshire near some hives and orchards. In 0 ABY, after the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry captured the hives and orchards from the Galactic Empire, the rebel Sergeant Fektrin led a scout party to the settlement and det…
Mount Veermok was a mountain on the planet Eriadu located to the north of the Orrineswa River. It was part of the Carrion Spike and was owned by the Tarkin family.
The forty Great Families of the Chiss Ascendancy were a political ruling group of Chiss families within the Aristocra of the Chiss Ascendancy.
The Whirlwind was a Chiss starship part of the Chiss Ascendancy's Expansionary Defense Fleet. It was equipped with engines and could be brought to flight status in half an hour.

Csaplar was the capital city of the planet Csilla and the Chiss Ascendancy. Csilla was the homeworld of the sentient, near-human Chiss species. By the time of the rise of the Galactic Empire, most of the city was located underground, well below Csilla's icy surface.

A mining field was located on the terrestrial astronomical object Thearterra, in the Unknown Regions. In 19 BBY, it had been newly opened. In that year, the Chiss Ascendancy's ruling Mitth and Ufsa families both sought control over the field.

Naporar was a planet in the Chiss Ascendancy and was also the headquarters of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. Naporar contained a medcenter where Mitth'raw'nuruodo underwent physical therapy after the Vagaari pirate operations.

Dioya was a location in the Dioya system in the Unknown Regions. Shortly after the Vagaari pirate operations, Supreme General Ba'kif planned to travel there with Mitth'raw'nuruodo in order to investigate a derelict ship found in the system.
Thearterra was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Unknown Regions' Thearterra system, within the Chiss Ascendancy nation.

Treen was a remote forest moon. The Jedi Padawan Vosa attempted to meditate in the Forest of Tranquility on the moon, but mistakenly sat on a spikeworm nest. Vosa was warned of the nest by a native ape creature, and managed to avoid being attacked by the worm.

The Forest of Tranquility was a forest on the remote moon of Treen. The Jedi Padawan Vosa visited the forest to meditate, but mistakenly sat on the nest of a spikeworm. An alien ape warned Vosa of the danger, saving him from being attacked by the worm.
Lava nymphs were winged creatures that dwelled in groups, living in luminescent hives at the Corvax Fortress during the Imperial Era.

R2-Q2 was an R2-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that was attached to the 501st Legion of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, it was part of the team that boarded the Tantive IV to root out Rebel spies.

The Western Provinces were a region of the Mid Rim planet Naboo. During the Republic Era, the girl Rabene Tonsort hailed from the Western Provinces and spoke in the distinctive accent of those who lived there.

result: Conflict between the Chiss Ascendancy and the Paataatus
x: The attack on Csilla was a battle between the forces of the Chiss Ascendancy and three attacking warships. The attackers were the Paataatus Hiveborn, though they were unidentified at the time of the attack.

A protocol droid served the Alliance to Restore the Republic aboard the cruiser Invincible Faith. In 4 ABY, shortly prior to the Battle of Endor, the protocol droid was in the workshop of a rebel technician for repairs.

The city cemetery of Theed was the main burial area of Naboo's capital city. The Naboo who died in the Battle of Naboo not buried in their family plots were interred there, with the Queen's crest carved on their gravestones.
The Financial District was a district of Coronet City, the capital of Corellia. The Mangrove Hotel was located in the Financial District.
Arch Canyon was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit. Most races opted to travel over the Dune Sea instead of through Arch Canyon, though the Boonta Eve Classic did not.
The Whip was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit.
Bindy Bend was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit.
The Coil was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit.
Jett's Chute was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit. During 32 BBY's Boonta Eve Classic, Anakin Skywalker's podracer's engines overheated in the Jett Chute.

Guildhead's Way was a location on Chandrila. The smuggler Platt Okeefe wrote in the Smuggler's Guide that individuals seeking to smuggle fine oro-weave should ask for Ox-Herder at the Trappist cantina on Guildhead's Way.
Rori was a small moon that orbited the planet Naboo. Before Grizmallti people discovered Naboo, the Elders left behind their statuary on the moon.

Spider-sponges, also written as spider sponges, were a type of flora native to the planet Geonosis. Nests of spider-sponges lived in the air vent tunnel between the power generator hub and the fusion reactor in the Geonosian droid factories in 22 BBY.

objective: Rescue Lobot and sabotage tibanna mining operations
Retrieve the Skywalker lightsaber
Study carbon-freezing
x: Following the Escape from Cloud City, a mission was undertaken to Cloud City by Rebel Alliance members Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, and former Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian.
The Carrion Spike was a location on the Carrion Plateau on the planet Eriadu. It was owned by the Tarkin family. It sat atop a hill and was made out of black volcanic glass.

A planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories was covered in a shallow sea of crystal clear water that featured coral growth. Conquered by the Galactic Empire, it was the site of Horizon Base, a vital Imperial shipping port and refueling station.

result: The Spectres successfully escape with a load of fuel
Chopper is left behind at Horizon Base
objective: Steal fuel for Phoenix Cell
x: The heist at Horizon Base was a mission conducted by the Spectres to steal fuel from the Galactic Empire-controlled Horizon Base for Phoenix Cell in the year 3 BBY.

Oru was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was home to a group of human warriors known as Oruans. The First Order took over the planet and stripped it of its resources, causing Oru to become toxic.
The Oruans, also known as the Oru, were a group of humans native to the planet Oru. A warrior people, the Oruans fought back when their planet was taken over by the First Order.

result: The Oruans promise to provide aid to the Resistance
objective: Recruit the Oruans
x: The Battle for Horizon Base took place during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. It saw the operatives Poe Dameron, Finn, and Gannis Ducain undertake a journey to the outpost of Horizon Base in order to recruit the Oruan resistance group who had fled there aft…
Hangar Five was a hangar on Horizon Base. During a Resistance mission to Horizon Base, Finn asked Poe Dameron to collect him and Gannis Ducain at Hangar Five.
The candori was a tentacled carnivorous creature. Mezlo, the leader of a resistance group of Oruans on Horizon Base, kept at least two candori to fend off First Order forces.
The Tarinna, also known as Critonian story vampires, were a sentient species that fed on experiences and memories.
Rook Minor was a terrestrial astronomical object that hosted the Golden Rocket Bank. The Troig Durl and Dekk worked as security in charge of the bank's vault on Rook Minor.

Magnetic rock chimps were a species of creature that lived in the jungles of the planet Opop Hibbedit. They spoke simplistic Galactic Basic Standard and consumed metal, which they referred to as "popo-nut".
The Ragged Claw was an XS stock light freighter used by the smuggler gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi.

t: Unidentified B1 battle droid lieutenant (Opop Hibbedit)
x: A B1-series battle droid served as a lieutenant in a squad within the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
A B1 battle droid served the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. The battle droid operated under the tactical droid TX-20 during the Battle of Ryloth.
A B1-series battle droid held the rank of sergeant in the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Jafani delegation was a group sent from the planet Jafan to participate in the Chommell sector summit held by Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo. It was headed by Harli Jafan, the daughter of Jafan's planetary director.
Camp three was a prison camp constructed on the planet Naboo by the Trade Federation during its occupation.
A B1-series battle droid served as a sergeant in the Confederacy of Independent Systems' droid army during the Clone Wars.
Sector 11374265 was the designation of an area of the planet Teth, outside the B'omarr Order Monastery.
An OOM command battle droid of the Confederacy of Independent Systems was stationed on the planet Teth, at the B'omarr Order Monastery.
The Bantha Plains were a location on the planet Tatooine. The Plains were located between the Northern Dune Sea and B'omarr Flats and were a sandy region inhabited by wild banthas.

Bildor's Canyon was located on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine. The north entrance of the canyon connected to Tatooine's Desert Valley region and its south entrance led to the North Jundland Wastes region.
Pika Oasis was a location in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. It was near Ben Kenobi's home and the wreckage of the crashed freighter Spice Siren.
Starboard #5 fusion reactor complex was a reactor complex on the starboard wing of the First Order flagship Supremacy. It was located next to Starboard #6 fusion reactor complex.
Starboard #6 fusion reactor complex was a reactor complex located on the starboard wing of the First Order flagship Supremacy. It was next to Starboard #5 fusion reactor complex.

The University of Yabol Opa was a planet-wide university located on the Colonies world Yabol Opa. In 22 BBY, Grand Warden Solokin Sakellar served as the university's absolute ruler and had a lodge on the Galactic Republic capital of Coruscant.

The Wealth Level was one of the eleven levels of Pau City, the capital of Utapau. It contained a number of seawater processing plants that extracted valuable substances from the planet's world-ocean. The level also contained warehouses and factories.

The Hieroprince's Ascension was an event marked by the Opaline Creed, a religious faction based on the Outer Rim world Crucival during the time of the Galactic Empire. The event was based around the Hieroprince, an individual in the Creed's religion.

Zeta was a Z7 series construction droid who was part of a crew tasked to build a settlement on Cro-Akon. When the construction site was raided by slavers, Zeta sacrificed herself to allow fellow droid Z5-TXT to escape with the other droids and organic workers.

The Lok Revenants were a group of pirates that existed during the final decades of the Galactic Republic, led by the Feeorin Nym. The pirates operated along the Corellian Run and the end of the Llanic Spice Run, as well as the Arkanis sector in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Waldo Flats were a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit.
The Waldo Grade was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit on the planet Tatooine, near the Waldo Flats.
A sentient species of ancient insectoids were active in the galaxy following the Battle of Jakku. Navigators known as the Attendants were members of the insectoid species.
The Renown was a Venator-class Star Destroyer utilized by the Galactic Republic and its naval branch, as well as the Open Circle Fleet, during the Clone Wars.
The Fifth Moon of Thrinittik was a terrestrial moon located in the Thrinittik system of the Colonies. It hosted a university library, which was, at some point, partially destroyed during an attack.

Sarjenn Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object with a cold climate located on the edge of the Sarjenn system. During her time studying at the University of Bar'leth, Chelli Aphra embarked on an unsanctioned archaeological expedition to a fortress on Sarjenn Prime.

An Arquitens-class light cruiser served the navy of the Galactic Empire. After the Empire attacked the Son-tuul Pride crime syndicate and confiscated their fortune, the credits were to be transferred to an Imperial vault aboard the Arquitens-class light cruiser.

t: Workshop of the Architects of Vaale
x: The workshop of the Architects of Vaale was a sanctum located beneath the city of Vaale on the planet Dianth.
Tish was a mountainous planet with a stormy climate home to a lightning mining platform crewed by Ugnaughts.

Hetzal Prime, also known simply as Hetzal, was a planet located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet and its system were within the territory of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era, containing a total population of forty billion.

Sesid Traffic Control was an organization that controlled the movements of ships in the planet Sesid's airspace. According to Nien Nunb, the organization would alert the Galactic Empire of suspicious activity immediately.
The Leleen River was a river located on the planet Toydaria. Its average width was 100 meters, although it could become even wider during floods.
The Windswept Lakes were more than a dozen bodies of water that formed at the intersection between the Merchant Mounds of the city of Riar and the surrounding swamps.

A species lived in the caves in Basteel's mountains. The species was black and rather small, and lived in large swarms. During Operation Yellow Moon, Leia Organa and her team were attacked by a swarm, which left each of them with multiple bites.

A volcanic island was located on the planet Sesid. It was near the planet's main island chain, and though the volcano was active, by 4 ABY it had not erupted in five to six years. As part of Operation Yellow Moon, Leia Organa and her team planned to put a beacon on the island.
The Lower Flora Cloud was a location in the Inner Rim Territories. While disguised as a hyperspace scout, Luke Skywalker stated that his ship had been attacked by pirates and damaged by meteorites.

A BX-series droid commando was ordered to transport stolen lightsaber crystal to a ship in a ice mountains on the other side of the planet. However Clone Commander Gree had been assigned to retake the Crystals from the droid, who had hidden them in the canyon.

Lupal was a moon located in a system centered around a dying star. Once home to a highly advanced and cultured civilization, Lupal was rendered inhospitable by the solar flares of its star, and the moon was eventually left uninhabited.

HCT-10 was an excavation droid on the crew of the explorer Fionn Tucat during a mission to the uninhabited moon of Lupal. When the red light emitted by Lupal's dying star drove the Shistavanen crewmember Kordus Vrak mad, he began to attack the rest of the crew.
RF-U5 was an excavation droid that served in the crew of the explorer Fionn Tucat during an expedition to the moon of Lupal.

Obsidia was a storm-wracked moon located in the Unknown Regions. The moon orbited a tempestuous gas giant that was slowly being torn apart by gravitational pressure, which caused Obsidia's orbit to slowly decay and fall toward the planet.
According to legend, the Straits of Hibrath were a location deep within the Unknown Regions. The Sith Lord Darth Caldoth traveled through the Straits of Hibrath to reach the moon Obsidia.
Kizan was a world that housed a number of academics, including students who traveled to Kizan's glass towers to study the philosophies of other cultures.
Bathoris was a frozen moon located in the Bathoris system in the Outer Rim Territories, situated in grid square N-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Athamar was an astronomical object, that, according to legend, was home to the floating laboratory complex of the Sith Lord Darth Caldoth.

The Royal Academy of Arts was a learning institution on the celestial body Atrisia. At one point, the aristocrat Resinu Santhe-Caltra, who was a member of the Santhe family from the Outer Rim Territories astronomical object Lianna, was enrolled at the academy.
Delphon City was a major city located on the planet Delphon in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Bypass Notch was a location on the planet Ryloth.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: During the Operations on Tatooine, the Imperial base Fort Ironhand was attacked by Rebel Alliance forces, which emerged victorious.

t: Attack on the Empire Shuttle Yard
result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: During the Operations on Tatooine, an Imperial base known as the Empire Shuttle Yard was attacked by Rebel Alliance forces, who emerged victorious.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: During the Operations on Tatooine, the Imperial garrison on Tatooine was attacked by Rebel Alliance forces, whom emerged victorious.
CH-33Z was a MSE-6 series repair droid. At one point, the Chadra-Fan Vosa stood atop the MSE series droid at the Day Star Hotel while she spoke to her spy, Faddey.
DFS-311 was a Vulture-class starfighter that served in the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars as part of a starfighter squadron.
Ardee was an astromech droid in service to a human man who claimed to be the Rebel Alliance pilot Luke Skywalker during the Galactic Civil War.
A solif-spider was a species native to the planet Pasaana that could produce silk strands. Many of these silk strands were in the modified WTK-85A interstellar transport called the Bestoon Legacy.

The Implacable was an Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship that was part of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars, which lasted from 22 BBY to 19 BBY and was fought by the Galactic Republic and Separatist Alliance.
The Tide of Progress XII was a Munificent-class star frigate active in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

The fall of Yordain Core was an event which took place at the Yordain Core where the individual Zab, who was eventually a Sergeant in the 61st Mobile Infantry, experienced a struggle for survival and was present for a blessing from a priest-king.
The Highgarden District, or simply Highgarden, was a lightly urbanized district on the planet Troithe.

The Scar of Troithe was a continent on the planet Troithe which had been heavily mined. During the Galactic Civil War the continent was flat and riddled with ravines and canyons, with no resident life.

The Core Nine mining megafacility, or simply Core Nine, was a large, dome-topped, cylinder-shaped deep core drilling site used during the heavy excavating of the Scar of Troithe, a continent on the planet Troithe. Around 5 ABY, Core Nine was the only mining facility remaining.
The Taa Complex was a sublevel greenhouse with rooftop gardens which was located in the Raddakkia Plaza on the planet Troithe, which used a climate emulator.

The Raddakkia Plaza was a public area on the planet Troithe which featured the Taa Complex, a greenhouse with rooftop gardens, and drift platforms which allowed individuals to walk about above the plaza.
After the Clone Wars and Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine's proclamation of the New Order, the Galactic Empire annexed the planet Onderon.

The Thannerhouse District, or simply Thannerhouse, was an urban district on the planet Troithe which bordered with the Thanner Lake, a large reservoir whose presence was clouded by towers, bridges and platforms.

The Gloried Chalice District was a district on the planet Troithe which served as the capital for a thousand years. Following the rise of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, the capital was relocated to the Troithe Planetary Defense Center.

The Troithe Planetary Defense Center, or TPDC, was a militarized area on the planet Troithe. By the Clone Wars, which began in 22 BBY, its barracks and weaponry was abandoned and the defense of Troithe was undertaken by private military companies.
The Old Skybottom District was a populated sector on the planet Troithe which was eighty kilometers south of the main spaceport.
The Web was a district located on the planet Troithe, so named by the locals. The area had many factories, most of which were decommissioned by the Galactic Civil War.

Kellgar Seven was a terrestrial astronomical object on the fringes of the Outer Rim Territories. A cell of the Spice Runners of Kijimi undertook a heist on Kellgar Seven, escaping to Yavin 4, where they became stranded after they killed their traitorous pilot Beke Mon'z.
Setor was a planet located in the Colonies. A number of colonists from Setor settled on the moon Yavin 4, in a settlement referred to as Wetyin's Colony, where they became farmers.

EV-6B6 (Eevee-Sixbeesix), known as Eevee, was a helpful and talkative EV-class droid who originally served the Pyke Syndicate aboard a Moraysian cruiser. The Moraysian cruiser was stolen by the mercenary Ledesmar, and EV-6B6 was thus forced to serve her.

The Zualjinn Syndicate was a criminal organization of spicerunners during the time of the New Republic. They rivaled the Spice Runners of Kijimi, who sent the operative Tomasso to kill the Zualjinn high commander.

Quintil was a frigid planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. Tomasso, an operative of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, was stranded on Quintil after successfully eliminating the high commander of the Zualjinn Syndicate.

Yungbrii was a cold and rocky planet in the Opalok system of the Far Xandil sector in the Mid Rim. It had a sparse population, including humans, who were mostly unconcerned with galactic affairs. The planet also had a meager defense force.

Garsath were massive and aggressive space-faring creatures. A group of Spice Runners of Kijimi attempting to escape the Zualjinn Syndicate by hyperspace skipping encountered a garsath along the Davezra Way.
Moraysians were a species of tan, stout humanoids from the Moraysi system. They were skilled inventors and builders of starships, and had an ability to actualize their schematics.
A Moraysian cruiser was utilized by the Pyke Syndicate. The Moraysian cruiser, along with its complement of droids, was stolen by Ledesmar, a mercenary formerly enslaved by the Pykes.
Lurkers were a non-sentient amphibious species of carrion eaters native to the planet Judakann, in the Torch Nebula. The Rokana Raiders pirate group made a stew from Lurker meat.
Shownar was a terrestrial planet in the Shownar system in the Parmic sector of the Outer Rim Territories, located near the Torch Nebula. The nebula was visible at night from the surface of Shownar.

Elkeenar was a rocky wasteland planet located in the Penagosis system in Wild Space, in grid square K-21 of the Standard Galactic Grid. While a member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, Poe Dameron visited the Marimkes Mountains on Elkeenar with Tomasso.

The Marimkes Mountains were a mountain range on the planet Elkeenar. They had stairs carved in stone that led up to a rock hut. The mountains were the only notable landmark on the planet, which was otherwise a wasteland.

Guat'a was a barren planet located in the Outer Rim Territories near the Torch Nebula, and a haven for many criminal types. The Spice Runners of Kijimi undertook a heist on Guat'a, stealing from the warlord Smaatku.

Alshuey Town was a town and trading post on the planet Guat'a. The town was small with old and worn down buildings, including a social club called Rugova's, which served as the base of operations for the warlord Smaatku.

Fiumarians were a sentient species from the Fiumar system in the Core Worlds with pale pink skin, pupilless eyes, a sloping forehead, and yellow blood. They were deceptively fast and could remain neutral in heated negotiations, making them adept diplomats or smugglers.

Gordelians were a large, bloated, and slow-moving sentient species hailing from the Nishmar system, on the fringe of the Unknown Regions. They were often considered lazy and rarely seen away from their homeworld.
The "Purple Ones" were an alien species native to a planet. Unable to speak basic or use blasters, many were enslaved by Krastic Tarta, slavemaster of the Arkanian Dawn.
During the Galactic Civil War, a rebellion against the Galactic Empire occurred on the planet Andelm IV, backed by members of the Rebel Alliance.

Zeva Bliss's Centurion-class battlecruiser served the leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. Zeva Bliss used the battlecruiser to travel to the planet Judakann and collect her daughter Zorii Bliss and Poe Dameron and take to Kijimi as full members of the Spice Runners.

The Vondel was a G9 Rigger-class light freighter owned by the smuggler and enslaver Alfris Sotin. During a deal where Sotin betrayed the Spice Runners of Kijimi, Spice Runners Zorii Bliss and Poe Dameron stole the Vondel, and their cell of the gang continued to use the freighter.

The Osako pirates were a pirate organization active during the era of the New Republic. After Poe Dameron joined the Spice Runners of Kijimi, Dameron's father Kes Dameron and his friend L'ulo L'ampar made a deal with the Osako pirates to find him.
Krystar was a planet inhabited by a population of Ovissians. During the Clone Wars, the planet was a part of the Galactic Republic, represented by Vishar Koss and led by Regent Queb.

objective: Determine whether clone troopers were being held prisoner
x: The Galactic Republic undertook a mission on Krystar during the early Clone Wars in 22 BBY. The mission saw the 212th Attack Battalion's Ghost Company and at least one member of the 104th Battalion travel to the planet Krystar after Senator Padmé Amidala was given information …
TRK-R was a loader droid who worked in a settlement on the planet Serelia during the time of the Galactic Empire, transporting cargo using a landspeeder.

The Springhawk was a heavy cruiser of the Chiss Ascendancy navy that was commanded by Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo. After the Vagaari pirate operations, command of the ship was temporarily taken away from Thrawn, though he regained control soon after.
The Vigilant was a kilometer long Chiss Nightdragon man-of-war commanded by Admiral Ar'alani of the Chiss Ascendancy.
The Paataatus were a sentient species with a swarm mentality. The Chiss Ascendancy led an attack on numerous Paataatus fighters above the Paataatus homeworld, Nettehi.

Nettehi was a planet located in the Unknown Regions' Nettehi system, which was located within Holy Paataatus space. The planet was the homeworld and hive-home of the Paataatus sentient species, and their government of the Paataatus Hiveborn.
Weltflies were creatures that stung their enemies. Although a weltfly's sting was not dangerous alone, a large number of them could be.

The attack on the Paataatus was a retaliatory strike conducted by the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet on Nettehi, the homeworld of the Paataatus species, shortly after an attack on the Chiss homeworld of Csilla around 19 BBY.

Nikarduns were a sentient species found in the Unknown Regions. General Yiv was a Nikardun. The Nikardun government was the Nikardun Destiny. At the time of the Clone Wars, it began to invade a number of nearby societies. General Yiv was thwarted by Thrawn.

Arch-E was a navigator droid who worked with the smuggler Jayko, and was also able to play the drums. Arch-E and Jayko were present in a cantina when the smuggler's former crewmate Tan entered, thanking Jayko for writing about him in his book, A Smuggler's Life.

An OOM command battle droid served in the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. The OOM command battle droid was one of many battle droids dispatched during the Separatist siege of Hisseen.

x: The incident on Quintil, also known as the skirmish with the Zualjinn, was a skirmish that occurred between the Spice Runners of Kijimi and the rival Zualjinn Syndicate on the planet Quintil during the time of the New Republic.

The heist on Kellgar Seven was a heist mission undertaken on the astronomical object Kellgar Seven by a cell of the smuggler gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi. The group, led by Vigilch, succeeded in executing the heist, escaping to the moon Yavin 4.

A skirmish broke out on the planet Yungbrii between the Spice Runners of Kijimi and the New Republic. A group of Spice Runners, including the Klatooinian Vigilch, sought refuge from New Republic starships on Yungbrii, and became cornered in the Trune family farm.
By 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry fought a battle on Cartao, a terrestrial astronomical object in the Expansion Region.
Y'ness was a moon located in the N'zoth system of the Core Worlds on which a variety of kyber crystal known as kimber stones could be found.

Hadros was a planet of the Outer Rim Territories that was rich in ore deposits. Supposedly, at some point after the year 29 ABY, Ambassador Slokin blackmailed the ambassador of Hadros into providing him access to the ore deposits of Hadros, which had not yet been claimed by th…

Routh was a planet where the Achinios weed, a plant that was used to create a type of poison, could be found. The ambassador Slokin supposedly acquired a poison derived from the Achinios weed of Routh, which he used to kill his superior, Gorson.
A protocol droid served the government official Gorson. According to myth, when Ambassador Slokin, who worked under Gorson, met with his superior, the protocol droid was sent to provide refreshments.

The Exactor was a Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire. Supposedly, the Imperial officer Alger Denholm served aboard the vessel. After Denholm's superior, Lieutenant Marsden, was killed by Darth Vader, Denholm was promoted, but began to go mad, seeing visions of Marsden's death.
Basath was an ice moon located in the Basath system of the galaxy's Colonies that was supposedly liberated by the Jedi Master Nil Idyth.
Ixilix was a planet upon which, according to legend, Jedi Master Nil Idyth was killed by an assassin. Idyth's belongings were eventually recovered from Ixilix by a Jedi Order team.
Eremond, known as the Sanctic moon, was a terrestrial moon located in the Deep Core. The Jedi Knight Sol Mogra supposedly quashed an uprising on Eremond.

The Thikkiiana spaceport was a spaceport located in Thikkiiana on Kashyyyk. The hunter Tyro Viveca visited the Thikkiiana spaceport by 10 BBY. Viveca recorded the visit in the Smuggler's Guide, attributing the port's cleanliness and efficiency to the rule of the Galactic Empire.

Pundith was the central city on a subtropical peninsula of the world of Kizan, consisting of glass towers. The city was supposedly destroyed by the Sith Lord Darth Caldoth in order to attract the attention of the Jedi Order and lure Jedi Master Bran Ath'Morath to Kizan.

The Steady Wing was a Star Cruiser used by the Galactic Republic and Jedi Order. During the High Republic Era, it set out from Port Haileap, intending to carry its passengers, including young Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh, her charge Avon Starros, Padawan Imri Cantaros and Dalnan…
Port Haileap was a spaceport and outpost located on the planet Haileap during the High Republic Era. Its marshal was Jedi Master Douglas Sunvale.
Wevo, formally designated Moon Two-Three-One-Two-Three-Four, was a terrestrial moon in the Haileap system covered in wild jungle terrain which orbited the double gas giants Neralus and Nixus.

A maintenance droid operated at the outpost of Port Haileap during the High Republic Era. Around the year 232 BBY, during the High Republic Era, the maintenance droid was present near the starship Steady Wing, which was scheduled to transport a delegation, including Dalnan Amb…
The Otoh Villages were a series of bubbles that radiated out from the center of the city of Otoh Gunga. Most of the city's Gungan population lived and worked in the Otoh Villages.
Arnthout was a location in Tatooine's Jundland Wastes. Luke Skywalker once passed through Arnthout on his way to Ben Kenobi's home.
Caviness IV was a terrestrial astronomical object home to a district controlled by the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate. The district was bombed in an attack by the rival Mourner's Wail Syndicate.
A district of the astronomical object Caviness IV was controlled by the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate. It was attacked in a bombing by the rival Mourner's Wail Syndicate.
Nozho was a city-state on the planet Bith, homeworld of the sentient Bith species. Around three centuries before the Galactic Civil War, Nozho entered a civil war with the city-state of Weogar.

Weogar was a city-state located on the homeworld of the sentient Bith species, the planet Bith. Weogar entered into a short-lived civil war with Nozho, another city-state on Bith, around three centuries before the Galactic Civil War.

The Brentaal Futures Program was a part of the Republic Futures Program that operated on Brentaal. Galen Walton Erso was a member of the Program, and once received top honors at its materials competition.

a: Battle at the Tomb of Padmé Amidala

x: The Taung were an ancient sentient species of the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. The day of Taungsday was named for the species. The beskad, a traditional Mandalorian sword, was based on an ancient Taung design.

Jubilar was an astronomical object in the Jubilar system in the Jubilar sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square T-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was used as a prison by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Aparian Wastes was a rocky area on the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno. Just before the Clone Wars, the Spike, a vast underground prison, was constructed there by the Confederacy of Independent Systems to hold highly valuable prisoners that Count Dooku wanted to inter…

Kway Teow was the sprawling capital city of the planet Felucia. The Commerce Guild had a large presence in the city, with their headquarters located just outside. Kway Teow was originally built using Felucian laborers aided financially by Gossam.
Har Gau was a major city on the planet Felucia.
Jiaozi was a major city located on the jungle planet Felucia.
Niango was a major city situated on the jungle planet Felucia.
The Leewau Cluster was a major city on the planet Utapau, consisting of four narrow sinkholes interconnected by tunnels and surface crevasses.

The Duo Relay Race was a racing event hosted at the Taqual racing pit on the planet Utapau. The race involved dactillion riders guiding their beasts from the top of the sinkhole to the bottom, where they would hand over to varactyl riders for a race back to the surface.

Big Settlement was a major town located in Atterra Bravo's Firestone Islands. The settlement was composed of a number of saltstone homes and a large hydrofarm, which helped to provide its water. When the First Order occupied Atterra Bravo, the settlement became a ghost town.
Stinging midges were small creatures that lived in the jungles of D'Qar, near the Resistance base. Rose Tico was a wary of them.

The Imperial Trench was a part of Ilum where the Galactic Empire gouged out a large portion of the planet as part of their mining operations of the planet's kyber crystals. It was visible from orbit by 14 BBY.
The Atterra Belt was an asteroid field located in the Atterra system in the Outer Rim Territories' Kanz sector, along the Veragi Trade Route.
The Oteroan Sky was a massive refinery ship built by OteroaCorp. It was larger than an Imperial-class Star Destroyer, and could hold more than three dozen freighters at one time.
Oteroa Zero-Twenty was the twentieth city produced by OteroaCorp to assist their orbiting refinery ship, The Oteroan Sky, from the ground.

The Oteroan Sky crash site was the location where the refinery ship The Oteroan Sky crashed into the planet Dathomir after being sabotaged by the Nardithi Nightsisters. The ship crashed directly into the city of Oteroa Zero-Twenty, destroying the majority of it.
COO-2180 was a COO-series cook droid who served meals to passengers aboard the refugee transport Jendirian Valley during the time of the Galactic Republic.

Rentor was a terrestrial planet in the Unknown Regions, located within the backwater areas of the Chiss Ascendancy nation. The planet was neither a political nor cultural hub of the Chiss species despite its proximity to the Ascendancy's capital planet Csilla.
The Tomra was a Chiss Defense Force Transport of the Defense Fleet of the Chiss Ascendancy, commanded by Junior Captain Vorlip. Ali'astov served as an ozyly-esehembo aboard the vessel.

result: The Oteroan Sky crashes into Dathomir, destroying Oteroa Zero-Twenty
x: Sometime before the Clone Wars, the refinery ship The Oteroan Sky was sabotaged by the Nardithi Nightsisters, causing it to crash into the city of Oteroa Zero-Twenty on the planet Dathomir and destroying it.

Tagge's mercenaries were a mercenary unit who served Ronen Tagge, scion of the powerful House of Tagge. During his search for the Rings of Vaale, Tagge sent his mercenaries to pursue the crew of the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra.
Bog Bay was a collection of landing pads located in the Toydarian city of Riar. The pads were owned by the Gorensla kajidic and were built just above the water of a nearby swamp.
The Gorensla kajidic was one of several Hutt clans that ran criminal operations in the galaxy. Many of Gorensla's activities were based on Toydaria, especially in the city of Riar.
Between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, a battle between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems as part of the Clone Wars took place in the Mid Rim's Ruusan system.
RT-3PO was a silver-plated protocol droid that worked at Walisi's Elegant and Exotic Artifacts. It was bought assist in negotiation, but was also a very skilled auctioneer.

Wrecker's Mercenaries were a group of mercenaries led by Wrecker. They were active in the Toydarian city of Riar. At one point, they were hired by the Nightsisters Jerserra to kidnap the Toydarian merchant Walisi and steal the Tragic Hope, a statue that he planned to sell.
The siluuk eel was a species of eel found on the planet Toydaria. The eels were larger than a Toydarian, and were farmed in huge numbers in the city of Arnel.

The sprantal was an amphibian native to the planet Dathomir. Sprantal were massive amphibians with thick hides, long legs, and longer necks. They were typically a deep mottled-green color that helped camouflage them, particularly underwater.
Belonuks were creatures native to the planet Dathomir. They were dangerous predators that possessed sharp claws and teeth and powerful, bony heads with which they could ram prey.

objective: Rescue Grand Master Yoda
Test Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker
x: In 26 BBY during the Republic Era, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker were deployed to rescue Grand Master Yoda of the Jedi Order.
Ronen Tagge's Private Penthouse also called Tagge Pavilion was the residence of Ronen Tagge, scion of the powerful House of Tagge.
The Assertor was an Assertor-class Star Dreadnought of the Galactic Empire, serving the Imperial Navy as the lead starship of its class.

The Wrath was an Assertor-class Star Dreadnought within the navy of the Galactic Empire. Both the Wrath and its sister ship, the Assertor, were laid down for construction at Kuat Drive Yards' Kuat shipyards before the Battle of Yavin.

Xorrn was a terrestrial planet located in the Xorrn system of the Ferra sector, deep within the southern Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A young world, Xorrn's recently-cooled crust provided access to mineral resources within the magma below.
The Old Mandalorians were one of three splinters of Mandalorian society following the Great Clan Wars, the others being the New Mandalorians and Death Watch.
The Sentinel was an Acclamator-class assault ship that was part of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Dauntless was a VT-49 Decimator in service to the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. At one point, it flew near a nebula.

Atale was a red-colored moon that orbited the planet Empress Teta in the Empress Teta system. Like the rest of its star system, it was situated in the Koros sector, a part of the Deep Core and the Interior regions, and was located in the grid square L-10 of the Standard Galact…
The Warhawk was a Raider I-class corvette that served alongside the Sargantuan and the Blood Ambition in the navy of the Galactic Empire. It was a part of the task force led by Captain Ralchio Nervi.

The Simoom was a Maelstrom-class battle cruiser. It shared its name with the Mid Rim's Simoom system. The Simoom initially served the Galactic Republic until it was reformed into the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, when the Galactic Republic Navy resultantly became the Imperial Navy.
The Maelstrom was the lead Maelstrom-class battle cruiser of the Galactic Republic's navy in the time of the Clone Wars, which took place between 22 BBY and 19 BBY.
The Battle of Kromus was a battle sometime between 22 BBY and 19 BBY in the vicinity of the Mid Rim's Kromus system.
The Battle of Cularin was a battle that occurred in the vicinity of the Cularin system, a star system in the Expansion Region, that occurred sometime between 22 BBY and 19 BBY.
BB-BOO20 was a BB-series astromech droid that had a orange, green, and silver body, with a black sensor. The droid resided on the dunes of Pasaana amongst the native Aki-Aki.
Vlemoth Port was a terrestrial backwater planet located in the Instrop sector's Vlemoth Port system of the southern corner of the Slice in the Outer Rim Territories.

Uvena Prime, also known as Uvena, was a planet that was the homeworld of the Shistavanen species. Located in the Uvena system in the Seswenna sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a world of forested continents and vast oceans.
Lanturi was a major city located on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Kowak.
Caden was a major city located on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Kowak.

A Pelta-class frigate was used by the Rebel Alliance at some moment during the Galactic Civil War. The Pelta-class frigate was modified to the specifications of another Pelta-class, the flagship Phoenix Home.

Andasala was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Andasala system in the Cor'ric sector of the Outer Rim Territories where a large skirmish between Void Wings and the Night Fangs occured during the reign of the Galactic Empire, leaving ony a single survivor.

The Offworlders' Block was located on Panna's Redwater moon. After being hired to deliver a shipment of Jovaninan gorefruit to the moon, the smuggler Platt Okeefe noted in the Smuggler's Guide logbook that she felt good about the job because she had wished to revisit a chance …
Merchant Mound Three was one of the three hills that comprised Riar's Merchant Mounds. The Merchant-Baron's mansion was located at the base of the Mound.

The Brodihi were a sentient species that had a pair of horns and a long snout. Artifacts of the Brodihi were recovered by the Chiss Ascendancy from a wrecked starship and displayed in an art gallery, though the Chiss did not know the beings' exact origins.

The Scofti were a sentient species from the Unknown Regions planet Bardram Scoft. The species underwent frequent changes in its leading Prefects and governmental regimes; transitions were often violent or motivated by the threat of violence.
The Tireless Wanderer was a SoroSuub Luxury 3000 space yacht. It was bought used by Yeel Dresk from a scam artist, and crash-landed on Toydaria soon after his purchase.
Foundry Four, located beneath the surface of the planet Xorrn, was a warren of five separate underground droid factories created by the Geonosians, which were joined by a central command center.

The Acquisition Division was an organization within the Jedi Order that was active by the time around the Jedi-Sith War. According to old records, the ancient Jedi Master Morrit Ch'gally created the discipline of Jedi Sentinel while a member of the Acquisition Division.

The Exchequer was a starship of the Galactic Empire under the command of Moff Boyse. It served as the flagship of the Imperial Navy's blockade of the planet Scipio and, along with Imperial advisors, ensured that the Core Five, the ruling council of the InterGalactic Banking Cl…
The Karazak Slavers' Cooperative, abbreviated KSC, was an enslaver organization active during the time of the Galactic Empire.

The Architects' Mausoleum was a crypt located beneath the city of Vaale on the planet Dianth. It was the final resting place of the Ring of Fortune, one of the Rings of Vaale, artifacts created by the Architects of Vaale.

The Sargantuan was a Raider I-class corvette that served the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of a task force led by Captain Ralchio Nervi that participated in the Battle of Xorrn.

The Blood Ambition was a Gladiator I that served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. It was captained by Ralchio Nervi and was the flagship of a task force that fought in the Battle of Xorrn.

The Battle of Xorrn was a battle on the planet Xorrn and in orbit during the Galactic Civil War between an allied group that was composed of Old Mandalorians, the Rebel Alliance, and the Clan Assembly against a naval task force and a ground invasion force of the Galactic Empire.

The Imperial Science Bureau, also known as the Imperial science corps, was a scientific bureau within the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. The organization was composed of several different subdivisions and answered to an individual with the title of scientific minister.

A super tactical droid commanded droid forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems at a weapons depot during the Clone Wars. The Galactic Republic sent a squad of clone trooper deserters to destroy the weapons depot.

Melagawni was a rocky astronomical object in the Melagawni system in the Likasha sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was host to a city and a weapons depot of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

t: Assault on a Separatist weapons depot
objective: Destroy the Separatist weapons depot
x: During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic carried out an assault on a weapons depot of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The mission was assigned by Clone Commander Wolffe to a squad of clone trooper deserters led by Heater.

The Haunted Lands were a region of the planet Dathomir that surrounded Oteroa Zero-Twenty. The region was extremely odd: mysterious lights were often seen, strange noises were common, and angry spirits were often spoken of.
The vursonk was a scavenger native to the planet Dathomir. Vursonks had six tentacles and eyes on both sides of their bodies.

Arumorut was a Mandalorian settlement located on the Outer Rim world of Vlemoth Port. A portion of Clan Awaud was based in the city, having grown tired of the factional conflicts that had become commonplace on Mandalore.
The Singing Mountain was a mountain on Dathomir.

The Jedi Temple's training gallery was a training room in the Jedi Temple used by the Jedi Order. In 26 BBY, Padawan Anakin Skywalker was tasked with training against Marksman-H training remotes in the gallery with only a wooden training sword.
The Gladius was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle of the Galactic Empire that participated in a mission to Hosnian Prime to recover Imperial Security Bureau Agent Thorn from an orbital outpost.
A therii was a large herding creature that could be found on the planet Batuu. Elee was a therii that was the pet of Black Spire Outpost resident Salju.

objective: Recover Agent Thorn
x: Following the Battle of Endor, the Galactic Empire's Titan Squadron undertook a mission to the planet Hosnian Prime to recover Agent Thorn from an orbital outpost.

Krishels were a type of strong, hardshelled, burrowing quadruped native to the Outer Rim volcanic planet Mustafar. They were hunted by the sentient Mustafarians native to the world, who tracked them through seemingly endless subterranean labyrinths of tunnels and caverns.

Tidros was the capital city of the planet Champala, homeworld of the sentient Chagrian species. Like all Chagrian settlements, it was built within a tidal zone of one of the planet's oceans, meaning it was regularly entirely submerged by rising tides.
Cinnagar was the capital city of the planet Empress Teta. An ecumenopolis, Cinnagar's cityscape covered the entire surface, and some came to know the name of the planet as the name of the city.
The Impetuous was a Raider-class corvette that served the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At one point, the corvette, alongside a TIE Advanced x1, passed over a blue celestial body.

The Instigator was a Raider-class corvette that served the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. The 150-meter-long corvette featured sublight engines and five twin laser cannons. At one point, the Instigator traveled through asteroids.
The Assailer was a Raider-class corvette that, during the Imperial Era, formed part of the Imperial Navy. The corvette boasted sublight engines and measured 150 meters in length.
The Victorum was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

The sky-walker corps was the navigation group that administered the ozyly-esehembos of the Chiss Ascendancy. While ozyly-esehembos of the corps and their caregivers often accompanied the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet on journeys, both were considered civilians.

Sector I-9 was a region of the Coruscant Underworld. Level 1325 was part of it, as was the portal warehouse Hangar 18. In 19 BBY, the fugitive ARC trooper Fives was tracked to the sector while he was on the run after being framed for attacking Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.

The Deathless was a Nikardun Battle Dreadnought that served as the flagship of General Yiv, and the mobile headquarters of the Nikardun Destiny. Yiv oversaw the expansion of the Destiny from the ship's throne room.
The Parala was a patrol ship commanded by Senior Captain Irizi'ar'alani "Ziara" of the Chiss Ascendancy.
The Ruleri were a part of the government of the Garwian Unity, the nation of the Garwian species.

The Vagaari were a sentient species that resided in the Unknown Regions and would modify technology of the alien species they conquered. The species put their prisoners in pods on their warships' hulls to discourage counterattacks.

Rapacc was a planet located in the Rapacc system of the Unknown Regions, home to the Paccosh species. Its capital city was Boropacc. During the Nikardun conquests, it was blockaded by General Yiv of the Nikardun Destiny.
The Paccosh, also known as the Pacc, were a sentient species from the planet Rapacc. The Paccosh held females of their own and other species in high, almost venerated, regard.
The Marocsaa subclan was a Paccosh clan. Its members included Uingali foar Marocsaa.
The Pathfinders were a group of Force-sensitive navigators, and one of several such groups who worked for the Navigators' Guild.
Bardram Scoft was a planet located in the Unknown Regions. It was home to the Scofti, whose government changed frequently, often with a violent transition.

Primea was a planet located in the Primea system, and the capital of the Vak Combine. It was home to the Vak species. General Yiv of the Nikardun Destiny sought to conquer the planet, leaving warships in orbit and meeting with the planetary leaders.

The Vaks were a sentient species that hailed from the planet Primea in the Unknown Regions. Their government was known as the Vak Combine. They had pale-amber skin, stubby black hair, and dull brown eyes. Neighboring powers often claimed the Combine was unable to make decisions.

Schesa was a terrestrial planet in the Unknown Regions, situated in the Schesa system near the edge of the Chiss Ascendancy. It was a major Chiss world. Pirates connected to the Lioaoin Regime attacked shipping off of Schesa and Pesfavri.
Pesfavri was a planet located in the Pesfavri system within the Unknown Regions' Chiss Ascendancy. It was situated in grid square G-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Kinoss was a planet located in the Kinoss system of the Unknown Regions. It was situated within the borders of the Chiss Ascendancy.

Urch was a terrestrial world located in the Urch system of the Unknown Regions. It was the homeworld of the Urchiv-ki species and the capital of their nation, the Tower Dimension. Space traffic around Urch was controlled by Urch Planetary and Space Control.

The Urchiv-ki were a sentient species from the Unknown Regions planet Urch. The Urchiv-ki's nation was the Tower Dimension, one of several governments under the control of General Yiv and the Nikardun Destiny, the Hegemony of the Nikardun species, in 19 BBY.

The Lioaoin heartworld, also known as Lioaoi, was a planet home to the Lioaoi and the capital of the Lioaoin Regime. It was situated near a gravity well. From space, it appeared green, blue, and white.
The Lioaoi, also known as the Lioaoin, were a sentient species who hailed from the Lioaoin heartworld in the Unknown Regions. They were allies of General Yiv's Nikardun Destiny.
Solitair was a planet in the Solitair system of the Unknown Regions, home to the Garwian species. It was the capital of the species' government, the Garwian Unity.
The Garwians were a sentient species that hailed from the Unknown Regions planet Solitair. Their government was the Garwian Unity, which ruled Solitair and five colony worlds including Stivic.
Stivic was a colony world of the Garwians located in the Stivic system of the Unknown Regions. Like other Garwian Unity worlds, it was a commerce center for a number of species.
Vector One was one of the group of navigators who worked with the Navigators' Guild in the Unknown Regions and could be identified by tattoos on their faces.

Avidich was a terrestrial planet of the Chiss Ascendancy, located in the Unknown Regions. After a majority of the population of the Chiss capital of Csilla were forced offworld by changes in the planet's climate, Avidich was one of the planets they were sent to.

Sarvchi was a planet in the Sarvchi system, a star system that lay in the eastern part of Chiss Space in the Unknown Regions. A number of Chiss migrated to Sarvchi after the climate of the species' homeworld, Csilla, grew less habitable.

Colonial Station Camco, also known as Colonial Station Cam'co, was a terrestrial planet located within the Colonial Station Camco system of the Chiss Ascendancy's Chiss Space in the Unknown Regions. It was situated in grid square F-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Jamiron was a planet in the Jamiron system in Chiss Space within the Unknown Regions. Mitth'ali'astov undertook her formal schooling on Jamiron. It was home to several major manufactories, at least one of which was owned by the Ascendancy's Clarr family.

The Destrama was a Chiss warship that served as the flagship of Commodore Ar'alani after her promotion to Commodore, and prior to her being given command of the Vigilant. The Destrama was part of Picket Force Six and present for the skirmish above Solitair.

The Void Guides were a group of Force-sensitive navigators, and one of several such groups who worked for the Navigators' Guild. Their members had gray skin, were marked by green, red, and blue tattoo scars on their temples, and wore dark-red utilitarian jumpsuits.

The Grayshrike was a Chiss heavy cruiser in service to the Chiss Ascendancy's Expansionary Defense Fleet. It served as part of Picket Force Six under Admiral Ar'alani and was commanded by Senior Captain Lakinda.

The Whisperbird was a light cruiser in service to the Chiss Ascendancy's Expansionary Defense Fleet. In 19 BBY, it served as part of Picket Force Six under Admiral Ar'alani and assisted in defeating forces of the Nikardun Destiny nation and their leader, General Yiv, at a batt…
The Stingfly was a light cruiser in service to the Chiss Ascendancy's Expansionary Defense Fleet. The vessel was equipped with a hyperdrive, engines, and various weapons for combat.

The Boco was a patrol ship in service to the Chiss Ascendancy's Expansionary Defense Fleet. It served under the command of Senior Commander Mitth'raw'nuru during a rescue of a luxury passenger liner that was descending into a gas giant planet, during which time it was Thrawn's…

Fen slugs were a type of slug known to the Chiss Ascendancy. In 19 BBY, while flying in one of the shuttles of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet heavy cruiser Springhawk during a mission in the Unknown Regions Rapacc system, the Chiss Mitth'ali'astov, core name "Thalias," c…
Flashflies were a type of creature capable of flight. Around 19 BBY, the Chiss sky-walker Che'ri drew pictures of flashflies and birds with markers.

Hop-toads were a type of toad known to the Chiss species in the Unknown Regions. Around 19 BBY, when explaining to the sky-walker navigator Che'ri why some caregivers had to leave the sky-walkers they cared for, caregiver Mitth'ali'astov, core name "Thalias," stated it could b…
The Jedi Sentinels were a group of Jedi that preferred working directly with the everyday citizens of the galaxy as opposed to contemplative meditation and study within the confines of a Jedi Temple.
Ready Room Two was a ready room located on the Chiss heavy cruiser Springhawk of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet.
DFS-081 was a Vulture-class starfighter that served in the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars. At one point, DFS-081 was visibly damaged while flying in an atmosphere.

DBS-404 was a Hyena-class Droid Bomber that served in the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars. At one point, DBS-404 was damaged while in a battle on Geonosis and conducted a suicidal run on a Galactic Republic All Terrain Tactical Enforcer after its preservation protoco…
DBS-32C was a Hyena-class Droid Bomber that served in the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars. At one point, DBS-32C flew near a Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel in space.
DIS-T81 was a droid tri-fighter that served in the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars. At one point, DIS-T81 attacked a Galactic Republic Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor in space.
A gas giant planet was located in the Unknown Regions and had three sets of orbital planetary rings and a thick, roiling atmosphere.
An excursion liner was owned by the Chiss Ascendancy's Boadil family, one of the Ascendancy's Nine Ruling Families, and captained by a member of the Ruling Ufsa family.
Urch Planetary and Space Control was an organization that controlled space traffic around the Unknown Regions planet Urch, the capital of the Tower Dimension nation.

The Regime Diplomatic Office was a branch of the Lioaoin Regime that was responsible for diplomacy. After being attacked by at Urchiv-ki in the presence of a Lioaoi warship, the Vigilant and the diplomat Boadil'par'gasoi contacted the Diplomatic Office.
A weapons inspection droid served in BG-RT's Tavern and Spirits, a cantina on Level 1313 of the planet Coruscant collecting weapons from those that entered the establishment.

Patrol Four was a Chiss patrol ship stationed at Taharim Academy on Naporar. Mitth'raw'nuruodo proved that he had not cheated on a flight simulator by flying against Patrol Four and three other ships.
Patrol One was a Chiss patrol ship stationed at Taharim Academy on Naporar. Mitth'raw'nuruodo proved that he had not cheated on a flight simulator by flying against Patrol One and three other ships.

Patrol Three was a Chiss patrol ship stationed at Taharim Academy on Naporar. Mitth'raw'nuruodo proved that he had not cheated on a flight simulator by flying against Patrol Three and three other ships.
Patrol Two was a Chiss patrol ship stationed at Taharim Academy on Naporar. Mitth'raw'nuruodo proved that he had not cheated on a flight simulator by flying against Patrol Two and three other ships.
Shadow Number One was the designation of a hole made in the solar wind of the Unknown Regions' Rapacc system by one of its two gas giant planets.
Shadow Number Two was the designation of a hole made in the solar wind of the Unknown Regions' Rapacc system by one of its two gas giant planets.
A protocol droid served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
The Heavy Weapons Clone Trooper, also simply known as the Heavy Gunner or Heavy Trooper, was a specialized clone trooper that provided infantry with heavy firepower and anti-vehicle support.

Remembrance parties were events hosted in the Unknown Regions Garwian Unity nation on the holiday of Mid Spring. Attendees of remembrance parties wore clothing that incorporated features from various periods in Garwian history.
By 1 BBY, the Galactic Empire had blockaded the world of Kubindi and enslaved its native Kubaz species at some point after the declaration of the Rebel Alliance.

The Kimbples were a group that lived on the Unknown Regions Garwian Unity planet of Solitair. Before 19 BBY, they planned to host a remembrance party—a Garwian event where participants competed to create the most intricate outfit using clothing from throughout Garwian history—…
A skirmish took place on Arbiflux when Minister Pitina Mar-Mas Voor hired three bounty hunters to pursue the rogue archaeologist Chelli Lona Aphra.

t: Attack on the edge of the Dioya system
x: The attack on the edge of the Dioya system was an incident that occurred shortly after two Paccosh refugee starships escaped from their homeworld of Rapacc while it was under blockade by General Yiv of the Nikardun Destiny.

objective: Investigate the origin point of two refugee starships
x: The mission to the Rapacc system was undertaken by Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy in order to investigate the point of origin of a refugee starship that had been destroyed by the Nikardun Destiny in Chiss territory.

result: Chiss Ascendancy capture a Nikardun blockade frigate
x: The raid on Rapacc, also known as the Rapacc attack, was a battle orchestrated by Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy in order to capture a blockade frigate of the Nikardun Destiny in the Rapacc system.

Send an ambassador to Urch
x: The Urch incident was a confrontation that arose out of a Chiss Ascendancy diplomatic mission to the planet Urch, capital of the Urchiv-ki, with whom the Ascendancy had a treaty.

result: Vigilant rescues Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo and escapes
x: The attack at Primea, also called the Primea incident, was a skirmish between the Chiss Ascendancy and forces controlled by the Nikardun Destiny above the Vak homeworld of Primea.

The Lioaoin skirmish was an attack launched by the Chiss Ascendancy on the heartworld of the Lioaoin Regime. The attack was in response to a Lioaoin attack against the Chiss warship Vigilant at Primea, which had been orchestrated by General Yiv of the Nikardun Destiny.

The battle over Primea was the ultimate event in the Chiss Ascendancy's intervention in the conquests of the Nikardun Destiny. Taking place above the Vak homeworld of Primea, the battle was orchestrated by Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Ascendancy.

The Cron Supernova was a supernova that took place in the Cron Cluster. According to the Qel-Droma Epics, the supernova was triggered by the Sith Lord Naga Sadow, and the Jedi-controlled planet Ossus was devastated by the event.

The Ysanna were a humanoid race who resided in the wastelands of the planet Ossus. They wore tribal masks and depended on the native kirruk, residing in the nitrogen-rich valleys near the Eocho Mountains.
Foran Tutha was a terrestrial world located in the Tion Cluster's Cronese Mandate in the Foran Tutha system, within the Outer Rim Territories.
The Neti were a mythical sentient species that appeared similar to trees. A number of Neti supposedly resided on the forest moon of the planet Ossus.

Shuraden was a terrestrial planet on the Galactic Frontier in the Outer Rim Territories. It sat in grid square I-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid and was connected by a hyperspace route to the Virgillia system and Sump, homeworld of the Nuknog species.
Deezee was an R-series astromech droid that served the Resistance. Deezee flew in the X-wing starfighter of Black Squadron pilot Karé Kun during the search for Lor San Tekka.

Ronika was a terrestrial prison planet located in the galaxy. During the Galactic Civil War, Eara Lota, the heir to the monarchy of the planet Empress Teta, frequently protested the living conditions on Ronika or the working conditions for miners elsewhere in the system, with …

result: Sith Empire is overthrown from Serenno
x: According to legend, a battle occurred on the planet Serenno when a member of House Serenno led a charge against the Sith Empire, of which Serenno was allegedly part of. The event resulted in the Sith Empire being overthrown on Serenno.

Imhar Canyon was a location on Ossus. According to the Qel-Droma Epics, it housed a Jedi temple run by the Jedi Master Anstak, situated in a submerged tunnel system, where Anstak trained Padawans from amphibious species.
Molos was a planet located in the Stensen sector within the Outer Rim Territories that was under the rule of King Amand during the Galactic Civil War and controlled by the Galactic Empire.

The pumice forest was a region located near Big Settlement, the largest town on the planet Atterra Bravo. The "forest" was composed of a number of tall columns of pumice, each of which contained a number of holes.
Rockland Plate was a location on the planet Atterra Bravo. It was north of the Firestone Islands, which contained the major settlement known as Big Settlement.

Thrawn's patrol boat was a Vak patrol boat that was commandeered by Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy in order to escape the Vak homeworld of Primea with the caregiver Mitth'ali'astov.
Thrawn's freighter was a customized freighter used by Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy in his campaign against General Yiv of the Nikardun Destiny.

Attacker Four was the designation given to a heavy cruiser by the Chiss Ascendancy. The heavy cruiser, along with three others, was sent to attack the Chiss warship Vigilant by the Lioaoin Regime, under orders from the Nikardun Destiny, when the Vigilant attempted to collect S…
Attacker Three was the designation given to a heavy cruiser by the crew of the Chiss Ascendancy warship Vigilant.

Attacker One was the designation provided to a heavy cruiser by the Chiss Ascendancy. Accompanied by three other heavy cruisers, Attacker One was sent by the Lioaoin Regime to attack the Chiss warship Vigilant on behalf of the Nikardun Destiny when the Vigilant visited the pla…

Attacker Two was a heavy cruiser, designated as such by the crew of the Chiss Ascendancy warship Vigilant, who came under attack from the heavy cruiser and three others above the Vak homeworld of Primea.

Parkella was a terrestrial astronomical object inhabited by humans that was located in the Parkella system in the Elbaran sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square J-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

A species of creature was native to Cianap. The species was black-skinned, with four red eyes, two horns protruding from the back of their heads, and six hoofed legs, as well as two wing-like protrusions from their rear.
The Battle of Tansarii Point Station was a battle involving M3-A Scyk interceptors at Tansarii Point Station which saw the defeat of Talonbane Cobra, one of Black Sun's ace pilots.

Car'das was a group of smugglers that participated in the Battle of Tansarii Point Station. With the defeat of the ace pilot Talonbane Cobra during the battle, members of Car'das managed to turn the tide of the battle.

Tempes was an astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories. Home to a Jedi outpost during the days of the High Republic, it served as the destination for Luke Skywalker's quest to retrieve a lightsaber following the loss of his own during a duel with Darth Vader.

IG-88D was an IG-88 assassin droid who worked as a bounty hunter. IG-88D was one of five identical IG-series assassin droids manufactured by Holowan Laboratories. Upon their activation, the droids slaughtered their creators and escaped their laboratories into the galaxy.
Trymant IV, or Trymant, was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Subterrel sector, within the Trymant system.
The attack on Trymant IV, also known as the Battle on Trymant, was an attack carried out by Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era.

result: Destruction of a New Republic corvette
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish occurred in the Jendorn system between a New Republic corvette, supported by its X-wing starfighter escorts, and TIE/ln space superiority starfighters of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.
Ooroo Canyon was a location on the planet Ossus mentioned in the Qel-Droma Epics. According to the Epics, the canyon shared its name with the Jedi Master Ooroo, teacher of the Jedi Odan-Urr.

Esstee-Ninety-Three was a PJ unit droid who worked at the shipyard of the criminal mechanic Rekias Nodo during the time of the Galactic Empire. Esstee-Ninety-Three was a hulking bipedal droid with a pair of powerful piston arms that featured pincers.

Gideon's Outland TIE fighter was a starfighter of the TIE fighter series that was present for the clash on Nevarro and was piloted by Moff Gideon. However, it was destroyed by Din Djarin, who placed a grav charge upon the TIE late in the clash.

Sandmoths were a species of insectoid creatures native to the planet Glee Anselm. As a child, the Nautolan Nakano Lash played with several of the moths during a trip to the ocean world's surface with her family.
Holenesh Canyon was a kilometer-deep canyon on the planet Ilum, which a strange Force anomaly was centered upon, manifesting in a fluctuation occurring about every one hundred standard years.
The Harbinger was a Star Destroyer that served in the First Order Navy during the First Order's war with the Resistance.

result: Darksaber reclaimed from the Jedi Temple by Mandalorians
x: The sacking of the Jedi Temple occurred during the fall of the Old Republic when the Mandalorians launched an assault on the Jedi Order. The sacking allowed members of the House Vizsla to steal the Darksaber from the Jedi Temple.
Toydarian knights were knights of Toydaria. Toydarian King Katuunko wore a modern version of the traditional helmets of the Toydarian knights when away from the capital city.
Benetage was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was abandoned almost 30,000 years before the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Auratera was a planet located in the Auratera system of the Vorzyd sector, a sector of the Outer Rim Territories, and was situated along the Salin Corridor hyperspace route. It contained a powerful vergence in the Force, centered at Acablas.

affiliation: Either the Jedi Order or the Sith Empire
x: The Square Sea was an artificial, 500 by 500 kilometer square-shaped sea located on the planet Auratera, and was located about 800 kilometers west of the Acablas Ruins.

The Ark Angel IV was a starship owned by the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra. Originating from the time of the High Republic, the vessel was left abandoned on the planet Dianth, where it remained into the Imperial Era.

Ruckle was a droid that operated during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict fought between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic. It had four spider-like legs, but was capable of standing on just two of them and using its other legs as arms.
The Red Hills were a group of hills on the planet Dathomir.
The Hope of Aldera was a GR-75 medium transport that was part of an Alderaanian refugee convoy after the destruction of Alderaan.
The Tormentor was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that served as the flagship of Captain Amos and his fleet following the Battle of Endor. It was destroyed during a battle above Desevro.

The Silver Coronet was a New Republic MC75 Star Cruiser that served as the flagship of Anvil Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Caliban was an Outer Rim moon with a frigid climate. Its snow-covered frozen tundra, mountains, and ravines were home to the Qubey species.

The Qubey were a sentient species of alien native to the moon of Caliban. They were short creatures, and in terms of technology, were not very advanced. Their homeworld was disturbed during the Clone Wars, due to an invasion by Separatist forces led by General Grievous.

Ja-bess was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Ja-bess system in the Tragan Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the stage for the Ja-bess Incursion, an engagement between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

t: Raid on the Alliance to Restore the Republic
x: Sometime before the Dissolution of the Imperial Senate in 1 BBY, a senator of the Imperial Senate pushed for the 181st Imperial Fighter Wing of the Galactic Empire's Starfighter Corps, to launch a raid on the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Toydarian kingdom was a feudal monarchy that ruled the planet Toydaria and its moon Rugosa. Although the kingdom did ultimately answer to various Hutt kajidics, it was allowed an unusual amount of independence.

Dewbright was a city located on the planet Auratera. It was largely dominated by Ithorians, and maintained a populace of roughly 15,000. The Ithorians on Auratera had long dedicated their lives to restoring the city to its natural state following the end of the Sith Wars.

The Crystal Sea was an inland sea located in the southern hemisphere of the planet Auratera, in the Outer Rim Territories. The city of Dewbright was located in a large cove on the Crystal Sea's eastern edge.

Hriin was a city located on the planet Auratera. Located on the high bluffs north of the Hriin River, it was the closest settlement to Acablas, although it was still over three thousand kilometers away. The city had no starport, although it have landing pads for airspeeders.

Senoloro was a city located on the planet Auratera's equator, on a large island-like plain formed by six surrounding inland seas and their rivers. At 30,000, its population was the highest of any of Auratera's cities. Most of Senoloro's residents were human or Duros.
The Crescent Royale Casino was a casino located in the Canto Casino and Racetrack on the planet Cantonica. As one of the city's main attractions and oldest venues.
The Aurora was an MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's navy during the Galactic Civil War.
