x: In 2 BBY, the Spectres embarked on a mission to rescue the argora from the Galactic Empire and return the sacred bird to the Xendekians. The bird was being transferred to Emperor Palpatine's personal zoo. The rebels infiltrated a cargo ship and freed the bird.

Zox was an X-0X recording droid owned by Mandora Catabe when she was editor-in-chief of the HoloNet News in Coruscant. After the Imperial military banned the use of relay droids, she upgraded it and gave it to Calliope Drouth upon her dismissal.
Estaria was an astronomical object in the Estaria system in the Indrexu sector of the Outer Rim Territories that featured a number of orbital ports and was known for its dense civilian traffic.
In 232 BBY during the High Republic Era, an Emergence of the Great Hyperspace Disaster occurred in the Eriadu system of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Hassarians were a species of the galaxy with willowy physiques, lilac hair, and long snouts. As of the High Republic Era, the species had a centuries-long rivalry with the Skembo.
The Screaming Talons was a criminal organization operating during the Galactic Civil War. Far-ji was a Boss within the gang, and waged a feud with rival gangs.

The Azure Sunset was a luxury sail barge owned by the Pantoran noble Kyja Cho. During the Galactic Civil War, Kyja Cho hosted an event aboard the Azure Sunset, summoning Hutt crime lords and Corporate Sector Authority executives to view a rare krayt dragon pearl Cho had in her…
The Zapertine Cup was a podracing course on the planet Korrilan IV. The series of races were only eligible to racers piloting CR-17 Incendia podracers.
Korrilan IV was a planet located in the Mid Rim Territories. The Zalpertine Cup was a Podracing competition held on the world, catering to podracers piloting CR-17 Incendias.

During the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY, General Hera Syndulla and her New Republic forces aboard the Star Destroyer Deliverance were attacked by several Imperial sabotage droids, which were used to slow the New Republic's pursuit of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

This Consular-class cruiser was used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Jedi Master Luminara Unduli and Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano used it to transfer arrested Viceroy Nute Gunray to the Tranquility. It was later stolen by Faro Argyus during his escape with Gunray.

A Nu-class attack/transport shuttle was used by a Galactic Republic delegation under Senator Kharrus assigned to deliver a ransom of spice to Hondo Ohnaka's gang of pirates in exchange for Count Dooku.

This Flarestar-class attack shuttle was used by the Weequay pirate Barb Mentir to shoot down the Nu-class shuttle carrying Senator Kharrus. It was stolen by Confederacy of Independent Systems leader Count Dooku during his escape from Florrum in 22 BBY.

Anakin's shuttle was an refitted Eta-class shuttle that used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Jedi Generals Anakin Skywalker and Adi Gallia used it to board General Grievous's Recusant-class light destroyer and rescue Jedi Master Eeth Koth.
This Sheathipede-class transport shuttle was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. It was assigned to rescue General Grievous during the Battle of Saleucami.
This Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship was used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

This Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship was used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. When a Zillo Beast was captured after the Battle of Malastare, this ship was used to transport the creature to Coruscant.
The Gauntlet was a Kom'rk-class fighter/transport that was used by the leader of the Death Watch, Pre Vizsla, as his personal ship.
Kirima was a terrestrial planet located in the Mid Rim. Located near another celestial body, Kirima had icy and rocky terrain with blue crystals.
Yavin 8 was a moon in orbit around the red gas giant Yavin Prime. It was one of twenty-six moons in its orbit, and one of three which supported life, including Yavin 4 and Yavin 13.
Yavin 13 was a moon in orbit around the red gas giant Yavin Prime. It was one of twenty-six moons in its orbit, and one of three which supported life, including Yavin 4 and Yavin 8.
KC-78 was an astromech droid with masculine programming that served Jedi Master Estala Maru during the High Republic Era.

Soikans were a sentient species from the planet Soika. Tall in build and having pointed ears, they were divided into at least two groups, Gagics and Livtaks, both of which had distinctive colorations. White hair, silver skin and lilac eyes were typical for the Livtak.

Boltrunians were a sentient species which existed in the galaxy. Some Boltrunians were present in the medcenter of the Starlight Beacon space station when Administrator Velko Jahen arrived and was escorted through the facility by Okana.

Medosleans were a sentient species from the Medoslea system which resembled large jellyfish. Shortly after arriving on the Starlight Beacon, Administrator Velko Jahen saw one Medoslean, spread over two cots, being administered drugs by Doctor Gino'le, the Chief of Medical Oper…

The Skembo were a sentient species in the galaxy. They had short legs and long, prehensile tongues with which they could seize food. The Skembo had a rivalry with the Hassarians. Ceeril, one member of the species, served as the Ambassador of Rion during the High Republic Era.

The Halaisi were a sentient species in the galaxy. Humanoid in shape with a build similar to that of humans, they had golden skin and eyes, and four limbs with five-fingered hands. Their eyelids and lips could be blue, and they could have black eyebrows.
FB-88 was the designation of a Pelta-class frigate that served within the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Gorobei was a celestial body located in the Gorobei system of the Inner Rim Territories and the Interior. It was situated in grid square M-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid and was the homeworld of the Frenk bounty hunters Rumi Paramita and Twazzi.

Great Zilk was a celestial body located in the Irishi sector's Great Zilk system, which was within the Mid Rim Territories and the New Territories. It was situated in grid square K-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Halais was a celestial body located in the Halais system of the Colonies and the Slice. It was situated in grid square N-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid and was linked to the Alderaan and Commenor systems via the hyperspace route known as the Commenor Run.

Lavisar was the homeworld of the human Jedi Master Cin Drallig. It was located in the Lavisar system in the Strabin sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square M-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Bombardment of Xorrn took place on the Outer Rim Territories planet Xorrn in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars.

Korbori was an astronomical object located in the Korbori system of the Colonies and the Interior. It was situated in grid square N-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid and lay on the Hydian Way hyperspace route, which connected it to the Candovant and Ubardia systems.

The Ssori Fragments were a celestial body located in the Ssori system, a part of the Klina sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. They were situated in grid square S-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid and were the homeworld of the Ssori bounty hunter Seripas.

Cybloc XII was an astronomical object situated in the Cybloc system of the Outer Rim Territories' Meridian sector. It was the homeworld of the Snivvian Morlimur Snugg, a superintendent on the InterGalactic Banking Clan's Cybloc Transfer Station in the same star system.
Vrant Tarnum was a terrestrial moon in the far reaches of the Stygmarn system. The Kharvashark Ruins were located in its southern hemisphere.

The Kharvashark Ruins were a location on the southern hemisphere of the planet Vrant Tarnum, in the Stygmarn system. Long before the High Republic Era, members of the Elders of the Path hid half of an ancient relic in a cave on the ruins' outskirts.
Bogaranths were large, quadrupedal carnivorous creatures. They produced noxious slime when they were hungry, which was frequently.
Apatros was a world in the Apatros system, a star system in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Coynites were a sentient species from the Coyn system. One such being was involved in a gladitorial fight in the city of Sclavos on Zygerria, which ended with the Coynite's death.
The Nova Defiant was a Recusant-class light destroyer that served in the naval forces of the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
The Gilded Aegis was a Recusant-class light destroyer that served within the Confederacy of Independent Systems' naval forces during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
The Patriot Fist was a Recusant-class light destroyer that served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
The assault on Starlight Beacon occurred during the High Republic Era when the Starlight Beacon space station came under attack by the Drengir, a species of sentient carnivorous plants.
Parcelus Minor was a location in the Parcelus Minor system in the Parcelus sector of the Expansion Region. The mercenary Saponza once participated in the Retreat from Parcelus Minor.
The Separatist Council Conference Room was a room on the planet Mustafar where members of the Separatist Council conferred. It was located deep in the mining facility of the Techno Union.
Croluthe Zenj was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Croluthe Zenj system in Lannik Space, a sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square R-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Banchii was a planet in the Inugg system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, it housed a Jedi outpost which Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi was stationed at in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster.
The Razzi warehouse raid was robbery of the Razzi Syndicate that had occurred by 10 BBY. In the aftermath of the raid, stolen cargo was received by the rivial criminal orginization Crimson Dawn.

Dry Gulch was a settlement in the southern hemisphere of the planet Savareen where an independent coaxium refinery was located. By 10 BBY, the Bellwing Gang had been harrasing Dry Gulch over the refinery, and the locals hired the mercenary Gallandro to deal with the gang.
G2-RX was a G2 repair droid who served the Resistance and repaired droids on board the Raddus.
The Onoam spaceport was a spaceport serving Naboo's moon, Onoam. It was located only a few kilometers away from the queen's secondary palace on the moon.
Blarrum was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Blarrum system in the Mayagil sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was inhabited by gundarks and home to Kul Kenada Spaceport.

A summit was held on the planet Mon Cala between 235 BBY and 232 BBY. At the summit, the human female Avon Starros was forced to eat joppa stew for a month straight, as it was the only thing her nanny droid J-6 was programmed to prepare.
Flutterbugs were insects found on Hosnian Prime and Dalna. Avon Starros once followed a flutterbug outside of her family home and was kidnapped as a result.
The fifth Emergence was the fifth of the Emergences, fallout of the Great Hyperspace Disaster in which fragments of the freighter Legacy Run shot out of hyperspace seemingly at random.
The nineteenth Emergence was the nineteenth of the Emergences, fallout of the Great Hyperspace Disaster in which fragments of the freighter Legacy Run shot out of hyperspace seemingly at random.

The Salenga were a sentient species which existed in the galaxy. They had pink skin, yellow eyes with vertical eyelids and triangular pupils, and hands with one thumb, one finger and a single wide appendage where humans and species with similar hand shapes had more fingers.

result: The galaxy is led to the brink of financial ruin
x: The Battle of Muunilinst was a battle during the Clone Wars that took place on the planet Muunilinst. The training of clone trooper pilots in their handling of the V-19 Torrent starfighter postponed their deployment until this battle.

Bormus was a planet in the Bormus system in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was under the jurisdiction of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Malkii was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Malkii system in the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Winds of Ruin, also known as simply Ruin, were a criminal group who captured the musician Tu-Wane Jipps and had him play music for them at their base.
Cioral was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Unknown Regions Chiss Ascendancy nation. In 18 BBY, it was the stronghold of one of the Ascendancy's Great Families, the Xodlak family.
Creepmice were a type of mice. In 382 BBY, Path of the Open Hand member Yana Ro encountered the mice on the moon Jedha.

Soon after the Battle of Yavin that marked the start of 0 ABY, a swoop race was held on the Outer Rim planet Rion to determine the Rion Swoop Champion. The prize for the race was 1000 credits and a trophy.

Jekara was an ice planet located in the Jekara system of the Mid Rim. The Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate, having resurfaced under the control of Lady Qi'ra, stole the carbonite-frozen smuggler Han Solo from the bounty hunter Boba Fett, holding a celebration on Jekara to aucti…

A wisp spider was a type of spider that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. According to the Dalnan Honesty Weft, his father—Ambassador Weft—had captured a wisp spider and then set it free outside on at least one occasion.

Mos Espa Way was the main street in the city of Mos Espa on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Tatooine. It was lined with cantinas and stalls intended for tourists. Its side roads led into the entertainment district, and it was overlooked by the shopping district.
The New Quarter was a section of the city of Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Tatooine.
The Old Quarter was a part of the city of Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Tatooine.

The Theed market square was the largest market square in Theed. Prior to the Invasion of Naboo, it contained four fountains, a number of statues and benches, power generators, and several entrances to the Theed sewer system.

R0-VR, known as Rover or Ar-Oh, was an astromech droid owned by the former Jedi and saber-for-hire Ty Yorrick during the High Republic Era. Often resembling a puppy, R0-VR had the temperament of a loyal canine.
KL-03, or K-L, was an admin unit and protocol droid owned by the former Jedi Ty Yorrick, who worked as a saber-for-hire during the High Republic Era.

The Tholothian mercenary Ty Yorrick flew a starship during the High Republic Era. Accustomed to rejecting attachment to what she perceived as tools, Yorrick gave the YT-750 freighter no name, only using a variety of registration numbers for the vessel when docked in Galactic R…

Safrifa was a swamp planet located in the Galactic Frontier of the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Safrifan species. The planet was inhabited by swamp farmers as well as clans led by marsh-lords.

Safrifans were a sentient species native to the swamp planet Safrifa. They had skin the color of stagnant water, large oval eyes, and hair like pondweed. Despite their perceived scrawny nature, the Safrifans were industrious, able to raise crops in Safrifa's marsh terrain.

In the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster during the High Republic Era, a task force was created by the Galactic Republic in order to discover the cause of the disaster and subsequent Emergences, and find a way to deal with them.
A village located on the planet Aleena housed a population of Aleena. At one point, the Galactic Empire attacked the village and an Aleena child was orphaned.

During the Imperial Era, the Galactic Empire undertook a mission to the planet Aleen. During the mission the Empire committed an act that caused a stormtrooper and two other to desert from the Empire. An Aleena village was damaged and an Aleena child was orphaned.

During the Imperial Era, Tase Somer's black market network was a clandestine network operated for the purchase and sale of rare artifacts. The artifacts listed on the network included items from the High Republic Era.
Level 121 was a relatively quiet section of Cloud City on Bespin. The Ugnaught Recnelo Cott preferred to live on the level instead of with her family in a busier part of the city.
Level 142 was a section of Cloud City on Bespin. It contained the Azure Den, an underground gambling site.
A pirate frigate was frigate utilized by a pirate group. During a battle in the Mirrin sector, Rapier Leader Poe Dameron was captured and interrogated on the frigate by the pirates.
During the era of the New Republic a battle took place between Rapier Squadron and a pirate group in the Mirrin sector. Rapier Squadron was lead by Commander Poe Dameron.

Celwis was a planet of the Chiss Ascendancy and a stronghold of the Xodlak family. It was located beyond the eastern edge of Chiss Space in the Celwis system in the Unknown Regions. Though Celwis was economically valuable, the world was politically insignificant.

Boropacc was the capital city of the planet Rapacc, homeworld of the Paccosh species. When the Paccosh drove out the Nikardun forces that had invaded their planet, the city underwent damage, both from the Nikardun destroying what they could as they fled and from the Paccosh in…

The Midsummer was a frigate in service to the Chiss Ascendancy's Xodlak family, serving as part of their planetary defense fleet, though it was stationed on the surface and was derelict and abandoned.
The Apogee was a light cruiser in service to the Chiss Ascendancy's Xodlak family, serving as part of their planetary defense fleet, though it was stationed in orbit as a defense platform.

Sunrise, as it was named by the Chiss species, was a planet located in the Unknown Regions Sunrise system. The world was covered by mountains, forests, and rivers, as well as a compound located near a nyix metal mine.

A light freighter was owned by the chief Fardi of the Fardi clan in the year after the formation of the Galactic Empire. It was based in the shipyard of the clan's compound, which was on the planet Thabeska in the Thabeska system, until the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano
Shihon was a planet in the Shihon system in Chiss Space, in grid square E-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid in the Unknown Regions.

Hoxim, often referred to as the "Agbui mining world," was an unclaimed and uninhabited planet in the Unknown Regions. Its terrain consisted of forests and grasslands as well as rugged mountains and small swaths of desert, but it had extremely acidic soil.
Copero was an astronomical object of the Chiss Ascendancy located in the Unknown Regions, situated in the Copero system near the Ascendancy's east and southeast sectors.

leader: Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious
x: The Tankers were a type of guard created as part of a wider cloning effort and located on the Sith planet of Exegol, specifically stationed on the Sith Citadel on the planet's surface.
The Agbui, nicknamed Scratchlings, were a sentient species that resided within the Unknown Regions. Their members possessed a form ability of telepathy, able to read a being's emotions by touch.

A ship was owned by Chardri Tage and his partner and co-pilot, Tamsin, in the year after the formation of the Galactic Empire. Bail Organa sent the pair in their starship to locate a former Jedi, Ahsoka Tano, though he did not tell them whom he sought.
A starship was owned by an agent of the Black Sun criminal syndicate. It was equipped with two engines and armed with powerful cannons. In 18 BBY, the starship was well-maintained and no longer new.

R2-H7 was a green-and-white R2-series astromech droid in the Royal Naboo Security Forces who traveled to the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY in the astromech socket of an N-1 starfighter piloted by Captain Gregar Typho.
A-Foroon was a planet located in the Arkanis sector within Outer Rim Territories. A-Foroon was the homeworld of the Hutt Arok.
The Magys's people were a sentient species that resided within the Unknown Regions and hailed from the planet Sunrise. The Magys was a Force-sensitive member of the species.

Wazta was a location in the galaxy that was the site of the Wazta emergence during the High Republic Era. Two Hassarians were injured in the Emergence and transported to the Starlight Beacon space station to receive medical care.
Soika was a terrestrial planet which was the homeworld of the Soikan species. It was located in the Soika system in the Inner Rim Territories, in grid square M-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The mission to the Malaga Cluster was a diplomatic mission undertaken in 232 BBY by Jedi Master Avar Kriss, Jedi Knight Nib Assek, and Assek's Padawan Burryaga Agaburry, to the Malaga Cluster to negotiate a trade agreement between the Ayelina and Ludmere.

The Wazta emergence was one of the Emergences of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, in which debris from the destroyed freighter Legacy Run were launched out of hyperspace at great speeds in locations across the Outer Rim Territories.
A bodyguard droid with masculine programming was owned by Ambassador Ceeril of Rion during the High Republic Era.

A detention center was located onboard the Starlight Beacon space station. After the Skembo Ambassador Ceeril was discovered to have staged an assassination attempt against himself to try and frame two Hassarian patients in the station medcenter, Marshal Avar Kriss ordered Cee…

The security tower was a section of the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon. Unlike the rest of the station, it lacked elaborate decoration and looked very plain. Evidence room three was located there.

Evidence room three was a room in the security tower of the Starlight Beacon space station. The remains of a bodyguard droid belonging to Ambassador Ceeril were placed in the room after the droid was destroyed during an assassination attempt on the diplomat.

The massacre on Suba Tren was an incident that took place on Suba Tren in which a number of Frizznoths were massacred. Vap Tomulus was involved in the massacre, later claiming that he had not murdered the Frizznoths on purpose.

x: Shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire, the irregular clone commando unit Clone Force 99 was sent on a mission to Onderon to wipe out a supposed separatist outpost.

An island was located on Glee Anselm. During the reign of an empress, members of the Anselmi species claimed and settled the island. When the Anselmi outgrew the island's natural space, they constructed a series of dams to push back the surrounding oceans.

t: Battle in the Bright Jewel system
x: During the High Republic Era, a battle was fought in the Bright Jewel system near Ord Mantell between a Galactic Republic-Jedi Order starfighter force and a group of Nihil pirates.
A prison planet was located in the Grehollo system, a part of the Manoe sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim that also contained the prison moon Captivity.

Tulgah Heights was a location on the Forest Moon of Endor that shared its name with the Endorian Tulgah species and was home to witches. The Ewoks of Bright Tree Village told stories about the witches around campfires and considered the witches "malevolent."

Ashla was a moon of the planet Tython. For millennia, it was held as a sacred world to the Jedi Order. Members of the Order would travel to the moon so they could meditate on disturbances and visions they would find troubling.

Wingmaws were a species of carnivorous flying creature that could be found on Ashla, the primary moon of the Deep Core planet Tython. They would feed by picking the flesh from the bones of already-deceased prey.

R2-RN8W was a rainbow-colored astromech droid that enjoyed celebrating with others on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. Its dome had primary photo receptors, radar eyes, a data card reader, and a Herner optical holographic projector.

The Tipoca City Training Facility, also known as the Kamino training room, was a location within the Tipoca City Military Complex on the planet Kamino that was used by the Kaminoan cloners to train clone cadets.
A cafeteria was present within the Tipoca City Military Complex where clones would eat food.

result: Clone Force 99 escapes with their damaged shuttle
The Lawquanes successfully board a passenger shuttle offworld
x: Shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire, a skirmish took place at a spaceport town on Saleucami between the fugitive clone commandos Clone Force 99 and Imperial clone troopers.

A training course was located on the Outer Rim moon Ajan Kloss. Situated in the Klosslands, the course was used by Leia Organa to instruct her Padawan Rey in the ways of the Jedi during the First Order-Resistance War in 35 ABY.

The monzu was a predatory species found on the planet Zolan. As a result of a spike of solar radiation from Zolan's sun, the monzu and various other species on the world developed the ability to alter their skin color and change their body shape as an adaptation.

Rugosa giant beetles were a species of beetle native to the coral forests of Rugosa. The beetles had light-purple skin. Yoda and a group of clone troopers encountered the beetles during a mission to the moon Rugosa.
Unidentified Rugosa snakes were a purple-skinned species of snake native to the coral forests of Rugosa. They lived inside the ground, only with a small stub of their body sticking out.

Saleucami town was a spaceport town that existed on the planet Saleucami at the beginning of the Imperial Era. Controlled by the Galactic Empire, it contained an impound lot used by Imperial forces to hold seized starships.

BU-11 was a BU-series bartender droid who worked in Ziro's Palace during the Clone Wars. It served a Trandoshan a glowing green cup. It reacted as Senator Padmé Amidala entered the room with HELIOS-3D.

R4-H5 was an astromech droid utilized by the Nautolan Jedi Master Kit Fisto at the First Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY. Since that battle marked the outbreak of the Clone Wars, Fisto was assigned a new droid, R6-H5, by the Jedi Order.

Gonky was a defective GNK-series power droid, who served Clone Force 99 aboard the Marauder. Wrecker frequently used the droid as a weightlifting aid. As a defective unit, Gonky's power unit could not fully charge.
The Mercenary Guild of Coyn were a group of mercenaries. By the time of the Clone Wars, the guild had operated for decades and centuries, having a host of seasoned warriors at their disposal.
Qibbu's Hut was a hangout on Coruscant. Clone troopers would visit at times.

Jungle Felucians were a primitive sentient species of amphibians native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Felucia. Members of the species were tuned to the ever-changing presence of the Force on their homeworld.
The Ordo Moon Dragon was a species of nocturnal creature native to the Ordo Moon. It fed on raw energy.

The Ordo Moon was a rocky moon that orbited a blue gas giant in the Bortele sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It had a thin atmosphere and was home to the Ordo Moon Dragon, a creature that fed on raw energy.

The Kanji Criminal Enterprise, also known simply as the Kanji, was a criminal group that operated on Nar Kanji with the Kanji Hutts. They were involved in the pit fighting in the Garkata Fighting Arena, and protected the fighter Wyrmen Lictor.

x: During the Onderon insurgency, a mission to Onderon occurred shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire.
A group of creatures was native to the moon Noaxson. The creature had Pink hair, yellow eyes and a beak. The creature had two large legs and was used to ride on by pirates.
The Talortai were an avian sentient species that possessed feathers and clawed feet. Talortai hailed from Talor, an astronomical object that featured tropics.
Talor was a tropical astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories's Varada sector that was home to the Talortai, a species strong in the Force that was once massacred by the Sith.
Rystan was a cold, inhospitable planet located in Wild Space. A freezing world, it maintained a habitable zone that could sustain some life, including creatures like the slarga.

Rystan's habitable band was a section of land on the freezing planet Rystan that was able to support life. Though not as inhospitable as other areas of the planet, the habitable band was still plagued by intense cold and wind.
The Golamaran ice flats was a fielded region of the planet Rystan that was home to a location known as the Shrine.

Slarga were large creatures native to the planet Rystan. Strong animals with thick, shaggy pelts, slarga were capable of traversing through the harsh elements of the freezing world and were used as beasts of burden.
Rust-weevils were a species of insectoid creatures native to the planet Rystan that were known to feed on metal objects.

A Saber Trainer was an expert in the ways of the lightsaber and instructed other individuals in its usage. During the First Order-Resistance War, several Saber Trainers served aboard the Halcyon, an MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser operated by Chandrila Star Line.

An impound dock was located in a spaceport town on the planet Saleucami at the beginning of the Imperial Era. Controlled by the Galactic Empire, impounded starships were brought to the lot, where they were secured with magnetic boots for later verification of their signatures.

The Crystal Flats was a location on the planet Mustafar. It was made of solid rock, and in the Flats' north, minerals were naturally deposited in the crystalline there that the region's name originated from.
The dining commons were a location in the Galactic Senate Building, where Padmé Amidala met with fellow Senator Rush Clovis.
The Reconciliation Project was a project undertaken by the New Republic following the collapse of the Galactic Empire at the Battle of Jakku and the end of the Galactic Civil War.
Ord Gimmel was a terrestrial astronomical object where variable holdout blasters were produced. It was located in the Ord Gimmel system in the Ado sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

result: Soran Keize is killed, failing in his mission to destroy the databank
x: The attack on Coruscant's Verity District was a mission undertaken by Colonel Soran Keize of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.
J Street was a street on Coruscant, where the Padawan Ahsoka Tano and the Jedi Master Tera Sinube chased the criminal Cassilyda Cryar.
Several Jedi younglings, including Ran Deezy, belonged to a species with light green or blue skin and large eyes.
CG-67 was a protocol droid owned by a Gran trader on Pantora shortly after the end of the Clone Wars. She was in charge of supervising his three other droids, Clink and the astromechs 225 and DK-3.
Clink was an LE-series droid owned by a Gran trader on Pantora. Along with the astromech droids 225 and DK-3, Clink was supervised by the protocol droid CG-67. The small droid did not suffer fools.
225 was an R-series astromech droid owned by a Gran trader on Pantora. Along with fellow astromech droid DK-3 and the LE-series droid Clink, 225 was supervised by the protocol droid CG-67.
Ro Station was a city located on the moon Pantora. During the early days of the Galactic Empire, the outpost's business and industry was struggling despite the end of the Clone Wars.
DK-3 was an R-series astromech droid in the service of a Gran trader on Pantora. The protocol droid CG-67 supervised DK-3 and the trader's other droids, fellow astromech 225 and the LE-series Clink.
Idaflor was an astronomical object located in the Idaflor system within the Sarin sector of the Outer Rim and Trailing Sectors.
The Pantoran Security was the law enforcement agency on the moon Pantora.

Early in the Imperial Era, a chase occurred in the city of Ro Station on Pantora after the mercenary Fennec Shand attempted to kidnap the child clone Omega. The girl had escaped Kamino with the fugitive Clone Force 99, and Shand had been hired to track her down.

place: Stronghold of the Morubas crime family, Bahlah
x: A battle took place at the Stronghold of the Morubas crime family, on Bahlah between Maul's Shadow Collective and the Morubas Crime Family. The crime family, led by Jjan, had taken Maul hostage and the Shadow Collective, led by Maul's brother Savage Opress arrived to rescue.

Cyclor was a planet located in the Cyclor system in the Alui sector of the Mid Rim that was home to the insectoid Cyclorrian species. A relatively small planet, Cyclor appeared green and brown from space and was orbited by vast shipyards.
The Innovator was an Elite-class research vessel designed by the engineer Vam Targes and constructed by the insectoid Cyclorrians at the shipyards over the planet Cyclor during the High Republic Era.
After the Battle of Naboo in 32 BBY, Dooku, on the orders of his Sith Master, came to the planet Sullust on a secret mission and met with SoroSuub Corporation's representative Kap Klyp.

This pill droid served on the Longbeam cruiser Aurora IX in 232 BBY. During a rescue operation on Solar Array 22-X, the Republic Defense Coalition Captain Finial Bright utilized this pill droid in gathering survivors from the wrecked space station.

t: Unidentified San Tekka clan servitor droid
x: A servitor droid was served on the San Tekka compound, Lake Country on the planet Naboo around the year 232 BBY.
The central marketplace was a district of Ro Station, a city on Pantora. A bustling locale, the central marketplace contained numerous businesses.
The lower division was a district of the city Ro Station on Pantora. It contained a skyway and at least one maintenance tower.
Ivan's Wampa House was the name of several restaurants in the central marketplace of Ro Station, a city on Pantora.
The Outcast was a starship owned by the bounty hunter Fennec Shand at the beginning of the Imperial Era. As her personal vessel, Shand had the Outcast outfitted with her unique modifications.
Black Ice was the name of a train of two Field Secured Container Vessels containing nine linked force-field fuel spheres that was used by the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy.
The Prosperous was a Providence-class Dreadnought manufactured in the factories on the planet Pammant by the Quarren builders of the Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps.

The Starcrusher was a battleship active during the Clone Wars. The Galactic Republic sent a squadron of Venator-class Star Destroyers to attack the Separatist fuel tanker Aurora in an attempt to draw out the Starcrusher, though the Aurora was able to escape.
The Impavid was a Star Destroyer that served within the naval forces of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Separatist Alliance. It carried a complement of clone troopers.
The Battle of Turkana was a battle that was fought over the Outer Rim planet of Turkana when a squadron of the Galactic Empire ambushed a task force of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Battle of the Phu system took place in 22 BBY within the Phu system during the Clone Wars. Prior to the battle, several Galactic Republic fleets had been destroyed in a series of attacks by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and its new mystery weapon, the Subjugator-c…

Jindas were a sentient species from the Jinda system that were introduced to the moon of Endor at some point. During the High Republic Era, a cruiser with a troop of Jinda dancers attended the Republic Fair on the planet Valo.

Gorphs were an amphibious sentient species who were native to the Forest Moon of Endor. They possessed green skin, and bluish-gray eyes with yellow sclera. Additionally, each of their hands possessed three webbed finger, and a singular protrusion was present atop their heads.
Gupins were a winged sentient species who at some point thought to have been introduced to the moon Endor on a crashed ark around a millennium before the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
Phlogs were a sentient species that inhabited the moon of Endor. A crash millennium ago was thought to bring them and Gorax to the moon.

Tiikae was a small desert planet located between the Starlight Beacon and Coruscant. Controlled by the San Tekka clan under the permission of the Galactic Republic, it housed a settlement inhabited by San Tekka vassals and a Jedi temple during the High Republic Era.
The Integrity was a Carrack-class light cruiser of the Galactic Republic that served as the flagship of Home Fleet Strike Group Five under Lieutenant Commander Lorth Needa.
The Mas Ramdar was a Dreadnought-class heavy cruiser of the Galactic Republic that served in the Coruscant Home Defense Fleet during the Clone Wars.
The Perseverance was a Carrack-class light cruiser of the Galactic Republic that served in Home Fleet Strike Group Five under Lieutenant Commander Lorth Needa.
The Indomitable was a Carrack-class light cruiser of the Galactic Republic that served in Home Fleet Strike Group Five under Lieutenant Commander Lorth Needa.
The knobby white spider was a species of spider that lived and lurked on the planet Dagobah. They later grew into gnarltrees.
Ozu was an astronomical object in the Greater Javin Region of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
Grass Trekkers were a semi-sentient race native to the forest moon of Endor. They were aggressive and skilled hunters.
Tulgah were a sentient species introduced to the moon of Endor at some point.

The Port Administration was an organization within the Utapaun Committee, the planetary government of Utapau, which was led by the Chairman of Utapau as head of state. The highest levels of Pau City was occupied by the government and the Port Administration.
The Sher Kar was the apex predator of its homeworld, the volcanic Outer Rim planet Mustafar. Large and scorpion-like, they possessed six segmented limbs with feet with at least four toes.

The Lusankya was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought ordered for the navy of the Galactic Empire. After the loss of the Imperial Death Star at the Battle of Yavin, the tactical importance of the Empire's Super Star Destroyer project increased.

Cymoon was an astronomical object situated in the Cymoon system of the Expansion Region's Corellian Industrial Cluster. The first moon of Cymoon, Cymoon 1, was an important factory world for the Galactic Empire.

Adrafar was a planet located in the Abafar system of the Quelii sector within the Outer Rim Territories. The sister world of the desert planet Abafar, Adrafar orbited the yellow star Abafed on an identical orbit, though four months behind.
Located on the Outer Rim planet Mustafar, Berken's Flow was the largest lavafall in the galaxy, as well as one of the few constant features of the lava planet.
The Smoking Forest was an area on the Outer Rim lava planet Mustafar. One of the planet's few constant features, the region was named for the tree-like, smoke-belching rock chimneys there.

The Burning Plains was a region of the Outer Rim lava planet Mustafar which boasted heavy volcanic activity. The area was to the north of Mustafar's giant central volcano, and it was one of the few contant features of the planet.
Centax-1 was the primary moon of the planet Coruscant, located in the Core Worlds. The standard month was based on the syzygy of Centax-1, and the day of Centaxday was named after it.
The Zhell were a historical sentient species of the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. The species was believed to be the origin for the name of Zhellday, a day in the standard week.
The Ratts Tyerell Foundation was an awareness group dedicating to exposing the dangerous aspects of the sport of podracing.
The Valcyn was a T-class long-range personal cruiser that was used by multiple Sith Lords, including Darth Bane.
The Starswarm Cluster was a star cluster located in the Koros sector of the Deep Core and the Interior. It was also situated in the grid square L-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Eclipse was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Deep Core.
Khommite striders were elegant four-legged creatures found on the fertile Deep Core planet Khomm.
Khommites were a near-human species native to the fertile Deep Core planet Khomm.

type: Renovated from a gunner's nest into:
x: Omega's Room was a private cabin room and bunk specially for the enhanced clone Omega aboard the Marauder, an Omicron-class attack shuttle that served as the personal starship of Clone Force 99.

The Republic Judiciary Council was a judicial organization of the Galactic Republic. It held authority over the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center on Coruscant, that had 64,000 staff members and 3,200 Coruscant Guard shock troopers.

The Imperial Penal Council was a judicial organization of the Galactic Empire. It was formerly the Republic Judiciary Council, and held authority over the Central Detention Center on Coruscant, that had 64,000 staff members and 3,200 Coruscant Guard Imperial shock troopers.
Vaal was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories within the galaxy.
Dagri was one of the four moons of the planet Onderon, located in the Japrael system of the Inner Rim's Japrael sector. Dagri was located at grid square O-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Dxun was one of the four moons of the planet Onderon, located in the Japrael system of the Inner Rim's Japrael sector. The moon was situated at grid square O-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It shared its name with Dxunwood.
Evas was one of the four moons of the planet Onderon, located in the Japrael system of the Inner Rim's Japrael sector.
Suthre was one of the four moons of the planet Onderon, located in the Japrael system of the Inner Rim's Japrael sector.
Molopolis was a city located on the planet Molos. During the civilian uprising on the planet, a battle took place in the city that left it burned.
Deko Neimoidia was a Purse World located in the Deko Neimoidia system in the Quellor sector of the Colonies region of the galaxy, and was in close proximity to the Neimoidian homeworld of Neimoidia.
New Valis was a mining colony located in the Outer Rim Territories. The colony was controlled by the Galactic Empire who brutally forced the civilian miners to mine the rich minerals.

result: Valo is devastated, with hundreds of thousands dead
x: The Valo Atrocity, also known as the Battle of Valo, and remembered as the Tragedy of Valo, was a battle that occurred during the High Republic Era when the Nihil attacked the planet Valo.

During the High Republic Era, the Nihil attacked Tiikae. A Jedi starship travelling in the area, containing Jedi Master Cohmac Vitus, Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh and their Padawans, Reath Silas and Imri Cantaros, diverted to assist in repelling the attack.

A village was home to a tribe of Tusken Raiders. According to legend, the village was under attack by the krayt dragon Krayt during the Imperial Era, until the creature was defeated by exiled Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi.

A tribe of Tusken Raiders lived in a village on the planet Tatooine. According to legend, the tribe was under attack by the krayt dragon Krayt during the Imperial Era, until the creature was defeated by exiled Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi.

place: Old Ord Mantell City, Ord Mantell
result: Muchi is rescued and returned to Bib Fortuna
objective: Rescue Muchi
x: The mission to Ord Mantell, also referred to as the mission to Old Ord Mantell City, was undertaken early in the Imperial Era when the fugitive Clone Force 99 rescued the rancor Muchi from Zygerrian enslavers on Ord Mantell.
Old Ord Mantell City was a ruined city on the planet Ord Mantell. It was located on the far side of the planet from Ord Mantell City.

t: Mission to Recover the Republic's Battle Plans
result: R2-D2 recovers the plans and destroys the droid factory
objective: Recover the Galactic Republic's battle plans
x: In 20 BBY, the Jedi Order undertook a mission to recover the Galactic Republic's secret battle plans, which Chancellor Palpatine had given to Separatist General Grievous to take to the planet Geonosis.
The Vermin-Thrax was a modified HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 bulk freighter owned by the Trandoshan hunter Garnac.

Kaderin was a terrestrial astronomical object situated in the Outer Rim Territories. The arms dealer Ebann Drake ran an arms-smuggling ring on Kaderin during the Imperial Era. Somewhat nearby Kaderin was an array of asteroids.

Vulagools were a non-sentient species of diminutive, hunched bipeds commonly found on the planet Alderaan during the era of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

A battle was fought at Distilon between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire sometime between 2 BBY and 3 ABY. Wedge Antilles and Derek Klivian both participated in the battle.

A battle was fought at Perimako Major between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire sometime between 2 BBY and 3 ABY. Wedge Antilles and Derek Klivian both participated in the battle.

Varykino, also known as Lake Retreat, was an island amidst the waters of Naboo's scenic Lake Country that housed Varykino Villa, an ancient dwelling of the Naboo epic poet Omar Berenko and the Naberrie family which took its name from the island.
The Vo Granee Droi was a YT-2000 Light Freighter operated by Boonda, a Hutt who held Rebel Alliance sympathies.
The Faithless was a YT-2000 light freighter operated by Luca, a Rebel Alliance sympathizer. The ship was known as a tramp freighter.
The Bakuran Blade was a YT-2000 light freighter operated by the female tramp freighter captain Dana Galvason, a Rebel Alliance sympathizer.

affiliation: YT-Series Warranty and Repair Shipyard B33
x: A droid served the Corellian Engineering Corporation at YT-Series Warranty and Repair Shipyard B33 on the planet Corellia during the Imperial Era.

Massassi warriors were warriors of the Massassi that lived on Yavin 4 and have built the Great Temple on the moon. The Great Temple was alleged to have been built in honor and under the leadership of the Sith Lord Naga Sadow by circa 5000 BBY.

Wormtown was an area of the Hutt Space moon Nar Shaddaa that contained the pit fighting Garkata Fighting Arena. Boba Fett traveled to the town during the Galactic Civil War to eliminate Wyrmen Lictor, the champion of the arena.
The Bespin Beldons were a grav-ball team that played for the planet Bespin. In 178 BBY, Galaxy Feed predicted that that year would be the year for the Beldons.

The Chagrian courts was a court system utilized by the Chagrian people. The courts were considered some of the most fair and balanced courts in the galaxy. All evidence was examined thoroughly and trials were usually brief since most Chagrians put on trial admitted their guilt
Donovia was a rainy planet located in the Donovia system of the Expansion Region's Hali sector where mechanics known as Donovian rainmen maintained signal towers.

A droid was created by the Jedi padawan Shi-Fara in 196 BBY for the science fair at the Jedi academy on Coruscant. After Roan Novachez's baking soda volcano exploded, Shi-Fara's droid cleaned up the mess in fifteen minutes.

result: The Agbui take over the planet and mine it for nyix.
x: Sunrise's civil war was a civil war fought on the planet Sunrise in the Unknown Regions around 19 BBY. The civil war was orchestrated by Haplif of the Agbui, a servant of the Grysk "Jixtus," and devastated much of the planet.
The dolovite mines of Mustafar contained tunnels that were guarded by the roggwart Kongo against xandanks and lava eels.
Centax-2 was a moon of the planet Coruscant, located in the Core Worlds.
Stalker lizards were long-necked predators on the planet Dantooine. They were able to grow to three meters long.
The fabool were commonly found balloon-like creatures on the planet Dantooine. The greatest fear of the fabool was to be punctured by blba tree thorns and then devoured by small carnivorous snails.
Piket were large long-necked, slow-moving herbivores that lived on the planet Dantooine and fed off Blba trees. They were gregarious animals that travelled in large herds.
The Primea Central Command was the highest military authority of the Vak people's Vak Combine in the Primea system.
A city on the planet Rapacc was inhabited by refugees from the civil war on the planet Sunrise.

t: Mission to Nar Shaddaa (War of the Bounty Hunters)
result: Failure to locate Fett for both the rebels and bounty hunters
objective: Meet with Sagwa to gain information on Boba Fett
Locate Boba Fett
x: In 3 ABY, a group of rebels led by Commander Luke Skywalker undertook a mission to the moon Nar Shaddaa in order to meet with Sagwa, a contact of Chewbacca, who had information regarding a sighting of the bounty hunter Boba Fett on the moon.
A T-series tactical droid served the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

The HopeBreaker, briefly named by the Chiss as the Unidentified Battle Dreadnought, was a Shatter-class WarMaster of the Grysk that fought against forces of the Chiss Ascendancy above the planet "Sunrise" during the Nikardun campaigns.

t: Mission to a droid decommissioning facility
result: Hunter gives the copied data to Rafa Martez
objective: Retrieve a tactical droid head
x: The mission to a droid decommissioning facility was a job undertaken by the renegade Clone Force 99 at the behest of the information broker Ciddarin Scaleback to steal the head of a tactical droid from an Imperial decommissioning facility in Coronet City, Corellia.
Chiss warriors constituted the Armed Forces of the Chiss Ascendancy. They could have the ranks of Junior Warrior, Mid Warrior, and Senior Warrior.

The Redhill province, also known simply as Redhill, was a rural province located on the planet Celwis. The province mainly belonged to the Xodlak family, and the rancher family of Xodlak'phr'ooa (Lakphro), Lakansu, and their daughter Lakris had a homestead there.
The Chiss Coduyo family possessed lands on the Chiss Ascendancy planet of Celwis. While much of the planet was rural, the Coduyo family's holdings were urban and unsuitable for agriculture.
Berthing Strip Twenty-Nine was a landing zone on the planet Celwis.
Brickwalk was a region of the Chiss Ascendancy planet Celwis. The Xodlak family's Patriel Xodlak'oo'nifis managed the family's affairs on a planetary scale from Brickwalk.
Sposia was a planet in the Chiss Ascendancy where thousands of Chiss families and millions of Chiss lived. It was located in the Sposia system in Chiss Space in the Unknown Regions.

The Watith were a sentient species hailing from an Unknown Regions star system. They used a type of hyperspace prediction technology, their own script, and employed a class of gunboats that could be piloted remotely.
Shuttle One was a Chiss shuttle aboard the Chiss heavy cruiser Springhawk commanded by Senior Captain Thrawn.

The Neimoidian Grasp was a Trident-class assault ship that served in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Clone Wars, the Neimoidian Grasp fought underwater on the planet Mon Cala.

The Vermillion was a ship used by the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate that served as its Fortress-Flagship. After the organization stole the carbonite-frozen Han Solo, he was brought to Crimson Dawn leader Lady Qi'ra on board the Vermillion.
Worlport was the capital city of the planet Ord Mantell. It was situated on the coast of the Worlport continent and had many casinos and gambling destinations that seduced visitors.
The Worlport continent was a continent located on the planet Ord Mantell. It was the location of the planet's capital city, Worlport, as well as several cities on the southern part of the continent.

The industrial dockyard was a docking facility located in an industrial area of Coronet City, Corellia. The dockyard was located near a decommissioning facility which scrapped Separatist battle droids after the end of the Clone Wars.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: In 3 ABY, a battle was fought at Elessia between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and Galactic Empire, when Imperial Commander Ellian Zahra and her forces intercepted transmissions between the rebel Fourth and Seventh Divisions, who were attempting to regroup after the All…

t: Mission to steal Imperial research crates
conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
objective: Steal Imperial crates consisting of biological weapons from the Kessel
x: Sometime between 5 BBY and 4 BBY, the rebel cell known as the Spectres went on a mission to steal Imperial research crates carrying biological weapons from the Kessel Bunker within the Kessel system.

Yubals were pack animals that were domesticated by the Chiss on the planet Celwis. The family of rancher Xodlak'phr'ooa had a herd of yubals, and could lure them using lure sticks, and herd them using growzers.

The Altyr 5 Light Freighter Race was a starship race for light freighters. Despite the name, the race took place in space. Starting sometime between 10 BBY and 9 BBY, Imperial-endorsed racers began to win, until sometime between 5 BBY and 4 BBY, when the Spectres won.

Galator III, also known simply as Galator, was a casino planet in the galaxy where Kes Dameron and Shara Bey first met. Around 4 BBY, Dameron traveled to the betting houses on Galator III with his friend, who was due to get married.
A bipedal sentient species had large, angular skulls; wide-set, reptilian eyes; and a long, low-slung, flat-nosed snout. They could have gray or brown skin, black hair, and black eyes.
A Carrack-class light cruiser was owned by the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Sometime between 5 BBY and 4 BBY, the ship was abandoned in the Kryton system due to a technical mishap.

The Grappler was a Trident-class assault ship that served in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Clone Wars, the Grappler fought in the Battle of Kamino alongside several other Trident-class assault ships.
The Nautolan's Revenge was a Trident-class assault ship used by a group of pirates. At one point, it flew over an orange celestial body.

Imperial Patrol was a law enforcement agency of the Galactic Empire. They had multiple TIE/ln space superiority starfighters at their disposal. Starting sometime between 10 BBY and 9 BBY, the Galactic Empire would endorse racers in the Altyr 5 Light Freighter Race.

Thyrsus was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Thyrsus system in the Inner Rim Territories. On Thyrsus, farming was seen as a cowardly occupation, only undertaken by those who did not wish to fight.

The Galactic Agricultural Alliance was a scientific organization affiliated with the Galactic Republic that operated during the High Republic Era, consisting of agricultural experts, botanists, biologists, and horticulturalists.

The Kanz Disorders were an event that occurred millennia before the reign of the Galactic Empire. During the Kanz Disorders, enslaved members of the Lorrdian species mined a variety of kyber crystal known as Lorrdian gemstones.
Nu-Cosa was a city located on the planet Cosia. It was the largest city on the planet and was home to thousands of Cosians.
An Imperial starport was a spaceport located on the planet Cosia. It was utilized by the Galactic Empire to house it's personnel. The spaceport was located in the forest, a few miles from Nu-Cosa.

The Imperial cabinet was an executive organization of the Galactic Empire. By 11 BBY, Count Denetrius Vidian was a member of the Imperial cabinet, but not yet a member of Emperor Palpatine's closest circle of advisors.
Zone six was an expanse of the asteroid field that surrounded the planet Bothawui in the Mid Rim. Zone six was located next to zone five.
Zone five was a part of the Fervse'dra asteroid belt around the planet of Bothawui, which was located in the Mid Rim. Zone five was located next to zones four and six.
Zone four was a portion of the Fervse'dra asteroid belt that surrounded the Mid Rim world Bothawui. Zone four was located between zone five and zone three.
Zone three was an expanse of the Mid Rim planet Bothawui's asteroid belt, being located next to zone four. During the Battle of Bothawui, General Grievous's fleet passed through zone three.

X-10 or Ex-Ten, was a droid member of the Nihil marauder organization during the time of the High Republic Era. When a number of Nihil, including Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro, were stationed on Quantxi, the Junk Moon of Ord Mantell, X-10 remained aboard their vessel.
The Varonchagger was a starship used by Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh and Padawan Lula Talisola to travel to the planet Valo to respond to a Nihil attack there.

Lonisa City was the capital city of the planet Valo, housing the under-construction Valo Temple. It sat on the shore of Lake Lonisa. During the High Republic Era, Lonisa City hosted the Republic Fair, welcoming visitors from across the galaxy.

A minor terrestrial moon was part of a family story of the Starros Clan. According to the story, Caden Starros—the great-grandfather of the human girl Avon Starros—was stranded on the moon after an enemy of his stole his starship.

An aerial circus traveled around the Messert system. The human Seftin Vanik operated as a stunt pilot for the circus before being encouraged to join the Resistance by one of their pilots, Poe Dameron, after he witnessed one of Vanik's performances in the group.

The Rhokai gang were a ring of thieves active shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. During that time, the Rhokai stole a lizard that was later stolen from them in turn by the Bad Batch, a unit of former clone commandos working for the informant Ciddarin Scaleback…

A Venator-class Star Destroyer was in service to the Galactic Republic and its navy during the Clone Wars, and was one of many scuttled on the planet Bracca following the war's end and the formation of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY.

A BTL-B Y-wing fighter-bomber was utilized by the Galactic Republic near the end of the Clone Wars. The BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber was aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Tribunal when Order 66 was issued, which caused the clone troopers onboard to turn against former…

Harvester beetles were giant beetles native to the planet Neimoidia. Settled on the other Purse Worlds, they were tamed by the Neimoidians to assist in the production of a fungus that brought them great wealth. They were found within Neimoidia's hot jungles.
Koto-Si was the capital city of the planet Neimoidia. It contained several docking bays for large freighters, which landed and took off from the city every hour.

t: Heist at the Temple of the Kyber
objective: To steal a statue
x: Around 14 BBY, the Ithorian collector, Dok-Ondar accompanied the Weequay pirates, Hondo Ohnaka and Quadoro on a heist at the Temple of the Kyber to steal an ancient statue.
The zardimallo was a rare species of non-sentient quadrupedal lizard. They had had green skin and could roll up into a ball. The species was highly valued and therefore sought by many factions.

Growzers were a species of domesticated animals present on the planet Celwis. Lakphro and his family owned a group of growzers used to raise and herd their Yubals. One of their growzers was named Slobber, who was trained to come at the sound of a jacket sealer.

result: Omega is captured by Cad Bane
objective: Eliminate Clone Force 99
x: The mission on Bracca was an operation undertaken by forces of the Galactic Empire shortly after its formation. Led by Crosshair, Imperial units traveled to Bracca to terminate the renegade Clone Force 99, Crosshair's former unit.
Blistmok were a type of reptilian predator found on the volcanic Outer Rim planet Mustafar. They hunted in packs and were tireless, running down prey for days before attacking.

Kaliida Shoals was an astronomical object located in the Ryndellia system in the Ryndellian sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was located near the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center, a Galactic Republic medical station situated in the Ryndellia system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Hesperidium was one of the four moons of the galactic capital planet of Coruscant, located in the Core Worlds' Coruscant system. It was situated within the Coruscant subsector of the Corusca sector, located at the coordinates L-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Fever wasps were insects native to the planet Haruun Kal.
The Choah Belt was an asteroid field located in the Mortex sector's Choah system in the Outer Rim Territories region. It was situated in grid square S-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
As part of Operation: Cinder during the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire attacked the planet Mon Cala.
During the Galactic Civil War, the planet Chandrila was attacked by the Galactic Empire as part of Operation: Cinder.

headquarters: DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station
x: Scanning crew BT-445 was one of several Imperial scanning crews stationed aboard the Death Star. After the Millennium Falcon was brought aboard the Death Star, scanning crew BT-445 was sent to investigate the freighter for any concealed smuggling compartments.
MK-09 was a droid owned by Ace Azzameen, a member of the Azzameen family. At some point, MK-09 began to co-pilot the family's YT-2000 Otana.

A group was local to the Core Worlds planet Hosnian Prime during the High Republic Era. By 235 BBY, the group wanted Hosnian Prime's Republic junior senator—Ghirra Starros—to agitate for stronger trade controls in the Galactic Senate.

result: The lizard is successfully captured and brought to Cid
objective: Steal the lizard from the Rhokai gang
x: Early in the Imperial Era, the renegade Clone Force 99 was sent by their informant Cid to steal a lizard, later dubbed "Ruby," from the Rhokai gang.

Guiteica was a planet within the Guiteica system in the Kadok Regions of Wild Space that was the homeworld of the Bitthævrian species. Historically, Kaleesh warlords, from the neighboring planet Kalee, took roggwarts from Guiteica as trophies.

Vole-kites were whiskered, furry-feathered animals that could be found on Chandrila. Three such creatures were searching for crumbs in the Eleutherian Plaza in Hanna City when Leia Organa and Mon Mothma walked together in the plaza.

The Garden Preserve was an area on the planet Kashyyyk. During the Imperial occupation of the planet, Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck chased a Wookiee through the Garden Preserve with a modified assassin probe.

R2-N3 was an R2-series astromech droid that was stationed onboard the Naboo Royal Starship. During the Invasion of Naboo, Queen Padmé Amidala and others attempted to break through the blockade surrounding the planet.

result: Many of the Nihil forces are defeated, but Marchion Ro and Krix Kamera
x: The Battle on Quantxi, also known as the Battle of Quantxi, took place during the High Republic Era on the junk moon Quantxi between members of the Jedi Order and their allies, and the Nihil pirates.
The Squall Spider, also simply known as the Spider, was a Nihil Spider Cruiser which operated during the High Republic Era.
Outer Mebarius was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Outer Mebarius system in the Inner Rim Territories.
The Second Battle of Epiphany was a battle which took place at Epiphany, the outermost of three planets orbiting a red dwarf star in the Corporate Sector's Salient system.

A sentient species had three eyes and an upright body build with two arms. The aliens had white skin, pink lips, no visible nose, and prominent eyelids surrounding their black eyes that had no visible sclerae.

The Diplomatic corps was the main diplomatic service of the Chiss Ascendancy. Sometimes, Chiss diplomats would travel with an escort from the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet, and sometimes with an ozyly-esehembo serving as a navigator.
The diplomatic corps was the diplomatic service of the Garwian Unity, a nation in the Unknown Regions, of which the Garwian envoy Proslis was a member.
The Constrainer was an Interdictor-class heavy cruiser in service to the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
A Partisan cell led by the Devaronian Blue was active in the Five Points system in the Outer Rim Territories.
An Agbui settlement resided on the Agbui mining world of Hoxim in the Unknown Regions. Haplif of the Agbui presented the settlement to Senior Aide Lakjip as a mining settlement.

The Dark Omen was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy that was active by 2 BBY. During the Galactic Empire's Lothal campaign against rebel cells such as the Rebel Alliance's Phoenix Group and the Spectres, the Dark Omen was under the command of Captain Corf…

While searching for the ruins of an Allanar N3 light freighter, Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn and the Chimaera encountered a cloaking device and gravity well hidden in an asteroid observation post. Hiding beneath the asteroid was an armed Grysk warship.

result: All Grysk forces are destroyed without being able to report home
The Chiss Ascendancy finds a weakness in the Grysk starfighters
x: As part of the Imperial–Grysk conflict, a battle between forces of the Grysk Hegemony and the allied forces of the Galactic Empire and Chiss Ascendancy occurred deep within Imperial space.
Massoss was a planet of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Unknown Regions, located within a system of the same name.

result: The Agbui's purported nyix mine is destroyed
All involved families emerge with honor and glory
x: The Hoxim incident, also referred to as the Hoxim battle and privately named by the Chiss Ufsa'mak'ro as the Battle of the Three Families, was a battle that occurred above the planet Hoxim between Chiss forces as a result of the machinations by "Jixtus" of the Grysk Hegemony.
During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, a battle was fought on the extragalactic planet Kamino, homeworld of the Republic's clone trooper army.
The Amaxine warriors were supposedly a warrior people that dated back to the dawn of the Galactic Republic. Instead of using currency, the Amaxine warriors traded weapons for goods and services.

The Saltbarrel was a freighter originally owned by the Watith captain Fsir. During the plot to destroy the Chiss Ascendancy, the Saltbarrel sent out a distress call to Senior Captain Thrawn of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet.

result: The Paataatus are liberated from Nikardun control
x: During the Nikardun campaigns, a skirmish occurred above the planet Nettehi, the homeworld of the Paataatus species.
C1-1KR, nicknamed "Checker," was a C1-series astromech droid belonging to the Royal Naboo Security Forces.

A feline creature lived in the forests and grasslands of the planet Eriadu. They had blue fur that was slightly lighter in color on their spine and jaw, yellow eyes, large fangs, and four claws on each paw.

DT-JZ nicknamed Jez was a DT-series sentry droid that worked alongside Captain A'Shar Farless at the Imperial security complex on the planet Scarif. The droid was given to the captain by his family to offer him protection while he served in the Galactic Empire.

conflict: Plot to destroy the Chiss Ascendancy
Agbui attempt to precipitate a Chiss Ascendancy civil war
result: Capture of the Watith and their starships
x: A skirmish occurred between Chiss forces and the Watith crew of a freighter during the Grysk Hegemony's plot to destroy the Chiss Ascendancy.

Wick was a planet located in the Wick system of the Instrop sector, a part of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square S-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid and shared its name with the celestial body Wick 111 that was situated in the same star system.
The Opal Empress was a luxury leisure cruiser. The arms dealer Ebann Drake boarded the vessel after being invited to what he claimed was an incredible opportunity.
Zee-Nine City Seven, situated deep within Hutt Space, was a droid-run settlement that served as a pirate repair center and data hub.

Gak-Sixtoo was a nav droid who served the Hutt Bokku, operating aboard Bokku's barge. When Bokku guided the Sith Lord Darth Vader and the Sith assassin Ochi to Zee-Nine City Seven in order to locate the carbonite-frozen smuggler Han Solo, Gak-Sixtoo piloted the vessel, communi…

A barge was owned by the Hutt Bokku and operated by the nav droid Gak-Sixtoo. Bokku used the barge to transport the Sith Lord Darth Vader to Zee-Nine City Seven, deep within Hutt Space, as part of Vader's search for the carbonite-frozen smuggler Han Solo.
A crew was lead by the Abednedo Telsla. During the Clone Wars, the crew took over Tomarian's theater to claim payment that he owned to Telsla.

The Shani were a sentient species of tall, multicolor-feathered reptilian humanoids from a homeworld within Wild Space. They possessed extremely long lifespans, and could unhinge their jaws to devour creatures and beings whole.
A Sentinel-class landing craft was utilized by Task Force 99, also known as SCAR Squadron, an elite stormtrooper squad of the Galactic Empire.
Bora Vio was a planet situated in the Lido system. The planet had a cloudy atmosphere, which hosted a Kaminoan facility that was abandoned by the time of the Galactic Empire.

result: Omega escapes and is rescued by Clone Force 99
objective: Prevent Omega from falling into Kaminoan hands
x: Early in the Imperial Era, the young clone Omega was rescued from an abandoned facility on Bora Vio. Omega, a creation of the Kaminoan cloners, was highly valuable due to being one of only two clones in existence with the unaltered DNA of Jango Fett, who had served as the clon…

objective: Rescue Qui-Gon Jinn and the other Wookiees
x: Around 41 BBY, on the planet Kashyyyk, Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and several Wookiees were rescued by Obi-Wan Kenobi and other Wookiee warriors. The Jedi and the Wookiees had been prievously captured by Trandoshan hunters in the lead-up to Life Day, a Wookiee festivity.

Loreth was a terrestrial planet in the Loreth system in the Saijo sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The settlement of Wyke Town was established there during the High Republic Era, founded by Layton Wyke.

A maintenance droid worked aboard the luxury cruiser Steady Wing during the High Republic Era. While the Steady Wing was on the planet Haileap, the maintenance droid encountered the Nihil marauder Klinith Da, who was disguised as a mechanic in order to orchestrate the destruct…

The Lapiz Cutter was the personal Sheathipede-class transport shuttle of Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray. It was used by Gunray during the Federation's Invasion of Naboo to transport him and Rune Haako to Theed.
The Eocho Mountains were a mountain range located on the Outer Rim Territories planet Ossus. The mountains were allegedly riddled with crystal caves that contained kyber crystals.

Saludad was the capital city of the planet Dalna. After a skirmish against the Nihil on the moon Wevo, Honesty Weft sent a message to the Dalnan capital for help, hoping that the planetary governor's experience with the pirates meant they could assist.

conflict: Plot to destroy the Chiss Ascendancy
result: HopeBreaker badly damaged on the port side
Grysks and Grysk allies strategic victory
The Battle Dreadnought and the Agbui freighter carrying nix escape int
x: A skirmish occurred above the planet nicknamed "Sunrise" between the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet and forces allied with the Grysks, in approximately 18 BBY.

result: Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo discovers the Magys's people
objective: Investigate the remnants of the Nikardun Destiny
x: During the Nikardun campaigns, Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet undertook a mission to the planet Rapacc, the homeworld of the Paccosh species, to investigate the remnants of Nikardun forces in the Choas.

The Lonisa City Zoo was a zoo located in Lonisa City, on the planet Valo. It featured night barbarbarbs, sanvals, hragscythes and a mudhorn. In 231 BBY, Jedi Master Elzar Mann visited the zoo before the arrival of multiple dignitaries and many of his fellow Jedi.

Night barbarbarbs were a type of tiny creature that made chirping noises to serenade one another. By the time of the High Republic Era, several of the creatures were present in Lonisa City Zoo on the Outer Rim planet Valo.
Sanvals were a species of reptilian dragons, and apex predators of their home environment.

Hragscythes were a species of carnivore native to Onderon and were an apex predator in their environment. Standing on six large, clawed legs, they had three heads with six eyes on long necks, with large mouths, gnashing teeth, and a long, spiny tail.

Kri-snorts were a type of flying creature that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Valo. In 231 BBY, Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram noticed several kri-snorts slowly flapping toward Valo's Lake Lonisa as he traveled toward the world's capital, Lonisa City.

Karova Canal was located in Lonisa City, on the planet Valo. The riverway was capable of holding multiple pleasure rafts and security cruisers, and had a high-end hotel whose windows faced down toward it.
Praknat 3 was the closest moon of the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches planet Trymant IV. Situated in the Trymant system, it was small and uninhabited.
5-Triad was a security protocol droid with masculine programming who worked at a detention center in Lonisa City on Valo during the High Republic Era.

Downtown BC was an area of Bralanak City on the Outer Rim planet Trymant IV. In 231 BBY, Zeen Mrala, a former resident of Trymant, Jedi Master Kantam Sy, and Jedi Padawan Lula Talisola traveled to Trymant IV to locate the Elders of the Path religious group to invesigate inform…

Crashpoint Peak was the nickname of a hill in Farodin Woods on the planet Valo, so nicknamed because local daredevils liked to try speeder tricks by the hill. Crashpoint Tower, the planet's comm tower, was located on the peak.

T-9, or Tee-Nine, or Teenine, was a cam droid owned by Rhil Dairo, reporter for GoNet during the High Republic Era. The droid assisted Dairo in reporting on the events of the Republic Fair on the planet Valo, and was present for the subsequent attack by Nihil marauders.
The remains of a J9 worker drone that supposedly held a treasure map within its head were discovered by the scavenger Rey on the desert planet Jakku.

Grizal was a forest planetoid situated in a distant area of the galaxy in the Mid Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, the planetoid was home to an abandoned prison complex that the Nihil marauder organization utilized as a main base of operations.

Celwis's largest moon was located in the Celwis system within the Unknown Regions and orbited the Chiss Ascendancy planet Celwis, which was controlled by the Chiss Xodlak family. It was situated in grid square F-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Redhill was the capital city of a province of the same name on the Chiss Ascendancy planet Celwis. Xodlak family Councilor Lakuviv managed the family's affairs on a provincial scale from his White Judgment Seat in Redhill Hall in Redhill.
The Kerk were a sentient species. The mercenary Caratoo, who led a mercenary band during the High Republic Era, was a Kerk.
Batarikans were a type of serpent found on the Outer Rim planet Galidraan. At some point during the High Republic Era, the mercenary Ty Yorrick was hired to hunt a batarikan on the world.

Kuranu were a sentient species that possessed smooth purple skin and pupil-less eyes. The species also had an almost pathological fear of germs. The inventor Mantessa Chekkat and her daughter, Klerin, who lived during the High Republic Era, were Kuranu.

The Coruscant Dawn was a starship owned by Lina Soh, Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. Soh used the vessel to travel to the Republic Fair on the planet Valo, accompanied by her subordinates, several Jedi, and the reporter Rhil Dairo.

The Fleeting was a starship owned by Ariole Yu, a lieutenant in the Sixth Kin criminal syndicate. Yu and Just Lucky used the vessel to travel to Crimson Dawn's auction of Han Solo in order to track down Gallin Crae, a supposedly traitorous Sixth Kin lieutenant.

Daivak was a rocky dry planet in the Daivak system in the Karthakk sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, it was considered part of the Galactic Frontier and was inhabited by settlers.

The Blood Moon Uprising was a conflict which occurred by the High Republic Era. A phrik staff from the uprising found its way into the Jedi Archives and was among many artifacts displayed in the Starlight Pavilion during the Republic Fair on the Outer Rim planet Valo in 231 BB…
Lake Lonisa was a large lake on the planet Valo, considered nearly large enough to be an inland sea. Lonisa City, Valo's capital, was located on its shore.

Drethi were a type of creature that had wings. During the dedication of the Starlight Beacon space station in 232 BBY, Jedi Master Elzar Mann met Jedi archivist OrbaLin for the first time and was left with the impression that the archivist was capable of boring the wings off a…

Rekelos was a terrestrial astronomical object. During the High Republic Era, the Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar witnessed the results of a swarm of Nihil scav droids on Rekelos. By the time of the Galactic Empire, a large city was present on Rekelos.

Cinderhawks were a type of hawk found on the Outer Rim planet Elphrona. After being severely injured by a harpoon during a battle against the Nihil marauder organization in 231 BBY, Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar imagined himself hearing the voice of a Jedi Master as he struggled …

The kitehawk was a type of hawk. In 231 BBY, Pan Eyta, a Tempest Runner of the Nihil marauder organization, captured a hologram recording of the Talortai Nihil Udi Dis, who had recently gained favor with the group's leader, Marchion Ro.

Gossam Courivers were a group of Gossams that existed prior to the establishment of the Galactic Republic who made use of an ancient tumbledrive. In 27,000 BBY, the Courivers colonized the planet Felucia.

Rhinnal was a Core Worlds planet that was part of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. It had a sky-island with a replication of its environment for the Republic Fair on the Outer Rim planet Valo in 231 BBY, as it was considered one of the Republic's key worlds.
A type of green-feathered bird was the pet of Padmé Amidala during her time as Queen of Naboo, sometime between 32 BBY and 28 BBY.

GS-8 was an RA-7 protocol droid who served Senator Avi Singh of the Confederacy of Independent Systems on the planet Raxus Secundus. Following the formation of the Galactic Empire, the planet fell under Imperial occupation, led by Captain Bragg.
