Greenstripes were a species of venomous insect present on the planet Shihon. Unlike most toxic insects known to the Chiss Ascendancy, Greenstripes neither poisoned their victims by stinging them nor biting them. Instead, Greenstripes spat poisonous saliva at their targets.

Saddlebulls were a non-sentient species domesticated by the Chiss. They were featured in the expression "When you see the saddlebull is about to throw you, jump off." In 18 BBY, Senior Captain Xodlak'in'daro, core name "Lakinda," had been censured by the Xodlak family for her …

Packbulls were a non-sentient species domesticated by the Chiss. Packbulls were known to "whinny", a sound that sky-walker Che'ri drew a comparison to for the accents of the Paccosh when speaking Minnisiat.

The central volcano of the Outer Rim planet Mustafar was one of the lava world's few constant features. Lava poured out of the spot at nearly 100,000 liters per second and pooled at the giant volcano's base.

The Valo Republic Fair was a Republic Fair held on the planet Valo in 231 BBY. The first Fair to be held in a generation, Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh intended the festival as a way for the Galactic Republic and the galaxy to show they had recovered after the devastation of the…
Frozians were a sentient species from the Froz system. The High Republic Era Jedi Nooranbakarakana was a member of the species.

A cataclysm took place in the Unknown Regions Rapacc system millennia before 19 BBY. The cataclysm caused the inner part of the star system, as well as much of its outer parts, to be seeded with large asteroids and meteors.
The Mistfly was a type of creature native to the planet Neimoidia.
The neekoflight was a type of creature native to the planet Neimoidia.
A terrestrial astronomical object was the homeworld of the targon—a type of large cat—and pinnoc trees.

The Dynamo was a starship owned by the Kuranu inventor Mantessa Chekkat and her daughter, Klerin. As Kuranu had a pathological fear of germs, the Dynamo was kept clean and sanitized by an army of small droids.
The moons of Dutar were a group of moons white in color located in the Dutar system within the Core Worlds and the Interior.
Krantians were a sentient species that hailed from the Krant system in the Mid Rim. A family of Krantians, including mother Lerahel and child Sarry, attended the Republic Fair on the planet Valo.
The Peasle were an insectoid sentient species. They possessed orange shells and a natural urge to roll into a ball at the first sign of danger.

Mulita was a forest planet located in the Mulita system, deep within Wild Space in grid square H-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of the sentient carnivorous plants known as the Drengir and the haven of the Great Progenitor, the first of the Drengir.

Soka flies were a type of buzzing fly that could travel in groups. After being wounded in a battle against the Nihil marauder organization at the Cyclor Shipyards in 231 BBY, Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar felt that everyone around him was constantly checking on his welfare, simil…

The Sith were a red-skinned species with tentacles, susceptible to using the dark side of the Force. They shared their name with the Sith Order, a religious organization of Force-sensitives who also used the dark side.

Sagamore was a planet that the Kotabi bond-twins Ceret and Terec, who served as Jedi Knights of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era, originated from. Alongside the planet Kotab, Sagamore was considered the twin's homeworld.

Grizal's moon was the single natural satellite of the planetoid Grizal, which was located in the Grizal system within the Hadar sector of the Mid Rim and Western Reaches. It was situated in grid square L-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The First Battle of Cyclor, also known as the attack on Cyclor, was a Nihil raid on the Cyclor Shipyards above Cyclor in the Mid Rim.

The Carnival District, also known as the Fair park, was a district of Lonisa City on Valo constructed for the Valo Republic Fair. It was divided into four zones, Arts and Culture, Faith and Life, Sport and Adventure, and Technology and Science.

The Isle of Seclusion was the name given by the ancients to a stretch of land on Ashla, the primary moon of the planet Tython. The isle was located in an ocean, and had warm, golden sand under a burning sun. The area was inhabited by carnivorous wingmaws.

The great cull was a massacre perpetrated by the ancient Sith upon the Talortai species over four thousand seasons before 231 BBY. The Talortai became an endangered species as a result, when their numbers had once been legion.

During the High Republic Era, the Drengir slaughtered many residents of the Outer Rim planet Daivak. The sentient carnivorous plants had emerged across the Galactic Frontier several months earlier, prompting an alliance between the Jedi Order and the Hutt Clan to combat them.
Sometime between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist Alliance, a battle occurred on the planet Neimoidia.

A security council was active within the government led by Queen Elarec Yovet of Shili. The security council was tasked with advising the Togruta leader on matters relating to her own security and protection.
Togruta intelligence was the intelligence service of the government of the Togruta species during the High Republic Era.

The Faith and Life zone was one of the four areas of the Carnival District in Lonisa City on Valo. As part of the grounds of the Valo Republic Fair, the Faith and Life zone contained the Starlight Pavilion, which represented the Starlight Beacon space station and the Jedi Order.
The Forbidden Gardens of Nuswatta was a point of interest located in the Nuswatta system of the Cronese Mandate sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

T0-B1 was a Force-sensitive droid that dreamed of being a Jedi. He was originally Tobi, the Padawan of Professor Mitaka. Although Tobi died during the Great Jedi Purge following Order 66, Mitaka placed his soul inside a droid body to resurrect him into T0-B1.
Trymant III was a moon of the planet Trymant IV, a world in the Outer Rim and Western Reaches regions of the galaxy.
Ost Molkar was a moon of the planet Trymant IV, a world in the Outer Rim and Western Reaches regions of the galaxy.
Taz Molkar was a moon of the planet Trymant IV, a world in the Outer Rim and Western Reaches regions of the galaxy.
The Mystic Nine were a group that existed by the High Republic Era. The Lariat of Armistice, an unbreakable rope that belonged to the Jedi Archives in 231 BBY, dated from the time of the Mystic Nine.

The "Super Sith team" was a group within the Executive Separatist Council, the governing body of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 20 BBY the Executive Separatist Council obtained secret battle plans of the Galactic Republic.

An Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship was used by Torrent Company in order to reach the Wild Space planet Teth. From the assault ship, the company deployed to the surface for the Battle of Teth.
2714 was a B1-series battle droid that served in the Trade Federation Droid Army. During the Naboo Crisis, 2714 fought against the Gungan Grand Army at the Great Grass Plains.

7824 was a B1-series battle droid that served in the Trade Federation Droid Army. During the Naboo Crisis, 7824 fought against the Gungan Grand Army at the Great Grass Plains. The B1's designation was written on the back of it's comlink booster pack.
6369 was a B1-series battle droid that served in the Trade Federation Droid Army. During the Naboo Crisis, 6369 was assigned to guard the entrance to the Theed Royal Palace throne room.

An Imperial doonium refinery was a doonium mine and refinery constructed near the Tann Province on Ryloth by the Galactic Empire shortly after its formation in 19 BBY.

The western outskirts were an area on the planet Ryloth that contained Sector 3. Early in the Imperial Era, a skirmish took place there between the Free Ryloth Movement and Imperial forces.

Gobi Glie's starship was a Rainhawk-class transport belonging to the Twi'lek freedom fighter Gobi Glie. He used the starship to give the young Hera Syndulla piloting lessons, although he would not let her do takeoffs or landings.
A variety of jellyfish was native to the planet Dac. Cloned tissue from the jellyfish was used to produce organic gills.

Shuttle two was a Rho-class transport shuttle stationed at the Imperial doonium refinery on the planet Ryloth shortly after its occupation by the Galactic Empire.
Sector five was a location on the planet Ryloth, situated just outside the capital city of Lessu and containing a large rock spire.

The Ultima II was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire that served under the command of Admiral Kalaxo.

Imperial Escort Boat Twenty-Nine was an Imperial escort boat that was stolen by members of the Free Ryloth Movement during the Ryloth Insurgency. Members of the movement used the escort boat in an attempt to assassinate Emperor Sheev Palpatine and Darth Vader.
By around 2 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's Thirty-Second Infantry was obliterated. The event resulted in the deaths of over 400 of the infantry group.

The Eriaduans were a cultural group of sentients who lived on the planet Eriadu, a world whose population included Humans and Rodians. Game hunting was important to their culture, which was also known for personal vendettas and political intrigue.

The western ridge was a location in a canyon on the planet Ryloth. Early in the Imperial Era, three members of the Free Ryloth Movement, including Lenk, observed Galactic Empire forces arrest their comrades Gobi Glie, Serin, and Hera Syndulla for weapons smuggling from the ridge.
During the Clone Wars, Twi'lek Resistance leader General Cham Syndulla operated out of a command outpost.
A Rho-class transport shuttle was in service to the Republic Medic Corps of the Galactic Republic in 19 BBY.
The Last Chance was a heavily modified YT-1300 light freighter owned by the smuggler Platt Okeefe. It had severeal features that distinguished it from the stock YT-1300.

Dee-Four was a rebel protocol droid. Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, it traveled to the asteroid outpost "Z-LOQ" with the rebel spy Alexsandr Kallus to receive information about Imperial technology from Grand-engineer Lony Coleema.

An obstacle course was located on the Outer Rim moon Noaxson. Designed by R2-D2 and constructed by Finn and Poe Dameron; the obstacle course was designed to help Rey train to be a Jedi so that she could accompany the two Resistance fighters on missions during the First Order-R…

Zeetar's Tempest was one of the three Tempests within the Nihil and was led by the Tempest Runner, Zeetar. It was formed as a result of the complete destruction of Kassav Milliko's Tempest during the Battle of Kur.

The Ahch-To Conservation Society was a society that supported the conservation of the planet Ahch-To. At least one poster made by the group requested that visitors of the planet not eat the native Porgs.

Wullffwarro's World of Wood was a location owned by the Wookiee Wullffwarro on the planet Kashyyyk. At least one of their advertisements requested that people visit it for classic Kashyyyk crafts, such as bowcasters or battle shields made of wroshyr.

SK-62O was an astromech droid present on Chandrila Star Line's MPO-1400 star cruiser Halcyon during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. The droid had special modifications that included an antenna.

Y-99 was a droid who served the crime lord Jabba the Hutt. The droid was one of several enforcers who Jabba sent to the Hutt homeworld of Nal Hutta to disrupt negotiations between the Hutts and the Jedi Order.

Irlings were a large, non-sentient species of insectoid ptero-creatures that lived on the planet Ord Mantell. They were nocturnal creatures, preferring dark environments such as caverns and mining tunnels, and would form hives made out of a web-like substance within them.

Underground mining tunnels were located in and around Ord Mantell City. Considered old by the beginning of the Imperial Era, the tunnels were largely unknown, although there were several entrances throughout the city, including one in Cid's Parlor.
The Spiderspun was a freighter in the service of the Byne Guild. A new, top-of-the-line starship, the Spiderspun was under the personal command of Scover Byne, the Guild's leader.
The Kestrel's Dive was a starship in the fleet of the Byne Guild during the High Republic Era. It was crewed by the parents of Affie Hollow, who were indentured to Guild leader Scover Byne.

The Ministry of Commerce was a ministry of the Galactic Republic. They had offices on Coruscant which were visited by Sylvestri Yarrow while she was attempting to warn the Republic about Nihil operations in the Berenge sector.

The Vendetta was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer.

Vollka were a species of hunting cats that were native to Mirran Six. They were nearly the size of small humans but not as large as targons, another feline species, and they had green and blue rosette markings.

The Great Hyperspace Rush was an onrush to map and claim the existing yet unknown hyperspace routes as the Galactic Republic expanded into the outer regions of the galaxy during the High Republic Era, which had yet to be well mapped.
The Grand Theljian snow dog, or simply known as a snow dog, was a type of large dog that could be kept as a pet.
The San Tekka conglomerate was a corporation owned by the San Tekka clan, a family who had gained influence by the time of the High Republic Era for their work as hyperspace prospectors.

Chortose was an astronomical object situated in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories, inhabited by the Chortose species. During the High Republic Era, Agricultural Hub 42 was a factory situated on Chortose.
The Chortose were a sentient species that resided on Chortose, an astronomical object in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The species had a small stature and was covered in brown fur.
Hangar 272 was a hangar of the Galactic Empire's second Death Star. Emperor Palpatine used the hangar to arrive on the Death Star.
The Great Work was a program run by the government of the planet At Attin to produce Republic credits as a way of helping the Galactic Republic.
The geological survey team was an Alliance to Restore the Republic ground surveying team that investigated the surface of Ab Dalis to ensure that it was safe to establish a rebel outpost.

The dark science laboratory was located in the cavernous Sith Citadel on the planet Exegol. The Sith Eternal, a Sith cult loyal to the Sith Lord Darth Sidious, used the laboratory for genetic experimentation.

Daro was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Ojoster sector. It was covered primarily in forests that enveloped its mountainous terrain, and the available galactic information on Daro implied that the planet was uninhabited, housing no settlements or ins…

Cellblock 25 was a detention area located on level six of the Galactic Empire military base on the planet Daro. After he attempted to desert, the clone commando Captain Gregor was imprisoned in the facility before being rescued by Clone Force 99.

Level six was a level in an Imperial base on the Outer Rim Territories planet Daro. Cellblock 25, where the clone commando Gregor was held after he attempted to desert, was located on the floor. The level was protected by TK troopers and Imperial commandos such as Scorch.
J6-F8 was an RX-series pilot droid that piloted a transport shuttle operating out of Batuu's Black Spire Outpost.

The attack on Kamino, which included the destruction of Tipoca City and decommissioning of the Kaminoan cloning facilities, was carried out by Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart and the clones under his command around 19 BBY following an operation to withdraw all useful assets from th…

Ta'klah was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories. In 232 BBY, when it fell under threat from an Emergence in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, Jedi Master Stellan Gios and other Jedi arrived to help Ta'klah's inhabitants.

Rendezvous Point Lambda-Four was a Rebel Alliance rendezvous point, situated on the edge of an impact crater on the Outer Rim Territories planet Ab Dalis. The rendezvous point contained a resupply depot and mechanical facilities for repairs.
Reerez was one of four planets located in the Mygeeto system of the Albarrio sector, which was located in both the Outer Rim and New Territories regions.

Pergoomi was one of several planets in the Mygeeto system of the Albarrio sector, which was located in the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories regions. In close orbit to the star of Malola, Pergoomi was an airless rock that was orbited by several moons.
Itzeho was one of the planets located within the Mygeeto system of the Albarrio sector, situated in both the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories regions.

At some point before the Clone Wars, a short civil war occurred on the city-world of Troithe. The war, between the planet's human majority and its mixed-species underclass, was manipulated in part by an ambitious aristo-mercantile family seeking to profit.

During the High Republic Era, the Nihil marauder organization attacked Agricultural Hub 42, a factory on the Rseik sector astronomical object Chortose. The marauders, whose forces were led by a Storm, wished to steal the factory's sprayer droids for their own purposes.

The battle on Mulita was an assault during the High Republic Era that the Jedi Order and Hutt Clan undertook on Mulita, the homeworld of the sentient carnivorous plants known as the Drengir, located in the Mulita system, deep within Wild Space.
A Munificent-class star frigate was utilized by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Following the war, the Munificent-class star frigate was left as a derelict.
Mrlsst was a terrestrial astronomical objectin the Mrlsst system in the Tapani sector of the Colonies from which an artist hailed.
Meerou's fortress was an asteroid fortress owned by the Orooturooian crime lord Meerou Woodring. The asteroid was defended by numerous sentry droids and was armed with high powered weaponry.
The Draethos were a sentient humanoid species. A Nihil Storm was a member of the species. They possessed massive teeth and had blue-colored skin, black eyes, and four-fingered hands.
The Krayt's Honor was a modified Gozanti-class cruiser owned by the Kel Dor Siqo Vass prior to the Clone Wars.

Dinbar was a location on the planet Elrood which hosted a moderately-sized starport. The former SoroSuub Corporation technician Dai Danu had stolen starship armaments and equipment berthed at the starport by his clients.

A moderately-sized starport was located in Dinbar, a location on the planet Elrood. At one point the former SoroSuub Corporation technician Dai Danu had his clients off-load stolen starship armaments and equipment to a cargo ship at the spaceport.

Seikosha was the fourth planet in the Breago system, a star system located in the Trans-Hydian Borderlands region of the Outer Rim Territories. Cryospac Repulsorlift Corporation, who produced the Model 90 Ranger landspeeder, was based on the planet.
Heat-flies were a type of fly that lived on Elphrona, a hot Outer Rim planet. The flies featured large, compound eyes that were visibly similar to those of Cyclorrians, a sentient insectoid species.
TK stormtroopers, commonly known by the shortened name of TK troopers, were an early generation of non-clone stormtroopers who served the Galactic Empire.

Genetians were a race of humans hailing from the astronomical object Genetia. Force-sensitive Genetians, such as Imri Cantaros, possessed powerful empathic abilities which could be difficult to control without the proper training.
The Evereni were a sentient humanoid nomadic species, distinguished by their slate-gray skin and pitch-black eyes.

The Vengeful Goddess was an experimental starship constructed by the Graf family's company during the High Republic Era. Built at a Graf-owned shipyard on Corellia, the Goddess was initially owned by family scion Xylan Graf, and kept at the Graf compound near Neral's moon.

The Resplendent Pearl was a yacht owned by Xylan Graf. He traveled to Everbloom, the family's space station estate, accompanied by his bodyguard Basha, the pilot Sylvestri Yarrow, Jordanna Sparkburn, and the Jedi Cohmac Vitus, Vernestra Rwoh, Imri Cantaros, and Reath Silas.
T'onga's crew was a crew of bounty hunters and assassins put together by the bounty hunter T'onga during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

The Fraunesaa was a hauler starship belonging to the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. The ship had been seized from a Hutt after he had been forced to stop at the Starlight Beacon space station, and added to the fleet of ships overseen by Jedi Master Nubarron.

Bora-finches were a type of yellow-and-blue bird.

x: Early in the Imperial Era, Clone Force 99 launched a mission to rescue their leader, Hunter, from the Galactic Empire. Hunter had been captured on Daro while the squad was rescuing another clone, Gregor, from Imperial custody.
The Graceful Promising was a Vontorian treasure ship. At one point by 10 BBY, it became cracked apart and settled in an orbit around a dark star.

Perithal was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Perithal system of the Inner Rim Territories which the New Republic Senator Wyl Lark visited around 11 ABY, before he traveled over to Spirana to meet Yrica Quell and Chass na Chadic, who he had fought with as a New Republi…

Section nine was a region of the Ring of Kafrene, a trading post located in the Thand sector. Shortly before the Battle of Scarif, Cassian Jeron Andor and Tivik met in the sector, an encounter than provided Andor with intelligence about the Death Star and led to the deaths of …
Bay 2 was a hangar bay onboard the Shield Gate space station that orbited the planet Scarif. Immediately before the Battle of Scarif, Bay 2 was undergoing a tractor beam test.

Bay 8 was a hangar bay located aboard the Golan M3185 Shield Gate that defended the world of Scarif. Directly prior to Battle of Scarif, Bay 8 was one of several hangar bays involved in a tractor beam test.

Aloxians were a sentient species from the planet Zav Alox on the edge of the galaxy. Most young Aloxians wore helmets made from the skulls of vonduun crabs. Born with immense strength, Aloxians were prized as child soldiers.

Platform five was a location in Tipoca City on Kamino. Early in the Imperial Era, members of Clone Force 99 entered the city via the platform while attempting to rescue their leader, Hunter, from the Galactic Empire.
The massacre of Tu'oon was carried out by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing at Tu'oon during the reign of the Empire.
Convergence was the ancestral home of House Palpatine in Naboo's Lake Country.

The clan led by the Nightbrother Mak Eak was active during the Clone Wars. One of their former clan members, Arzo Suun, escaped from the planet Dathomir but sought to smuggle medical supplies, basic technology, and sophisticated long-range comm-systems to his former village le…

A species of humanoid beings resided on the forested planet Bri'n. Some members of the species held great value in the many trees that covered the world, but a faction known as the Metal Clan desired to destroy the venerated plants.

Argiopid was a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, one member of the species was present at the Auction for Han Solo that was hosted by Crimson Dawn, on the planet Jekara.

A mountain was located at the Mitth family's homestead below the surface of Csilla, the homeworld of the Chiss species. Mitth family merit adoptives who wished to become Trial-borns visited the homestead to perform their Trials, the last of which involved climbing the mountain.
Dubraib was a waterworld in the Cegul sector's Dubraib system, located in the Outer Rim Territories and the Western Reaches, It was situated in grid square M-20 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The charr ant was a type of ant found on the Mid Rim planet Kashyyyk that shared a symbiotic relationship with the shi-shok tree.

An uprising occurred on Molos against the Galactic Empire. King Amand and his sympathizers, as well as members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic fought against the Empire on Molopolis and were victorious.

The Battle of Molopolis was a battle on the city Molopolis on Molos between the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and the Galactic Empire. Following a civilian uprising on Molos, King Amand and his army fought against the Imperial Army's reinforcements.
Mount Bikja was a mountain on Alaris Prime that was the location of the Yallow Shrine, a sanctum once used by the Yallow Fellowship, a group affiliated with the dark side of the Force.
An Imperial diplomatic legation for the Core Worlds planet Coruscant was led by the mother of the Apprentice Legislator Chassellon Stevis by 3 BBY.
Sanyassans were a humanoid species in the the galaxy; among its members was a pirate named Gruk who led other individuals of the species in criminal escapades during the New Republic Era.
A type of fish lived in the oceans of the planet Kamino.

Athiss was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories' Athiss system, which was in the Sith Worlds portion of the Esstran sector. It was situated in grid square R-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Naratar was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Naratar system within the Wornal sector of the Mid Rim. It was situated in grid square K-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Yallow Fellowship was an organization affiliated with the dark side of the Force. Dying out long before 241 BBY, the Fellowship had a sanctum, the Yallow Shrine, located on Mount Bikja which was full of artifacts.

The Three Suns Overlook was a high-altitude observation spot in the Batuu Wilds, in Batuu. It overlooked giant spires and rugged, rocky canyons with low vegetation. In 34 ABY, a droid repair technician went there to retrieve some cargo for Mubo.

The Batuu Wilds was an undeveloped region of the planet Batuu. It was composed of giant spires and rugged, rocky canyons. Some points of interest included the Three Suns Overlook, the Dead Root Refuge and the Hissiq Springs.

Hissiq Springs was an area in the Batuu Wilds, in Batuu. It was a system of rugged, rocky canyons with green liquid flowing. In 34 ABY, a droid repair technician went there to retrieve some cargo for Mubo.
Dead Root Refuge was a high area in the Batuu Wilds, in Batuu. It overlooked giant spires and rugged, rocky canyons. In 34 ABY, a droid repair technician went there to retrieve some cargo for Mubo.

The zalaaca was a species native to the planet Naboo. Its appearance partly inspired the design of Baktoid Industrial Systems' Versatile-Athletic Walker, which was nicknamed the "zalaaca walker" after the species.

Mount Tantiss was a mountain on the planet Wayland that hosted Tantiss Base. During the early days of the Imperial Era, the Galactic Empire relocated its cloning program from the extragalactic planet Kamino to the Wayland facility, establishing it as the headquarters for the s…

The clan led by the Nightbrother Freff was active during the Imperial Era. They served the Nardithi Nightsisters who lived on the planet Dathomir. After they were wiped out during the Battle of Dathomir in 20 BBY, the clan served the one surviving Nardithi Nightsister, Jerserra.
Hoojibs were a sentient species of small, white-furred beings from the planet Arbra. They had long ears and an antenna on the top of their heads, and moved on four legs.
Kul Kenada Spaceport was a spaceport settlement on the Outer Rim Territories astronomical object Blarrum. The town had several levels, and was built into the side of a rock face.
Wyke Town was a settlement located on the Galactic Frontier astronomical object Loreth. The community was founded by Layton Wyke, a human from Naratar, during the High Republic Era.

Temple Peak was a mountain located on Loreth, an astronomical object located on the Galactic Frontier. The mountain was named by Layton Wyke, founder of the nearby settlement of Wyke Town, after a temple on his homeworld of Naratar.
The lyuna was a quadrupedal creature possessing long necks, two tall, spiked humps on their backs, hooves, and a tail. They were known for being stubborn but hardworking.
Reindeer were horned creatures that lived in the galaxy. The Dathomirian Zabrak Darth Maul had cranial horns which he could use to impersonate reindeer. Santa Claus owned reindeer.

The Izvoshra were an elite cadre of Kaleesh warriors assembled and served as loyal bodyguards of the Kaleesh warlord Qymaen jai Sheelal, the man who became Grievous, on their native homeworld of Kalee.
Parein II 4 was the fourth moon of the planet Parein II within the Parein system in the Sarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The moon was the scene of the first real test for the MagnaGuards.
A skirmish took place on the starship of famous actress Risha Synata. Synata was a spy for the Confederacy of Independent Systems and worked under Count Dooku.

The Arms Market was a market located in Wormtown, on the moon Nar Shaddaa. In 3 ABY, the bounty hunters Valance and Dengar went to the market, since Dengar assured that Devono Vix, an arms dealer, could tell them why Jabba the Hutt put a bounty on his former favorite bounty hu…
Betting houses were located on the planet Galator III. Around 4 BBY, the human male Kes Dameron and his friend put together some money and decided to play in the betting houses.

x: In 34 ABY, a cargo transport owned by Mubo—the owner of Droid Depot—and J-4X was attacked and boarded by a Guavian Death Gang cell led by Tara Rashin.

x: The Battle of Ab Dalis was a battle that occurred on Ab Dalis between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire during the Alliance's Operation Starlight.

Adepts were Force-sensitive Nightbrothers whom were trained to use the Force in order to augment their physical abilities to improve their skills as assassins and bodyguards in service to the Nightsisters.

The "Lando ordeal" was the name the Tonnika sisters used to describe an event involving at least themselves, the smuggler Han Solo, and smuggler Landonis Balthazar Calrissian. The ordeal was Solo's idea, yet he would blame the outcome of the event on the sisters.
Ateseven was a security droid on Starlight Beacon.
Around 36 BBY, skirmish took place in the Chiss Ascendancy's Kinoss system between the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet and pirates of the Lioaoin Regime.

The pirate attack at Stivic, also known as the Stivic incident, was a conflict of the Lioaoin pirate campaign around 35 BBY The incident began with Lioaoin pirates attacking a Garwian merchant station over the Garwian Unity planet Stivic, a trade hub for the local nations of t…
Blockade Two was one of four Nikardun blockade frigates stationed by the forces of the Nikardun Destiny to blockade the Rapacc system during the Nikardun conquests.
Blockade Three was one of four Nikardun blockade frigates stationed by the forces of the Nikardun Destiny to blockade the Rapacc system during the Nikardun conquests.
Blockade Four was one of four Nikardun blockade frigates stationed by the forces of the Nikardun Destiny to blockade the Rapacc system during the Nikardun conquests.
Blockade One was one of four Nikardun blockade frigates stationed by the forces of the Nikardun Destiny to blockade the Rapacc system during the Nikardun conquests.

x: The mission to Pijal was a mission undertaken by the Jedi Knight Rael Averross to serve as the lord regent of the Inner Rim planet Pijal for the Pijali Princess Fanry from around 48 BBY to 40 BBY.
The Lioaoin High Command was a branch of the Lioaoin Regime.

The skirmish above Solitair was a conflict of the Lioaoin pirate campaign above the planet Solitair, homeworld of the Garwian species and capital of the Garwian Unity, several years before the defeat of the Nikardun Destiny in 19 BBY.
Doc Ragon's clinic was a clinic located on the moon Nar Shaddaa that was owned by the criminal doctor Ragon.
An order of monks operated on Kashyyyk. The order made use of a model of vibroknuckler known as the Sayormi Heartstriker.

H7-09, nicknamed Aychseven, was a droid who was a member of the Nihil marauder organization. The droid served in the Tempest of Tempest Runner Lourna Dee, operating aboard her starship, the Lourna Dee.

A droid was owned by Xet, a Falleen member of the Black Sun criminal syndicate who was secretly a spy for the Crimson Dawn syndicate. The droid communicated in whirring sounds and hovered in the air, possessing gray plating and a single blue sensor.

The Dark Syndicate was a War Cruiser utilized by the Son-tuul Pride criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era. The cruiser, commanded by a member of the syndicate, was present above the planet Jekara during Crimson Dawn's auction of the carbonite-frozen smuggler Han Solo.

Lake was the denomination of an Asteroid field located in the Aakaash system within the Oplovis sector of the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories. It was situated in grid square M-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid, and located between the planets Land and Wind.
A cheating charge was leveled against Mitth'raw'nuru (core name "Thrawn") while he was a cadet at the Chiss Ascendancy's Taharim Academy on Naporar.

A skirmish occurred in the Daalang system between Lieutenant Luke Skywalker of the Rebel Alliance and an Immobilizer 418 cruiser of the Galactic Empire after Skywalker and his starship, the Desert Jewel, were pulled out of hyperspace by the cruiser.
A gang of Pakiphantos was led by Trunc Adurmush, a male of that species.
Deneba was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Deneba system in the Maerdocian sector of the Mid Rim Territories that housed a temple known to former Jedi Master Cohmac Vitus.

Drogheda was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Drogheda system, within the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice regions. It was situated in grid square Q-11 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Coonee was a planet in the Brevost sector of the Expansion Region. According to a theory from smuggler Tregga, the Wookiee Chewbacca raised an orphaned Han Solo after the end of the Clone Wars, and before being captured by the Galactic Empire on the planet Mimban they made the…

Saberhing was a planet in the galaxy. The smuggler Tregga theorized that before being captured by the Galactic Empire on Mimban, the Wookiee Chewbacca raised an orphaned Han Solo, and they together made their living on planets such as Coonee and Saberhing.

During the early Clone Wars, a battle occurred on the moon of Caliban after General Grievous invaded it. Captured by Grievous, Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi and members of his 212th Attack Battalion allied with the native Qubeys.

Piroket was a world located in the Piroket system in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, situated in grid square R-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid near the desert planet Tatooine, which was located in the Tatoo system of the Outer Rim Territories' Arkanis sector.

The Lourna Dee was the flagship of Lourna Dee, Tempest Runner in the Nihil marauder organization, following the loss of her previous starship of the same name. The vessel was formerly the Restitution, a correctional ship of the Galactic Republic.
The Holwuff were a sentient species in the galaxy. One, Rogwa Wodrata was a senator.

x: The Primea diplomatic reception was a diplomatic mission hosted by the Vak Combine on the Vak homeworld of Primea in 19 BBY. Primea served as a hub for trade and diplomacy in the region, and as such, many nations sent representatives to the reception.

Ashas Rine was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Ashas Rine system within the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. It was situated in grid square R-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Zallo was an astronomical object located in the Zallo system of the Outer Rim's Tamarin sector. In 231 BBY, after obtaining intel stating that the Nihil pirates were massing in the Soola system, Jedi marshal Avar Kriss requested to Jedi High Council Member Stellan Gios that sh…
The Battle of Takodana, also known as the attack on Takodana, was a Nihil raid on the planet Takodana during the High Republic Era.

The Ransacker was a Nihil Stormship utilized by the Jedi Order during an attempted infiltration of the pirate group. The starship had been acquired by the Jedi after the attack on the Nihil base on Grizal.
The Battle of Grizal, also known as the infiltration of Grizal, was fought in the aftermath of the attack on Valo when the Jedi attacked the Nihil base on Grizal.

R6-W1CH was a R6 astromech droid that had a red, black, and white body, with a black sensor. She also wore a tall, pointed black hat. The droid was known to aid a coven of witches in their wielding of dark magic.

Splintered Spire was a high area in the Batuu Wilds region of the planet Batuu. By 34 ABY, a Guavian Death Gang cell led by Quarren pirate Tara Rashin established a base there, until they were rooted out by a droid repair technician running errands for cantina-owner Seezelslak.

Shard was a cold moon in the Outer Rim Territories. Controlled by the Galactic Empire, it was the site of a battle during the Galactic Civil War where the Alliance to Restore the Republic attacked Shard's Imperial base.

Sran was a rocky planet situated within the Ash Worlds. It was prone to storms that kicked up dust. The Nihil Strike Andrik Keller visited Sran after he escaped the Battle of Galov, in which the Galactic Republic and Jedi Order captured numerous Nihil marauders, including Temp…

A celebration took place on the planet Serenno in the capital city of Carannia in 90 BBY. The celebration's objective was to show what the Outer Rim Territories planets could offer to the Galactic Republic. The count of Serenno Gora presided over the event.

objective: Establish a base for the Rebel Alliance
x: A mission was undertaken by Alliance to Restore the Republic operatives Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker to the planet Bogano between 0 ABY and 3 ABY during the Galactic Civil War.

Magaveene was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Prefsbelt sector's Magaveene system as part of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories and New Territories, situated in grid square K-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Karvoss Dawn was a Longbeam cruiser utilized by the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era.
Spearhead was an ancient fortress city on the planet Naboo, home of the rogue Gungan warlord Boss Rogoe.

The Pinnacle was a large rock spire located along the Mos Espa podrace circuit, in the middle of the Mos Espa Grand Arena on Tatooine. Centuries ago, the rock pinnacle was a sacred site for tribes of Tusken Raiders.
Bosthirda was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Bosthirda system in the Sith Worlds, a region of the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had a brown and black surface.
The Silver Knights were a group of mercenaries active in 200 BBY. They were led by captain Li Yu of the Silver Dawn, along with his protocol droid White.

The Pinnacle was a location controlled by the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. In 231 BBY, while temporarily imprisoned aboard the Republic space station Starlight Beacon, the Nihil Storm Tasia spoke to Lourna Dee—her Tempest Runner who was also imprisoned aboar…

Novor was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Novor system of the Outer Rim's Tharin sector. During the High Republic Era, the Hutt Clan sent the enforcer Ola Hest to Novor to collect protection money from a children's medcenter run by the Sisters of the Ninth Plane.
B-14961138815 was a B1-series battle droid who at one point broke a door on Fortress Vader with an ax which scared Hutt crime lord, Graballa.
DD-1A, also known as Deedee-Wunay, or simply as Deedee, was a droid that served the Jedi Order on the planet Banchii during the High Republic Era.

During the occupation of the Twi'lek colony on the planet of Aaloth, the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Quellus, who served as an emissary of the Sith Empire, was dispatched to conquer the world and incorporate it to the Sith dominion within the galaxy.
Hon-Tallos was a terrestrial planet in the Inugg system. During the High Republic Era, the Jedi Order operated a temple on Hon-Tallos.
Spinnaker was a coastal city on the planet Naboo that was inhabited by the human Naboo. The city featured numerous buildings with tan walls and green domed roofs.

Water chicken was a creature from the Aakaash system planet Water. It was used in various dishes of the star system, including Water chicken meat pie and Water egg fried rice, or could be eaten fried. It was an egg-laying organism.
The spring village on the Aakaash system planet Wind was supplied by the Silver Knights group of mercenaries.
Banchiians were a diminutive avian sentient species native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Banchii.
The Silver Dawn was a starship used by the Silver Knights, a group of mercenaries led by Li Yu alongside protocol droid White.
Green Radish Hill was a hill in Green Dawn, the capital city of Begamor. The presidential manor of Jamie Brasson was located there.

R5-D56, often referred to as R5, was an astromech droid that was the faithful companion of the former Sith known as the Ronin. He traveled with the Ronin through the edge of the Outer Rim Territories in the time following the Sith rebellion against the Jedi.
A sentient species resided on the planet Ridlay. A group of the species lived in a settlement consisting of stone structures, situated near the Ascension Well.

The Ascension Well was a hole in the rocky terrain of the planet Ridlay. During the planet's total eclipses every fifty years, beings that Ridlay's inhabitants believed to be spirits rose from the Ascension Well.

A terrestrial astronomical object was orbited by two sets of planetary rings and featured forested and mountain terrain. During the Imperial Era, the Gamorrean criminal Crob Vel, alongside several other members of his species, operated on the astronomical object.

A crew led by the Ubese bounty hunter Boushh was active during the Imperial Era. Consisting of Brene, Hareck, Ilini, and Tans, who were also Ubese as well. They all, like Boushh, had been exiled from Uba IV.
Kragan Gorr's shuttle was a unique shuttle made from scavenged Imperial Lambda-class T-4a shuttle parts by the pirate organization known as the Warbird gang.
A ship was owned by "Jixtus," an agent of the Grysk warlike species during his campaign against the Chiss Ascendancy.
A starship was captained by Haplif, an Agbui agent of the expansionist Grysk species in the Unknown Regions.
A freighter was utilized by Agbui agents of the Grysk warlike species to transport the valuable metal nyix.

objective: Investigate lack of communications
x: During the Clone Wars, Jedi General Mace Windu and Lightning Squadron were sent on a mission to the planet Ridlay to investigate its lack of communications.

The Freedom Fighter was a GR-75 medium transport that served in the Alliance Fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Following the Battle of Yavin, the Freedom Fighter was one of multiple transports that evacuated Alliance personnel on the surface.
Vespaara was a rocky planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the Grand Arena, where individuals from across the galaxy competed in the Hunters of the Outer Rim tournament.

J-3DI, also referred to as Jay-Threedeeaye, or simply Jay-Three, was a unique droid who had been programmed to believe that he possessed the Force and was a Jedi Knight. He had plating in the style of Jedi robes and wielded a blue-bladed lightsaber.
Utooni was the name taken by a pair of Jawa brothers and scrappers active following the fall of the Galactic Empire. The two Jawas participated in the Hunters of the Outer Rim tournament on Vespaara.
Hunters of the Outer Rim was a competitive sporting show hosted within the Grand Arena on the planet Vespaara that saw various warriors from across the galaxy engage in combat.
The Sabracci Sages were a group of Force-sensitive Zeffonians that operated by the High Republic Era. Their teachings included the ability to stand on a vertical surface without falling.

K-344, nicknamed Kurti, was a droid who was the guitarist of the band Star Waver. Formerly abandoned, K-344 found her purpose in music. She had a calm demeanor and an authoritative tone, but let her playing do most of the talking.

TD-4 was a droid that was the constant companion of Lop on the planet Tao. The droid possessed a number of abilities and tools that included a recording functionality, capturing moments of Lop's life, from her time as an orphan through until becoming part of a family.

B-2ON was a protocol droid that served the twins Am and Karre, Dark Lords of the T-Empire. At some point after the Battle of Exegol of 35 ABY, B-2ON was with Am in her throne room aboard a Gemini-class Star Destroyer.

R-DUO was an R-series astromech droid who served Am and Karre, Dark Lords of the T-Empire. At some point after the Battle of Exegol of 35 ABY, while aboard a Gemini-class Star Destroyer, R-DUO accompanied Karre as he entered the Star Destroyer's reactor core chamber, where he …

x: In 3 ABY, the crew of the Ubese bounty hunter Boushh fought in a skirmish aboard the Acquisitor against the Tagge Corporation led by Lady Domina Tagge, after they had been hired by Crimson Dawn to eliminate the individuals on the corporation's Executive Board.

The Ancient Quarter was a historical preservation district in the Gungan capital city Otoh Gunga on the planet Naboo. It encompassed the original foundations laid by Boss Gallo over the foundations of Spearhead, an ancient fortress city.
The Grizmallti were the human inhabitants of the planet Grizmallt in the Core Worlds. Their religion involved the worship of a deity named Nabu.

A colony ship was part of a group of colony ships containing human Grizmallti refugees that fled a civil war on the planet Grizmallt in approximately 4,000 BBY. The ship crashed on the planet Naboo, and the humans from the ships colonized the world, becoming the Naboo people.
Manress was a planet located in the Manress system in the Inner Rim Territories. The world was home to the sentient Stokhli species as well as megafauna that were hunted using spray sticks.

x: During the Galactic Civil War, the Bothan Spynet undertook an intelligence operation on behalf of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Arkanian Offshoots were a sub-species of the Arkanian race, genetically engineered by the famed Arkanian scientists. The Jedi Knight Dagan Gera was a member of the sub-species.
The Honor Guard were highly trained guards assigned to protect Lady Domina Tagge while she served as the head of the Tagge Corporation, a wealthy and powerful company owned by the House of Tagge.
FX-6 was an FX-9 surgical assistant that built Grievous after the Kaleesh was involved in a gruesome shuttle crash that almost killed him and destroyed most of his original body.
Valron was a planet that contained the Sacred Garden used by Jedi to train their apprentices. It was visited by Ady Sun'Zee and her apprentice Nooa during the High Republic Era.
A DH-Omni Support Vessel was commanded by Separatist General Grievous at the mission to Utapau in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars.

Hy Izlan was an icy tundra planet situated in the Outer Rim Territories. In a time long after the fall of the Jedi Order, the planet was ruled by Margrave Juro, who sought to restore the Jedi with the help of the lightsabersmith Lah Zhima.
V-5 was a droid musician and member of the band Star Waver. V-5 mixed electronic sounds for the band.

x: In the time following the Battle of Exegol, the dark side adept Karre and his astromech droid, R-DUO, sought to escape a Gemini-class Star Destroyer with the kyber crystal that powered it.

The Edgehawk was a starship used by the bounty hunter T'onga and her wife, Losha Tarkon, in their search for Cadeliah, the heir to both the Unbroken Clan and the Mourner's Wail Syndicate who had the potential to unite both criminal syndicates.

Vamga were creatures found on mountains of the Outer Rim Territories planet Habo. They were known to be dangerous, although, according to Jedi Master Tajin Crosser, they typically did not attack unless provoked.
Habo was an inhabited planet situated in the Outer Rim Territories. The residents of Habo had a reputation for being shy, and visitors were not common to the planet.

Tao was a continental planet with rich nature and tradition, situated in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet had struggled to modernize despite its rich resources, and, during the Imperial Era, accepted Galactic Empire occupation in exchange for industrial advancement.
Keelia was a terrestrial planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It had lush forests, rivers, and large rock formations.

The Rolling Gales was a starship that served as the mobile headquarters and concert stage of the band Star Waver. It was piloted by the droid K-344 and carried her fellow band members Lan Ar-Shoo, Jay, V-5, and Geezer Odajion.

An RA-7 protocol droid bounty hunter served as a guard of a village on the planet Genbara, as part of a group of guards commanded by a Trandoshan. When the village was attacked by a group of bandits led by a Sith named Kouru, the guards attempted to defend the villagers.

In 19 BBY, during the Clone Wars, Jedi Commander Jay and a force of the Republic Military took part in a battle against the Separatist Droid Army. While fleeing blasterfire, Jay fell into a vehicle belonging to the Hutt guitarist Geezer Odajion.
Meevai Village was a small settlement on the planet Keelia.
C03 was a small droid living in the residence of Professor Mitaka, one of several droids in his possession. C03 often tagged along with T0-B1, such as in his quest for kyber crystals.

Emita was a settlement on the planet Chandrila. New Republic Senator Leia Organa directed Captain Lina Graf to a bar in Emita when Lina sought transport to Mustafar in search of her missing brother Milo and the droid CR-8R.
T-Stormtroopers were soldiers who served the T-Empire commanded by twin dark side adepts Am and Karre, who were created though the dark side of the Force to bring Imperial rule back to the galaxy.

The wampa Unkajo had a lair located in an icy valley on the surface of the planet Hoth. The Rebel Alliance had abandoned several stardrop torpedoes which they had used to eliminate asteroids, and the Galactic Empire recovered all but one due to its proximity to Unkajo's lair.

99-99, nicknamed Four-Nines, was a droid companion to Lah Kara on the Outer Rim planet Hy Izlan. The droid was capable of self-propelled flight and of firing blaster bolts that Kara could deflect with a lightsaber.

An Imperial base on Tao was attacked at least seven years into the Imperial Era. Tao, a resource-rich but undeveloped planet in the Outer Rim Territories, accepted the Empire's rule in exchange for assistance developing.

Gramps was a boatman droid who was stationed on the planet Hy Izlan for the purposing of ferrying organic beings. Old, slow, and cantankerous, the boatman greatly preferred sipping warm fluid on the icy planet as opposed to doing its job.

A nue was, according to a song, a nocturnal creature. When human Jedi Tsubaki trekked to a royal palace to confront Sith Lord Masago, Tsubaki's travel guides Senshu and Kamahachi sang the song that referred to a nue that cried, believing the music had the power to ward off evi…
Kaddyr bugs were chirping insects indigenous to Ossus.

Knossa was a major city that, according to the quasi-historical Qel-Droma Epics, existed on the Jedi planet Ossus. According to the Epics, Knossa was built from stone and bronzium, and its squat domes were located high in the western Eocho Mountains.

The kirruk was a reptilian native to Ossus. Quadrupeds, kirruk were domesticated by the Ysanna following the planet's ruin during the Cron Supernova. They were named for their squawking call, and served as mounts for their Ysanna masters.
Airtight Base was one of the notable bodies within the Hoth asteroid belt, which overlapped the boundries of the Hoth system and Anoat system in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Genbara was a planet located at the fringe of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was blanketed with pines and villages nestled in mountainous valleys. Twenty years after the failed Sith rebellion, the former Sith known as the Ronin came to Genbara.

A scaled boar was a type of large boar with scales. One scaled boar was used to pull a woman's wagon as they traveled as part of a group of individuals on the road to Osou spaceport on the Outer Rim planet Genbara.

The attack on Harrikos Fifteen was an engagement between New Republic Intelligence and the Galactic Empire in the Harrikos system at the Harrikos-Fifteen Research Station.

The Norikus gang was a gang led by an Octeroid male during the High Republic Era that prowled the lower levels of Coruscant. The gang had many members, some of whom included the Octeroid ringleader, a long-limbed Lepi, and a female Nephran with tattooed pincers.

F's ship was a Clone Z-95 Headhunter flown by the fugitive Jedi F in the time between 19 BBY and 1 BBY. F used the starfighter to travel to the planet Keelia after being summoned there by an old ally, Valco.

Alzarians were a reptilian sentient species from the Alzar system. During the High Republic Era, one Alzarian was a member of the Nihil and would later participate during the Nihil attack on Valo.
The Forshul were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy that possessed long gray hair. During the High Republic Era, at least one Forshul was present on Valo during the Nihil attack on Valo.
Emmerians were a sentient species from the Emmer system. During the High Republic Era, one member of the Nihil was an Emmerian Cloud who was part of Pan Eyta's Tempest.

An Alpha Team was led by expert Commander Halka Four-Den during the Republic Era. At one point, the Alpha Team was dispatched to the planet Dagobah in order to chart and map the extending borders of the Galactic Republic and learn more about Dagobah's flora and fauna.
The Aurora was a specialized refueling tanker utilized by the Confederacy of Independent Systems' naval forces during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.

Riot Mar's starfighter was a customized Helix J-104 starfighter used by the bounty hunter Riot Mar. Riot Mar's starfighter was destroyed by the Mandalorian Din Djarin's gunship the Razor Crest, during a fight between the two in the Tatoo system, in 9 ABY.
The Feast of Lord-Protector Jarmanidath was a holiday from the Colonies region which was approved by the Galactic Empire's Culture Ministry.

Mucous salamanders were salamanders native to the rivers of the jungle moon Yavin 4. The moon's spider angler organisms weaved their webs above murky river water in order to search for and catch mucous salamanders.

A mountain range was located on the planet Genbara in the Outer Rim Territories. According to a woodcutter who lived nearby, there had once been four villages near the mountain range, but by two decades after the Sith rebellion, at most one village remained.
A cruiser was part of the Galactic Republic Navy during the Clone Wars, with Commander Prakas serving aboard the craft during the rescue of Galen Erso.

Q-2, also spelled as Cuetoo, was a droid that assisted the Jedi Master and investigator Emerick Caphtor during the High Republic Era. The droid accompanied him on missions and had the ability to perch on his shoulder.

The kublag was a type of creature found on the forest moon of Endor. They had six legs, broad antlers, and glossy skin. During an especially bleak winter on Endor, a group of Ewoks from Bright Tree Village caught a kublag while out hunting for essential supplies.
Moon moths were a type of moth with white wings that were found on the forest moon of Endor in the Outer Rim Territories.

The spilesnark was a type of creature found on Endor, a forest moon in the Outer Rim Territories. During a particularly bleak winter on Endor between 1 BBY and 4 ABY, the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick wished to leave his home in Bright Tree Village and see the snow covered forest…

The Conquest was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that saw service during the Galactic Civil War. It served in Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader's personal fleet, Death Squadron, when the unit was stationed in the Juris sector shortly prior to the Battle of Hoth.
During the Clone Wars in 22 BBY, an OOM pilot battle droid served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Xais was a planet situated in the Rocun Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was home to a single settlement, a former gas refinery. Following the Battle of Galov, the Nihil marauder organization operated on Xais, occupying the gas foundry there.
Pavo Prime was an astronomical object in the Pavo Prime system of the Inner Rim Territories, in grid square N-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The prisoner rehabilitation program was a government organization of the Galactic Republic that oversaw rehabilitation of prisoners in the galaxy during the High Republic Era.

Sirna was a moon of the Outer Rim planet Aaloth, located in the Gaulus sector.

The Wartaki Sea was a body of salt water located on the planet Kashyyyk. The Wawaatt Archipelago lay there.

The Narrant Shoals were a location in the Narrant system in the Narrant sector of the Mid Rim Territories. The Imperial Navy officer Tyrus Meori won a battle there, which ultimately influenced his promotion to admiralship.

The Aquilifer was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that was built at the Kuat Drive Yards for service in the Imperial Navy and later served as the flagship of Admiral Tyrus Meori. The Star Destroyer was heavily damaged during the Mutiny on Mon Cala.

The Ardency was an MC95 Star Cruiser that served in the Resistance navy during the war between the Resistance and the First Order military junta. The Ardency was one of two MC95 Star Cruisers that participated in the Battle of Batuu.

The Sunfire Mountains were a mountain range that were visible in the distance from the town of Mos Gofti on the planet Tatooine. At some point during the Imperial Era, the astromech droid LA-R1 noticed the twin suns of Tatooine set behind the faraway Sunfire Mountains.

The Whisper Network was an intelligence service that controlled the galactic underworld. It employed information brokers and could steer syndicates along the path of their choosing. Toren and Prima Wessex were the members of the organization.

Dazenma was the capital city of the planet Dekien. It contained a spaceport and was once visited by the former Sith warrior known as The Ronin.

The Kiljis were a sentient species that hailed from the Unknown Regions' Kilji homeland. The species' wrinkly, rubbery-looking, dark orange skin stretched and formed patterns that reflected the Kiljis' emotions.

Zyzek was a planet located in the Zyzek system of the Unknown Regions. It fell within grid square F-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was a trade hub for several nations and species situated to the east and southeast of the Chiss Ascendancy.
The Torada Collective was a Naboo artists' group which existed by the beginning of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.

Vuzsa was an astronomical object in the Vuzsa system in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square R-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Rock Weavers were a species of large spiders which resided on the astronomical object Loreth. They could be found on the mountain Temple Peak, and caught live prey in their webs to eat.

The Eye of Ashlanae was, according to the Qel-Droma Epics, a powerful Force vergence on one of the peaks of the Eocho Mountains, that was a place of pilgrimage for the Jedi.

Agorn Mountain was a mountain on the planet Ossus in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. A part of the western Eocho Mountain range, the Knossa Spaceport was established around the mountain to support the Jedi pilgrims.

The leviathan krayt dragon was a rare form of greater krayt dragon characterized by its sixteen limbs and its ability to spit a highly corrosive ichor onto attackers. Din Djarin and Cobb Vanth once helped a group of Tusken Raiders defeat one such beast.

Rhigar, also known as Rhigal, was a terrestrial planet of the Chiss Ascendancy that was affiliated with the Clarr family. It was located in the Rhigar system in Chiss Space amidst the Unknown Regions.

Cloud-deer were a type of deer found on the planet Rei'izu that had white-flecked purple-gray fur and branching horns. Hundreds of cloud-deer lived on the grounds of a shrine in the pilgrims' ward of the city Yojou on Rei'izu.
Hanna Institute of Antiquities was a location on the Core Worlds planet Chandrila.
The Crystal Caves of Ossus were a series of cave systems allegedly located within the Eocho Mountains. Within the caves, lightsaber crystals were plentiful.

Yojou, a city located on the planet Rei'izu, was the old capital of the first Empire. It was said to be the home of a thousand gods. The Moga River separated Yojou's spaceport from the pilgrims' ward.

The Wishful Thinking was a T-1 shuttle utilized by the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. The shuttle was one of the starships in the care of the Jedi quartermaster Nubarron aboard the Starlight Beacon.
Rimk was a remote, tropical planet in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet's existence was removed from the Imperial Star Guide, once Palpatine discovered the Sith tower.
The Tetan nobility were the noble houses of the planet Empress Teta. They included the family of Sianna Sekko and the ruling Keto family. The nobility and the ruling family formed the Tetan monarchy.
A tribe lived on a swamp planet. Between 32 ABY and 34 ABY, the human male Kori Ong was part of the tribe.

The Aelos was a blockade frigate utilized by the Nikardun Destiny. The frigate had been stationed by the Nikardun at the Paccosh homeworld Rapacc in the Rapacc system, but was captured by the Paccosh after the downfall of General Yiv of the Nikardun Destiny.
Kronk was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Kronk system within the Auril sector of the Outer Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square R-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Oyokal was a terrestrial agricultural astronomical object located in the territory of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Ascendancy nation, within Chiss Space's Oyokal system. It was situated in grid square E-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Universal Analysis Group, or UAG, was an organization within the Chiss Ascendancy. Based on Sposia, the UAG served as a clearinghouse for alien artifacts and technology, collecting and studying such items.
The FateSpinner was a massive and pristine Shatter-class WarMaster warship that served as the flagship of the Grysk operative "Jixtus"'s fleet and was commanded by a Grysk captain.
Ornfra was a terrestrial planet of the Chiss Ascendancy within the Ornfra system of the Unknown Regions.

Sharb was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Unknown Regions' Sharb system, within the Chiss Ascendancy nation. By 19 BBY, the Chiss Syndic Mitth'ras'safis received a report on crop projections for Sharb's northern hemisphere.

result: Qilori of Uandualon is captured by the Chiss
x: In 18 BBY, the Grysk operative "Jixtus," who had allied himself with the Kilji Illumine nation, sent General Crofyp's task force to the Unknown Regions' Rapacc system to capture a group of refugees hiding on the planet Rapacc.

The Anvil was a Kilji war cruiser commanded by General Crofyp of the Kilji Illumine, the nation of the Kilji species. The Anvil was one of two Kilji warships in Crofyp's task force, the other being the Kilji picket cruiser Hammer.

A Resistance heavy freighter was active in the galaxy during the time of the First Order-Resistance War. Concurrently with the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY, the freighter came into contact with a First Order Resurgent-class Star Destroyer above the Forest Moon of Endor.
As part of the Grysk "Jixtus"'s attempts to lead the Chiss Ascendancy into its destruction, an attack was carried out at the Chiss planet of Jamiron.
Cormit was an astronomical object of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Unknown Regions. A fleet depot of the Ascendancy's Clarr family was situated at Cormit, anchored by the light cruiser Orisson.

The Jandalin was a patrol ship of the Chiss Ascendancy's Stybla family. The starship carried Senior Aide Stybla'ppin'cykok "Lappincyk," alongside Mid Commander Mitth'raw'nuru "Thrawn" and Syndic Mitth'ras'safis "Thrass," in their investigations into a hijacked freighter.

A planet was located in the Glastis system in Chiss Space within the Unknown Regions. Located in the south-nadir part of the Ascendancy, the planet was midway between the capital world Csilla and Copero.

V-484 was a cargo ship of the Chiss Ascendancy's Stybla family. While traveling from Csilla to Sposia containing cargo that included a section of a tachyon flow synchrotron accelerator from the second Starflash weapon, the starship was hijacked by members of the Clarr family d…
Zorba's Back was the name the locals gave to the largest of three stone archways that stood at the entrance of Arch Canyon, on the planet Tatooine. It shared its name with Zorba the Hutt.
The Hurian plains were a location on the desert planet of Tatooine, near the city of Mos Entha. They housed a series of munka mines that were owned by a miner and his family.

Dustweaver spiders were large, spindly-legged creatures found on the planet Tatooine, nesting in the Mospic rise. The appearance of the brain walkers used by the B'omarr Order reminded of those spiders.
Combat arachnids were bantha-sized spiders from the planet Carida, whose bodies were covered in reflective spines. They had pointed legs, sharp fangs, and razor-sharp barbs on their lower abdomens.
The Ghorfa cavern was a cave located on the desert planet of Tatooine. It contained undeciphered pictograms that might have been linked to the mysterious Kumumgah people.

The Kanz were a tribe of Tusken Raiders from the desert planet of Tatooine. They owned a sacred wooden totem, whose carvings indicated the location of several salt mines in the Dune Sea. At some point, that relic was stolen from them by Jabba the Hutt.
Vorzyd V, nicknamed the Gambler's Paradise, was a terrestrial planet which contained the urban location Efavan.

D3-O9, also spelled Deethree-Ohnine, was a droid who served aboard the Star Cruiser Halcyon. Built centuries prior to the First Order-Resistance War by the founder of Chandrila Star Line, D3's primary role aboard the Halcyon was running ship logistics.
10-K8, also known as K8, and Ten-Kayt, was a droid with feminine programming that belonged to the bodyguard Alys "Crash" Ongwa, who led a security team during the High Republic Era.

The Bellicose was a Firewolf man-of-war commanded by Chiss Admiral Ers'ikaro of the Chiss Ascendancy nation's Defense Force. In 18 BBY, the Bellicose stopped the battle at Csaus between the Chiss Tahmie and Droc families before it escalated.

The Black Sun criminal syndicate was involved in an fiasco on Ryloth by 3 ABY. The incident—which occurred on the Outer Rim planet Ryloth—was considered by the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra to be significant for Black Sun.

The Kilji Overlords were a part of the government of the Kilji Illumine, the nation of the Kilji species. They affirmed the decisions of the generalirius, the leader of the Illumine and its military, the Illumine Kilhorde.

Ool was a terrestrial planet in the Unknown Regions located in the nation of the Chiss Ascendancy. In 18 BBY, it was inhabited by over two billion Chiss residents and was a fairly popular destination for tourists.

The Jedi Agricultural Corps research laboratory was a research facility located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, that was affiliated with Agricultural Corps. It included a number of large globes containing alien flora for research.
The First Knowledge Quarter of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant was where the Room of a Thousand Fountains was located.
The Armageddon was a StoneCrusher-class WarMaster that served in the fleet of the Grysk "Jixtus." The Armageddon was destroyed during a battle over Sunrise.

The Emery was one of three StoneCrusher-class WarMasters that served in the fleet of the Grysk operative "Jixtus." Around 18 BBY, the StoneCrusher engaged a group of forces of the Chiss and Paccosh species over the planet Sunrise in the Sunrise system.

The SkySweep was a StoneCrusher-class WarMaster warship that served the armada of the Grysk warlike species as part of the fleet commanded by the Grysk operative known as "Jixtus." Around 18 BBY, the SkySweep fought against Chiss Ascendancy Senior Captain Thrawn's fleet over t…
The grand banquet hall, formerly known as the Jedi Library was one of the earlier libraries located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

The sacred spire was a natural mountain spire around which the Jedi Temple on Coruscant was constructed. The local Coruscanti considered it a sacred place as it was a light side vergence, which drew numerous Force traditions to it.

The Battle of Parein II 4 was fought on the fourth moon of the planet Parein II during the Clone Wars. During the battle, Jedi General Sannen led the Republic Military against the Separatist General Grievous and his forces, which included Grievous's IG-100 MagnaGuards.

Noris was an astronomical object located in the Chiss Ascendancy, the nation of the Chiss species in the Unknown Regions. It was situated within the Chiss Space's Noris system, within grid square F-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Junkyard was an asteroid field located in the Rhigal system of the Chiss Ascendancy within the Unknown Regions.

The Hammer was a Kilji picket cruiser commanded by Colonel Tildnis, who served the Kilji Illumine, the nation of the Kilji species. It was armed with spectrum lasers and equipped with a main drive, a hyperdrive, and a tractor beam.

Csaus was an astronomical object located in the territory of the Unknown Regions government named the Chiss Ascendancy. The Chiss Space celestial body was situated in the Csaus system, within grid square F-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Orisson was a light cruiser in service of the Clarr family homestead defense force, the family fleet of the Clarr family of the Chiss Ascendancy. It was stationed at the Clarr fleet depot.

Bogey Three was the name given to a light cruiser-sized warship of the Grysk Hegemony by the crew of the Imperial Star Destroyer Chimaera. Along with Bogey Four, Bogey Three joined a battle against Chimaera, during which it was attacked by the Empire's TIE fighters.

Bogey Four was the name given to a light cruiser-sized warship of the Grysk Hegemony by the crew of the Imperial Star Destroyer Chimaera. Along with Bogey Three, Bogey Four joined a battle against the Chimaera.

Lessa-7 was a terrestrial moon in the Lessa system in the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was home to a facility where Wookiees produced medicine from the stomach juice of a sarlacc.
The Stybla honoring ceremony, also known as the Stybla honoring ritual and the odo ceremony, was a ritual in which the Stybla family conferred the suffix "odo" onto the name of an honored individual.

Following his death in 34 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Asajj Ventress cremated Narec's body and held a funeral for her master, Jedi Knight Ky Narec, on the planet Rattatak. At the funeral, Ventress cried at the loss of her master.

Santrapei was a location on the Inner Rim planet Spirana where New Republic pilot Yrica Quell's brother Thren lived. Santrapei was located three hundred kilometers east of Yrica Quell and Chass na Chadic's house.

M-OC was an Imperial hunter droid created by Emperor Palpatine and was tasked by the Emperor with locating a legendary weapon. At some point, M-OC encountered the Freemakers and relentlessly chased them through several planets.
R0-GR, or "Roger," was a B1-series battle droid who worked alongside the Freemakers, a human family of scavengers that traveled throughout the galaxy.

N-3RO was a droid who lived on the junk planet of Zoh. On Zoh he and other droids was led by Jek-14. Shorty after the Freemakers visited Zoh seeking Jek-14's help. N-3RO led a droid uprising against Jek-14 and the Freemakers.

BL-OX was a droid who lived on the junk planet of Zoh. On Zoh, BL-OX and other droids was led by Jek-14. Shorty after the Freemakers visited Zoh seeking Jek-14's help, a ungrateful droid named N-3RO led a droid uprising against Jek-14 and the Freemakers.

The annexation of the Qiilura system was an operation launched by the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 20 BBY to take over the Qiilura system during the Clone Wars. The location of Qiilura thus became a battleground.

Fixer was an MSE-6 series repair droid who lived on the junk planet of Zoh. On Zoh, Fixer and other droids were led by Jek-14. Shorty after the Freemakers visited Zoh seeking Jek-14's help, a ungrateful droid named N-3RO led a droid uprising against Jek-14 and the Freemakers.
The Upper Ring was a location on The Wheel. An elevator for the Upper Ring had a TT-8L/Y7 gatekeeper droid installed.

DLC-13 was a DLC-13 mining droid with masculine programming who once helped the B1-series battle droid R0-GR save his friend Rowan Freemaker from certain doom. After the incident, DLC-13 stayed in contact with Roger, and even sent him cards on Life Day.

Zoh was a isolated junk planet located in the Sarka sector of the Mid Rim Territories where Jek-14 took refuge. R0-GR visited the world and recorded his time there in his autobiography From Trenches to Wrenches: The Roger Story.

Ningoth was a water planet located in the Karthakk sector within the Outer Rim Territories. At some point, R0-GR was part of an event on Ningoth which he later recorded in his autobiography, From Trenches to Wrenches: The Roger Story.

Ord Tellarom was an astronomical object in the Suolriep sector of the Outer Rim Territories. R0-GR visited the world and recorded his time here in this autobiography From Trenches to Wrenches: The Roger Story.

Nal Kapok was a world in the Nal Kapok system in the Taldot sector of the Mid Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, a battle between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic was fought on Nal Kapok.
A battle took place on the planet Nal Kapok during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. R0-GR considered the battle the worst battle he fought in.
Race to Ningoth was an event that occurred on the planet Ningoth.
Dooku's throne room or Dooku's chambers, also known as Dooku's great hall or simply great hall, was a hall located in the main tower of Castle Serenno on the planet Serenno.

The Orphans, also known as Chanath Cha and the Orphans, were a group of orphans led by the bounty hunter Chanath Cha. In addition to Cha, the members consisted of Sear, the droid Ladybright, and Imara Vex.
Genosha was an astronomical object located in the Genosha system of the Outer Rim Territories that was wiped out by a Galactic Empire-induced bioplague sometime before the Battle of Yavin.
