A B1 battle droid in the Geonosian droid army served in the Petranaki Arena during the First Battle of Geonosis. The battle droid had its head accidentally grafted onto the chassis of C-3PO when the protocol droid had gotten trapped in the droid factory's conveyor belt system.
Calior was a planet situated in the Seitia sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Inhabited by humans, Calior was controlled by a regional government.

An ambush occurred in the Valo system against the forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic by the Galactic Empire. Imperial agent Lyle Kullan had infiltrated the Rebel Alliance's Rogue Squadron in an attempt to capture Commander Luke Skywalker.

Vincorba was a rocky planet located in the Vincorba system in the Piryn Shar sector of the Expansion Region. Its inhabitants included humans and members of a bipedal species, while the pontiff of a religious cult was a ruling figure on Vincorba.
G-90, or Gee-Ninety, was a Jayosbrand assassin droid who was part of the Assassin's Guild in the Imperial Era. The droid had a large spherical body with a head that protruded from the top.

The Revengers, with its members dubbed "heroes," were a group that operated during the Imperial Era. Led by Ankala Sahm and consisting of S'ira and Tanka, all three of whose homes had been destroyed by the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate, their goal was to pursue operatives of…
Hold 6 was a cargo hold on Orca-class freighter, Freighter 2716. It contained a massive Kyber crystal and was guarded by Death trooper, DT-F16 and her squad.

The Portmaster's office was an office located in the Trannon district of Carannia, the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno. The office was far from the Carannia Spaceport and controlled space travel to and from the spaceport.

Gus Talon was a moon of the planet Corellia. During the High Republic Era, the Nihil marauder organization undertook a plan that involved operations on Corellia as well as Gus Talon, which would be overseen by Sabata Krill, a member of the cell led by Krix Kamerat.
Endovar was a terrestrial planet located in the Endovar system within the Terrabe sector of the Mid Rim and the Interior. It was situated in grid square M-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The spine dragon was a type of creature. Tarl Sokoli, a war hero of the Galactic Empire, was known as the "Spine Dragon of Anaxes."

The Kerrakk were an insectoid sentient species whose members were grouped in hives. A hive of Kerrakk enforcers operated during the Imperial Era, but were killed by the bounty hunter crew led by T'onga after they attempted to rob the Carbon Score Cantina on Burnin Konn.
A hive of Kerrakk enforcers operated during the Imperial Era. On Burnin Konn, the Kerrakk enforcers attempted to rob the Carbon Score Cantina after its bartender failed to pay protection.
The Forerunner II was a light cruiser in the service of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. It was commanded by Admiral Tarl Sokoli, an Imperial war hero.
Arashar was an astronomical object in the Arashar system of the Inner Rim Territories situated in grid square J-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It appeared blue-green from space.

The Court Of Justice was the court of the planet Mon Cala. In 34 ABY, Resistance General Leia Skywalker Organa Solo led a mission to Mon Cala to get starships needed for their navy. But Chewbacca, Rose Tico, and Rey were attacked by a Quarren mob but were accused of the crime.

Bogo Rai was an astronomical object located within the territory of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Ascendancy nation. It was situated in grid square E-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, within the Bogo Rai system.

Yashuvhu was an astronomical object located within the territory of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Ascendancy government. The celestial body was in the Yashuvhu system, situated in grid square F-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
A Paccian gunboat was piloted by the Chiss Mid Captain Csap'ro'strob "Apros" of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet at the battle in the Sunrise system known as Senior Captain Thrawn's last stand.
Slingshot was a united persona, consisting of a modified droideka piloted by the Ugnaught Dizzy. Slingshot was active following the fall of the Galactic Empire.
The Livorno were a species native to the astronomical object Livorno, which was ruled by Queen Prizzi.
Caramm V was a planet in the Caramm system within the Talcene sector of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square R-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Cargo Bay 17 was a cargo bay on the Orca-class freighter, Freighter 2716. It contained prisoners captured by the Empire to help build the first Death Star.

Ladybright, also known as Bright, was a droid member of the Orphans, a group led by the bounty hunter Chanath Cha. Similar to the other members of the Orphans—who, as the group's name suggested, had lost their parents—Ladybright was the last of their factory line.
In the battle, Dao's flagship had suffered critical damages to its essential systems and was dangerously low on fuel and ammunition.

The Siroto was a starship utilized by the Orphans, a group led by the bounty hunter Chanath Cha, during the time of the Galactic Empire. The members of the Orphans—the droid Ladybright, Sear, and Imara Vex—operated under Cha aboard the vessel.
The Liswarr was a Wookiee gunship owned by Doshanalawook, a Trandoshan who earned the nickname "Chainbreaker" for her activities freeing Wookiees from captivity.

Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection, nicknamed Crash's crew, was a security crew that operated out of Coronet City on Corellia and was led by the bodyguard Alys "Crash" Ongwa during the High Republic Era.

Subsector seven was an area of Coronet City on Corellia. While the security crew of Alys Ongwa was protecting Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh during a visit to Corellia, the operative Prybolt Garavult patrolled subsector seven with a pair of Corellian hounds.

Tunnel Team Twelve was a unit of the security crew led by Alys Ongwa that was active during the crew's mission to protect Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh while she visited Corellia. Smeemarm reported in for the unit from the underbelly of Coronet City.
Ground Team Six was a unit of the security team led by Alys Ongwa which operated during the crew's mission to protect Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh while she visited Corellia.
Sector two zero nine was a sector of the jungle planet Hissrich.

The Darkpath was a frigate utilized by the Black Sun criminal syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Adorned with a yellow Black Sun logo on the front, the ship was owned by the Black Sun boss Lord Gyuti. The ship had a large hangar that could accommodate many ships.
Yeksom was a terrestrial planet in the Yeksom system in the Antemeridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Perlemian Trade Route.
Japeal was a terrestrial planet with a temperate climate in the Japeal system in the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Veragi Trade Route.

Tais Brabbo was a planet in the Tais Brabbo system in the Shadola sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Crime-ridden, Tais Brabbo's corruption was such that the Hutts were rumored to have decided against moving some of their operations there.

The Scram Gang was a gang of thugs led by the Gloovan gangster Scram. The thugs fought the Lepi smuggler Jaxxon T. Tumperakki in a cantina on Rekelos, after Scram accused the Lepi of cheating in a game of sabacc.
JJ-5145, nicknamed Forfive, was a logistics droid that served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
The sand beast, also known as a sand ape, was a species of large, predatory, reptilian creature with six limbs that lived on the planet of Tatooine.

The blutfish was a type of fish. Between 1 ABY and 3 ABY, Rebel pilot Ibti Myrak was stationed on the MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser, the Home One after her reckless actions during the attack in the Cilpar system.

The lighting of lanterns was a ceremony on the Mid Rim Territories planet of Kijimi that evolved from an act of basic survival. It was practiced by the Dai Bendu monks during the cold nights, and was held to express gratitude.
The Ardok Ranch was located on the Chiss Ascendancy planet Ool and was owned by Cohbo'rik'ardok, known by the core name "Borika", and her husband Bomarmo.

A planet that was barely thought about and barely named was home to a Jedi temple. Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader travelled to the planet to steal a tablet from the Jedi temple.

The Verdigris Hills were located on the mining world Elphrona and contained a deposit of nova crystals. Between 247 BBY and 232 BBY, Jedi Master Porter Engle discovered herbs growing out from the hills' crystal deposits and decided to use them in his cooking.

Grid 24B-30 the designation of a set of land on the planet Elphrona. It contained an aurodium mine that suffered a collapse during the High Republic Era, prompting Jedi Loden Greatstorm and Bell Zettifar to lead a rescue operation from the Elphrona Outpost.

An aurodium mine was located in Grid 24B-30 of the planet Elphrona. During the High Republic Era, Freeno, one of several Er'kit miners searching for the mineral aurodium, discovered a valuable kantak crystal in the mine and attempted to unearth it with his rockspanner.

A quadruped droid was utilized by the bounty hunter Boba Fett while he worked on the Outer Rim Territories planet Carajam between around 2 BBY and 4 ABY. Fett rode the droid while transporting the corpse of a rebel pilot he had captured across a desert.

AL-42 was a train operator droid who operated a train for the Pyke Syndicate. In 5 ABY, the droid operated a train that made its way across the Dune Sea, killing various Tusken Raiders and their banthas along the way.
The Order of the Night Wind, or simply the Night Wind, was an order of assassins that were located in Hutt Space.
Gazian was a living planet in the Mid Rim's Gazian system. It was covered by the Living Sea, a large, deep growth of mushrooms with hallucinatory spores. The area was strong in the Force.

A tribe of Tusken Raiders was active on the Dune Sea of Tatooine following the rescue of Han Solo by his companions from Tatooine Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. The tribe was led by a chieftain and used black clothing and garments.
The Twins, also known as the Hutt Twins, referred to a Hutt brother and sister who were crime lords during the New Republic Era.
The death pits of Duur were a location in the galaxy.

A Horned gekko was a species of lizard native to the desert planet Tatooine. Capable of crawling inside a host being's body and creating hallucinations, the lizard was used by Tusken Raiders to guide individuals on spiritual journeys.

The Talid were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. A male podracer Gen-Goma was a member of the species. By sometime during or after 5 ABY, a large statue of a Talid could be found on the planet Ando Prime.

A droid was stationed at the Jedi Order's Elphrona Outpost during the High Republic Era. It alerted the Jedi that inhabited the outpost of any pressing matters, including those that involved the wellbeing of Elphrona's citizens.
A species of bird was native to the Outer Rim planet Dathomir. The birds cleaned the teeth of the rancor when they got dirty.

The moon of Ahch-To was a moon that orbited the planet Ahch-To located in the Ahch-To system of the the galaxy's Unknown Regions.
The Sithmas Battle was a battle that was fought between the First Order and the Resistance during the holiday of Sithmas.
An archipelago continent was located on the Core Worlds planet Alderaan. The continent was carpeted in a layer of whitish stone that was often used as gravel on the world during the Republic Era.

The Coruscant Patrol was a patrol organization that shared its name with the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. The organization was active during the High Republic Era and had a number of starfighter cadets.
Chespea was a forest world in the Outer Rim Territories' Rayter sector. During the High Republic Era, it was the location of a Jedi temple.
The Fian were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy that possessed a higher resistance to radiation than that of humans.

UK2-B was a droid that was active during the New Republic Era. In 9 ABY, the droid escorted two Gamorrean guards through the palace of Boba Fett and presented them to the newly-risen crime lord, watching intently as Fett chose to spare the prisoners' lives.
Long before 230 BBY, the Umbaran female Jedi youngling Orla Jareni was part of a group of younglings within the Jedi Order at the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.
A mission to Riosa was undertaken by the Jedi Elzar Mann and Avar Kriss to the Inner Rim Territories planet Riosa long before the Nihil attack in the Echerta system in 230 BBY.

An attack was carried out by the mauraders known as the Nihil against civilians in the Echerta system in 230 BBY. The Echerta system served as a hub for hyperspace lanes causing dozens of ships to have emerged there and thus be attacked by the Nihil.

A species of small animals were present on a planet in Wild Space to which the Chiss Mitth'raw'nuruodo was exiled. Thrawn used the animals to sneak explosives past an Imperial encampment's sentry perimeter.

The Ace of Staves was a cargo ship owned by the pilot Koley Linn during the High Republic Era. Around 230 BBY, Linn and his starship were trapped aboard the space station Starlight Beacon when the Nihil pirates enacted plans to destroy the station.
The Enso were a sentient species from the Ensolica system. Around 230 BBY, the defense minister of the planet Eiram was an Enso woman.
The war room was an atrium-like room with high ceilings inside the Dai Bendu Monastery on the Mid Rim Territories planet of Kijimi. Around 19 ABY, it was one of the sites of the Kijimi summit.
The Spectre was a starship in the service of the Nihil pirates during the High Republic Era. It was commanded by a captain who had bad blood with Roborhyan, another member of the marauders.
A raid was conducted against a Pyke Syndicate repulsortrain by a Tusken Raider tribe, led by Boba Fett.

Pomprey was a location on the planet Ool in the Chiss Ascendancy, the nation of the Chiss species. The area had a few inns for lodging as well as a skybus depot.

The Aqualish crime family was part of Jabba's criminal empire when it was led by Lord Bib Fortuna following Jabba's death.
A Klatooinian crime family was part of the criminal empire of Jabba the Hutt until his death and replacement by Bib Fortuna.
The Ruusanians were a species native to the planet Ruusan.
J7R-T was an R5 series astromech droid that was active during the New Republic Era, serving in the palace of Daimyo, Boba Fett.

The Belsallian Sea was an ocean located on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Serenno. The planetary capital of Carannia was located upon its shoreline. It shared its name with the Belsallian Cantina.
The Carannian hills were a group of hills on the planet Serenno located outside the capital city of Carannia. By 42 BBY, a lookout was established in view of Carannia.
The Meerians were a sentient species. They could have silver skin and gold hair. One Meerian, Yeet, was a member of the Nihil.
Thelj was a planet located four sectors away from the planet Dalna and was home to a population of varied settlers.

Quaymoon betting parlor was a betting parlor in the Hutt Space.

Izizian monkeys were a type of creature native to the Inner Rim jungle planet Onderon. The creature shared its name with Iziz, Onderon's capital city.

Logal Ri snakes were snakes that lived on the Moon of Logal Ri. They attempted to go near the lamta crops planted by the farmers T'onga and Losha Tarkon at the couple's moisture farm, but were kept away by Tarkon, who picked up sharp-shooting skills defending their crops.
Marchion's Declaration, also known as Marchion Ro's speech, was a speech given shortly after the destruction of Starlight Beacon in 230 BBY.

The Cantina District was located near the Abregado-Rae Spaceport on the planet Abregado-Rae. Around 5 BBY, the Pyke Syndicate searched the district for the cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance after he took down several Pykes in a cantina.

The Caviness Thorn crew was a bounty hunting crew that operated during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Around 5 BBY, the crew took a bounty for a smuggler and traveled to the planet Abregado-Rae where they were to take out the target.
Oruba Square was located in Wormtown on the Smuggler's Moon of Nar Shaddaa. It contained a statue of Oruba, a Hutt male member of the Grand Hutt Council during the Clone Wars.

Club Afterburn, also known as the Afterburner, was a drinking area located on the hangar deck of the Rebel Alliance EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Redemption. The club had a banner with Aurebesh text spelling "Club Afterburn" on it.
Hangar Fifteen-D was a tertiary auxiliary hangar located on the Executor, the flagship of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

The Imperial Anti-Terrorism Watchline, also known as the Imperial watch-line, was a service of the Galactic Empire concerned with the safety of the galaxy that could be contacted in order to report acts of terrorism.

A humanoid species possessed the ability of technopathy. The species had blue skin, hair, and eyes. Lony Coleema was a member of the species.

The Starlight Beacon meditation garden was a meditation garden located on Starlight Beacon. There was a bench that sat next to a pond filled with singing, joyful bioluminescent fish.
Zyzek System Defense was a defense organization that protected the Unknown Regions' Zyzek system, where the planet Zyzek was located.
The vrelt was a large, hairless rodent. The evasive creatures had two hind legs which they used to hop around. They ate crops, but sometimes gnawed at campers as they slept.

The Taymar were a sentient species that inhabited the galaxy. Taymar had human-like faces, glittery blue-green skin, flowing tendrils, and the ability to float, as well as multiple arms.
Vrblthers were aggressive predators found across the moon of Nar Shaddaa, although they were believed to have originated on the Hutt homeworld of Varl.
Ozlyn Gox was the capital city of Gravlex Med, a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy.
Manka cats were a feline predator species with a pack instinct found across the mountains and grasslands of several Core Worlds, with the largest population living in the mountains of Alderaan.

The Port of Lafete was a city on Lafete that contained a diner. Boba Fett and Din Djarin traveled to the Port of Lafete to meet with Bo-Katan Kryze and Koska Reeves.
The Executor project was a military shipbuilding project designed for the construction of the Executor-class Star Dreadnought and established by the Galactic Empire during its reign.
During the Clone Wars, an OOM command battle droid served within the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Nakano Lash's crew was a crew of bounty hunters led by the Nautolan female bounty hunter Nakano Lash during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Members of the crew included the twins T'ongor and T'onga, the cyborg Beilert Valance, the Trandoshan Bossk, and for one job, Boba Fett.

The planet Chandrila was orbited by a moon that shone over Chandrila's Silver Sea at night.
A pie house was a restaurant in the central marketplace of Ro Station, a city on Pantora. A big pie was pictured on the Aurebesh signage by the entrance.

Aq'alicious Seafood was the name of a seafood restaurant in the central marketplace of Ro Station, a city on Pantora.
A shop selling hot beverages was located in the central marketplace of Ro Station, a city on Pantora.
VZ-114, also known as Rampart's Star Destroyer, was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that served within the naval forces of the Galactic Empire under the command of Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart.

The Syllain District was a district in Coronet City on the planet Corellia. The district had two abandoned storefronts covered with political posters and a fishmonger that sold coppergrins and garsmelts.

Twon Ketee was a planet where Han Solo, Chewbacca and Varond Jelik were sent to capture Rathtars. It was inhabited by frogs, spiders and carnivorus plants.

A root-mouse was a type of mouse that squeaked. During the Wookiee holiday of Life Day one year, when the Wookiee Chewbacca removed a luma-bulb illumination device from the ceiling of his starship, the Millennium Falcon, it sounded like a root-mouse's squeaks.
The Forbidden District was the district located on the planet Exegol that bordered the Sith Citadel. It housed derelict shipyard forges that dated back to the old Sith Wars for control of the galaxy.
Everon was a tempest planet and the homeworld of the Evereni species.

Wroonians were near-human species that originated from the Wroona system. Around six millennia before the Battle of Yavin, Wroonians colonized Saleucami. Wroonians were similar in appearance to Pantorans, both having blue skin.

During the Clone Wars, a B1-series battle droid served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 21 BBY, the B1-series battle droid was part of a Separatist blockade in orbit of the planet Ryloth under the command of Neimoidian Captain Mar Tuuk.
Kalamu District was district in Coronet City. It contained many of the city's hotels, including Hotel Feather.
Kalamu Boulevard was a boulevard located in the Kalamu District of Coronet City.
A bodyguard company was run by Dizcaro. It operated during the High Republic Era in Coronet City, and had a rivalry with Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection.
Tase Somer's residence was a house belonging to Tase Somer, the Head Curator of the Coruscant Museum, on the planet Coruscant around 3 ABY.

In 3 BBY, Princess Leia Organa went on a humanitarian aid mission to Wobani as part of her Day of Demand challenges. At the time, most of the planet Wobani's residents were starving and badly in need of food and medicial supplies.

The Green, also referred to as the Greens, was an area on Corellia on the outskirts of Coronet City. It was a natural area that had much wildlife including creedoks and snomats. The Green was also the home to the Ongwa family after their nomadic travels brought them to Corellia.
A Creedok was an amphibious reptile that lived in the swamp of The Green in Coronet City, Corellia. They would literally hunt themselves into a coma.
A Snomat was a creature that lived in the swamp of The Green in Coronet City, Corellia. They emitted high pitched chirping noises.

Snugano was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Mid Rim Territories and the Western Reaches' Spirva sector, within the Snugano system. It was situated in grid square L-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Living Sea was a location and a vergence in the Force that covered the surface of the planet Gazian. It was visited by Luke Skywalker and many other Jedi.

The Great Storm was a cataclysmic natural event on the planet Everon centuries before circa 500 BBY. It was a vortex storm that rose from the planet's core bringing strong winds and lightning, destroying the native Evereni's civilization.
The High Council holomap room was located within within the High Council Tower of the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.

Gonkatine was a red GNK-series power droid that resided in the Unknown Regions planet of Exegol. He attempted to join the Knights of Ren; however, they were not allowed to join.
The Coronet Independent Media Network was a news network that operated in Coronet City during the High Republic Era. One of their employees was Taljo Stant.
Santiv Ru Bay was a bay located on Endovar.

The trakkrrrn was a type of creature native to the forest planet Kashyyyk, homeworld of the sentient Wookiees. The creature had naturally spicy meat that was cooked on the bone and served with sauce to make the dish Barbecued Trakkrrrn Ribs.

Ops was the centralized communication center on Starlight Beacon. It was heavily staffed and always busy. Stellan Gios and Estala Maru would often run the station from this area.

A shark-boar was a creature that had white tusks. During the Republic Fair on the Outer Rim planet Valo in 231 BBY, Jedi Master Stellan Gios mentally compared the hull of the Innovator—an Elite-class research vessel—to the color of shark-boar tusks.

Predavorexxes were a species of tall, hairy, bipedal creatures that could be found on the planet Numidian Prime. They were incredibly large, towering over Weequays, and had distinct large horns, red eyes, and long gray hair on certain areas of their body.

The Republic Pathfinders conducted expeditions in the Outer Rim Territories for the Galactic Republic and often worked alongside the Jedi Order.
Kadrillians were a sentient species from the Kadril system in the Outer Rim Territories. They possessed terrapin half-shells, and had scaled skin which could be orange in hue.

A communications team or comms team was responsible for receiving messages via EX droids from Republic Pathfinders who were far away in the Outer Rim Territories. They would then set up a string of relay buoys to keep the Republic in contact with the frontier worlds.
Devalok was a terrestrial planet known for its gardens and gardeners that was located in the Devalok system in the Altier sector of the Expansion Region.
A city was located on the planet Devalok. The city's northern district contained the Amrit spaceport.
The Pasaana Plains was a location on Pasaana where many travelers had ventured through to get to the Forbidden Valley.
The Kijimi Crooks were a gang on the planet Kijimi. After seeing a bounty poster of Rey Skywalker, they decided to go after her.
Antsy Astromech was a Astromech droid found in Kef Bir Space.
The Company 77 Village was a location on Kef Bir where the Company 77 soldiers and residents lived. The village consisted of a farm and museum, and was surrounded by mountains and lakes.

Daring Droid was an astromech droid found in Exegol space that was aligned with the Resistance. As the First Order was pinning down the Resistance, this droid, along with a protocol droid, went out to rescue soldiers nearby.
The Wookiee Choir was a band of Wookiees consisting of four singers and the Choir Master.

x: The attack on Jabiim, or the Jabiim incident, was an attack conducted by the Galactic Empire on the base of the Hidden Path on the planet Jabiim.

A crew of at least four members was headed by the Weequay Jarl on the planet Coruscant. In 22 BBY, they became aware of a valuable EX droid in the possession of the Mirialan Servit. The crew followed him to Dex's Diner, where they held up the customers at blaster point.

Char rat were a type of rat. Sometime between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Tasu Leech—a member of the bounty hunter T'onga's crew—called the bounty hunter Dengar a "double-crossing char rat" after the latter left the crew on the flagship of the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn after he had…

G-1FY or Iffy was an old protocol droid who worked on the Wookiee starship Namrelllew in 22 BBY. Shortly after the beginning of the Clone Wars, he encountered Senator Padmé Amidala when she went undercover on the ship on a mission for the Galactic Senate.

The Starheart was a gunship that served as the command ship of the New Republic's Halo Squadron. The Starheart intercepted a freighter carrying Dathan, Miramir, and Rey as it was chased by forces of the Sith Eternal.

A starship was utilized by a criminal group in 3 ABY. The starship was in space above when Luke Skywalker flew his T-65B X-wing starfighter near the ship. The group's boss wanted a T-65 and the captain ordered the starship to use it's magna-harpoons to fire at the ship.

Desinta was an ice planet in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Sometime between the years 42 BBY and 32 BBY, Desinta was embroiled in a civil war between the Desintian government, led by the nominally elected Prefect Aminar, and multiple other factions, includ…
Chimeraleons were a species of half-dragon, half-jungle-cat predators. These creatures could change color to blend into their environment. They had razor-sharp jaws and they could breathe fire.

t: Execution of Force-sensitive individuals on Garel
x: An execution of Force-sensitive individuals carried out by the Galactic Empire took place on the planet Garel. Imperial forces, including Tala Durith, rounded up fourteen individuals, six of whom were children, from four families. All were killed by the Inquisitorius.
Zerek Besh was a criminal syndicate that came into prominence during the Galactic Civil War and had influence into the farthest reaches of the galaxy.
The Toren crime family, also known as Papa Toren's group, was a crime family led by the crime lord Toren that was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

The Neimoidian faction was the faction of the Trade Federation controlled by members of the Neimoidian species, who leveraged control over the entire Federation. As such, it was not the only faction of the Federation controlled by Neimoidians.
Rylorii Minor was a neutral mining planet located in the Rylorii Minor system in the Rocantor sector of the Expansion Region.

ZZ-10 was a droid who accompanied the Wookiee male Jedi Arkoff during the High Republic Era. He was buried on the planet Banchii with Azlin Rell's journal to protect it until he was discovered by the Nihil pirate organization.
The Dank Graks were a group of criminals whose members were mostly rejects from dark side of the Force cults, active in 382 BBY.

Vernost was a volcanic planet and the only place in the galaxy where the "miracle liquid" Ceela was found. In 2 ABY, the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire battled over the Ceela in the canyons of the planet.

The Obsidian Cliffs was a location on Oba Diah. The Mayor's majordomo mentioned how he wanted to see the cliffs while negotiating surrender with a Pyke commander
The Aqualish Quarter was a location in the Worker's District in Mos Espa, Tatooine.

A gang of four Aqualish stole on the planet Nevarro shortly after the fall of the Galactic Empire. The gang was confronted by Marshal Carasynthia Dune and defeated in a small skirmish.

Tibidon sand whales, or just sand whales, were a relative of the tibidee that was native to the desert planet Tatooine. Measuring three hundred meters in length, the sand whales used their pectoral fins and a tail fluke to propel themselves through either sand or air.
A nameless rocky barren moon not far from Jabiim was the site of a duel between Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and the Sith Lord Darth Vader in the year 9 BBY.
This moon was one of fifteen moons that orbited the Outer Rim planet Geonosis.
Tessen was a celestial body in the Tessen system of the Phelleem sector in the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice that fell within grid square S-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
A tribe of Jawa was active on the planet Tatooine in 9 BBY. Teeka was the boss of the tribe.

x: In 19 BBY, a lightsaber duel took place within the former Jedi Temple on Coruscant between Darth Vader and the Grand Inquisitor. The duel was a test by Sith Master Darth Sidious to test both and introduce them to each other.

A species of beings was found throughout the galaxy that included among its members Armo Malou, a bartender who worked at the Canto Casino and Racetrack on Cantonica. Another member worked as a supply store clerk on Tatooine during the Imperial Era.

A species of white-skinned beings counted among its members Grayla Stindy, an individual who once attended the Canto Casino and Racetrack on the planet Cantonica. Members of the species sported large skin flaps that arced down from their bulbous heads.

A dark side hellscape was located in the galaxy. Its location was known to the former Sith Lord Maul and Lady Qi'ra, the leader of Crimson Dawn, but was unknown to the Sith Lords Darth Sidious and Darth Vader.
The Dan'Gar were a political party on the planet Desinta some time between 42 BBY and 32 BBY. The group were a political opposition to the worlds nominall elected leader, Prefect Aminar.
KP-1 was a masculine K-series astromech droid associated with the Hidden Path. In 9 BBY, the droid was found on the planet Jabiim.

The garu-bear was a type of hibernating bear. When a freighter carrying the child Rey and her parents Dathan and Miramir emerged from hyperspace in Wild Space in 21 ABY, it hung momentarily in space like a garu-bear coming out of a long hibernation and taking stock of its surr…

Hyperkarn was a forested planet in the Outer Rim Territories with a twilight forest where the human female Miramir lived for years with her grandmother before giving up her life there to travel with her husband Dathan, who had also lived on Hyperkarn for a period of days.

A duel took place in 241 BBY atop Mount Bikja on the planet Alaris Prime. After having ascended the mountain and entered the shrine of a dark side cult known as the Yallow Fellowship, the Zeltron Padawan Klias Teradine encountered a vitalicron that corrupted his mind.

Janx II was a gas giant located in the Janx system in the Prackla sector of the Expansion Region near the Inner Rim Territories. In 21 ABY, Boxer Point Station, a space station that functioned as a huge multipurpose port facility, was located in high orbit above Janx II.

The Errant Venture was a starship with a dedicated casino. By 21 ABY, the gambler Lando Calrissian had made one of his best hauls playing in the casino, which he considered to have a good gambling hall.

objective: Kill Depa Billaba

Cirimalk was a town on the Outer Rim planet Adelphi that contained a card hall. On one occasion before his daughter Kadara Calrissian was kidnapped in 15 ABY, the former Rebel Alliance general Lando Calrissian spent a few days in Cirimalk with Kadara and the Twi'lek woman Kaas…
Mircapala was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Mircapala system of Wild Space. It was situated in grid S-3 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Neftali was a barren cold and frozen planet located in the Socorro system of the Outer Rim Territories. It had crystal seas and ice floes.
The second moon of the Outer Rim and New Territories planet Vernid was located in a Kanz sector's Vernid system near the Veragi Trade Route in grid square M-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Karolia was a densely forested planet located in the Belderone system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Tauntaza, the Imperial governor of the planet Gabredor III developed a piece of technology that drained the power from living things.

Antillion was a backwater world located in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, it was located in a sector governed by an Imperial governor, and was where former University of Bar'leth Sava Madelin Sun worked as a junk seller after h…
Tirn III was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Tirn system in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Tsukimitsurin was a jungle moon located in the Tsukimitsurin system, a star system in the Churnis sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

Primus Cabru was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Primus Cabru system within the Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim and the Slice. It was situated on grid square S-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Primus Cabru was the site of a library.
A market moon was located in the Pirsen system in the Eidoloni sector of the Mid Rim Territories, seven parsecs away from the planet Polaar.

Bothsoliman was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Bothsoliman system within the Hollan sector of the Mid Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square M-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Jarbanov Orbital Sorting Association was a scrapping organization based at the barren Expansion Region planet Jarbanov, located at the edge of the junker systems.

CSA troopers, nicknamed "Espos," were the infantry soldiers of the Corporate Sector Authority. The brown armored troops of the CSA functioned as an army, utilizing military formations such as companies and platoons.

CSA officers, nicknamed redcaps and Espo officers, were CSA troopers who held a position of authority and responsibility in the Corporate Sector Authority. CSA officers wore red helmets and brown field armor.
Taw Provode was a planet located in the galaxy. An Imperial fuel dump was located on the planet.

The planet Rapacc was liberated from the Nikardun Destiny hegemony around 18 BBY.
Malathon IX was a planet located in the Malathon system within the Ghost Nebula sector as part of the Expansion Region.

Ko-Longava was an astronomical object located in the Ko-Longava system within the Hocatar sector of the Expansion Region and the Slice. It was situated in grid square P-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Muqular was the homeworld of the tibanna gas–breathing Muqularan species. It was located in the Muqular system within the Montitian Grant sector of the Expansion Region and the Interior, situated in grid square J-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
A planet was ruled by the Sith Lord Viceroy Exim Panshard prior to his death. By 21 ABY, the planet had become long forgotten and the viceroy's tyrannical reign of the planet was told in legends.
Etai was a planet located in the Mid Rim Territories within the galaxy. The etaan crystal was a powerful type gemstone found on Etai that was utilized to power lightsabers.
Imperium One was the designation of an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser used by the forces of Imperial Governor Tauntaza.
Aloxl was a hot planet located in the Deep Core within the galaxy. The planet had an unusual ellipse around its gigantic star causing a 125-year hot season, and a 25-year cool season.
"Kiza's world" was the name of a large asteroid located on the edge of the Red Honeycomb Zone in the Unknown Regions.
Temako was a planet in the Temako system in the Antemeridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was the location of Voltec's manufacturing headquarters during the Galactic Civil War.
A crew was led by the female criminal known as "the Sphox." In 21 ABY, the crew were hired to assist the Jedi hunter Ochi in his search for a young girl sought by the Sith Eternal.
Yoturba was a planet located in the Mid Rim Territories. In 21 ABY, the Lerct Historical Institute conducted an archaeological dig at a site on the planet.
A moon was located in a sector near the Inner Rim Territories. The moon, along with many others in the sector, was almost the size of a planet.
A private security service was set up and run by Nikka Xizen in the years after she left her service as a Bespin Wing Guard during Lando Calrissian's time as baron administrator of Cloud City.

M-1, or Em-One, was a scarlet former Imperial mouse droid owned by the former Acolytes of the Beyond member Komat when she lived in exile on the planet Polaar. She used M-1 as as a danger signal due to Polaar's distronic radiation poisoning.

KB-68, or Kaybee Sixty-Eight, was a Duelist Elite droid with feminine programming who was owned by a male individual on Mircapala. The individual programmed her to defend him from an attacker that never actually came.

Pasaana's moon was the bright white single natural satellite of Pasaana, a planet in the Middian system of the Ombakond sector. The planet was a part of the Expansion Region and the Slice and was situated in grid square O-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Therezar was a gas giant located in the Therezar system. The station Nightside was located in a fixed orbit of Therezar within the planet's ring system.
Torrenoteer Minor was a desert planet located in the Torrenoteer system. It had three moons, two which were green, and the third being violet.

Polaar was a Mid Rim Territories planet located in the Polaar system within the Aubreeyan Cluster of the galaxy's Eidoloni sector. During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish was fought near Polaar, where a Mon Calamari battle cruiser was forced to flee.

result: Deaths of Zaycker Asheron and Dina Dipurl
x: In 21 ABY, an attack on Halo Squadron was launched by the Droid Crush Pirates of Bestoon which resulted in the deaths of Halo Squadron pilots Zaycker Asheron and Dina Dipurl.

Torrenoteer Minor's third moon was the third moon of the planet Torrenoteer Minor in the Torrenoteer system. Unlike Torrenoteer Minor's other two moons, which were green, the third moon was bright violet.

Taw Provode's solitary moon was the solitary moon of the planet Taw Provode in the Taw Provode system. The moon's surface was made of thin diamond sheets held aloft by larger crystal bergs that floated in a subterranean ocean.
The Kaywhite was a Corporate Sector Authority capital ship that was the sister ship of the Emchen. The two served as the command ships of the CSA's fleet in 21 ABY.

"RogerRoger" was the online alias of a B1-series battle droid who served in the Clone Wars. At one point, he left a one star review of the All Terrain Reconnaissance Transport, citing the fact that it stomped on big metal legs as a reason for his disdain.
The Trade Federation landing zones were the areas on the Outer Rim planet Geonosis where the Trade Federation kept its core ships.

x: Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, during the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn's war against the Galactic Empire, seventeen Imperial engineers were rescued from an Imperial starship by the Imperial officer Lieutenant Beilert Valance after a Crimson Dawn mole sabotaged the ship's reactor.

The Banshee was a Ginivex-class fanblade starfighter used by Separatist Alliance commander and Sith assassin Asajj Ventress during the Clone Wars. Ventress used the Banshee during the Battle of Sullust, and survived thanks to its design.
The Mon Calamari faction was the Mon Calamari and Quarren faction that represented their government in the Senate of the Galactic Republic.

t: Attack on a rebel recruitment base
x: In 4 ABY, Squadron Five of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing attacked a GR-75 medium transport which served as a mobile recruitment base for the Rebel Alliance.
Billaron was an astronomical object in the Billaron system in the Chitarghar sector of the Expansion Region.

Volta was an astronomical object in the Volta system in the Chaykin sector of the Expansion Region. The human Dathan was stopped traveling aboard a sunscooper at Volta, and instead joined up with the crew of a Twi'lek captain who was traveling to the Outer Rim Territories.

Land City was a city located on the gas giant Bespin's surface. At some point after the construction of Cloud City, a city in the clouds of the gas giant, a civilian told visitors of Cloud City not to confuse the city with Land City and Sea City, another city located in Bespin…

Sea City was a city located on the gas giant Bespin's ocean. At some point following the construction of the city in the clouds of Bespin, Cloud City, a civilian next to one of Cloud City's landing pads informed visitors of Cloud City not to confuse the city with Sea City or t…

The Death Star Cafeteria was a cafeteria on the second Death Star that fed Imperial stormtroopers. The cafeteria had a menu consisting of Boba Feta Cheese, Lando Calzone, Darth Wafer, Yoda Yogurt, blue milkshake, Han Salad, and more.
The Jedi Master Quinlan Vos made use of a personal Jedi starfighter during the opening weeks of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems in 22 BBY.

A mudslide disaster occurred in the eastern regions of the secondary continent of the planet Naboo in 22 BBY. Most of a village was destroyed, with only eight children who had been onboard a school transport surviving.

Aldhani was a planet located in the Cademimu sector in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. During the Imperial Era, Cassian Andor joined the Aldhani rebel infiltration team for a mission to rob the Imperial base there.

B2EMO, also known as Bee-two or Bee, was a B2 groundmech salvage assist unit who spent years in the service of the Andor family. An old boxy droid with red plating and a black main sensor, Bee could roll on his wheels over a range of terrains.

The Traffic Division was a division of the New Republic Tribunal that regulated traffic. They were responsible for sending fines to pilots who traveled above speed limits.

The B-wing Owners' Club was a club for pilots that owned B-wings. They issued bumper stickers with a pun that compared a B-wing to a picture of a bee, and one of these stickers was collected by Poe Dameron in a vehicle guidebook.

The Coruscant Skyways Authority or CSA was a group that regulated the skyways of Coruscant. At some point, they sent a Charge Payment Order to Obi-Wan Kenobi, as his Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor did not display identification.

The First Order Family Fun Day was a day for having fun hosted by the First Order. It was intended for families, and hosted events such as visiting Kylo Ren's command shuttle, or face painting to look like Maul. A poster for it was collected by Poe Dameron in a vehicle guidebook.

In 38 BBY, a battle took place in the Unknown Regions Pleknok system between the Chiss Ascendancy government's Boadil family and the Paataatus Hiveborn government initially, and later the Ascendancy's Chiss Defense Force.
Leia's bedroom was the childhood bedroom of Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan, located on Alderaan in a high tower of the royal palace and was considered simple by royal standards.
Rockmites were insects which could supposedly burrow into and nest inside the horns of Iktotchi suffering from horn rot.
The Chadawan moon was a desolate moon, barely larger than an asteroid, which orbited Chadawa, an inhabited ocean world constructed by an ancient alien species eons before the Galactic Civil War.

Gideon's Imperial Remnant Warehouse was a warehouse located in the galaxy. It sold cruiser parts, and featured Moff Gideon in advertisements. It was affiliated with Gideon's Imperial remnant and offered discounts for founders of the First Order.

Sva'leer was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories that was host to a lighthouse which contained an artifact known as the Pharorb. At some point, the archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra traveled with the assassin Just Lucky to claim the Pharorb.

Between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, Han Solo conducted a mission to the Vontorian treasure ship Graceful Promising, one of the former pirate queen Maz Kanata's caches which was locked in orbit with a dark star in the Outer Rim Territories, with the help of his partner Chewbacca and some …
The fighter design bureau was a branch of the Incom Corporation. Alliance to Restore the Republic sympathizers within the branch designed the Alliance's T-65B X-wing starfighter.
Spintiri glowbat was a type of bat that was native to the forest planet Spintir.

The Forward Work Team was a team that worked in the crew of Resurgent-class Star Destroyers. They worked in the front of the battlecruiser, as opposed to the Rear Work Team who worked in the back. A poster advertising the team was collected by Poe Dameron in a vehicle guidebook.
The Rear Work Team was a team that worked in the crew of Resurgent-class Star Destroyers. They worked in the back of the battlecruiser, as opposed to the Forward Work Team who worked in the front.

Basta Core was a frigid scrub-covered planet that possessed blue vegetation. In 21 ABY Enric Pryde, Viceprex Coromun and a group of CSA troopers participated in a mission to eliminate a syndicate of insurgents and capture a cache of arms.
During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic's 327th Star Corps fought a battle on the Outer Rim Territories astronomical object Honoghr.
During the Clone Wars, a battle was fought on the astronomical object New Holstice. The Galactic Republic's 327th Star Corps participated in the battle.
The Death Star II Restoration Fund was a foundation formed during or after 4 ABY to restore the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station.
G4-G4-G5-XNXX7-G4 was an agridroid working on Hyperkarn. She was managed by Dathan who was tasked with keeping the droid operating.

The Loongren were a species who were persecuted by the Land & Sky Corporation, ostracized by propaganda and kept in poverty. The species did not enjoy the civil rights of other sentients within the Aakaash system.

The great gash was a scar in the landscape of the planet Lenahra. It was created by the crash of a starship long before 41 BBY. The survivors of the starship crash founded a civilization on the planet, and lived peacefully for some time.

A B1-series battle droid served under the command of General Lok Durd during the Clone Wars. While stationed on the planet Maridun, the battle droid was stationed in a Separatist command center and commanded his fellow units, only to be cut down by Jedi General Anakin Skywalke…
The Core District was a majestic district in the center of Cinnagar, capital of the planet Empress Teta.

A crew was led by the pirate Crimson Jack. In 34 ABY, the crew attempted to claim a bounty from the First Order after learning that a Resistance spy had sent a transmission about a drive of secret codes.

R5-D5 was an R5 series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton. In 9 BBY, the R-series astromech droid was operating on the Imperial-controlled planet Mapuzo, where it worked alongside the loader droid NED-B on a landing pad atop a flat mesa.

A city was located on the Inner Rim Territories planet Zeitooine during the Imperial Era. The location contained a spaceport as well as a city square. It was visited by the freighter Mighty Oak Apocalypse seven months after the Battle of Yavin.

2X-3KPR was a KPR security droid that belonged to the Lars family on the planet Tatooine. In 9 BBY, it stood outside the Lars Homestead on alert conditions when the former Inquisitor Reva Sevander arrived in search of the Lars's adopted son, Luke Skywalker.
R2-B3 was a droid that was part of the Hidden Path. In 9 BBY, R2-B3 was present for a meeting preparing for the Rescue of Princess Leia.
New Town was a gated town in the Known Universe. Despite not being located in the galaxy, the conflict of the Skywalker family was felt there through a Disturbance in the Force.
Madurs was an ice moon in the Lenguin system in the Maldrood sector of the Mid Rim Territories that orbited a gas giant. The inhabitants of the moon built ice palaces and had a great value for art.

Wayunings were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Topi Topi was a diminutive member of the species from Ardennia who by 34 ABY had a bounty placed on their head for stealing a Kowakian monkey-lizard from the Creature Stall in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.

x: During the Clone Wars, the planet Cato Neimoidia was conquered by the Galactic Republic at some point after it had fallen under the control of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
MK-8 was an RA-7 protocol droid manufactured on the planet Vulpter by Arakyd Industries. The protocol droid had silver plating, black sensors, and stood 1.7 meters tall.
SE-5 was an SE-2 worker droid manufactured on the planet Affa by Cybot Galactica. The worker droid had white plating, black sensors, and stood 1.79 meters tall.
Fissure Lake was a lake located on the Chiss Ascendancy planet of Celwis.

A sentient species of insectoids lived in the galaxy, on worlds such as Ferrix. One member was Euphaus Biro, who lived during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

The Andon Host were a species on the planet Malenko. By the time of the Clone Wars the Andon Host were long extinct. According to legends, they were powerful necromancers.

The Bank of Kolma was a financial institution based on the planet Chandrila. In 5 BBY, Chandrilan senator Mon Mothma approached Kolma banker Tay Kolma for help clandestinely accessing her family accounts without alerting the watchful eyes of the Galactic Empire.

Malenko was a planet located in the Mid Rim Territories. Part of the Malenko system in the Eidoloni sector, the planet appeared to be bathed in green mists and covered in bleak water bodies with crystalline shards sprawling through its surface.

Ajax Sigma was a warrior-priest droid who lived in the High Republic Era and was created on Kligson's Moon, he sought the freedom of droids and became an insurgent out of anger until he was struck down by the Jedi Order.
Gansevor, known as the "planet of knives," was a rocky, mountainous planet located in the Tammuz sector of the Outer Rim Territories, and on the Republic frontier.

Turrak was a planet in the Turrak system within the Outer Rim Territories and Galactic Frontier that was the homeworld of the Scalvi species. During the High Republic Era, it was visited by Jedi Grandmaster Yoda after the Scalvi sent out a call for help.

The ISB conference room, also known as the ISB meeting chamber, was a room in the ISB Central Office on Coruscant. It was used for Investigations branch officer meetings, including the sector supervisors' forum and major policy change announcements.

A massive datavault maintained for the Imperial Security Bureau was located within in the ISB central office on Coruscant. It contained datatapes with data from multiple Imperial sectors under ISB supervision, which officers could use in their investigations.

Pier Nine was a location at Niamos. The human Cassian Andor was apprehended by a shoretrooper after being suspected of suspicious activity.

A charitable organization was founded to help individuals find and reunite with their families after being separated during the Clone Wars. Founded by 1 BBY, the organization attracted the attention of the Alderaanian Rel during his time as a student.
A battle took place on the Outer Rim moon of Shard during or after 1 BBY.

The bog slug was a type of slug that lived in bogs on the Outer Rim Territories swamp planet Dagobah. Whenever they were available, the alien Jedi Master Yoda used bog slugs as an ingredient in the Mud and Bug Soup meal—which he admitted did not taste good—during his exile on …

A division of the Imperial Security Bureau was led by Colonel Wullf Yularen and tasked with exposing instances of sedition within the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate. Yularen served in the division after resigning his admiral commission in the navy.
Narkina 5, also known as Narkina, was a small water moon that orbited the gas giant Narkina. The Galactic Empire maintained a prison complex there.

The Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex, also known as the Narkina 5 detention facility was a complex of seven separate Imperial factory facilities situated in the middle of a lake located on the moon Narkina 5.

A lifeless planet was the site of the Jedi Mitaka's compound, where the human and several of his assistant droids resided. Within the structure, Mitaka and his assistants researched how to bring life to the planet.

Galdi was a planet located in an eponymous star system within the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Deris-plata was a planet located in the Eucer sector within the Mid Rim Territories. Incognito Cassian Andor claimed to be from Deris-plata during his time on Niamos. In reality, Andor was from Kenari.
Giermos was the home planet of a prisoner at the Imperial prison on Niamos who was being transferred to another facility.
Spellhaus was an astronomical object that hosted a power station for the Galactic Empire. By 5 BBY, the rebel cell led by Anto Kreegyr was probing the power station and planning an attack.

Narkina was a gas giant located in the Abrion sector's Narkina system within the Outer Rim, specifically at Standard Galactic Grid space S-15. The planet also lay in the section of space known as The Slice.
A village located on the planet Shili was inhabited by members of the Togruta species, including a young Ahsoka Tano and her mother, Pav-ti Tano. It was located at the edge of a forested wilderness.

The Ghorman Front, also known as the Ghorman rebel cell, the Ghorman resistance, or as the Ghorman rebels, was an anti-Imperial group that was active by 5 BBY on the planet Ghorman.
Two-ton was a droid who kept company to Dagonet’s son Uriel while he was kidnapped by villagers.
The Festival of Balance was a festival that the Convocation of the Force planned to hold on the moon Jedha during the Season of Light.

The Lonto were a sentient humanoid species with a powerful and unique connection to nature. They were culturally worshippers of the light side of the Force who devoted themselves to the good of the natural world.
Mon-Hella was a location on the same astronomical object as a farming village. During the Imperial Era, farmers in the village delivered their harvests to Mon-Hella.
Drutash grubs were a type of grub that were farmed as food by the Sullustan species in large dank caverns on the volcanic planet Sullust.

The Sectorists were a group that opposed the Galactic Empire and were active by 5 BBY. In that year, the human rebel Luthen Rael approached the leader of the Partisans rebel group, Saw Gerrera, to convince his associate to team up with the separatist Anto Kreegyr.

Rohm was an agriworld in the Mid Rim Territories' Hevvrol sector that was inhabited by farmers. In 397 BBY, the Force-sensitive human Rooper Nitani was born on Rohm before eventually being taken to the Core Worlds planet Coruscant by the Jedi Order for training.

The Katikoot were a batlike sentient species from the twin planets of Gloam and Aubadas. Originally native to Gloam, the Katikoot were forced to immigrate to Aubadas after mining activities unleashed a plague which turned members of the species into zombie-like monsters.

The moon of Barroth was a terrestrial moon located in the Barroth system within the Kriz sector of the Outer Rim and Western Reaches. The moon was situated in grid square K-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Umberfall was a Pathfinder ship used by Jedi Master Silandra Sho's Republic Pathfinder team.
The Foundling was a Pathfinder ship used by Outer Rim Expedition Two-Five-Two, a Republic Pathfinder team led by Jedi Master Rok Buran.

An inhabited water world existed in the galaxy. In 382 BBY, the EX droid EX-8C saw the world, with artificial lights illuminating its inhabited areas, on its journey from the Outer Rim planet Gloam while carrying a distress message from stranded Jedi Master Rok Buran.

EX-8C, or Atesee, was an EX droid assigned to Outer Rim Expedition Two-Five-Two, a team of Republic Pathfinders active in 382 BBY. The team was betrayed during an expedition to the planet Gloam, with its leader, Jedi Master Rok Buran, the sole survivor.
The fae were an ancient species. The myth "The Silent Circle" tells the story of how the trees, the fae and the beasts once lived in harmony on Batuu.
The Trees were an ancient species of sentient, though non-animate plants. The myth "The Silent Circle" tells the story of how the Trees, the Fae and the Beasts once lived in harmony on Batuu.
The beasts were an ancient species. The myth "The Silent Circle" tells the story of how the trees, the fae and the beasts once lived in harmony on Batuu.

Outer Rim Expedition Two-Five-Two was a Republic Pathfinder team led by Jedi Master Rok Buran during the High Republic Era. Besides Buran, the team consisted of Padawan Maliq, Joneth, Branda, and the communications droid EX-8C. They operated out of the Pathfinder ship Foundling.

Geptish was a terrestrial planet located in the Mid Rim and Western Reaches. During the High Republic Era, Jedi Master Silandra Sho and her Padawan, Rooper Nitani, returned to Geptish's Jedi temple while not on missions on the Galactic Frontier.

Around 3 ABY, an auction on Spira was hosted by a Troig auctioneer. It was one of two antiques auctions held a year on the planet Spira.

Maz Kanata's pirate crew, also known as Maz's crew, was a crew of pirates led by the pirate queen Maz Kanata during the High Republic Era. During the Battle of Jedha, the Jedi Padawan Sav Malagán went undercover to join the crew.

The Bpfasshi were a humanoid species associated with the religion the Truthsayers of Bpfassh. In 382 BBY, one member of the species who was a Truthsayer confronted Ran Yaltan for pretending to be a Truthsayer in the Holy City on the moon Jedha.

Kligson's Moon was a moon located in the Ostega system in the Grohl sector of the Outer Rim Territories with a droid station known as the Haven in orbit of it. For millennium, the Kligson clan safeguarded the station, and the moon bore the clan's name.

Bo-Katan Kryze's unit was a team of Mandalorian Nite Owls under the command of Lady Bo-Katan Kryze, the former Mand'alor. Kryze and her followers fought against Gideon's Imperial remnant and hunted for the Darksaber with the intention to one day retake the planet Mandalore.
The Fountain Square was a large square located in the Ferrix business center. Rix Road culminated in this square and the main city hotel was located adjacent to it.
The Ferrix Bell Tower was a bell tower located on the one end of Rix Road in the Ferrix business center, opposite to the Fountain Square.

A healing house was located on Invocation Way in the Holy City on Jedha. In 382 BBY, the Path of the Open Hand purchased the house and used it as an almshouse. It was also where the Path's members resided whilst they were on Jedha.

The Preox-Morlana Corporate Zone was an area on the planet Morlana One under the jurisdiction of Preox-Morlana. In 5 BBY, Cassian Andor went to a brothel in the Leisure Zone there, in search of his sister, whom he had been separated from at a young age.
Even Piell's cruiser was a Venator-class Star Destroyer commanded by Jedi General Even Piell and Captain Wilhuff Tarkin during the Clone Wars.

Ipsidon bucks were a species of herding creature resided on an ipsium-rich planet Ipsidon. The species was quadrupedal, had blue fur with a white underbelly, and had three horns; two atop its head, and a single horn affixed between its eyes.

Ilith's Group was a splinter faction of the Ascendant cult that was established centuries before the Galactic Civil War to pursue a different form of research compared to the leader of the Bar'leth Group, Miril.
Ridley was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories that the bounty hunter Boba Fett visited to undertake a job. Whilst on the planet, he was forced to defend his client from Bossk.
During or after 18 BBY, the Bad Batch undertook a mission to collect ipsium from Cid's mine on Ipsidon. With the absence of Echo, the squad's dynamic was tested.
Emoh terminus was a location in the Ploo sector's Emoh system, within the Expansion Region and the New Territories. It was situated in grid square N-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Fissrit were a type of carnivorous, many-legged arthropod that were native to ice worlds. Also known as fire worms, they could produce incredible heat through a natural chemical reaction in their underbellies, which allowed them to thrive in frozen conditions.
An apartment located in a building in Carannia, the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno, belonged to Republic Intelligence Officer Raz Fellidrone by 23 BBY.
Karaxis was a planet in Wild Space home to the Karaxians. Kylo Ren and General Hux visited to enforce Snoke's will upon its population.

result: Separatist and Techno Union occupation of Ryloth

A band of mercenaries was lead the Kerk Caratoo during the High Republic Era. The former Jedi Ty Yorrick was part of the band until Caratoo turned his back on her.
An army of mercenaries working for Dro-Nal-Pru was active during the High Republic Era. Ty Yorrick as well as Gren were part of the group.
The xunji were large creatures. If individuals of different species were scratched by a xunji, they would turn into a xunji too. The Mythrol Gren turned into a xunji during the High Republic Era.
An encampment was located on the planet Salstan during the High Republic Era. The Cerean Dro-Nal-Pru was its marshal.
Salstan was a planet located in the galaxy. The Cerean Dro-Nal-Pru served as the marshal of an encampment on Salstan.

The Imperial officer and Hidden Path mole Tala Durith owned a shuttle that served as her transport. An Iota-class TS-485 light shuttle produced by Sienar Fleet Systems and Cygnus Space Workshops, it was taken away by the Galactic Empire while it had docked in Fortress Inquisit…
Northern Indoumodo was a location on the planet Indoumodo. The Termite forests were part of the northern Indoumodo.
Octopoids were creatures on the planet Mannius Eight. Auric Graf used to study Octopoids.
Slime-toads were creatures in the galaxy. It was also used as an insult.
Freighter One Seventeen was a freighter owned by the Naboo Sabé and Tonra, which they brought with them on their mission to the Outer Rim planet Tatooine.
The port control of the Mos Eisley spaceport on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine operated by the time of the Clone Wars. It managed traffic in and out of the spaceport by assigning docking bays.

Pyrr IX was a terrestrial astronomical object. Centuries before the Galactic Civil War, a splinter faction of the Ascendant cult established a temple on Pyrr IX. Sometime later, the faction was wiped out by the Sith.
A hauler was used by the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts to transport creatures. SF-R3 and CAM were locked in the cargo bay together with many Gorgs.
The flats was a location on the planet Nevarro.

A soulcraft was in operation on the Inner Rim planet Pijal by 40 BBY. During that year, the vessel was attacked by blackguards and was engulfed in plasma fire. The Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi attempted to rescue it using field lasers to dispel the flames.

The attack on the Inner Rim planet Pijal's Grand Hunt took place in 40 BBY. Prior to the event, the Pijali Princess Fanry ordered her enslaved attendant, Cady, to reprogram the hunt's prey, a crab droid, with the intent to kill the princess.

result: Narin fails to collect the bounty on Lando Calrissian

The Serenno Camp was a camp set up in 42 BBY during the Invasion of Serenno on a mountain. The camp housed many veterans that were wounded.
Mokkotown was a decrepit ipsium mining facility owned by the gang boss Mokko during or after 18 BBY.

Centuries before 4 ABY the Sith Darkseekers carried out an attack on the Ascendant temple on Pyrr IX. During the attack, Ilith, leader of a group of the Ascendant used his Spark Eternal to wipe out a number of Sith, though he was caught by surprise and stabbed in the chest by …
EX-5A, also known as Ex-Five, was an EX communication droid and part of an Outer Rim Exploration Team.

objective: Defeat the Drengir
x: In 231 BBY, mercenary Ty Yorrick was hired by Safrifan farmers to defeat a member of the Drengir species that had destroyed their crops and killed many of their children.

The Keshiri were a sentient species from the Wild Space planet Kesh. They could have skin colors of either, different shades of lavender and violet or blue, and could have red eyes and purple hair. Sohi and Chellwinark Frethylrin were members of the species.
An asteroid served as the location of a base for the Haxion Brood during the Imperial Era.
Blorp was a droid bounty hunter of the Haxion Brood criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era. At some point, he encountered the crew of the Stinger Mantis luxury yacht.
Skeezumps were creatures found on the planet Lateron. They were fuzzy and had digestive systems that fermented whatever they ate, which put the creatures in a state of constant inebriation.

x: With the help of Merrin, Cal Kestis infiltrated a Haxion Brood base during the Imperial Era in order to destroy it.

Between 12 BBY and 11 BBY, the Stinger Mantis crew undertook a mission to the planet Murkhana. During the course of the course, the Jedi Cere Junda and Cal Kestis dueled with the Inquisitor known as the Fifth Brother.

A CR90 corvette served the Pijali monarchy's royal fleet on the Inner Rim planet Pijal. By 40 BBY, a captain commanded the vessel and used it to ensare the Righteous in a tractor beam.

The security forces of the Inner Rim planet Pijal served the Pijali monarchy. The forces comprised of the world's royal guards, honor guards, members of the royal fleet, and secretly, the blackguards.

The formation of the Byrnum Maw nebula in the Inner Rim Territories occurred centuries before 40 BBY. After the event, the hyperspace routes near the nebula were disrupted and rendered unusable, isolating neighboring systems, such as the Pijal system, from the wider galaxy.
The Nomad Plains was a location on the planet Gansevor. The city-state Firevale was located above the Nomad Plains
In 40 BBY, Pijali blackguards executed a raid on a Czerka facility on the moon of the Inner Rim planet Pijal.

The Ramshead Gorge was a gorge near the Rook, the capital city of the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh. During the High Republic Era, the gorge was used for starfighter and target practice drills by members of E'ronoh's fleet.
Abyssin Outpost was an outpost operated by Abyssin mercenaries that was located on the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno by 42 BBY, close to the Carannian hills and the capital city Carannia
A cruiser of the Pijali monarchy's royal fleet was in operation by 40 BBY. When not in use, it was kept in the royal palace's dock.

Ersos' apartment was the residence of the Doctor Galen Walton Erso, his wife Lyra Erso, and their daughter Jyn Erso. It was situated in an elevated residential area of the Project Celestial Power complex in the former B'ankor Refuge on the planet Coruscant.

A Consular-class cruiser served the Galactic Republic during the Republic Era. In 40 BBY, the vessel transported the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan, Obi-Wan Kenobi, to the Inner Rim planet Pijal.

The Modine Valley was a valley on the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh that featured glittering spires. At some point by 382 BBY, the E'roni princess and fleet captain Xiri A'lbaran flew her squadron, Thylefire Squadron, over the valley's spires.
The Ossein Plains were located on the Boneworld. Ambercrysts could be found there.
The Office of the Frontier was a department of the Galactic Republic where frontier worlds could send in their petitions for Jedi aid.
Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven, also known as Pathfinder team 807, was a Republic Pathfinder team led by the Mikkian Jedi Master Helion Volte during the High Republic Era.
An environmental team, also known as a science team, was a Galactic Republic team sent out to investigate whenever a planet's environment was in danger or seemed to be unbalanced.

Has's crew was a group of individuals led by the smuggler Has Obitt during the Clone Wars. While Obitt was working for the Republic Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic, the latter replaced Obitt's crew with a team of Republic Intelligence direct action operatives commanded by t…
The Erasmus Sea was a sea on the planet Eiram. It was near Erasmus Capital City, the capital of Eiram.

Agopies were a water-dwelling creature that lived on the planet Eiram. They resembled horses and could be ridden. Wild agopies living near the city of Erasmus Capital City were very docile and would let any of the locals ride them.

The Scatalpen was the podracer of the Aleena pilot Ratts Tyerell. Equipped with twin Vokoff-Strood Titan 2150 rocket engines, it was named for a deadly predator from Tyerell's homeworld, Aleen.

The giant turtle gator, also known as the dinosaur turtle, or simply the lake monster, was a non-sentient reptilian creature, which was known to be aggressive.

Gorian Shard's pirate crew, or Gorian Shard's gang, was a gang and pirate crew led by the Pirate King Gorian Shard that was part of the larger Pirate Nation. The gang operated in the Dalicron sector and on the planet Nevarro around 9 ABY.

A Cumulus-class Corsair was owned by Pirate King Gorian Shard and his pirate crew around 9 ABY. It was involved in a dogfight in the Nevarro system, and later launched the Pirate siege on Nevarro itself, during which it was destroyed by the Mandalorians.
Voidroaches were small, six legged creatures the Colony of Kezarat used to eat. The colony used a Longbeam cruiser as a breeding pen.

Silla was a temperate forested planet in the galaxy. Featuring forests, grasslands, and mountains, Silla was a slow-paced and serene world. Its inhabitants lived in smaller villages spread across the grasslands.
A village was located on Silla. During the Imperial Era, it was set upon by a cloned Zillo Beast that had escaped from a crashed Imperial transport.

Transport 904 was a, Imperial research transport of the Galactic Empire. During or after 18 BBY, it was bound for the planet Wayland and the new facilities there when its cargo, a cloned Zillo Beast, broke loose and drastically damaged the ship.

CU-28, nicknamed Copper, was a was a protocol droid that served as the assistant to High Magistrate Greef Karga on the planet Nevarro during the early New Republic Era, helping Karga with daily tasks and administrative work and informing him of events in the city.

The charon were a type of creature that lived on the planet Gand. Prior to Zuckuss' undertaking of the Great Rite at some point before 4 ABY, a number of sacred flowers known as the T'karra flower were spotted by Gand as growing in the nesting grounds of the charon.

Eiram's western isles were a chain of islands west of Erasmus Capital City on Eiram. During the Eiram and E'ronoh War in 382 BBY, they were attacked by E'roni forces which forced many of its inhabitants to flee to the capital city or more precisely to the Rayes Canal.

An astronomical object was located in the galaxy. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca visited the astronomical object to bury the neural core of the droid revolutionary Ajax Sigma and prevent it from being acquired by the crime lord Jabba Desil…

An astronomical object was located in the galaxy. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the smuggler Han Solo was forced to crash his starship, the Millennium Falcon, on the astronomical object after it was fired on by Akko, who was piloting the starship owned by his boss Khel Tanna.

The Mandalorian secret covert was a covert established by the Children of the Watch on a barren terrestrial planet within a cave system that was near a body of water, after maintaining a Mandalorian covert on the Glavis Ringworld.
The Anzellan Droidsmiths were a legendary crew of three Anzellan droidsmiths living on the planet Nevarro.

The Great Rite was an event undertaken by the Gand species on Gand prior to them becoming Findsman. Before he undertook the Great Rite, the future bounty hunter Zuckuss began to have doubts about whether he had to undertake it and if he wa worthy of becoming a Findsman, and we…

A starship was owned by Marshal Buck Vancto of the Benelex Marshal Service. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the marshal used the ship to transport the Corbus Tyra to Paqualis III where he intended to imprison the criminal at the Benelex Marshal Service Headquarters, though Tyr…

The Civic Center, also written as civic center, was located in the city of Sundari on Mandalore, above the Mines of Mandalore and the Living Waters. It was heavily damaged during the Great Purge of Mandalore.

The Eventide was a starship owned by Axel Greylark's father and after his death by Axel Greylark. After Axel was imprisoned, his mother Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark gifted the ship to Jedi Knight Gella Nattai.
Pipyyrians were a sentient species native to the planet Pipyyr.

Pipyyr was a gray and white colored planet located in the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Pipyyrian species. It was located near the planet of Bakura. The atmospheric pressure of the planet caused problems for some, making them sick.
CA73Z was a prison barge on which Axel Greylark had been imprisoned before being transferred to the Republic Correctional Facility on Pipyyr.
L-5G6, abbreviated as L5, was a chrome-plated protocol droid that served Jedi Master Mace Windu during the Clone Wars.

The Spinnaker Raiders were a group of raiders that operated on the planet Vandor. They were known to attack those who entered their territory, notably killing workers attempting to build tracks for conveyex transports and tearing up the tracks each time.
The Dunes of Contemplation were located on the moon Jedha. A statue of a Jedi known as the Final Protector was located in the Dunes of Contemplation.
The Square of the Supplicants, also known as the Square of the Penitents, or simply as the central square, was a location in the Holy City of Jedha.

Qiilura was a location in the Qiilura system in the Qiilura sector of the Mid Rim Territories. In 20 BBY, the 104th Battalion was redirected from the battlefront on Qiilura to aid the Aleen relief effort.

Scrabblers were rat- or lizard-like reptiles that lived on planet Gloam in colonies. In 382 BBY, Dass Leffbruk hunted the small reptiles for food using a sharp stick, which he poked into the rocky nooks the scrabbler colonies lived in.
A medical droid aboard Transport 904 warned Tech about a danger shortly before it fully malfunctioned and shutdown.
