Asteroid fields were located at the edge of Nevarro's system. The fields were mined by by belters, and the money made from mining them helped Nevarro City on the planet Nevarro to prosper.
Boolsa were large blue creatures that lived on Dalna. In 230 BBY, Vernestra Rwoh, Imri Cantaros, Yacek Sparkburn, Honesty Weft and Sha'nai Plouth had to run from a boolsa stampede.

Moon fish were a type of fish edible by tooka cats. In 230 BBY, Jedi Knight Yacek Sparkburn cooked moon fish in the Jedi temple on the Outer Rim planet Dalna which he then placed into a woven bag with fruits among other items in other bags.
Snipes were dangerous predators on the planet Dalna.

t: Attack at an outpost near Tiikae
x: In 230 BBY, the Nihil pirates undertook an attack at an outpost near the Galactic Frontier planet Tiikae. Within hours of the Nihil's attack, it was reported to the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon.
Corellian gluttonbugs were bugs that lived in hives. According to Rieve, the Grand Arena looked like a hive of Corellian gluttonbugs.
The Hypernova was the starship of Balada the Hutt. It floated over the Grand Arena on Vespaara.
The First Order Space Ministry was an organization in the First Order.
Vaapad was an invertebrate creature native to the Core Worlds planet of Sarapin. Jedi Master Mace Windu developed a lightsaber form named after the creature.
A village was the home of the Kage child Krylind. It was destroyed by the Nihil.
Hansibel Island was a large island on the planet Dalna. When Dalna had to be evacuated, everyone was sent to the emergency shelter on Hansibel Island to wait for Starlight Beacon to arrive.
Bragh Ocean was an ocean on the planet Dalna.
The Dalna temple had archives where all reports and records made by the Dalna temple Jedi were stored. Its archivist was Lyssa Votz.
The Dalna temple had a meditation garden near a brook. Nyla Quinn suggested visiting the garden when Vernestra Rwoh and Imri Cantaros arrived at the temple on their mission to rescue Avon Starros.
A brook was located near the Dalna temple. It had brilliant cerulean water and rocks with red moss laid nearby.

Master Sho's Pathfinder team was a Republic Pathfinder team led by Jedi Master Silandra Sho during the High Republic Era. The team consisted of Sho, Sho's Padawan Rooper Nitani, Dietrix Jago, Obik Dennisol, and the droids GT-11 and EX-9B.

T1L-D4, also referred to as "Tilda," was a droid who worked as a bounty hunter alongside Killena during the Imperial Era. The two hunted Cal Kestis and confronted him when the Stinger Mantis crew infiltrated a Haxion Brood base.

Kesh was a planet located in the Kesh system in Wild Space, in grid square U-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid, past the eastern edge of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Keshiri species, and the planet never joined the Galactic Republic.

Chikua City was a city on the Core planet Hosnian Prime. The Stinger Mantis crew traveled to Chikua City to meet Qeris Lar, a wealthy man using his money against the Galactic Empire. The Latero Greez Dritus didn't like the city because of its lack of plants.

During the New Republic Era, skirmish erupted outside a Mandalorian covert during a Children of the Watch induction ceremony when a dinosaur turtle attacked members of the Tribe. The Mandalorians had difficulty dealing with the beast until the arrival of Din Djarin.

Artemesium was a terrestrial planet located in the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice regions of the galaxy, within the Lifh sector's Artemesium system. It was situated in grid square R-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Artemesium had a a breathable atmosphere.
Zimara was a small moon in the Outer Rim Territories covered in volcanic terrain and had sulfur baths. The moon was tidally locked, such that one side always faced towards the sun.
Barton IV was an icy planet where the Galactic Empire maintained a supply depot that stored armor and other equipment. The outpost was commanded by Clone Commander Mayday and his squad.
The Imperial Information Bureau was an information agency of the Galactic Empire that was active by around 18 BBY.

Nosna fish was a type of fish that could be found on Naboo and Miekos. Noparo Yar and his wife, Fee-Na, were farmers who raised several types of fish, including nosna fish, at their homestead on Miekos. It was the favorite food of Aryssha, a member of the Starros Clan.
Gaja birds were a type of bird that could be found on the Core Worlds planet Hosnian Prime, where they plucked fish from the world's oceans. They bickered with each other and were hunted for sport.
An Imperial Depot, nicknamed "The Outpost" by its squad, was situated on a mountain on the planet Barton IV.
The black ice vulture or simply the ice vulture was a type of bird native to the icy planet Barton IV.
A footman droid served Bo-Katan Kryze and operated in Kryze Castle on the planet Kalevala. The droid announced visitors, and downloaded R5-D4's data to learn what happened to Din Djarin.

Alamites were a sentient humanoid species native to the planet Mandalore, where they once resided in the deserted wastelands beyond the cities. After the Galactic Empire's purge of Mandalore, some Alamites relocated to the ruins of Sundari.

The Nihil encampment on Dalna was the main camp of Kara Xoo's Tempest in 230 BBY. The Nihil kidnpped Avon Starros and other children and took them to this encampment. There Avon met Zadina Mkampa with whom she developed the Sunvale crystal to power a groundquake machine.

A raiders' hideout was located on a mountain on the planet Barton IV. The hideout featured several cargo crates, a snow skiff containing two cargo crates stolen from the nearby Imperial Depot on the planet and at least one power generator.

Reptavians roamed the ruins of the Civic Center of Sundari on Mandalore, following the Great Purge of Mandalore. A reptavian chased Grogu when he escaped the ruins. Grogu was able to get in Din Djarin's N-1 starfighter, and R5-D4 piloted the ship away from the planet.
Team Gundark was one of the teams the Hunters were assigned to randomly before a competition.
Team Mudhorn was one of the teams the Hunters were assigned to randomly before a competition.

A droidsmith workshop was ran by the Anzellan Droidsmiths on the volcanic planet Nevarro. Around the time of the New Republic, Din Djarin visited the workshop and asked the Anzellans to help repair IG-11.

Groovy Grotto was a dance club in the Forbidden Valley on the planet Pasaana. A Disco Director attempted to hold a silent disco during the Festival of the Ancestors in 35 ABY, but mechanical issues caused several malfunctions.

Bay 2 was a hangar aboard the First Order Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Thunderer. In 34 ABY, the Resistance pilot Venisa Doza and her astromech droid Torch entered the bay, hoping to escape off of the Star Destroyer.

The Warthogs were a sentient species. They had bluish-gray and red skin and dark hair and were notable for their long snouts with two large tusks at the front and four further horns along the upper part, including an epijugal horn.
A predator was a type of carnivorous mammals that inhabited the swamps of the planet Gloam. They appeared to be a cross between a charhound and a giant cat.

Loading dock 23 was a bay of the Colossus loading docks. In 34 ABY, Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono was nearly assassinated by First Order spy Teroj Kee after the latter individual ordered dock worker Glem to drop his locker—which Xiono was trapped inside—into the waters of Castil…

A group of raiders operated on the ice world of Barton IV. They stole crates of Imperial armor and weapons from an outpost guarded by Mayday's squad. To protect themselves from the cold, the raiders wore bandages and even the armor of clones they had killed.
A mole rat was a type of rat in the galaxy. According to Ponda Baba, Saelt-Marae resembled a mole rat or a camel.
Bay squids were an aquatic species that lived in the Ugyir River of Coronet City on the planet Corellia. They had a habit of ducking in and out of the clear waters of the river.

Starlows were a species that lived on the planet Corellia. They gathered in flocks on the rooftops of Coronet City. Starlows were named after their brown feathers, which sparkled in the streetlights of the city, giving them the appearance of starlight when they took flight.
Troithe sewer rats were a species that lived on Troithe. Comparing someone to a Troithe sewer rat was a saying used in the galaxy.
Blaze bugs were a type of bug. Rieve likened her memories of previous events haunting her to their habit of repeatedly biting.

Dooku's prison was a prison consisting of various cells and torture chambers located deep within the rockface of a large cliff where Castle Serenno was situated on the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno.
The Battle of Salamento Bridge was a battle fought in the Eiram and E'ronoh War. The Eirami Paternok and the E'roni Kimbral both lost many loved people in the battle.

The Spider Tank was a large, manually-controlled model of droid utilized by a cyborg that resided on the planet Mandalore. In 9 ABY, the cyborg utilized its Spider Tank to capture and sedate the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin.

Pabu island, also simply known as Pabu, was a remote island located on the tropical planet of the same name. It was led by its mayor, Shep Hazard, and its inhabitants were mostly refugees from the Clone Wars.

The Freetown Marshal's office was the law enforcement department that operated in the town of the planet Tatooine Freetown and Mos Pelgo territories. During the New Republic Era, the agency was headed by the Marshal Cobb Vanth and his right-hand man, Deputy Scott.

The "Armorer's planet", also known as the Covert, was an unknown planet in the Outer Rim Territories that hosted a Mandalorian covert in 9 ABY. The planet was discovered by a scout from the Children of the Watch.
The mantabog was a creature native to the planet Malastare. They shared their name with the Mantabog Crevice Rally, a podracing course that had been set up by around 10 BBY.
Upper Pabu was the older part of the remote island on Pabu. It was home to the Archium and defended by a large seawall that protected the area from sea surges.

Lower Pabu was the newer part of the remote island on Pabu. It was wrecked during or after 18 BBY when a sea surge was caused by tremors under Pabu. However, its inhabitants were able to reach the safety of Upper Pabu with the help of Clone Force 99 and Phee Genoa.
Around 9 ABY, a taxi droid piloted Doctor Penn Pershing in an air taxi from the Galaxies Opera House to Amnesty Housing on the planet Coruscant.
Moonyos, also spelled moon-yos, were a creature that inhabited a remote island on Pabu. According to the elders of the island, moonyos had inhabited Pabu before humans had settled there.
A parole droid supervised Penn Pershing when he was part of the Amnesty Program.
The New Republic Amnesty Program was a rehabilitation program operated by the New Republic during the New Republic Era, established after the fall of the Galactic Empire.

Tibidee Clan was a Jedi Initiate Clan that included the Togorian Jak'zin, the Trandoshan Gheyr, and the Wookiee Krrsish. The clan was taught by Grand Master Yoda, and for a period of time by Jedi Master Dooku, at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

Corvair II, also known simply as Corvair, was an astronomical object located in the Corvair system, within the Corvair sector of the Inner Rim Territories. At one point, Jedi Grand Master Yoda brought the Tibidee Clan of Jedi Initiates to Corvair II for a trial.

The Scarlet Skulls were a crew formed during the Nihil pirates occupation of the Outer Rim planet Valo by the Jedi Ram Jomaram, Gavi, Kildo, Tep Tep, and the aspiring pirate Zyle Keem to fight back against the Nihil.

x: The Pabu sea surge hit Pabu when the Bad Batch visited the remote island during or after 18 BBY.
The Aurora Sun was a Longbeam cruiser owned by Kyong Greylark.
The Orra Lagoon was a location five kilometers away from Erasmus Capital City on the planet Eiram. Phan-tu Zenn liked to visit the lagoon. Slek grew and was traditionally gathered in the Orra Lagoon

During or after 4 ABY, a diplomatic mission to Endor was undertaken by the Lepi Jaxxon T. Tumperakki of the New Republic to help resolve a crisis on the moon Endor. Tumperakki was accompanied by the protocol droid C-3PO, who the native Ewoks saw as a god.
C1-940 was a C1-series astromech droid optimized to function in the permafrost desert of Jedha and its spiritual nature.
Jul's droid army was an army of droids purchased by the Skakoan revolutionary Jul Tambor during his attempts to liberate Skako Minor from the Skakoan Council.

A river system was located around the town of Kublop Springs on the planet Tenoo. The Kublop Classic took place in the river.

The Pirate Nation was a loosely-knit pirate utopia in existence during the New Republic Era. The Pirate Nation was identified by it's jagged black and white livery on the hulls of it's ships which were well known among interstellar merchants.

Tuttle's office was an office assigned to Colonel Tuttle inside the New Republic Coruscant skyscraper in the planet Coruscant.
The landing yard was a port for visitors and residents to park their vehicles located in Nevarro City.

The Warehouse District was a district on Vespaara where an illegal underground fighting ring was located.

Ipsidon spaceport was an abandoned spaceport located on the planet Ipsidon.
Tanalorr was a peaceful and paradisiacal planet, strong in the Force that was located inside the nebula Koboh Abyss in the Outer Rim Territories.

Shiverpedes, commonly known as springers by locals, were a species of winged insectoid residing on the planet Koboh. It had two pairs of wings and two arms tipped with scythe-shaped claws, as well as orange and yellow skin.
Plazir-15 was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. During the New Republic Era, the planet was an independent world under a elective monarchy with direct democracy.

The Republic High Council was an organization that considered changing the punishment of Axel Greylark.

The Gios was a Longbeam cruiser used by the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era under the command of Jedi Master Keeve Trennis. Trennis used the Gios to fight an insurgent on the edge of the Republic.

J4X-7, nicknamed Jax, was a droid that served as a close accomplice to Jarrod Kelvin.
Starweirds were an ancient species of semi-corporeal spirits that resonated with the Force and were considered a great and terrible power.

Mitth welcoming ceremonies were ceremonies held by the Mitth family in the Chiss Ascendancy. It was a common and brief event held to welcome new Mitth adoptees into the family and included a rematching dinner.
The office of the Ohnaka Transport Solutions shipping company was located on the Outer Rim planet Batuu.

The Yiulong Canyons were a series of narrow canyons on the desert planet Jakku. Niima the Hutt controlled all traffic that moved through the canyons and deep Caverns of Bagirlak Garu of Jakku. The Valley of the Eremite was located beyond Niima's canyons and caverns.

The Social Science Department was a department of the Land & Sky Corporation that did research on the behavior of the people living in the Aakaash system.

A type of bird inhabited the volcanic planet Nevarro.

Karlini City was a city on the planet Karlinus that was the site of Governor Kelma's house. In 22 BBY, Representative Saché and her aide Tepoh visited Karlini City.
The Procopian Crisis was an event that occurred by around 482 BBY in the vicinity of the Colonies' Procopia system in which a male individual wielded blasters.

The governor's house in the planet Karlinus' Karlini City was occupied by the world's Governor Kelma by the time of the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Representative Saché and her aide Tepoh visited the governor's house for negotation meetings.
The Hanna City greenhouse was located in Hanna City, the capital of the Core Worlds planet Chandrila. The greenhouse cultivated sun-dew flowers, a type of flower with firm stems and resilient petals.
Saaw Moon was the moon of the planet Pipyyr in the Pipyyr system in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Purrgil's Dream was a starship owned by the San Tekka clan member Precoria San Tekka.

Dalnan sylbeetles were a type of beetle from the planet Dalna. In 382 BBY, during a Jedi attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on Dalna, Jedi Master Char-Ryl-Roy paused and heard Dalnan sylbeetles chirping in the grass and weeds at the end of a field.

While serving as queen of the Mid Rim planet Naboo, Padmé Amidala lived in an apartment within the Theed Royal Palace. Amidala's captain, Quarsh Panaka, installed extensive security measures in the apartment due to the queen's refusal to have guards stationed within.

A langskib was a type of longship operated in 9 ABY by Mandalorian survivors who stayed on Mandalore after the Great Purge of Mandalore. It was led by a Mandalorian captain. They were joined by Mandalorians who retook Mandalore.

A trinitaur was a creature that roamed beneath the surface of Mandalore, following the Great Purge of Mandalore. One trinitaur attacked and destroyed a langskib when a scouting party of Mandalorians traveled to the Great Forge, attempting to retake their homeworld.

A mech droid was a type of droid used by a cyborg that resided on the planet Mandalore. The cyborg was able to get out of the droid, and also had another form of droid, the Spider Tank. Around 9 ABY, the cyborg captured the Mandalorian Din Djarin.
The moon of Paraqaat was a moon in the galaxy. Commissioner Helgait was sent there in exile.
C-04L, or Fourell, was a silver-plated protocol droid that attended to Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark in 382 BBY.

A poma-club was located in Quarrow, the capital city of the Expansion Region planet Nakadia. The club hosted several deprivation chambers, which used bubbling poma liquid and throbbing pulse-music to cause hallucinations and relax an individual's muscles.
A dune scratcher was a type of large rat native to the moon Jedha. They were quadrupedal, with gray, veiny skin, sharp claws, six red eyes, and rows of pointed teeth.

Klako fish were a type of fish that the Starros Clan member Mevera Starros loved. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the fish were on display at Wild Wollina's Animal Adventures zoo on the Outer Rim world Hon-Tallos.
Bubble sharks were a type of shark that was on display at Wild Wollina's Animal Adventures zoo on the Outer Rim world Hon-Tallos between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.

Pontu-siren were a type of creatures with gray skin and a long snout-like appendage. Around 3 ABY, the pontu-siren were shown in an exhibit at Wild Wollina's Animal Adventures on the planet Hon-Tallos.
The Genetian Collective was a criminal syndicate that operated during the Imperial Era. Members of the syndicate included the Pantoran Lanitra, a Nautolan, a Kajain'sa'Nikto, and an Elom.

An icy asteroid was located within an asteroid field. It had a Type I atmosphere breathable to multiple species, although its surface was flat and barren with features of icy rocks.

A Darius G-class freighter was operating off of the supertanker fuel depot Colossus in 34 ABY. The Resistance operatives Poe Dameron and Kazuda Xiono performed a Widowmaker maneuver with the latter's racer, the Fireball, by hiding on the freighter.
The Centennial Chihuahua was a starship owned by the pilot Isabella.
A Viper probe droid served Moff Gideon during the New Republic Era. In 9 ABY, the droid was present on Coruscant to conduct a report between Gideon and Amnesty officer and spy Elia Kane.
Norm-3PO was a 3PO-series protocol droid, programmed to assist the Imperial scientist Heinz Darthenshmirtz.
The Darthenshmirtz Sith Inc was a starship owned by the Imperial scientist Heinz Darthenshmirtz.
A Immobilizer 418 cruiser was used by Moff Wilhuff Tarkin during a incident in the Obroa-skai system.
A squad of stormtroopers were deployed by Cerasus Ehllo, a captain in the Galactic Empire, to attack the Starros family homestead on Hosnian Prime.

A small shuttle was owned by the Platypus Perry.

The Empire Administration Offices was a modified Imperial I-class Star Destroyer active during the Galactic Civil War under the Galactic Empire. The Death Star plans was stored and guarded in the capital ship.

A delegation to the Shadow Council operated under Captain Gilad Pellaeon. In theory, the delegation represented Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo "Thrawn," but he never personally arrived to Shadow Council meetings.
R2-E6 was an R2-series astromech droid that served Gideon's Imperial remnant.

HS-197 was an abandoned ore-rich mining moon in the Horox system of the Outer Rim Territories. The moon was rocky and covered in canyons and hills. By the Imperial Era, the moon became a base for Imperial operations that investigated rebel activity on the moon.

The office of the New Republic Chancellor Mon Mothma was located on the Core Worlds planet Chandrila. In 5 ABY, Mothma hosted several senators in her office and dismissed them upon working up a headache.

Dredger Gorge was a location on the Outer Rim planet Koboh. It was a winding canyon with steep rises and drops. During the busiest era on Koboh, it was a favorite priorite prospecting location for the local mining population.

Fort Kah'Lin was a fortress on the Outer Rim planet Koboh. Originally a bandit camp, it was transformed into a base of operations for the Bedlam Raiders after Rayvis unified them. It was located in the same area of Koboh as Rambler's Reach Valley.

The Basalt Forest was a forest on the planet Koboh. This forest was considered a geographical oddity, and was part of the reason that during the High Republic Era, the Galactic Republic and Jedi Order found the planet so fascinating and chose to construct one of their research…
Basalt Rift was a location on the planet Koboh. It was located in the Basalt Forest.
The Rift Passage was a location on the Outer Rim planet Koboh. It was located in the Basalt Forest. Within the Rift Passage was a turbolift which opened into the Koboh Observatory.
The Bilemaw Den was a location in the Basalt Forest on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
The Nekko Pools was a location in the Basalt Forest on the Outer Rim planet Koboh where, in 9 BBY, Jedi Knight Cal Kestis learned to tame and ride nekko.
The Stone Spires, also known as the devastated settlement, was an area near the Rambler's Reach Valley on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
Klynan was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice, within the Klina sector's Klynan system. It was situated in grid square S-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
K-4O5 was a KX-series Security Droid Enforcer who wielded an electro riot baton. He worked for the Galactic Empire on Coruscant.

The Naboo Reformations affecting the Royal House of Naboo took place around 44 BBY, when Queen Ekay ascended to the throne. Established to address concerns about the negative effects of dynastic rule, it limited monarchs to a maximum of two two-year terms.

M-6NK, nicknamed Monk, was a bartender droid who worked at Pyloon's Saloon on the planet Koboh as the business partner of the Latero Greez Dritus. Monk was known for keeping a close eye on the patrons of the saloon and for his extensive knowledge of beverages.

KLE-0, nicknamed Cleo, was a bounty droid who worked for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. They were the companion droid of the Finau brothers, Masi and Fenn, assisting them in every facet of their bounty hunting profession.
PR-85T, known fully as PR-85T the Other Half, was a bounty droid who worked for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era.

Jo, known as the Cannibal, officially J0-WR1, was a bounty droid who worked for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. She earned her moniker by building herself over the years by taking a part of every droid she found or destroyed.

x: The attack on Tanalorr, also known as the invasion of Tanalorr, was a surprise attack by the Nihil marauders on the planet Tanalorr during the High Republic Era.
Hiorin was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Hiorin system in the Ash Worlds of the Outer Rim Territories that was the site of Mareti Base.

Z-LOQ was a terrestrial asteroid outpost in the Z-LOQ system in the D'Aelgoth sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, the rebel operative Alexsandr Kallus, along with the protocol droid Dee-Four, met Grand-engineer Lony Coleema on Z-LOQ.

The Holowan droid foundry of Holowan Mechanicals was located on a pink terrestrial planet. Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, Grand-engineer Lony Coleema was kidnapped by the IG-88 assassin droid IG-88B and brought onto the world inside the foundry.

The Holowan droid foundry was a foundry of the Holowan Mechanicals division of Holowan, a droid manufacturer. By 4 ABY, the facility had been abandoned, with protocol droid Are Zero Are Zero and several IG-series droids left deactivated in the foundry.

place: In the orbit of a triple-ringed gas giant, Unknown Regions
x: The rescue of a Chiss Ascendancy excursion liner took place in the Unknown Regions. The liner belonged to the Ascendancy's Boadil family, and had been caught in the Gravity well of a triple-ringed gas giant planet.
The Shattered Moon was a moon in orbit around the planet Koboh.
Sakavians were a sentient species from Sakavi Tar. One Sakavian, Skoova Stev, was a master fisherman on the planet Koboh in 9 BBY.

Sakavi Tar was a frozen planet located in the Sakavi Tar system of the Outer Rim Territories that was home to the Sakavian species. The Sakavians survived on fish and other underwater animals they hunted in the vast oceans beneath the planet's frozen wastelands.

Flix's mother's home was located on the celestial body Talivar. In 34 ABY, business partners Flix and Orka intended to have themselves, their pet gorg Bitey, and the pit droid G-LN shipped from their business aboard the refueling station Colossus to Flix's mother's home throug…
The First Order delivery service was a First Order mailing service active on the supertanker fuel depot Colossus by 34 ABY.
Marcus Speedstar's racing team was a racing team formed by the racer Marcus Speedstar that consisted of him, his mechanic Oplock, and the astromech droid R4-D12.
Are Zero Are Zero, nicknamed Roro, was a protocol droid. By 4 ABY, the droid was stationed out of commission inside the Holowan droid foundry on a terrestrial planet.
ZN-A4, nicknamed Zee, was a specialized research droid who served Jedi Master Santari Khri during the High Republic Era.

Shield Troopers, also known as Riot Scout Troopers, were a specialized variant of scout troopers who served in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. They wielded riot shields and electro-riot batons, and were primarily used for riot control.
Mareg IX was a nomadic planet known for its yurts.

Section Four was a corridor aboard the First Order's |refueling station Titan. During a patrol of the station in 34 ABY, a First Order stormtrooper asked their companion if the corridor they just swept was Section Four or Section Five.

Section Five was a corridor aboard the First Order's supertanker fuel depot Titan. While patrolling the station in 34 ABY, a First Order stormtrooper asked their companion if the corridor they just inspected was Section Four or Section Five.
The Divine Oasis was an oasis located on the desert moon Jedha.
Skritons, sometimes referred to as desert crabs, were a species that resided on the moon Jedha. They were very ruthless creatures and unpredictable.
Golden Skritons were a subspecies of Skriton that resided on the moon Jedha.
Relters were a species of winged creature that resided on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
Mogu were a predatory and carnivorous mammalian species that resided on the planet Koboh. Typically highly violent predators, mogu preferred to stalk prey, then aggressively attack them.
A planet was located in a quadruple star system in the Unknown Regions.

Taborr's gang was a pirate gang lead by Taborr Val Dorn during the High Republic Era. Other members included the droid EB-3 and the Gamorrean Pord.
Level 2046 was a level on the metropolitan world of Coruscant and was accessed by the underworld portal. It was controlled by the Pau'an Senator Sejan in 9 BBY.

Eiska was one of the four moons of the planet Rodia, located in the Tyrius system of the Outer Rim Territories' Savareen sector. The moon was situated at grid square R-16 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Hardshells were a type of creature lived in the cold deserts of the moon Jedha. Due to the inhospitable nature of their habitat, they had to find ways of adapting to stay protected. Most of them had hard shells, not to protect them from the weather, but against predators.

Enak was one of the four moons of the planet Rodia, located in the Tyrius system of the Outer Rim Territories' Savareen sector. The moon was situated at grid square R-16 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Yasooska was one of the four moons of the planet Rodia, located in the Tyrius system of the Outer Rim Territories' Savareen sector. The moon was situated at grid square R-16 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Soomana was one of the four moons of the planet Rodia, located in the Tyrius system of the Outer Rim Territories' Savareen sector. The moon was situated at grid square R-16 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Shadow ARF Troopers were a type of clone trooper in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army of the Republic. The ARF Troopers specialized in stealth missions and used a black blaster.

Dubrovia was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Dubrovia system within the Aldino sector of the Mid Rim and Western Reaches that was not far from the Outer Rim's Berenge sector. It was situated in grid square J-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Golak was a desert planet home to rocky mesas and large, expansive deserts. The planet's surface was covered by little vegetation. Many of the rocks and sand on the planet were tinted cream to golden color.
E3-VE3 was a custom-modified Droideka found on the planet of Koboh. The droid was modified to have enhanced offensive capabilities and heightened belligerence algorithms.
D-L1T was a DT-series sentry droid who was destroyed by the Jedi Knight Cal Kestis in 9 BBY. D-L1T was stationed at Hangar 2046-C on the planet Coruscant.
Beetu Deetu was a B2-HA super battle droid who was modified by several Bedlam Raiders. The droid's processes were overclocked which resulted in the droid's attacks being faster and more aggressive.

T-1N8, nicknamed Tina, was a SE-2 worker droid with feminine programming who resided on the planet Koboh. Tina was once the protocol droid to a family who toiled in the caverns beneath Prospector's Folly.
Fobaris, formerly known as Moon B, was a planet discovered by the droid 0G-LC.
Yarrum was an Outer Rim planet located in the Bri'ahl sector. During the High Republic Era, the planet was a base for various pirate gangs.
Andraven was a snowy planet located in the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The native species domesticated wellagrins.
Yamradi was a planet located in the galaxy. During the High Republic Era, SF-R3 from the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts was sent to Yamradi to research the Chylaroo species.
Federian was a planet located in Outer Rim Territories that was home to the Skriffles.
Rex Strata was a planet and the homeworld of the technician Faraz. Jedi Master Zia Zaldor Zanna trained on this planet during her time as a Jedi trainee.
The channelfish was a type of fish on the planet Tenoo. The fish was a huge delicacy and made into many varieties of foodstuff such as the Tenooan channelfish dumpling and the channelfish sandwich.
The kibbin was a type of rodent-like creature native to the planet Tenoo.
The stalaats were creatures living in caves of the rocky planet Rex Strata. Kai Brightstar, Zia Zaldor Zanna, and Ace Kallisto encountered two of them when their shuttle crashed into a cave.
The Kublop Springs marketplace was a marketplace located in the town of Kublop Springs on the planet Tenoo.
During the High Republic Era, a battle broke out between the Trade Federation and an enemy force.

The sinking city of Kuratow was a city in the Kuratow system of the Expansion Region's Brevost sector. The Nightsister Merrin visited the city while traveling the galaxy after separating from the crew of the luxury yacht Stinger Mantis between 12 BBY and 11 BBY.

The Persaya cliffs were a rock formation located in the Inner Rim Persaya system. While traveling the galaxy after separating from the crew of the luxury yacht Stinger Mantis at some point between 12 BBY and 11 BBY, the Nightsister Merrin visited the cliffs.
The Temple Library, also called the Jedi Archives, was a library utilized by the Jedi Order located in the Tenoo Jedi Temple
A giant Tenoo tree was located amongst the forests on the planet Tenoo. The yara plant was found only on the top of this giant Tenoo tree.
The Kublop Geyser was a large geyser in the river near Kublop Springs. The geyser erupted only once every year, making it a spectacle for the residents to enjoy.

Marlaa Jinara's junkyard, also known as Marlaa's junkyard or Kublop Springs junkyard, was a junkyard owned by Marlaa Jinara in the town of Kublop Springs on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era.
Chylaroo was a small rodent-like creature native to the planet Yamradi.
The Star Seeker was a Renning-class shuttle piloted by the droid 0G-LC. With this ship 0G-LC explored the Bri'ahl sectorand discovered the planet Fobaris.

objective: Find Bode Akuna
x: In 9 BBY, Jedi Knight Cal Kestis undertook a mission to the Galactic Empire's II-0810 Satellite Station also known as Nova Garon in search of Bode Akuna.

Skrats were a type of rodent-like creature that it was rumored were used to make Turbo Dogs. In 9 BBY, while a pair of stormtroopers where discussing what to eat at the end of their shift patrolling on the planet Coruscant, one trooper suggested Turbo Dogs.
Salamanders were a type of amphibian that could be found in the galaxy. The frilled newt was a type of salamander that could be found in the planet Koboh.

The Catastrophonator was a custom MSE-6 series repair droid created by members of the Orbak Tribe on Kef Bir. The mouse droid had modifications that allowed it to discharge electricity and fire projectiles.
The Grapnel was a starship captained by Wan'yek Whett and crewed by a fishing crew.

The Gorocco matriarch was the leader of the gorocco pack. As a stronger specimen than the male goroccos, the gorocco matriarch would usually hunt for the pack. When the Bedlam Raiders came to Koboh, the gorocco matriarch got increasingly aggressive.
Dee was a droid who assisted Jedi Master Zia Zaldor Zanna during the High Republic Era. They were often tasked with taking care of the Tenoo Jedi Temple while Master Zanna was away.

Bilemaws were large quadrupedal creatures that lived on the planet of Koboh. They were covered in a hard exterior, which makes them resistant to most conventional attacks. Additionally, bilemaws could regurgitate acidic spit, known as "bile," to any enemies within their way.

The vile bilemaw was a creature found on Koboh. It was similar in most ways to a normal bilemaw, but had bile far more acidic than the average bilemaw and is even said to be able to melt through ferrocrete.

Rawkas, commonly known as rushers by locals, were bipedal avian creatures indigenous to the Outer Rim planet of Koboh. They were commonly known to rush their enemies and butt them with their over-sized head—hence the nickname rushers.
The Spawn of Oggdo was found on the planet of Koboh. It was a variant of the Oggdo Bogdo species found on Bogano.
Bramliks, also known as spikers by the locals, were spherical creatures indigenous to Koboh. If a bramlik was approached, the spines on its back would extend, deterring most threats.
The Korbans were a species of blue-skinned sentients that hailed from the planet Korba. Korbans possessed a head with green hair, two pink cheeks, and two large, pink eyes.

A species of large, non-sentient, purple beast could be found on the planet Korba. The creatures' skin and hair were purple, and their round, large eyes and mouth were black. They possessed two ears and four legs that ended in three orange feet with black claws.
A city was located on the planet Chorin. During the Imperial Era, a parade was held there following the Liberation of Chorin.

Sutabans were a large, bipedal species native to the desert moon of Jedha. Sutabans stalked the ruins of Jedha's ancient temples for prey. They were highly aggressive and single-minded creatures that struck fast with their powerful arms.
The Sutaban Alpha was a far more aggressive creature than even their normal sutaban cousins. Some survivors of the beast claimed that the Sutaban Alpha enjoyed attacking others.

"The Massiff" was a highly-modified MagnaGuard droid which was a personal project of the Gen'Dai Rayvis. The modifications led to a ruthless, hyper-enhanced 'killing machine'. It would not stop fighting until the last of its processes failed.

JG-1, also known as the Junk Giant, was a monster droid created by Taborr Val Dorn and his gang. She was later adopted by the Chadra-Fan junk keeper Marlaa Jinara to work in her junkyard. JG-1 had a special system of rechargeable power cells to energize her massive frame.
The Gedonian ground weevil was a rodent-like creature native to the forest planet Tenoo.
0G-LC, often simply referred to as 0G, was a droid who piloted the Star Seeker during the High Republic Era.

The Jangori settlements were a series of villages inhabited by the Jangori tribe. An Imperial-operated hovertrain route cut through one such settlement, often leading to ambushes by Jangori rebels on Tungar-back.
A light cruiser belonged to the Chiss Ascendancy nation's Coduyo family. In 50 BBY, a breakaway alien sect threatened Coduyo family holdings on the planet Massoss.
The Buktari were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Hoogenz and Anonda were members of this species.
During their existence, the Rakatans invaded the planet Kuat.
Korba was a terrestrial planet whose surface featured mountain spires that featured caverns rich with kyber crystals, which the Jedi Order used to construct its weapons, the lightsabers.

Glottsamcrabs were a type of solitary mollusc that lived in the mired swamps of the planet Koboh, using whatever they could make a makeshift shell from as a home. In 9 BBY, the fisherman Skoova Stev caught a glottsamcrab in Koboh's Viscid Bog for the aquarium at Pyloon's Saloon.
Andravens were a sentient elephantine species who lived on the frigid planet Andraven. They had gray or light blue colored skin. Gumar, Jam, Varna, and Onderrs were members of this species.

Burrowberry birds were a type of birds native to the forest planet Yamradi. Around 233 BBY, the species was discovered by SF-R3, Kai Brightstar, Nubs, and Lys Solay after a burrowberry bird mistakenly took CAM for a berry.
Presta birds were a type of nesting bird that featured in an expression from Kalastar about being defecated upon if you stood underneath a presta bird nest.

x: In 9 BBY, a battle occurred at the Mountain Observatory on the planet Koboh between the forces of the Bedlam Raiders and the Galactic Empire.

A spaceport was located on the Mid Rim planet Aloxor, in the city of Tiquwe. Only a small portion of the spaceport was considered to be "decent," while an even smaller part was controlled by the Galactic Empire—leaving the majority of the port dominated by smugglers and pirates.

Firebugs were a type of nesting insect. In 9 BBY, Jedi-in-hiding Bode Akuna described Jedi Knight Cal Kestis as having "kicked the firebug nest" after Kestis slew Rayvis, leader of the Bedlam Raiders, during a mission to the planet Koboh's Shattered Moon.
E2 was a black spherical looking droid belonging to the former Sith Lola. After Lola left her old Sith master she became a reclusive artist. Some time later Lola's old master tracked her down.
The Iron Talon was a starship used by Taborr Val Dorn during the High Republic Era.

Bogan Collections were hidden vaults of the Jedi Order where dark side artifacts were stored. Bogan Collections in the galaxy included the Archive of Forbidden Artifacts in the Jedi Temple, the Bogan Vault in Starlight Beacon, and a vault on Jedha.
Z-1 was a canine-like droid created by the Twi'lek Kalina Kalfus, who often fixed the droid if it malfunctioned.
A cave on the planet Rex Strata was the home of two stalaats.
The Imperial Credit Union was a bank located on the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station.
Daclavian 3 was a location that, akin to Kalimahr and Jedha, was a site for pilgrims aross the galaxy.

Between 387 BBY and 382 BBY, during the Eiram and E'ronoh War, a battle took place on the planet Eiram. A squad of E'roni soldiers were briefed that their assignment was to take a munitions plant, but in reality, the plant was a refugee shelter filled with refugees.

Argazdans were a green-skinned sentient species. By 382 BBY, an Argazdan spacer claimed that Evereni could talk to the dead and see ghosts, which prompted Evereni Yana Ro to smash his nose into a bar.
Flitterpods were striped, purple fish with fins that could be found in the river of the forest planet Tenoo.
MA-55H, nicknamed Mash, was a bounty droid who worked for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era.
Dedoon was a big moon of the forest planet Tenoo. The moon was red and surrounded by a ring of asteroids.
Manjtoo were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Members included Scrapjaw Motito, a scavenger who worked on the planet Jakku, and Gapgrin Dozito, a prisoner on Selnesh.

x: In 9 BBY, Jedi Knight Cal Kestis and the Nightsister Merrin undertook a mission to Pilgrim's Sanctuary on the moon Jedha in order to rescue Armias, a Narkis Anchorite.
The Jedi storeroom was an old storage room hidden behind a big shelf of holobooks. Around 233 BBY, the room was uncovered by Jedi Initiates Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs
A diminutive species with brown skin and black eyes existed in the galaxy.

place: Grand Temple's throne room, Great Temple, Yavin 4
x: An afterparty was held right after the Royal Award Ceremony concluded.

A yellow haired species with blue eyes existed in the galaxy. One member was Caspus Pillar, who lived during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. Other individuals could be seen on Ferrix in the years of the Galactic Empire.
The River Qwewt was a reptilian found on the forest planets Tenoo and Yamradi. They lived near bodies of water and resembled a gecko.

Norsid was a planet under the control of the Galactic Empire. Sometime prior to 9 BBY, the Jedi survivor Cal Kestis worked with members of the Partisans in an attempt to spark a coup to overthrow the Imperial regime oppressing the planet.
The wide-winged rok was a type of bird with a wide wingspan found on the Inner Rim planet Birren. While living their with her family, the human Kata Akuna watched wide-winged roks and other birds.
Arnine-Ellnine was an R-series astromech droid that accompanied Jedi Grand Master Yoda to the Ring of Kafrene during the Clone Wars.

The three-footed noor was a type of bird with three feet found on Birren, a planet in the Inner Rim Territories. During her time living with her family on Birren, the human Kata Akuna saw three-footed noors and other birds while bird-watching.

Team Crimson Bolt was a team participating in the racing skiff competition Kublop Classic. The team consisted of pilot Nash Durango, droid RJ-83, and Jedi younglings Kai Brightstar, Nubs, and Lys Solay.
Following a failed attack over an Imperial supply moon, Darth Vader led an attack on the Rebel outpost on Jamiri, destroying Rebel Alliance starfighters and pilots.
Invocation Way was a street in the Holy City on the moon Jedha that was the site of an almshouse that was purchased and operated by the Path of the Open Hand during their time on the moon.
The Chiss aristocracy were the ruling class of the Chiss species in the Chiss Ascendancy. The Aristocra were members of the aristocracy.

Ganath was a planet located in Hutt Space and the Slice's Ganath system. It was situated in grid square R-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid. At Ganath, members of the sentient Hutt species engaged in illicit activities. It shared its name with the Ganath Cloud nebula.
Dolgarak was an Outer Rim planet visited by Toul and Ara by 1032 BBY.

Urusai were four-winged reptavians native to the desert planet Tatooine. They ate sarlaccs that were in the spore stage of their life cycle, but shared a symbiotic relationship with adult sarlaccs, picking their teeth and tentacles clean.

Hoth hogs were small, omnivorous relatives of the ice scrabbler that lived on the ice planet Hoth. They used their tongues to locate thermal vents or heated caves when scavenging in family units and then dug down to find their food using powerful clawed feet.
R4-M4 was an R4 astromech droid that lived in the galaxy.
R6-E1 was an R6 astromech droid that lived in the galaxy.
The Statues of prophecy were two large statues hidden by clouds on the planet Dolgarak. One represented the Light Side of the Force, while the other represented the Dark.
M5-NT was an astromech droid that lived in the galaxy.
RC-99 was a droid who worked for the Gozzo Raxlo during the High Republic Era.
Yuhong was a bounty droid who worked for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. The droid was destroyed by Cal Kestis and Merrin on the moon Jedha.
RZ-12, nicknamed Raz, was a bounty droid who worked for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era.

The quartermaster's office was a location on Starlight Beacon situated between the main docking bay and principal cargo bay.
A mountain village was located in the mountain ranges of Mid Rim Territories planet of Naboo. Ruwee of the Naberrie family and his wife Jobal helped to establish the village.
Firaxan sharks were a type of shark. By 22 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Iskat Akaris had a polished firaxan shark tooth attached to the end of her first lightsaber.
The Bimms were a sentient species characterized by their fur, feather-like whiskers and long, floppy ears. They spoke a language called Bimmini.

A core ship located on an asteroid outside the Red Honeycomb Zone was used as a home by the former Acolyte of the Beyond Kiza around 21 ABY. During a duel in the ship, the ship's forge caught fire, which caused much of the ship's interior to burn down.
In 34 ABY, Neimoidian Baron Paw Maccon maintained a collection of starfighters, a T-47 airspeeder, and a X-34 landspeeder, which were located inside his palace on the Colonies planet Cato Neimoidia.
T6-315, referred to Jedi Padawan and future Inquisitor Iskat Akaris as Lyre, was a T-6 shuttle utilized by Akaris and her master Sember Vey by 22 BBY.
Pkorians were a sentient species from Pkori. The species had red skin, long fingers, two hearts, and unusually keen senses. They could also have blue eyes and brown hair.

Yista bugs were a type of insect capable of burrowing under a being's skin and incrementally causing illness. In 22 BBY, Jedi Master Sember Vey likened the effects of the dark side of the Force to a yista bug infection.

A starship served within the navy of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, a member of the Empire who served as a mole for the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn sabotaged the ship's reactor, trapping seventeen engineers aboard.
Pkori was a primitive planet in Wild Space that was the homeworld of the sentient Pkorian species.
Athio III was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Athio system of the Mayagil sector within the Outer Rim Territories. It fell within grid square N-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Alcedians were an avian sentient species of humanoids with light gray skin that originated from the Outer Rim planet Valo.

The Fountains of Plenty were fountains located in the Holy City of the Mid Rim moon Jedha. In 382 BBY, a Sarkan pilgrim intended to visit the Fountains of Plenty during their stay within the Holy City, which they told the Jedi Master Vildar Mac as they sat next to each other o…
Hallyn was a city on the planet of Alderaan. It was the hometown of Duke Kayo Organa, who lived there with his wife, Duchess Celly Organa, and son, Niano Organa.

A tribunal was held against Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo (core name "Thrawn") in the aftermath of his last stand over the planet Sunrise, where Thrawn's fleet of Chiss vessels had destroyed Jixtus's fleet.

The Manarai Heights was a district on the planet Coruscant.
The Alien Protection Zone was a walled neighborhood on the planet Coruscant. It was walled-off from the central regions of Imperial City.

The Southern Underground was a region of the Coruscant Underworld located in the southern pole of Coruscant. A 102-story-high palace owned by Black Sun leader Prince Xizor was located in the region. It was in close proximity to the vast Hasamadhi Warehouse District.
The Coruscant Police Sectors was a district on the planet Coruscant.

The abandoned recycling compartment was a waste-processing facility on the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station utilized by Galactic Empire Scientist Heinz Darthenshmirtz as a lair. In 1 BBY, he built his Sith-inator and was confronted by Rebel Alliance agent Perry there.

The Alliance to Restore the Republic Platypus agent Perry owned a starship that he used to escape the Death Star space station shortly before it was destroyed with Galactic Empire Scientist Heinz Darthenshmirtz onboard.

Uokara was a fertile class IV planet in the Unknown Regions. For millions of years, it was inhabited by the pathogen Ghymnon, who covered it entirely from sea to sea and killed thousands of would-be conquerors and despots.

Helmaxa was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Helmaxa system of the Inner Rim Territories. After the Battle of Crait, Resistance members Poe Dameron and Finn traveled to the planet Corellia on a mission to free high-value prisoners and deliver them to a safe house on He…

The New Republic Diplomatic Corps was a diplomatic body within the New Republic. The protocol droid C-3PO was a member of Senator Leia Organa's staff that served as an envoy to the Corps at some point between 4 ABY and 28 ABY, C-3PO informed the New Republic pilot Jaxxon T.

Quorks were a species of sentient furred bipeds found on the moon Endor. After word spread that the Ewoks of the Bright Tree tribe and a group of Yuzzums had seen off a group of Imperials in 4 ABY, a Quork was among a number of neighbors of the Ewoks who gathered at Bright Tre…

Quadrant D was a quadrant of the supertanker fuel depot Colossus. In 34 ABY, after the submerging of the Colossus by the Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono into the oceans of the planet Castilon, two First Order SCUBA troopers carried out patrols of the station.

Level 12 was a level of the supertanker fuel depot Colossus. In 34 ABY, in an attempt to retake the Colossus from the First Order after they took over the station, the Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono intended to swim through the oceans of the planet Castilon to reach level 12.
Level 2 was a level of the supertanker fuel depot Colossus.

The Melida were a group that inhabited Melida/Daan in the Cadavine sector alongside the Daan. When the Melida took the leader of the Daan captive, a Republic senator and his eighteen year old son, Axel Greylark, embarked on a diplomatic mission with the Jedi Order to negotiate…

The Daan were a group that inhabited the Cadavine sector's Melida/Daan alongside the Melida. After the Melida took the leader of the Daan captive, the Jedi Order and Republic senator Lexxir Greylark and his eighteen year old son, Axel Greylark, embarked on a diplomatic mission…

Zess-flies were a type of fly. When the Death Star superweapon's Docking Bay 327 was locked down in 1 BBY, it caused a swarm of multicolored indicators representing traffic control for hangars 250 to 350 to crawl like zess-flies on a screen that Commander Pamel Poul was watchi…
The Ragoon were a type of creature that preyed upon the malia.

The Ezra's Gate was a Gymsnor-3 light freighter owned by the Spice Runners of Kijimi, though it was later taken by the pilot Shara Bey for the Rebellion.
Petyr was a crusader of the Second Revelation droid freedom group who searched for similarly enlightened sentient droids within the Galactic Empire between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.

Gertee was a droid who was part of the Second Revelation, a group of self-aware droids. Around 3 ABY, Gertee was present in the Colony of the Second Revelation, and after the colony received a message from one of their Crusaders, a droid known as Petyr, about a new threat know…
The Colony of the Second Revelation was a colony on Mechis III where the Second Revelation, a group of sentient droids, resided.
Command Sector South was an area in the second Death Star.
Scourge 01, or Scourge One, formerly designated the Chelator, was a former Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that served in the navy of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.

A KX-series security droid served in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Around 3 ABY, the KX-series security droid was among a number of Imperial personnel who were sent to clear out the Amaxine Station on the request of Emperor Sheev Palpatine.
The umbraspider was a type of spider that produced silk with unusual properties, making the spider's webs virtually invisible due to how it refracted and absorbed light.
The Kilian Rangers were a group from Kilia IV who pledged to defend against the nefearious renegades of their world.

Kilia IV was a world in the Kilia system of Wild Space, in grid square I-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, on which the Kilian Rangers were based, a group active during the Galactic Civil War who pledged to defend against the nefarious renegades of their world.
A gas giant was located in the Ciaox Verith system, within the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim Territories.
Kundu Minor, also known as Kundu, was an arid planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the home of the Besalisks Braygh and Slaygh.
Hazun was a planet located in the Astal sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Hazun was the homeworld of Princess Inaya and her royal family.

During the High Republic Era, a wedding was held on the world Quarzite for the brother of a Kage female and their partner. The sister felt that the event was the biggest wedding that her family had ever thrown.
Langsha-Raang was a green planet within the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Malangsha species. The planet also housed a greenhouse school.
Gargantua were a species of large mammalian ape-like animals. At least one lived at Sil Gohtta's Nature Preserve.
C1-MNST4 was a C1-series astromech droid that was constructed using spare parts of other droids on the planet Coruscant. The droid was colored in green, purple, brown and black.

An ice hauler operated during the High Republic Era.In 382 BBY, members of the Thylefire Squadron were selected for a mission to escort the ice hauler to the planet E'ronoh's capital, The Rook, so it could distribute ice.

Rekardia was an Expansion Region terrestrial astronomical object located in the Vensensor sector's Rekardia system. By 382 BBY, during the High Republic Era, the Path of the Open Hand cult members Yana Ro and Kor Plouth spent time on Rekardia.
The Strukian Ocean was a blue ocean. In 382 BBY, Path of the Open Hand member Marda Ro longed to see her deceased lover Jedi Kevmo Zink, whose blue skin she felt was the color of the Strukian Ocean.

Jallen Outpost was a settlement on the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh. In 382 BBY, the E'roni Princess Xiri A'lbaran and her betrothed, the Eirami Prince Phan-tu Zenn, visited the outpost aboard the sail barge Amaryliss to deliver aid supplies to the residents living there and annou…

A starfighter was used by Xiri A'lbaran, the princess of the planet E'ronoh and captain of the planet's Thylefire Squadron. In 382 BBY, A'lbaran crashed the ship onto the planet Eiram, which her world was in a war with.

The Sabracci collection was held on the moon Jedha that shared its name with the Force-sensitive Sabracci Sages. By 382 BBY, Jedi Padawan Matthea Cathley had visited the collection, and later discussed her findings there with her Jedi Master, Leebon.
The Amaryliss was a sail barge used by the heirs of the planets Eiram and E'ronoh, Xiri A'lbaran and Phan-tu Zenn, to deliver relief supplies to citizens of E'ronoh in 382 BBY.

A devilfighter was used by Bly Tevin, a pilot who served as Thylefire Nine in Thylefire Squadron of the planet E'ronoh. The devilfighter had originally belonged to the planet's princes, Xiri A'lbaran, though she instead gave it to Tevin.
A starfighter was used by the E'roni pilot Lina during the war between her homeworld E'ronoh and the planet Eiram.
In 382 BBY, members of the Jedi Order undertook a mission to Eiram to deliver relief crates of medical supplies to the planet Eiram.

A Galactic Republic Pathfinder team was led by the Jedi Knight Gella Nattai during the High Republic Era. By 382 BBY, the team had undertaken an expedition to Orvax which Nattai came to view as a failure.

Lan Barell was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Hook Nebula's Lan Barell system in the Outer Rim Territories and the Trailing Sectors, situated in grid square O-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid. During the High Republic Era, a hive of Qieg lived on Lan Barell.
A cemetery was located in the Rook, the capital city of the Outer Rim planet. In 382 BBY, the funeral of Jerrod Segaru concluded at the cemetery.

Heliol was a village settled in the underground caverns of a region on the planet E'ronoh. When the Galactic Republic envoy Axel Greylark, Jedi Knight Gella Nattai, E'roni princess Xiri A'lbaran, and Eirami heir Phan-tu Zenn visited the village in 382 BBY to bring rations and …

6-RA-7, also spelled "Six-Aray-Seven," and sometimes referred to as Six-Ar, was an RA-7 protocol droid in service of the Inquisitorius. On Iskat Akaris' trip to Pkori, she brought 6-RA-7 under the assumption that the native people did not speak Basic.
The wellness district was located in Galactic City on the planet Coruscant and contained a number of saunas.

A pier was located in the Rayes Canal in Erasmus Capital City on the Outer Rim planet Eiram. In 382 BBY, the Eirami Prince Phan-tu Zenn dove off the pier into the Erasmus Sea to rescue the E'roni princess Xiri A'lbaran, who had crashed into the sea.
K1-T, also known as Kit, was a droid DJ of the band Ku-Bops.
The sons were a group of male citizens active on the planet Ferrix alongside the Daughters of Ferrix. They were discontented with the occupation of Ferrix by the Galactic Empire, in 5 BBY.

A dry eel was a type of eel edible to Quarren. During the High Republic Era, some of the eels were stored aboard Republic Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo's Alif-class Longbeam—the Paxion—for him to consume.

AR-K4, also known as Arkfour, was a top-of-the-line Galactic Republic protocol droid. In 382 BBY, she was assigned to the Paxion, an Alif-class Longbeam that belonged to Republic Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo.

PD-4 was a droid who accompanied the human princess Inaya.

A tang tang bird was a type of bird. At some point between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, Jedi Master Uumay Hawlatha sang a song about a tang tang bird, referencing it several times by referring to Jedi Knight Iskat Akaris as one.

Jatz was the name of an R3 astromech droid and was a member of Tualon Yaluna's company. He was given the name "Jatz" because he enjoyed music far more than other droids. He would often play music that fit the mood, and would provide background music during times of relaxation.

A'ranni was a small farming village located in the Badlands of the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh. Iazacal trees grew within the village.
A Tikotiko was a small species of creature. A batch of tikotikos hatched and infested Hap's Sap Tap after accidentally being delivered there.
Tharnakans were sentient species from the planet Tharnaka. When Tharnaka was flooded due to storms, the Tharnakans left the planet, leaving behind the Tharnakan Story Stone.

Aklyrr Bend was a town on the forest planet Tenoo. The town was named for the blue aklyrr, a creature that could be found nearby. By around 233 BBY, the town was taken over by the biker gang Ganguls.
The Ganguls, also known as the Gangul gang, were a pirate gang who operated in the Outer Rim within the Bri'ahl sector during the High Republic Era.
The starfish was a species of creature that inhabited Lake Paonga on the planet Naboo. Starfishes had light orange skin and five limbs.
Olgothon 3 was a moon that orbited the gas planet Olgothon.
Olgothon was a gas planet orbited by the moon Olgothon 3.

Tharnaka was a planet that housed the artifact Tharnakan Story Stone. It was the native planet of the Tharnakan species. Long before 233 BBY, the climate on Tharnaka changed, causing a flood to descend on the entire planet.
Nash's speeder was a landspeeder built by the pilot Nash Durango and her mothers.
Havel Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object that was host to a warehouse belonging to the Tagge Corporation that contained a number of prototype battle droids.

Thraxsos were a species of large non-sentient reptilian carnivores native to the moon Olgothon 3. Between 20 BBY and 19 BBY, Jedi Knights Tualon Yaluna and Iskat Akaris were attacked by and slew a pair of thraxsos during a mission to Olgothon 3.
Tiss'ell was a planet that had lava fields.
Lava fields were large fields of lava located on the planet Tiss'ell
The facet spider was a type of spider. It was served in a cantina on the planet Christophsis as a delicacy.
A division within the Tagge Corporation was led by Silas Tagge, who served as the company's Head of Weapons Development.

Mips were minute parasitic creatures found on the arid planet Geonosis in the Outer Rim Territories. They traveled in swarms and formed a symbiotic relationship with the enormous merdeths that dominated Geonosis's barren exterior.

Sand snakes were a type of furry snake found on the arid planet Geonosis in the Outer Rim Territories. Their eyes and mouths were situated at the center of their body, which could grow up to three meters, or ten feet, in length.

Ur-greedles were a type of six-winged creature found on the planet Geonosis in the Outer Rim Territories. Cousins of the sentient insectoid Geonosians who were native to the world, the ur-greedles were shorter and stouter versions of their relatives.
Ace's ship was owned by the human thief Ace Kallisto.

Lump was an IG-series droid owned by the Ortolan shopkeeper Gamodar and used to protect his artifacts. Sometime between 19 BBY and 18 BBY, an acquaintance of Gamodar's, the former Jedi Iskat Akaris, accompanied by the Grand Inquisitor, came to remove Gamodar's collection.
The Veil was the treacherous atmosphere of Sophros. It made landing on the planet remarkably difficult by acting as a sort of defense mechanism and immune system for the world.

Piranha eels were a type of eel that traveled in shoals. In 382 BBY, while traveling through the treacherous atmosphere of Wild Space's Planet X known as the Veil, the Path of the Open Hand Force religion member Marda Ro noticed balls of liquid swarming toward the Scupper, the…

x: During the Galactic Civil War, Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus went on a supply run to obtain supplies for the Phoenix Cell.
Sulon was one of the two moons of the planet Sullust, and was located in the Sullust sector's Sullust system in both the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches regions.

Horn-toed morglesnaps were a type of creature featuring horned toes. While aboard the Jedi cruiser Star Hopper in 231 BBY, the Padawan Lula Talisola asked her friend, the Mikkian Zeen Mrala, how she was as they traveled to the latter's homeworld, Trymant IV.

A bomber was used by the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era. It was part of a class of bomber that ran on the fuel zylium 12. In 231 BBY, the bomber was deployed during the Nihil attack on the Republic Fair on the planet Valo.
A battle took place on the planet Ord Tiddell when Galactic Empire forces attacked the Alliance to Restore the Republic as it evacuated its forces from the world at the start of the Mid Rim Retreat.

In 230 BBY, the Maawat Mountains on the planet Dalna were attacked by the Nihil.

K-2PL, abbreviated K-P or K-2 was a droid who served the Moldwarp thief and collector Draiven Bosh alongside the astromech droid R4-13 during the High Republic Era. The droid had yellow sensors and silver-bronze plating.

R4-13 was an astromech droid who served the Moldwarp thief and collector Draiven Bosh alongside fellow droid K-2PL during the High Republic Era. The droid had an orange-colored sensor and maroon-white plating.
The Teevan were a sentient species that originated from the Teevan system. In 382 BBY, a Force-sensitive Teevan man was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult.

6609 was a prison cell located in the Naraka prison on Naraka. In 2 BBY, Ezra Bridger and other members of the Spectres, including Garazeb Orrelios, Sabine Wren, and Chopper rescued their occasional ally Hondo Ohnaka from the cell.
The lower district of of the Outer Rim planet Actlyon's Actlyon City had a cantina operating in it by 34 ABY.

Piasas were a large type of bird indigenous to the planet Koboh. They could be distinguished by their ax-like beak and large stature. The piasa was considered one of Koboh's apex predators, striking fear into any creature it decided to prey upon.

type: Imperial I-class Star Destroyer hyperspace transport ring
x: The Eye of Sion was a large hyperspace transport ring built by forces under the supervision of the witch Morgan Elsbeth, with the intent of reaching and rescuing Grand Admiral Thrawn from exile in another galaxy.
Peridea was an extragalactic planet located in the far galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Noti and once the center of the Witch Kingdom of the Dathmiri, which eventually collapsed.

Arcana was a planet that held a stronghold constructed by the Nightsister witches of Dathomir thousands of years before the Battle of Endor. In 9 ABY, Ahsoka Tano took a map from Arcana which was believed to lead to the Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Seatos was a planet in the Denab system in the Outer Rim Territories that was inhabited in the past by a species from a different galaxy. They constructed a mechanism on it to locate their galaxy powered by a spherical star map.
The Badlands was a desert region on the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh that was home to the farming village A'ranni. Iazacal trees were cultivated on farms by the E'roni.
The Brushlands was a region on the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh that was home to a mining village that had been abandoned by 382 BBY.
RD-3 was an SK series astromech droid that was with the New Republic Defense Fleet during the New Republic Era on board the Defender-class cruiser Vesper under Captain Hayle.

C1-D1, or See-One for short, was a protocol droid working at the control centre for the Santhe Shipyards in Coronet City, on the planet Corellia during the dismantling of the Imperial fleet for the New Republic. Her function was catalogue inventory on arriving transports.
A New Republic nav droid was a protocol droid who operated on the Vesper and was destroyed by the Force-sensitive mercenary Shin Hati.

The Senate Defense Council was a council within the New Republic. In around 9 ABY, the Council, led by Senator Leia Organa, requested an update from General Hera Syndulla regarding the breakout of prisoner Morgan Elsbeth from New Republic custody.

Kavith III was an icy planet in the Kavith system in the Corva sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was flat, with no mountains to obstruct the sky, and covered with black lakes and rivers. Inhabitants of the planet would shelter underground during blizzards.
Hoth Scout Troopers were scout troopers equipped with heated suits for deployment in cold environments, such as on the ice planet Hoth. They drove speeder bikes like standard scout troopers.

Miekos was a small marshland planet on the edge of Wild Space. Formerly a San Tekka colony, the planet became a farming community. It had a diverse population that included Togruta, Mirialans, Nautolans, humans, and other species.
The Scion shuttle was the custom starship used by witch Morgan Elsbeth as a transport and private shuttle.

The Primacy, also known as the Sunken Lucrehulk, was a crashed Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter that served as the base of operations for the Bedlam Raiders, a group of marauders on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
A freighter was commanded by the safari droid SF-R3 to deliver various creatures to the Sil Gohtta's Nature Preserve during the High Republic Era.
A shuttle was owned and operated by the Moldwarp collector Draiven Bosh during the High Republic Era.

Teriona was a small, forested planet located in the Mid Rim Territories. Despite it being along several major trade routes, long history of war and violence kept it from being considered useful by the Galactic Republic.
A botany classroom was located on the planet Langsha-Raang.

Jalucaz was a small, swamp-filled planetoid in the Outer Rim Territories where the Chuul's tavern was ran. It was located in the Jalucaz system in the Subterrel sector.

Prospector's Folly was a region of the Koboh Mountains on the Outer Rim planet Koboh, located near the Rambler's Reach Valley and Rambler's Reach Outpost. Prospector's Folly was named after the many priorite prospectors that died attempting to climb the peaks of the area.
Hares were a species that roamed around the icy planet Kavith III.

The Baldamiro Family was one of one five crime families—alongside the Rang Clan, the Wandering Star, the Droid Gotra, and envoys of the Hutt Clan—that made up the Crymorah Syndicate during the Imperial Era.

A diplomatic trip to Mon Cala was undertaken by the Galactic Republic senator Ghirra Starros in 238 BBY. For the trip to the planet Mon Cala, Ghirra's six year old daughter Avon accompanied her. During her time on the planet, Avon stole an escape pod and flew it.
Springfield was a small town on the astronomical object Earth.

Earth was a planet in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of Maggie Simpson.

Nazzar were a sentient species that lived in relative harmony with other species on the planet Coruscant. Krrl and Akray were members of the species.

The sanctuary district was the district located on the planet Exegol. At its heart was the Sith Citadel, an ancient fortress.
Bracront was a remote terrestrial moon in the Tarabba sector where the Warlord Tartak Vil operated during the High Republic Era.

The northern territory was located on the planet Ipsidon. It was home to herds of Ipsidon bucks, and was covered in rocky mountains and deserts, that hid caverns and subterranean lakes.

RX-23 was an RX-series pilot droid who operated during the Galactic Civil War. At one point, the droid flew a GX1 short hauler from Iego, but the ship was hijacked by R2-D2 to fly to Gallios to find and recruit 0-0-0 for D-Squad.

The Great Mothers were three Dathomirian Nightsisters who allied themselves with Grand Admiral Thrawn. Their names were Klothow, Aktropaw, and Lakesis, and they were practitioners of dark magick, claiming to be able to read the threads of fate and destiny.

The Bandits of Peridea, were a group of pirates that roamed the desolate alien wasteland of the extragalactic planet of Peridea in the distant barred spiral far galaxy that spoke the same language as the native Noti.

The Silver Arrow was, according to General Leia Organa, one of the Rebel Alliance's most reliable supply-run ships during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, something went wrong with the ship's droids, causing a member of the ship's crew to contact out for immediate aid.

The Hawk's End was a starship used by the Rebel Alliance under the command of Captain Magna Tolvan during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Tolvan used the ship to depart from Mareti Base on the Outer Rim astronimical object Hiorin.
Reena was a planet in the Reena system in the Tapani sector of the Colonies that was home to the eponymous Reena University.

An ancient city was built into a cliff-side on Gloam. It was surrounded by abandoned mining equipment. It had rows of carved archways over 30 meters above ground that led inside. It was laid out like a hive, with a large central chamber that lead down to the mines.

The hydrominae was an aquatic species present in the Sublight Lounge within the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon as a part of the process in making the alcoholic cocktail Silver Sea Martini.

Setarans were a sentient species that had domed, ridged heads, pale skin, and gills running from the bottom of the neck to jutting cheekbones, framing two deep-set eyes. Setarans did not possess a mouth, and instead communicated with other sentients via telepathy.

A shipweaver was a creature that wove webs within ships. By 382 BBY, a large amount of webs had been made by a shipweaver in a locker within the Scupper, a yacht owned by the prospector Sunshine Dobbs.
Scuttlers, or scuttling lizards, were creatures that inhabited Okut Dand's ship. The colony nestled in the nooks and crannies of the ship, including the crew's mattresses.

The Casus Belli was a battleship in the fleet of the Tagge Corporation. It served as a research facility for the company, and Lady Domina Tagge—the company's leader—oversaw experimental weapon development for the company aboard the ship.
A crew was led by the rebel Captain Magna Tolvan during the Imperial Era. It consisted of Tolvan, the navigator Kelb, a Caamasi named Pilok, a Devaronian named Sheyo, and an Ikkrukkian named Brissa.

Glabos were a type of eel that lived in caves on the planet Ryloth. During the first two years of the Clone Wars, which began in 22 BBY, the Twi'lek Jedi Knight Tualon Yaluna went on a mission to Ryloth, during which he learned how to fish for glabos as he waited for an opport…
Abridon was a planet in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of Amnen Jhoff, her son Harclew, and her grandson Kasva.

The Destruction of Dalna was a volcanic cataclysmic event on the planet Dalna in 230 BBY. It was triggered by the Nihil pirate organization and their scientist Zadina Mkampa using a crystal matrix built into the planet's crust that created groundquakes.

The Viscid Bog was a swamp located near the Rambler's Reach Valley on the Outer Rim planet Koboh. During the High Republic Era, the area served as a fresh water source for Jedi and Republic scientists stationed on Koboh to research the Koboh Abyss and the anomalous Koboh matter.
Bramalish were a species that resided on the planet Karaxis.

Bavana was a planet located in the Sertar sector within the Outer Rim Territories. The traitor Graygon Eckt hid on the planet from Count Dooku.

The viscid lurker, sometimes referred to as simply lurker, was a species of jellyfish-like aquatic invertebrates endemic to the Outer Rim planet Koboh. The species dwelled in dark, underground waters of the planet, intentionally avoiding natural light.
The barbed hookfish was a species of fish endemic to the Outer Rim planet Koboh. The species evolved out of necessity into a brutal predator.

The blue-finned crayfish was a species of crustacean endemic to the Outer Rim planet Koboh. The species was particularly elusive. At one point, priorite prospectors thought to capture the rare creature to sell at a high price. Their failures made many declare the species a myth.
The Ugyir River was a river on Corellia. The bay squid that lived in the river became extinct due to pollution caused by the Galactic Empire's construction of Star Destroyers.

Nena's ship was a ship owned by the Nikto engineer Nenavakasa Nalor. In 34 ABY, Nalor feigned damage to her ship in order to board the supertanker fuel depot Colossus in order to sabotage it for the First Order.

The Reekrider Cartel, or the Reekriders, was a criminal cartel. Following the Battle of Kur in 232 BBY, a Nihil Strike in Tempest Runner Pan Eyta's Tempest group seized a reedug drug shipment from the cartel, which had been destined for the celestial body Athiss.

Praadost II was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Nembus sector's Praadost system. Once hosting an environment friendly to its inhabitants, Praadost II was strip-mined by the Separatists shortly after the Clone Wars began in 22 BBY, leaving its air unbreathable,…

The snakefish was a species of fish endemic to the holy moon Jedha, orbiting the Mid Rim planet NaJedha. The snakefish thrived in the scattered oases of the moon, including in the Narkis Highlands. The frigid waters of the oases provided a natural coolant for the snakefish.

The Narkis Highlands were an area of the Narkis Desert on the Pilgrim Moon Jedha, orbiting the Mid Rim planet NaJedha. The highlands were the namesake of the Narkis Anchorite group, since members of the monastic cult frequently visited the area.
The Phlac-Arphocc Prototype was a sample model of the droid tri-fighter, manufactured by Phlac-Arphocc Automata Industries.
Inleshat were a sentient species. Anst Wozo was an Inleshat who operated during the High Republic Era.
The Jedha Markets, also known as Jedha's primary marketplace, was a location in the Holy City of Jedha. The market covered a large area of the Holy City, hosting many market stalls and vendors.

Hangar D-13 was a hangar aboard the First Order Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Thunderer. In 34 ABY, as the TIE pilot Tamara Ryvora was preparing her TIE fighter for departure from the Star Destroyer in order to desert from the First Order, she was questioned by Agent Tierny a…
The Castilon gorgs were a non-sentient subspecies of the amphibious gorg. Bitey was a member of the species.

A type of arthropod was native to the Wild Space world Mulita. In 231 BBY, the sentient carnivorous plants known as the Drengir weaponized the arthropods to act as guards for them during the joint Jedi Order and Hutt Clan assault on Mulita.

The Moon of Sarkhai was a boxy cruiser used by the Path of the Open Hand. In 382 BBY, it was part of a mission to retrieve Nameless eggs from Planet X, captained by an individual named Hal and carrying Path members Nanda and Tragor.
In 230 BBY, a groundquake occurred in the mining village of Charbana on the planet Mikkia. Jedi Mirro Lox and Amadeo Azzazzo were dispatched to help.

The Island was an unidentified island located on an unidentified planet. Many castaways called the island home after they had crashed on the planet.

A clan which included members of the Hutt species was active at Kintan, a Hutt Space planet that was the homeworld of the Nikto Nenavakasa Nalor. Years before 34 ABY, when she was a little girl, Nalor was enslaved by pirates, who later sold her to the clan.

A shipyard on Corellia produced control boards during the Imperial Era. Around 13 BBY, the White Worms criminal organization attempted to stage a raid at the shipyard and steal its products.

Doc Nindle's place was a building in Ferdan, on Dalna, that served as Doc Nindle's clinic and surgery center. It featured windows, an examination table, a cupboard with shelves, and storage drawers.
