The Mother's cottage was the residence of the leader known as The Mother within the Path of the Open Hand compound on the planet Dalna. It had been built by a Weequay who had died of a wasting illness.
A battle took place during the Galactic Civil War over an astronomical body in the Corellian sector.

By the year 5 BBY, the human Cassian Jeron Andor had embarked on a search for his long lost sister Kerri, whom he had not seen since she was six years old on their homeworld Kenari.

Marda Ro's cell was the personal residence of Marda Ro within the Path of the Open Hand compound on the planet Dalna. It was clustered with other cells near the southern edge of the Path commune.
The honeycomb cells were a tightly grouped cluster of living cells located within the Path of the Open Hand compound on the planet Dalna. One of the cells was occupied by Marda Ro.

Cincey's work hut was a small outbuilding located within the Path of the Open Hand compound on the planet Dalna.
Yana Ro's cell was the personal residence of Yana Ro within the Path of the Open Hand compound on the planet Dalna.
Forrians were small, furry mammals that lived on the world Batuu. They harvested dried berries from the forest floor and had claws that they used to grip tree bark.

Skylar-birds were a type of bird that lived on the world Batuu. While meditating in the Batuu Jedi temple around 379 BBY, Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani reached out with the Force, perceiving the life around her as glowing colors and sensing both a flock of skylar-birds and a herd…

Hosnian termite were a type of small termite that shared its name with the Core Worlds' Hosnian system. Around 12 BBY, a team of Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate operatives—led by the woman Qi'ra—visited a Jedi temple on a planet to seek a Force artifact.
Coronet salamanders were fly-eating salamanders that partially shared their name with Coronet City, a city on the Core Worlds planet Corellia.
Vader's throne room was the personal throne room of the Sith Lord Darth Vader within his personal residence, Fortress Vader, on the planet Mustafar.

According to rumors, kill zones, also known as killzones, were locations established inside the Occlusion Zone by the Nihil. It was assumed that Nihil patrols used those kill zones to get rid of starships that managed to break through the Stormwall without beeing destroyed.
The Observatory was an ancient building on The Island.

Marrok's Fiend fighter was a modified RP82 Fiend fighter used by Marrok, a former Jedi hunter of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius, while serving the witch Morgan Elsbeth as a mercenary during the post-Imperial era.
An asteroid field was located in the Outer Rim Territories. Kori Zaran was stranded in the field, and undertook the galaxy mission to return to Hoth.

Sarjenn 3 was a moon in the Sarjenn system, orbiting an astronomical object. Between 0 ABY and 4 ABY, Darth Vader embarked on a mission with Sulaco in order to convert her from a rebel spy to a double agent for the Galactic Empire.
The Sarjenn 3 port was the sole port of the moon Sarjenn 3. At some point, the port was converted into a rebel stronghold.
In 5 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic, the New Republic declared victory over the Empire at Andara.

The Enami were a species of furry humanoids native to the planet Ena. Their fur could range in shades of brown with speckles of color which could lose its hue or turn white with old age.

The brikal was a blue-shelled arthropod found on the planet Dalna, which was used by the Path of the Open Hand to make the blue paint that members wore on their faces. The paint was created by crushing the shells and mixing them with chalk and a sweet-smelling binding agent.
An spontaneous resistance movement erupted into being on the planet Ferrix during the Galactic Empire's occupation, which had been upsetting the sons and Daughters of Ferrix, in 5 BBY.
The honey glider was a small non-sentient species found on the planet Dalna. They could jump and glide in the air using wing membranes. A diet of blue brikal larvae tinted the animals bright blue.
Asheris was a terrestrial moon located in Tagge Space. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the droids of the Tagge Corporation ship, the Casus Belli, were infected by the Scourge.

Sarkhai was a world located in the Sarkhai system within the M'shinni sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was situated in grid square M-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Sarkhai were a people native to the Mid Rim world of Sarkhai. The Sarkhai people painted their faces to protect themselves from predators that lurked in the forests.

Between 21 BBY and 19 BBY, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi of the Jedi Order participated in a skirmish against Tofen's Raiders. While fighting the Confederacy of Independent Systems–aligned Tofen's Raiders pilot unit, Kenobi's starfighters experienced technical issues.
8422 was a B1-series battle droid that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Battle of Murkhana, the droid approached Captain Wilhuff Tarkin with a E-5 blaster rifle in hand.
A group of pirates operated during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the group broke into a Tagge Corporation warehouse on the planet Milvayne and stole a Tagge prototype battle droid.

Sector two was a part of the Rebel Alliance Lucrehulk-class battleship Lucrehulk Prime that contained the brig.

The kite was a species of flying creature native to the Core Worlds planet Alderaan. For generations, the Alderaanian inhabitants of the world tamed two species, kites and thrantas, to act as airbourne steeds and convey individuals from one city to another.
Isatabith falls was a point of interest on the planet Alderaan that shared its name with the Isatabith forest. Alderaan was destroyed by the Galactic Empire in 1 BBY.

The Squall was a location where those aspiring to be members of the Emperor's Royal Guard sparred against each other. During their final test, trainees fought each other to the death before Emperor Palpatine.

Soola was an astronomical object located in the Soola system of the Outer Rim's Khuiumin sector. In 231 BBY, the Jedi Order staged a skirmish near Soola so it could infiltrate the Nihil pirates and discover its leader's identity.

R0-1N6 was an R0-series astromech droid that played the drums as part of a performance by Maximilian Rebo alongside a Bith musician at Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary on the planet Tatooine. R0-1N6 was destroyed when the Pyke Syndicate bombed Fwip's sanctuary in 9 ABY.

Epikonia was a terrestrial tech-focused planet located in the Ojoster sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a communications hub that relayed and boosted signals from its sector to other parts of the galaxy.

The Nihil established their main base on the planet Hetzal Prime after they destroyed Starlight Beacon and established the Occlusion Zone. They established it to control food shipments.
A protocol droid served as a translator for Jabba the Hutt at Jabba's Palace.

Thorum was a minor jungle planet located in the Thorum system of the Vendusii sector in the Mid Rim Territories of the galaxy. It had a substantial Crimson Dawn presence. Calda was the planet's largest city and a business hub. The Hammers syndicate were also located on the world.

The Gray Cap was a cantina located on the planet Corellia. The cantina was a popular hangout for off-duty Imperial officers. At some point, a group of rebels raided the cantina to gather intel from the off-duty officers.
Hylanth was a moon located in the Hylanth system in the Meram sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Two astronomical objects were able to be seen from the surface of the moon.
R4-6D0 was the personal R4 astromech droid of High Magistrate Greef Karga on Nevarro. When the Pirate Nation attacked Nevarro, the droid sent a message to the New Republic asking for aid.

Between 21 BBY and 19 BBY during the Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic, a Confederate naval force launched an attack against a Republic fleet. The battle saw Republic and Separatist ships clash.
R2-D3 was one of the astromech droids on D'Qar. When R6-D8 malfunctioned right before the Battle of Starkiller Base, R2-D3 took his place as Temmin Wexley's astromech for the battle.
Anto Kreegyr's group was a rebel cell led by Anto Kreegyr, a former militant of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, as part of the neo-Separatist Coalition.
The Lothal County Fair was a county fair hosted on Lothal.

Miv'rah was a world located in the Miv'rah system within the Gaulus sector of the Outer Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square R-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid, and was linked to the Ab Dalis and Wrea systems by the Corellian Run super-hyperroute.

The Ministry of Protection, also known as the Protection Ministry, or as the Nihil military, was an organization established by the Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro.

A village was located in the trees of Kashyyyk during the High Republic Era. The Wookiees Johgeshakka and Whitaggikk lived there.

Mardorsh were creatures that were encountered by Lys Solay and SF-R3 on the planet Aludia. At that time, they were considered to be a newly discovered species by the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts.
Ayrou were a sentient species. Kilan T'Dara—who served as chair of the advisory council for Force-related groups known as the Convocation of the Force—was an Ayrou.
Ootoos were a sentient species from Ootoo Prime. Ayva Ackler was an Ootoo miner who lived during the High Republic Era.

Ballum was a planet located within the Mid Rim near the Nihil Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era. A year after the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Ballum was the base of operations for Skarabda the Wise.
PT-3 was a droid who lived with the Chadra-Fan Marlaa Jinara after being abandoned by his previous owner.
AG-1 was a droid built by the farmer Roog on the planet Omaka.

The Chiffons were avian creatures found on the planet Kondoraan. They used their wings to glide along the wind current of the planet.

Haven was a mountain village on the planet Ison. Haven was led by Lesa Benex, the woman who started Haven to be a place where people could live in peace, away from all the violence brought by the Galactic Empire.

Cols was an astronomical object located in the Cols system within the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square Q-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. At one point, Cols was under the control of the Galactic Republic.

Ookbat was an astronomical object located in the Ookbat system within the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square Q-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The Ootmian Pabol hyperspace route linked Ookbat to the Randon and Ubrikkia systems.

Rorak 5 was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Rorak system in Hutt Space and the Slice. It was situated in grid square S-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Rorak 5 was located at the junction of the Gamor Run and the Shag Pabol hyperspace routes.

During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, there was heavy fighting in the Humbarine sector including the bombardment of the sector's capital, Humbarine, by Separatist forces.

Recon troopers where a type of clone trooper that specialized in reconnaissance missions. A part of the Galactic Republic's Grand Army of the Republic, Recon troopers wore white Phase II clone trooper armor and used a black blaster.
Gonkstar was a Power droid who resided on Kef Bir after the Battle of Endor.

Kondoraan was a planet within the galaxy. The inhabitants used sky skimming boards as their main method of transportation. In 232 BBY, Zia Zaldor Zanna took a group of Jedi younglings to Kondoraan, where they learned how to surf.

Albrae-Don was a world in the Albrae-Don system in the Sern sector of the Colonies, in grid square L-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid. During the Imperial Era, Albrae-Don was a rebellious world along with other worlds in the Sern sector such as Ghorman.

Luzalite was a planet located in the Luzalite system of the Core Worlds and the Interior, situated in grid square L-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A hyperspace route connected it to the Pantolomin and Coruscant systems.

Sulorine was an astronomical object in the Sulorine system in the Suolriep sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the human Vanden Huyck Willard, who was serving with the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the moon Yavin 4 by 1 BBY.
Gorag Tower was a tower in a city on the planet Reena containing a penthouse owned by House Reena. Around 396 BBY, it was the site of a party celebrating the Queen's Bloom Festival.
A city on the planet Reena was home to Reena University.
Aaricetri was a planet located on the very edge of the Imperial Outer Rim. The starport city of Penshakka was located on Aaricetri.
Ifron was a planet located in the Thuris sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the Bovris Tapcafe, which notably served Thuris Caf.
Aludia was a forest planet located in the galaxy. During 232 BBY, a starship thief named Sty Trune crash-landed a starship on Aludia's surface after getting into a fight with bounty hunter Rhugo Tar.

Barlok was a terrestrial planet in the Barlok system of the Marcol sector in the Inner Rim Territories and the Interior. It fell within grid square L-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The world was known for its advanced horticultural techniques.
Torren was a planet within the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, Grand Master Yoda went to Torren, uncovering mysteries that surrounded the red planet and visiting its Temple Ruins.

Q-4, or Kew-For was a QR-unit droid who piloted the Starcruiser Lourna Dee for the Twi'lek Hutt Clan enforcer Lourna Dee. During a battle at the planet Ballum, Dee ordered Kew-For to bring the Lourna Dee around.
Gel was an android and a partner to the human Kako.
The medical and science research tower, or simply the medical tower, was a section of the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon that housed the station's medcenter.
The Schism Imperial, or simply the Schism, was a secretive breakaway faction that was opposed the reign of Emperor Sheev Palpatine while remaining loyal to the Galactic Empire.
MHD-19 was a medical droid doctor and member of the Rebel Alliance. The sick patient Palia was under his care.

While he posed as a dissentive member of the Imperial Senate, Senator Gall Trayvis owned a pair of RQ protocol droids that accompanied him to the Lothal City Capitol Building, yet remained unaware of his true loyalties as an agent of the Galactic Empire.
The Torment was the name the Ikkrukkian Jedi Master Porter Engle gave to a shuttle he used during his time in the Nihil pirates Occlusion Zone.
The Nooroyo primary landing control operated on the spice-producing Outer Rim planet Nooroyo as its traffic control organization during the Republic Era.

The Temple baths were baths inside the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant where Jedi could wash themselves after a mission. After helping with an evacuation in 232 BBY, Padawan Reath Silas was looking forward to visiting the Temple baths.
4VO-TG, or Teegee, was a non-binary astromech droid. He was repaired by Jedi Padawan Enya Keen in 382 BBY.

The Dawnbringer was a Defender-class cruiser that was the sister starship of the Vesper, both serving in the New Republic Defense Fleet. The Dawnbringer was built at the start of the New Republic in 5 ABY.
A region of the Deep Core planet Tython contained an ancient Force-henge temple. The region was more temperate than a cold region known as the Meridional Ice Cap.
A2 was a location within the Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory on Eadu. During the mission to Eadu, a public address announcer said that only authorized personnel could access A2.

Coruscant's Training Room was a training room in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. It was used by Jedi to train their lightsaber skills. At some point around 233 BBY, Jedi youngling Kai Brightstar used the room for lightsaber training.

A protocol droid was an envoy who served Orlen Mollo and the Galactic Republic. In 382 BBY, the droid was sent to the planet E'ronoh but he was destroyed when the Eroni fleet explosed the droid's ship.

GT-3 was a scout droid and a member of Gella Nattai's Pathfinder team which took rest of the expedition of Orvax by 382 BBY. After three days into the expedition, the equipment of the team disappeared.
KE4-N4 was an Astromech droid that flew alongside Lieutenant Callahan in her E-wing starfighter on the planet Lothal.

A remnant of the Galactic Empire was led by General Maximilian Veers. The remnant sought to use the parts of various droids to create an army of battle droids to attack the Alliance to Restore the Republic and restore the Galactic Empire.

The Guardian was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that was active during the pan-galactic Clone Wars. The human Jan Dodonna, who went onto serve Rebel Alliance as a general in Sector Command, served as a bridge officer aboard the Guardian during the Clone Wars.

The assassin droids 0-0-0 and BT-1 were active on the planet Gallios with the intention of carrying out a massacre. While 0-0-0 was not concerned by it, BT-1 was under the control of the Scourge, which used him to carry out the slaughter.

88-Z was a remotely activated droid used in combat missions and for surveillance by the Galactic Empire. It was equipped with infrared scanners and targeting sensors. The droid was armed with blaster emplacements and electromagnetic disruptors.

Fuel Purity was a sector within the Galactic Empire's Imperial Bureau of Standards. The disgraced corpo Syril Karn was hired to fill an immediate vacancy in Fuel Purity in 5 BBY after his influential uncle Harlo arranged for him to attend an interview with the functionary Flob…
A crew was led by the Byne Guild member Vishla during the High Republic Era. They operated the starship Rushlight Equinox and were known to the Byne Guild pilot Leox Gyasi.

Bursant was a planet in the galaxy which was the homeworld of the Bursantian species. During the Clone Wars, a group of Jedi and senators, including Jedi Masters Yoda and Mace Windu, and Senator Yarua, visited an archaeological dig site on the planet.

Bursantians were a bipedal species native to the planet Bursant. Bursantians were covered in short black and purple fur, had two large red eyes, two arms that ended in three clawed fingers, and two legs with four clawed toes.
Burowgas were farm animals that loved to dig and burrow. They were playful and curious creatures by nature. Farmers utilized the animal's love for digging to help get soil ready for planting seeds.
Docking bay 93 was one of the numerous docking bays located in the spaceport town Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. It was situated adjacent to Docking Bay 94.

The Strider was a CR90 corvette in the service of the Rebel Alliance. During a naval battle, the ship's engines were destroyed, leaving the ship to float dead in space. A group of rebels were sent aboard the ship to evacuate the Rebel personnel still aboard the burning ship.
The Tarnack was a famed galactic cruiser. Han Dardell Thorpe served as its head pilot.
Ootoo Prime was a planet within the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Ootoo species.
Omaka was a planet within the galaxy. During 233 BBY, a farm owned by the human farmer Roog was located on the planet.

A group of pirates once attempted to steal weaponry from the supertanker fuel depot Colossus on the planet Castilon.

Hintis IV, also known simply as Hintis, was the fourth planet from the Hintis star, situated somewhat near the Nihil Occlusion Zone. For thousands of years, it was home to a vast and thriving civilization, but the people began to flee as Hintis started dying circa 430 BBY.

A marsh-lord and their son were part of a clan on the swamp planet Safrifa during the High Republic Era. In 231 BBY, a rival clan kidnapped the son, prompting the marsh-lord to ask the mercenary Ty Yorrick to rescue them in exchange for novian ore.

Sea slugs or sea-slugs were creatures that lived in seas. Decades after 382 BBY, the Scalvi Carli and Tren were playing amongst themselves re-enacting their uncle Bree Menaren's famed encounter with members of the Crulkon species.

The Northern tundra was a location on the northern pole of the planet Lothal, where the Lothal Jedi Temple was located.

Samaria was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Samaria system in the Core Worlds. Between 3 and 4 ABY, the bounty hunter Dengar was on trial in the Imperial Court of Criminal Justice, which was located on Samaria.

The Enthian mob was a criminal organization from the Enthi system that was led by Boss Voss. By 4 ABY, Voss was assassinated by the human Rik Duel under the orders of Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

Devshi was an ocean moon in the Devshi system in the Inner Rim Territories. The Devshi prison complex, run by Warden Mattis Coto, was situated on the ocean floor of Devshi.

C4-R4C was an astromech droid that worked on the planet Corellia for the Santhe Corporation and operated a REV-2K personnel carrier during the New Republic Era.
Snap-crows were a type of crow that lived on the Outer Rim planet Valo. The crows could squawk to make high-pitched noises when disturbed.

Spotted spiders were a type of giant spider. During the High Republic Era, the Jedi youngling Kildo put a jar of the spiders inside the Jedi Master Eicho's bag when he returned to the Outer Rim planet Valo's Jedi temple.
Rikahawks were a type of hawk that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Valo. Their diet consisted of the world's ground-dwelling creatures.

Fleshflies were a type of fly that fed on animal carcasses. In 229 BBY, the Nihil recruit Driggit Parse reflected on the way the Nihil marauders had ravaged her homeworld—the Outer Rim planet Valo—thinking that the occupiers had swarmed over the locals like fleshflies to a car…

Ekkhounds were a type of hound. At some point during his time with the pirate Tanana Keem's crew, the pirate Coromont Vizzle was bitten by one of the hounds and the feral creature's bite injured his backside.
The Haplak district was a residential district on the Outer Rim planet Valo, located in Lonisa City. During the High Republic Era, the home of the Parse family was located in the district.

The Felicitations was a Galactic Republic starship that was small and lightly armed. It came across the Way of Clarity while Fel Ix and his crew were inserting Graffian slicer codes into a communications buoy.
A series of dry lands existed on an unnamed moon. Terrain on the rocky, barren moon, the dry lands sat beside a labyrinth of rock pinnacles.

Accounting was a department within the Galactic Empire. The individual Gladys worked for the department before getting herself a promotion to commander.

In 229 BBY, during the High Republic Era, a hostage situation in Coronet City occurred. Jedi Master Kantam Sy of the Jedi Order was caught up in the situation, which lasted for weeks and took place in Coronet City on the Core Worlds planet Corellia.
Firehawks were rare birds native to the planet Tenoo. Nash Durango named her starship, the Crimson Firehawk, after them. They are known for their stubbornness and their beautiful feathers.
The Comet Runners were a pirate group led by the Palliduvan Corr Taldaan during the High Republic Era.
B-333, also known as Bee-Triple-Three or Big Bee, was a droid who worked alongside the black market smuggler Argomon.
Pikpik were a diminutive, sentient rodent species. Some Pikpiks worked as scrappers on the planet Bracca during the High Republic Era.
M1-M1, commonly referred to as "Mimi," was a small droid who assisted the scrapper Eren Kitt on the planet Bracca.

The Unbreakable was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served as the flagship of Admiral Corleque of the Galactic Empire.

Eye-Oh-Ninety-Eight-Dee was the designation of a droid processor of the Galactic Empire. The Sith Lord Darth Vader utilized the droid brain and several others to take control of the M.A.R. Corps, a team of cyborg rebels, with Eye-Oh-Ninety-Eight-Dee being implanted into Masakint.
The Jedha Campus was a Jedi academy on the planet Jedha. The campus had a policy restricting the keeping of wild animals as pets, including those deemed "cute."
Nanta's tree was a tree in Bright Tree Village on the forest moon Endor where Nanta—an Ewok who aspired to become a Storykeeper—recorded his stories by carving them into the tree's bark.

A Jedi Initiate clan included the Jedi younglings Reva Sevander and Faris. In 19 BBY, the clan were present in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant when they were attacked by clone troopers as part of Order 66.

A secondary facility served as a backup for Darth Sidious's secret facility on Mustafar, where the Sith Lord attempted to perform a conditioning procedure to turn Force-sensitive children into his personal army of dark side spies.
The Ikoru was a Nihil cloudship used by Marchion Ro and the She'ar to travel to Planet X to retreive members of the Nameless species.

Lurca hounds were a species of dog on the planet Wayland. They had gray skin, and the sclera of their eyes was red while their pupils were blue. Lurcas had bony frills protruding from their noses—which were snubbed—and were muscular.
K-9X1, or K-9, was a droid in service to the Galactic Empire in the Mount Tantiss facility on the planet Wayland. They had a yellow sensor, and were equipped with a stun baton.

Dryaxes were a type of huge, humanoid-shaped predator found in the jungles of the planet Wayland. They had glowing red eyes and lupine features. During or after 18 BBY, the clones Omega and Crosshair encountered a dryax on Wayland while fleeing from Tantiss Base.

The assault on Exegol, otherwise known as the razing of Exegol, was carried out in 3 ABY, by the Schism Imperial when they attempted to challenge Emperor Palpatine's power by attacking the Sith Citadel on Exegol where he kept his greatest treasures and secrets.

The Tantiss Base communication center was a communication center within Tantiss Base of Mount Tantiss, which provided incoming transports with clearance and instructions on how to approach and land on the facility.

The Tantiss Base command center was a location within the Galactic Empire's Tantiss Base on Mount Tantiss.
Shuttle 135 was a Nu-class attack/transport shuttle that operated as part the Galactic Empire's Advanced Science Division.
The central lab was a highly secure laboratory in the Tantiss Base utilized by Kaminoan cloning expert Nala Se to research the integration of m-count into clone trooper blood.

A medical bay was located in the Tantiss Base on Mount Tantiss, where Emerie Karr, assistant to Imperial cloning program chief Royce Hemlock, collected the blood of clone troopers imprisoned in the facility to test for successful m-count integration.
Setron was a jungle planet in the Expansion Region. Doctor Royce Hemlock of the Galactic Empire once had a laboratory stationed on the planet.
Imena was the only inhabited planet in the Tybal system. It had large blue oceans and five moons, one of which had a spaceport.

Conscription trooper pilots were conscripted soldiers that served as Imperial Starfighter Pilots for the Galactic Empire during the early Imperial Era. They acted as a precursor to the TIE fighter pilots that were later used by the Empire.

The Battle of Seswenna was fought between the Nihil pirates against the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. After the battle, the Nihil celebrated their triumph over the Republic and Jedi during a celebration at their compound on Hetzal Prime.

Aricho was a planet located in the Outer Rim behind the Nihil pirates Stormwall in the Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon in 230 BBY, Jedi Padawan Imri Cantaros hid on the planet.

Flower serpents were a type of serpent found on the Outer Rim planet Haileap. The scientist Avon Starros—who lived for a time on Haileap—considered them to be pretty but deadly, and that they had no care for anything beyond themselves.
Omega's room was a room located in the Galactic Empire's Tantiss Base on the planet Wayland where the young clone Omega lived during her Imperial captivity during or after 18 BBY.

Sarumo was a planet of the Galactic Republic situated within the Galactic Frontier in the Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, General Abediah Viess chose to live in retirement on Sarumo.
The human Elecia Zeveron led a crew of thieves around 396 BBY. One member of the crew, the Kilotowan Leyli Romero, was attending Reena University as a student to spy for them.
A B1 battle droid was stationed on the Separatist Subjugator-class heavy cruiser Malevolence in 22 BBY.

Janaus was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Janaus system in the Thrasybule sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square P-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid, that was the site of a Jedi outpost established by the Jedi Order during the Republic Era.

Lesser Tontakoh was an astronomical object in the Lesser Tontakoh system in the Klina sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the site of a Jedi outpost of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era.
Barayfe was an astronomical object in the Barayfe system in the Alchenaut sector of the Expansion Region where the Jedi Order maintained a Jedi outpost during the Republic Era.

Tharben was a terrestrial planet in the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice, near the edge of Hutt Space along the Ootmian Pabol. The planet was home to a Jedi outpost of the Jedi Order and had a security patrol subsidized by the Galactic Republic.
Ord Jannak was a terrestrial planet situated along the Ootmian Pabol in the Slice. The Jedi Order had a Jedi outpost on Ord Jannak during the Republic Era.

Yitabo was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Yitabo system in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Situated near the planet Kwenn, Yitabo exported foodstuff to many of the worlds around it.

The Gem Cities of Kwenn were a series of thirteen island archipelagoes situated on the planet Kwenn. The islands were transformed as part of the Grand Renewal, one of the Great Works of the High Republic Era, when Kwenn was rescued from the brink of destruction.

Brazatta Key was one of the islands in the Windward Chain of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. It contained an industrial zone and a spaceport, and was home to a number of manufacturers that exported goods to the rest of Kwenn.

Vorah Key was an island on the planet Kwenn, a part of the Windward Chain of the Gem Cities of Kwenn. It contained a judicial complex as well as Gutson's Pub, and was known for its nightlife. Bridges connected Vorah Key to Brazatta, Capital, and Zyboh Keys.

Zyboh Key was an island of the Gem Cities of Kwenn's Windward Chain on the planet Kwenn. It contained Kwikhaul Livery Corporation and a fathier-racing venue, and also hosted a vintage spacecraft show and auction. Zyboh Key was connected via bridges to Vorah, Gala, and Parva Keys.

Parva Key was an island of the Windward Chain of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. The island contained the Bivall Colony, which provided a home for members of the Bivall species after the Protobranch disaster, as well as other aquatic beings.
Essafa Key was an island of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn, situated in the Middle Chain.

Gala Key was an island of the Middle Chain in the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. The island was known for its entertainment, containing an arena where acts from across the galaxy came to perform.

Capital Key was an island of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn, situated within the Middle Chain. Sanctuary Mount, a mountain that contained an outpost of the Jedi Order, was situated on Capital Key.

Kinnawah Key was one of the islands of the Middle Chain of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. It contained the Lamplighter Boutique, a district famed for its antiquities, as well as a landing for the casino sail barge Pelagic.

Langdam Key was an island of the Gem Cities of Kwenn's Middle Chain on the planet Kwenn. The island was home to the Harbor Market, where luxury shopping was available, including the Tasty Comet dessert and fine clothiers.

Quarney Key was an island in the Middle Chain of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. The island contained a nature preserve and served as the gateway to the exotic chains of the north sports waterfalls and caves that were crafted as part of the Grand Renewal.

Rayley Key was an island of the Leeward Chain of the planet Kwenn's Gem Cities of Kwenn. The island was home to the Paths of Harmony, a park designed to promote reflection and healing that originated from the mind of a Jedi Master, as well as a clinic.

Malbaira Key was an island of the Leeward Chain in the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. The island was protected from development as a nature preserve, and its flora and fauna attracted numerous naturalists. Malbaira Key was also known for its views of the aquatic oroko.

Addoa Key was an island of the Leeward Chain within the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. Rendili Hyperworks operated on the island, which was home to factories connected via spaceport to the Kwenn Space Station above the planet.
The Windward Chain was an island chain that was part of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. The chain consisted of Brazatta, Parva, Vorah, and Zyboh Keys.
The Middle Chain was an island chain within the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. It contained the Capital, Essafa, Gala, Kinnawah, Langdam, and Quarney Keys.
The Leeward Chain was one of the three island chains of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. It contained the Addoa, Malbaira, and Rayley Keys.

The teal oroko, commonly known as simply oroko, were aquatic nine-pointed echinoderms that could be found in the sea of the planet Kwenn. The creatures had numerous spawning grounds within the islands of the Gem Cities of Kwenn, including near the Gala, Essafa, and Malbaira Keys.

Sanctuary Mount was a promontory on Capital Key in the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn that served as an outpost of the Jedi Order. Sanctuary Mount was the name of both the promontory and the Jedi outpost that had been carved into it.
Regal Voyager was a travel company that operated luxury liners in the region known as the Slice. The company offered passage to the planet Kwenn and its Gem Cities of Kwenn.

The Pelagic was a casino sail barge that operated within the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn, traveling between the various islands of the archipelago. The casino's home port was on Brazatta Key, and it also docked on Gala, Capital, Kinnawah, Langdam, and Quarney Keys.

The Jedi Order established an outpost on the planet Kwenn at some point by the High Republic Era. In 229 BBY, Jedi Master Yarael Poof was present at the outpost while he attended a meeting—via hologram—with the remainder of the Jedi High Council, Jedi Master Elzar Mann, and Su…

The Gurus of the Assassin Guild were individuals affiliated with the Assassin Guild. At one point they taught the bounty hunter Dengar twelve forms of bladed combat.
During the early reign of the Galactic Empire Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine used a Rho-class transport shuttle as his personal craft.

Lau was a planet in the Meerian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. After Omega and Crosshair fled Imperial facility on Wayland, they ended up on Lau before they managed to steal and ship and leave the planet.

Lau birds were species of birds with colorful feathers native to the planet Lau.

A town was located in the planet Lau. It included a spaceport, where Star Commuter 2000 shuttles ferried passengers to the planet, as well as a cargo port.
VP-8R was a bodyguard droid who served the pilot Vane Sarpen during the High Republic Era.

The moon of Saltear was a terrestrial moon that was the site of a settlement. After the formation of the Nihil marauder organization's Occlusion Zone in the Outer Rim in 230 BBY, the moon was located at the edge of Nihil territory.

Exu Prime was an Outer Rim astronomical object located in the Tolonda sector's Exu Prime system. In 230 BBY, it became stranded behind the Stormwall hyperspace barrier that defined the Nihil marauder-controlled region of space known as the Occlusion Zone.
The Kinpany Gap mining settlement was a settlement in the mining location Kinpany Gap on the planet Lothal.

An eclectic marketplace was located on an astronomical object. Around 379 BBY, Marda Ro—the Evereni founder of a group of marauders who would eventually become the Nihil—visited the marketplace during her hunt for other members of her species.

The Iron Assembler was a vulture droid of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The droid was identified as a Scintilla Scavenger.

Belin's ship was a transport starship piloted by the Ugnaught Belin during the High Republic Era. After Belin was trapped behind the Stormwall in the Occlusion Zone, a region of space captured by the Nihil marauders, he unwillingly used his ship to transport cargo for the Nihil.

Prandril was a small moon in the Outer Rim, situated in the Prandril system within the Minos Cluster. During the High Republic Era, the moon was home to a colony of the Rodian species, who did not wish to spoil the land upon which they settled.
An asteroid field was located in the Prandril system, situated in the Minos Cluster within the Outer Rim.

An unnamed moon was located in the Farj system where it orbited the second planet in the system. It had no water and was uninhabited. It was covered with an organic network similar to an aboveground silver and gray root system.

The Financial District, also known as the financial zone was a location that spanned 30 square kilometers in the Galactic City of Coruscant. It was adjacent to the Federal District and The Works and housed many banks and financial institutions as well as the Greth Lan-Dwu Corp.
Arli's moon was a moon that orbited the ocean planet Arli in the Outer Rim. During the High Republic Era, the family of Jordanna Sparkburn, a member of the San Tekka clan, resided on the moon.

Arli was a red ocean planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Great Hyperspace Rush, the planet was settled and had a hyperspace route mapped by the San Tekka clan, and a hardy moss was discovered on its islands that could be utilized in various materials.

Uveron was a planet located in the Colonies. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma undertook a funding mission for the Alliance to the world. During her time on Uveron, Mothma was kidnapped by the Scarabi.
Ice wyrms were a creature found on the planet Barton IV.

A room built from transparisteel was located aboard the Gaze Electric, a ship that belonged to the pirate leader Marda Ro. Although she suspected it was meant to have been used for medical observation, by around 379 BBY she used it to cage a beast known as the Great Leveler.
Shihan was a terrestrial planet in the galaxy mainly inhabited by droids. At some point, Mandalorians Din Djarin and Grogu visited Shihan to deliver cargo to the droids.
The Tempest Breaker was a starship operated by the bounty hunter crew known as the Tempest Breakers during the High Republic Era.
The Wookiee Chalmun maintained a private office behind the main bar of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina, a cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine that Chalmun owned.
Kindosorn was a planet with jungle terrain situated in the Kindosorn system in the Lol sector of the Outer Rim. It was the site of an outpost of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era.
Vuundalla was a planet located in the Bri'ahl sector within the galaxy. The planet was ruled by Pychor Vuundir and Dafne Vuundir.
Seswenna City was the capital city of the Outer Rim planet Seswenna. When Seswenna fell within the Occlusion Zone territory of the Nihil marauders, the city was occupied by the Nihil.
A large gas planet was located in the same system as the ocean planet Arli within the Outer Rim Territories. Situated closest to its sun, the gas planet was also the star system's namesake.

Birage was a small city located on the moon of the planet Arli. The settlement was composed of buildings constructed from sandcrete that were clustered in seven neighborhoods around a central square, also including a spaceport.

The Iliri Spine was a ridge located on the moon of Arli that was blanketed with dark moss and spindly grasses. The ridge was overtaken by a blight that had begun to consume the entire moon, which left the Iliri Spine gray and lifeless.
Neon bats were a type of bat that could produce light that were found on the moon of the planet Arli in the Outer Rim.

K-5, also known as Kay-Five or five, was one of the K droids constructed by the droid J-6 on Aricho. Along with the other K droids, K-5 was built to assist the local resistance force in liberating Aricho from the Nihil marauders.
The droid designated one was a K droid constructed by the droid J-6 on Aricho. Along with the other K droids, one was built by J-6 to aid the resistance force of Aricho against the Nihil marauders.

Seven was the designation of a K droid built by the droid J-6 on Aricho. The K droids were made to aid the planet's resistance force in liberating its people from the control of the Nihil marauders, although seven was incomplete.

Ytrecht was the capital city of the planet Aricho. It was located on a side of the planet that suffered from powerful storms that made flight difficult, resulting in the town being accessible for only a few months of the year.

Pabu cove was a rocky cove located on the island of Pabu. The cove was below the seawall that delineated Lower and Upper Pabu, but lay in a largely uninhabited part of the island, away from the populous.
Odes Town was, according to legend, a town located on the planet Monta that didn't celebrate Life Day.
Merisee was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Merisee system in the Elrood sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The cult built a temple on a asteroid in Wild Space. The temple was said to overlook a fissure which allowed viewers to stare into the essence of the Living Force itself.

The Eaduan village cluster was located on the Outer Rim planet Eadu during the Imperial Era. Although Eadu had a hostile and rainy climate, the southern hemisphere, where the village cluster was located, had fertile soil and was less inhospitable than the northern hemisphere.
A blast range was located on the planet Eadu. Dynamic kyber field experiments were conducted there as part of the Tarkin Initiative's research to create the Death Star.
The Preelos Consortium was a local criminal organization on the planet Toydaria. The Preelos Consortium was well known in the Riar underworld and an ally of the Desilijic Hutt Kajidic.

A clan of Wookiees produced the dish known as rillrrnnn spears by wrapping spears of the plant rillrrnnn in thin strips of meat and soft dough made from grains from the Wookiee homeworld, Kashyyyk, before seasoning and baking them.
Durand's Council was a council within the Durand crime family. A Devaronian captain was put on trial and executed by the council after he was declared guilty of conspiring against the family.

A ship was owned by a Theelin family during the High Republic Era. Between around 397 BBY and 387 BBY, the family was present on the Expansion Region planet Genetia when the Evereni Ro family was attacked by townspeople.

Khaërn VII was an abandoned mining planet, occupied by natives and colonists. The colonists maintained a hyperspace communications relay. The planet was covered in swampy plains and bayous, with the occasional jungle.

A private landing field was located in the Holy City on the Mid Rim moon Jedha near the Roalj Temple. By 382 BBY, it was owned by a donor of the Path of the Open Hand cult.
A group of pirates that stole treasure from an Imperial Governor. Three of its members, Marath, Kalab and Houliet betrayed the group and took the treasure for themselves.

Tarlafars were a short, white-furred sentient species of which Wamoth, Ailish, and Bayrn were members. The Tarlafars' head shared some visual similarity to the species of Senator Nico.

The spixx was a species of fish found on the planet Taypho. There was a sport on Taypho called Spixx leaping, which involved riding a wild spixx fish for as long as possible.

Lava worms were a type of giant, black-scaled worm native to the volcanic planet Brazadann located in the Outer Rim Territories. Growing to be hundreds of meters long, they traversed the lava seas of the planet and were ridden by the locals.

The sublevel containment chamber was an underground containment facility in Tantiss Base on the planet Wayland. It was used to hold cloned Zillo Beasts—referred to by Royce Hemlock as "the assets"—created by the Advanced Science Division.
The Nihil engineer Alfkenda resided in quarters aboard the Gaze Electric, the flagship of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro.
Ro's suite was the personal living quarters of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro aboard his flagship, the Gaze Electric.
Caraad was a planet located in the Interior and Colonies regions of the galaxy.

Gant spiders were large poisonous spiders that lived on the world Batuu. Around 379 BBY, Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani learned that a salmaca that was raiding Peka village was also protecting the village by preying on a nearby colony of gant spiders.
B.O.B.7 was a Protocol droid and Rebel agent who operated on the planet Ominia.
The Slangs were small, nomadic beings that traveled the galaxy as true space scrappers. They had four arms with long, thin fingers, a stocky thorax, and an elongated face.

Ethark was a tropical planet in the Epsilon 69.02 system. The surface consisted of vast steppes of photosynthetic plants, forests, and mineral reliefs. An estimated two-thirds of the surface was covered in forests.
A2-D6 was a pilot droid that served the Galactic Republic's Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era.

Scratch-hens were a type of hen. In 382 BBY, the leader of the Path of the Open Hand cult, Elecia Zeveron, suffered a seizure while in the Path compound on the Outer Rim planet Dalna.

Ominia was a glacial planet in the Epsilon 69.02 system. The planet's surface was completely covered in ice and had no indigenous life. A mining station owned by Yohn Stelly was present on the planet.
Lahn was the gas giant moon of the planet Ethark. The moon was mostly composed of sulfur, nickel, and plutonium. It had multiple asteroids orbiting it.

Torku was a terrestrial object in the Inner Rim Territories where a group of rebels fought the Galactic Empire.

x: A diplomatic mission to Melida/Daan took place around 395 BBY, when Galactic Republic Senator Lexxir Greylark, his son Axel Greylark, and a Jedi Knight traveled to the location Melida/Daan to release the leader of the Daan, who had been captured by the opposing Melida.

The Great Western Sea was a sea located on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, situated far from the world's Jedi Temple. In 33 BBY, Jedi Master Yaddle thought about the sea while working on legal duties within the Temple, reflecting on how she felt she was drowning in details.

Chamble was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Chamble system in the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square Q-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A part of the Galactic Republic, it was represented by a senator.

Yinchorri were a reptilian sentient species. They possessed broad, rounded snouts and unlike other reptilian species such as the Trandoshan and Saurin, had smooth scaleless skin. Jodak, a pilot for the Riftwalkers, was a Yinchorri.

The Riftwalkers were a pirate gang that operated in the Slice during the Republic Era. The gang was named for the Riftwalker sabacc game. The Nautolan Zilastra, leader of the Riftwalkers, plotted against the other pirate gangs in the region.
The Vellus was a GR-75 medium transport belonging to the Rebel Alliance and was destroyed by Darth Vader between 2 BBY and 4 ABY.
IK-111, or Eyekay, was a murderous assassin droid who worked for Zilastra, the leader of the Riftwalkers pirate gang.

Valboraan was a desert planet located in the Valboraan system, in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was situated along the Ootmian Pabol near the planets Kwenn and Keldooine. The planet was home to many cave systems, which made it attractive as a hideout.
Galactic City Recovery was a company based on Coruscant that repossessed stolen starships and returned them to their owners for a fee.
The Poisoned Blades was a pirate gang active in the Slice during the Republic Era.

The Filthy Credits, commonly known as the Filthy Creds, was a pirate gang that operated throughout the Slice during the Republic Era. Its leader was known as the Chief Executive, while its members wore suits.
The Vile was a pirate gang that operated in the Slice during the Republic Era. The gang was known for being vicious and depraved.
The Staved Skulls was a pirate gang active in the Slice during the Republic Era. Its members decorated their heads by driving metal spikes into their skulls.

Maldroth was a planet in the Maldroth system in the Grumani sector of the Outer Rim Territories with a vast archipelago surrounded by a glittering sea. According to legend a group of colonists settled on Maldroth after a great war that left the people with a lasting guilt.
A vast group of islands surrounded by a glittering sea.
A sea that surrounded a vast archipelago on the planet Maldroth.
The 4077th Medical Army Spatial Hospital, shortened to the 4077th Mash, was a Rebel medcenter commanded by Colonel Burns. Its headquarters was the hospital ship, the Asclepios.
The main port city of the planet Kennerla had a docking hangar by the High Republic Era.

A docking hangar employing a Besalisk harbormaster was located in the main port city of the Outer Rim planet Kennerla by the time of the High Republic Era. In 229 BBY, the pilot Affie Hollow parked her ship, the Vessel, in the hangar.
2-1B33, nicknamed "Piquouse", was a Rebel medical droid that assisted Doctor Benjamin Pierce.
FX-9-33 was a surgeon droid and a colleague of medical droid 2-1B33. FX-9-33 worked aboard the Rebel medical frigate, the Asclepios, and specialized in cardiovascular operations.

Erebus was a planet located in the Erebus system in the Colonies. A mountainous and muddy world, Erebus had valuable resources that would be extracted by Imperial strip mining, which left the terrain even more barren and potholed.
Em'liy were a sentient species. One Em'liy, Mikilanie, lived on Jedha during the High Republic Era.

Hafernia was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories that had joined the Galactic Republic shortly before 33 BBY. As a showing of good faith, they wished to send pallets of boots to the Republic to be worn by the Jedi Order.
Pendalanorians were gigantic, skeletal humanoids native to the jungle planet Pendalanor. They had translucent skin and slightly fluorescent bones.
The Regal Zephyr was a passenger transport operated by Regal Voyager along the Ootmian Pabol hyperspace route during the Republic Era.

The Morleen was a freighter piloted by its owner during the Republic Era. The freighter was captured by the Riftwalkers pirate gang with its owner still aboard and transported to the Riftwalker Compound on the planet Keldooine.
Termidotes were a type of tiny creature found on the forest moon Endor. They possessed six limbs, a pair of wings, two antennae, two black eyes, and a pair of long teeth.
Valnoos was an astronomical object in the Valnoos system in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A variant of sabacc known as riftwalker sabacc originated from Valnoos.
The Invasion of Ison was a battle fought between Imperial General Sorin and a Rebel squad on the planet Ison.
Otto's Grotto was a location on Quarney Key on the planet Kwenn that served fleek eels.
The Paths of Harmony was a park designed to promote thought and healing that was located on Rayley Key on the planet Kwenn.
The Education Ministry was a government location on Capital Key, Kwenn, that contained the office of the deputy minister for academic loan reconsolidation.
The Bivall Colony was a colony on the island Parva Key, Kwenn, founded by the Bivall victims of a solar storm on Protobranch, but has since come to serve other refugees.
Noosa fish were a type of fish that could be found on the world Miekos. During the day, they absorbed sunlight, which they reflected back for the first few hours of night.
Thana were a type of fish that could be found on the world Miekos. Noparo Yar and his wife, Fee-Na, were farmers who raised thana on their homestead.
A ship was owned by the Vukorah during her time as a bounty hunter.
SK-89 (Esskay-Aytnine), known as Esskay, was a droid that operated for Kwikhaul Livery Corporation on the planet Kwenn.

The Randomizer was a Pelta-class frigate that served as the flagship of Zilastra, leader of the pirate gang known as the Riftwalkers. Zilastra had previously stolen the frigate from the Trade Federation.

Marsh ponies were a type of pony that had a vegetarian diet. In 228 BBY, while unloading supplies on the Republic Defense Coalition mobile launch and repair station, the pilot Jordanna Sparkburn thought about how her girlfriend Sylvestri Yarrow wanted to one day buy land on a …

An antique ARC-8 starfighter was owned by Fraxa, owner of Kwikhaul Livery Corporation on the planet Kwenn. The ARC-8 starfighter was originally from the High Republic Era, during which it had seen extensive use.

Dee-Twelve was a droid owned by the family of Jerlyn, a resident of Peka village on the world Batuu. Around 379 BBY, while working on the family's farm at night, Dee-Twelve was taken by a salmaca that was raiding Peka and brought to its nest.
A city on the ocean world of Mon Cala that was five kilometers from the Great Ungeness Trench.

A Kraalfin was a creature that lived in the oceans of the planet Mon Cala. The child Carus once lied to his parents about encountering one outside of its territory to which his father set out looking for it.
A Mandelfish was a fish that lived in the oceans of the planet Mon Cala and swam in schools. They were thought to populate the planet when the Mon Calamari were only a fledgling species.
The Regal Hopper was a cargo ship operated by Regal Star Freight. On one occasion, the starship transported grains from Yitabo to Keldooine.

Assurance was a CR56 corvette commanded by Captain Pell Baylo during the Republic Era. Under Baylo's command, the corvette had operated in a variety of roles, including in nine planetary defense forces and as commercial security for eight corporations.
Rockworms were, according to legend, creatures that lived on the moon Endor. with the cave-dwelling Ewoks during the time of darkness before the Golden One came and brought light to the moon.

Boolahs were a type of rodent native to the planet Kwenn. They possessed white fur and had a long, slinky body. Pogee Shrag owned a number of boolahs that had been abandoned by residents of Kwenn who had left the planet.

A ship owned by the Thradian Jonram Dremel was used between the years 14 BBY and 9 BBY. The Mohsenian Kricad would later steal the ship following the death of Dremel onboard the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station.
Perro Quay was a location on Langdam Key on the planet Kwenn. It contained the Langdam Harbor Market.

The Langdam Harbor Market was a market located at Perro Quay on the planet Kwenn's Langdam Key. The Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi visited the market while on Kwenn, witnessing a relationship disagreement between the Yarkora Aptorr and Varralis.
Hydrosnakes were a type of snake. During or after 18 BBY, the clone Echo called former Imperial Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart a hydrosnake when questioning if he could be trusted.

Black Rock Passage was an area of space located in the Akkadese Maelstrom, a region of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice consisting of ionized gas, dust clouds, water vapor, ammonia, and planet-sized carbonbergs as well as gravity wells.
BOS-4D was a loader droid that lived in a droid village on the planet Shihan.
Level 3921 was a sub-surface city level of Galactic City, the ecumenopolis covering the planet Coruscant.

The Athio Seven Hundred was a podrace held in the vicinity of the Outer Rim Territories' Athio system and was held during or after 22 BBY.
Temerancé was a forested planet located in the Rekai system. After the Nihil marauders established the Occlusion Zone, Temerancé fell behind its Stormwall barrier.

Abtin was a planet in the Abtin system in the Danjar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. When the Nihil marauders expanded the Stormwall barrier that surrounded their Occlusion Zone territory, Abtin was one of the worlds that fell into the Nihil's new borders.
Bay 8 was a hangar bay located within an orbital space station Imperial Station 003.

Docking Bay 5-02 was a hangar bay located within the Imperial orbital space station Imperial Station 003. Lieutenant Holmes was in charge of the bay.
Alpha-44 was an Imperial Rho-class transport shuttle. During or after 18 BBY, it was stolen by Echo, a member of the Clone Underground and the rogue clone commando unit known as the Bad Batch.

The Rendellians were a species native to the planet Rendel. Rendellians possessed fur that ranged in color from purple, green and orange, as well as wings that matched the color of their hair. Zalla and Bellan were members of this species.
The TIE fighter bay was a hangar located in the Galactic Empire's second Death Star.

The Black Pits were a navigational hazard that had been named by wary spacers. They were located in the Slice, in the vicinity of the Outer Rim Territories world Kessel as well as the surrounding Akkadese Maelstrom, a region consisting of ionized gas, dust clouds, water vapor,…

A freighter was owned by the smuggler Azita Cruuz. When Cruuz obtained the formula for coaxium ultra on the moon Ro Mira, she and the Jedi Mace Windu traveled to her freighter, which was parked at the Radial Spaceport.

A morgue was active on the second Death Star shortly before the Battle of Endor.

Kay Vess' crew was a crew led by the criminal Kay Vess to carry out a heist. Their ship was a prototype EML 850 light freighter called the Trailblazer designed in the Republic Era and last of its kind from the Clone Wars.

Pilot's End was a navigational hazard in the Akkadese Maelstrom, a region of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice that consisted of ionized gas, dust clouds, water vapor, ammonia, carbonbergs, and gravity wells.
The Thunderhead was a location within the Corkscrew, a part of the turbulent Outer Rim Territories region known as the Akkadese Maelstrom.

The Mudfields of Bororn were a set of muddy fields on an astronomical object. In 228 BBY, by which point the mudfields' astronomical object had been annexed as part of the Nihil's Occlusion Zone, monster hunters Ty Yorrick and Drewen Qweebjillan were hired to defeat a Trilark …

Leebon's shuttle was a shuttle owned by Jedi Master Leebon of the Jedi Order when she was stationed on the Mid Rim moon Jedha during the High Republic Era. After Leebon's death during the Battle of Jedha in 382 BBY, the shuttle's ownership transferred to Jedi Master Vildar Mac.

A cruiser was owned by the Hoopaloo Strat during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, Jedi Padawan Matthea Cathley and Jedi Knight Oliviah Zeveron traveled aboard the cruiser from the Mid Rim moon Jedha to the Outer Rim planet Dalna to investigate the Path of the Open Hand cult.

A ship was owned by the Tarsunt Okut Dand during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, the Path of the Open Hand cult members Werth Plouth and Yana Ro briefly served aboard the ship as they traveled from Port Mackie to the Outer Rim planet Dalna.
The great hall was a massive hall located in the space station Starlight Beacon.
An art gallery was located in the space station Starlight Beacon. It held many arts donated by the planets of the Galactic Republic.
A storage room was located in the space station Starlight Beacon. In 232 BBY, the dedication plaque was stored in the storage room prior to the dedication of the Starlight Beacon.

Lake Haruuni was a lake located high in the mountains of the planet Haruun Kal. Due to its altitude, the fish that dwelt in the lake practically floated out of its dark waters when the Haruun Kal native Azita Cruuz fished for them alone from Lake Haruuni's rocky shores during …

Pelek Baw was the capital city of the planet Haruun Kal. Azita Cruuz, a human native of the world, grew up alone in the city as an orphan and encountered many other children there who still had parents.

Gate Control was an organization of the Galactic Empire responsible for controlling access through the Shield Gate, the single entry port of the otherwise impenetrable deflector shield around the planet Scarif.
A Rodian colony was based on Prandril during the High Republic Era.
A village housing a Rodian colony was on Prandril during the High Republic Era.

objective: Deliver grain to Prandril
x: A mission to deliver grain to Prandril was undertaken by Jedi Master Avar Kriss and the pilot Belin in 229 BBY.
An attack on Prandril was carried out by the Nihil after the Rodian colony on Prandril failed to pay their tribute to the organization.
A Cloudship was utilized by the Nihil Cloud Sarn Starbreaker during the High Republic Era. During the First Battle of Cyclor, the ship was destroyed by Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar.

Engineering was a location within the Galactic Empire's Star Destroyer Implacable. It was worked by a team of engineers including Lieutenant Naylyn Bashan and led by the vessel's chief engineer, Lieutenant Commander Del Meeko.
A passenger transport was in operation by the time of the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, the vessel set out for the Outer Rim location Travnin with several individuals on board.

A blum-maggot was a type of maggot. Between 5 ABY and 28 ABY, the Dulok King Gorneesh referred to the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick as a "snivelling blum-maggott" when Warrick ran to attack a group of Duloks at their camp on the Outer Rim Forest Moon of Endor.

The Halisite were a sentient species that originated on a planet on the frontier and were considered rare by the time of the High Republic Era. They possessed a bone fin that crested their head and pulsed red and blue as it flushed with blood in time with their heartbeat.
A planet was the origin of the Halisite sentient species. The planet was situated farther out on the frontier of the Outer Rim than the planet Hetzal Prime.
The Happy Grove was a forest on the moon Endor where Bright Tree Village was located.
Hangar Twenty-Two was a hangar on the Cyclor Shipyards which housed the research vessel Innovator.

result: The Hoopaloo steals part of Ty Yorrick's arsenal
x: Between 241 BBY and 231 BBY, a job on Alzoc III was carried out by the monster hunter Ty Yorrick and a Hoopaloo. During the job, which took place on the Outer Rim planet Alzoc III, the Hoopaloo stole part of Yorrick's arsenal.
A world in Hutt Space that had never seen peace or justice was the homeworld of the human girl Kylah Lohmata.

The Four Sword Saints was a group that the Sith Master Okinaa belonged to. Okinaa lived in a village on a planet with their droid R5-D56 and other villagers. Over time, many of the villagers died until Okinaa and RD5-56 became the village's only surviving members.
At Attin was a forested planet in the Outer Rim Territories with an orderly population that was isolated from the wider galaxy as part of the Great Work of the Old Republic.

During the Republic Era, an ecological calamity occurred on the planet Kwenn. In the time before the High Republic Era, mining firms were heavily drawn to Kwenn due to the presence of precious gemstones.
A claim was located on the Outer Rim planet Elphrona in the High Republic Era, situated north of the world's Jedi-operated Elphrona Outpost.
Extermination units operated as pest controllers on the Outer Rim planet Elphrona during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, a claim on Elphrona experienced difficulties with a nest of chromants.
RA-7-81 was an RA-7 protocol droid who was stationed on board one of the Galactic Empire's science vessels.

Penumbra was a floating city that orbited a gas giant in the Tollello system. By around 377 BBY, Jedi Knight Rooper Nitani and Jedi Master Silandra Sho infiltrated an illegal weapons deal in Penumbra with the aim of arresting the criminal Ullan Yite.

Hallitron-7 was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Hallitron system in the Jalor sector of the Mid Rim. During the Republic Era, Renzoh Silliac of the Blood Oath Syndicate operated a salvage yard on Hallitron-7.

Bright Circle was a criminal organization that was lead by Ullan Yite. Around 377 BBY, it put together a deal with a pirate group to sell smuggled weapons. The deal was broken up and Yite was captured by Silandra Sho, Rooper Nitani, and P3-7A.
The Idiot Three were an inept trio of amateur pirates that operated in the Slice during the Republic Era.
The Mission to Sorin's Star Destroyer was an attempt by a squad of Rebels to prevent General Octavion Sorin's Star Destroyer from traveling to the planet Ison.

A salvage yard located on Hallitron-7. It was run by the Chevin known as Renzoh Silliac, who was murdered there by Huijari after a conflict between Jango Fett and various other bounty hunters unfolded on the site.

A salmaca was a type of large lizard-like creature that lived in caves on the world Batuu. They raided homes for valuables to line their nests, and some believed that they only existed in legends. Around 379 BBY, a salmaca began raiding homes in Peka, a village on Batuu.

An RA-7 protocol droid served the Blood Oath Syndicate member Renzoh Silliac on the planet Hallitron-7. After a brief skirmish, the protocol droid was interrogated by the Palliduvan bounty hunter Aurra Sing and coerced into unlocking Silliac's computer.

An office belonging to an information broker was located on Level 1313 on the planet Coruscant. The bounty hunter Jango Fett encountered a group of Anselmi threatening the broker and dispatched them with a micro-rocket, causing significant damage to the office.
During the Republic Era, a mission to the planet Hallitron-7 occurred.

The Regional Republic Headquarters was a location on the planet Jaloria. After trying to negotiate a peace treaty between the Anselmi and Nautolan species, a heist occurred in the headquarters, which resulted in the theft of the artifact.

The secret gambling den was a location active on the planet Oosalon during the Republic Era. While attempting to capture the bounty on the Koorivar Fissark Tozan, the bounty hunter Jango Fett destroyed the gambling den.
2341 was a B1-series battle droid who once was deployed to a desert environment with a fellow B1 unit.
A bipedal species had gray fur and brown horns, skin, and eyes.

Escander was a muddy terrestrial planet which had a Separatist base.

Transport One was the designation of a Longbeam cruiser of the Galactic Republic's Republic Defense Coalition that assisted in the Republic and Jedi Order's raid on the Korvix Vorn, a prison ship of the Nihil marauders, intended to serve as a transport to rescue the prisoners.

A planet was the location of a village that the Sith Okinaa lived in. Okinaa lived on the planet for at least ten years, and was one of the last remaining members of the village along with their droid, R5-D56.
A village on a planet was the home of the Sith Okinaa. Eventually, Okinaa and their droid companion, R5-D56, were the last two remaining members of the village.
The Senate Budgetary Committee was a committee made up of senators from the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate, which was based in the Senate Building on the planet Coruscant.
The capital city of the Colonies planet Hynestia Prime contained the Hynestian royal palace.
A Longbeam cruiser became part of the Colony of Kezarat, a former convoy that had been stranded in No-Space the same day of the Great Disaster during the High Republic Era.
836-VS was a Sentinel-class landing craft that was stolen by the Alliance to Restore the Republic and used for a mission to the moon Killun 71.
A CZ protocol droid accompanied an R4 astromech droid while the two searched for a village on a planet. Throughout their search, the CZ protocol droid complained and argued with the astromech.
A prison ship was utilized to transport the members of the Final Occultation cult after its members were arrested and imprisoned by the Sith Lord Darth Sidious.
The training room was a laboratory and training facility located in the Imperial Tantiss Base on the planet Wayland.

An R4 astromech droid, along with a CZ protocol droid, searched for a village on a planet. During their search, the astromech droid admitted it did not know if they were headed toward a village, and the two droids began arguing.

The guaqa was a type of burrowing lizard that was capable of curling into a ball and was found on a desert planet. At some point during the Imperial Era, a pit was dug into the planet by individuals enslaved by the Galactic Empire.
Pip was a PIP repair droid who accompanied Verosha "Osha" Aniseya and later her sister Mae-ho "Mae" Aniseya during the High Republic Era.
M-6JR was a protocol droid who became a wheat farmer after a prolonged exposure to magnets.
C-43S was a protocol droid of the Rebel Alliance who became a corn farmer after a magnet scrambled his programming.

The Sith Okinaa considered a location on their homeworld to be a holy place. The holy place was located on the edge of a cliff, and had several small rock piles, markers, statues, and other objects, including a statue that resembled an Ewok who had once lived in their village.
Dinutu was a planet located in the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Dinutun species.

R8-26, also known as R8 for short, was an R6 astromech droid who served the New Republic by 5 ABY, specifically Ambassador Nadura. R8 joined Nadura on a mission to Corvus, Nadura's homeworld, where she hoped to accept them into the new government.
A species of pack beast with four legs, cream colored skin and thick, blue hair existed in on a snowy world.

The Gundark's Back was a GR-75 medium transport once owned by Malia Shariv. The transport was stolen by Dai Danu, and its transponder code was cloned onto another, almost identical GR-75.

Egralla mites were insect pests that fed on data storage devices. They could infest libraries and archives, endangering their collections, and could require exterminators to remove. They could travel between systems on starships, and preferred to make for high ground.

A vantage point was located on the world Batuu and offered a view of the surrounding countryside and the village Peka. Three stones on the vantage point marked it as a site of worship for an ancient religion, and it was a favorite location of Jedi Master Silandra Sho.

SW-0222 was an Eta-class supply barge of the Galactic Empire. The supply ship was utilized by Administrator Sly Moore's Schism Imperial, a covert faction intending to overthrow the Emperor, as part of its plan to assault Exegol and the Sith Eternal.

An airless moon housed a lunar base where the service droid Olly operated a refueling bay. During or after 18 BBY, the pirate Phee Genoa visited the moon in her starship, Providence, to get the vessel refueled.
A criminal gang of aliens led by Kruno operated on the planet Ammon IV during the Imperial Era.
Gee-Bee was a droid who worked in the gardens on the planet Isobe alongside Levier during the Imperial Era.
The Megarian bog-worm was a type of worm that existed in the galaxy. The Chiss Fraulda Rynn owned a pet Megarian bog-worm named Skoogia.
Bay 5 was a hangar within the Galactic Empire's Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Sovereign. It housed multiple TIE fighters, as well as the Grand Inquisitor's TIE Advanced.
A Z-95 Headhunter was used by fallen Jedi Bode Akuna during the Imperial Era.

Shryke's crew was a crew in the Nihil marauders led by the Storm Melis Shryke within General Abediah Viess's Ministry of Protection. Aboard the Cacophony, Shryke and her crew performed a number of raids outside the Nihil's Occlusion Zone territory.
Sector four was an area of jungle on the planet Wayland. It was located past the perimeter of Tantiss Base, an Imperial facility built in Mount Tantiss on Wayland.
The Foregone Catastrophe was a starship owned by General Abediah Viess, Minister of Protection in the Nihil marauder organization.

Rigellians were a type of sentient species. Kang and Kodos were members of the species.

The diplomatic wing of the Royal Naboo Security Forces was a security group responsible for the protection of Naboo diplomats. Mariek Panaka served as a high-ranking officer in the diplomatic wing before becoming Captain of the Guard.
Wampas were a species of cave-dwelling, winged mammals similar to gigantic bats. They were native to the basalt planet Brazadann, and were ridden by the local Brazanites.
Droofs were a species of calm and peaceful mammals native to the planet Taypho. Taï, the native sentient species, rode droofs.
42X-58939 was a BX-series droid commando that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
42X-11811 was a Separatist B2-HA super battle droid created by Baktoid Combat Automata that was reprogrammed by the Gen'Dai Rayvis to serve the Bedlam Raiders in 9 BBY.
SC-97 was a BB-series astromech droid with a black sensor and dark red and white paneling. As a member of the BB-series, it was manufactured by Industrial Automaton and stood 0.67 meters tall.

AR-L5 was a BB-series astromech droid with a blue sensor and blue and white paneling, covered in rust. As a member of the BB-series, it was manufactured by Industrial Automaton and stood 0.67 meters tall.
R3-RN8W was a black and rainbow-colored astromech droid of the R3-series with a transparent dome. This astromech called the Coruscant Underground its home and roamed the lower levels of Coruscant.

The Zedrahls were a species of sentient, reptilian Humanoids. Their skin was covered in scales. The species was in a major nuclear conflict amongst themselves caused by Arglos, a fanatical, religious leader who sought to eliminate all life on their planet.
NRX, or "Enarex," was an enigmatic assassin droid and one of the leaders of the Princes of Hell. NRX wore purple robes to hide it's true nature from strangers.

The Great Worms Cemetery was a valley on the planet Brazadann where lava worms went to pass away. The cemetery was considered one of the most mystical places on the planet, and was sacred to the local Brazanites and Salamander Warriors.
T42, also known as "Tea For Two", was an administrator droid who worked in the warehouse of the Rebel prison, Ergün prison.

Ophidions were a formidable species of translucent moray eel native to the planet Taypho. They were one of the many dangerous aquatic creatures that resided in the planet's oceans, living among the coral masses.

G-2, also called Xiri's starfighter or just Xiri's fighter, was a Forward ReCon fighter starfighter that Princess Xiri A'lbaran and her husband Phan-tu Zenn discovered in a hangar north of the Path compound on the planet Dalna during the Night of Sorrow in 382 BBY.
The Lazuli was a small starship used by Jedi Master Creighton Sun and Jedi Knight Aida Forte in 382 BBY for their mission to the Outer Rim planet Dalna to investigate the Path of the Open Hand cult.
Pelks were a species of large bird native to the ocean planet Taypho. Pelks were ridden by Coral-monks.
Brazadann City was a city located on the planet Brazadann. The inhabitants of the city were called Brazanites.
A species of parasitic organism was found in the starship, Gorgorror. The species developed in the warmest parts of the ship, and could be found clustered on the walls.

An uprising on Banfoden Prime occurred sometime between around 389 BBY and around 379 BBY. Rooper Nitani, a Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order, helped to settle the uprising, which took place on the Expansion Region astronomical object Banfoden Prime.

A creature was native to the Outer Rim planet Tao. The skin of the creature was called shagreen, and was used to wrap the hilt of a lightsaber that was passed down through the generations of the Yasaburō clan, a notable family on Tao.
Biotics were a hybrid between a host species and a species of parasitic organism found on the starship, Gorgorror.

The Malastare Hunting Guild was an organization that hosted the Great Hunt of Malastare. The club's keepers would admit participants to the hunt. Regulars included members of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, including Second Vice Chair Exum Jermit.
Krinnan was a species that roamed the jungle of Kindosorn.
JD-FA was a droid who served aboard the Star Cruiser Halcyon. Like other JD series droids, he helped with the ship's maintenance.
Operations was an Imperial unit that operated on Kamino shortly after Order 66 in 19 BBY.
Sector 2A was an area on the planet Onderon. In 19 BBY, Saw Gerrera's camp was located near this sector, a sensor in the area was tripped by Clone Commander Crosshair and his Elite Squad.
Lama Su's Office was a private room belonging to the Prime Minister of Kamino Lama Su. It was used as an office by Kamino's Ruling Council.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Ahmar was a notable member of this species.

Calda was the largest city on Thorum. It had a busy spaceport due to the large amount of business conducted there. Most of the wealthy business owners lived north of the city where the climate was a bit more temperate.
A syndicate was led by the Jenet crime lord Cenevax during the Republic Era. An unlicensed gambling ring, Cenevax's operation was based in her den within the Hythan Quarter of the planet Coruscant.

Bard was a modified R1-series astromech droid that belonged to the Batuu historian and "Lore-weaver" Tohan Lege. Lege found the discarded remains of an old droid behind the Droid Depot in the Land Port of Black Spire Outpost and recruited local mechanics to help create a new one.

The elites of Geonosian society made up a caste within their species hierarchy, much like the drone and warrior castes. Like the various other castes of their species, elite Geonosians could be found in the catacombs of their homeworld, the planet Geonosis.
