Trench Alpha-7 was a location in the Coruscant shipyard.

A cave on the world Batuu was inhabited by a salmaca creature. The cave's entrance was a tunnel that led to an immense chamber, where the salmaca made its nest. Around 379 BBY, the salmaca began raiding homes in the nearby village Peka.
Sabé's private quarters were a room on the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Executor used by the former Naboo Royal Handmaiden and Imperial Lieutenant Commander Sabé.
Celegians were a tentacled sentient species. One Celegian was present at the annual pre-Dragon Void Run celebration aboard the Dragon Void space station in 0 ABY.
The Koboh Mountains were a mountain range on Koboh.
Brendok was a mysterious planet located in Wild Space. During the Emergences in 232 BBY, the planet was rendered lifeless but life had mysteriously returned to the planet by 148 BBY.

Ueda was a remote planet located in Xappyh sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Ueda was home to Point Ueda, located on a small green island connected via a landbridge to further land, where a landing pad was located.

Khofar was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that featured forest and jungle terrain. During the High Republic Era, the Wookiee Jedi Master Kelnacca lived a solitary life in the jungles of Khofar.

Hangar Bay Five was a hangar located on the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon. In 231 BBY, after Starlight Marshal Avar Kriss requested each Jedi stationed on the station depart to assist her in battle against the carnivorous plants known as the Drengir on the G…

The Filthy Zephyrs was a gang of pirate Quarren who operated on the ocean planet of Manaan. At one point, Skoova Stev, Wan'yek Whett, and the rest of the crew of the Grapnel encountered the gang after crashing on Manaan.

Bode's quarters were the living quarters of Bode Akuna and his daughter, Kata Akuna, within the Officer's Quarters on the Imperial Security Bureau's II-0810 Satellite Station in the Nova Garon system.

The raid on Quilken was a raid during Nihil conflict on the rocky planet of Quilken in which Jedi Master Porter Engle set a trap for the Nihil, luring in the Storm Slombo and Tempest Runner Lourna Dee under the guise that a vault on Quilken contained treasure.
During the existence of the Galactic Republic, a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid was employed by a mining company at the Administrative Zone Twelve settlement on the planet Roxuli.
Administrative Zone Twelve was a settlement on the mining planet Roxuli.

A droid served in a Cloud within the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the Cloud kidnapped several Force-sensitive children from a small settlement on the planet Temerancé in the Occlusion Zone, which led the inhabitants of the settlement to…
Pak Harbor was a harbor that was active during the High Republic Era on the planet Abtin. In 228 BBY, a year into their time traversing Abtin, Kitrep Soh and Jom Lariin ventured there.

Trilarks were a type of creature that could be found on the mudfields of Bororn. During the High Republic Era, the former Jedi Ty Yorrick and Segredo Drewen Qweebjillan fought such a beast, bringing trophies from their kill back to members of the local population.

Praesitlyn was an astronomical object situated in the Sluis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 228 BBY, during the High Republic Era, Praesitlyn and the rest of its sector fell within the Occlusion Zone territory of the Nihil marauders when its Stormwall barrier was expan…
Averam was an astronomical object in the Seswenna sector's Averam system, located in the Outer Rim Territories and the Western Reaches.

Ma'ar Shaddam was an astronomical object located in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, Ma'ar Shaddam was located within the Galactic Frontier, a region considered to be remote by the Galactic Republic.

Corva Yag was an astronomical object situated in the Corva Yag system in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, Corva Yag was part of the Galactic Frontier, a region considered to be remote by the Galactic Republic.

Cmaoli Di was an astronomical object in the Cmaoli Di system, which was located at the intersection of the Grumani, Garis and Brema sectors of the Outer Rim Territories. The celestial body was situated at grid square M-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.#

The Hammers were a local criminal organization on the planet Thorum. They were considered small time by Crimson Dawn and mostly busted unions and blackmailed local politicians.

Oanne was a planet in the Oanne system and the homeworld of the Elia-An, who had a symbiotic gestation with the planet's nativity trees. A type of fungus that grew on the roots of the trees could be used as an efficient electroconductor.

The Nihil Cloud Vark Tarpalin led a group of several Nihil—Strikes—during the High Republic Era, developing a reputation among his colleagues as a ruthless marauder.
Seevi worms were a type of large worm that could live in lakes or saltwater. During the raid of the Innovator, the Jedi Initiate Tep Tep summoned a seevi worm to fight her Nihil enemies.
The Dybbuk Silencer also known as simply the Dybbuk was a fleshy, star-shaped yellow-green parasitic creature used by the Galactic Republic to subdue violent criminals in the High Republic Era.

The Fallon was a WD-2550 Whydah-class yield conveyer operated by the Trade Federation during the High Republic Era, commanded by the Neimoidian captain Blex. Verosha Aniseya and Fillik worked as mekneks aboard the freighter for some time.

The Palwick was a DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship that operated during the High Republic Era, ferrying a number of prisoners to Coruscant. It was piloted by variable geometry droids which were permanently part of the cockpit seats.

Wrosidians were a semi-plant-based sentient species that originated from the Outer Rim's Wrosdi system. The humanoids had a set of five organs for atmospheric filtering at the back of their head.

The Clarodians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Brothers Tianris and Guanlos Mez were members of this species.

Screecher's Reach was a mountain on a planet that featured a cave which was considered to be haunted. At some point prior to the Sith revealing themselves to the Jedi in 32 BBY, the cave was inhabited by a Force-sensitive woman.

The Imperial Laundry was a laundromat located aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator. It consisted of an array of washing machines and was used to wash the clothing of Imperial personell stationed on the ship.

The T-Imperial crew were the crew-members aboard Am and Karre's Gemini-class Star Destroyer and were affiliated with the T-Empire.

A security hub was located on the space station Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era. After a riot broke out in the dining hall of the station, Soikan Velko Jahen and Mon Calamari Chief of Security Ghal Tarpfen rushed passed the hub.

A dining facility was located on the space station Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era. At some point, a riot ensued in the facility which prompted numerous individuals to stop the fighting.
The main concourse was a location found on the space station Starlight Beacon. During the High Republic Era, the Ithorian Yomo Vrex and Amani Prot Xan fought on the concourse.
The exhibition gardens were a series of gardens that were located on the space station Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era.
Central Block B-25 was an area within the Force-sensitive twins Am and Karre's Gemini-class Star Destroyer.

The Pyrlix Miasma was located in the Mid Rim Territories and the Trailing Sectors' Tyus sector, which was situated in grid square N-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The strike in the Ossiathora system was a system-wide strike in 228 BBY that prevented a grain harvested in the Mid Rim's Ossiathora system from being collected.

A spring was located at the base of the world Sarumo's mountains. The spring's water bubbled, forming a sound like tingling laughter. During the High Republic Era, riftfeather brandy was produced from its water.
The Axiom was a Republic Defense Coalition cruiser in the service of the Galactic Republic by 228 BBY, commanded by Captain Ba'luun. It took part in the assault on Naboo.
Wayfar was a settlement on the planet Tatooine. During the Imperial Era, the Weequay Quint Cresadde was the sheriff of Wayfar.
Izuma's raiders were a group led by Lord Izuma. The group consisted of Izuma, a Twi'lek, an Abyssin, and an army of reprogrammed B1-series battle droids.

Cephalosaurs were a type of creature with tentacle-like arms that could be found on the astronomical object Regnio III. During his youth, the Evereni Marchion Ro hunted the creatures while on Regnio III.

Elzar Mann's quarters were a set of personal living quarters in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant occupied by Jedi Master Elzar Mann. In 228 BBY, Jedi Master Avar Kriss visited the quarters, bringing sourstone mead and keldov nut pastries.

Ronaphaven was an agricultural planet located in a mid-sized system within Galactic Republic space. During the High Republic Era, kelivan root farmers worked on Ronaphaven. The Drengir, a carnivorous plant species, were present on Ronaphaven, but were driven away by the blight.

Isolt was a pastoral planet that fell within the Nihil marauders' Occlusion Zone territory during the High Republic Era. The Nihil, attempting to trigger a volcanic eruption similar to the event that devastated the planet Dalna, bombed Isolt repeatedly.

Vixoseph I, or simply Vixoseph, was a planet that was located within Galactic Republic space during the High Republic Era. The planet's main colony was attacked by the Drengir carnivorous plant species, after which Vixoseph I remained largely uninhabited.

Corridor eighty-four was a location found on the space station Starlight Beacon. During the High Republic Era, a human Nihil contacted Senator Ghirra Starros via a hologram and commanded the senator to disable the cameras in the corridor.

Corridor twenty-three was a location found on the space station Starlight Beacon. During the High Republic Era, a human Nihil contacted Senator Ghirra Starros via a hologram and commanded the senator to disable the cameras in the corridor.

Scyre-fish was a type of fish that existed in the galaxy. While dreaming on the space station Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era, the Mon Calamari Chief of Security Ghal Tarpfen imagined being fitted with scyre-fish skinned trousers and tunics.

A battle took place in Meevai Village on the Outer Rim planet of Keelia. Lord Izuma led a group of raiders to take the chief of Meevai Village as collateral for pillaging the village. His granddaughter Haru decided to take his place and go with Izuma.
Mos Algo was mining town located on the planet Tatooine in the far eastern Western Dune Sea, on the border of the North Jundland Wastes that was abandoned by 3 ABY.
The Precipitate Fire was a Nihil battlecruiser that served as the flagship for General Abediah Viess—the marauders' Minister of Protection by 228 BBY.

The Vorashian Sea was a sea located on the world Hosnian Prime that was connected to a river. In 228 BBY, the Nihil Minister of Information Ghirra Starros looked down on the sea from her cruiser, the Pearl of Faretta, while it was in low orbit over Hosnian Prime.
Flyhorn lizards, also simply known as flyhorns, were a type of lizard found on the planet Tatooine, where they lived solitary lives out in the world's deserts.

The Rite of Ascension, also named the Ascension ceremony, was a ritual practiced by witches on the planet Brendok. The ritual was seen as noble and magnificent, combining the strength of all witches who participated.

A tiny planet in an unnamed sector of the Outer Rim orbited at a distance from its tiny sun, resulting in its atmosphere and oceans being unsettled. During the High Republic Era, the planet was located within the Occlusion Zone territory of the Nihil marauders.

The Eternity Enterprises barge was a pleasure barge operated by the tourism company Eternity Enterprises.

A starport was located on the planet Vespaara. A digital map of the location could be found within the Vespaara Tours Loading Zone building at Vespaara Row, a civilian plaza and part-time make-shift battle arena utilized by the Hunters of the Outer Rim.

The Outworld Resort was a tourist destination within the galaxy. Posters advertising the Outworld Resort could be found within the Dune Sea Outpost battlefield of the Grand Arena, utilized by the Hunters of the Outer Rim on the planet Vespaara.
A Garbage Shoot could be found on along the edge of the Death Star Crossfire battlefield of the Grand Arena, utilized by the Hunters of the Outer Rim on the planet Vespaara.

Blue scorpions were a type of scorpion native to Eiram. They were mostly kept out of Erasmus Capital City by the protection dome, although smaller ones could sometimes slip through. These scorpions became poisonous once they reached maturity.

Pendalanor was a jungle planet in the galaxy. It took three days of hyperspace to travel from the planet Hoth to Pendalanor. The planet was the home of the Pendalanorians, which were a species of tall, skeletal humanoids. The Ho'Din Ho-Jon lived on Pendalanor.
Balada's Row was a location on Vespaara, listed as one of the destinations offered by the Vespaara Tours transportation service in association with the Hunters of the Outer Rim.

Chakonnis was a major city on the volcanic planet Burnin Konn. It was destroyed by a series of volcano eruptions in 4 ABY when forces of the Galactic Empire led by General Valin Hess detonated the geothermal reactors within the city and other cities on the world.
Dashaad was a planet active during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Q-10 was a droid who lived during the reign of the Galactic Republic in the Old Republic era.
The Moulee-rah Casino was a location on Vespaara, listed as one of the destinations offered by the Vespaara Tours transportation service in association with the Hunters of the Outer Rim.
The Ootmians was a location on Vespaara, listed as one of the destinations offered by the Vespaara Tours transportation service in association with the Hunters of the Outer Rim.

Launchbay 12 was the name of a location associated with the Hunters of the Outer Rim on Vespaara. It is referenced numerous times via graffiti displayed around the Hunters training grounds within the Grand Arena.
The Asclepios was a medical frigate utilized by the Rebel Alliance. It was the headquarters of the 4077th Medical Army Spatial Hospital
A farm was owned by the family of Jerlyn, a resident of Peka village on the Outer Rim world Batuu. Jerlyn and the family's droid, Dee-Twelve, both worked on the farm.

The Coruscant Emeralds were a grav-ball team that played on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant during the Imperial Era. Edi Myrtaan, a keeper for the team, had a significant fan following and appeared in a number of recruitment materials for the Galactic Empire.

The Coruscant League was a grav-ball league on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. During the Imperial Era, the Galactic Empire used grav-ball in its propaganda and broadcasts of tournaments were often accompanied by recruitment messages featuring popular players.
Bay 7 was a location just outside of the Vandor Railyard, a battlefield of the Grand Arena utilized by the Hunters of the Outer Rim on the planet Vespaara.
Bay 6 was an location on one side of the Vandor Railyard, a battlefield of the Grand Arena utilized by the Hunters of the Outer Rim on the planet Vespaara.

During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic, a shipyard at the Mid Rim Territories astronomical object Turco Prime was under Imperial control. The New Republic fought to gain control of it in 5 ABY.
During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic, a shipyard at Anadeen was under the control of the Empire. The New Republic fought to gain control of it in 5 ABY.
A First Order Spider probe droid discovered the presence of the supertanker fuel depot Colossus at the planet Aeos Prime during the First Order-Resistance War.

Fanbugs were a type of flying bug that could be found on the moon of the Outer Rim planet Arli. When the San Tekka clan member Jordanna Sparkburn lived on the moon years before 228 BBY, she and her brother Harth Sparkburn attended a school in the city Birage.

The Crimson Reach was a hauler used by Qi'ra and her crew to retrieve an item for Dryden Vos. The ship was piloted by Drex and Noyio during the mission. It had a gun turret in the aft section for defense.

Qira's crew was a group of Crimson Dawn personnel that worked together while stationed on Thorum. The crew was originally led by Cerveteri Slane but Qi'ra assumed leadership as her position in Crimson Dawn rose.
Ashlasi was one of the twin moons that orbited the planet Brendok, alongside Bogaro. The ringed moon had a pale gray appearance, with darker areas and circular regions.

An escape craft was attached to Polan GX-8, a Polan-717 Jedi transport used by the Jedi Order. The escape craft was not equipped with a hyperdrive. Above the planet Brendok, Mae-ho Aniseya stole the escape craft and used it to flee from Jedi Master Sol aboard the Polan.
Bunk 23 was a bunk bed on the sub-level of the Trade Federation's WD-2550 Whydah-class yield conveyer Fallon. In 132 BBY, it was used by the meknek Verosha Aniseya.

The Thranta was a starship of the Survivor Fleet, a fleet of Alderaanians who survived the destruction of the planet Alderaan by the Death Star and got rescued by rebels Princess Leia Organa and Lieutenant Evaan Verlaine.
Blackbolt was a droid pirate captain who operated on the starship Terror of Tenoo during the High Republic Era, plundering the planet Tenoo, including Kaliah Kublop's staff.
The Great Forge was an underground magma lake with small basalt islets.

The Tactics and Strategy Subcommittee was a subcommittee of the Galactic Empire. The subcommittee, which had a revolving membership, authored the memo "TIE fighters in a clustered battlefield," which argued that there were serious issues with the design and usage of TIE fighte…

Caranthanax B was a world in the Outer Rim. When the former handmaiden Sabé allied with the thief Warba Calip to locate Luke Skywalker—Jedi trainee and the son of Sith Lord Darth Vader—Calip sent Skywalker a datacard summoning him to the Southern Pole on Caranthanax B.

The Exegol Excavation Project was an archaeological endeavour undertaken around 35 ABY and led by historian Beaumont Kin in the aftermath of the Battle of Exegol and the final defeat of the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Sidious.

Hrumphs were a type of non-sentient quadrupedal herbivore found in the swamps of the planet Naboo. The had purple spots smattered across their lightly tanned body and four long horns that they used together with their highly sensitive ears to avoid predators.

A city became part of the Nihil pirates' Occlusion Zone region of space at some point after its formation in 230 BBY, stranding the city behind the Nihil's Stormwall hyperspace barrier. A resistance cell working against the Nihil used the city to operate from.

The mission to arrest Osha Aniseya was carried out by Jedi Knight Yord Fandar and his Padawan, Tasi Lowa, in 132 BBY in the wake of the murder of Jedi Master Indara, whose killer was reported to the Jedi and believed to be the former Jedi Versosha "Osha" Aniseya.
Bantha ticks were parasites that feasted off of the large hairy mammal, the bantha.

Taroon was a astronomical object located in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the home of the Ugnaught pilot Belin.
The Dalnan Council was a council of the Dalnan government that was active during the High Republic Era.
The protection corps was an organization of the Dalnan government. The Dalnan Honesty Weft was a member of the corps.
The security corps was an organization of the Dalnan government charged with security.
The emergency corps was an organization of the Dalnan government charged with responding to emergency situations.

A humanoid sentient species that could be found on the planet Sarumo during the High Republic Era. This species could be tan or pink in coloration, and though they were naturally bald, they could still develop facial hair.
The Western sea was a sea located on the planet Abrion Major. The sea was home to a Confederacy of Independent Systems weapons factory, situated on the central island of an archipelago.
Crocodinas were a type of crocodile-like creature with scaley heads that included a pair of eyes and a long, thin snout with a toothy maw.

A settlement was located on the planet Banchii in the Outer Rim's Inugg system. A Jedi outpost was located near the settlement. In the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster in 232 BBY, refugees were relocated to the settlement.
Besh Gorgon was an astronomical object located in the Besh Gorgon system in the Maldrood sector of the Mid Rim along the Perlemian Trade Route. It was orbited by the space station known as The Wheel.

Valaracs were nomadic birds found on the planet Kijimi. They possessed exceptional vision that allowed them to hunt prey at great distances, while their wing serrations allowed them to fly quietly, making them virtually silent before striking their prey.

R2-Q9 was an astromech droid who served onboard the Death Star II battle station in 4 ABY. The droid regularly made trouble for the stormtrooper TK-423, locking them out of their quarters, running over their feet, and even threatening them with an arc welder.
The city was the major settlement of the planet Ivera X.
The Peacemaker was an Arquitens-class light cruiser that operated for the Galactic Empire at the planet Arieli.

The government on Kwenn maintained a planetary police force during the Republic Era. The pirate Zilastra hoped that the police was paralyzed during the battles on Kwenn against the Jedi Order. The constabulary used police vehicles and maintained a police barracks on Capital Key.
The Coastal Watch was an organization on Kwenn that was responsible for overseeing the coasts of Kwenn's islands.

The government on Kwenn maintained defense forces during the Republic Era. The pirate Zilastra hoped that the defense forces were poisoned and dying aboard the Kwenn Space Station during the battles on Kwenn against the Jedi Order.
The Kwenn Traffic Patrol was a law enforcement agency on Kwenn. The patrol participated battles on Kwenn against the Vile.
Eiram's central council was an advisory council made up of six royal counselors and advised the Queen. The council was active during the Eiram and E'ronoh War.

Operation: Titan was a secret project of the Confederacy of Independent Systems to develop a new type of battle droid that was also considered a superweapon; the megadroid. The megadroid was being constructed on Golatha and was uncovered by Jedi Grand Master Yoda.
During the Imperial Era, the Mining Guild sent agents to patrol and represent its interests in the spice mines on the planet Kessel in order to make sure that it got its cut of the profits.
Trillia was a desert planet and home of the Kuan'Mar species. During the daytime, temperatures reached above 50°.

Curlnow was a location on the Core Worlds planet Hosnian Prime. The manor of the Starros Clan was located on the outskirts of Curlnow near a private spacedock. In 34 ABY, Hosnian Prime was destroyed by the First Order's Starkiller Base superweapon.
The Kuan'Mar were a sentient, lizard-like species native to the desert planet of Trillia.
The Onyx Cinder was a Galactic Republic starship utilized for credit ingot transportation from a Republic mint. At some point, it was stolen by the notorious pirate Tak Rennod.

A small shuttle was used by the communications engineers Amos Tillian and Kam, who were part of Republic Communications Team Oh-Arr-Ee-Three-Six-One. In 382 BBY, they found the damaged EX droid EX-8C, and examined it aboard the shuttle.
K-A0S was an Imperial KX-series security droid who competed as a Hunter in Hunters of the Outer Rim on the planet Vespaara in 9 ABY.
A clan of Elia-An lived on the planet Oanne by 228 BBY.

A large city that had processing plants and neighborhoods was located on the planet Ronaphaven during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, Jedi Knights Bell Zettifar and Burryaga Agaburry traveled to Ronaphaven seeking evidence of the life-draining blight affliction.

SM-33, nicknamed "Thirty-Three," was a droid pirate who served as First Mate of the starship Onyx Cinder. At some point the Onyx Cinder became buried in a forest on At Attin and by the early New Republic Era.

Ah Re Won was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Republic Era, between around 40 BBY and 32 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Sidious sent his Sith apprentice Darth Maul to meditate in stillness and quiet in the Sith temple on Ah Re Won.

A coven of the Presagers of Hakotei was led by a priestess, an insectoid alien dark sider. By around 82 BBY, the Presagers were believed to be extinct, though the coven, in hiding on the planet Asusto, was the last one to survive.

Safe House One was a cave used as a safe house by the Scarabi mercenary group. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Alliance to Restore the Republic investigated the safe house, trying to locate rebel leader Mon Mothma, who had been kidnapped and held for ransom by the Scarabi.
The Imperial headquarters on the planet Ivera X was looted by the resident Iverians after the Galactic Empire's rule there ended.
The rare watervine peach was cultivated in a small region of its homeworld. Years prior to 3 ABY, an Imperial officer ordered that all available watervine peaches be redirected to him.
A region was located on the homeworld of the watervine peach. The region was known for producing the watervine peach which grew only in that region of the galaxy.
The Ministry for Antiquity, also known as the Ministry of Antiquities, as a ministry of the Galactic Empire that was active during the Imperial Era.
Anteaters were a type of creature with snouts similar to those of the skura, creatures with long, pink snouts that they used for foraging.

R5-Z0MB was an R5 series astromech droid whose appearance was akin to a droid zombie, and could be found wandering the swamps of Corvax Fen on Mustafar. The droid was various shades of green and pink and possessed a melted head with an exposed interior.

By 232 BBY, during the High Republic Era, Jedi Padawan Orla Jareni of the Jedi Order traveled on a mission to a world known for its sculpture, which Jareni noted was 'beautifully realistic.' During the mission, the Padawan saw statues crafted from a native stone that appeared …
A private spacedock was located on the Core Worlds planet Hosnian Prime. It was located near the manor of the Starros Clan, which was on the outskirts of the location Curlnow.
N-4M was an analyst droid who worked for the Rebel Alliance.

The Pit Hangar, also knows as the Podracer Hangars, was a hangar located in the Mos Espa Grand Arena. It was situated next to the Pinnacle, not far from the race track. The distinctive engine bay struts are typical of the famous podrace hangars on Malastare.

The Royal Box was the most opulent viewing box of the Mos Espa Grand Arena. It was reserved for the ruling Hutts, especially for Jabba the Hutt, the grandmaster host of the Boonta Eve Classic. On the backside of the box, darkened windows concealed secret deal-making rooms.

The Viewing Towers of the Mos Espa Grand Arena were towers used to watch podracing events, like the Boonta Eve Classic. Family and friends of some privileged racers watched the race from these towers.

The Commentary box of the Mos Espa Grand Arena was a small area of the grandstands that was used by commentators to comment on podracing events, like the Boonta Eve Classic. The Commentary box featured a data array.

The grandstands also referred to as the grandstand and stands were the main complex of the Mos Espa Grand Arena. They were cradled within a natural canyon amphitheater and consisted of many overcrowded seats. The grandstand could hold more than 100,000 spectators.

Gerrigon was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Gerrigon system in the Masla sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was once a hub of culture and commerce. During the Republic Era, a civil war broke out on Gerrigon.
R5 was an astromech droid and a member of the Rebel Alliance. R5 was the partner of Karie Neth during the battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
Arfive was a droid and a member of the Rebel Alliance who served on the flagship Home One during the battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
Seezee was a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid and the secretary droid of chronical Dora Mar in 4 ABY.
Fennesa was an astronomical object in the Inner Rim.
Endoviara Seven was an astronomical object in the Endoviara system in the Dantus sector of the Outer Rim Territories, near the border of the Rim and Wild Space.

A droid assisted the former handmaiden Sabé during the Imperial Era. The droid accompanied Sabé to collect the thief Warba Calip from Sergia and then to Caranthanax B, where the former handmaiden intended to test whether the Jedi Luke Skywalker had a dark side.

Servo or SR-V0 was a Gonk droid who accompanied the nerf herder Sig Greebling. Servo was upgraded by Sig as a challenge from Jedi Master Bobarian Afol to test Sig's Force Builder abilities. He was given the ability to speak not only Gonkian but also Basic due to this upgrade.
An asteroid was situated within an asteroid field in the Nihil marauders' Occlusion Zone territory. It held a Nihil base that Baron Boolan utilized as a base for his experiments.
Astenban was a moon in the Outer Rim Seswenna sector that was near the planet Eriadu, as well as near the main hyperspace route of the Outer Rim Inugg system planet Banchii.

The karafankata was a creature of the Outer Rim planet Ah Re Won. Carnivorous creatures, karafankata fiercely protected their young. Between around 40 BBY and 32 BBY, a karafankata lived on Ah Re Won with several babies.

Attacks were made on the planet Ivera X during the Imperial Era after Galactic Empire propaganda and recruitment posters on the planet Ivera X saw repeated vandalism, which led to Imperial officials ordering the destruction of its cities.

The Arena Citadel was part of the Mos Espa Grand Arena on Tatooine. It hosted betting floors with giant screens which were used to follow races. These live channels were Hutt-owned and the gambling was controlled by Jabba the Hutt.

The Rathtar's Revenge was a massive starship used as the flagship of the pirate group Ganguls. The starship took part during the Battle of Tenoo where it attempted to destroy the Tenoo Jedi Temple with cables.

Mynos III, or Mynos Three, was an agricultural planet in the Dalchon sector of the Outer Rim Territories, under the protectorate of the Pacithhip of Shimia. The planet was red in color, possessing two planetary rings that crossed at the equatorial lines.

The Lucky Tortle, formerly known as the Sarlacc's Scorn, was a refitted Viperi-class cargo shuttle utilized by Dahara the Hutt. The shuttle was equipped with a Class One hyperdrive, shield technology, and four laser cannons, including one that rotated.
T8-3R was a BB-series astromech droid that resided on The Island of a planet after being stranded there. The droid was one of the many inhabitants known as Castaways who called the island home.

The Brendok four was a team consisting of four Jedi: Masters Kelnacca, Sol, Indara, and her Padawan Torbin. They were stationed on Brendok in 148 BBY, about a century after the Emergences which had seemingly left the planet lifeless.
Variax was a rocky planet in the Variax system in the Aldino sector of the Mid Rim Territories that hosted a shipyard during the High Republic Era.

Variax security was an organization that controlled a shipyard on the planet Variax. When the Ganguls attempted to steal starships from the shipyard, a number of starfighters converged on their flagship, with an officer commanding the vessel to leave.

The zaba wolf was a type of legendary wolf on the world Andraven. The Andraven inhabitants once befriended the zaba wolves with kao reed flutes, also using them as mounts. By 232 BBY, however, none of the wolves had been spotted for a number of years.

The blue aklyrr, commonly known as the aklyrr, was a rare creature found in the forests of the planet Tenoo. They were quadripedal creatures, featuring antlers and four eyes. Aklyrrs made dens on the ground, but were adept at climbing and were fast.

An H-type Nubian yacht was utilized by the former handmaiden Sabé during the Imperial Era. Accompanied by a droid, she took the H-type Nubian yacht to Sergia to collect the grifter Warba Calip before traveling to Caranthanax B in order to meet the Jedi Luke Skywalker and test …
Bay Eighteen was a hangar bay located on the modified MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser, the Home One, the flagship of the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Bestoonian were a sentient species. One Bestoonian was the Sith assassin Ochi, who hailed from the planet Bestoon.

During the Imperial Era, an uninhabited planet existed within the Outer Rim Territories. While the Rebel Alliance was stationed on the planet to repair an Imperial fortress for their own purposes, the Sith Lord Darth Vader managed to thwart their efforts and use the fortress o…

The Skilla were a sentient species. Their vital organs, including photosensitive orbs for sight, vibrating cilia for hearing, and smell receptors, lined an uvula-like bulb suspended from the roof of their mouth, behind rows of sharp teeth.

The Frejukes were a sentient species that possessed heat-retaining blubber. Wolentic Dudge, a resident of Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi, was a Frejuke whose blubber made him a good fit for the world's snowy climate.

Myykians were a species of elephantine humanoids that lived in the galaxy. The species possessed blue skin and was elephantine in appearance, including a long trunk-like nose and two eyes. They could also possess a head of hair.

The yard was a location found on the Nihil prison ship Korvix Vorn. During the High Republic Era, numerous prisoners were ordered by the Nihil pirates to appear in the yard for "The Warden," an alien who commanded to ship.

Level 3 was a location that was located on the Nihil prison ship Korvix Vorn. After a raid occurred on the ship, a Nihil pirate mentioned to The Warden that the shields to the Korvix Vorn had been breached.

During the High Republic Era, the Nihil alien, The Warden, had quarters located on the Nihil prison ship Korvix Vorn. After yelling at the human Driggit Parse to head towards the Stormwall, the Warden mentioned how he would be in his quarters.

A service droid served the Jedi Order while stationed at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. During the High Republic Era, the service droid attempted to assist the human Avon Sunvale after the terminal she was at was malfunctioning due to her own actions.
A bedroom for the human Avon Starros was located at the Nihil main base on the planet Hetzal Prime in the Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era.

The Hall of the Eye was a location that was found in the Nihil main base on the planet Hetzal Prime in the Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era. The room consisted of a dais in the center of the space with seating that accumulated in a half circle.
An astronomical object was located in the Prandril system and was collided with at some point to form an asteroid field in the system.

The Quintad, also known as the Eriadu High Council, the High Council, or as the Ruling Council, was a council made up of the five ruling families of the planet Eriadu, with one being the Tarkin family. The Quintad met within the Seswenna Hall in Eriadu City.

Zahra's raider crew was a group of raiders who operated during the Imperial Era. After being left for dead by Princess Leia Organa on Panisia, former Imperial Commander Ellian Zahra found the raiders and joined their ranks as their new leader, providing her tactical expertise …
In 228 BBY, a mission to Banchii occurred on the planet Banchii between Nihil pirates led by the scientist Niv Drendow Apruk and the Jedi Order, the native Banchiians, and the Drengir.

An IG-100 MagnaGuard was a member of a raider crew during the Imperial Era. After the former Galactic Empire commander Ellian Zahra joined the raiders, the IG-100 MagnaGuard served her aboard a Raider-class corvette in her quest to capture Princess Leia Organa.

A Raider-class corvette was utilized by a group of raiders during the Imperial Era. After the former Galactic Empire commander Ellian Zahra joined the raiders, she commanded the Raider-class corvette, with an IG-100 MagnaGuard operating aboard it.

A fire gnat was a type of gnat. In 33 BBY, when Jedi Master Depa Billaba threatened the pirate Zilastra after having been imprisoned by her in brutal conditions, Zilastra was unconvinced, assessing that Billaba could not even swat a fire gnat in her state.

A medical droid was on the Voyager Dawn between 12 BBY and 9 BBY. The medical droid was of the 2-1B surgical droid model and was taking care of its master, Jedi Elan Rast. As the droid examined the Jedi, they were attacked by the Galactic Empire and The Grand Inquisitor.
The Andraven Ancestors Circuit was an event on the planet Andraven where Andraven kids completed challenges to honor their ancestors who settled the world.

Ena was a planet home to the Enami sentient species. During the High Republic Era, the planet was situated within Galactic Republic space.

NX-88 was a droid member of the Ganguls pirate gang during the High Republic Era. NX acted as the pilot for the Ganguls' flagship, the Rathtar's Revenge, during the gang's raid on Deppani for starships following a storm.
During the Republic Era, Galactic Republic and Jedi Order forces attacked the headquarters of the Riftwalkers pirate gang on the planet Valboraan.

The Republic Ministry of Energy was a ministry of the Galactic Republic that Galen Walton Erso had an internship with prior to joining the Humbarine Academy of Advanced Studies.

A probe droid of the Viper probe droid model was a member of the Galactic Empire. Between 14 BBY and 9 BBY, the probe droid undertook a mission to the astronomical object Gerrigon with the Fifth Brother inquisitor.

The mission on Dallenor was a mission undertaken by Jedi Master Mace Windu of the Jedi Order to the Mid Rim planet Dallenor at some point by 33 BBY. During the mission, Windu utilized smoke bombs.
The assassinations of the pirate leaders was a plot by Zilastra, leader of the Riftwalkers pirate gang, to kill the leaders of the other gangs in the Slice, in 33 BBY.

The Poldon Bain was a cruiser of the Republic Defense Coalition that was active during the High Republic Era. The ship called for help to the Dreadful Day after the ship's navigation systems were fried.

The Fearless Rain was a starship owned by the Nihil during the High Republic Era. After the Brightbird exited out of hyperspace, the Fearless Rain contacted them and told the pilot, Cair San Tekka, to leave immediately.

The Jumurra were a sentient species with tan skin, pointed ears, and brown eyes. They also possessed jowls. During the High Republic Era, the elder Naasa, a member of the species, was in the Brendok coven.
Keldooine's largest city was a megalopolis situated on the planet Keldooine. In 33 BBY, Jedi Master Depa Billaba went undercover in the city in order to investigate piracy within the Slice.

The Shipping District was a city district of Keldooine's largest city on the planet Keldooine. The East Spaceport, which contained a hub facility of the Regal Voyager passenger line, was located in the district.
The Mirogana Market was located in the city Mirogana on the moon Toshara.
Sashin was a village in the Karaba Foothills on Akiva, a jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During 3 ABY, the wives Shirene and Esmelle lived in the village.

Kadùa Village, simply known as Kadùa, was a wind fishing settlement in the Mirogana Valley on the moon Toshara near the Mirogana Gate. In 3 ABY, the settlement was made up of several buildings surrounding a center Robuma pen.
The varaki were predatory creatures native to the moon Toshara. They generally fed off smaller animals, also posing a threat to grazing robuma.

Robumas were herbivorous mammals native to the moon Toshara where they roamed the savannas. Herd animals by instinct, they were domesticated by the first arrivals to the moon and became essential to Tosharan culture, with the creatures' milk, leather, and meat all commonly use…
Ronga bugs were small insects of the moon Toshara. They possessed light-emitting organs that they used to locate one another in darkness.

Yubesho rats were a type of rat found on the moon Toshara. Living mostly underground, the rats were mostly blind, but had a heightened sense of smell that could lead them to food at impressive distances, and they were known to chew through wood and even metal to get to it.

Gushiro were small mammals native to the moon Toshara. Possessing densely-furred, slender bodies, they hunted small rodents and insects like the apono moths in the moon's shrublands, which were their primary habitat.

Kama birds were a type of large predatory bird native to the savannas of the moon Toshara. The birds' preferred prey was robuma calves, and they circled around herds of the creatures for some time before striking.

Apono moths, or simply aponos, were a type of moth native to the moon Toshara. Due to the world's strong winds, the insects developed strong winds that allowed them to stay airborne, although their fat bodies and tendency to stay at low altitudes made them a primary target as …

Slygels were a type of soft-bodied invertebrate that resided in the orbit of the moon Toshara. They possessed gelatinous skin and fed on energy, such as that from starships and the energy cells of satellites.

The Castellan was a cruiser operational during the High Republic Era. After falling under attack by a fleet of Nihil starships, the Castellan made an emergency jump to hyperspace, crashing on the moon Toshara.
Palagosal was a planet located in the Arkanis sector. After signs of the blight were found on the planet, the Galactic Republic ordered an evacuation of any individuals on the planet.
The Ralltiir Occupation, also known as the occupation of Ralltiir, took place in 1 BBY when the Galactic Empire occupied the world Ralltiir and kept a presence there for an extended period.

Ascaal district was a region of the moon Toshara that included the Ascada River. In 3 ABY, unusually high rainfall occurred during a hurricane, causing authorities to predict flooding in the district a week later.

The Ascada River was a river located in the Ascaal district of the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, there was unusually high rainfall during a hurricane and, a week later, this led authorities to predict flooding in the district.
Sector 14-D was an area of the city of Mirogana on the moon Toshara. A toxic mainline rupture in the city sector led to its closure to the public while toxicity remediation took place.

Helikoprion was a waterworld in the Helikoprion system in the Nilgaard sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was home to the Heliko species. After the planet was engulfed in a civil war, the Delik family, who resided on Helikoprion, moved off-world.

The wreckage of a Venator-class Star Destroyer was present in the Zavian Abyss the New Republic's Vanguard Squadron came across the wreckage of a Venator-class, while escorting three GR-75 medium transports, before coming into contact with the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer …

MT-7 was a BX-series droid commando who briefly participated in the Clone Wars as a soldier of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. His first mission sent him to the planet Akiva, but a rainstorm soon separated him from the rest of his unit.

The Canyon of Akar, was a winding serpentine valley on the jungle planet Akiva. It stretched below Mount Selasa from a cliff known as the Witch's Finger in the Great Basin region towards the Karaba Foothills.

The Peka river was a river near the Peka community on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. Many of Peka's inhabitants worked as fishermen and farmers, some of whom would offer to take off-worlders on fishing excursions where they could catch fish and cook their own lunch on the banks o…

Glowflies were a type of fly that buzzed and flickered. Between 229 BBY and 228 BBY, the former Nihil pirate Krix Kamerat returned to a room in an abandoned apartment building where he and the former Jedi Padawan Ruu were interrogating the Nihil Haakon Pav.

The kyumo rabbit was a species of mammal native to the planet Kijimi. It had white fur, yellow eyes, a long nose, and large feet. To avoid predators, the rabbit would run or dig into the snow to hide. The kyumo rabbit's sensitive ears were excellent at detecting a threat.

Tarnoonga was a terrestrial astronomical object where the Hutt Cedraa, the cousin of the Hutt male Churo, had a palace during the High Republic Era.

A pink moon orbited the planet Eroudac, which was located in the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice regions. While growing up at the Jedi temple on Eroudac during the High Republic Era, Jedi youngling Jamil Sollis was able to see the moon from his dormitory.

Henku were a type of large, warm-blooded mammal that were believed to share common ancestry with the banthas of the desert planet Tatooine. Like banthas, they were domesticated for their milk, meat, and leather and also possessed curled brown horns.

B1 Unit 275 was a B1-series battle droid that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems on the planet Akiva, where a droid factory produced units for the Separatist cause until an attack by the Galactic Republic. 275 was destroyed, and their remains were left in the factory.

B1 Unit 699 was a B1-series battle droid active during the Clone Wars on the planet Akiva, where they were destroyed. In 3 ABY, glitching BX-series droid commando ND-5 saw memory issues and called for B1 unit 699 to respond as he passed his remains.
B1 Unit 888 was a B1-series battle droid that served on the planet Akiva, the site of a droid factory and battle during the Clone Wars. 888 was destroyed on Akiva.
Sneaky Hollow was an clearing in the Karaba Foothills on Akiva, a jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Magadua plain was an area of the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, a cyclone passed over the plain while avoiding most major settlements.
A pub on Cato Neimoidia was the location of a meeting between the Neimoidian Royal Guard Ruug Quarnom and Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi during the investigation of the Cadesura disaster in 22 BBY.

Zeekay was a droid that belonged to the child Yesula and her father. At some point no earlier than 227 BBY, Yesula and her father were rescued by Jedi Master Kelnacca and his Padawan, Yarzion Vell, after their home on the astronomical object Veek caught on fire.

A terrestrial planet was the homeworld of the Jedi Yarzion Vell, a member of a humanoid species. By 230 BBY, when Vell was a Padawan, he returned to his home planet on a mission and had himself tattooed with the name of his Jedi Master, Lulad, in accordance with the planet's t…
Veek was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Outer Rim. During the High Republic Era, it was inhabited by members of a sentient species, including the child Yesula and her father.

The child Yesula and her father were members of a sentient species. At some point no earlier than 227 BBY, multiple members of the species were present on the astronomical object Veek when the home of Yesula and her father caught fire.

The Heliko were a sharklike sentient species from the aquatic planet Helikoprion. They were distantly related to the Karkarodon species, with whom they came into conflict with by the High Republic Era.
The Redemption was a diplomatic yacht owned by the Greylark family and utilized by Rina Greylark, senator of the Galactic Republic, during the High Republic Era.
The Endless Lake Village was a village on the Forest Moon of Endor. It was attacked and sunk into the Endless Lake by Orcon, King of the Underwater Kingdom.
Devil serpents were a type of creature found on the Forest Moon of Endor.

Salini serpents were large aquatic reptilian creatures native to the planet Palagosal. They possessed a beaked mouth, long dorsal fins, and short vestigial hind legs, and could grow up to the length of a Galactic Republic Longbeam cruiser.
A Nihil crew was stationed on the planet Daedus during the High Republic Era.
A Nihil patrol was stationed on the planet Daedus as a part of a crew.

Dust rats also known as a Tatoo-rat were a type of rodent that lived on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine. They had brown or white fur and black or brown eyes as well as a long tail around the same length as their body.
Jabarek lizards, also known simply as jabareks, were a type of lizard found all across the planet Akiva, where they prefered to live beside lakes or other large bodies of water.

Nobaki rats, also known as just nobaki, were a type of small rat-like species that lived on the icy planet Kijimi in 3 ABY. They had blue fur and were considered both to be pests and were kept as pets by that year.

Shaparaks were a type of robust, green insect found on the tropical planet Akiva. Intelligent and docile, they emitted pacifying waves with their wings to subdue potential threats, although the expressive patterns on their wings were also used to scare off predators.

Sommato birds were a type of bird found on the tropical planet Akiva, where they lived near large bodies of freshwater. Their scaly skin was gray on their back, head, and wings while the birds' underside was yellow and their feathers red.

Venga were a type of amphibian found on the tropical planet Akiva. Opportunistic predators, venga were mainly found in the wetlands but would migrate to other areas in search of food, especially during Akiva's rainy seasons.
The Tharben Jedi outpost was a outpost used by the Jedi Order during the Republic Era on the planet Tharben.

In 229 BBY, Jedi Master Kelnacca of the Jedi Order and his Padawan, Yarzion Vell, fought members of the Nihil pirates on the Lol sector astronomical object Vianax in the Nihil-controlled Occlusion Zone as part of the Order's conflict with the marauders.

Vianax was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Lol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 229 BBY, when Vianax was part of the Nihil pirates' Occlusion Zone region of space, Jedi Master Kelnacca and his Padawan, Yarzion Vell, fought members of the Nihil there.

Rebel elite commandos were specialized commandos of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Rebel elite commandos could be organized into platoon-sized groups and were comparable in quality to Imperial Dark Troopers. They were more elite than SpecForce troopers and Marines.
X2-X0 was an astromech droid in service of the Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Boltiga VII was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Boltiga system of the Colonies and the Interior. It fell within grid square M-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid and served as a mining colony during the Imperial Era.
The Ukio Bread Incident was an event involving a rebel spy that occurred by 3 ABY in the vicinity of of the Ukio system, and shared its name with the agrarian planet Ukio.

Niraya was a planet in the Inner Rim that was inhabited centuries before the Imperial Era, featuring a number of cities. The former Jedi Knight Azlin Rell hid the weapon known as the Grim Rose in a city on Niraya.

Lower Mirogana was an area of the multi-level city Mirogana on the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, a fire occurred in Lower Mirogana's central market that destroyed a number of merchant stalls.

The central plain was located on the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, conditions across the plain remained stable despite persistently strong and steady winds occurring over several days.

A swoop gang of bandits operated on the Outer Rim planet Rishi during the reign of the Galactic Empire and wrought havoc on the world using swoops. Following a long campaign against the gang's operations, the Empire's forces neutralized the group in 3 ABY.
The Imperial Galactic Bank, also known as Imperial Bank, was a bank associated with the Galactic Empire during its reign.

Verinti was an astronomical object in the Verinti system of the Outer Rim's Vorzyd sector and fell within grid square R-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was where citizen Mav Gatta lived in a homestead.
When Dev and Sig Greebling uncovered The Cornerstone of the Galaxy, a powerful artifact, from a hidden Jedi temple on Fennesa, the galaxy became mixed up.

A weapons smuggling ring was active in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The smugglers stole disruptor rifles and reconfigured them before providing the weapons to several criminal syndicates in the sector.

Rajatha Ridge was a ridge on the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, a mild tornado warning was issued for the area and reported on Holonet News Toshara by wind report host Botto Fna, who advised listeners with high sensitivity to wind to remain indoors.

Mirogana Gate also known as The Gate was a narrow canyon on the moon Toshara. The gate shared its named with the city of Mirogana and the Mirogana Valley, in which the city and the canyon were located.

Orbital Security was a security organization that performed cargo checks on citizens of the moon Toshara in the Toshaal system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Kyaa was a jungle planet located in the galaxy.
Sleeth was an icy planet where the Rebel Beta Base was located.
Olcull was a terrestrial planet located in the galaxy.
The Windliner was a Sienar-Chall Utilipede Transport used by a Sullustan engineer to transport cargo during the Imperial Era.
A DUM-series pit droid was nicknamed "Drip" by Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker.
During the Republic Era, a battle droid previously owned by the Trade Federation operated on the moon Black Rock.

VX-2411, nicknamed "Ringer" by the youngling Anakin Skywalker, was a droid that functioned as a podracer during the Republic Era. The droid previously served as a conductor unit for trains on the planet Vandor before being modified to work on a podracer.
Toshaal was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim, orbited by the moon Toshara.
Karalle was a swamp planet located in the Outer Rim's Albanin sector. The force-sensitive Quermian Jarea Kaela once hid on Karalle to hide from bounty hunters and the Inquisitorius.

9-EZ was an A-LT Utility Droid who operated on the moon Jedha. In 1 BBY, 9-EZ was rolling through a street in Jedha City, when a passsing Imperial TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank transporting kyber crystals was attacked by Partisan fighters.
Kroop birds were bipedal avian creatures indigenous to the planet Omaka. The birds lived in flocks, building tubular nests into the sides of mountainous paths.
Oppa was a terrestrial planet located in the galaxy. In 3 ABY, while delivering Han Solo to Jabba the Hutt, Boba Fett stopped on the planet to refuel.
Craysol was a rocky planet with constant lightning storms where a hideout of Clan Colbra was located.

Clan Colbra was a criminal organization based on Craysol and active during the reign of the Empire. It was led by Razze Colbra. In 3 ABY the group kidnapped Max Rebo and stole Han Solo from the bounty hunter Boba Fett.

A subterranean species was native to the planet Ridlay. The species, referred to as "ghosts" by the local inhabitants, lived underground; only journeying to the planet's surface every fifty years during the total eclipse.
The Stingray was a ship manufactured by the Urukabb Slipways that was owned by the family of the Heliko female Haze Delik. Delik used the ship when she was a part of the Nihil pirates.

In 3 BBY, the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire subjected the planet Bosph to repeated large-scale orbital bombardment, causing effectively irreparable damage and attempting genocide on the species that inhabited the world.

The job on Alzoc III was an incident where the mercenary Xi'an and bounty hunter Din Djarin, both members of a crew alongside the criminal Ranzar Malk and Xi'an's brother Qin, traveled to the Outer Rim planet Alzoc III for a job. The job saw Djarin dive into his darker instincts.
Freighter G-55-A was a freighter that was docked in Mirogana Spaceport in the city Mirogana on the Outer Rim Territories moon Toshara in 3 ABY.
Mirogana Spaceport was a spaceport located in the Mirogana city on the Outer Rim Territories moon Toshara.

Cryopedes were a type of creature found in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. In 3 ABY, cryopedes got into the office of Wen Delphis, crime lord of the Sixth Kin gang, in Club Tarsus through the building's vents.

The Glass Abyss was the derisive name of the underground caverns on the planet Metagos that contained its capital city of New Xaxxis. The caverns contained large crystal obelisks, both standing on the ground or hanging from the ceiling, which were the source of the name.
Picadir was a swamp planet located in the Mayagil sector within the Outer Rim Territories.

Reath's lab was a laboratory located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, utilized by the Jedi Knight Reath Silas during the High Republic Era while researching the Nameless creatures and the blight affliction.

A medical droid served the Jedi Order in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during the High Republic Era. The medical droid treated Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh after she sustained injuries during a confrontation with Nihil leader Marchion Ro during a mission on the planet Vixoseph I.

The Excavator was a Venture-class cruiser used by the former Jedi Master Cohmac Vitus during the High Republic Era. Vitus utilized the cruiser during his search for the Tolemite civilization.

The Invictus was a Pacifier-class transport ship utilized by the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era.
Tolis was a planet in Wild Space home to the Tolemites, a species who worshiped the Peace and lived around twenty thousand years before the High Republic Era.

The Miyuki Trade League was a merchant and smuggling syndicate that was formed during the Republic Era when groups of smugglers came together to protect shared interests. As the league grew it began employing merchants which offered equipment on a number of worlds.

Ahsoka Tano's quarters were the living quarters used by Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano. Located inside the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, Tano's quarters were a small and simple space where Tano would meditate.

Angoth was a small planet that featured woods and a ring of scattered asteroids. During the High Republic Era, a settlement existed on Angoth, and the Nihil marauders also established a base in a former detention center for smugglers.

Ripurni was a lifeless planet located near the edges of the Anoat sector. Eventual Imperial Grand Moff Ubrik Adelhard was born on this planet. At some point during the Imperial Era, Ripurni was used as a mining planet.

The Metagosan were a reptilian sentient species. Possessing dense musculature, they were similar to the Trandoshans. The species had a typical sibilant hiss when speaking.
New Xaxxis was the capital city of the planet Metagos. Located in the underground caverns known as the Glass Abyss, the city was shaped like a wagon wheel and housed nearly a million New Xaxxans.
The Zilka were a sentient buglike species. They possessed four legs and were armored. Two Zilka enforcers encountered the undercover Jedi Master Mace Windu on the planet Metagos.
A Hutta snake was a common type of snake that partially shared its name with the planet Nal Hutta. The Hutt Churo studied the skin-shedding habits of Hutta snakes.

Grozz's hometown was a town on the planet Kashyyyk. By 9 ABY, the town had nearly been converted into a shrine for the Wookiee Hunter Grozz, honoring his exploits as a professional Huttballer and even housing a museum to the then-Hunters of the Outer Rim entertainer.

The Storming of Abartolom was a conflict that took place on Abartolom during the Imperial Era. As part of the engagement, the Galactic Empire deployed TK stormtroopers from at least one V-82 dropship.

The Moraysi rebellion was a conflict that took place during the Imperial Era some time after the Storming of Abartolom and prior to the Battle of Atollon. As part of the rebellion, the Galactic Empire deployed at least forty-two TIE fighters and attacked a starship.

Thrumfrogs were a type of frog that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Eriadu during the High Republic Era.
Qi Dail was a world located in the galaxy that had unusual rock formations.

The Wookiee sanctuary was a Wookiee village deep in the forests of the planet Kashyyyk. Yanna was the elder and leader of the sanctuary. At some point between 19 BBY and 18 BBY, Clone Force 99 rescued the Wookiee Jedi Padawan Gungi, and brought him to the safety of the village.

The Imperial Veterans Association was a veteran's affairs organization dedicated to veterans of the Imperial Military, a force composed of seemingly countless beings who served the Galactic Empire, which reigned from 19 BBY to 4 ABY before falling in 5 ABY.
Petris Major was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories that had at least one city. During the High Republic Era, Jedi Tar'ak Borran lived on Petris Major, who had an Echo Stone.
Zondula was a world located in the galaxy. During the Great Jedi Purge, the 501st Legion was sent to eliminate five Jedi who were stationed at a temple on Zondula.

The Great Wheel, or level four, was a level of the city New Xaxxis on the planet Metagos. It was circular in shape, with concentric rings and spokes that radiated from the center.
The Syblins was the name given to individuals of the species of Queen Sybil, an insectoid being who resided on the planet Metagos and whose species' name was unknown.

The Queen's Road was an section of Kijimi City which led from Kijimiko Square to the Monk's Gate on the planet Kijimi. During 3 ABY, the area around the road by the Monk's Gate was part of the Ashiga Clan District.

The Ridge Terrace was an grouping of housing that over looked a ridge on the edge of the Thermal District of Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi. During 3 ABY, the Quarren merchant, Shuma would land her ship there and sell her wares.

Vermingilua was a classification of avian that the small and tubby skura species belonged to. Standing 0.15 meters tall and eating stone fleas and formants in the sea caves of the planet Bal'demnic in the Outer Rim, the skura had long snouts and slabbed-shaped heads.

Iliabath was an astronomical object located in the Iliabath system within the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square R-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The South Depot was a location on the planet Ghorman. During the construction of the Galactic Empire's Palmo armory around 3 BBY, the Ghorman Front learned that nightly cargo-carrier shipments for the building of the armory originated from the South Depot.
The Jedha Working Group was an organization within the Galactic Empire that produced classified data pertaining to the construction of the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station and the Mid Rim moon Jedha.

New Alvaros was the capital city of the planet Barajin during the Imperial Era. Between 19 BBY and 4 ABY, when the human female Rynn Zenat—a native of Barajin—was at a very young age, her parents were killed by the Galactic Empire during a raid carried out by the Spice Runners…
Senator Greylark's office was the office of Galactic Republic Senator Zenny Greylark during the High Republic Era. It was located on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.
ISB plaza was a plaza that existed in front of the Imperial Security Bureau Central Office on Coruscant.

The meknek Fillik owned a PIP droid during the High Republic Era. Manufactured by Pui-ui Implement Products, it was eighteen centimeters (seven inches) tall, had black and orange plating, and was equipped with an internal carousel that included custom tools.

The Hidden Mounds was a rock formation on the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, an advertisement featuring a picture of the mounds along with the phrase "The Hidden Mounds, visit now" written in Aurebesh was displayed at the capital city Mirogana.
Carburo was an Expansion Region celestial body located in grid square K-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Khepi, located in Wild Space, was a planet and the homeworld of the Khepi who existed since the formation of formation of the Galactic Republic and remained independent of it through out most of its existence.

The Poor Crow was a light freighter owned by the pilot Ekiya. It was a long, sharp-nosed ship that had extensible, scarred wings and stenciled writing on its side naming it "the poor crow." On the inside, the Crow was neat and well maintained, though it appeared assembled out …
Vel's home was the home of Vel Sartha on the moon Yavin 4.
A scout ship was stolen by the Sith Kouru to pursue the former Sith known as the Ronin.

Uedar was the only moon of the planet Ueda, which was part of the Ueda system in the unincorporated Bosphian provinces of the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories in square Q-3 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Quaraxian was a sentient species that aged very slowly and possessed significant intellectual prowess. By the time of the Republic Era, the species were virtually extinct, with the exception of individuals such as the Quaraxian female criminal Phaedra.
The Khepi Tomb, also known as the Great Tomb, was a necropolis built into an asteroid hidden in the Sayma Nebula located in Wild Space.

Arjee-Entoo was a gold plated droid that worked for Phaedra between the years 40 BBY and 34 BBY. The droid was destroyed after being shot down in Phaedra's shuttle by the bounty hunter Zam Wesell in the Y'Toub system.

The lodging and hospitality quarter was an area of Point Ueda, the planet Ueda's capital city. The city once housed the administrative offices of a lucrative logging operation based on the valuable Ueda conifer and was home to the operation's mill workers.

The Old Loggers' Hill cemetery was a cemetery located in Point Ueda, the capital city of the planet Ueda. The city was built on the slope of a hill on one of Ueda's archipelagos and the cemetery was located around half way up outside the built up areas.
Sil Gohtta was an Outer Rim Territories and Trailing Sectors celestial body located in grid square Q-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Two-Headed Toothvole was a creature from Bogmadada with two heads each with a set of eyes. At least twenty cycles before 3 ABY, the pirate captain Hondo Ohnaka claimed to have killed the fearsome Two-Headed Toothvole of Bogmadada by shooting it between both sets of eyes in…
The destruction of the Wild Space planet Khepi occurred during the High Republic Era when an asteroid impacted the planet causing it to break apart.
Qorvino's island hideout was an island on Lake Amari in the Great Basin region of the jungle planet Akiva.
Qorvino's cave hideout also known as the Crash Site was a cave located on the jungle planet Akiva that was used by the pirate Qorvino to raid the Imperial supply lanes along the Hydian Way.

Bororn was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Bororn system in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories, located in grid square N-20 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the site of the location known as the Mudfields of Bororn.

The trade commission of the planet Ueda was housed in an orbital station above the world in the Outer Rim's Ueda system during the High Republic Era. The haulcraft pilot Trowee Astur shuttled passengers and cargo from the space station.

A nori-inkal was a rare coral-like creature from Boothi IV, a location in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim. It had four pink appendages with fins and two thinner appendages between them with darker tips.

The Imperial Archaeological Division was a division of the Galactic Empire. By 3 ABY, Doctor Jessik was member of the division who sent a report on their progress towards finding the Great Tomb of the Khepi in the Sayma Nebula from Hauler's Keep in the Khepi system of Wild Space.
A cantina operated on the planet Eiram shortly after the destruction of Starlight Beacon in the year 230 BBY during the High Republic Era.

Pinedrillers were a type of creature that produced wool and could be found in the coastal forests of the archipelagos on the Outer Rim planet Ueda, home of the Ueda conifer pine.
Mehdo's Parlor was a private sabacc parlor operated by a Melitto named Mehdo in 3 ABY out of the backroom of the Domak Refectory, a popular cantina in Kijimi City on the fridge Mid Rim planet Kijimi.

Nagai were a sentient humanoid species hailing from the astronomical object Nagi. They had black hair, two red eyes, and pale white skin, along with pointy ears and unique face markings. The species was shown to be strong-willed and spoke in Galactic Basic Standard.
Disney Parking Planet was a terrestrial planet with a breathable atmosphere, typically used by visitors to the Disney Playground Planet as parking space.
Disney Playground Planet was a leisure destination planet in the galaxy. Visitors typically went to Disney Parking Planet first.

JO9-4MN was a boxy, primitive model of power droid manufactured by Veril Line Systems that was repurposed by the Trade Federation to act as a repair droid and foreman on the WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer Fallon.
BL-R4 was an astromech droid affiliated with the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts. A friend of fellow GSCR member Quinn, he had male programming and a shy personality.

Outer Kavorn was a terrestrial world. By 228 BBY, an infection known as the Blight that drained worlds of life, was found on Outer Kavorn during its spread across the galaxy. Around that year, the Blight's spread was stopped.

Levulia was a terrestrial astronomical object. By 228 BBY, during the High Republic Era, the infection known as the Blight that drained worlds of life was found on Levulia during its spread across the galaxy.
The Bad Hurt Time was the name given by the female charhound Ember to an event that occurred when she was a puppy where a spike-sparrow killed all but one member of her charhound pack.

Songbirds were a type of bird. Around 228 BBY, as a drift of Jedi Vectors flew through the sky above the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, they swooped and dived like a flock of songbirds chiming through the air.

A spike-sparrow was a type of sparrow that could be found on the Outer Rim world Elphrona during the High Republic Era. By 232 BBY, a spike-sparrow killed all but one member of a charhound pack on Elphrona.
A sparrow was a type of bird. Types of sparrow include song sparrows and a spike-sparrow.
The Auberge, formerly known as the Glitterstim Shine, was a war cruiser owned by a spice dealer from Kijimi until it was confiscated by the Nihil after the formation of the Stormwall.
The Majestic Aiwha Clan was a clan of Jedi Initiates in the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. It shared its name with the aiwha, a type of flying amphibian native to the planet Kamino.

Khofeen was the only moon that orbited the planet Khofar, which was located in an intersecting portion of the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories. It was part of the Khofar system in the Lahara sector and lay in grid square M-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
2J-4DPR, also known by landing area staffers as Silvertreads, was an astromech droid manufactured by Lerrimore Automata assigned to repair and assess starships visiting the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

During the Clone Wars, a siege took place on the planet Wrea against a Separatist base. C-B3 cortosis battle droids were deployed to the battle, however because their designs were sabotaged, they were ineffective in combat.

A office in Hauler's Keep was used by Reess Passik while he worked as a contract broker for the Miyuki Trade League in 3 ABY. The office had a viewport that overlooked one of the space station's hangers.
A Yarkora colony on the Outer Rim planet Carlac was settled by members of the Yarkora species by 132 BBY. The colony was located in Carlac's cold blue-sand equatorial deserts.

Godis Ulani's home neighborhood was located in Olega City on the Mid Rim planet Olega. The human Godis Ulani lived in the neighborhood during the High Republic Era, and in 132 BBY, while Ulani was sitting outside the Olega Apothecary, they wore clothing with a tartan pattern t…

The Southern Isles were islands located on the Mid Rim planet Olega. In 132 BBY, the spiritual horticulturalists Thakira Tatara and Kiraya Tatara traveled from the Southern Isles to Olega's capital, Olega City, to sell exotic seeds and sprigs.

An astronomical object located in Wild Space was the homeworld of the Shani species. According to the hyperspace savant Mari San Tekka, it was located beyond the known routes like the Wild Space planet Sophros.

Dendroks were creatures found within the cave walls on the planet Kundu Minor.
The Upper Arts Sector was located on the planet Coruscant, situated three levels above an area near the Duros Blocks.

The Duros Blocks were located on the planet Coruscant.

A city existed on the planet Duro during the later Republic Era. The city was crime ridden. The Duros criminal and bounty hunter Cad Bane grew up as an orphan on the streets of the city together with his friend Niro. The city was governed by a town council and had a police force.

In 232 BBY, explorer droid 0G-LC had an excavation site on the Outer Rim planet Tenoo to unearth the fossil remains of rakas, ancient creatures on Tenoo which climbed trees using their well-adapted claws.

Musso was a terrestrial planet where an imperial base was located.

The Back Alley was an alley in the Wonto District of Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine which led from the Wonto District market to an Old Junkyard. By 3 ABY, an individual had lost a well–made airspeeder toy.
Sulton was a terrestrial planet where an imperial factory was located. After the Liberation of Lothal, the TIE Defender program was moved to Sulton.
Pitsy was one of numerous protocol droids owned by a debtor of Watto in the Federal District of Coruscant.

The Pyke market was an area in the city of Mirogana on the Outer Rim moon Toshara. It was located between the Pyke District and the Market District of Mirogana. A merchant named Hen Puon operated a store out of the market in 3 ABY.

The Maintenance Room is a room in the city of Mirogana on the Outer Rim moon Toshara that could be accessed by a vent. By 3 ABY, a non functional sweeper droid had been stashed in a container with in the room.

Gorak’s suite was a private space used by the Pyke underboss Gorak Palas in the city of Mirogana on the Outer Rim moon Toshara that could be accessed by a turbolift from within Makal's Gambling Parlor.

Q-13 was the personal droid of Jedi Master Skia Ro.
Hemlock's shuttle was a Rho-class transport shuttle that transported Imperial Doctor Royce Hemlock to the Imperial summit on Eriadu during or after 18 BBY.

A raider group attacked a Chorin village at some point prior to 1 BBY. The attack ended with many of the village's inhabitants being killed and buried. After the attack, Beilert Valance returned to the village and was outraged before leaving to attempt finding the raiders.

The Battle of Jabo was an engagement fought at some point by approximately 180 BBY. In the battle, the Twi'lek Jedi Master Skia Ro of the Jedi Order famously defeated the Sith Darth Kozyr, a fact that was known to Ro's apprentice Christina Starspeeder.
Arium Island was a volcanic island located on the tropical planet Eiram. It was known for a secret research facility studying blue scorpions.

Lahtee was a distant snow-covered planet located in the Mid Rim Territories of the galaxy. In 34 ABY, Supreme Leader Kylo Ren traveled to Lahtee with Vaneé to hunt down a Theelin Jedi survivor known as Grandea.

A town was located on the Mid Rim Territories snow-covered planet Lahtee that contained several structures, including an eatery. In 34 ABY, Supreme Leader Kylo Ren confronted a Theelin Jedi survivor known as Grandea on the town.

The Decimator was a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer used by the First Order.
Beltire was a location in the Beltire system of the Mid Rim Territories' Narrant sector.

The Carlac belt was an asteroid field near the planet Carlac in the Carlac system of the Outer Rim Prefsbelt sector. In 132 BBY, the DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship Palwick exited hyperspace in the belt and collided with several asteroids, spinning out of control.

Xivalia was an astronomical object in the Xivalia system in the Bes Ber Bikade sector of the Expansion Region. The Galactic Republic knew the Alvadorjian species as "Xivalians" due to some of them settling there, but their true homeworld was in the Alvadorjia system.

A rebel cell organized on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva by a local named Calys during the reign of the Galactic Empire. As the cell grew, Calys's Twi'lek brother Asara Deyn began helping the cell by spying on Imperial patrols.
Omwat was an astronomical object in the Omwat system in the Garis sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Omwati species.
The Xenoform Interests Caucus was a political grouping within the Imperial Senate during the Imperial Era.
The Nonmonetary Trading Committee was an Imperial Senate committee pertaining to trade during the Imperial Era.
The Millennial Planning Committee was an Imperial Senate committee during the Imperial Era. In 19 BBY, Millennial Planning Committee members attended the COMPNOR-Alpha summit.

Argazda was an astronomical object in the Argazda system in the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Argazda was the farthest edge of the Zygerrian Slave Empire at its height.
Woostri was an astronomical object that was the homeworld of the Woostroid species. Woostri was also the homeworld of the human male mercenary Migs Mayfeld.

Columex was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories along the Perlemian Trade Route and the Salin Corridor.
