Suboreen was a planet located in the galaxy. Around 6 ABY, Beilert Valance met with Han Solo at the planet.

The Palpatine Foundation was a Galactic Empire organization that shared its name with Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine. In 2 BBY, the organization hosted the Third Decennial Imperial Jubilee on the planet Alderaan.

Red was a BDX droid who was active at Savi & Son Salvage in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu by 34 ABY. The diminutive biped was a charismatic leader who enjoyed supervising his fellow BDX units and developing plans.
A OOM command battle droid served the Confederacy of Independent Systems in the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars.

Grek was a BDX droid who was active at Savi & Son Salvage in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu by 34 ABY. The diminutive biped was shy, but with a keen attention to detail, which made her effective at cataloguing.
Oskar was a BDX droid who was active at Savi & Son Salvage in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu by 34 ABY. The biped was highly energetic and enjoyed pranks.

The Third Decennial Imperial Jubilee was a gala organized by the Palpatine Foundation and held on Alderaan in 2 BBY to celebrate the 30th Anniversary of Emperor Sheev Palpatine's election as Chancellor of the Republic.

A webberie co-op was a co-op of nine webberies based in Beldoni Valley, Ghorman. In 3 BBY, a broker for the co-op, Sunif Brecanti, travelled to the Ghorman capital of Palmo to represent the estates in a town hall.
A type of hive-mind beetle lurked in the service corridors of the First Death Star during its construction over the planet Geonosis between 14 BBY and 9 BBY.
The Wild Squadron was a rumored group of ghosts who scoured the stars each Life Day to collect the souls of the damned to join them in their unending hunt.
K'shar was a moon that existed somewhere outside of the jurisdiction of the Galactic Republic. A city was build in the hollowed inside of the rocky moon.
The Aspirant was a Republic Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship active in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars.
The Auxiliary Bay was a docking bay on the Achra Station, a space station located in the Akiva system. In 3 ABY, the docking clamps in the bay were fried and the whole system needed to be reset.

Nechrim's Wake, also known as Necrim's Wake, was a New Republic CR90 corvette led by Captain Gauvis during the New Republic. On the edge of the Fenril sector, it was attacked by Zantarrk Gang starships and forced to crash on Loradil.

Doric Prime was a planet that existed in the the galaxy. It was a mostly oceanic world, with few islands that harbored forests. A type of settlement was located near one of the islands and was supplied by a nearby hydro power plant.

Elkew-Nine was an IG-86 sentinel droid who worked alongside the bounty hunter Aurra Sing. Together with other IG-86 droids, Elkew-Nine was tasked with ensuring her security while she copied a list of Republic agents from Asajj Ventress at the Doric Prime power plant.

Ologage was city on the planet Ylagia. At the end of the Clone Wars, the city changed its allegiance from the Confederacy of Independent Systems to the newly-formed Galactic Empire as the Imperial Army entered the city.
A vortex moon orbited around the planet Ylagia, a world within a trinary star system.
Level fifty-ninety-one air race was an airspeeder race on Coruscant. In 20 BBY, Senator Bail Prestor Organa and Perrin Fertha attended the race in a private box.
Dead Man's Claim was an area of the Sayma Nebula near Hauler's Keep in the Wild Space Khepi system.
Digger's Charm was an area of the Sayma Nebula near Hauler's Keep in the Wild Space Khepi system.
The Scrap was a rocky area of the Sayma Nebula in the Wild Space Khepi system.
Mynock Lair was a rocky area of the Sayma Nebula in the Wild Space Khepi system that was home to a number of Mynocks.

Glassbreaker Way was located on the planet Coruscant. Around 19 BBY, the spy Chemish Runazha began monitoring the "4040s"—a pro-Galactic Empire activist group—and participated in their Separatist Reintegration Day protests.

The Irons was a neighborhood on the planet Coruscant. Around 19 BBY, the spy Chemish Runazha began monitoring the "4040s"—a pro-Galactic Empire activist group—and participated in their Separatist Reintegration Day protests.

Zephlin's Chrome was located on the planet Coruscant. Around 19 BBY, the spy Chemish Runazha began monitoring the "4040s"—a pro-Galactic Empire activist group—and participated in their Separatist Reintegration Day protests.

Rishon Street was located on the planet Coruscant. Around 19 BBY, the spy Chemish Runazha began monitoring the "4040s"—a pro-Galactic Empire activist group—and participated in their Separatist Reintegration Day protests.
The Selonian worker scandal was a political scandal pertaining to laborers of the Selonian species, otter-like sentient bipedals from the planet Selonia in the Core Worlds.

Leyoye Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Leyoye system in the Elochar sector of the Mid Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, Confederacy of Independent Systems operatives were contracted by the CIS to plant a bomb on a city in Leyoye Prime and escape.

objective: Plant a bomb in a city
x: The Mission on Leyoye Prime was an operation during the Clone Wars. Confederacy of Independent Systems operatives were contracted by the CIS to plant a bomb on a city in Leyoye Prime and escape.

The spikeworm was a type of worm native to the remote forest moon Treen. They were large in size with a brown, segmented body from which small spikes protruded. The worms also had a large, beak-like maw with a spiked tongue.
The Rhanipur Belt was an astronomical object in the Rhanipur system in the Hevvrol sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

The Strange Pillar was a pillar-like rock formation in the Pillar Forest area of the North Jundland Wastes region of the Outer Rim, desert planet Tatooine. Sometime before 3 ABY a Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier crashed into one of the Strange Pillar.
The SuperNovas were a criminal gang based in Coronet City, Corellia, during the New Republic Era.
An archivist droid was kept by the Alvadorjian Nahasta clan to record memories of the group and its members. The droid was cylindrical and able to hover three meters above the ground.

The Concentrated Care Unit was a room located on level 9 in Lina Soh Hospital. In 1 BBY, after Luthen Rael stabbed himself using the Nautolan bleeder, he was kept safe in this room with life support for his interrogation the next morning.

objective: Recruit members for the Partisans
x: An attack was carried out by Saw Gerrera's Partisans against Center One, a Galactic Empire reeducation facility in 19 BBY.
Kessel City was a city located on the planet Kessel.
A succession crisis on Chandrila erupted sometime between around 32 BBY and 19 BBY, rocking the Core Worlds planet Chandrila during the Republic Era.

An attack was staged in Hanna City, in Chandrila, by the Confederacy of Independent Systems in the early stages of the Clone Wars. The Separatists caught planetary defenses off guard, and jammed all transmissions as Chandrila attempted to send urgent calls to Coruscant.

The Death Star Summit, as designated in the Imperial Archives, was a high-level assembly of the Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military, convened in a conference chamber aboard the Death Star shortly prior to the obliteration of Alderaan in 1 BBY.

The junction station was a location on Starkiller Base. During the Battle of Starkiller Base, Rey and Finn sabotaged a junction box to allow Han Solo and Chewbacca to infiltrate Starkiller's oscillator structure.
The Assembly Area was a location on Starkiller Base.
The Interrogation Room on Starkiller Base was used by Kylo Ren to interrogate Rey.
In 19 BBY, a massacre took place outside of Cantham House, the official residency of Senator Bail Prestor Organa of Alderaan on Coruscant.
A task force of the Jedi Order was assembled in 132 BBY to travel to the planet Khofar to aprehend the assassin Mae-ho Aniseya.
The moon of Aster was a terrestrial moon that, according to the Theelin-human Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon, had a vibrant emerald ocean.

Human cultists were a type of cultist active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. When discussing the early rebellion with Axis network leader Luthen Rael, Saw Gerrera considered human cultists, along with the Partisan alliance and Ghorman Front, lost.
Tordus was a planet that was the homeworld of the Tordusian species.
Axiloth City was a city that belonged to the Axiloth civilization on the planet Tordus. By the time of the Galactic Republic, the city had turned into ancient ruins.
Xorfin were a type of giant fish found on the planet Tordus. They were dangerous and aggressive if approached.

The Sand Striker was a vehicle built by Lax Torios for planetary use on The Island of a planet. When Ros Okslad uncovered a crashed TIE striker, he loved the sandy look of it so much that he requested Lax Torios build him his own.
In 22 BBY during the Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic, Jedi General Mayanka Catrine departed from Outpost 716 for a mission.
R2-B0025 was an R2-series astromech droid that was present on the planet Corvus. The droid was painted in orange and black, with green and gold accents.
Tech Management was a field where staff of the Jedi Order operated in on the planet Coruscant in the Jedi Temple.
LEP-999, or "LEP" for short, was an LEP-series service droid that worked for the Hassarian Separatist general Kazameer.

terrain: Mountains out of stone, crystals and minerals
x: Siline was a planet located in the galaxy and was the homeworld of the Silinese species. The planet held a variety of biomes including forests of blooming pale-blue and green colored trees, grasslands, deserts, oceans, and mountains.

The Silinese were a sentient species hailing from the planet Siline. They had crystalline bones, facial horns and teeth and diverse vibrant skin colors with matching hair and eyes. Because of their physiology, they were stronger and tougher than many species, including humans.

x: The Attack on the Kassina Outpost was an assault performed by the Alliance to Restore the Republic and Kay Vess' crew on the planet of Akiva, within the Galactic Empire's facility of Kassina Outpost.

result: An injured Gayla Reen escapes with all data disks
objective: Retrieve data disks
x: During the Clone Wars between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems-aligned spy Gayla Reen carried out a mission to the planet Sullust in order to recover a collection of data disks.
Preene was a swamp planet located in the galaxy. During the Galactic Civil War, Luke Skywalker crash-landed on the planet and fought a Dragonsnake.
Hadlyn was a rocky planet located in the galaxy.
A type of bird lived on the planet Hadlyn. Its screeches could awake the native rock creatures.
A species of rock-like creatures lived on the planet Hadlyn. When awakened by a screech of a Hadlyn bird, the creatures would assemble from separate rocks into a humanoid shape.

A Crowning Convocation was held on the planet Siline in 134 BBY. The Jedi Padawans Jecki Lon and Yord Fandar participated in the Crowning Convocation and managed to stop a conspiracy during the great hunt.
A translator droid was utilized by the Wookiee criminal Lonkus on the planet Liskan during a trade dispute between the Trade Federation and the Gillanter Corporation.
Around 160 BBY, Jedi Master Vernestra Rwoh carried out an attack on the pirate group known as the Strafes on the planet Cerifisis.
Kryger was a terrestrial planet in the Kryger system in the Ado sector of the Mid Rim Territories where the Jedi Order operated a Jedi temple during the High Republic Era.

Crystal bats were a type of bat found in the Triple Moon Caves on the planet Siline. In 134 BBY, while visiting the caves, the Silinese Rhos Arthyst told Jedi Padawan Yord Fandar to watch out for both crystal bats and endangered dry-rock salamanders.
Dry-rock salamanders were a type of salamander found in the Triple Moon Caves on the planet Siline. During the High Republic Era, they were endangered.
The Moten yacht was the personal SoroSuub 3000 space yacht of the woman Cellia Moten.
A mission occurred to the planet Tryth during the Imperial Era.

Syrinxians were a cultural group of a horned species hailing from the Outer Rim planet Syrinx Prime. Between 40 BBY and 34 BBY, the Syrinxians went to war with the neighboring Vekurans, as the latter invaded Syrinx Prime following centuries of distrust and tension between the …

A sentient species existed on the Outer Rim planets Syrinx Prime and Vekura. The populations of this species hailing from these two planets formed two distinct cultural groups: the Syrinxians and the Vekurans.

result: Jedi Master Mace Windu and Jedi Knight Aayla Secura incapacitated

x: Between 40 BBY and 34 BBY, the assassin Corlis Rath and Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn engaged each other in a challenging duel on the agriworld of Mina-Rau.

An oversight board was active within the Galactic Empire during the construction of the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station. It was composed of six directors who reported directly to Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine's advisory committee.
Monnoc was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories in grid square N-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid. During the Nihil conflict, refugees fled Monnoc in fear of the Nihil raiders.

Pontus was an asteroid city situated in the Pontus system of the Outer Rim Territories' Tolonda sector. The city became part of the Occlusion Zone following its formation in 230 BBY and was sealed behind a barrier preventing hyperspace travel.

Solunus was a settlement on the planet Asternin in the Outer Rim Territories. Nine months after the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Solunus was raided by the Nihil. During their raid, they were successful in capturing the Jedi Grand Master Pra-Tre Veter.
Aggarda was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Aggarda system in the Metatessu sector of the Mid Rim Territories that the pirates Zilastra and Burlug once visited.

Tellion was a densely populated planet in the galaxy that was a well-known manufacturing and recycling world. It was part of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era, and was afflicted by the Blight in the final weeks of the Nihil conflict.

Estarvera was a planet in the galaxy that was home to at least one city. During the final weeks of the Nihil conflict, Estarvera was afflicted by the Blight, and much of its population unsuccessfully attempted to flee the world.
A little-known world was, by the time of the Galactic Empire, a colony of Nothoiin, a planet in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

objective: Find Azlin Rell
x: Around 228 BBY, Jedi Knight Reath Silas underwent a search for Azlin Rell. Azlin Rell, a former Jedi assisting in a mission to the planet Sophros, had escaped in a ship. Following the mission, a memorial service at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant was held.
Varovians were a sentient species from the planet Varovia. Naarok of the Varovian Order of Seers was a Varovian.
The trial of Marchion Ro was held around 228 BBY in the Galactic Republic's Senate Building on the planet Coruscant.

A shuttle was used by the Luminous Nine during their mission to the planet Sophros in 228 BBY to travel to the planet's surface from the Ataraxia. The shuttle landed safely on Sophros, but suffered immense damage to its systems and was unable to fly.

A type of wriggling creature was found on the planet Sophros. It was long and relatively thin for its length, and it was bright red in color. It had many legs and its underside consisted only of teeth.

t: Memorial service at the Jedi Temple
x: Around 228 BBY, a memorial service for those who had died in the Nihil conflict was held at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. The service was joyful, and hundreds of Jedi attended the service to honor the dead and laud their heroes.

A ship that belonged to the Jedi Barnabas Vim was later found on the planet Sophros by the former Jedi Azlin Rell, who used it to leave the planet. Aboard the ship, Rell found Vim's lightsaber and bled its kyber crystal.

A shuttle was used by the Drengir to leave the planet Banchii. The Drengir, who had a truce with the Jedi on Banchii, were given the ship by Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi in exchange for agreeing to help protect the planet.
N9 was a navidroid that served hyperspace prospector FalaFala Mo Dap during the High Republic Era.
TT-5T was a droid that served hyperspace prospector Trenwick Mashwick during the High Republic Era.

A terrestrial mining planet was the site of a chemical mine during the High Republic Era. The human Raf Thatchburn grew up on the planet and worked in the mine, which ultimately resulted in his lungs becoming shredded, forcing Thatchburn to wear a breathing apparatus.
Amaltanna was a planet within the Amaltanna system, a star system in the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Battle of Amaltanna was a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars on the planet Amaltanna.
The Atriik were a sentient species known to exist during the time of the Clone Wars. Members of the species possessed horns on the sides of their heads and mottled skin.

An oclatar was a many-tentacled creature found on the abandoned starship which contained the Tomb of Sarasti Thel, founder of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door. By 32 BBY, a nest of oclatars settled in the dark, depressurized interior of the ship despite the lack of atmosphere.

Kaltrais was a planet located in the Fenril sector of the Inner Rim Territories. By around 6 ABY, Tusvein Shoirin served as the president. Following his death, the Fenril Consortium took control of the planet.

A starship contained the Tomb of Sarasti Thel, founder of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door religious group. In the innumerable years since Thel's death, the ship had wrecked in an asteroid field, remaining there so long that it began to merge with the asteroids themselves.

Casino Yego was a casino ship that was located above Glee Anselm between 12 BBY and 9 BBY. In this time, the Seventh and Ninth Sisters met Eorgus aboard the ship to collect information regarding the whereabouts of Tensu Run.

Crax eels were a type of eel. At one point, the alien crime lord Sabi Sabo Acidy fed his brother to a pack of feral crax eels for a bottle of squig. Eventually the incident became known to the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra and New Republic Director Meteora Gray.
No earlier than 5 ABY, a six-month-long Expedition on Hoth was undertaken by the New Republic's Department of Artifacts and Archival Goods Retrieval on the Outer Rim planet Hoth.
Imynusoph was an astronomical object that was located in the Imynusoph system in the Kallea sector of the Outer Rim Territories in grid square J-21 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Holo-News buyout was an event between 5 BBY and 3 BBY that saw the HoloNet News bought out. In the past, the station had been independent but was directly taken over by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems, with the Gal…

Sinsara was a dangerous and minor planet in the Anoat sector within the Outer Rim. It had a mysterious connection with Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn's past. In the years before the Invasion of Naboo, the assassin Corlis Rath attempted to kill Jinn for a reason involving Sinsara.
A species of sentient bipedal species existed in the galaxy. One member of the species was the crime lord Sabi Sabo Acidy.
An Ot'oak, also known as a mole, was a burrowing creature native to Endor.
Tryth was a planet located in the Tryth system covered in mercury. The planet experienced ionic storms and mercurial rain.
The Campi were a sentient three-armed humanoid species that existed in the galaxy. Two members of the species were the emissaries Xiering and Stingxi.
A ship was utilized by the bounty hunter Quin Carree during the High Republic Era.
Broondas was a tropical planet where a separatist base was located.
The Flamsteed was a large utilitarian freighter in operation around the time of the formation of the Alliance to Restore the Republic in 2 BBY.
A BX-series droid commando was a BX-series droid a part of the personal entourage Cellia Moten at her estate. During or after 18 BBY, the droid was destroyed by Omega with a war hatchet.

A city was located on the Outer Rim Territories planet Mygeeto. It was a vast metropolis and featured a big spaceport. During the Clone Wars, battles had been fought in the city and heavy artillery strikes had damaged or destroyed many of it's buildings.
Dallow was a planet located in the Dallow system and the home of the Moten estate.

A sentient species was found to the planet Angcord, commonly described as the first Pilgrims of Angcord among the Angcord kingdom, and comprising the majority of the Pilgrim Warriors by 482 BBY. They had elongated heads, with blue skin, black or brown hair, and gray eyes.

Bareen was a terrestrial astronomical object that housed a distillery during the New Republic Era. Between around 31 ABY and 34 ABY, as the human racing team owners Lando Calrissian and Han Solo shared a glass of ale on the Mid Rim planet Malastare, Calrissian praised the qual…
See-Fordeeoh was a droid who served Han Solo during the New Republic Era.
A pirate group was active during the First Order-Resistance War. At one point they took part in a mission to acquire a Jedi text from a ship that was being consumed by a star.
Ravnok was a terrestrial planet where an Imperial base was located. In 9 ABY, Din Djarin and Grogu visited the abandoned base in search of spare parts and were attacked by a Rancor.
Oldo was a terrestrial planet where a rebel base was located.
Mohan was a terrestrial planet where a battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire took place.

In 18 BBY, a new dreadnought was introduced to the Imperial Navy after less than a year of construction. By the time of its inaugural launch from the construction and overhaul facility, however, the starship had already been labeled a placeholder.
A protocol droid was being used as a statue in homage to C-3PO in the Bright Tree Village on the forest moon of Endor.

Seezee was a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid employed as a tutor droid at the Gimm sisters' orphanage in the city of NiJedha, on the holy moon Jedha prior to the city's destruction in 1 BBY.
A service droid served food rations on board a 20-T Railcrawler conveyex transport transporting prisoners of the Galactic Empire to Kethmandi Prison by 13 BBY.
The Triple Moon Caves were located on the planet Siline. Crystal bats and endangered dry-rock salamanders lived in the caves.

Hopper Town was a dense, mixed residential and business neighborhood in the city of NiJedha, on the holy moon Jedha prior to the city's destruction in 1 BBY. Around that time, the origin of the name of the settlement had long been lost.
Oskatoon was a terrestrial astronomical object that existed within the galaxy during the New Republic Era.
The Nikto Gannis Ducain owned a starship which he operated around the world of Oskatoon during the New Republic Era.
Square of Stars was plaza in the city of NiJedha, on the holy moon Jedha prior to the city's destruction in 1 BBY. It was connected to the Blessing Way.
A settlement existed on the planet Kethmandi under Galactic Empire control by 13 BBY.
Kethmandi Prison was an Imperial labor camp on the planet Kethmandi. By 13 BBY, Corporal Estoc had delivered nearly 10,000 prisoners to the prison.
A viewing gallery was located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
The Jedi Temple's primary hangar was used by the Luminous Nine to load up the Nameless onto the Ataraxia.
A shuttle was used by the Other Nine to retrieve members of the Luminous Nine following their mission to the planet Sophros around 228 BBY.
During the Clone Wars of 22 BBY to 19 BBY, a battle took place on Metalorn involving the Galactic Republic.
The Intelligence and Armed Services Committee was a committee in the Galactic Senate that included Senator Tanner Cadaman of Feenix.
After nearly dying on Metalorn, the clone trooper Ponder was shuttled to an orbital clinic, where he recovered an received a new leg as well as orders to return to Kamino.
The Mountain Clan village was a series of cave dwellings established by the Mountain Clan in the mountains of the planet Dathomir. The village was led by a Matron.

In 4 BBY, Director of Advanced Weapons Research Orson Callan Krennic hosted a secret conference between various officers and employees of the Galactic Empire at a clandestine Imperial facility on the Maltheen Divide, a Mid-Rim planet located in the Trax sector.
The Sinsarans were a sentient species that was found on the planet Sinsara. Corlis Rath and Gara were members of this species.

Feleantor was an astronomical object with wide plains and enormous trees in the Outer Rim Territories that was the site of Rebel Base E322 during the Galactic Civil War. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Galactic Empire's forces discovered the base and attacked it.

Horford was a terrestrial world in the galaxy. Early in the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire's Task Force 99 operated on Horford and were celebrated by the population as liberators, but years later when they returned sometime before the Battle of Endor, the population h…
Maldran was a planet in the galaxy. A space station that was under the control of the Galactic Empire up until the end of the Galactic Civil War was located near Maldran.

Karimenen was an arboreal astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories. Years prior to the end of the Galactic Civil War, Lando Calrissian and the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca aided their Nagai friend Garlev in a mission to infiltrate a data nest on Karimenen.
Bevin Twelve was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Bevin system in the Rolion sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was ruled by a satrap.
Fasha IX was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Fasha system in the Colonies that was the site of the Heptathlon, a series of seven contests.

The Banished, formerly known as the Behru, were a group of exiles on the Anoat sector planet Sinsara who were driven out following an event known as the Horomeeda. They had no love for the Jedi Order, who were also banished from Sinsara following the Horomeeda.
Klathos was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Klathos system in the Chorlian sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Fracni was a small planet located near the Juinkwy Triangle, a confluence of hyperspace routes. The Jedi Wayseekers Ty Yorrick and Vernestra Rwoh once stopped pirates from scamming Fracni's populace with bootleg bacta, and Rwoh later reminisced that their conversation while re…
Ghalla was a terrestrial astronomical object in the galaxy that was the site of the Roundelay Trials, a civil war and ethnic cleansing that was perpetrated under the guise of a legal proceeding.
Killof was a terrestrial astronomical object in the galaxy. By around 160 BBY, artifacts bearing the dead language Fruscti were found on Killof.

Kilner's Seventh Moon was one of the moons of the astronomical object Kilner in the Cor'ric sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, a protocol droid on the moon of the planet Neral was selling a premium spice that originated from the Seventh Moon.
Kilner was an astronomical object in the galaxy that was orbited at least seven moons, including Kilner's Seventh Moon, which was the source of a premium spice in the High Republic Era.
Krugan was a frozen terrestrial astronomical object in the galaxy that only experienced a few months of temperate weather each year.

Tulpi was an astronomical object in the galaxy. During the High Republic Era, the father of a man was arrested by the Jedi Order for stealing credits from a banking ship, and was sentenced to imprisonment in a prison ship orbiting Tulpi.
Lanjer was a tropical jungle planet located in the Lanjer system in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated in grid square N-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Reylesh was an terrestrial astronomical object that was located in the galaxy and was part of the Galactic Republic. During the Nihil conflict, it was ruled by a queen and represented by Senator Nanders, and was not located within the Nihil Occlusion Zone.
Tyvish was an terrestrial astronomical object that was the site of the Wrevnick College of Agricultural Science during the High Republic Era.
Erdo was a mining planet in the Erdo system in the Kriz sector of the Outer Rim Territories, situated in grid square K-19 along the Lipsec Run hyperspace route.

x: A mission was undertaken to the planet Sinsara by Jedi Master Mace Windu and Jedi Knight Aayla Secura to find an antidote for the Emubara poison that had been administered to Qui-Gon Jinn by Corlis Rath on Mina-Rau between 40 BBY and 34 BBY.
Lissam was an astronomical object in the Lissam system of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of Turgle.

objective: Bouny hunting-related
x: The job on Mimban was undertaken by the human bounty hunter Imara Vex sometime prior to 9 ABY and her involvement with the Hunters of the Outer Rim, which resulted in her becoming cold and wet among the planet Mimban's swampy environment.
Hangar bay five was a hangar on the planet Mynos III. Dahara Devirsivik Norri landed her ship Sarlacc's Scorn there to meet with the Nihil who had taken over the planet.
Faydra was a town on the planet Mynos III.

Cyrus's workshop was located on the Outer Rim planet of Vuundalla during the High Republic Era. The workshop served as the pirate Taborr Val Dorn's base of operations, being where he stored his pirate gear when not in use.

Nagi was a planet that was the homeworld of the Nagai species. During the New Republic Era, a number of Nagai were forcefully removed from their homeworld to the planet Gadrilam by other members of the species.
A terrestrial world was the homeworld of the Force-sensitive human Vetna Mooncrest. According to Mooncrest, it was said on her world that peace did not exist without war.
By 382 BBY, during the High Republic Era, a yacht was owned by a female individual who served as queen of the Mid Rim planet Naboo.
BB-5 was a BB-wing droid starfighter created by Sig Greebling. It was piloted by Jedi Vader during a battle against Solitus, alongside BB-2 and BB-8.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Mokko was a member of the species.
This species was a sentient species. Turgle, a native of Lissam, was a member of the species.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Tulli Mu was a member of the species.

A town was located on the Outer Rim planet Ah Re Won. It was nestled between a beach and ancient Sith temple ruins. During the course of the local human woman Alma's life, the area grew from an unincorporated settlement into a town large enough to justify a mayorship.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Bhima Ook was a member of the species.

A starship was used by the Pirate King of Sector Nine to travel to a town on the Outer Rim planet Ah Re Won in search of their son, Prince Afolonkin. The pirate also brought a tank on the ship, which they used to gain the attention of local authorities.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Pili Walde was a member of the species.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Tulakt was a member of the species.

Lont bugs were a type of insect. Dahara Devirsivik Norri enjoyed eating them fried.

A near-human species lived in the galaxy. The species greatly resembled humans, but they had blue skin and dark blue hair. One member of this species was Zefin Tuzo, the owner of a resort casino on Marquinn. Her security forces were of her own species and were all female.
The Ballian were a small furry species that originated from the Balli system in the Outer Rim Territories. The brother of Maisie was a Ballian on the planet Metagos.
A bacta hot spring was a type of spring. The former Sith known as the Ronin was brought to a bacta hot spring to recuperate following a duel with the Grand Master.
Tallimar Prime was an astronomical object in the galaxy that was the home of the Ressad Dynasty which included the Tallimarian Centada Ressad.
Meddan was a terrestrial astronomical object in the galaxy that the bounty hunter Boba Fett pursued Samu Mavolak to during the Imperial Era.
Lulu was a droid owned by the Besalisk Joona. It was an old friend of the Jedi F.
Inoli was a terrestrial planet. It was the site of a carbonite mine. After earthquakes triggered a gas leak at the mine, a carbon freeze affected Inoli's population.

result: The shield relay unit is lost
objective: Steal a Imperial shield relay unit
x: After the hunt for Lyco Strata, the Theelin bounty hunter Latts Razzi led a heist at a shipyard on the astronomical object Cassaro to steal a Imperial shield relay unit.

result: Failure, Sebulba detained by Grakkus's criminal empire
objective: Steal credits from the Hutt colosseum
x: Around 10 BBY, Sebulba's crew attempted a heist at the Hutt colosseum on Nar Shaddaa. The heist failed, resulting in Sebulba being captured by Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi.

affiliation: Department of Artifacts and Archival Goods Retrieval
x: Deegee-Aytseven, nicknamed "Stripes" by Chelli Lona Aphra, was a modified GNK-series power droid in service to the Department of Artifacts and Archival Goods Retrieval.
To-Ba was a mobile gambling hall owned by Anzellan gangster Que-Dama and located within a AK-BK on the planet Olcatz. It was frequented by several individuals, including the Tonnika sisters.
Olcatz was a terrestrial planet with features such as mountains and islands.

Snowtrooper Ops, also known as Snowtrooper Operatives or Snowtrooper Scouts, were a group of specialized elite snowtroopers of the Galactic Empire. They specialized in stealth and in reconnaissance and scouting missions.
A starfighter was used by the Grand Master, who used it to travel to the planet Olcatz to find the former Sith known as the Ronin.
The planet Olcatz was put on lockdown by a Jedi known as the Grand Master in order to trap the former Sith known as the Ronin on the planet until the Jedi could find and kill him.

Winger was an assassin group active during the reign of the Galactic Republic. By 19 BBY, the bounty hunter Sevn contacted a Trandoshan about an assassin protocol she had installed in her droid partner IV-A4 that she was trying to remove.

Kaamui was a terrestrial planet that was the homeworld of the master of the droid Teto. At some point, Kaamui was destroyed by a war, and Teto escaped with his master aboard a starship designed to resemble the planet.
Ceezee was an RA-7 protocol droid with masculine programming who worked as a businessman.
A village was located on the snowy planet Joetz. After it was destroyed by the Galactic Empire, the rebel princess Crane rescued a survivor of the attack, the Gigoran child Woopas.

Oppressor was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that pursued the Jedi F. The Star Destroyer was captained by an admiral of the Imperial Navy and served as the flagship of Zero, formerly the Jedi Master known as Shad-Rah.
A Sheathipede-class transport shuttle was owned by the human Ron and was capable of being piloted by the droid Lulu.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were humanoid, with white skin, and a singular horn growing out of the left side of their forehead.
Tkoku Island was an artificial island on the planet Olcatz, accessible via the Tkoku Bridge. It was created by the Anzellan Que-Dama.

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were diminutive humanoids with long arms that nearly reached their feet, as well as wide mouths, upturned noses, and long, curved, fleshy points extending from the sides of their heads.

A gang of Rodians operated during the reign of the Galactic Republic. By 19 BBY, when the Sand Bird, the starship of the bounty hunter Sevn and her droid partner IV-A4, was attacked, Sevn asked if their attackers were agents of the Basham mercenary group, which IV-A4 confirmed.

A duel occurred on the planet Olcatz between the former Sith known as the Ronin and Aneé-san, the bodyguard of the Anzellan Que-Dama, after the Ronin's astromech droid companion R5-D56 caused a disruption in Que-Dama's gambling hall aboard an AK-BK walker.

A battle occurred on Tkoku Island on the planet Olcatz when the Crusaders, a radical Jedi sect led by the Grand Master, were lured there by the former Sith known as the Ronin and the associates of the Anzellan Que-Dama.

Winger's base was a base used by the assassin group Winger during the Republic Era. By 19 BBY, while leaving the planet Genya aboard their starship Sand Bird, the bounty hunter Sevn suggested to her droid partner IV-A4 that they earn some credits.

A skirmish took place on a battlefield sometime after the Ronin's rupture with the Jedi clans. Amidst rain and blasterfire, a Sith known as the Ronin dueled a Jedi who would later call himself the Grand Master, near some crates and a moisture vaporator.

A golden droideka owned by Zonus Corporation was at one point employed by businessman Jin-Sim Canbelon. The large droideka variant could be directly controlled by a human pilot. Canbelon used the droideka in his duel against the bounty hunter Sevn.
The Morenias Sabacc tournament held aboard the casino cruiser Morenia in 3 ABY. The tournament's grand prize was the coordinates to the hidden moon Okala Five.

A rocky moon of the jungle planet Akiva, which was located in the Akiva system within the Meerian sector of the Outer Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square O-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

A four-breasted species was a sentient humanoid species that existed in the galaxy. Around 9 ABY, a light-skinned, dark-haired female member of the species was present at Starport Borgo, performing solo dances as a door girl to attract customers to a local dance club.

The Explorator was a Dreadnought-class heavy cruiser under the command of Commodore Visler Aqorian Korda III of the Galactic Empire. The Explorator was shot down during the Battle of Jakku, killing Commodore Korda.

The Thrantha was a Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire that was under the command of Captain Torsal. During or after 18 BBY, the Thrantha intercepted a yacht owned by Cellia Moten after it received damage to its engines.
Between 19 BBY and 0 ABY, a duel occurred aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Oppressor between the Jedi F and her former master, Zero.
The oceanic delegation was a political group that Prince Flot of the Taisun Isle Royal Court had to write a speech as part of his coronation day.

The Crusaders used Low Altitude Assault Transport transport crafts at some point. When the former Sith known as the Ronin was found on the planet Olcatz by the Crusaders, thanks to a report by the Rodian bounty hunter Do N-Yuk, the Crusaders mobilized transport crafts to the p…

A town was built around a coaxium refinery on the moon Ro Mira in the Vergara system. The town was build in a cave underneath Ro Mira's ice sheets. The town had many businesses and, like often with refineries, it attracted lawlessness and corruption.
Yakuza was an organization. The Anzellan gambling hall owner Que-Dama was a Yakuza leader.

A cemetery existed on the planet Olcatz by the time of its lockdown by the radical Jedi sect known as the Crusaders. It contained dozens of tombstones and a large rock with an illustration of the Jedi known as the Grand Master and the Crusaders squaring off against Ewoks.
Adikaria was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Adikaria system of the Core Worlds and the Interior. It fell within grid square K-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The planet Olcatz had snowy mountains on its surface. The Anzellan Que-Dama ran To-Ba, a mobile gambling hall within an AK-BK that was at one point located in the mountains. A river could be found near the mountains.

The Sand Bird was a gunship used by the bounty hunter Sevn and her droid partner IV-A4. After the Sand Bird was damaged in an attack by Basham agents, Sevn and IV-A4 traveled to the planet Genya to make repairs, where they were hired by the businessman Jin-Sim Canbelon.

Basham was a mercenary group active during the Republic Era. An orphaned girl was kidnapped and raised by Basham and given the name Sevn by them. At the age of seventeen, Sevn betrayed Basham, and they sent agents after her on multiple occasions.

A Nihil crew was present in Slendo's during the occupation of Eriadu. The group of six officers were carousing in the back of the bar which annoyed the owner Slendo. After delivering a free round of Eriaduan ale to their table, they were shot dead by Slendo.

A Nihil group was present in Slendo's during the occupation of Eriadu. They entered the bar right after Slendo had killed a group of Nihil officers. They threatened him when the bartender told them his bar was now a no-Nihil zone. The group was killed by the patrons of the bar.

Mita was a terrestrial astronomical object located within the galaxy. The human female Sevn hailed from Mita, though she was orphaned during a war and eventually left the location by 19 BBY, temporarily serving as a mercenary for the criminal group Basham, before becoming a bo…

The sky-bellied leaf eels were a type of eel living on the planet Siline. It was a long creature similar to a snake. The skin on the eel's upper side was red while on it's underside it was a darker color that was almost royal purple.
The Special Forces Clone Trooper was a type of special forces clone trooper employed by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

result: The Zerek Besh spy is found and killed
Sliro Barsha secretly creates an alliance with Bib Fortuna
objective: Discover the identity of a Zerek Besh spy among Hutt Cartel ranks
x: During 3 ABY, Jabba the Hutt coerced the bounty hunter Vail Tormin and the outlaw Kay Vess to perform a mission in infiltrating Fort Sunfire, a stronghold of the Galactic Empire, in order to identify a Zerek Besh spy planted within the Hutt Cartel.

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The red-skinned species was diminutive and appeared humanoid, seeming to posses two arms and two legs, with rounded heads featuring only one mouth with elongated, circular lips, as well as two large eyes with smal…

A sentient humanoid species existed in the galaxy. Members of the species had large heads and green or pink skin. They had two small tendrils that danged from their upper lips, large black eyes, and lacked any visible nostrils.

A humanoid sentient species existed in the galaxy. Members of the species had tan skin with a pair of short, flesh-covered horns protruding from the upper fronts of their heads. They also had two pointed ears and could grow gray mustaches and eyebrows.

The Anzellan Que-Dama rode a modified mouse droid. The MSE series droid was equipped with a scrolling display screen and blaster armament, the latter being employed in a battle on Tkoku Island on the planet Olcatz.
5D6-RA-7 was an RA-7 protocol droid that served the Galactic Empire, and was aboard the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station shortly before its destruction during the Battle of Yavin.
The Rodian bounty hunter Do N-Yuk owned a fighter decades after the Sith rebellion. The starship docked to the AK-BK walker where the gambling hall To-Ba was located, on the planet Olcatz.

result: Sevn betrays Jin-Sim Canbelon and aids the insurgents
objective: Capture members of an insurgent group
x: By 19 BBY, Zonus Corporation CEO Jin-Sim Canbelon hired the bounty hunters Sevn and IV-A4 for a job and tasked them with capturing members of an insurgent group.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
objective: Investigate the Galactic Empire's movements on Joetz
x: Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, the Rebel Princess Crane performed reconnaissance on the planet Joetz to investigate the movements of the Galactic Empire after they landed near a rebel base there.
Kay's room was in the attic of The Broken Hoof bar on the planet Cantonica where the thief Kay Vess lived during the Imperial Era.

A tentacled armed alien was seen imprisoned within Jabba's Palace around the time of the Rescue of Han Solo. The alien reached its tentacled arm outside of its prison window and grabbed protocol droid C-3PO but was swatted away by a Gamorrean Guard.

A YT-2400 light freighter was used by the Rebel Princess Crane following the evacuation of a rebel base on the planet Joetz. Crane sat in the YT-2400 light freighter's cockpit with the rescued Gigoran child Woopas and spoke with Admiral Basil Kiucee via hologram.

A ship was used by Jedi Hunters as they pursued Juro's ship. The Jedi ship escaped, but the Jedi Lah Kara was blasted into space and eventually drifted to an abandoned ship. The Jedi Hunter ship arrived at the abandoned ship, where Kara was again able to escape the Jedi Hunters.

Juro's ship was a starship used by the Jedi Juro, Ethan, Lah Kara, and Homen. While being pursued by Jedi Hunters, Kara was blasted into space and left behind when the starship jumped to hyperspace to escape. The Jedi later returned to rescue Kara.
Lux's XS stock light freighter was a XS stock light freighter owned by Lux Bonteri during the Clone Wars, it was used to transport the Onderon rebels.
Sarnath was an ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid under the direct command of Confederacy of Independent Systems Head of State Count Dooku.
Ekabi Central was the vibrant electric town of Coruscant, an ecumenopolis entirely covered by Imperial City.

1211 was a level of Imperial City, the ecumenopolis that covered the planet Coruscant. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the TC-series protocol droid TC-99 considered 1211 to be a den of iniquity so bad that even the electronic thought of it made his heuristic processor…

A gang was active during the Republic Era. The group was originally led by Lazlo, after whose death Cad Bane emerged as the new leader. Other gang members included Arin, a Bith, Tay Grutty, and Vak Lako.
Arar-Toozero was a probe droid in service to Itai, a prospect to the Knights of Ren.
Menrec was a planet where a separatist base was located.

Mount Jobin was a mountain on the planet Genya. While the bounty hunters Sevn and IV-A4 were searching for members of an insurgent group, IV-A4 reported the group's last known location was Mount Jobin.
The Zonus Corporation had a defense force affiliated with it. The company's CEO, Jin-Sim Canbelon, offered a position as a commanding officer in the defense force to the bounty hunter Sevn.
An insurgent group operated on the planet Genya. Members of the group were once enslaved by the Zonus Corporation, but escaped and sought to free members of their families who remained enslaved.

Jin-Sim's protocol droid was a protocol droid that served Jin-Sim Canbelon, the CEO of the Zonus Corporation. The droid escorted the bounty hunters Sevn and IV-A4 to Canbelon's office, where he hired them for a job.

result: Governor Thorden acquires the encrypted coordinates of Okala Five
x: Forces for the Galactic Empire carried out a raid on a workshop used by the Starfallers criminal group on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY.

result: Siv and Torbi are successfully rescued
objective: Rescue Siv and Torbi from Parnassos
x: In 34 ABY, Resistance Spy Vi Moradi undertook a mission to rescue Siv and her daughter Torbi from the dying world of Parnassos, also the homeworld of First Order Captain Phasma.

The Eighth Brother's TIE fighter was a TIE/ad v1 starfighter used by the Eighth Brother, a Jedi hunter of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius. It was manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems sometime between 4 BBY and 3 BBY.
TC-99 was a TC-series protocol droid who served as personal assistant to Colonel Halland Goth, commander of the Imperial Royal Guard.
A pirate gang was led by Fox-Ear and operated on the planet Tatooine. Its members included Gura, Riku, and several alien underlings.
A triangle droid lived with the child Yuko and accompanied him when he rescued the droid BILY from pirates.
The red hold was the largest of the four holds on the Gaze Electric. In 228 BBY, Marchion Ro had Ghirra Starros met him there to discuss his plans.
JN-47 was a bipedal droid who, between 232 and 230 BBY, damaged his vocabulator beyond repair. JN-47 then went to Dotti's Droid Workshop in Kublop Springs on the planet Tenoo for maintenance.

An antechamber was a room deep inside the Jedi Temple. It had heavy doors and air vents high up in the walls. It was on the same level as high-security detention cells that the Jedi Order used to hold dangerous prisoners, including a dozen Shrikarai.

objective: Locate Aquint Garva in order to know more about Corlis Rath
x: Between 40 BBY and 34 BBY, the human Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Tensu Run embarked on a mission to locate the information broker Aquint Garva on the moon K'shar to learn more about the Sinsaran Corlis Rath.
A starship was used by a pirate gang led by Fox-Ear. The pirates used the starship to attack the home of the child Yuko.
A starship was used by Bennet Sten and Myler Sten, who brought food and medical aid to those in need across the Outer Rim Territories. They both died and left the starship to their son Yuko.

t: Destruction of the Kingdom of Biwaji
result: The Kingdom of Biwaji is destroyed
x: During the Imperial Era, the Kingdom of Biwaji was destroyed by the Galactic Empire using All Terrain Armored Transports. The kingdom's princess, Crane, survived and became a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

objective: Find and open a vault on the planet Vandor
x: During the First Order-Resistance War, the Knights of Ren went on a mission to raid a vault located in the cold planet of Vandor under the orders of their new leader Tava Ren.
A starship was owned by a bounty hunter. The hunter used the starship to pursue Arluu, the prince of Zenarita's royal family.

objective: Retrieve treasure stolen by Bennet and Myler Sten
x: The pirate captain Fox-Ear began a search for treasure stolen from him by Bennet and Myler Sten at some point no earlier than 1 BBY.

result: Kay Vess and Gedeek Obaz successfully escapes from the Imperial facili
objective: Extract Gedeek Obaz from Research Station 57
x: During 3 ABY, Kay Vess' crew rescued the Rodian droidsmith Gedeek Obaz from the Imperial facility of Research Station 57, in order to recruit a crewmember that can surpass the droid gatekeeper of Westhill Palace, the place of which they intended to perform a heist in.

Ba'ken's entourage droid served as a levitating guard droid for the alien Ba'ken on the planet Zenarita. It had red sensors on a cylindrical grey-plated head and body with an orange-colored sphere protruding from the bottom.
A city was located on the planet Inoli. During the Imperial Era, a groundquake released carbonite gas from a nearby carbonite mine, and the city was frozen by a storm of carbonite.
The warru'zan, the bloodhalls, was a location on the planet Kalee. At some point, the Kaleesh elders had indoctrinated Sidon, later known as the Delphidian pirate Sidon Ithano.

Chita's ship was a YV-865 Aurore-class freighter owned by the smuggler Chita. When the planet Zenarita was occupied by the Galactic Empire, Chita was hired to bring the planet's prince, Arluu, to safety.
Mining Guild Field Recruitment was a subgroup of the Mining Guild. They were the contact information on a job listing for a "Heavy Equipment Technician" at Vergesso Prime.

result: Tava Ren is allowed to escape the Finalizer.
x: During the First Order-Resistance War, Supreme Leader Kylo Ren had a duel aboard his flagship the Finalizer with the new leader of the Knights of Ren, Tava Ren.

A terrestrial world was home to a city during the Imperial Era. During or after 18 BBY, the Theelin bounty hunter Latts Razzi and her companion C-21 Highsinger hunted and killed a four-armed alien on the world.

A bustling city was active on a world during the Imperial Era. During or after 18 BBY, the Theelin bounty hunter Latts Razzi and her companion C-21 Highsinger hunted and killed a four-armed alien in the city.

By between 2 BBY and 0 ABY, the planet Zenarita was occupied by the Galactic Empire. Zenarita's royal family had begun to question the state of the galaxy following the rise of the Empire, and they were imprisoned for conspiring against it.
A type of bat with brown hair and gouging eyes existed in the galaxy. During the New Republic Era, one such bat was present on the planet Nevarro, being perched on the shoulder on a human.

A gold reptilian creature accompanied with neck frills existed in the galaxy. During the New Republic Era, a magician used one such creature for a magic trick in Monument Plaza on the planet Coruscant.
A millipede was a type of creature that existed in the galaxy. During the New Republic Era, a gold eyed millipede was present in the Shipyard Depot on the planet Coruscant.

A gold eyed millipede was a type of millipede that existed in the galaxy. During the New Republic Era, one such millipede, roughly the size of a rat, was present in the Shipyard Depot on the planet Coruscant.
A Bird of Paradise was a type of reptavian. The Jedi Padawan Nakime wore earrings resembling them. During a spiritual trial, Nakime saw several of the creatures fly past her.
A blue bird species was native to an astronomical object during the Imperial Era. During or after 18 BBY, the Dathomirian Asajj Ventress fed several birds food outside of a transport office.

Naos III was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Naos system within Wild Space. It was the location of a slave pits and an Imperial shipyards manufacturing MTV-7. At one point, the shipyard was struck by Y-wings.
A terrestrial desert world was home to a species, alongside a grandfather and his granddaughter during the Imperial Era.
A Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought was used by the First Order during their assault on the planet Naboo in 34 ABY.

The F'cote District was a district located on the Hutt Space moon Nar Shaddaa. During the Imperial Era, the Shawda Ubb information broker Sheraxx Quorsha operated in the district and was tracked down by the bounty hunter Boba Fett for information on the Kajain'sa'Nikto Corm Va…
An archaeological site was located on Ash Moon 1. Korin Aphra worked there and was contacted by Boba Fett who asked him to identify a tattoo on a dismembered hand.

t: Unidentified DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid (Darth Maul)
n: Unidentified DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid
x: A DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid was sent by the Sith Lord Darth Sidious to observe his Sith apprentice Darth Maul on tasks Sidious' would send the apprentice on.
A species that existed in the galaxy. This bipedal humanoid sentient species was distinguished by the row of horns that extended from their forehead up and over the top of their craniums.
The Son of Suns was a small spaceship, a flying antique during the age of the Galactic Empire.

A thorn lizard was a type of lizard found on the planet Siline. In 134 BBY, during the survival level of the Crowning Convocation coming-of-age ritual on Siline, the human Lionine Graf looked out over a forest canopy around dusk and heard birds screaming and a strange, piercin…
A droid worked at a hotel on the Outer Rim planet Ah Re Won alongside another droid between around 40 BBY and 32 BBY.
A droid worked at a hotel on the Outer Rim planet Ah Re Won alongside another droid between around 40 BBY and 32 BBY.
By 40 BBY, a job was carried out on the Hutt Space planet Nal Hutta by the Devaronian Coir Cion, where he ended up encountering the Rodian criminal Aro who eventually remained beside Cion.
A rain skink was a type of poisonous amphibian found on the planet Siline. After rain, they crawled out of certain trees and secreted a venomous oil through their skin.
The survival arena was an area on the planet Siline where the survival level, the second round of the Crowning Convocation coming-of-age ritual, was held.
A cantina was present on the planet Zenarita. The alien Ba'ken lounged in a booth of the cantina when the human Chita confronted him. The Cerean former Jedi Gleenu was also a patron of the cantina.

A DT-series sentry droid was active and operated on the planet Mustafar in the year 34 ABY. During that time, the sentry droid and several others pursued the human Kylo Ren, but was eventually cut down by the intruder.

In an incident related to the alleged death of a naval inspector in 5 BBY, the Galactic Empire blockaded shipping lanes to the Ghorman system on orders from the Imperial Ruling Council, including council members Ars Dangor and Sly Moore.

A breakaway sect of the B'omarr Order of monks made up of murders and thieves believed they escaped their sins in life by "ascending," which consisted of removing their brains and placing them in B'omarr brain walkers or even non-walker equipped brain jars.
Lakeetahs were creatures found exclusively in the grasslands of the Outer Rim planet Tenoo. They were known for their speed and always traveling as a family unit.

Blue Meekas, sometimes referred to as meekas, for short, were playful creatures found within the Blue Forest on the planet Tenoo. Meekas were drawn to shiny objects such as holocameras and would try to take them.

A pentabat was a small creature that lived on Sophros. They had five legs and small wings that were tipped with claws. Their shell was hard and iridescent. They attacked in swarms and left a smell of burnt sulfur when ignited.

Vorill serpents were a species of serpents that could be found on the planet Jakku. During the New Republic Era, the smuggler Han Solo and his accomplice Chewbacca encountered several serpents in a lair owned by the Crolute Unkar Plutt.

Corellian sting-gnats were a type of gnat that shared their name with Corellia, a Core Worlds planet. In 230 BBY, during the High Republic Era, the starship known as the Vessel traveled to the Echerta system in the Outer Rim in an attempt to make a faster journey to the Galact…

A yacht was owned by Ullan Yite, the leader of the Bright Circle criminal organization. Yite attempted to escape to his yacht after an illegal weapons deal he was involved in was infiltrated by the Jedi Rooper Nitani and Silandra Sho, but it was sabotaged by the droid P3-7A, w…
A yacht was owned by the Sullustan Piralli, who had taken ownership of it to settle a debt and worked on rebuilding it using salvaged and purchased parts over the course of eight years.

Sentinel One was a toxic volcanic planet with dark rocky terrain located in the galaxy. Covered in bright yellow rivers of acid and once plundered for minerals, Sentinel One was the location of huge antennas that littered the planet's landscape, collectively making up a planet…
The council room was a room located in the Great Temple on the moon Yavin 4.
Brel was a planet located in the Tsevuka system in the Cademimu sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Merchant Uprising was massacre that took place on the planet during the New Republic Era.
Rikmania was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Steniplis sector within the Outer Rim Territories. The Rikmania way station was located there.
Grong beetles were a type of isopod that existed in the galaxy.

HLE-3, also known as Ellee, was a cobbled together droid, made with a PIP droid and a GNK-series power droid, that was owned by the female Besalisk Emm'jai. In 28 ABY, the droid was repaired by the human scavenger Rey, which delighted Emm'jai.
The 157th level of Lothal's Imperial dome housed the complex's administrative offices, including Governor Arihnda Pryce's office, which was found in D block.
Garasu was a crystalline planet where a Republic base was located.
Apexx was an droid built by Rek Minuu who became sentient. Apexx was strong and fast.
Kroa birds were a type of bird found exclusively on the planet Batuu in the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The birds had four, featherless, yellow wings and a featherless tail.
An emotional-support droid existed during the High Republic Era. After being kidnapped by 235 BBY, the human female Avon Starros spent time visiting the emotional-support droid.
The Twilight Explorer was a starship affiliated with the Jedi Order that was lost at the bottom of Lake Paonga, on the Mid Rim planet Naboo.
Minmo was a droid created by the droidsmith Rek Minuu sometime before or during 230 BBY. They were a smaller version of a spider droid model also made by Minuu.
A mygora was a large type of creature that could be found on the planet Bracca. The creature had four brown eyes, were a blue-green color, and had a clubbed tail they used to attack enemies.
A festive astromech droid was active in the galaxy. At some point, the droid was with the foundling Grogu.

Portwoo was a terrestrial planet mentioned in Oolon's Star Almanac, a catalog of fictional planets that it claimed were cataloged by its author, Oolon, during his travels. According to the almanac, it was the site of the throne room of the King of Ash.
Craydor was a terrestrial planet located in the galaxy, where Landonis Balthazar Calrissian confronted Faul Odantil after he sold him a defective ship.
Eeka was a terrestrial planet located in the galaxy. After the Battle of Endor, Landonis Balthazar Calrissian delivered a shipment to Eeka as part of a race with Han Solo.

The Calrissian's Comet was a YT-2400 freighter that Faul Odantil sold to Landonis Balthazar Calrissian. After discovering that its systems were not functioning properly during a race with Han Solo, Calrissian returned the ship to the seller.
Bisnus were a type of small, quadrupedal, egg-laying creature that could be found in the junkyards on the planet Bracca. They had purple skin, green eyes, and gray fur.

A flying type of creature was found on the gas giant Sterna IV. Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, several of these creatures flew around an Imperial factory facility on the gas giant while the bounty hunter Boba Fett broke out a human bounty to deliver to the criminal Tusk on the world…

An RA-7 protocol droid served the criminal Tusk on the world Ergeshui during the Imperial Era. Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, the protocol droid gave the bounty hunter Boba Fett credits after he had delivered a human bounty to Tusk.

result: Boba Fett successfully rescues the bounty
objective: Breakout a human bounty on Sterna IV from an Imperial factory facility
x: During the Imperial Era, a breakout occurred on the gas giant Sterna IV, in which the bounty hunter Boba Fett successfully rescued a human bounty from the Imperial factory facility on the gas giant to deliver to the criminal Tusk on the world Ergeshui.
In 134 BBY, Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon was rescued from a group of mercenaries on the planet Siline.
A group of mercenaries was led by the human Orisent on the planet Siline.

A droid bounty hunter attempted to capture R2-D2 and BB-8 for a bounty of 10,000 credits while they were traveling through a desert canyon to a junk shop to purchase a replacement part for the Millennium Falcon.

A Starlight Run was hosted on Romakka Nebula Station in the Calzag system during the Galactic Civil War. Smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca returned to defend their title after winning a previous race.
Gigantica was an asteroid located within the Calzag system. During a Starlight Run, Han Solo and Chewbacca had to navigate through the asteroid while running from Boba Fett.

A planet located in the Calzag system was the homeworld of a clan of Gamorreans. Believing he was pursuing the Millennium Falcon, bounty hunter Boba Fett landed on the planet, where he was attacked by the clan.
Hyban was a moon located in the Calzag system. Competitors in a Starlight Run were required to navigate through the moon.

Janix Civil Defense HQ, also known as Police HQ, was the headquarters for the Tactical Defense Force, a police agency that operated out of Janix city, on the planet Janix during the Imperial Era.
The Tactical Defense Force (TDF) was a law enforcement agency that operated out of Janix city's Janix Civil Defense HQ on the planet Janix during the Imperial Era.

The dressing rooms were a series of rooms found within the Grand Arena on the planet Vespaara where the contestants known as Hunters could store all of their belongings, and prepare for demonstrations.

Bogachi was a terrestrial astronomical object in the galaxy that was the site of a town during the High Republic Era. The Jedi Kai Brightstar and Bell Zettifar visited Bogachi to rescue the missing charhound Ember.
Rive was a terrestrial moon that was located in the Butler system.
Hadne 3 was a tropical moon located in the galaxy that was run as a retreat as a collective venture by the executives of several major corporations.
Sardich was a terrestrial planet located in the Sardich system of the Unknown Regions. It was the location of Cluost City as well as a Senator's mansion.
The Unseen were a group of exploited workers on the planet Urubai during the Clone Wars.

Cochukka, or cochukka sheep, were a species of sheep raised by shepherds on the planet Pkori.

This EG-6 power droid was one of many droids owned by the team of Jawa brothers known collectively as the Hunter Utooni. It featured an orange and blue exterior, with dark gray legs, gray and black components, as well as glowing green and red buttons and other elements.

H8-U411, or H8 for short, was a murder droid that had tried to start a galaxy-wide purge of all organics. The droid's core and voice modulator was salvaged by Reveth and rewired into a red-painted, physically helpless MSE droid for laughs.
Ceewags were creatures found roaming on the planet Malastare. One member of the species was Ba'zhu
A foraging mission to the planet Naboo was conducted by a group of Jedi Padawans led by Jedi Knight Bavoc Ansho and accompanied by a Jedi Master.
During the Clone Wars, Jedi Knights Tualon Yaluna, Charlin Plaka and Jedi Master Bavoc Ansho undertook a mission to the planet Kamino.
An astronomical object was the home of the sacred tree forest. A Jedi Master and his Padawan Nakime fought the Sith apprentice Aman on the world.

The Marketplace was a location on The Island of a planet where multiple shops were set up. The shops at the Marketplace were Doktut's Divinities, Grinoto's Goods, a barbershop owned by Floid Burbakk, and a clothing store owned by Sezuke Yanzec.

A blue-winged mink was a type of creature with blue wings. In 134 BBY, while Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon was training in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, she scrambled through a rope-and-bar course and mentally compared her speed and grace to that of a blue-winged mink's.

The meditation retreat was a meditation area that was located on the cruiser Voyager Dawn, being utilized by elderly Jedi of the Jedi Order.
